I just moved to Philadelphia, and my sister and I went out trying to taste some of the more trendy places to eat.  We both were very skeptical of eating here, and wondered how good Pan-asian food really could be, but decided to suck it up and see what all the fuss was about.... We were nothing short of blown away!  Here are my notes from the evening:
1.  Service:  Our server was very helpful in helping us decide what to order and on warning us how big the portions are.  I also loved that the bottle of wine did not sit on the table, which is a pain for the server but he did a very good job.
2. Food Ordered: edamame ravioli - My new favorite thing in the world!  A MUST order.  House salad- big enough portion for two, and it was pretty good, I'm just not a huge salad person.  Lobster fried rice- I did not like this at all, again portion was big enough for two, but the soy sauce is a little sweet for my liking, so I felt like I ruined it by adding the soy sauce.  Butter Poached Lobster- SO SO good! Again, we shared this because the portions are so big.  The sauce it is in was delicious. Dessert- Chinese donuts, which I did NOT want to order because I do not like them normally... and well, I ate 3 of these when they came to the table.  The cream, chocolate, and what seemed to be a raspberry truffle sauce... outstanding.
3. Atmosphere:  A little close to the table next to us, but we also showed up late for our reservation, which they were very nice about.  The decor is VERY impressive and very hip... It is a place you could take anyone into and they would be impressed by how cool it is and very romantic at the same time.
4. Price:  WORTH EVERY PENNY!  The portions were so big, with two people the bill was only $120.  Keep in mind the $120 included a $50 bottle of wine.  So we got wine, salads, appetizer, two entrees, and dessert for that.  And walked out stuffed.  
5. Summary:  GO! And if you don't get the edamame ravioli, you will regret it! I can't wait to go back and try more stuff!!

My five star rating is for one reason and one reason only:  The Persian Sandwich they have is the best sandwich I've ever had in my life!  I got the lamb one, and a friend of mine got the chicken one, which we easily could have split one because they are huge!  You have to try it!!! 
I hate hookah bars because of the smoke and refuse to go in them, but trust me... it is worth it.  It is just a little cafe style restaurant that is family owned, not really my scene but that sandwich... seriously... Go NOW!  
Oh and it's a BYOB just in case anyone was wondering. :)

It was good, but I expected a little more having just eaten at two other steven starr restaurants.  It was probably my fault for ordering sushi and not one of the other dishes, but as far as I'm concerned, I could get the same quality of sushi when I lived in the midwest. The decor was pretty cool, annoying that the lamp in the middle of the table doesn't move, but as long as you aren't sharing it's not a big deal.  The walls changing color were really awesome.  I am going to go back and give it another try but from what I ordered (shrimp tempura, sushi platter, house salad, tarte dessert), I would have given it two stars because it was overpriced for what I got.  The decor and food presentation were easily a 4 star but I just couldn't give it 4 stars because of the food.

The food was ok, but considering a few days before I went to another similar restaurant in Chinatown and the food was cheaper and better... I can't really say I'll be coming back to it.  The friend I was with said the service was a lot better last time but when it was terrible this time.  They took forever to come to our table, never took a drink order, and when it came time to pay the check, they were all sitting at a table reading the newspaper, not paying attention to any of the customers.  They seem like nice people, but if I'm going to pay more for food, I expect better service to come with it.

After a rough Saturday night, a few friends and I decided to walk here and check it out.  It was very diner-style but the food was really good for sunday brunch... I had the huevos rancheros and it was good.  I was actually most impressed with the drinks- having been a high-end bartender for several years, I am very picky about my drinks... and they were amazing! We had a bloody mary, key-lime pie martini, and my favorite, the STRAWBERRY BASIL CAIPIRINHA.  The espresso martini was pretty good, and I don't know if I tried my friend's mimosa or not.  Anyway, everyone like the meals, and well... we left brunch needless to say- a little tipsy.  
Service was great, very friendly staff who appeared to be having a good time. I can't really comment about prices, but I know the three of us spent over $100 total, but mostly because we had so much to drink. :)

I went to both this one and the rittenhouse one within two weeks of each other.  Happy hour in Old City, food was decent but the service was terrible.  Now don't get me wrong, the server/bartender was very sweet, but they were obviously understaffed.  Then the one in Rittenhouse I went for Friday night cocktails and the bartender was terrible.  I am not sure how you mess up a margarita with patron, grand mar, and sour in it, but she did... badly.  We choked down our 3 drinks that cost $50 and left with a very bad taste in our mouths.  The atmosphere on the roof was awesome!  But again, understaffed and well, the space was awkward because of the tightly packed seats surrounding the bar making it almost impossible to order drinks through people sitting.  Of all the steven starr restaurant I have been to, this was by far the worst one.  I think the food was very good, but the management here apparently does not know what they were doing.  I'm sure I'll go back and give it another try, but for the issue both times at both locations to be "staff issues", it makes me think the restaurant could be amazing if they just fixed their front of the house issues. 

Summary:  Good food, decent prices. Drinks... whoever bartends at Jones needs to come teach the rittenhouse location a thing or two.

First day I moved to philadelphia this is where I ate for dinner.  It was terrible, and I was really disappointed.  The waitress was rude and pretty much didn't even come to our table because she thought we were two college girls who would't tip her well.  I am SO glad I didn't let that keep me from going back.  
My sister came to visit me this past week and we went there for Saturday morning brunch, it was AMAZING.  We both had the spanish dishes, and they were so good.  Very unique and not too filling.  The bartender who was acting as our server bc we opened up the restaurant was extremely nice and probably the nicest I've seen in Philly.  It isn't expensive, and still offers the old city charm.  I would recommend anyone to eat hear for brunch.

Summary- Brunch is 5 stars for service and taste. Dinner is a whole different animal....

I have been craving crab rangoon... and due to rain, I was looking for a place that delivered.  It is strangely hard to find places in chinatown that do crab rangoon so I decided to try this place. 
Mediocre at best.  I have been spoiled by being so close to chinatown apparently, and no know that a 2 star in chinatown is equal to a 4 or 5 star outside of chinatown.  
I ordered shrimp lo mein... which looked so good.... way more generous with amount of shrimp and food in general than most places.... but it was bland.  I didn't know that was possible for chinese food... and even after dumping a pound of soy sauce on it, I still didn't like it.  The crab rangoon was not very good, but I haven't found any good crab rangoon since living in philly.   My advice... if you want delivery, order from "the Chinatown restaurant" ... kinda hard to find, and it may not be the best chinese food in chinatown, but it delivers, is cheap, and is way better than this place! If you don't need delivery...  go to David's Mai Lai Wah... that place is everything you want in a cheap chinese restaurant! Well, except crab rangoon.

I would say for old city, it is the best place to get groceries.  Though it is a little expensive, and somewhat limited, for it's size, you can usually get what you need.
They don't have a ton of meat selection, but their deli is not bad.  But as long as you don't need chicken, hamburger or seafood... they will most likely have it.  
Summary:
1. If you are in old city and need something fast- this is the best place to go
2. If it's before 6pm and you need produce- go to reading terminal just about 8 blocks away... you'll save the money the taxi costs
3. owners are really nice, and work pretty hard to keep the place stocked and clean
4. prices are not cheap, but it's cheaper than eating out (most of the time)
5. No alcohol... mulberry market is the closet place for beer...

I eat at a lot of chinatown places, and this is my favorite.  
It is good, cheap chinese food... just the way it was intended to be made! I have no had one bad thing from there yet.  AND it is open really really late.

Things I like:  Shrimp Egg rolls, egg drop soup, all the fried rices, shrimp lo mein, shrimp with vegetables, and well... everything else they have.  Their spicy food is every good and I usually hate spicy food!
+ they take credit cards (rare for chinatown)
+ Cheap, dirt cheap
(-) they don't deliver... which is probably good or I would be eating here way too much!!!

I've been waiting a long time to do a review here bc I wanted it to be just right, seeing as how I eat here at least 3 times a week :)  So here it goes:

(+)Things you MUST try:  
   1)French Toast (SO SO good)
   2) Grilled Chicken Sandwich... my favorite AND it warms up great if you don't eat it all!!
   3) Hummus- the best I've had in the city
   4) Spiced Chai Tea - You will NOT find chai tea this good anywhere else, make sure you get it with whole milk and I usually ask them to go a little light on the cream.

(-)Things that don't do the place justice:
     1) Tuna salad sandwich- bread is kinda hard
     2) breakfast burrito- least favorite thing there, mostly bc I feel like        the salsa is more like tomato paste than salsa

Overall:
(+) great prices considering the quality of food
(+) WAY better than the starbucks down the street
(+) Serves breakfast til 2pm EVERY DAY
(-) close somewhat early
(-) no A/C in the summer
(-) Not a lot of seating bc of popularity, I always get my stuff to go, but 90% of the time it's not a problem

And given those last three negatives which are huge to me, I still think it is the best cafe I've been to.  Go now!  And order the chai tea!

This place is really great for sushi!  I haven't eaten there that much so I can't give it 5 stars yet, but I liked the sushi here better than at morimoto.  I have had the sushi roll combo platter a few times now, and each time it is just as good as the first.  The prices aren't cheap but they aren't bad either... but so far this is the best sushi I've had in philly.  Can't wait to actually take advantage of the BYOB and try even more stuff here!

Recommendation:  A VERY safe bet for good sushi!

Four stars for drunken late night pizza.  I'm not sure I would give it four stars sober... but at 3am... this place is great!
I usually prefer real Italian thick cheeses on a thin crust, but for what I have found to be the "philly style" pizza, the chicken ranch pizza here is pretty awesome.  
I didn't like the BBQ chicken pizza, and they didn't have any seating at 3am but I'm not sure if that is true all the time... plus with a line out the door... it's kinda hard to have seating. 
The door guy is pretty funny too... never really seen a pizza place with a bouncer, but hey, whatever works :)

Overall- great late night pizza... get chicken ranch, it's the best!

Keep in mind I went for restaurant week lunch:

I thought this place was decent, but wasn't really sure what all the fuss was about when I went.  I had a mediocre lunch which included sqash soup, ravioli, and a tarte.  The tarte was amazing though.  And as tempted as I was to give it a 3 star rating, my roommate went that night for dinner and came back saying how amazing it was.  She had tried one of the steak dishes, and us being from the midwest, we can not find good steak out here... so if she said it was good... it was good.  Especially considering how the night before she had complained about the steak at butcher and singer.  So as hard as it is for me to make a rating off of something I did not try, I trust her opinion 100% when it comes to steak. I will update my rating once I try it, but as of now, I couldn't give it three stars after hearing her rave about it...

Awesome melasian food!  I went here with a friend of mine who is Melasian... and he helped our whole group order.  The indian pancakes were SO SO good!  Everything everyone ordered was good except for the pho (or something that looked like pho).  I ordered my shrimp lo mein without spices and it was very very good.  They weren't the fastest place, but other than that... one of the best places in chinatown for sure! I plan on going back very soon and will add more...

Walked in here accidentally thinking it was one of the other sweet shops with a 5 star rating.  The worst service I have ever seen in chinatown... and there are some places with BAD customer service! We walked in, were ignored for the first 10 minutes while whoever was behind the counter was finishing making whatever sweet they were working on.  We were the only people in here, and it makes sense now.  After my friend tried to get her attention 3 times, and was ignored, I pretty much had to keep her from making a scene.  Reluctantly, we still got a few things because we really wanted to see what all the fuss was about... and well, it was obvious after my first bite into my apple crisp and her cookie that there was no way possible we had gone to the right place.  So in other words, even if you are desperate, don't go here...

Call ahead and they will bend over backwards to accommodate you!

This is a family owned BYOB that is great.  They will keep your drinks in the back and try to make sure they stay chilled for you, the food is not your standard menu and is really good.  I ordered the tomato and shrimp pasta, I forget the name, but it was good... not amazing by any means but not bad.  Everyone else seemed to enjoy their dishes a lot more than me and overall we had a great time.  The prices were decent and I think it is a great place to try, especially for the atmosphere.  One of the best BYOBs in the city!

This place is a great basic sushi restaurant.  The small menu is very fresh, good portioned, and yummy!  They didn't have a ton of options, and the booths are very small, which are the main reasons I didn't have it five stars.  Favorite roll was the philly roll, and I liked that it was a BYOB.  Only advice, if you are sitting in a booth, be careful because it is very easy to hit your head against the person behind you.  Oh and the ceiling aren't 6'0... they are probably 7'0.. so don't freak out if you are 6'2 or anything... you'll be fine.

Worst delivery service I've ever had (and I order 90% of my meals).  I was 0.4 miles away- even used grubhub to order bc they are awesome at making sure everything is right and on time.  They took an hour and half to get here, 40 minutes after the grubhub time which NEVER happens.  THen their customer service even called them and said they left 15 minutes ago- and my food showed up 30 minutes later.  Apparently it takes 45 minutes to go 0.4 miles.  Not to mention I had a VEry simple appetizer order that probably look 5 minutes to make (cheese fries and sampler).  Grubhub was awesome about it but this place won't ever get my business again.... Only wish john's place was open on sundays :(

Oh and if that's not enough- the food was not good at all.

My favorite cheap delivery place!!! They have the BEST old bay cheese fries... i add mozz and cheese wiz to them but they are awesome!  The delivery people usually get lost but they call and are always really sweet.  Now their are for sure better places out their, but for the price... this place is top in it's category.  I'll update when I've eaten more food types but so far everything has been good :)

Great Delivery Food- not so good when you eat in... No idea what the deal is?!?
Food:
Must Try- Bagel Roll, philadelphia roll with avocado added on the outside, and gyoza!!!  
Also like- rainbow roll and bento boxes are a pretty good deal because it's a TON of food
Do not try- the all you can eat sushi for $24... first of all, they load it with rice, and are slow as hell... and their menu says if you don't finish a piece you have to pay like $1 or something like that... pardon my language but WTF? If they would take away that stupid rule and give you the sushi rolls that are so full of rice... they would be raking in the cash!  

Service:  horrible- but I mean, they were dead both times I went (off peak hours), and so I understand how you can space out when you only have one table... but then again... when I see 4 people each eating $24 sushi deals... I would probably pay a little more attention because it's an easy tip.

Atmosphere: Outside smells like fish, but it's chinatown, so it comes with the territory.  Inside, fairly normal and casual... nothing fancy.

Random:  I did have a celebrity siting there... if you call Steve Ward a celebrity that is... 

Price: Decent prices, probably the best sushi in chinatown for the price.... I still prefer Kisso for fresh sushi... but that bagel roll is addicting...

It's Cosi... but if someone hasn't eaten there and wants to know what's good and what's not... here is what I have so far:

Great: nothing food wise, but the fresh made drinks (especially the raspberry lemonade) are a craving of mine on a hot day
Good: the signature salad, buffalo chicken sand.
Decent: the steak TMB, breakfast wraps
Yuck: shrimp remoulade, brownies, turkey bacon cheddar melt (which would probably be good if some idiot didn't put honey mustard on it... does no one use ranch in these parts... seriously?!?!)

Bonuses: I always love seeing the teenage managers on a power trip while I abuse the free wifi for studying :)  Depending on the Cosi you go to that is... not sure if it was the 15th street one

Minuses:  Get some freaking power outlets and students would be all over the place!  They lose so much money because of this... why even have free wifi if you don't have a place to plug the computers in... it's false advertising as far as I'm concerned!

Call me a little sentimental... but I had a pretty good first date here :)  I showed up about 20 minutes late thanks to a taxi driver who had no idea where locust was (ok and maybe a little because I was primping)... but the food was really good.  Minus the calamari being a little overcooked which kinda annoyed me because we let them suggest an appetizer and well... you don't suggest over-cooked calamari.  
  I wish I could remember exactly what we had, but my date had apparently loved the place and had been bragging about how everything on the menu was awesome (he was even more pissed about the calamari than I was).  It is small, so you have to make reservations... and while I think it has the ability to be romantic, on a friday or saturday night it has a drunken BYOB crowd mixed with professional students and business men.  Summary:

Food: amazing- try everything except the calamari
Drink: BYOB- if you don't bring wine, you may look a little funny
Service: very polite and attentive, though I would be careful taking suggestions from them
Price:  Sorry not sure... but I think I remember it being reasonable 
Atmosphere: loud and fun, but lighting is intimate... a little cramped but they deal with what little space they have.  
Overall:  Very enjoyable... but then again it could have been my date
Recommendation:  Next time you have a group of people... go here... it's the best Italian I've had so far in Center City (spazzo's is pretty neck and neck with it) but for BYOB I plan on taking a group back for sure!)

THE KING TURKEY IS AMAZING!  I don't care how many calories are in it... it is SO SO GOOD!
I stumbled upon this place wanting to avoid the long dinick's line...long story short... haven't been back to dinick's since.

I know they are famous for their cannolis but what they really should be famous for.... their New York Style CHEESECAKE!!!  This is by far my favorite dish in the world to buy and pawn off as my own at any place possible... dinner parties, cooking for the boyfriend, thank you gifts... etc etc... for $12... it is by far the best Cheesecake I've ever had... and I really don't even like plain cheesecake.  Normally what I'll do, is go home, chop up some fruit and drizzle some melted strawberry jelly over it all (you know, so it looks like I made it at home)... and let me tell you... I have no heard one person who wasn't in obsessed with it after just one bite.  So if you want to impress someone with your cooking skills (or lack-there-of) ... this is the best place to do it!  Just make sure you have a good excuse for the somewhat awkward size of the pan you would have had to make it in ... 
Summary:

Reading Terminals BEST place for a SWEET TREAT
Famous for Cannolis- which is actually the only cannoli I've ever had that I actually liked... so they must be pretty good... because I'm not a huge fan but the cheesecake is to die for! I keep trying to force myself to try new things but I can't stop buying the stupid cheesecake!  

Warning:  You are likely to consume a whole cheesecake on your own in less than 48 hrs... it is that good!

BY FAR THE WORST STARBUCKS IN TOWN TO STUDY AT! ***

***That is obviously a false statement- I'm hoping people who don't really read these see it and it keeps them from studying here and taking up my tables :) 

This is actually my favorite study spot in all of Philadelphia... and I am NOT a starbucks person.  
Reasons:
1. Free wifi
2. WITH PLENTY OF OUTLETS
3. Nice staff
4. Only tables made for two people- so it prevents annoying crowds that talk a lot (yet somehow they still miss the handicap sign on the front table)
5. I don't get phone service here... which you may think is initially a problem... until you realize how productive you are! 
6. It's steps away from public transit, yet tucked away enough to keep it from being swarmed by the 9-5'ers
7.  I'm not sure if it's because it's located next to Fox and Hound or that it is close to the gay district... but it would be a lie if I said I didn't enjoy the man candy that walks by between 4-6pm every weekday :) 
8.  Also, it seems to be people who actually study... i'm sure the two person seats and unlimited triple white chocolate mocas don't hurt that any tho (not that I order those...)
9.  They don't care if you bring outside food in... as they realize no real person could sit there for 12 hours straight and eat the crap they have

Review completely based on using it as a place to study.  I would give it one star but it only has three ratings and I don't want to kill it's rating that bad.  One reason I hate this place and walk to one much further away to study at... NO OUTLETS!  Seriously people... I don't understand what the deal is with places in philadelphia offering free wifi without access to more than one outlet in the whole place... it makes sense if you want one time customers.... but not if you want them to come back...

I would give it zero stars if I could.  The food is fine- not the best not the worst.  The prices are way too high for what they give you- so don't expect more than five chunks of chicken in your dishes jfyi.  They delivered to another address for me- and I guess I had messed up the number I put in for the delivery- because when the delivery guy got to the door- he was pissed.  He said he had tried to call me several times because he couldn't find parking so I could come down and get it- and had to drive around for 20 minutes to find parking just to bring it to me.  FIRST OF ALL- the reason I order delivery, is so I don't have to come out and get it.  Second of all, ok- so their delivery is free- they still have to deliver the food.  Then when I was wondering why the delivery guy was getting so rude with me- he let me know that he wasn't a delivery guy- he was the OWNER.  WHICH was WAY WORSE that the owner would sit their and raise his voice to me because I didn't come down 15 floors to get the food I thought was suppose to be delivered.  The phone number I usually don't put in anyway bc their is a doorman downstairs.  Overall, the food is fine- still prefer Minar or Tiffin- but I don't ask to get treated like crap when I deliver food from a restaurant because the owners lazy butt didn't want to walk to deliver it. 
I only wish I hadn't pre-tipped the guy!  Oh and they are not only skimpy on meat, but you will also get about 1/3 the rice as anywhere else.  So unless you are desperate and have no other options- don't order from here.

Very pleasant surprise!  4.5 stars for me... but if I were a guy, I'd give it 5 stars :)  
It is swanky and very mafioso feeling inside... the kind of place you would take business with a cigar in your mouth.  BUT it is also nice dim red lighting for date that can be romantic and very romantic.  I wish I could remember the name of the dishes we had, but they were both fish and very good!  
The cigar dessert was delicious!  And I don't even like really rich desserts... it was amazing!
Honestly, it is a GREAT date restaurant... because it is different and not crazy loud... plus it is in a good location and you aren't elbow to elbow with the table next to you like in a lot of other steven starr restaurants... but you are still pretty close at some tables... but you don't have to be.  
If you looking to talk business... like I said, it's a great spot... I just hope next time the business that is being talked about next to me isn't about repairing lady parts after having a baby! (I mean seriously people... at dinner?)

I went here because of all the high reviews on yelp.  Maybe it is just me, but I am not impressed by "quaint"  little wine bars with bad seating and terrible a/c (or at least the day I went).  I haven't had any food that has blown me away, so I think I'm going to give it another shot.  I would for sure not take anyone here to impress them... go drink wine at Del Friscos down on chestnut if you want amazing scenery.  Overall, it was average for me... great little neighborhood stuff but nothing to write home about.

This place is great.  My boyfriend and I did the tasting menu when we went here... and can I tell you... probably the best french food I've ever had.  I've also been here during restaurant week, which I wasn't very impressed by the food when I did... so don't let that be the judge... or at least all I remember is the food being not good and the specialty drink being the best thing I've ever had in my life (and everyone at the table agreed).  Unfortunately, they don't have those drinks all the time or I would probably be there more than I should :)  Anyway, back to the food... if you have money to spend or want to treat someone... the tasting menu is AMAZING!!!  The only minus is the lighting is so dim.. you get really tired... but for that food... extremely worth it!

I am giving it two stars because I walked into it expecting it to be a 4 star or 5 star... which it is a far cry from some of the amazing places here in philly.  For it's price point, you are much better off going to amada for tapas that are much better.  I had several things, and the only thing that wowed me was one of the cheeses on the cheese tray.  It was cramped, which is fine, but this was a little more excessively cramped than any of the other places I've been to in Philly... I would say if I had a little more weight on me, I wouldn't even want to walk into this place.  Keep in mind with my rating, Tapas are my favorite, and honestly, I'm not going to go back to this place.  I've had a few people tell me it is their favorite, but I just don't get it.  I would say this place would be good for a night out with the girls or a casual night with the boyfriend ... not a date night spot unless you are wanting super casual and tables not big enough to fit more than one of the tapas at a time.  Oh and the server also kinda made me feel stupid when I pronounced something wrong on the menu... instead of asking me to clarify what I meant, he didn't even bring out the dish, and when we were sitting around waiting for it and finally asked, he replied, "oh I didn't know what you meant."  Seriously? 
Summary:
  Casual night out and you want something new... this is probably a good place.  If you are expecting 4 or 5 star tapas... not so much.

My absolute favorite place to have brunch!  Everything I have ordered has been amazing!  I usually get the french toast, and my boyfriend gets something less sweet so we can switch half way through... and I have yet to have something I didn't think was good.  The outdoor seating is great, you can't beat the view... but even the indoor seating is really nice and they are usually really good about accommodating whatever size party you have.  So if you want a Sunday brunch spot... GO HERE!  Great for dates, groups, or just being hungover and wanting good food and a cocktail :)

Being from KS... I'm extremely picky when it comes to eating steak... and this is the only place I have had an amazing steak in town! The restaurant itself is just amazing, with some of the most beautiful architecture I've seen.  The place is huge, yet every time I've been there it's been busy.  The bar seems to be a pretty popular place for a drink if you don't want to be around a lot of college kids... and the wine cellar is impressive as well.  What I love:  Filet Mignon- Medium rare- Oscar style.  If you like steak like that, and you think somewhere in town has a better one, please let me know! Until then, I think if you want to impress a date, treat people from out of town, see something new as a tourist, or just have a damn good steak... this is your best bet in town.

I'll keep it brief because this is a chain restaurant like any other chain restaurant... the food is standard "expensive business crowd steakhouse" quality (which is usually pretty high quality).  It's good, the only complaint I have really is that this one in particular isn't as nice or as elegant as some of the others I've been in.  The stuffed dead animals on the walls just don't really help my appetite any... which is probably why this place reminds me of where all "the guys" go have lunch and drink scotch.  It's exactly what you would expect, so if you are a routine type of person, stick with this.  For drinks with "the guys" ... I still think Alma De Cuba would make me feel cooler :)  but it's not a steakhouse so if you are wanting a steak, Alma won't really do you any good.

When I pay for a nice restaurant or want to go somewhere before a classy event, I don't want children and families eating next to me in jean shorts and t-shirts when I'm dressed to the 9's.  The server I had was horrible, but the one next to us was so good, he more than made up for it.  Unfortunately, my boyfriend got good poisoning but I did get to eat most of my food before we had to leave... and I would say it was nothing impressive at all.  With that said, it was extremely overpriced for the quality and the atmosphere... which is really a shame because the decor is pretty cool and the view is amazing... but the lack of dress code and children keep it from being romantic in the least bit.

I eat a lot of Indian food... and I honestly was not expecting anything from this place because I accidentally stumbled here because a friend of mine has a gluten allergy and had also never tried Indian food.  We ordered the chicken biryani and the lamb saagwala and they were GREAT.  I couldn't order them with any spice in them because she hated spice, so with these dishes being completely mild... they were amazing! The biryani was some of the best I've had and it was a huge portion! The lamb saag was really good, but I can't say it was my favorite ever because it didn't have spice in it.  Also, it is currently a BYOB... which is awesome to have right on Market street.  They also serve an appetizer I wasn't familiar with, but just something to munch on... which is nice.  The prices were moderate, nothing crazy but really good considering it was a BYOB.  Not sure how everything else is but if you order what I did, you will be very happy!  Also, we guessed on the whole gluten-free thing and ended up being right... and if I had a gluten allergy, this might be all that I eat :)

My absolute favorite Indian Restaurant in town... and I've tried them all.  I am always on search for the best lamb saag and chicken tikka masala, and they continue to be my favorite to order, especially for the price.  While I think tiffin is a little better taste wise, they do not give you as much and they cost more.  They always have a pan of rice for each meal you order, which makes a HUGE difference.  They include all the necessary ingredients, and if you want it extremely spicy... be careful because you will get what you ask for.  I really like everything I've ordered from there, except for the chicken biryani.  Also, the $10 lunch buffet is probably the best deal in the city... but I always call and make sure they have lamb or goat saag on there for me to really enjoy it.  If you haven't tried those... this is the place to do it at!  
Delivery is also on time at minimum, usually early for me... and we order it probably at least twice a week.  I just wish they had longer hours!

Solid Indian food.  I can order anything from here and assume it is going to taste good.  Minus one incident I had with the chicken being a little dry ... but overall... probably the most reliably good indian in the city.  The only reason it isn't the place I order from all the time is because Minar Palace is significantly cheaper ($5/meal)... but when I feel like treating myself, I order the lamb saag and chicken tikka masala from here :)

As far as center city neighborhood grocery stores go, this is the best one I've found.  While it's not as cheap as Trader Joe's, it is perfect to just walk down the street and grab what I need and know it's not going to $60 for milk and cookies.  They have a good selection, while I wish they had hamburger meat or chicken breasts... they have just about everything else I need for a typical meal.  
Also, I didn't even know this place existed because there aren't any signs outside really... but I'm very glad I went in.

Good for what it is.  If you are looking for over the top... that's not really what this place is but it is for sure better than Cosi.  While I wish there was a panera in center city, this place is probably about as close as you can get.  It's clean, in a good location for commuters, or just a nice place to have a cup of coffee if you want to avoid the starbucks crowd.

I am giving it 5 stars for their delivery service, I've never been to the restaurant itself.  For delivery, it's the highest quality I can find in my area that doesn't charge an arm and a leg for delivery.  I highly suggest the salmon... it's not cheap, but it's really good.  I feel like it's the kind of dish you would put on a plate and try to pretend you cooked on your own to impress someone.  All my roommates love the pastas and salads, but we've never ordered the pizza.  So if you want high quality delivery food, this is your best bet.

Great bar for dates and meetings - perfect for groups. Staff is on point - food is hit or miss but when the main chef is there isn't a always great.  I've eaten here several times - I would say it's one of the best app and bar spots for 30+ in old city.  I love coming here b you don't feel crowded like most old city places so I can't give it four stars just bc I didn't like one dish.  Bar is worth the five stars- and I'm picky.

Great food - wish I had gone earlier.  It is a great atmosphere and especially great if someone wants authentic Italian food and a great atmosphere.  The pasta is great, apps especially, old thing I didn't like was the liver.  Great date or romantic spot - several rooms that all have a different Italian home feel.  Counsel wear jeans and a nice shirt or dress up and not feel over dressed.  Def eat here at least once - ask the waiter to recommend something that he would eat.

One of my favorite dive bars and actually has a back room that makes it nice for crowds. This is a perfect non-smoking dive bar with great drinks and wings!  Bartender absolutely takes care of regulars- one of the nicest guys you'll meet in old city.

As far as a great place - I'd give it five stars for fun.  It is pretty expensive for drinks - I rarely walk out of a place and am like - wow - how did we spend that much? This is the place it happens.  Maybe if I were a little better at pool it wouldn't- but they're not necessarily known for having good specials.  Good news is - the prices keep the crowd pretty clean cut so it makes it worth it to me (or someone else is paying haha).  Great date spot or after-work spot for anyone with a friendly competitive side.  A lot of local old city people favorite it- especially service industry.  Highly recommend - just wish they had a little bit lower cost.

1EiBjAbU_MlwMcEGsMO5Tw.review_text: Yesterday, my work ordered pizza from here. I'm not a huge fan of pizza , but after one slice of the cheese pizza I am HOOKED! I can't wait to order a pizza from Boardwalk, tonight for dinner. I can't speak for the customer service but the pizza was damn good! Everyone at work couldn't stop talking about it! They say it's Newyork style... What ever it is I want more!

Service was easy, fast and friendly, I did a walk in order and only waited a few minutes. Egg roll was realllly good.  I tried the crab ragoon, as other reviews suggested, but they were right about one thing, they r different! It is a sweet version of ragoon so beware.... Place was clean but no Ac no biggie since I was just coming in and out

I've been coming here for over a year now, weekend regulars! ( a 30 min drive from our home) The service is awesome, yes, it gets busy, and there's gonna be a wait! Because this place is amazing and it is a cheap breakfast! Kelly! Is the best server, she knows our order by heart ! I can't say enough about her or this place ! My boyfriend always get the hobo hash , there portions are ridiculous big! We also order the French toast with extra cinnamon and powder sugar and we NEVER put syrup on it , ONLY butter! Ask for there apple butter and strawberry jelly! We've tried other places that were closer to our home in Clearwater, but each time we are just disappointed, and look at each other and say, " we should have just went to sky way jacks! " Lol. If your looking for gourmet and modern, this is not right place for you.....

Went on a Sunday, at noon, super busy, the drive they was pretty long, but once we placed our order it went fast.   My boyfriend drives a Tundra, getting thru the drive thru was no problem at all ( no tire damage). You order at the window, so no crappy speaker to listen or talk thru, so they is no confusion with ordering. All the employees we came in contact with were super excited, friendly, and effective.  Fried chicken strip were really tasty and juicy! Must try! Cali sandwich was delicious. I especially liked the bun!  I ordered a side of the blueberry ginger dressing but I don't think id like it on a salad... We Order a vanilla milk shake... Pretty good. ( no were near as good as five guys). The milk shake came with a huge pink straw... It made me smile... And my boyfriend and I got a kick out of it.  The fries were average.  Over all, I enjoyed my meal and will def return......
UPDATE: try the zucchini fries With the RANCH SAUCE!!!! So freakn good!!!!!!!

Came by around mid night,Service was friendly, ordered 2 Big Macs and a large fry.... (One Big Mac with special sauce and one with OUT! )They told me to pull up to the 3rd window while the Big Macs were made...about 5 mins later the manager came to the window with my bag... Got home both Big Macs were made WITH sauce.... TIP: check your order before you leave.....My order wasn't right but the fries were hot and yummy! 

I did notice inside there were computers to make your order , if you don't feel like having a face to face encounter with a cashier! Pretty cool....

I like parking and ordering ... There's a screen , where you can see your order, and u order at your leisure! then swipe your card right then... No assistance from employees....my bf ordered mozzarella sticks, chicken strips dinner, a hot dog and a tea... The guy that brought out good, he was on roller blades was impressive on the skates .... !!! We tipped him... He deserved it! Food was hot and he ate it all! Worth the drive! Open more sonics! One in Clearwater please

My co workers and I switch off on buying breakfast every Saturday, it was my turn this Saturday.  I've bought breakfast twice now from this location which is right down the street from work. Easy to get to. No long waits. The manager has took my order each time. Offered condiments napkins and has had a professional manner each time. The coupons were defiantly a savings since I'm buying for multiple ppl, I don't eat much fast food but my co workers said it was very tasty. Not the most modern Burger King! But it was fast ,fresh and friendly! I'll be back on my next turn ..... Thx

Sunday morning around 8 am, no wait what so ever. No true hostess, they just holler from the bat, "seat where ever you'd like" Plenty of seats to choose from. One waitress came over took out drink order, in the mean while I noticed the table we picked was dirty salt, pepper and other crumbs on the table. So I just wiped it down myself. A different waitress brought out drinks to us and she took our order. We ordered your basic egg, home fries, bacon, toast and waffle meals.  Food come out quick. I enjoyed my breakfast and it was fair priced. There were a lot of staff there, but hardly any customers , and they were having their selfs a good time.... We heard all the gossip and conversations... Loud and clear.... We will probably be back and explore some other menu items... To try and find the prefect breakfast dish we just can't live with out.....

I've ordered egg rolls, crab Rangoon ( a must try from here) low main, fried dumplings, beef teriyaki and the boneless spare rib dinners! Allllll good!

(don't get the honey chicken .,,. Yuck). I love u can order online , walk in and grab your food and be on your way. The place is small and hot. But the staff has been nothing other then friendly to me each visit! 

I look forward to continuing to come here and trying new dishes. I've brought a friend here and she said she loves it compared to the places she has tried.... In the Clearwater area

We have been looking for a go to Mexican place, finally this is it! Was seated immediately.  Lots of booths.  Large menu. Service was quick and food was awesome.  They bring salsa in a miniature pitcher with bowls ... That way you can double dip with out someone pointing it out :). I had the fajita burrito. It came with rice normally I never eat the rice but this rice was flavor able and fluffy! The portions are plentiful.  My boyfriend ordered his entree with special instructions and the waiter made it happen and didn't seem to mind catering to his request... We will def be back and I'm already spreading the word about this place!

0 stars!!!!!! After waiting 30 mins for 3 strips and fries... I just left. Once I got home I called their corporate office and they refunded my money since I never received what I ordered or what I paid for.  

This place not only looks run down but the employees have no clue what is going on, the woman manager Is A JOKE... No leadership here, they need to bulldoze this place and start over. I've never seen any thing like it! STAY AWAY FROM THIS DUMP!

So happy to have another culvers In The our area and closer to my home! But this is seriously bad for my waistband and purse!  I'm addicted to the one scoop turtle! I went in on opening day and the next day! So far the staff is doing a great job! Burgers and cheese curds a must try!

Eat the carrot cake! Screw the ice cream, it had nothing on that carrot cake!!!! I got vanilla and tried the chocolate, the waffle cone was pretty good too, but TRY THE CARROT CAKE! I completely devoured it! I ate it once I got home and was so sad I only had one piece... 5.99 a slice yikes, but worth it!

Went for lunch on Saturday $10 ... This place gets crowded quick by the time we left there was a wait serve was good food came out very quick. Steak on hibachi was awesome... I tried a few rolls ... Just so so

We came here on a referral of a friend. And I'm so glad we did we have been looking for an all you can eat crab legs restaurant. We ate til we were about to burst.  I like this place bc it's laid back and you just feel like your at home!  We arrived on Sunday around 4 o'clock and there weren't many people there , by the time we left there was a wait to get in! Jennifer was our waitress and she was amazing. We ate the feast which came with crab legs shrimp muscles and shrimp hush puppies and one side for 22.99 and you get a lulus plastic cup with the beverage! I'm so glad we came we will be back again!

If you try the smoked fish spread , add Lulus Hot Sauce... Very tasty!
Well they have done some much needed renovations!   Food is still the same and awesome... My only suggestion is bring Tina back!!!! :) she is missed

(If u do pick up be sure to check it before you leave) we Called in a take out order, we normally dine in, but we wanted to enjoy wings at home. 10 wings for him and 8 for me.. We arrived at hooters, paid and left with our food. Fast and friendly. We got home. Opened our boxes and only mine were correct. They didn't was his wings at all :( At this point he was in no mood to drive back to hooters, 10 mile round trip down gulf to bay,So I just called & talked with the manager, Sam, who was very understanding and she offered a credit Or to have us pick them up again. I took the credit... ( and just listened to him cry) we frequent this location and I'm still happy with them! ( way better then Wing house!)

Mac n cheese!!!!! Must get this ! Every time! 

Def. a more upscale Panara! I tried the newrks sub.... Chicken was moist and delicious ... The bread is fantastic! Next time I'm trying a salad. I really couldn't decide what I wanted I wanted it all.  I like there condiment bar....

Love the food and staff... but unfortunately on three separate occasions I have went by after work which is 615-ish and they are closed even though their hours are to seven. It's very heartbreaking when you pull up and they're closed early maybe they should just make their hours to six

Yes,yes, yes!!!! This place was worth the extra bucks!!!!!! The French toast is amazing.. different then what I've ever tried.  Love the strawberry preserves. biscuits , homemade and crumbly...Cheese grits were different (light n fluffy)then southern grits! But yummy! I had quiche for the first time, to die for! 

I feel like I should dress up coming here, which is a nice change of pace.... what girl doesn't like to dress up sometimes! 

Honestly if your tired of the average morning diner food, COME HERE!  The food is so good, but don't expect and huge portion... this place is quality over quantity!  Worth it!

Christine was our waitress , we told her it was our first time and she really showed us great hospitality! I was extremely happy with our whole experience!

Ps if your in a super hurry and want the rush rush experience ... do not come here.... this is a set back and enjoy ur food and company kind of place! Although our food did come out reallllly fast!

My co worker told me about the avocado toast here... boy was it better then she described! I called in my order ,walked in ,paid and was out the door to work! I love the bread ( Texas toast style)and the basted eggs... $11.  I'll be back ... everyone was more then friendly also!

Came in today , to order a cleanse ... I'll be picking it up in a few days.  This place is so cute I'd never know this place existed if it wasn't for a friend.  Got a small bowl n it was delicious! Will be back soon!

We are frequent visitors of boardwalk pizza in Clearwater... I still like their pizza but their service can be down right bad. So we have been on the look out for a new New York style pizza , after driving by Big Romans many times, my boy friend finally decided to give it a try! Boy am I glad he did! This place is spotless and the cheese pizza hits the spot for me!  And the staff is down to  earth n friendly, score ! We ordered  a large cheese pizza for 12 bucks! Delicious ny style! I really liked the sauce n cheese n crust, oh that's everything isn't it! The have a special for two slices and a drink ... at the lunch hour on certain day! I think that is more then far! We will be back for sure

Our friends have been raving about this place for weeks.  So we decided to all go together.  We made reservations for 4 at 730 on a Wednesday.  Good thing , they were packed! 

Ok the good! The brisket was OUT OF THIS WORLD Good!  Try the Carolina gold bbq sauce if you like sweet sauce, mmmm mmm good.  Try all their bbq for $15 ... the Jim sampler comes with brisket, bulled pork, n ribs, n 2 sides. It was a huge portion! The manager did a table touch and she tried to fix our complaints.  She really took our issues in strid... she never seemed combative or irritated.  She ended up making up for all the flaws.  She is a very attentive manager.  Also, I really like the atmosphere.  Service was fast!!!!!! And it was " lady's night" so many apps were 1/2 off, gotta love that. Honestly I thought the prices were really fair especially with the portion sizes.

So here are the bad!   We sat in a booth... not sure if the seat backs are attacked or bolted down Bc EVERY single time the ppl behind us moved ( which was ALOT)  the seat back would move ... and it would just jolt , very disruptive.  The table was very unbalanced, even after putting napkins underneath it still wasn't right.       
We decided we wanted to try their "cheese curds"but the waitress warned us, there only Mozzarella sticks.  Oh maybe you should change the menu to reflect that, 

So we ordered baked potatoes with out main meal, when our meal came out the server let us know they r out and what else would we like.  What a bummer steak houses should NEVER run out of baked potatoes, never!  After that a "bus boy " came by n asked if we would like a refill, we said yes, and he took our glasses but never came back lol.  Eventually we just hunted down the manager since we didn't see our waitress or the guy who took the glasses.  She got the refills :) I'm in love with onion rings, so I ordered those as a side.  They were huge.. There were four... but unfortunately, they were not to my liking.... greasyyyyyy! Not Crunchy , soggy from grease. 

The server did notice I had not ate them and made a very good attempt to talk me in to other sides.  But honestly I was so full from all the other yummy stuff I eat n tasted.  Skip the Mac n cheese too, just ok. Fried mushroom and artichoke dip were good though! One last observation.   Servers please stop asked your guest ... before each refill ... was that " sweet or unsweetened tea" or " regular or diet coke "?  Maybe work on a way to memorize your guest drink orders.  

Over all I am thrilled with this steak house and I can't wait to come back again... although I'm sure they don't want us back after the complaints we made!  But I am very impressed by the managers  skills to face the customers complaints and try to make it right!   If they were to just tweek a few things ( that I have mentioned) this place would most def. be a 5 star place! 
See y'all soon :)

** try the margarita pizza with Pesto Sauce** Thx me later

So we have been on the look for s new New York style place, after driving by Big Romans many times, my boy friend finally decided to give it a try! Boy am I glad he did! This place is spotless and the cheese pizza hits the spot for me!  And the staff is down to  earth n friendly, score ! We ordered  a large cheese pizza for 12 bucks! Delicious ny style! I really liked the sauce n cheese n crust, oh that's everything isn't it! The have a special for two slices and a drink (5 bucks)... at the lunch hour on certain day! I think that is more then far! We will be back for sure

I can't comment on the meats yet Bc I just left this butcher shop now, but I can comment on their customer service. And it's top notch!  Kirk, at the meat counter.... saw us wonder in looking alittle lost.  He from the get go ... introduced himself and asked if we had been there before. We told him no. He gave us the whole run down of the place. We settled on a 5 lb brisket and 2 steak tips ( marinated-steakhouse & Argentina).  After our military discount, 48 bucks! The cashier Nathan was super helpful and patient with us! I'll be sure to up date once we grill these meats!

The cashier Nathan was super helpful and patient with us! I'll be sure to up date once we grill these meats! 

Update: all the meats are great quality! The marinated meats are very TENDER  and tasty! My favorite was Steakehouse Marinade!

Okay, so I've finally checked this place out! First and foremost I must say the staff was just fun nominal on the line and register!  Very patient and took into consideration it was our first visit .  

So my tips are DO NOT get pan crust ... I was expecting Pizza Hut pan pizza crust.... not even close! It is verrrry bland with no texture.  But I did try the tradition Italian crust!!!! Much better!  

I also tried their buffalo pizza... now that was tasty I'd order that again.

The spicy Marinera ,personally way too spicy for me so I won't do that next time.  
 
we also ordered the Cinnamon sticks... but there was Major flaw.  The edges where the sugar would melt and BURN is a true problem!!!! So we just  bite right into it (anticipating sweet gooey goodness).  Not what we got, lol.  It was  burned sugar.  It really just Ruined it and our pallet!  So try to avoid those edges if you can.
  
They had some interesting fountain sodas and tea varieties at  the unlimited drink area! ( that I've never seen before)


Minor annoyance..,you Oder your pizza with one person, they make it, then you are passed on the the register where you repeat most of your order again to someone else. I'd like to see that part eliminated..but those pizzas come out hot and fast... a plus!

If pie 5 .. could change the ordering process and fix the burned sugar issues this place will be a solid 4!

So with all of that being said... I'll Definitely come back , on the hunt to find my favorite person pan pizza!
Mandy! Thx for all your advice and patience with placing our large 2 platter order! Food was great service was better! FAst delivery with a short notice!

Had a good experience here. Got right in on a Saturday night.. Watched some college football. Had a cheese, mushroom, and garlic pizza with the hand tossed crust. Really good! Also split the buffalo wings with a friend.. Good but a little bit too strong ketchup taste. 
Our waitress was also awesome! She gave us tips on what to get & was very quick.
Another plus.. 2 for 1 beers! 

As other people have said, it does seem pricey.

Sloco is absolutely amazing. When I went, they were sadly out of all chicken so I decided to get the ham and cheese. It was delicious! I don't even like ham much but there was a relish on it that blew me away. All my friends loved their sandwiches as well including the meatball made from quinoa. The staff was awesome.. very friendly, asked how we liked everything, etc. 
My only negative is the lack of seating space inside. Luckily it was a warm enough day to sit outside. 

I can't wait to go back and try the chicken options!

Delicious restaurant with a cute decor. 

I had "The Bird" with the side salad and couscous. I loved it all! And I loved the price. I will be back soon to try another sandwich (or maybe get the same one I loved it so much) and try one of the desserts.

Went to Edley's on a Saturday afternoon with some friends from out of town. Most of the tables were full but we managed to grab one. The lady taking orders was really friendly and even let us try a sample of the side of greens before ordering it. 

I ordered the pulled pork with a side of mac and cheese and beans. The pulled pork was really delicious and a huge portion of meat. Being a fan of extremely cheesy mac and cheese, I was pretty disappointed with side here. It wasn't bad.. just different. However, the beans were really good. My friends all got the brisket & loved it.  

I will be back!

I just moved to Nashville and was really excited to try Urban Flats & see the Gulch neighborhood. Loved the neighborhood, not a fan of the restaurant. 
First, I called for reservations & they said they were full but the wait would only be around 20 minutes. Ended up waiting 1 hour & a half! Insane.
The food was alright. I had the black & blue flat.. It was okay, nothing too flavorful or mind blowing. I don't think I'll be back, too many great places to try!

I went to The Pharmacy on a Saturday night with a group of friends. We were expecting a long wait so no big deal when we were told an hour and 15 minutes. We sat at the bar while we waited. All of the bartenders were awesome and the service at the bar was fantastic. 

Unfortunately, that was where the great service ended. We were seated after 45 minutes which was not bad. Our waitress was awful.. not friendly, looked lost the whole time. We all ordered and the waitress forgot to put my friend's order in so her burger did not come out until 30 minutes after we had already gotten our meal. At this point, I shared my burger with her because she was starving. I also ordered a beer and never received it - but it was put on my bill. Our waitress never apologized, nothing. Just look annoyed. 

Honestly - great burgers but not worth it to endure the worst service I have ever received anywhere in Nashville.

Don't do it. 

I love cheap, non-authentic Chinese food (Panda express anyone?) so I thought this place would be fine. Unfortunately, the food was not good at all. I had the sweet and sour chicken and my roommate had the sweet and sour pork. Both were pretty bad. Even the rice tasted strange.. kind of like a fryer. I had to throw my leftovers away because I just couldn't eat it.. and that does not happen ever!

I've been to Puckett's a couple times in my year living in Nashville. Every time I've had the pulled pork.. it is soo good and flavorful, probably the best I've had in Nashville! I also love the potato salad, sweet potato fries, & redneck burrito. My dining partner also really enjoyed the fried green tomato BLT. I also find the reservations through Yelp extremely convenient! The only thing I don't enjoy is the macaroni and cheese (I'm a tough critic though) and the tourist atmosphere in the summer months. 

The servers are always friendly & nice when I've been here!

After months of stalking (via Facebook & Twitter) the Grilled Cheeserie truck, I FINALLY got around to trying it out. And try it out a few more times. What can I say? Being from around the WI area, I am a huge cheese person so grilled cheese is right up my alley. 

I think their "melt of the moments" are really the stars so you have to hit up the truck when they have one you like. The first time I went I got to try the springtime melt which was buttermilk cheddar, Benton's bacon, and grilled asparagus. UH-MAZ-ING! This is by far the best grilled cheese I've ever had. I've also tried the B & B which was pretty good & I made a smoked gouda melt with tomato & bacon. 

My only complaints that keep this from being 5 stars.. it is expensive & sometimes I feel they don't put enough ingredients on the sandwiches (1 slice of bacon, really?). Also, they are always out of something I want (cheesy tots?! out every time). 

Overall, a must! Next time I want to try the pudding..

Love love love me some Copper Kettle. 

Let me start off by saying I've never been for brunch, only lunch during the week. I would describe it as a classier meat & three, which I appreciate as most of them are dives. The atmosphere is very nice and the porch is great. So they have the meat & 3, but they also have a menu of sandwiches, salads and excellent "healthier" sides. By healthier I mean pasta salad, lettuce salads, fruit salads instead of the typical meat & 3 sides. I've had a sandwich, goat cheese salad, and just a "vegetable plate" with macaroni and cheese, pasta salad, and the green bean casserole. All of it has been delicious! You must try the cornbread that comes with every meal.. mmm mmmm. 

I must say the employees are always super nice and helpful while I'm struggling to decide what I want. There's just so many great options!

So I was nervous about coming here because I didn't know if I liked Thai food.. turns out I love it! At least from the Smiling Elephant. 

I've been here 3 times and none has disappointed. I could eat the cashew chicken every day for the rest of my life. That sauce.. yum. I've also had the Pad Thai which is delicious. 
It is a really small restaurant with such a cute decor. I noticed they have added a few tables outside which would be nice on a day when it''s not 95 degrees out. I surprisingly have never had to wait which is a plus, even the time I came with a group of 10! When I've been there, many people come in and get take out orders so I may need to try that soon. I cannot say enough about the service and employees. Everyone is so nice & friendly! Bang the gong when you leave! 

Hmm Moment: The first time I went there the portion size was great for one meal but the second time the portion was way bigger & was enough for 2 big meals.. not that I'm complaining! & no wine.

I went to Taco Mamacita the other night for a late dinner. 

First off.. Don't go here thinking it's Mexican. Not even close & they don't claim to be (no free chips & salsa, sad day). 

Anyway, I love the atmosphere of the restaurant - the decor is cool and the patio is awesome. For a drink, I had the sangria which was excellent! For dinner, I had the two taco & a side deal - I got the taco royale and the oy vey with sweet potato fries. The tacos were small, tasted good but nothing too exciting. The sweet potato fries were not very good. However, I want to mention that our server was awesome! We had a large, rowdy group & he was very efficient and friendly. 

Pretty mediocre, not my thing. I wouldn't rush back.

I was really surprised I liked Amerigo so much. I've been there twice & both times were a great experience. The menu is large with expensive items & more affordable items. The waiters are very knowledgeable & friendly. The bread & olive oil they bring out before the meal is delicious! I really want to know what's in that olive oil.. so addicting. For the meal, I highly recommend the Chicken Tuscany or the Chicken Marsala. Mmm mmm. 

Oh, another plus, Yazoo Gerst on tap!! More places need to have Gerst!

2 WORDS: 

WHEAT SOURDOUGH!! 

I am addicted to this bread.. it is an unhealthy addiction but I cannot stop. 

It's also a great place to grab a quick breakfast or fancy coffee drink. No complaints on the food, except they do seem to be out of what I want occasionally.

I like coming here for the drinks & listening to music on the awesome patio.. but the food & service are not so great. I had the Mississippian pizza & tried the Bob Marley as well. Both were meh. I think the crust was the biggest problem, it was pretty soggy. 

Overall, I would not eat here again but I'll be back to drink on the patio!

I LOVE this place. First off, let me say that I love Greek & Mediterranean food & eat it very often. 

I come here a couple times a month now.. I would recommend the gyro, chicken platter (which comes with hummus, rice, Greek salad, pita bread), & the hummus. The hummus is absolutely delicious! 

Also, the staff is really friendly & always have my to go order out quickly! I've never sat down to eat but it's pretty nice inside.

I loveeee me some Fido, as in I go here at least once a week 

The food is fantastic, made with really fresh ingredients. Some of my favorites: BLT, turkey pesto sandwich, sesame bagels, fries, salads, pancakes, and those muffins in the ordering line. Mmm! I also love the coffee of course. Also, you can bring your dog to sit at the outside tables. Major plus! 

Only cons.. can get really busy, but the line goes quickly and it is a little expensive for breakfast.

I have only been here once during restaurant week, but it was so delicious! I had a Caesar salad (homemade dressing!), the plum pork entree, and KALHUA cheesecake. It was amazing. The sauce on the pork dish was so tasty. I wish I could eat that cheesecake every night of my life, it was that good! And I'm not even a dessert person. 

Also, my boyfriend said this is one of the best meals & experiences he has ever had at a restaurant (he had some sort of steak, cooked perfectly). I will be back during a normal week!

One of my favorite places in Nashville! 

Love the bagels, bagel sandwiches, smoothies, coffee drinks, etc. The coffee is good, it seems strong to me but don't take my word for it, I am no coffee expert. Everything tastes so fresh! My favorite sandwich is the asiago turkey or one of the specials with turkey, pesto, and avocado. YUM, please add this to the daily menu! I have also had great service in all of my experiences here. 

Parking can be tricky but usually I try to go during the off hours or find a spot around the area. It will not stop me from my Star Bagel!

My first time here was last weekend when the weather was finally warm. I am loyal to Yazoo but I wanted to give this place a shot. First of all, the patio is AMAZING!! Obsessed with it. It is huge! The inside is designed really well. You can see where they make the beer, not to mention there are 2 bars and some tables made from whiskey barrels (I want one of these!). 

The beer was fantastic! I tried the Basil Ryeman previously at a local restaurant and liked it. After getting the sampler, I love the Southern Wit and the sweet potato stout even more. Can't remember the clever name for that one. The beers were reasonably priced and the bartenders were fantastic! 

For food, it looks like they were selling popcorn and had a food truck. Live music too! I'll be back.. many times.

So I've been to The Pharmacy at least 10 times since my last unfavorable review. It took me awhile to warm up to it after the awful service I had the first couple times. I will say the service is better, the beer garden is fantastic, and the food is delicious. 

Definitely best burger in Nashville in my opinion! Love the Mission City and the regular cheeseburger. Also please get the sweet potato fries!

I can't believe it took me so long to go here. People are not joking.. best pizza I have had in Nashville. I'm from Chicago so it is hard to please me with thin crust pizza, but this place is YUM! 

Best parts: 
BYOB, no fee. This means lots of vino. 
Pizza with the artichokes and mushrooms. I can't stop ordering this! 
Cheap! Split the smaller size pizza with a friend for less than $8. 
Umm toppings - fresh garlic, cheese, balsamic vinegar, oils, spices for dipping. This means so much to me as I love dipping. 
Location.. walk over to mid-town afterwards. Perfection!

Great beer selection that changes frequently. Love me some craft beers! 

The bartenders are fun and really helpful. 

Great patio for summer! 

A few food options which I appreciate when I want to drunk snack. 

(-) 1 star for being a little pricey. Happy hour Sunday all day though! Also, only open until 11 or 12.

I would give the Flying Saucer 5 stars based on their pretzels and cheese alone. AMAZING. I literally dream about these. 

Plus they have a fantastic beer selection and laid - back atmosphere. Good deals: Monday night is $3 pint night and there is always a $3 fire sale beer. 

Service is hit or miss but I always keep coming back!

I've lived in Hillsboro Village for over and year and finally made it to Cabana. I am so sad I waited so long! 

I went with my girl friends who were visiting Nashville and it was a perfect place for that. The patio is perfect on a warm summer night. I had the mahi special with cheddar grits and spinach, wow! It was so delicious, comparable to a seafood meal I just had in Florida. My friends loved their meals of shrimp and grits and the steak special. They also have tasty Sangria and Moscow mules. 

Plus, no wait on a Saturday night! Can't beat that! 

Hmm moments: it is a little pricey and filled with bachelorette parties. I think we saw 5 in the 2 hours we were there. 

I will definitely be back for dinner and for Ladies Night deals.

Best. tacos. everrrr. Love this place. It's small & eccentric, you have to wait in line, and the tacos are amazing. They have a little patio to sit on which is great if it's not really busy. 

Favorites: 
 - pulled pork taco 
 - tilapia taco 
 - chicken tortilla soup 
 - iced coffee with HORCHATA. Words cannot describe how delicious this is!! Go get it now. 

They only take cash & not great for big groups. They also have strange hours so check that before you go. Also, they rotate the tacos so I've never gotten to try the fried avocado taco. Fingers crossed for next time.

I hate giving 1 star after just going to a place once... but here it is. 

I went here for the first time last weekend. The positives were that we were seated right away and they had many local brews. Hmm moment? We were at Jackalope before coming here and the Jackalope beer was a $1 more here.

There was nothing on this menu I wanted to order. I ended up with the "hot" chicken nachos. I have a very low tolerance for heat and these were not hot at all. My friends had other meals with the hot chicken and beignets. Everyone liked the chicken, but all said not worth the price.

They do have a happy hour during the week so maybe I'd come back for that and skip the food.

My favorite sandwiches in Nashville! Love the turkey avocado, BBQ brisket, and the banh mi. Can't wait to try more, they have specials that look delicious. Love their iced coffee as well, not sure what kind it is. 

They have other food besides sandwiches.. Like the salad bar and breakfast bar. I haven't tried it because I'm all about sandwiches but I appreciate that it's there. 

There is a line on weekends but it goes fast and is worth it. I wish it was closer to where I live but still worth the 20 minute drive for me. 

Wherever and whoever Mitchell is... I thank you!

Loved this place! I came here for the first time this week with a group of 12 for my birthday. I was a little nervous about getting in because they do not take reservations, but we only waited 10 minutes. Awesome! 

The decor and atmosphere of the restaurant is great. I love the design, inside and out. 

Now for the most important thing - FOOD! They have small plates, meats (sandwiches or by the lb), sausages, tacos, and some signature plates. We tried many small plates - elote corn salad, potatoes, brussels sprouts & trio of dips. Brussels sprouts were amazing! 
I had the brisket and tried the knockwurst sausage. Would definitely order again, also the burger looked delicious. 

I would come back for the beer alone! They have many beers made by local breweries specifically for this restaurant. The Black Abbey Bourbon Ale (or something like that) was my fav!

With all the hype on this place, I was expecting amazing. I don't know, it didn't blow me away. We had to wait in line for awhile (not a big deal) and got to sit outside on the back patio.. which is great! The staff was nice enough. 

The food was where it didn't work for me. I had the egg plate and maybe I was starved this day, but I was still hungry after I ate it. The biscuits were alright and the grits were not flavorful. Maybe I've been spoiled because Biscuit Head in Asheville is amazing and I was comparing it to that. The mimosas are good, but $9, which seems steep for an informal place like this.

How have I never reviewed one of my favorite places?! 

I love coming here for drinks on the patio. They have a great selection! 

Favorite eats:
 - avocado BLT 
 - smoked chicken burrito.. how is this so good?! 
 - sides that aren't just "fries", love the seasonal veggies + the quinoa tabbouleh
 - my PIC loves the burger 
 - anything on the specials board! 

Only negative is service. I've had amazing service and then so-so service. They have a system where you don't have one set server.. anyone can serve you. This can be awesome and it can also be chaotic.

I had an amazing ladies night here. We may have went a bit overboard on ordering, but it was SO worth it! 

Favorites - 
 - Roasted dates, that pork belly!! Mmm! 
 - Hot Cauliflower.. I don't even like cauliflower and can't stop thinking about this. 
 - Brussels because well, brussels. 
 - Ahi guac 

My friend said the kale salad was a favorite too. I am not in the "Kale Lover" fan club so we'll keep my opinions out of it. The fried cheese, fish tacos and smoked chorizo/pears were also good. 

+parking lot in the back 
+brunch 
+awesome service! 
+can make reservations online
+patio

I would give this a 3.5, but had to go with 3. My favorite part about this place is that there hasn't been a wait when I've gone, even with a group of 10 on a Saturday! The food is pretty good and less expensive than other Thai places I've been in Nashville. 

The cons for me were slow service and the server switched some of our orders. I feel like the spice level has been different on each visit even though I got medium each time (I can be a spice wimp).  

I will keep coming back here but I still prefer Smiling Elephant.

I'm a big fan of Kay Bob's. It's not authentic Greek food by any means but it's fresh, healthy and delicious. + they have many sauces. My go to is the salmon salad or the "Zeke the Greek" pita. They have a great beer selection and have 2 for 1s on Tuesdays and Saturdays (yay Saturday!!). I like hanging on the patio, drinking good beer and people watching. 

They have cheap growler refills on Wednesdays. 

The staff is awesome and friendly.

I was so excited to try this place since I LOVE sandwiches more than anything. 

It was okay, I'm not in a hurry to go back. The worst part is the price.. it's too expensive - $17 for a sandwich and a side. The waiter told me the mac and cheese was the best item on the menu and again, I make better Mac and cheese at home. Did not get a beer because the options were not great (no local beers on draft when I've been) and they were way overpriced. 

And what's the deal with the service? Order at the counter & then you have someone bring you your order.. But how do I get a water? Or a beer if I wanted to pay for one? 

Mitchell's has better sandwiches for cheaper.

So I still love this place. Just wanted to update on the food. The first thing I had was the grilled cheese & it was pretty good but nothing too memorable. Well now I've had the sweet potato poutine & the fish tacos. AMAZING! Not really poutine but I don't care. So good. My friend also said best burger in Nashville. Better than Pharmacy.. Which whoa, I'm trying it next. Or maybe the sandwich with the ham. Decisions, decisions. Plus, they have new games. Love the darts and giant connect 4.

I was not blown away by anything here. Tacos are small & pricey, I don't even remember which ones I had. I remember them being "fine". I was excited for the Mexican street corn because I LOVE Mexican street corn. It wasn't great and my friends kept telling me how bad it smelled (it was the cheese, guys!!). 

Seems like a popular, cool new place but I'll stick with Mas Tacos and my fav taco truck on Nolensville Pike. 

Best part about my experience was the service at the bar!

Awesome!! Romantic atmosphere so perfect for a special date night. Plus it's too expensive for an average night for us :) 
Loved the quail appetizer, beer can chicken & grouper entree. I would recommend ordering the cocktails. I usually don't because they tend to be more sugar than booze but these were perfect! Plus, I felt a little buzzed off one (light weight maybe?). 

The desserts looked delicious & homemade, but we were too full by that point. Next time we may just go to the bar for a drink & dessert. Mmm! 

I see many people complained about the service, but we had great service! Did not rush us out.

This has got to be my favorite M Street restaurant, which, full disclosure is not hard. Saint Anejo.. over hyped. Whiskey Kitchen.. I don't get why people love it here. Tavern.. annoying atmosphere. But Moto, awesome! We went for "Moto Monday" which is not unlimited cheese, pizza, etc. as others have said. Now it is a 3 course small plate tasting with 3 wine pairings for $25. We got this as an appetizer.. yep. There was 4 of us in my defense. I would call the food innovative Italian, or Nashville Italian. Not authentic by any means, but creative. I tried the gnocchi (with a blueberry balsamic sauce), seafood pasta, and blueberry lasagna. All of them were awesome.. definitely rich! Brussels sprouts were delicious. Our server was very attentive the whole time and knowledgeable about the food options. I'll be back!

Ran into the truck at Centennial Park and had to try the famous sushi burrito. It was SO amazing. It is huge so I split it with my boyfriend. They are not skimping on the fish/ingredients. I think we tried something else but I can't remember because the burrito stole the show. Good news - they are opening a restaurant so less searching for the truck, although that is part of the fun ;)

Really liked this brewery! They have a great selection of beers that change quite a bit. I was there 2 times in the past 3 weeks and they had multiple different beers, which I liked. 

+ ping pong tables 
+ games 
+ outdoor seating in the back 
+ good location if you are hanging around in East Nash 
+ not too crowded (yet) 
+ hours, I think they are open every day 

- they were out of pretzels when we were there both times, waaah. Love brewery snacks.
