I come here during Happy hour, where it's 11 margarita pitchers and 30 cent wings. The wings are AMAZING. So delicious! Plus, if you order a beer, you get a shot of tequila for a buck. Pretty sweet deal if you ask me!

EDIT : 
My recent visits have gotten worse and worse. Everything still tastes good, but the lady bartender seems to mess up a lot. It was a slow night, so it wasn't that she was busy. After the first mistake, I emphasized my order again. 2 mess ups later, I decided to call it a night.

17 bucks got me 5 bottles of Red Lion, 3 hot dogs, and 6 tacos. That's a great deal! Definitely a great place to go if you're not trying to spend much. The music is too loud to be a hang out spot. But it's nice to have a place to just drink at.

Drunk. Hungry. And upset. 

On a piece of paper that they taped to their bullet proof glass (classy), says 2 drumsticks + fries for 2.95.

I was there at 1 am, and requested such a excellent priced offer. They didn't have anymore. Really? Alright... I guess I'll leave. 

My roommate arrives home with that special. I asked him how did that happened, and he said that he gave the guy an extra dollar and got what he wanted. 

My roommate was polite to give me one, and it was bitter. Bitter because they lied to me, and bitter because they probably over-salt their chicken to hide the spoiled chicken taste.

Cravings is akin to those tiny hole-in-the walls places in NYC, but the food they make is fantastic!

During the summer, I would get a slice and a soda for about $3.50 and sit in Rittenhouse square. During pizza parties, I'd always suggest Cravings as the place to pick up our pizzas. And the people - the people there are so super duper nice. Just a bunch of humble folk who know how to make a good pizza. 

I can't recommend Cravings enough!

This place is the BEST when you feel like asian food and can't decide between chinese or japanese. I am not a fan of sushi. But damn it all do I go crazy when I eat their King Dragon rolls, or their California rolls. 

The overall cost was pretty cheap, and the inside is really attractive. I scored a lot of points taking girls out here.

It's a nice place for some space. SItting at the bar, I can just watch some TV and not be bothered. I usually come with my co-workers who have a hoot with the regulars. The bartender, Chris, is awesome. Super nice guy to serve you alcohol.

Their hoagies are the BEST. THE BEST. It's one of the places where if you don't eat it in a while, you start getting cravings. Horrible midnight cravings. 

I also tried their cheesesteaks. Can't say I'm a fan though. But don't let that affect you.

I came here twice and both times, I asked for fries and they gave me tater tots. I HATE tater tots. The server apologized and gave me fries. Annoying... but SWEET! 

They didn't have a few things on the menu, so I'm guessing I had come on a bad day. My buddy got a burger, but out of burger bread, they used a hoagie roll. We just shrugged because...

Their happy hour is pretty awesome! $1/$2 can beers.

I will say that if I get Tater tots one more time, then Teri's must really hate me.

Sometimes I wonder how life would be like if we exchanged American currency for Five Guys fries. I think I would be homeless, as I'd be constantly eating my own money. 

Their burgers are pretty tasty. A good filler for a In-And-Out burger craving. But the fries... the fries are amazing.

I never understood why this place exists. It's not very good. I ate here on two occasions. And both times, they messed up my food. It's not very hard. You put broccoli on one side, and mushrooms on the other. And somewhere along the line, you turn it into a pizza. 

And then I must have told them to mess it up. Because they sure did that. And they did that pretty well.

I never had so much fun. Pitchers were cheap. And music was SO great. The music was pretty good mix of everything from 80s rock to current hits of today. And the people - I love a place where people are having a great time. Also, no women trying to take photos or guys showing off how many push ups they can do.

The wings were drenched in buffalo sauce, so the next order I told them to put it on the side. But that's not enough to ruin my experience. 

I love it here.

I was at another bar and asked people, "What other bars are around here?" They gave me some great recommendations. Ray's Happy Birthday, Teri's, 12 steps down, Royal Tavern. I asked about the Dive Bar.

"They have $2 happy hour. And pizza?"

He said 'pizza' like a question - a shrug. Like, 'I think she's pregnant? But she could be fat.' Or 'I think that's cancer? It could be a mole.'

I went for a Happy Hour special. A beer and 2 slices of pizza? Awesome!

And then I found out why he said 'pizza?' with a question mark.

It wasn't pizza. It was the cardboard crap from J&Js. Ew. No thank you. That place sucks. There are hood pizzerias that are better than J&Js! Hell, there are pizzas thrown on the GROUND that is better than J&Js! My assumption is that J&Js is paying The Dive to take their pizza. Because nobody with even half-a-brain would actually order from J&J. That's my only assumption.

The place was small. Tight. 3 people at a table means you're knocking elbows with your mates and everybody who passes by.

But the people were nice. The bartender was pretty cool. Stay away from the pizza. And if somebody gives you a slice, you chuck it in their face and call the cops.
Just got a spinach and mushroom pizza. And it was SOOO GOOD! The guy behind the counter was visibly worried about how I was planning to bring my pizza home. (It was raining and I was on a scooter)

This is the second time I've been here. The food was okay. Beef tasted rough, and the chicken was okay. 

Maybe I just don't understand Ethiopian food. But it did not wow me and I have no reason to really go back.

I went there three times. 
The first time I went, I was in burger heaven. 

But the second time, my friend was getting verbally assaulted by a REALLY aggressive employee there. She was sitting at a table saving a seat for me while I was picking up our food. He shouted that the tables are for customers only. "Do you not see this bag in my hand?!" He came off very aggressive, telling us we shouldn't be here and have to go. Racist much? I thought it was just a fluke - maybe a guy was just a jerk. 

Third time I went by myself, and it was just as bad. Employees being aggressive, and just hassling customers. What the hell happened? During the summer, everyone was polite and there were a lot of happy workers. 

Is there apparently a 'no ethnics minorities' at this place now? Cause I'm getting really bad service here and I don't think I can come here again.

THIS is the authentic stuff. The menu is hand-written and taped up to the bullet proof glass, there's no seating, and this single woman behind a worn out kitchen gives you food in a styrofoam case. As a south-east asian, this is where it's at. The food is seriously authentic. You'll whiff smells that will make you uncomfortable. You'll eat flavors that you didn't know existed. You'll pay so little that you wonder if this is against the law.

I honestly don't even want to post a review, out of fear that some hipster will read this and think it's all trendy to visit this place and hipster up the place.

PLEASE HIPSTERS, DON'T RUIN THIS PLACE LIKE YOU RUINED HARDENA. GO BACK THERE AND ENJOY YOUR 9 DOLLAR SOUP and 4 DOLLAR PIECE OF MYSTERY MEAT.

You're paying 9-12 bucks for what amounts to a slider, some crappy frozen food fries, and a soda. I went here 3 times, hoping it would be different, but nope. 

It's a 5 on my burger scale, and Five Guys is a 8, and In-and-Out is a 9. 

If you're in the area, stick to Five Guys. Or go across the street and wait an hour at Village Whiskey. You're spending 12 bucks anyways - why not get a gourmet burger?

I guess this is the legendary Shake Shack burgers. And frankly, they're pretty meh.

My order took 55 minutes to get here. I'm only 6 blocks away, and regret not walking over. The food is overpriced, even more expensive than downtown prices. They messed up my girlfriend's order. Taste is okay, but it would have been faster to drive to Chinatown and grab dinner than ordering from here.

Went in at 8pm. Workers were telling each other stories about their school experience, cursing and calling each other names. Asked for a courtesy cup of water. 
"We don't do courtesy cups no more." 

"That doesn't sound right. Is there someone I can speak to about this?" I ask them.

"Yo. Can you tell him?" The teen call to her friend, who she was telling the story to. "You heard her. We don't do give out cups anymore."

as part of my road trip, i wanted to try a philly cheese steak

i had mine with hot peppers and it was DELICIOUS, i ate the entire foot long in one sitting, no leftovers!

my dining pal, had a chicken cheese steak with hot peppers, which was not as good

they are CASH only

there is ample street parking

there is NO bathroom. 

the food was prepared quick and staff were very friendly! try it out!

yummy

i had the mexican coffee and chocolate, my pal had the plum. i wish i could have tried all of them, but i was double parked and didn't want to risk a ticket


all were awesome! counter staff were very friendly and patient! the place was really hopping too, especially around 5pm on thursday

yikes ! this is the local equivalent to ben's chili bowl in dc: overhyped, tourist trap

food
gumbo-yuck, i did not finish it. and I hate to waste food, yes it was that bad
jambalaya-bland, mushy

the portions were small 

service
lukewarm 'waiter', the guy literally came to the table holding a cup or a bowl and put it on the table, i honestly thought he was a patron and not a member of the work crew

ambiance
terrible, filthy, i was uncomfortable sitting down in the dingy establishment

price
outrageous prices for what is given

overall: AVOID

bonjour mardi gras!

Came here on a dinner date. It seemed to be very fancy and great for people who are looking to try new foods and have an eclectic palette.

The drinks were excellent. There was one in particular which had gin and spice. I really wish I remember the name of it but it was so tasty. When I asked about one of the ingredients the bartender was nice enough to come over and explain how they made the drink. That gave the place a nice touch.


We tried a bunch of different samplers. The thing that really struck out to me was the foie gras. Which I normally have never taken a liking to especially because of the way they kill the geese. However this was quite tasty.


This is not a cheap place to eat so expect to spend money.


Parking is on the street.


Ambience is very nice. The bathroom is outside of the restaurant and shared by the building. It was very clean. The vibe of the restaurant is very dark and cool. The bar area is very nice. It has very high ceilings and reminds me of an old New England city.

Overall I'm very glad that I came here and I would recommend it.

And this is where fast food comes to save my day! Not only that I absolutely love Sonic. It is one of my favorite fast food chains. The typical thing I get is the cheeseburger with tater tots and a limeade slush and this did not disappoint. The servers were super cool. They didn't roll escape but they were very much on point and got me my food quickly and it was hot. I have no complaints whatsoever about this place and if I'm in the area again, hopefully I'm not  I would try it again

1js82HjEaZdqGhVAnMNXsw.review_text: Awesome cheesesteaks! I got a pepper cheesesteak with extra cheese. In my opinion it really needed the extra cheese but that's a personal preference. The line was a bit long but totally worth it. If I had one annoyance with this place it's that they don't serve French fries to go with the mouth watering cheesesteaks.
Not overly impressed with the Greek food in particular. The Italian isn't bad, but the gyro was just underwhelming.

Granted I just moved from Texas so I have high standards for my Mexican food, but these tacos were not the best. They are absolutely huge in comparison to any other taco place I've been to. I felt like they needed a bit more garnish and flavor.

Loved the dim sum here. The fried pork soup dumplings were amazing. I've never had anything like them. Definitely a must have when anyone comes here. Not to discredit the the food because it was amazing, but I will say that in comparison to other dim sum places I felt like there weren't a ton of dim sum options. I miss my custard bun.
Did care for this Chinese bakery. My boyfriend and I bought pork and custard buns. There was almost no filling in any of them. It was really disappointing.
Solid 4 stars. This place had a lot of very interesting menu items that I haven't seen before.
Awesome market. They have almost every type of food here. It's amazing. The donuts here are so good.
Awesome sandwiches. I got the Italian style pulled pork sandwich. Very satisfying lunch!

Went here for dinner with a friend during restaurant week. The fried chicken entree was very good. Nice and crispy and the sauce on top is good. The veggies were also very well seasoned and delicious. The cheesecake dessert was also really good.

This is a decent breakfast/ brunch spot on weekends. I've gone a couple of times with friends. The French toast is awesome - in particular the drunken monkey French toast. The apple pie French toast is good too. I think it would be made even better if they added some of the drunken money sauce on top! Coffee and lattes are decent and good sized. I wish they had a list of flavors to add to the lattes on their menu. Service can also be a bit slow at times but not too bad.
I ordered the green curry here for dinner. The chicken in the dish tasted tough, dry and old. Also, I didn't think it came with enough rice given the amount of curry.

Went here with a friend for dinner. The place was almost totally empty. I ordered the onion soup which was pretty good but the burger I got (although huge) was super dry and therefore harder to eat. I'd be willing to give this place a second try but I would stay away from the burger.

Drunken monkey French toast was not the same as usual with this visit. Normally it has a really good sauce on top. This time it had oats and dried fruit with some rotten bananas. Definitely no where near as good as the normal drunken monkey. Bring the old kind back! The new one sucks. I left disappointed.
Very good Italian food. Service was very slow last time I was there even with the restaurant basically empty. Food was very good. Got the gnocchi. Super good but very heavy and filling.
Good for a dinner with friends. The place had great ambience for a date night as well. Got the burger. So tasty!

Worst experience I've ever had at a Cheesecake Factory

1. The wait - over two hours to get seated. Which was more than what we were told 

2. When we finally get to the table and order drinks. One glass cake with shards of glass all over it which then got all over the table. Two people at the table cut themselves on the glass. Hopefully the person that had the glass didn't accidentally drink any glass. 

3. Another waiter accidentally dropped a gravy boat that hit my sister 

4. After all this shit, they didn't offer us free dessert or anything. Any other restaurant would have done something. But nope not here. Just trying to get as many people into the restaurant as possible so they can make money. They clearly don't care about cleaning the glasses/tables and making sure their customers don't I don't know EAT GLASS! HORRIBLE!!!!!!
This place was really crowded for mid-week early dinner. We ended up eating at the bar to avoid long wait times. Food was decent, we got the fondue which I enjoyed.
I was really disappointed in this farmers market. Very limited stands. Was expecting it to be better based on the pictures. Never thought I would miss the San Antonio farmers market until today.

I think this place is a 3.5 stars. 

The food was ok. We got the flat breads, I didn't really care for mine. The bread was really good though, better than the actual entree 

The service was slow given how few people were seated at the time I was dining. 

The drinks were delicious and the grounds were so cute. I would come back but they really need to step up their food game. I'd likely just come for drinks
People here are nice. Not the best I've had but certainly not the worst. Will definitely give them another try
Seriously some of the best short ribs I've ever had. I've been waiting for them to put it back on the menu so I can stuff my face again!

Coming from someone that spent a couple years living down south, this is decent bbq especially for up north standards. They have a great array off bbq sauce to choose from and decent meat. I think the sides could use some work. The Mac and cheese was good but the beans were very very Smokey and heavy in a thick sauce. I would have really liked to see creamed corn on the menu. 

My bigger beef came in terms of portions. It looked like dine in customers were getting more food. Also, I watched them dump some of the beans out of the container before putting the lid on.

Had their dumplings at a Philly street food festival. I tried the cheesesteak, Asian pork and blueberry cheesecake. The two meat based ones were great. Flavor was amazing wrapped in a crispy almost wonton like shell. I didn't care for the blueberry one as much. The filling was a bit too thing I thought

After going to the DC location and coming to the bakery here downstairs I needed to try their brunch. I was not disappointed. The food was so good and there was such a variety of choices. In addition to the buffet you can order specials to the table included in the buffet choice. The bacon on a stick was amazing. Not sure if they rotate the extra options or not but would recommend taking advantage.

1kdfj_PaRk8i870ghdIvXg.review_text: Stopped in for dinner.  The atmosphere was modern, food was pretty good.  I would go back, but would not break my neck to get back there.

This is actually my second time coming here.  The first time I went there I ordered the gyro and it was great.... HOWEVER, this particular time I went there, it was just the opposite... HORRIBLE!!!  Maybe this was a bad day for them for gyros...  And on top of that, they overcharged me a few bucks.  When I told the lady at the window, she acted as if she did not understand how she overcharged me, so a supervisor had to come and fix it and give the overage back...  I probably won't be coming back anytime soon.

This Wal-Mart is always overcrowded!!!  My Wal-Mart experience today was ok, nothing out of the ordinary.  I got my things and the cashier acted as if she were happy to be ringing my order up, but I don't know how excited she really was (non-verbal communication goes far beyond verbal sometimes! LOL!)  I don't think the experience will effect me from coming though.  I'm sure I'll be back!  It's all about convenience!

I was very disappointed!!!  I make a mean curry chicken, that I have not been able to find restaurant that can come close to mine, so instead of ordering the curry chicken, I ordered the curry goat, being that I have never cooked, or even eaten goat for that matter.  It most definitely wasn't anything to write home about.  The goat was more fat than meat.  It looked as if it were a lot of meat, but once I began eating it, I realized that it was not too much more than some CURRY FAT!  I ate what I could of it and found myself still hungry afterwards.   If that is what eating goat is about, I don't want any parts of it!  I won't be going back there anytime soon.  That was a waste of $12!

My Cracker Barrel experience was nice.  My husband had the fish and grits, and they were ok.  I've definitely had better fish and grits, but they weren't horrible.  I had the chicken fried chicken.  Even though I have had better chicken fried chicken, it was still pretty good.  The cornbread muffins will really get you in trouble (b/c its hard to leave them alone).  I guess what made this meal so nice was our waitress.  She was great.  She was always on time checking on us, she spent a few minutes chatting with us, etc.  Would I go back????  YES!!!  After we finished our meal, my husband and I spent some time sitting in the rocking chairs outside, with the music playing in the background, and played a game of checkers on their "checker-top-table".  It was a nice end to a meal!

I got the Jolly Rancher slushie and a doughnut from this place and it was great!!!!   That slushie will make you slap somebody it is so good!!!  I have had both flavors, the green apple and the watermelon.  I prefer the green apple, however the watermelon is jumpin' too!  It keeps me coming back time after time.  The doughnuts were great too, they are fresh and it's almost as if they melt in your mouth... but that could be a problem if you are trying to shed a pound or two. :)

A group of us came here for my husband's birthday and had a wonderful time.  The presentation by "Yoshi" was very entertaining.  I forgot the name of the dish, but it was a mix - chicken, shrimp, and filet mignon, over rice.  The food was better than expected!  The staff was phenomenal and "Yoshi" did all kinds of tricks while preparing our food.  And... a cool thing that you might not know is....

If you go on your birthday, your meal is free with the purchase of another guest's meal.  Which could save you up to $25 depending on what is ordered.  BUT - it has to be the actual day of your birthday!  They will ask for your id!

I have been to Landry's quite a few times, and this particular time did not stand out to me more than any other.  Right now they are remodeling and it looks like it will be a very nice ambiance once they have completed the renovations.  The staff was very helpful, as we had a birthday/deployment going away gathering there.  I don't know if I'd be running to get back there anytime soon though!

I love Pita Pit!  I have been a fan of this place since back in 2006.  It's almost like a subway for wraps, as they make it in front of you.  Its quick, the meat is usually seasoned pretty good, it's convenient (It's open pretty late), etc.  I used to always get a chicken pita, but this time, I tried their gyro and it was pretty good.  It wasn't as good as it would have been from a greek restaurant, but it was still pleasing to my taste buds!  If I find myself in a pinch for time, and I am in the area, and hungry...  I'd definitely make a pit stop to pita pit!!!

The smoothie I had here was very tasty.  They also started carrying soft-serve yogurt, which I had a taste and it was pretty good.  They have some comfy seating options, and they also offer wifi if you need to get plugged in for a bit!  I'll probably be back here soon!

Although this particular Publix is not open 24 hours (which usually all of them are), I kinda like this publix.  I usually do most of my grocery shopping at Wal-mart and just get the few things that I can't find at Wal-Mart at whatever grocery store near.  Going to this Publix was a pleasant surprise.  Their selection was more than expected!!!  I was in grocery heaven!  On top of that, when I got ready to check out, I thought I was gonna have to fill out some form to get a "Publix card" to take advantage of the sale prices, but the cashier told me that you don't need a card!!! WOW!!!  Publix, I think I'm in love!!!

The wait was extremely short.  The staff was awesome.  They have a new line of "carribbean" style items that were great.  We had some carribbean style wings that were phenomenal to say the least.  I will definitely be back here for some of these wings...
Crystal was great in helping us find the perfect mix of ice cream...  You can't go wrong with Cold Stone!  What more is there to say?!

I had a slice of pepperoni and my husband has cheese...  It was pretty good.  Its been hard to find good "pizza by the slice" in this area, so this place was an automatic hit.  

[So 4 stars for the food]

On the contrary...  I was watching my team play football (on one of their nice flat screen tvs), and there was less than two minutes left in the game and at that point, the game could have gone either way...  All of a sudden, the channel changes to the Tampa Bay Rays!!!!   WHAT?!  Are you serious?!  The guy that worked there that changed it told me that the Rays were coming on....  I didn't care if the Rays were coming on or not....  You could have given me my last two minutes of football before changing it to the other game!  UGH!!!  Complete turn off for me.  I told them too!  :(  

[2 stars for the lack of compassion for your fellow football watcher]  which is how I came to my 3 star rating!

This line is always long (but it moves rather quickly)!!!  However, they are open very late, and it helps to be able to grab a cup of coffee when you need a boost in the middle of your studying!  Love this place.... despite the line!

What can I say about this particular Wally World?!  Always great prices....  Since they have such a large range of products, it is hard for their selection of a particular item to be large, so sometimes I find specific items at a regular grocery store rather than here.  The service was average, nothing spectatular, but nothing horrible either.

I had a great time here!!!  The late night specials made our final bill ridiculously cheap.  Now they have a little electronic buzzer on the table, so if you need your waiter, all you have to do is press the button and it sends a message to the waiter.  I thought this was GREAT!!!  It made for a very pleasant night!

Although small, do not under estimate this place.  I had the shrimp curry and my huband had the chicken tikka masala, and both were instant hits in our book.  Both dishes were served with basmati rice and warm, fresh pita bread.  I read on their menu that they use "hormone free, boneless, all white meat chicken only", so if this is true, that's even better!  The last thing I need is more hormones!

The decor was contemporary, but still had an Indian flare to it, and there are a few tables outside if you want to catch some fresh air...  I give it a thumbs up!

I had a great time at this Applebees!  The service is prompt (partly due to the call button that you have on your table to alert your server that you need help).  I would definitely go back again!  You can't beat those late night 1/2 price appetizers!!!
Ally's had a pretty good slice of pepperoni pizza!  They let you sample a slice of cheese pizza.  The decor on the inside is pretty much non-existant, but the food is cool!
Ashley was great, yet again!!!  Our food was great!  The staff was awesome and we had a great time!
Great place for some great greek food!  My dish was phenomenal!!!  I have never been here and been disappointed.  I will definitely be back again!

This place was just "OK" at best! I mean, for you to name your restaurant "Gator's Dockside", you've got to hit me with some SLAMMIN' Gator!  When I tasted the gator....  I was more than disappointed.  I actually just had a couple of bites, and left the rest for my husband and I don't think he finished it either.  The gator wasn't tasty at all!!!!!  

As a sports bar, it serves its purpose.  I am a big Dallas Cowboy fan, and sometimes here in Tampa, you can't always catch the game on regular tv, so it is definitely an option for you if you want to be able to catch all your major sports games.  I did enjoy being able to see my team.

Overall, I would come back "ONLY IF" there was a game that I wanted to see and it was not being televised on tv.  Other than that, they probably will not see me again!

Staff was extremely friendly and helpful!  I loved the ambiance of this place.  I have to be honest....  From the outside, it doesn't look like much, but when you walk in, it is a nice, cozy Italian restaurant.  This place came recommended from a friend and I can see why now!

They have the BEST crab burgers & fish spread EVER!!!  This place is phenomenal!!!  My husband and I have come to this restaurant many times, and we are never disappointed.  The staff is very down to earth, and the food makes it hard not to come back!  It's a very laid back spot, and it is walking distance from the beach which makes this place a true gem!  This place is definitely worth coming to!!!  I believe they also deliver to hotels on the beach strip in the area!

The BEST FISH SPREAD I've ever tasted in life!!!  Seriously.... No joke.  The hubby & I used to go to this seafood restaurant on St. Pete Beach that we absolutely LOVED!  When we moved away to DC we couldn't wait to get back to our lil' seafood spot in Florida to grab some of our favorite grub.  This last time, we came out, only to find out that our spot had closed.  Luckily, the last time we were there, we asked them if they would tell us how they prepared their crab cakes & their fish spread since we were moving away.  They gave us their crab cake recipe & the told us where they got there fish spread from....  And this is the place!  The Reef!  We quickly yelped this place to track down the infamous fish spread.  We were on a mission!  We drove for what seemed like hours (actually about 10 minutes) and finally arrived.  From the outside, the place probably wouldn't have caught my eye, but I knew what was waiting for me inside... (Never judge a book by it's cover!).  We went in and bought a pound of fish spread.  It tasted just as good as we remembered...  PHENOMENAL!!!  I don't think we ate anything other than fish spread for the rest of the day (lunch, dinner & breakfast the next day).  

When we were planning the menu for my husband & sister-in-law's graduation party the next day, we ended up going back to the Reef & buying a whole GALLON of that stuff!  Everyone at the party LOVED IT!  It's some good stuff!  

(The spread is good by itself w/crackers, but if you add a dash of hot sauce it really takes it to another level!!!)

My husband and I used to come and hang out here (back in 2006/2007) before we were married.  Its very close to USF so it is a very convenient place for a student (or anyone for that matter) to get away, grab a cup of coffee and get some work done.  (The coffee is AWESOME here).  They frequently have live music, or different things going on here, which just adds to the fun of the place.  I stopped back in this year (2012) and it was just as I remembered.  Friendly staff, great coffee (and snacks) and just a great environment to stop in for a while and relax.
Great pick me up pit stop on a road trip!!! The drinks are on point and the staff is cool.   Gets the job done.
The pretzels are especially good when fresh out of the oven and the Cinnabons are temptation x's 10! The staff is pretty laid back and will get you in and out even when the line is long.

7 years since the first time I've tried the smoked fish spread from The Reef and I still say this place has the absolute BEST FISH SPREAD I've ever tasted in life! This place is a MUST every single time we come to town! This stuff is so addictive that I've even asked about having it shipped up to the east coast, but they can't because some of the ingredients can't be frozen. (BUMMER). If you like smoked fish, fish spread or even want to pick up some seafood to throw on the grill while you're hangin' out at the beach, you'd be doing yourself a disservice not to stop here!

I know, it's late... and everyone has a bad day every once in a while. Today was a roughy day for me, which is probably why the cashier's bad attitude stuck out even more. But given the fact that my latte was decent and showing a little mercy by assuming that the cashier isn't extremely disconnected and dry everyday, I'll spare this Starbucks 3 stars.....

21u_7llMMrgnWD9nyWbgAA.review_text: Disappointing.  We've been going to Opal for several years and it just keeps getting more mediocre.  The Seared Ahi had no flavor and was overpowered by the heavy handed peppercorn wasabi sauce.  When the small portion of ahi is gone, the very strong ginger overpowers the cucumber.  Strip that away and the vinegar kills whats left of the vegis.  Other dishes were also disappointing.  The pizza, which used to be very good, is below average.  Service is poor.  We had to keep asking other waiters to send our server, who though it was just fine to serve reaching across guests instead of moving around the table to serve properly.  This will be our last stop at what used to be a charming bistro.

We took out of town business clients to lunch at the Wine Bistro, thinking the ambience and food would be a delight.  The menu held much promise, with lots of organic, local and free range offerings.  The food itself, however, was without taste or texture.  My wife had to send her steak salad back twice as the meat had a weird taste.  My cobb salad had no  from any of the ingredients. or dressing.  Service was fine and they reduced the bill for the sent back items, but I would never go there again.

Ambiance and decor are fine.  Service was good.  But the crepes were undercooked and still doughy.  Quiche was small, mediocre tasting with tasteless crust.  We sent the soufle back is was very undercooked and was like eating batter.  For the money, there are many better choices in this neighborhood.

Tre Lune has become much more consistent over the years and we now enjoy it weekly.  Service can be pot luck, however there is a new waitress who is the best they've had in years.  Ask for Frieda when you make a reservation.  The farfale al salmon is always great and the chicken is also usually excellent.  Fish can be good or bad, depending on the night.

We took a French friend to lunch here and she couldn't see anything French about the decor, as there is no decor.  We found the Nicoise to be medicare and without taste, the "french fires" to be nothing like pomme frittes and the croque to be unlike anything ever served in France or any other French cafe we've been to.  My wife got sick shortly thereafter.  At $75 for lunch for 3, it's on the high end of downtown lunch prices.  Once was enough for us.
Always consistently fresh & tasty.  Clearly  the best place for mediterranean in SB.  The chicken kabob is maybe the best I've ever had.
Always fresh and healthy.  Consistent.  Great specials.  Friendly service.
Good and fresh.  tasty.  Seems like they turn over staff fairly often, so menu knowledge and service is inconsistent.  I go there at least once a week.
Love this place.  Freshest in town.

Food is tasty, fresh and healthy.  I love the variety of choices.  It's so good that it's often hard to choose something other than that thing you had last time that was so good, you want it again.  Seating is not as comfortable as it could be and sometimes service is slow, but all in all - this is a great place, with great people at the helm.

The pizza here is very good and comes out fast.  I like that one can modify their pizza anyway one likes.  It took me a couple times to get it right, so my first couple pizzas weren't stellar.  I kept asking for too much sauce, which made it soupy.  They tried to warn me.  the pesto pizza is surprisingly good.  I prefer the Marinara to the Mergherita as it seems to be more flavorful.  Gluten free (dough from the Soj) is also available.  A great lunch spot

The employees hate working there and they're not afraid to tell you, or show you.  Indifferent at best, rude and surly at worst.  There's never enough cashiers, and there's always a wait.  I avoid this place except for the very few things I cant get at the farmers market or Trader Joes.

They're sliding a bit on their game here.  Food's not quite as fresh, service is still excellent, but to turn the lights on bright at ten minutes after closing time is a bit rude.  I'm going to give it a break for a while.

We've been to Le cafe Stella many times throughout the years, usually with a group of 7-8 people.  Service is usually good and so is the food.  Our recent experience was very disappointing though.  The meatloaf, which is usually quite good, was tasteless and actually made me ill.  The cobb salad also had no taste and the mac & cheese made our daughter ill.  The coq au vin, usually good, was overcooked and bland.  Even the hamburger was tasteless.  I asked if the chocolate mouse was real mouse and ordered it after being assure it was.  It was not mouse, but a solidified ganache like mess which I sent back. A waiter kept running into me in his hurry to get to other tables, but never apologized or took another route.  Very rude and disruptive.   After patronizing this place for years, it will be a long time before we return.  Time for new management and training.

It's sad commentary on the quality of Santa Barbara sushi choices that Arigato is the best in town,  It would be average in LA, SF or NY.   That said, the fish is fresh and the sushi chefs are fast and friendly.  I come here a dozen times a  tear,  I've never felt welcomed - hospitality is very low on the priorities.  Tonight at 5:45  there were four places available at the sushi bar and one person was folding  napkins, taking the whole area.  I was, stridently, told the wait would be 10-15 minutes.  I commented that it seemed the napkins were more important than the customer.  To which I was told, "We need the napkins"!  And that sums up the attitude here - arrogant, cold and inhospitable.  I think I'll give this place a rest.  Let them fold napkins.

This place is a throw back to 50's East Coast kitsch filled cafe/deli - cramped, loud and kinda musty.   We arrived at 8:30 and there was one 4 top available.  They told us we'd have to wait about 15 minutes for a 2 top.  The place was clearing out, so more tables were becoming available.  We asked for the 4 top, not an unusual request, but was told we had to have 4 people for that.  So we waiting until a tiny 2 top came  open.  We were ignored by staff, but finally chased one down and he gave us the little table, despite another request for a more spacious table.  It's now 8:45.  He seats us and tells us the kitchen closes at 8:45 and we need to order immediately.  My wife thinks he's been rude for the last 15 minutes and doesn't understand why we can't have an adult sized table.  Anyway, we order salad verde lasagne and penne bolognese.  Neither of which were very good - sauce dry, yet doused in very sharp olive oil.  Not cheap, not good, not comfortable, not hospitable - not going back.
Consistently high quality fresh food.  Excellent service, friendly people.  One of the best two Italian restaurants in SB.  The other is Tre Lune.  we're regulars at both.
I've eaten there three times in the past 5 years, each time worse than the last.  Overcooked, bland pasta, sketchy service.  The worst in SB

Nice decor, decent service and mediocre, though abundant, food.  Caesar salad is OK, pastas are usually overcooked.    Sitting outside for lunch on a sunny spring day elevates the setting, allowing one to overlook the food's lack of quality.

Lovely outdoor setting, attentive service and good food make this place a comfortable respite.  Occasionally staff can be rude and imperious, but then we take a break from the place and by the time we come back, they're usually gone - until the next arrogant server comes along.  SB is not known for professional wait staff, except in very few places.

The food remains consistent, fresh and tasty, even though the menu has changed some.  The remarkable thing about the Soj is that the wait staff has a long history at the place.  This speaks volumes about the owner/manager, who seems to always be on site.  We also patronize the natural Cafe, which has a massive staff turnover rate and the consistency, quality and service suffers as a result.  This place feels like a nurturing home.

We've been going here for 15 years and have watched it go steadily down hill for the last 6-7.  In fact, we stopped going here regularly and only show up here when we forget how bad the last time was.  Tonight reminded us again that we swore never to come back.  Bad food and bad service.  The worst experience yet and hopefully our last.

Nice atmosphere, if a little tight in the seating.  I was surprised to find that they do not stock Diet Coke, which I enjoy before a meal.  So I ordered water, but had to ask for refills, which was somewhat indicative of the level of attentiveness of service - there is none.  Food was OK, but not great.  I had the duck confit, which was rather lacking in taste.  My partner ordered the steak, which was also lacking in taste.   A bit disappointing all around.
Fairly average food with fairly poor service. Maybe breakfast is better.
Consistently fresh and tasty.  Would prefer table service rather than stand and order.  One of the best in SB - actually in the top 2.  Which one is #1 varies from time to time.

We have been long time customers of Persona, patronizing the pizzeria at least once a week.  Tonight we arrived at 8:55 and we're told that the manager had instructed that no more pizzas be made.  We were unable to convince them that the pizza would take a minute to make and 90 seconds to bake and that we'd be out by closing time, 9pm.  We were still turned away.

So we walked a block away to Pizza Rev and were welcomed warmly.  The pizza was great.  in fact the red sauce is much better than Persona.  The choices of fresh toppings was impressive and there is no extra charge for as many toppings as you want.  The sweet fennel sausage was delicious.

All in all, our experience at Pizza Rev was excellent - the pizaa was great and the staff was very efficient and very friendly.    Persona employees often seem like they don't like the place and don't like you.

Sorry Persona, you've lost my business to a better, more customer friendly place.

All in all, our experience at Pizza Rev was excellent - the pizaa was great and the staff was very efficient and very friendly.    Persona employees often seem like they don't like the place and don't like you.

We were initially disappointed by being turned away at Persona, but in the end, they did us a favor.  We found a better place and a new favorite.  Best Pizza in SB!

This is my new favorite restaurant in SB.  The food is fresh, tastes exquisite and is easy to share.  Tonight my wife and I shared the tomato soup and the lasagne and left very satisfied.  Great vibe, friendly service and incredible food.
It's become one of our favs.  Much more consistent than earlier.  Salmon al Farfale is the benchmark for all others.
On a nice warm night, this place can be great.  Food more consistent these days, as is the service.

the first time I ate here, I was surprised at how good it was.  I've been back several times now and it has become by favorite tacos place in SB.  Really fresh and tasty.  Love the battered cod, ahi poke, spicy crispy shrimp.  Haven't even gotten to the traditional tacos yet.  Love it.

27km-ZQwZMMq_Yooq3nSIw.review_text: Love love love!! First time I went to dimitris I was blown away. The fresh pita bread was so good, breaded octopus was amazing and the shrimp scampi is my all time favorite!!! Service is hit or miss. The one girl is always so attentive and nice while the other girl is just kinda eh but the food is so good it doesn't matter! Byob is a great plus! This is my go to place

Wtf. I've been coming to this specific Applebee's for a very long time, I order to go constantly on my way home from work and always enjoy dinner with friends and family here. Service has always been amazing, except tonight. Our waitress named London (yes I'm putting her name out because she is the worst waitress I've ever encountered) and I am in the restaurant business myself so I know the difference between being confused or someone just having a bad day, well not her she's just slow and lazy and doesn't give a sh*t. We sat down, took her about ten minutes to come get our drink order, which by that point we were all ready to order so we had to grab her attention after taking the drink orders that we were ready. Okay fine, slow at first no biggie. Well when our appetizer came out before she gave us our drinks ( another 15 minutes still no drinks) that's a problem. She didn't offer us plates or silverware, another waitress was kind enough to come see we didn't have anything and brought it to us herself. She never came back to check on us until we were ready to pay and leave. I love Applebee's but your service is headed the wrong way!

My boyfriend and I have visited here a bunch of times and we will still be coming here! Everything has always been great! Mussels are amazing in the white and the red! Chicken Marsala is amazing! The drinks are a little to expensive, some of them being as much as your meal itself, but I guess that's because the location. Grab a drink across the street at Las Vegas lounge first to pay average price for a drink than head to an amazing dinner here!

Usually love this place, but lately the service sucked! And god forbid you try to order for pickup they are so rude OR put you on hold for the rest of the night! I understand it's a mostly eat in restaurant but your food is good, people are going to want it to go if they've had a long day. But that is just not okay with the servers/bartenders answering the phone. Straight attitude. But if you do eat there, pierogies are your best bet.

Margaritas are good. That's it. Want real Mexican go to taco Riendo at 5th and Thompson. This places blows, it's not even good Mexican American. The shrimp tacos were white. Shrimp is supposed to have a tan or red color to it and you can tell how frozen and old there shrimp was cause it was pure white. They were chewy and flavorless. My boyfriend ordered the chicken tacos which seemed to have flavor but were incredibly dry.

Cheesesteak here is amazing!! I always order for delivery because the staff is hit or miss. One day the cashier guy ( hate to point it out again since I just saw the review about this guy but...) the tatted up guy was so rude it was ridiculous.

Food is great! Been here three times so far and the food is always amazing! But the service, is a whole different story. Went in Friday night around 630 and it was busy but not crowded. Hostess told us about 10 minutes for a table so we figured we could grab a drink at the bar real quick and wait. The bartender sucked, she was young and blond and looked miserable! I grabbed an empty seat to order two beers and she looked over at me and never came and asked us what we needed. She went to the end of the bar and started chit chatting with a guy who was there, that already had a drink and just had a full conversation without coming to attend to other patrons! Well that started the bad service. We get seated in the front of the restaurant where it's a table next to the wall separating the dining area and the bar area, the hostess leaned over our table twice with her back to us and her hair waving in front of our faces!! Seriously I love the food but I won't be back with service like that especially with how much we pay for dinner, the service is not acceptable. Head to the south street location for WAY better service.

Drunken noodles. Do it. Staff is so friendly and always accommodating. Love this place . You won't be disappointed. Went with my girlfriend whose vegetarian and they had plenty of dishes for those who are non meat eaters!

My go to pizza place. Everything is awesome! Panini italiano is the best panini I've ever had, made on there homemade bread. Tomato pie is ridiculously good! Staff is always so friendly even when we call for delivery they are so nice! Love this place

Pros: Close to home, friendly staff and cheap drinks! 
Cons: smells like dog piss (because dogs do piss in there since there aloud) and the bands that play in the back room are incredibly loud you can't hear your own thoughts.

Love this place! Service is so friendly, decor is very cute & food is amazing!! I would suggest making reservations they get pretty busy & it's BYOB which is a great plus! The spicy chicken with noodles is to die for!

Not a big sushi fan, but props are needed for this place! The interior and decor are so cool and bright, sushi bar in the back was awesome, actually enjoyed sushi for the first time in awhile and drinks are very good!!

Been here twice so far and both times were very enjoyable. Wings are really good, and pretty standard burger too. There drink menu is awesome! The smoked piña is an amazing drink! Way different then anything I've ever tried. Happy hour is pretty sweet too, $15 margarita pitchers. Score!

Love this place! Start by saying when you call for a delivery, the guys answering the phone are so nice and polite. Delivery time is always about 20-35 minutes which is awesome, and of course the food is great. I've tried almost every pizza place in the neighborhood & the wings here are effing perfect!! Cooked perfect, taste good and are just flat out awesome. They also have great daily specials. Favorite pizza place in the neighborhood!
Best chinese takeout/delivery in NoLibs and fishtown area. The food is always good, they have some decent combos for a good price, and delivery is usually about 25 minutes.

I go to the fire most week nights after work for a few drinks,  chat with the bartenders, and relax from a long day. Well last night there was zero relaxation.  The new bartender 'Angie' has the most insane attitude problem ever,  doesn't know how to make drinks, didn't comprehend what an empty shot glass upside down on our money meant (somebody bought us our next drinks) and her eyes are completely glazed over from whatever type of drugs shes hooked on.  I really hope she gets fired or else she might just get punched in the face, its insane how terrible her attitude and service is towards people spending there money at this place. Rant over.

Amazingggg. Seriously hands down best tacos ever. The guys who work are so nice, make amazing food, and they get the food prepared in less theb 10 minutes. This place is my dinner about 2 to 3 times a week.

So last night was my first time ever trying Vietnamese food and I can't believe how delicious it is, the hype is real! Friends I went with ordered so many appetizers for the table, I'm usually a picky eater when it comes to new places but everything smelled great, presentation was nice and it was all so good! The owner I believe was our waitress, its pretty small inside but very cozy, and she was soo friendly! Definitely going back soon!! Oh and BYOB!!

So last night was my first time here for a friends bday party. We arrived around 10, and headed upstairs for the music and some dancing. They have two bars, pretty big/nice layout of the place. I think okay cool, this will be a fun night. Open a tab at the one bar just to make it easier grabbing drinks, and everytime I tried to grab a drink the bartender lady, was doing everything except actually giving a shit about tending bar. Whatever, it happens I guess. Now it's around 1130, I head outfront for a smoke and the bouncers aren't letting a group of people or kids i should say in because they don't have ID. Which is what bars have bouncers for, right? Well the one kid knew the owner,  calls the owner outside so he escorts the kids in himself!! Really? Way to encourage underage drinking. Head back upstairs, both bars are slammed with patrons. Like crazy busy, so i try to grab a beer from the bar that i don't have a tab on just because it looked a less bit crowded, the bartender was going crazy, he didn't leave the one end of the bar at ALL. Clearly doesn't know how to manage a bar and serve both ends, so i say screw it, go over to the other bar to close my tab and just leave at this point. Why stay when theres underage kids getting plastered and you can't even grab a drink. 30 minutes I had to wait for the bartender to even acknowledge I was there and wanted to close my tab. Probably the worsttt place I've ever been to, and trying to leave we had to avoid three different piles of throwup on the floor along with many dropped drinks. And and the DJ really fucking sucked. Caught a cab to Time which isn't filled with children, great dj and the bartenders are actually friendly and efficient.

Tonight is my second time using Go Puff and I'm so glad I have them in my life. I work crazy hours, and walking to get a case of beer in the cold weather is just not appealing, at all. First time I used it the delivery was a bit longer then expected, but I wasn't going anywhere so i didn't mind and the delivery guy was super nice. Tonight the case of beer I ordered came in like 12 minutes, I was super shocked it was so quick! Definitely going to be an App/business i will be ordering from frequently

This was by far the most complicated food shopping experience ever, we ended up just walking out. The place itself is extremely small and everything is packed in together, items are not where you would normally find them at any other super market, wayyy to congested with children running around unattended it seemed. Seriously the worst super market i have ever been to in any city. Fun fact, if your looking for body soap, its next to insecticides! WTF!

Tried this place for the first time last Friday night and was blown away! It was around 830 on a friday night, they were pretty busy but we got a table right away and we're greeted by a very friendly waiter. Our waiter thoroughly explained the dishes to us, we had the tomato salad and ceasar salad, the tomato salad was out of this world! Never had it the way they make it and it was just amazing. My dad ordered the trout and I ordered the eggplant, both dishes were enormous and delicious! I don't usually eat fish but tried the trout and it was super tender and had perfectt flavor. The eggplant was in a tomato sauce that was so good. Ambiance, service, and food was all excellent! Will definitely be back. And BYOB! Brought a small bottle of merlot that went perfect with the entire meal. Left super full and happy!

We live right around the corner and frequent el camino alot. Some days I'll hit happy hour with friends and come back later in the night for dinner, because the food is consistently good. Yesterday was the 2nd street festival so i get it is an extremely busy day for all restaurants in the area. Had lunch there in the front first bar, good service & food. Few hours later came back for some AC and a margarita still no problem. Finally after a long hot day of walking and being in the sun, we decide to head home and grab dinner at el camino before calling it a night. Sat at the back bar which was pretty empty, and had the rudest bartender i have ever dealt with. So like i said we frequent it alot, and ive never seen this kid bartending before. He's clearly young and at first was nice but turned out to be an asshole. We ordered our food and asked for 2 city wides of tecate & tequila and he said well idk guys it looks like you already had enough. We honestly thought he was being sarcastic since it would've been our 3rd drink the entire day, but when no drinks arrived we brushed it off because we were too exhausted to even say anything. Eat our food, ask for the tab and that never came. There was only three other people seated at the bar and he kept walking around without grabbing our tab for us. At this point we just wanted to leave, it wasn't busy, the service blew and we couldn't get a tab to leave. Finally i ask him a 2nd time for the tab and he looked super annoyed and put his finger up for us to wait but he wasnt even doing anything! I work in the industry, so there seemed to be no excuse for his behavior because he had no customers to be occupied doing other things. I hope someone teaches him customer service skills or becomes a host because bartending is definitely not for him.

Sooo this will be my 3rd update of the fire, and I frequent here so much because I basically live next door and its just so convenient. Management switched hands and it's definitely headed in a better direction with everything they have going on. Different beers, fitting into the NoLibs scene more, its great. I really only have complaint and feel bad for even saying it, because its about the one bartender whose extremely nice. Elisa, Alyssa? Not sure her name exactly, im not sure if she just fills in or does have a permanent shift because she's not there too often, but I always know when she is because the bar is always unattended when she's working. Like shes always in the back room when shes working, when she comes out shes super nice but it takes her forever and the bar should see that as a problem because they could definitely get robbed blind thats how long she takes being in the back. Shes always talking about music and working music so maybe she should work in the music scene full time instead of tending bar. Today (halloween) i walked in after work around 9pm for a 6 pack for my roommate and I, no exaggeration it took her 10 minutes to come out from Open mic while the bar was half full with patrons waiting and noo bartender in sight. I was going to leave but like i said, i live a minute away so I wasnt going to walk out of the way almost 15 minutes to grab a sixer elsewhere in the cold. I just dont get how its okay for that happen. Shes super nice but just not good at staying behind the bar at alll.

Palm Tree has become one of my favorite places for lunch. The sandwiches are always packed with fresh cut lunch meat, fresh vegetables & bread. And the best part is they DELIVER in the neighborhood. There always super nice on the phone & delivery is quick. For $8 i get a packed sandwhich, chips & a drink delivered. I highly recommend them.

Tonight my boyfriend & I decided on grabbing Dmitris for take out ( we often pick up about 80.00 worth of food to take home) tonight an extremely unpleasant woman named Rita answered the phone telling me that they no longer accept takeout orders ( its 6:15 pm), continuing with the kitchen is "super busy" but we could try to come in and eat and maybe land a table. Soooo I cant pick up food but your telling me to waste my time trying to "land a table" while you mentioned your kitchen is super busy. I've worked hospitality for 10 years & never seen anyone speak to any like Rita has. Thanks, definitely deterred from every spending my money here again or ever referring clients to come here. Face/voice of a business is everything and they lost us to say the least. Not the mention everyone we deal with on a day to day basis from out of town we always refer here, NEVER AGAIN.
