Take me to the Gumbo Shop! Not only is the food amazing, but the ambiance and service here is even more splendid. This is an absolute gem in NOLA. We found ourselves here for our last night at 9pm with no wait at all. Their outdoor area feels like you're dining in a garden --so beautiful and romantic. It was perfectly warm with the heating lamps out there even on a cold night.

We started off with a bottle of Jacob's Creek Merlot ($28) and their special gumbo of the day: Turkey and Spicy Andouille Gumbo ($5.99) as appetizer. The wine was smooth and the gumbo was tasteful. The cup size was perfect for us to get a little taste before our meal. As for the main entrees, we had the Crawfish Etouffee ($18.99) and Crawfish  and Pasta in Tasso Cream ($16.99). As yummy as the crawfish etoufee was, it was the crawfish pasta that won both of our hearts over. This was also our server, Jamal's recommendation, which was a wonderful one. The creaminess of the sauce truly complimented all of the pieces of crawfish in the penne pasta, yum! This place is seafood heaven. Even though I was too full by the end of the meal, I couldn't leave behind my leftovers and took it back home on the plane with me.

Damnit, Willie Mae --you've ruined fried chicken for me forever. I can never smell, see, and taste fried chicken the same way after having THE BEST FRIED CHICKEN IN THE WORLD! I am confident there is no better fried chicken out there.

I came here 10 minutes before opening at 10am on a Monday. There were only 3 parties before us, but the line started forming minutes after we arrived. Either way, everyone that was in line was able to be seated during the time we dined. If you want to skip the wait, your best bet would be on a weekday. We got our orders out of the way as soon as possible since everyone else would be ordering at the same time. Although we were hoping to also try the Baked Chicken, it would've taken half an hour so we passed.

We got two orders of the Three Piece Fried Chicken with Mac and Cheese ($15) --one for him and one for me. Get your own plate and some. Seriously, who would want to share such deliciousness?! Our food came out pretty soon and just the smell of the fried chicken was enough to have me salivating. Oh my goodness, the batter is so light and crisp that even the skin easily fell off the meat. It had the perfect flavor and crunch to it. Now the tender chicken meat inside was just the most incredibly juicy and detectable taste of chicken ever. Make sure to add in some of their hot sauce here per request and you've got yourself a winning chicken dinner!

Aside from the star of the show, their mac and cheese was memorable as well. It was so cheesy in flavor with a liquid-based consistency. Every plate automatically comes with peas, which were tasty as well. I'm not a fan of peas at all, so the fact that I ate almost all of my peas is saying a lot!

Be warned about coming to Willie Mae's for the first time. Once you've had the chicken here, your tastebuds will be changed and you'll find yourself wondering when you'll be back again. I'd keep coming back to smell like fried chicken everyday if I could.

The name says it all: Acme is "the point at which someone or something is best, perfect, or most successful," or simply THE BOMB. While there's many oysters spots around NOLA, Acme is one of the most famous ones. We waited about 20 minutes outside as it was drizzling to get a seat here for two on a Saturday at 5pm. There seems to be a lot of parties of two, so the couple before and behind us ended up seating in a large communal table with us. It was fun though as we had some extra company to cheers and chat with. The interiors of this place has dim red lighting for a really divey atmosphere.

To start off, the boyfriend and I each got two drinks (as the other two couples followed lead). I had the Acme Sunset ($5.50) and Hurricane ($9) while he had the Irish Mule ($8) and Mint Julep ($8.50). If you want something strong, go for the Irish Mule for sure. As for my two drinks, they were both sweet and fruity, but still tasty. Since the two of us ate not too long ago, we only had oysters here which was what we really came here for anyways. We got one dozen Chargrilled Oysters ($19.99) and half a dozen Raw Oysters ($8.99). They did switch up how much we wanted between the two types of oysters, but we weren't complaining since the chargrilled oysters were so bomb! These were definitely the favorite for us the entire trip in NOLA and all the other chargrilled oysters we had just couldn't compare. It was just so buttery and cheesy. I was licking the entire shell even after trying to wipe as much of it as I could with the bread.

Boy were we happy and so satisfied with these oysters at the end of the meal. Even though we were full, our server convinced us with their homemade Bread Pudding ($7.98) with a scoop of Vanilla Ice Cream. The pudding was warm and soft, which just complimented the cold and refreshing ice cream. This was a great way to end the meal as if the oysters weren't enough. You just can't do New Orleans without having the chargrilled oysters at ACME though!

Our very first meal in NOLA was at Royal House, which was a lovely start. We arrived on a Saturday late afternoon with no wait at all. I really wanted the balcony view, so requested a table upstairs outside. Unfortunately, the balcony at Royal House is incredibly slanted and narrow. As nice as the view was overlooking the streets below, I was fearing for anything accidentally getting dropped over the balcony. You're literally sitting at a 30 degree angle --kind of scary.

Anyways, we decided to order the Taste of New Orleans ($18) and Shrimp Creole ($18) to share. Since there was a free appetizer with a purchase of two entree deal on Yelp, we also added the Alligator Bites ($12). To start, the alligator bites were something new for us. It was a tiny little cup of fried bites that just tasted like fried meat --good, but nothing very special about it.

Now since this was our first stop, we knew the taste of New Orleans would allow us to try a little bit of everything. This sampler came with a cup of Chicken & Andouille Jambalaya, Crawfish Etouffee, and Chicken & Andouille Gumbo. Along with the shrimp creole, everything was served over a bed of steamed white rice. The rice here was so hard, which made it not as enjoyable. While the jambalaya was our least favorite, the gumbo and shrimp creole were solid choices. The real dish to get here is the crawfish etouffee though. This is the first time I have ever had crawfish etouffee and Royal House has had me hooked! I honestly wish we just got a full order of it instead. The creamy gravy was so whole-hearted with every bite. I'd highly recommend the crawfish etouffee here and anywhere!

We stumbled over to The Carousel for a drink per our Lyft driver's recommendation. It's inside a fancy hotel, so expect a more sophisticated crowd (besides one bachelorette party I saw in here). It was a pretty crowded evening, but we got lucky and found a table next to the window for two. A server came by to take our orders and even brought out our drinks fairly quick even though she messed up on my order and had to exchange my drink. We both ordered the Fleur Des Lis ($12), which was light and refreshing with cucumbers.

The carousel that makes this bar so special didn't amaze me, unfortunately. It moved so slow that it didn't even seem like it was even moving at all. This is a nice spot to check out, but also could pass on.

Where else are you going to find 25¢ oysters?! The happy hour deal here just doesn't get any better. I'm so glad our Lyft driver recommended this spot to us for their happy hour that runs from 4-8pm everyday including weekends! We came around 4:30pm and was seated right away outdoors, which sets you in a garden atmosphere. They also have heated lamps to keep you warm as it gets chilly at night.

The only requirement for the oyster deals is one alcoholic drink per dozen oysters, so we got three drinks and three dozen oysters between the two of us. In addition, their well drinks are also 2 for 1, so you get a double! I went for the well gin and tonic ($5.95), which was not something I usually go for. The boyfriend had a Jameson and gingerale ($7.50) and one of their local beers: Dixie ($4.50). Even the drinks are so cheap, so I ain't complaining.

We ordered one dozen charboiled oysters ($10) and two dozen raw oysters ($3 per dozen). Seriously, I can't get over how cheap these oysters are! And to add, they're HUMONGOUS oysters --literally the size of my palm. We were both all oystered out by the end of our meal here. So good, so cheap!

If you're looking for the best po'boy around, it doesn't get any better than Killer Po'boys --exactly like its name. It's located in the back of Erin Rose in a very small corner. There's only one table with a couple stools, but it seems like most people get their orders to-go here.

We ordered the Glazed Pork Belly Poboy ($12) to share. Oh my, the fatty and juicy pork belly was amazing! The pieces were huge and the marinate just enhanced the entire sandwich so much. For some refreshing balance, it's stuffed with a lime slaw that was delicious as well. Definitely the best po'boy I have had. For someone who isn't crazy about po'boys, this one was worth eating though!

This dive bar was already pretty busy on a Sunday afternoon. We had the  Frozen Irish Coffee, which is a must! For all the coffee lovers, this frozen alcoholic drink is perfect. And truth be told, it was yummy even for myself who isn't a coffee lover at all.

Grab a drink here and enjoy your po'boy in the back at Killer Poboy!

We came here strolling along Bourbon Street and got their $12 drinks specials. You get a choice of the Hurricane or Long Island Ice Tea --both super strong and sweet drinks. It's a good deal as it comes in a huge cup the size of a super-size me cup at McDonald's. Both of us barely made it through halfway of the drink throughout the night. Although it's strong, it was too sugary to hold down.

This was a nice grab to walk along Bourbon Street to sip on. It's nice that it's situated in this courtyard with a DJ playing nearby. I was particularly intrigued by the water fountain with fire coming out. Other than that, many other spots to check out along Bourbon Street.

While wandering Bourbon Street, I stopped by here to use the bathroom. The boyfriend also ordered a shot of Don Julio while waiting for me. They ended up pouring him two shots for only $4 --how cheap! We stayed a bit longer watching people take their shots on the mechanic bull. Pretty chill spot with cool "swampy" outdoors environment along with cheapass drinks.

Right when we got off the St. Charles streetcar, we saw this place and decided to check it out before heading to our happy hour spot. Although I was originally looking to share the Graveyard Platter for $13.99 (choice of 2 meats), the cashier recommended for us to get the Voodoo Platter (half rack of ribs & a meat) for $19.99 instead. For the other meat, we opted for the Jerk Chicken and got the Mac & Cheese and BBQ Jambalaya as sides. The plate also includes a cornbread too.

When our Voodoo Platter came out, the presentation was on point. But from just looking at the meats, you could already see how dry it was. We tried it anyways and the Jerk Chicken was simply disappointing even with all the BBQ and hot sauce to give it some flavor. It was just so dry, bland, and lifeless. Even the jambalaya was bland, but the ribs were okay. The only good part was the mac and cheese.

Even though this place sounds like a good value, it's not worth. The food is okay at best, but did the deed to ease our hunger a bit.

P.S. Free bread pudding with a Yelp check-in.

I came here hoping to get a tray of their crawfish, but it was sold out on a Monday afternoon. The server told us everything else on the menu is still just as great, including the shrimp. I thought I was getting the boiled shrimp, but actually made a completely wrong order. Maybe that's where it went wrong, but either way I wasn't too excited about my meal once it came out.

The two of us shared the 2 Combo Seafood Platter with Fried Shrimp and Fried Oysters ($19.99) and the Soup and Sandwich Special ($11.99). For the platter, the server gave us extra fries in replacement for the potato salad it was supposed to come with which we didn't mind too much, but there was definitely no toast. This entire platter was just filled with way too much fried things for me. I had a couple pieces and was done. I do have to say that the fried oysters and french fries were very tasty though. As for the sandwich, we got the Catfish & Shrimp Combo Poboy with the Gumbo for an extra dollar. Because we were so full, we only ate the fried pieces of the poboy and tossed the sandwich out. Their gumbo is pretty good with flavor, at least.

When it comes to Nashville fried chicken, Hattie B's is all I ever hear about. This spot has been on my list for years and I am a Nashville fried chicken connoisseur. You may say, I came to Nashville just for this. It was the first stop from the airport; with luggage and all.

On a Friday at 5pm, the line was about 10-15 minutes. We made our order and went to a picnic table in the outside patio. We ordered the Fried Chicken Sandwich ($10.50) with Crinkle-Cut Fries and the Small Dark Plate ($9) with Pimento Mac and Cheese and Cole Slaw. I heard Nashville does their spicy extra, so I tried to be careful by ordering the medium spicy for the quarter leg and hot for the sandwich. Unfortunately, it wasn't all that spicy for me so I could've gone spicier for sure. I mean, the crispy coating and flavors were on point, but the chicken was a tad dry. Don't get me wrong, it's still very good fried chicken; but not the best I have ever had. I hope it was just a bad day. As for the sides, my absolute favorite was the mac and cheese. The pimento cheese just made it so ooey gooey.

Nonetheless, this is still a must when in Nashville. I ain't never going to say no to a Nashville fried chicken sandwich.

As a huge fan of Luke Bryan, this bar was on the top of my list to visit. Surprisingly, the line was pretty short and there weren't too many people on the other floors. On a Friday night, it was only busy in the rooftop but we still found some lounging chairs to hang around.

I grabbed a few mixed drinks for $12 each. Pretty chill and standard spot, but it was not too lively.

It was a Friday night and the line was down the block, but it moved pretty quickly. Don't try to sneak over the ledge of the window as securities came really quick to remove those girls. There is live music playing on multiple floors and the space has a lot of open windows. There are also a few cash bars, so it's a bit easier than waiting at the actual bar for a drink.

It's crowded and a fun time.

This is a fun spot, especially for brunch on the weekends. Even though brunch menu ends at 2pm, it's still a cool spot to check out anytime. It's best if you can make reservations, which I booked for 2pm on a Saturday. I'm really just here for the fried chicken, so they always have that on the menu. 

To start off, I got the 20oz Watermelon Frose ($15) with an extra Smirnoff Watermelon Mint shot (+$5). If you're going to do it, do it big with the 20oz goblet! The drink was good and strong. It also gave me a bit of a headache from the sweetness and cold though. They have so many flavors of boozy slushy to choose from, so pick your poison. My friend tried a few of their draft beers, including a pickle beer which was subtle and unique. 

For the food, we shared the Hot Chicken and Beignets ($15), Hot Chicken Nachos ($16), and Hot Chicken Chorizo Queso ($12). Unfortunately, the food fell a bit flat here. The hot chicken was a bit dry and wasn't very spicy at all despite ordering hot spicy level. I'd skip the nachos, but would order the queso again. The queso was velvety and cheesy, which was our favorite of the three.

While this spot was more 3 stars for me, our waiter was super friendly and helpful with helping my friend pick out drinks and checking up on us.

My friend wanted to check out a rooftop bar, so we made our way here. It's located inside the Thompson Hotel into this gorgeous rooftop. Upon entering, you walk into a beautiful bar that is a centerpiece in this place. When you head out to the patio, there's a perfect view of downtown Nashville. It's nice to see the view from afar when you're not in the middle of the downtown rooftop bars.

For drinks, they have a few creative and fancy cocktails. I had the Time of Opportunity ($13), consisting of Tokyo Japanese whiskey, Pimms, cherry, lemon, pineapple, and absinthe. The drinks are pretty and so is the view. They even named a drink Social Media Influencer, which says it all here.

While in The Gulch area, we came here for some good ol' BBQ dinner. It wasn't too busy on a Saturday evening with seating both inside and outside. It has that rustic vibe with a mural right next door. 

For three of us, we shared the Combo Platter ($35), Peg Leg Wings ($12.95), Mac and Cheese ($2.50), and Potato Salad ($2.50). Since they use a dry rub here, get lots of BBQ and hot sauce with your food. The Combo Platter comes with half rack of ribs, half yardbird, pulled pork, and sausage hot links. The sausages were a plus since that wasn't listed on their normal menu. Although the ribs were dry, everything else was tender and flavorful, especially the chicken. I have never seen chicken fall off the bone so easily. For their wings, I liked that the cashier suggested we order it dry and they gave us Buffalo and BBQ on the side to dip, which gave us some variety. These wings were nice and crispy, but did not have much meat on there. The sides are the best here and are all only $2.50 each. We loved both the mac and cheese and potato salad.

Great BBQ spot here! I would skip the ribs, but get some extra sides! There are a few other unique items on the menu that you don't normally see at a BBQ spot here either.

This popular donut shop is super cute from the exterior to the inside. This bakery used to be a house and it's really creative how they have transformed the place. Plus, the story of how the owners named this bakery after their own five daughters is heartwarming.

What this bakery is known for is the 100 layer donuts. There are various flavors including monthly flavors. I opted for the King Kong ($4.75), which is rolled in sugar, infused with vanilla buttercream, topped with maple glaze and candied bacon pieces. The really impressive part is how they get a cream stuffed inside their layered donuts. While a bite or two is good, the donut got overwhelmingly sweet. I could not finish my single donut without feeling like I was going to get a cavity right away.

Prince's is the OG and inventor of the Nashville fried chicken. I have to thank this legendary Prince's lover for adding all the spices on fried chicken as revenge only to create such a delicious food. Despite this being the originator of hot chicken, I was disappointed with the actual food.

Maybe it's because it's become a fast-food restaurant, but the chicken was dry. This location at Assembly Food Hall is convenient with so many options around. There was no wait here on a Sunday afternoon and we got our food fairly quick. We ordered The Andre Chicken Sandwich ($10), Fries ($3), Cole Slaw ($2), and Mac & Cheese ($2.50). While the chicken was dry, the spicy had a good kick at hot level spice. The sides were all good as is, but a bit small.

While we grabbed other foods at the Assembly Food Hall, we decide to get something easy to share for a group. We came across this spot and ordered the Queso Blanco with chips ($5.25). The tacos on the rest of the menu seem pretty pricey, but this Queso was a solid choice.

I watched as the employee was making two orders of the queso. Although she was done, she continued working on other orders as I just stood there staring at my ready order until she called my name.

The queso itself is yummy. There's salsa and chorizo inside, which gives some spicy and texture when mixed together with the melty cheese. The chips are a bit oily though, but good as shareables.

While exploring Broadway, we came here because of the open windows for some good air circulation. We came here to watch Sunday football. Although the place was crowded, we found a spot near the bar. They also had live music playing. A girl named Rachel Horter was performing and we really enjoyed her.

The bathroom is pretty filthy though, but convenient enough for how much I was drinking here.

After a night of drinking, we needed pho ASAP. Luckily, we were able to order some on DoorDash without leaving our place.

When the food arrived, some of the broth spilled even though it was taped down. Despite that, the food was still good. I ordered the Seafood Pho ($11.95), which comes with shrimp, imitation crab, squid, and fish balls. Of course they also give you bean sprouts and basil to add. Although seafood isn't your typical pho ingredients, it was a nice change. The broth was flavorful and exactly what we needed when hungover.

As I was walking in the neighborhood, I noticed this donut spot. It claimed to be the home of the Tennessee Whiskey glazed donut and I was intrigued. 

Since we were on our way to lunch already, I only got the 3 pack Signature Mini Donuts ($3.50). There's a variety of unique flavors to choose from, but I ended up with the Whiskey Glaze, Frosty Fruity, and Dreamsicle. I was so impressed how they nailed every single flavor. It was exactly what you'd expect but in donut form. The whiskey glaze was filled with the alcohol aroma. There's nothing like starting your day with a little whiskey. 

Although I didn't get to try this, they have alcohol flights to match with your donuts --what a concept! You get to have donuts, coffee, AND alcohol! They have boozy shakes, wine, beer, coffee cocktails, and donut shots; that's what I call a party. To add, they were even offered CBD to your coffee, which my friend was looking for everywhere. 

This is definitely not your typical donut spot. It's the perfect way to start off your day!

When our original lunch plans fell through, we came here and it was the best decision ever because this ended up being my favorite place in Nashville. We arrived just before the lunch rush on a Tuesday, so we got seated immediately. 

The entrees here are huge as you can see on everyone's table. Not only is it worth your money, it's delicious as well. I ordered the infamous Mac and Cheese ($12) with Hot Chicken (+$5) while my friend had the Catfish and Chips ($17) with Wedge Salad (+$4). The Mac and cheese was perfect: crispy parmesan top but so velvety, cheesy inside. It went so perfectly with the added hot chicken. Why don't all mad and cheese come topped with hot chicken?!

I tried some of my friend's food, which was good as well. The wedge salad was drenched in dressing for good flavor and the catfish was crispy and silky. For drinks, I also had to try the Honeysuckle cocktail ($10). It was light on the alcohol, but still tasteful. Overall, everything was yummy here. I still dream about this mac and cheese with hot chicken.

Do it for the 'gram. Yes, this place is touristy and perfect for the millions of bachelorette and birthday parties in Nashville. You're here for all the cute photo ops, not for the food or drinks. Also note that reservations are made two weeks out and they will be booked, so be ready. 

We arrived earlier than our reservations, so we hung out at the lobby of Graduate Nashville hotel. This place is so aesthetically pleasing from the minute you walk in and there is plenty of seating. Once upstairs, we were seated at a tabletop overlooking the city. There's a nice view of the building and the entire place is adorned in pink and plants. The outdoor patio has even more cute decor from a pool to daybeds to an entire Dolly Parton structure.

After a few pictures, we ordered our drinks and food. I got In A Honky Donk, Down in Mexico cocktail ($13), which the server warned me was smokey. It was indeed smokey and spicy, but I liked it. My friend had a specially made "fun sparking water" with some mango, which was delicious as well. We also got the Baked Bread ($7) to share, which came with various breads, butter, and pepper jelly. The pepper jelly had a nice kick of spicy that was lovely, but the breads were pretty dry and stale. Like I said, you're here for the aesthetics and vibe. They have drinks for big parties, which seem like good fun.

My favorite part was seeing all the men that got dragged here because of their ladies, teehee.

IguBQce2WAOMtIK2cvn5Xw.review_text: We had the all meat pizza with garlic & parm on the crust. This was our fist time here, it was good not excellent but it was tasty. The sausage & ham were very good. We ordered the original breadsticks as an appetizer and it was delicious!! We'd return for another visit.

Love, love, love this place! Authentic Greek food, ambiance & wait staff. We had the "flaming cheese" appetizer...lit table side for added flair! It's delicious & served with bread. I had spanakopita and hubs had stuffed grape leaves. This is our 3rd time here & will be back. Of course we stopped at the bakery for baklava.

This was our first time here & we will definitely be back! The ambiance was classy & relaxing with out being stuffy & formal...we'd call it casual fine dining. We came for lunch on a Saturday and they were busy. I had a muffuletta sandwich, which was the best one I've ever had! The creole seasoning on the fries were good too. Hubs had the BELT sandwich (bacon, fried egg, lettuce & tomato) and he said it was delicious. The wait staff is friendly and efficient.

I joined 3 friends for breakfast and we loved this place. It was all our first time trying Datz and we will definitely be coming back. We, of course, shared the monkey bread as an appetizer and it was amazing. They had sold out of the small portion so we ordered the large and had enough to take a sample home for hubs! 

I ordered the "Datz Good Hash" with a side of the best cheese grits I've had in ages. The hash was delicious as well as my fried eggs. The milk bread toast was tasty too. 

Two of my friends each ordered an omelet, which they said was delicious. My other friend had the "Eggs Barbacoa" and all we could say about that was "WOW". First off, it was pretty to look at and the taste was out of this world! The portion is huge and she ended up taking 1/2 of it home. 

We enjoyed a casual & leisurely breakfast. Our waitress was great. Of course, we purchased some treats from the bakery case to enjoy later. This place is a must if you enjoy delicious food in a casual but classy atmosphere.

Good stuff here! We've driven by this place off and on for months and finally took the time to stop for lunch. We were not disappointed. Hubs had the kettle cooked chicken, corn on the cob and mashed potatoes. I had meatloaf, collard greens & mashed potatoes. Both meals also came with the salad bar, rice & cornbread. Everything was delicious...our only complaint was that the mashed potatoes are instant. We'll def come back and try other items on the menu.

Yum! What a great place for unique & delicious burgers (among other things). Hubs and I enjoyed our first visit for lunch today. We had fried pickles as an appetizer, they were fried perfectly and served with a creamy ranch dipping sauce. The pickles arrived steaming hot & were great. Hubs ordered the South of the Border burger and he said the Fritos were an interesting addition. The jalapeños added just the right amount of heat. I ordered the Juicy Lucy and it totally loved up to its name! The burger was flavorful and tender and super juicy. The fries were good too, lightly fried and just the right amount of salt. Our server, Gigi, was exceptional. We'll def be back!

Not clean! The food had good flavor but this place needed some elbow grease put to it. Neither the taco or quesadilla come with rice or beans. Chips & salsa do not come complementary. You have to go outside around the back of the building to get to the restrooms! We are not a fan & will NOT be back...ever.

This place is great!! The coal fire pizza crust is delicious. We added Italian sausage, hot peppers & mushrooms & we loved it. We ordered the 2 meatball & ricotta appetizer, it came with focaccia bread. We told our server that it was our first time there & just a little bit later the manager stopped by our table & brought us a free sample of their chicken wings & we were blown away by them! The flavor was outstanding & the carmelized onions were great. We will def be back!

Hubs and I were given a gift card for this place. We had been wanting to try it for awhile & we were pleasantly surprised at how tasty everything was. I had the Cuban BBQ sandwich & Hubs has the sausage. We both LOVED the fried okra. I also had the fried pickles, they were good. Hubs has fries & they were nothing special, The family style dining atmosphere is a little different but not off-putting. They're outdoor dining patio was busy but we chose to eat inside due to the humidity. The hand washing station was a great touch!!! Loved that.

Delicious food! I had the Midwest BLT featuring fried green tomatoes, a generous helping of crispy bacon & spicy sauce on grilled Texas toast. SO good...I can see why people rave about it. Hubs ordered the classic burger & loved it too. The seasoned fries are crispy and hot. 

We ABSOLUTELY loved the in-house, fresh made potato chips & spicy dip. What a treat to have a free appetizer!! 

Our server was great. He was friendly, kept our sodas full and did a great job. We used a groupon & that was super easy too.

This place is disgusting! The food was awful...what wasn't warm instead of hot was rubbery instead of crispy. The buffet was sadly lacking and desperately needed to be scrubbed down. Our table was cracked, someone tried to fix it but it just made the top uneven. The decor needed to be cleaned. 

Hubs & I chose some food for our plates, tasted a few items and promptly got up, paid our bill and left. So, about $25 later we left still hungry and disgusted! We'll NEVER return & will let others know about this nasty place.

Delicious food. Great atmosphere. Wonderful service. I enjoyed chicken parm & Hubs had the fried chicken...both dishes were great. We also liked the bread w/olive oil & herbs as an appetizer. This was our first time here and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. We'll def be back!!

Great place, nice casual ambiance and view. Hubs and I went for dinner. We shared a delicious wedge salad for an appetizer. I had the Smokin' Longboard burger and loved it. It has bacon, cheese, onion rings, pickle, onion, tomato & lettuce on it....wow, quite a loaded burger! I ordered grilled asparagus as a side, it was a nice change of pace from fries. Hubs has the shrimp boat that came with cole slaw & fries as a side. The fries are large, sort of like wedges. He said everything was good. 

They have an outdoor eating patio, place for live music on the weekends & dancing. We'd def come here again!

Great food. Relaxing & classy atmosphere. Attentive wait staff.  We went with family & all 4 of us loved our meals. I especially enjoyed my Ybor Flat Iron steak, fresh green beans & jalapeño mac and cheese. It was perfectly cooked and I would def order again!! We had the guac & chips appetizer as well as the hummus...it was all delicious.

Casual BBQ at its finest!!! My pulled pork and slaw sandwich was so good! I would def order again. I ordered a baked potato was ok but seemed a little dry. Someone we were with ordered the grilled lemonade & I will def be trying that the next time we stop here. It looked delicious.

Wow, delicious and fresh tasting food. Everything tastes great. Both times I've eaten here my friends and I ordered and then shared our meals. What a great way to taste different things in the menu. Today we shared the Floridian French toast & the egg sandwich. Yum!!! The wait staff here is attentive and friendly. Prepare yourself for a wait to get a table but it's totally worth it.

Hubs and I went for lunch today. Our server was friendly & the service was spot on! The fruit and grilled chicken salad was delicious and plentiful. The fish tacos were full and tasty. We will def be back!
Eh. This was not our favorite place. The menu is too cluttered & we were rushed when ordering. Our food was average. We aren't fans of this place...probably won't go back.
We loved our lunch! We enjoyed everything we tried, especially the black truffle mac & cheese. The wait staff is attentive and the ambiance is great. We plan to return again.
Yum! Fun atmosphere & delicious food...what more could you ask for? Our meal was served hot and relatively quickly. The chips and salsa are always a hit. You can't go wrong at Chuy's.

Delicious food and a unique atmosphere! The burgers here are so good, we've tried a few different ones on various occasions and have never been disappointed. You've got to check out the restrooms....the decor is fun!

Excellent shopping experience with a beautiful atmosphere....what more can a person ask for? There is a nice variety of shopping choices. The food court is pretty and offers a decent variety of dining choices. The courtyard is beautiful and the chairs positioned for relaxing are perfectly situated.

We love Liang's Bistro! The food is plentiful and decently priced. The General Tso's Chicken is my favorite and Hubs loves the chicken fried rice. The service is quick and the wait staff is attentive. They have plenty of room for a group of friends to gather for a nice meal. You can't go wrong here!

Cheddars never disappoints. They have THE best chicken tenders! The buffalo chicken wrapper is my favorite and there is always plenty to share or take home for another meal. It's always clean and the wait staff is attentive. It's a great place for a nice meal.

We love Texas Roadhouse. We like the continuity in all locations...it's nice to know that you'll get a delicious meal at whichever location you try. Hubs & I like to order the roadkill, the burger is tender and always has a delicious sear on it. The rolls and butter are always a hit too. 

I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 because the rusty peanut pails are nasty! They need to rethink putting anything rusty on a table.

We love Jake's Pizza! We always order the thin (cracker) crust. Tonight we ordered 1/2 meat lovers & 1/2 veggie to please everyone...and it did. We love it with regular mozzarella but provel cheese is also available. Yum!!

Our neighbor and another friend have been raving about this pizza so we knew we had to try it out tonight. We really liked it! We ordered the all meat and also a veggie and loved both. We'll def be ordering from Pomodoro Pizza again. 

The reason for 4 out out of 5 stars? The crust on the veggie pizza could have been cooked a little longer.

We loved this place. Our server was amazing, offering suggestions and making sure we had everything we needed. We thoroughly enjoyed our table sitting on the deck and right on the beach. Our chicken nachos were delicious and large enough for Hubs and I to share. The island fries were a great addition too. We will def return.

I had the veggie lasagne at Britt's on Friday. It tasted pretty good - I liked the zucchini in it better than the eggplant but overall it was good. The garlic knots were very good. The portion was huge, I couldn't finish it. We ordered a small anti pasta salad and split it...I wish I wouldn't thought to snap a pic of it. 

We've had their Greek salad on a previous visit & it was delicious!
Always delicious, always fresh and the staff is always pleasant & friendly! We follow on fb to get updates on the weekly goodies!
Delicious. Made on site & oh so good!!! This place has delicious soups & paninis as well. Friendly staff & quick service. This place is a gem in a beautiful outdoor mall.

Ih30H32YlBC1u5O6i6ub1Q.review_text: Had a great experience nice atmosphere and great service!!! Good food!!! The huervos ranchero was amazing !!!!
food was good  service and waitress was amazing

absolutely amazing atmosphere went with my 7yr old and she was completely amazed by the lighting, chandeliers, mango yogurt drink and food. The chicken kabob app is a bit spicy for kids but we loved it and the coconut chicken was enough for us to split and enjoy.
I enjoyed the four different sushi rolls I purchased. Prices are great. Fresh and rolled perfect
Excellent food ordered the shrimp tempura roll and spicy crab roll they were very fresh and tasteful.
Didn't care for the French toast nothing special very bland and bacon was cold. Server wasn't very friendly never checked on us

My boyfriend loves Jamaican food and it's so hard for me to get him to try new places. He loved this place we had the oxtails and curry chicken platters and they were so good! Very authentic!!! Loved the cabbage, sweet yams, Mac and cheese, and collard greens as well!!
Awesome place to hang out and just chill very quiet good music drinks pool and bowling
The Lebanese food was amazing especially the gypsy eggs. Everyone was very friendly and attentive. We sat outside and it was very chill and relaxing during breakfast on a Saturday

The spicy garlic shrimp create your own stir fry was awesome just make sure you have a lot of water because it's extra spicy :-) the red coconut curry chicken with wheat noodles was not good at all! This place has a nice open atmosphere with touch screen stations to place your order and sit. It has an outdoor seating option as well.
Good food taste a little bland with no flavors just really long wait time on a Friday and I'm only a few blocks away. An hour wait for Chinese is a bit toooooo long when it's just ok taste
Absolutely amazing service!!! Great portions and great taste. Fabulous loved everything!  So happy to finally have a good diner to go to in Bensalem.

I'll give it a one star only because I enjoyed the outside seating atmosphere on this beautiful day. However, the food was not even great. There was no taste of garlic or parmesan on the wings I had to add salt and pepper to get some taste out of it. Also the server asked us if we wanted fries or chips with our sandwich & wrap. What upset me was she never told us we would be upcharged an additional $2 each for the fries which only upsets me because I've waited on table for more than 10 years and I would have never offered "fries or chips" without explaining their is an upcharge for the fries. Once I asked her about the upcharge being on tgw bill she apologized and explained that's how all the servers take orders and kept referring to the prices being on the menu like I should have known prior. I even asked if I could substitute and get something else while ordering my wrap and she said sure but it will be $3 upcharge. This was a great time for her to tell me hey by the way those fries are $2. Crazy! It's not about the stupid $4 It's about sneaking $4 on my bill not cool at all and very untrustworthy.

I went there Friday at 8pm for whine down carribean fridays and they turned me away they said I needed to RSVP ahead of time or we would have to pay $20 cover. The flyer said $10 which I was willing to pay. They were very rude and we felt very uncomfortable. I will never step foot in this establishment again.
Love this place, very cute atmosphere, fast service, and the pho is soooooo Good! I highly recommend this place to everyone. Prices are very reasonable. I always have leftovers to take home.
The food was amazing but the service was average. Wish they could have given us better service but overall a good experience. I wouldnt go back on a weekend.

I absolutely love their happy hour specials!!! Bartender is always so nice and helpful. I like to sit in the bar area its alot cozier and less traffic. They have amazing food. Although the shrimp scampi always tastes different. I like to order it with the calamari and mozzarella sticks!!

The worst experience ever. The music is extremely loud for a coffee shop. When asked to lower the music they said the speaker was "broken" and the music could not be lowered or turned off per the managers order. I feel like I'm at a nightclub at 11am.

I waited an hour for my delivery and My chicken wings were over cooked, burnt, bare bones, and flavorless!! I'm really upset and hungry. It was so bad I ate one and left the other 9 wings in the box and trashed it.

Amazing food and customer service. We were the only people in there on a Saturday at 6pm. We were a table or 6 and our food was delicious. There take out was super busy and you can tell that everyone was calling in to place their orders.

We ordered the baked whiting, turkey wings, Mac and cheese, yams, cabbage, collard greens, and mashed potatoes. It was supposed to come with cornbread but it was missing from our order. Let's just say the only thing my family enjoyed was the yams and mashed potatoes. The Mac and cheese tasted like the plastic container it came in. We love soul food and order it all the time from local restaurants. Sadly we didn't enjoy it today.

Horrible experience. Called ahead bc we had a party of 13 and woman on the phone was really nice and said it's first come first serve, there was no issue with us being a large party and she appreciated us calling ahead. Once we arrived I waited at the hostess stand outside for 5 mins watching employees walk back and forth with no one ever speaking to me or greeting me. Finally the manager herself came out to ask how many people. I said 13 and she said we cannot all sit together outside and would have to sit inside . I said it was fine for us to be seated inside as long as we can sit together in the same area. She walked away and left me outside for another 10mins. Once she returned she takes us inside and sits us at two tables apart with one empty table between us. The children not knowing what was going on proceeded to scatter between the tables and the manager started to scold the children and the adults in my party that we can not all sit together and have to sit separated. At this point she got really nasty with us and was making us feel unwanted in the establishment. Speaking very loud so all the customers could hear what was going on making a huge scene in the middle of the restaurant so we all got up and left without her caring or trying to correct her wrongs for her nasty behavior. I would not recommend any one to step foot in this establishment and I will leave a review everywhere possible about the managers behavior.
Amazing food amazing atmosphere amazing service!! Loved everything about it!! Especially their bread with shaved sea salt.

Ihc0M84Aruh1me8sbz-LvA.review_text: Overall a good experience! My parents and I enjoyed the food and it came out very quickly. We got the shrimp potstickers, tofu spring rolls, thai salad, and a bucket of seafood. My only issue was that there were two different pop songs playing at the same time in different parts of the restaurant which made it hard to have a conversation at times. I was also a little disappointed that their menu is different for dinner and lunch, I really wanted to try some of their bun dishes!

What a lovely little place! The servers were super friendly and very helpful. Food came out fast and we all had a great meal! Not a single complaint. The server found out that it was my birthday and brought us a free dessert, it was such a wonderful and thoughtful surprise! I will definitely be going back.

I had heard about this restaurant through Southgate, another Korean-inspired restaurant that I really enjoy going to. My friend and I split a few small plates. We got the meat-filled mandoo and the wrappers were just the right combination of crunchy and soft. And the sauce was superb! Next were the KFC wings. While it was hard to eat without making a mess, we really enjoyed them. We finished with the Korean fried that come covered in red pepper flakes and accompanied by a spicy twist on ketchup. The sauce had a little kick and the fries were delicious! Definitely going to come back!

First off, having a good sushi restaurant so close to where I live is wonderful! This restaurant is quite small, maybe 6 tables, but it doesn't feel cramped. The waitstaff were friendly and considerate as I waited for my friend to arrive. We both ordered two simple sushi rolls that were priced between $4-7 each which I thought was a very acceptable price. The sushi tasted fresh and delicious! Definitely will be back.

Stopped in for dinner tonight. The restaurant was clean and the staff were very helpful in helping my indecisive friend and I pick our poke bowls. The food all tasted fresh and very refreshing. The portions were large, even the regularly left me very happily full! Will definitely be back!

I've been to JJ Thai several times and I always leave full and satisfied! Most recently, my friend and I tried their green curry and their duck noodle soup. My soup came with a salad as a starter and the soup itself had a ton of meat in it which was wonderful! Very tasty broth, would definitely order again!

I will give them 3 stars because while our desserts were delicious, it took an hour for us to get to try them! We were seated very quickly despite it being a busy night which i'm thankful for. But the desserts we ordered were very simple so i'm a but confused as to why it took so long for us to receive them. We did enjoy them a lot though and will likely be back. Hopefully next time we aren't waiting quite as long!

I love this store! They always have well-stocked shelves and have a much larger variety than meets the eye for such a small store! The sandwiches they sell are reasonably priced and always delicious. I love stopping in on my way home to grab a few items. And the people who work there are always very kind and friendly.

I tried the Pokéspot yesterday with two friends. We all built our own poké bowls. I got unmarinated salmon and tuna with too many toppings to remember (unlimited!). 

Pros: The ingredients tastes fresh, lots of carb choices (white or brown rice/zucchini noodles/cauliflower rice), very filling portions, kind and courteous staff, closer than all the other poké places!

Cons: Not a ton of seating and some wasted space, it can get a little loud in there. Not much in the way of cons!


Will definitely be back!

The only problem is that it took me 2 years to hear about this place! The shave ice is phenomenal (with lots of dairy free options too)!! My friend and I split two - watermolen and an almond flavored creation that I think was called Good Life? They both tasted amazing and usually almond flavor tastes like almond extract but this did not! The owners are very friendly and patient and I am already looking forward to my next visit to the Ice Cave!

I have loved Southgate from the beginning (and not just because it's super close to my apartment). They have always provided delicious and quality food and unlike a lot of "fusion" restaurants, they really stay true to the Korean roots of the dishes. Their portions are big and their cocktails are very creative and tasty! They have really nice outdoor seating in addition to seating inside at tables, the bar, or the community table! Even as they have moved on to new chefs running the kitchen, there were never any dips in the quality of the food they serve. Perfect for a night with friends, a date, or a nice place to take your parents (mine love it too!)

The only problem is that it took me 2 years to hear about this place! The shave ice is phenomenal (with lots of dairy free options too)!! My friend and I split two - watermolen and an almond flavored creation that I think was called Good Life? They both tasted amazing and usually almond flavor tastes like almond extract but this did not! The owners are very friendly and patient and I am already looking forward to my next visit to the Ice

This place is easy to overlook, as it's not on a busy street, but it is worth searching for! The staff are very friendly and we received excellent and fast service. The food was all delicious, we tried the pork dumplings, a rice ball, a beef sandwich, and a grilled chicken rice bowl (). The rice ball and the sandwich were our favorites. The rice ball was tasty and spicy and very filling! As was the sandwich, which had such a wide variety of flavors that all mixed very well together. In addition to the food, the aesthetic inside was very cute with paintings of Europe (I think) on the walls featuring cafes and shops and tables outside. Will 100% be back again!

I stopped in today to get some work done and I really hope I can go there again! My matcha latte with oat milk was delicious, the barista was very kind and helpful, and the work space was bright, open, with plenty of outlets! You can choose to work in a comfy chair, a high top, or a larger cooperative table. There are even signs to help you navigate the space. Definitely a wonderful addition to UCity!

I recently got to try a newer addition to their menu- crunchdogs! I am now a firm believer that fried cheese should be coated in sugar, such an unexpected but DELICIOUS combination. The staff here are so wonderful, I was super excited to try the crunchdogs but they had to delay bringing them back on the menu so they gave me a giftcard for when they were able to bring them back. Thanks to the top notch food and top notch customer service, I will be ordering from here many times in the future for sure!!
