Absolutely nothing special here.
The food and pricing are good.  BUT the place is filthy. Clean it up and I may be back.  The floor is gross.  If the area I can see is this bad I can only imagine what the area I can not see is like.

This is a good place but.  You have to go in and order your food in a line and then hope like hell there is a place to sit.  It is easy to get your meal and have nowhere to sit here.  That part of this place sucks.
Great Place.  You can't go wrong here.
Pretty much the same as the rest of these locations.  Good service.

Nadine's is awesome for lunch or dinner.  the quality and quantity of food presents a great value.  my team and I often go here for business lunches.  the service here has always been very very good.  the only negative thing I would say is that I do not like the fact that there is smoking allowed inside.  but it is a bar and it is what it is it will not keep me from eating here time and time again.

the food here is really really good.  every time I been here there's no where to park in the way to get in is about 45 minutes.  so if you choose this establishment be prepared to wait.  it is worth it and it is priced fair.

I have been to this place before and have never been really impressed.  My wife and I decided to go there again since we had not been to this location in several months.  We were greeted by the hostess and shown to a table.  We sat there with absolutely no service.  The booth behind us had a server that walked past us to get to them.  The booth in front of us was empty but then the hostess seated people at that table as well.  Another server came right up to that table and began taking their drink order.  At this time we decided it was time to leave.  We went up the street to Webers and had a great meal and service.

Had dinner at Hugo's tonight.  Unfortunately the server was horrible.  She was sitting at a table talking to some guy while our food sat at the kitchen waiting for her to pick it up.  When we finally got our food the potato salad that I was served was spoiled.  I accepted french fries as a substitute.  When the bill came the server attempted to charge me for the potato salad.  I refused to pay for that and the french fries.  Usually this place is pretty good.  I have never seen this server before and hope I don't see her again.  The last thing is that it was raining and the roof began leaking on our table so we had to move to a different table.
Good food Great Service.  Our server tonight was Adam.  He was super nice, fast and the food was brought out correctly.  It was a real team effort but our server was very, very good.

We went to this place to have drinks, food and watch a game.  Our server was a very good looking young female with black hair, Daisy Duke shorts, and a spaghetti strap shirt.  No name as she never introduced herself. and Unfortunately her looks were all she had going for her.  She was unfriendly, short, never smiled and basically made us wish we had never gone there in the first place.  The pizza came to the table on the cool side.  After taking some slices from it We sent it back to be warmed.  She brings it back to the table about 15 minutes later and it is burnt.  When we said no thank you.  She then takes it from our table to a table next to us and gives to a group of young men who either did not know or care that it had been on our table twice and we had eaten from it.  I do not really care about that but it seems wrong in so many ways.

We also witnessed another employee taking napkins from a table that people had been sitting at and putting them back on the stack of new napkins to be redistributed.  The other food that we ordered was okay but the entire experience was horrible.  There was six of us there and we all felt the same way.  Never going back!!!!!

By far the best Tacos I have ever had.  Having been raised in New Mexico and coming from a Spanish family I like to think that I know good Mexican food when I have it.  Give it a try.  I had my doubts but I go there at least one a week now for lunch.  There are nice people working there and It is reasonably priced for the quality and quantity of product that you receive.

Nice people, but the food was pretty much horrible.  The Cheese used on the Pizza was like getting a mouth full of velveta soft cheese.  They use a four cheese blend that is horrible.  I ended up giving my Pizza away and even those people did not eat much of it.  I ordered a Turkey sandwich as a replacement since I was still hungry.  That was not very good either.  So $50.00 in and not very excited about this place.  It is family run with very nice people.  The wings that I stole from my wife were good.  I won't eat the pizza here again.  I don't see myself returning unless I have too for a kids function.

KsStskr5Jak8bfMI-B5yDw.review_text: Excellent food and service! One of my favorite places for breakfast!
The best donuts and pies! Great selection for Thanksgiving, you can order ahead, but they also have pre-made ones available. Gingerbread men at Christmas time, too!
We have gotten their catering for a few family parties. They are always delicious and we get a lot of compliments!

New owners and the salads are so fresh! We had stopped going to this location, but I was in a rush and was willing to give them another try! I was surprised to see different owners! The salads were so good!
We have been here on several occasions and the food is always delicious. They also have a great happy hour with specials!
They have a great happy hour and drink specials. The food was delicious. They also have an area of games to play.
Delicious! We're never disappointed. My daughter and I usually get the poblano burger. Always fresh and friendly staff.
The best Chinese food in the area! The General Tso's chicken has white meat. It's a BYOB. They get very busy on the weekend at dinner time!

We stopped in last evening and had an enjoyable experience. We had the dumplings, spring roll, roast pork fried rice, and Singapore Mei fun. Everything tasted fresh and was delicious. The restaurant and carry out was busy. The gentleman at the register and taking phone orders seemed to know all the customers by name.

Excellent! We tried the edamame, scallion pancake, crab Rangoon, spring rolls, Shanghai pan fried pork dumplings, sesame chicken, Kung Pao chicken, hot and sour soup, steamed crab meat pork soup dumplings, roast pork fried rice, and the hot and sour soup. All of it was delicious and tasted fresh! They are a BYOB. They get pretty crowded after 5:30pm.
Everything is delicious! Cocktail shrimp are huge and the crab balls are great from parties. The crab Mac and cheese is delicious, too!
They are a great supporter of the community and my daughter's middle school's musical theater program. The food is always fresh and hot!

Stopped in for breakfast. The food was good and the portions were huge. Service was super fast. My daughter got scrambled eggs, home fries, bacon, and toast. I had a monte Cristo croissant breakfast sandwich, which came with home fries.
Stopped in for breakfast. The food was good. It does get pretty crowded, but we were sat fairly quickly.

We stopped in for dinner. My husband didn't have any issues with his meal. He had the meatloaf. He said it was Ok. I had the eggplant parm. I had to send my dinner back twice. I got a meat parm. I'm not sure what type of meat, it was pink. Then the replacement eggplant came out quickly, and was a weird consistency. I couldn't eat it. They offered a replacement meal, but I declined. They did take it off the bill and were very apologetic. Maybe it was a bad night?

We had a food truck for a neighborhood development and everything was delicious. There were 50+ families that ordered and they were able to handle the volume! We had a family meal special that came with several choices, but we picked the pulled pork and beef brisket, with sides: Mac & cheese, baked bean, collared greens, and potato salad, and it came with a 2 liter, corn bread, and sauces. I added coke slaw and the candied bacon. Plenty of food for 4 of us and we had leftovers.
Excellent! 1st had Kin Wah, back in 1990, when we moved to Somerton. I have moved away and was in the neighborhood, and it's the same owners and still excellent!
They are a nice BYOB for dinner. Friendly counter service. They make the best Sicilian pie, that I've ever  had.

KtoFgPE-gKhBjXBcIqoDBg.review_text: I must say I was highly disappointed with their Chicken Pad Thai! That is my favorite Thai dish. For those that love it from this place obviously HAVE NOT tried Thai Boat in Brandon. The ONLY reason I even decided to try Jasmine Thai was because Thai Boat is closed on Sunday.
Absolutely LOVE this place! My favorite dish is the Chicken Pad Thai. My only complaint is that they are closed on Sunday!

I ordered the Shrimp Pad Thai,?Shrimp Rangoon and, a Cucumber Salad. 

It was all very good. My only complaint is that when I called the restaurant they told me my food had been ready for now 10 minutes and it hadn't been picked up by the driver yet! However, once it did arrive, it was surprisingly still hot!

I LOVE Tropical Smoothie. My loyalty is long for them every since my first visit in Panama City (where I'm from) about 14 years ago.

I found myself downtown in Tampa wanting a smoothie, and what do you know, I stumble upon this beauty. I was stocked to go in for my Peanut Paradise. I ordered (no turbinado, no yogurt, add honey, add extra PB) and it ended up being delish from the first slurp. However, I won't EVER come back to this location. Why? The horrible customer service...

Long story short, there are 5 girls working when I walk in. Everyone is on their phone except one who is literally sitting on the counter top, eating chips that TP sales! So whatever, I place my order and everyone just stands there! Yes, they are all still on their phone (and eating). 

The young lady who took my order had to ask one of her fellow co-workers to make my order. But it gets better...a couple walks in after me to order, it's not a pre-called in pick up, and gets their smoothies before me! Mind you...3 out of the 5 still have their heads buried in their phone. 

Usually, I wouldn't care about the phone ordeal or receiving my order after someone else's and I ordered first BUT after my summed up, bad customer service above...I was done. I will find a new location...the TP franchise shouldn't be punished!

Joto Thai-Sushi is pretty good! Thursday night was my second time ordering. The first night it was just Shrimp and Chicken Thai Fried Rice that me and the BF split. However, this time I really wanted to try the Pad Thai, as one of my friends raves about it! So I ordered that for myself and the rice for him. 

The Chicken Pad Thai dish actually got them the 4 stars, instead of 5. It was decent, but way too oily! You could tell it was made with fresh ingredients but again way too much oil. 

Thai Fried Rice gets a 5 star...it was one of the best I have had. And I didn't mention that we ordered this before, but both the veggie and thai spring rolls are delish.

Definitely give Joto Thai a try. The family who runs the place is the sweetest too.

The BF and I were out running errands today and he got a craving for BBQ. I took a quick look on yelp and realized we happen to be about 0.25 mile from Deviled Pig. After a quick view of the menu, I called and ordered.

I got the turkey sandwich (and ate it without the bun) with sweet bbq sauce and he got the half rack competition ribs meal with mac and cheese and baked beans. 

The turkey was so fresh and seasoned to perfection, and the sweet bbq sauce for dipping was the icing on the cake. This is no wimpy couple slices of turkey type sandwich. Best (thick) sliced turkey I have ever had. Period. 

I split the mac and cheese with the BF and wish I had gotten my own. The bread crumbs were a nice touch and the cheese was so creamy. I didn't try the beans, but he loved them along with the ribs. He is EXTREMELY hard to please when it comes to BBQ so bravo Deviled Pig. We will be back...

Okay...so RB's is my jam. I haven't eaten it in years, until tonight. When my friend asked me to come, I wanted to say no because I haven't been eating fried foods BUT...yea, ended up here and ordered the Madame Butterfly shrimp with twisted fries a side of 5oz Grouper. It was EVERYTHING. 5 stars for sure! 

The food here is ridiculously fresh, tasty, and reasonably priced! I really don't like hush puppies but I love their's. I don't know what it is but they are amazing.

My friend got the Due West Snapper. She said the key lime cream butter sauce was very good, but the dish could've used a little more seasoning. However, the fish was flaky and fresh. 4 starts for that dish. Her son ordered the peel and eat shrimp and says it was GREAT! He did mention that there was A LOT of butter and for that reason it gets a 4.5.

Give RB's a try when you're in the Tarpon Springs area.

I really wanted some salmon tonight and had every intent on cooking it myself. However, when I went to The Fresh Market on Henderson Ave their selection didn't look as appealing as it usually does so I passed. By the time I made the decision to go to an actual seafood market (such as Cox's), they were closed. I finally said forget cooking and decided to order out. I was still set on having fish, so I went to Yelp like I normally do, typed in Salmon, and stumbled across Shells.

The reviews for Salmon Felix were good so I made that my pick. The BF went for the Shrimp Pasta. 

--Salmon Felix: 4.5 stars
*This dish normally comes prepared with lobster cream sauce on the Salmon, sitting on a bed of asparagus and rice. I ordered it with the sauce on the side and subbed broccoli and two small red potatoes. The picture does zero justice for how it taste. I was impressed with the flavor of everything, the Salmon was fresh and flaky, and I couldn't believe it was still hot after my 12 minute drive home. My only complaint, if you will, is that my broccoli was drowned in too much butter. 

--Shrimp Pasta: 4 stars
*My BF isn't as "wordy" or "detailed" as me, but described his dish as "very creamy, with plenty of shrimp." He made the comment he could finish the plate, but wanted to make sure he saved some for later! To me, it looked (and smelled) like your signature Italian Alfredo pasta dish with shrimp and I did notice the abundance of shrimp on his plate! 

My expectations were met tonight, for sure. I'm happy I found Shells and will definitely be back to try some other options. Oh! And they have curbside pick up...an automatic winner.

Update...and this post is a little late, but I just had to share that my #leftovers picture is what the BF and I had left over from Rusty Bellies. As many of the reviews mention, this place is small, the parking is minimal...BUT it's a diamond in the rough. I was a huge fan of Jo To Thai Sushi on Dale Mabry. However, they closed their doors permanently. Clearly, I was immediately on the hunt for another go to spot near me in Westshore and it looks like I found it.

There were 4 of us eating in total. We ordered chicken pad thai, drunken noodles with chicken, chicken and shrimp thai fried rice, and 2 order of veggie egg rolls.

**Pad Thai and Thai Fried Rice: Both these dishes receive a 5 by me. The Pad Thai was perfect. Not too oily, just enough sauce, and the right amount of chicken. I actually split this dish with a friend and still had some left over. The Fried Rice was my BF's so I gave it a taste and it was seasoned to perfection and the veggies looked and tasted so fresh. He finished it...although he probably shouldn't have! 

**Drunken Noodles: While I didn't try this dish, I was told it was good; just enough spice, fulfilling without being an overload, and was even better the next day. 

**Veggie egg rolls: These were tasty...everyone loved them and none were left. They were fried just right and filled with veggies but cabbage more than anything...my favorite!

So I order the Kale & Quinoa with Chicken. 

I'm funny about my chicken and it reminded me of shredded chicken, but in a breast type of style cut up. I don't know, probably not the best explanation! I just wasn't a fan. However, the Kale + Quinoa salad itself with the goat cheese, cranberries, walnuts, kale, salad dressing, etc was BOMB. The goat cheese was soooo good. (I would love to know the brand!) The kale was really fresh and the balsamic dressing, I think it was, had just enough salt to it and gave the salad so much flavor. I would order it again...but with a different protein. 

Looking over the menu though, I can't wait to order from here again. This time I want to go inside and not order via uber eats! (Uber eats delivery went fine, but reviews say the vibe is nice here so I want to see for myself...)

I was so happy when I went to OpenTable and was able to grab the last 9pm reservation for 4 this past Friday! I love Ulele and hadn't been in about 5 years. As soon as they opened back then, we moved...but we are back!!!!

Okay, so I ordered the Gouda Grouper and my BF ordered Shrimp and Grits. His brother ordered the Snapper and his wife ordered the Gouda Grouper too. 

Before rating the food, let me say...shouts out to Amy! Our server was bomb. Her customer service was on point and she knew the menu well. She had this energy and vibe about her that was refreshing and you could seriously see her smiling through her mask. Amy was great and she made our experience even better...

Gouda Grouper: I will have to order this dish the next 5 times I go and hope that helps my fix because I'm hooked! This plate was so good. In my opinion, the best on the menu. It came with rice but Amy, our sever, suggested to sub for mashed potatoes...so we listened. It was soo good with the sauce. Thinking about it right now is making my mouth water. It was not heavy but perfectly fulfilling and went fabulous with my 2 glasses of bubbly. 

Shrimp and Grits: The BF really liked this and shocked me when he said he loved the grit cakes more than the shrimp! He said the shrimp were definitely Gulf shrimp and satisfying but that grit cake was so unique and nothing like your normal grits.  

Snapper: So I don't have a photo of this dish, but let me just say...before my BF could ask him how was his food, it was gone. The plate was CLEARED...not a piece of evidence left. 

Oh! And I forgot to mention, I ordered the Key Lime to go and it did NOT disappoint. Can't wait to go back to Ulele in the prime River Walk area.

Update!!

Today, I had the opportunity to visit Water + Flour in person and I must say it's a cute little quaint spot. Not the largest dining room, but perfect for their setting, vibe, and decor.

This will be my new go to healthy lunch spot because I know I can drop in for a good meal AND if I'm being lazy I can get it via uber eats with the same quality.

Alrighty! I know, you want to know what I ordered = ) 

I got the Hot & Crunchy Tuna bowl. I will give it a 4.5 and our server brought the extra .5 stars. It was a dish full of yummy. I really enjoyed it but next time will ask them to hold the Tempura onions. I'm not a huge onion fan, but thought I would not be picky and give it a try. They weren't bad but there was too many! Interesting thing, this dish was prepared with scallions and they were so good. I loved them. There was just enough Tuna and the Cucumber-Ginger like sauce wasn't too heavily coated over the entire meal. The avocado was a nice touch. 
............................................................................................

So I order the Kale & Quinoa with Chicken. 

I'm funny about my chicken and it reminded me of shredded chicken, but in a breast type of style cut up. I don't know, probably not the best explanation! I just wasn't a fan. However, the Kale + Quinoa salad itself with the goat cheese, cranberries, walnuts, kale, salad dressing, etc was BOMB. The goat cheese was soooo good. (I would love to know the brand!) The kale was really fresh and the balsamic dressing, I think it was, had just enough salt to it and gave the salad so much flavor. I would order it again...but with a different protein. 

Looking over the menu though, I can't wait to order from here again. This time I want to go inside and not order via uber eats! (Uber eata delivery went fine, but reviews say the vibe is nice here so I want to see for myse

Since being back in town, I heard that SoHo, South Howard, Hyde Park or whatever name you like to use for this vivacious area was the place to be for good food and night life. After being in the house all day Sunday, needing a breather and some good food amongst a more turnt up versus low tone vibe, we gave Meat Market Tampa a go.

I love the ambience. I got a Downtown San Diego/South Beach feel with this place. I liked how open it was. We sat outside which is still somewhat inside, if that makes sense. The music playing was perfect; hip-hop mixed with a bit of pop. It's the perfect date night, night out on the town type establishment. 

Their customer service is great. You can tell the servers work as a team. Everyone is very attentive without giving a hovering feel. 

As for the menu...it's nicely balanced with Steak, Seafood, and Modern-Fare foods. You can be healthy here if you allow yourself, but they do have some indulgences. 

Prime New York: This steak was so flavorful and juicy cooked medium. Adding the truffle butter was just icing on the cake, if you will. I don't eat red meat often and would go back for this baby.. 

Lobster Mac and Cheese: The noodles in this dish reminded of thin Cheetos in regards to their texture and size. While this may not sound appealing to some, they are so good. I was impressed with the amount of lobster on the plate too. I had enough to take home for leftovers. Very creamy, but not too heavy...

I wanted desert, but instead opted for a glass of NV Ca 'Vittoria Brut Rose Sparkling Wine...it was refreshing, crisp, and had just enough sweetness to it.

Meat Market Tampa is for sure worth a visit. They gained a customer out of me...

Usually not my go to brunch spot. I tend to try supporting local businesses such as Datz but my boyfriend was craving their wheat bread and chicken and waffles. I tend to order the avocado toast and add salmon, however, the chicken and waffles picture looked good (and my boyfriend hyped it up) so I went for it 

I will admit...the chicken and specifically, the waffle was PERFECT. It was crispy around the edges, but fluffy in the middle with a light tan/brown color. The chicken (tenders) on top were cooked a little longer than what I would have, BUT they were delish. The powdered sugar on top along with their syrup was the "icing on the cake." I left very satisfied and with a little left overs as I wasn't able to finish it all.

And as many times as I have been to Cheesecake, I didn't realize they had fresh squeezed orange juice. I'm not a pulp fan, but this OJ was bomb. 

My only "complaint" was that when we sat down, the waiter asked if we wanted bread. We requested wheat only and was hoping to have at least a slice before our food came. However, our server, who was clearly busy, didn't make it back with our bread until AFTER one of their runners brought our food. By then, neither one of us wanted bread and frankly I didn't need it but give me what I ask for please! = )

Deviled Pig never misses a beat. My bf and I split the ribs, mac and cheese, and baked beans. I also added a side of the collard greens. 

Listen...don't knock 'em till you tried 'em! Their collards are SUPER impressive. My mom AND grandma would kill me if they knew I said this BUT...I must say, Deviled Pig's greens could EASILY be mistaken for one of their's. I get them every time we order and don't rave about them on yelp enough! Seasoned to perfection...

We were out and about and wanted something different to eat without the "restaurant vibe" considering we weren't dressed for all that. Passed by Little Greek and decided to hit a quick u-turn to try it out.

I'm huge on customer service and theirs was great from the jump. The girl working the front asked us if we had been in before, we let her know we hadn't, and she went through the menu. She let us know that they were out of 100% lamb but their Gyro meat (90% beef, 10% lamb) was good. I think she noticed under my mask that I was a little suspect of it being "good" and offered me to try a piece. It was delish and had she not told me, I would've thought it was 100% lamb; appreciate the honesty! 

I ordered the Greek Salad with Gyro meat and the BF ordered the Steak-Skewer dinner. Both of us were impressed with our meals. I loved the potato salad on the salad and their Greek dressing paired very well. My BF loved the rice on his salad and said the steak was "flavorful." The side of warm pita bread was good too and was shocked my boyfriend ate it too as that's usually not his thing. 

We ended up eating our food there and the manager periodically checked on us, which was a nice touch. The entire crew, front of the house and back, acknowledged us on our way out...another plus. I enjoyed the small business vibe and will definitely be back again.

Debating on what to do for date night on Saturday, it was a toss up between Del Frisco's, Kona Grill (next door) and Thai Prime (across the parking lot). We hadn't had Del Frisco's in a while and I was craving their crab cake....so Del Frisco's we went.

As I always mention, customer service is huge to me. Our server was sweet and knowledgeable of the menu. She was attentive, but not too much. We chatted with her a bit and once she noticed I was eating for two she mentioned coming back once I deliver so she can see his cute face. Wish I had gotten her name. Loved her, great service! Okay..to the food...

We knew, well I knew, we wanted the crab cake from the jump and it was immaculate. I'm all about fresh seafood and while this is a steak house, the crab cake made me feel like I was at a seafood house; fresh, nothing but the meat, with a little bit of crisp on the outside from how it was prepared. 

For our entrees (I promise to do better about pictures):

I got the Lemon Dill Salmon. It comes with asparagus, but I'm a broccoli girl so I switched it up. The sauce that is on this Salmon definitely makes the dish along with the fact that it's cooked just right. I could've finished it off, but I wanted to have left overs. Yes, it was that good! And by the way...about 3 hours after dinner, I heated it back up in the oven! No disappoints there...

My BF was planning to order the Chopped Steak. He said he was craving steak but wanted something on the thinner side. His go to choice is usually filet mignon, but that's more on the tender side and not thin. However, our waitress talked him out of that and suggested he order the Steak Frites. Good choice. I tried a piece with the chimichurri sauce and it was full of flavor! Definitely a dish to try and add to your list. He paired it with the mac and cheese. I want to go back just for a side to take home to go because unfortunately he had zero left overs. The mac was creamy with just the right amount of cheese. 

Crazy enough, I don't tend to get sweet cravings, which is slightly odd for a pregnant woman (at least that's what I hear). BUT I REALLY wanted something. Their dessert menu was a lackluster for me though. There were 4 options and I only remember two, coconut pie and peanut butter pie. I love PB, but it just wasn't what I wanted. I almost rated them a 4 because of the desert menu and seeing that I didn't leave with one, but honestly our service was too good and so was our food! 

Okay..long review but worth the read = ) if you haven't tried Del Frisco's, go show them so love...they will give it right back.

This review is wayyy over due, but it popped up on my feed and I realized I needed to share my thoughts on this establishment. 

I ordered the Greek Salad to go after getting a pedi next door (at Plush Nail's Spa; go see Becca). It was just okay and nothing I would go back for. Potato salad on it was tasty and the dressing that came on the side was decent but it was nothing to brag about. I also find it interesting that they ask if you want it with shrimp, which I got, and it came with ONE big shrimp. Kinda funny and disappointing all at the same time. When I got home with it my BF even said, did you just ask for one shrimp? I'm a shrimp lover so I cut it up, considering it was quite large, and made the best of it.

Their customer service was good and the girl at the front was very polite! However, I probably won't return when looking for a Greek Salad (or a salad in general) and would head over to Little Greek, which is right down the street, on Dale Mabry.

As many times as I have visited Datz, there is no excuse for this to be my first review! 

Today is my BF's birthday and he loves Datz. So...Datz it was for breakfast. 

One us tends to order either the Shrimp and Grits and/or Waffles and Tweets and we share. But today I was in the mood for some eggs. I created my own scramble and went with breakfast sausage, spinach, tomatoes, and goat cheese paired with breakfast potatoes. It was DELISH. I will be adding it to my list of options for sure. The amount of cheese was perfect and the sausage wasn't too salty or greasy. The eggs were cooked just right as I like mine to be a little well done and the potatoes were perfect, not too soft and not too crispy. Datz always does right. 

My BF went with the Waffles and Tweets aka Chicken and Waffles (not the benedict one) with a side of cheese grits. Their grits are BOMB. We have ordered them to go many of times before going home to make breakfast at the house because I don't prepare my grits like they do and doesn't seem like any other place does either! Try them! His waffles and tweets were satisfying per usual only this time he had a little bit to take to go.

Datz has A LOT to choose from on their menu. If you happen to not want breakfast, below are some items to try, but either way...you can't go wrong! 

Meatloaf
Pork shank 
Salem Hayek Salad
Any burger or sandwich option (with French Fries)

After a day of getting some shopping in at the International Mall, we had almost made it to our car parked in the front via valet and the BF said he's hungry.  Being pregnant and all, I can always snack on something so we decided to hit up Bar Louie. 

Scanned their menu and saw that they had decent bar bites/appetizer options, which was perfect. He went with the chicken quesadillas and I ordered the salmon sliders with tots. 

Babe said the quesadillas were spicy but good and didn't lack chicken at all. The salsa that came on the side look liked it was made in house. I didn't try it but he said it was great with a somewhat sweet and tangy taste. This wasn't a basic quesadilla and I'm basing that off it's size!  

My salmon sliders (minus the onions) were pretty good. I liked that they used arugula versus lettuce, and the sauce that looked like tarter sauce but wasn't gave the sliders its flavor. I have been eating way too many potatoes here lately, specifically french fries, but they had tots so I couldn't resist. They were hot and fresh. The side of bbq I asked for accompanied them well. 

The food was solid and some of the other plates that passed by looked decent as well. I say it's worth a comeback... 

I debated between a grade of 3.5 - 4 as I feel like they should have a sign saying "seat yourself" instead of making us (and others) have to wait to be told that and/or for one of their busy staff to have to relay that message. Customer service starts when you walk into an establishment and while our server was great, I didn't like just standing at the door with no host/hostess waiting to be sat, or in this case, waiting to be told to seat myself.

Steelbach was AMAZING and here's why....

When you walk into this place, the employees provide a warm welcome with a smile that you can see through their mask! 

We chose to sit outside and while it was a tad bit humid, it wasn't unbearable. It's hard not to sit outside with the beautiful views of the Riverwalk.

Alright..to the food (and this time I have pictures)! My friend ordered the fried chicken, I went with the grouper, and we decided to split the mac. I mean as they say, a picture tells 1000 words and in this case, it's all positive. 

I'm not a huge fried chicken breast fan (more of a chicken tender girl) but I had to try a piece because of the presentation alone. The chicken was seasoned to perfection with just enough crisp on the outside and a lot of moisture on the inside. My grouper with the crust/bread crumbs was decadent! I saw crust/breadcrumbs because I couldn't tell if it was pan fried or oven baked. Either way, it was very gourmet like with a southern twist. I will definitely be back for that dish again. From the pictures you can almost see how creamy the mac and cheese was. It may look like a lot of bread crumbs, but it was just right! And I'm not sure what type of cheese they used but it was different and delish! 

My friend also had a few drinks that she said were made perfect and the presentation of them made me have an urge BUT I'm pregnant and can't partake! 

Overall, Steelbach was awesome and we will be back. Great menu, great food, and great staff.

So last weekend was my BF's birthday and this weekend is mine! We are Datz fanatics so of course that's where we decided to have brunch again this morning (after a celebration last night with the friends at Charleys; can go see my review of them as well). 

As I always say, Datz never disappoints. I created my own scramble (again) with goat cheese, breakfast sausage, tomatoes, and spinach. You can never give me too much goat cheese (or gorgonzola) and whoever prepared my dish must've known to go heavy on the cheese. It was sooo good and creamy. This time when I ordered it though, wheat toast came with it. I wasn't expecting the bread but it satisfied me to eat it! Potatoes also came on the side but since I indulged in the bread, I didn't eat too many and opted to take majority of them to go. 

My BF, who always gets the waffles and tweets or shrimp and grits, decided to go for a few al a carte items! He ordered one pancake (which is a decent size serving), side of cheese grits, and bacon! We are no stranger to their grits and they looked good per usual. He is a (homemade) pancake lover and bragged about theirs. He had me try the bacon, stressing how good it was...and it was. It was a little salty but not too much and had this smoked flavor to it. I don't think I have ever had their bacon and will have to order myself a side next time.

Again...Datz for the WIN. We left full and happy!

I had heard a lot about Charley's and it was my birthday so why not...

I rated Charleys a 4. Service was great and that deserved 5 stars. However, I was torn between a 3.5 - 4 on the food and here is why. 

I will spend money on food...we are foodie's. But I felt like Charley's was overpriced based on the taste and quality of the food. I hate to say it but Eddie V's and. Ocean Prime are better choices in my opinion.  

The crab cake appetizer, that I wish I would have taken a picture of, was the BEST I have ever had. My BF even said, I wish we could get more of those to have at home! They were phenomenal and I'm happy we got them as I may have docked Charley's another 0.5 star or so. House salads were good and I liked the vinaigrette that was served on it. 

Everyone, but me ordered the 8oz Filet Mignon. My BF was happy with his and so was his cousin. My friend felt like her medium rare was overcooked, our server agreed, and handled it. No problem there! I ordered the Chilean Seabass and was somewhat disappointed. It was good, but I honestly have had much better...like at Eddie V's, for instance. There was just something missing. 

As far as our sides were concerned, we ordered the Lobster Mac and Cheese. I had high hopes for this dish, but again was disappointed. It was actually overcooked as well (but I just don't like to send food back, unless it's just unbearable). When I think of Lobster Mac and Cheese I think of not just a couple pieces of lobster on top and a big block of noodles and cheese right under it. I expected some lobster pieces to be mixed in and wanted it to be more creamy. It just missed the mark for the entire table.

The atmosphere of Charley's is great and the service was too. I guess I just had my hopes too high and should've ordered a steak like everyone else. However, considering they're are known for fine dining and had Red Snapper as the dish of the night, their seafood should be as up to par as their steak dishes.

Give it a try if you have never been and to say you have...but maybe skip the Seabass and go for Steak.

Eddie V's is another spot that should've had a review from me long ago! 

First night of my birthday celebration was at Charleys with my BF and friends. Go check out my review of them. Second night at Eddie V's was ladies night and it was everything and more.

It was packed out due to being Super Bowl weekend, but that didn't change their service provided. Valet kept me at the front and we were sat within minutes. Our server was attentive but not overly and made sure we were good at all times.

Alright, so let's talk food! We started out with their calamari (not pictured) which was spicy, but not too spicy! It was cooked just right, not too hard and not too soft, and offered more of the ringlets, which is right up my ally. 

When it came to the entrees, one of my friends ordered the Gulf Shrimp and the other ordered the Salmon. Both dishes looked great and let's just say there was a bit of a "moment of silence" while everyone indulged. Ha! Their meals did not disappoint. I was told the shrimp were seasoned great, a nice size, and the crab was icing on the cake. My other friend continued to boast about her Salmon in between bites and talked about the flavors mixed with the rice and spinach were perfect matches. 

As for me, I went with the Filet and Lobster Tail. I asked for my steak medium, and honestly it was a little undercooked BUT it tasted so good that I thought to myself, just roll with it. However, the lobster tail with a spruce of lemon dipped in the drawn butter was KILLER. I could've only ordered lobster and would've been A-OK. If you read my reviews you know I mention left overs so yes, I made sure to have some lobster to take home to go! 

Also not pictured are the sides we ordered of spinach and crab fried rice. I didn't try the spinach but my friends enjoyed it. Crab fried rice was tasty and something I would order again. I love when restaurants don't go light on the main focus...which was crab! 

Overall, Eddie V's did their thing per usual and provided excellent service along with some quality, well prepared dishes. Can't wait to pay them a visit again soon. If you have never been, give them a try! Ambience and setting are great for ladies night or date night and the price of it all is well worth it!

The fact that I hadn't left Tsunami a review should be a crime considering how much I have eaten here. Like, I go way back with them, say year 2015. Had a bit of a hiatus when I moved to CA from 2017-2020! However, when I returned, I wanted that old thang back and here I am being a frequent flyer again...

This time I ordered to go, the Hell Roll and Chicken Fried Rice. Both were great. I'm never disappointed with any of their rolls and frankly think they have the best specialty rolls outside of Soho Sushi in South Tampa. Their fried rice (any of them) is always so fresh too...not too many veggies, not greasy, and just down right good fried rice. 

If you haven't tried Tsunami and you're in the area, give them a try for lunch or dinner.

So Ulele was on point per usual. I have left a few reviews for them before. However, seeing that they made a few changes to the look of the menu and actually added a couple things, I thought it was time to update my review and circle back to just you all know how great they still are....

They have a new appetizer, Panko-Crusted Sautéed Shrimp. It was good. The bread that accompanied it was delish too but I felt like they should have paired it with another carb. It was food though. 

As far as the main (lunch) dish, I ordered my go to dish, Gouda Grouper. It comes with rice and mixed veggies. I mix it up a bit though and get mashed potatoes and spinach. BOMB.COM. Seriously. The only thing I did different this time was add crab to my mashed potatoes...great decision.

I love this spot...the ambience, customer service, food, etc. it's just all good and gives me great vibes when I go whether it be for lunch or dinner. Definitely my last visit for 2021 but 2022, I will be seeing you... 

Thanks for always making me leave with a smile and full belly Ulele...

So I must admit that this location is the worst I've ever been to. I have lived in multiple cities/states, traveled all throughout the United States, and have probably visited damn near every Chick-fil-A. I'm a Premier member and I eat their food way more than I will admit. 

All that being said. I'm used to the Chick-fil-A "it's my pleasure" type of experience. This location does not give you that. You will wait 45 minutes for a curbside order or you'll be in the drive-through for at least an hour. They are not efficient and while I continue to hear that they are working on it, nothing has changed.

This location is walking distance from my house so it's extremely disappointing. However, I keep going back to give them a chance with hope that things have changed and because I just have a love for Chick-fil-A. If you don't love them as much as I do, skip this location and head over to Brandon. They are much nicer, efficient, and your order will be correct!

Honestly, I should give them one star but again...the love for the chick made me do it.

So my first review of 2022 goes to Mama's Soul Food! And before I give the details on my to go order, let me say that I think Mama and her crew read you all's reviews that critiqued them. Tonight they delivered, receiving an A+ in all areas or to Yelps rating, 5 stars! 

I didn't feel like cooking and the boyfriend wanted black eye peas. I go to Yelp, type in "black eye peas," and a few places come up. However, Mama's caught my attention. Some of the reviews made me hesitant BUT the pictures were giving me a different vibe so I went for it. 

We ordered ahead...Meatloaf with Black Eye Peas and Yams, Fried Porkchops with Mac and Cheese and Cabbage, along with a slice of Red Velvet. 

Food was ready when we arrived to pick up and was still hot when we made it home. 

I'm starting with dessert because it was just that good..whoever tackled that red velvet, killed it. So moist and just the right amount of icing and nuts. I LOVED it. It is a MUST order item. AND I wish I had ordered a slice for myself and my boyfriend because sharing this one was tough...

Porkchops were fried golden brown, the cabbage was buttery and slightly salty but not too much, and the mac was creamy with plenty cheese.

While I didn't try the meatloaf, my boyfriend finished every bit of it. He said it was everything you want in a meatloaf plus some. Ha! I did try the yams and they were just as good as mine at home. The brown sugar definitely came through! Oh and he said the black eye peas did the trick! 

Long review I know BUT all said...food was great and we will definitely be returning.

This was my first time here, but had to visit after hearing such great reviews! I must say they live up to their reviews :] 

We opted for our own pizzas; I choosing the broken yolk. My new favorite way to eat pizza: with an egg cracked over top. It's like breakfast wrapped into your favorite dinner. 

Our waitress Hannah was phenomenal, the music was groovin, and we we're happy for our date night!

TIP: There's a 2nd room (adults only) adjoining the restaurant that looked very inviting for our next outing here!

In an attempt to broaden our food horizons, shoefly made it to the top of our list. B is a much more adventurous eater than I, but I like to stick with what I know. This restaurant kept us both happy. 

We started out with the tomato and basil "nachos" made from pasta paper with balsamic reduction. My favorite pasta nachos by far!

Then round 2...the bier battered walleye. Delicious! Hand breaded and meaty. I'm not one for tartar sauce, ever. I was feeling crazy tonight though and gave my walleye a little swim in it. Best decision I made all day. Well, maybe falls in 2nd after I chose to order the brownie sundae with raspberry sorbetto. Chocolate and raspberries...might be the best combo out there. 

Everything was great about this place. We rolled in around 6:15 and were seated right away. I say if you get in closer to 7, you may have a wait--well worth it though!

Our waitress was super friendly and informative too!

I read pretty good reviews about his place so I was excited to try.

I can agree with most of the reviews.

I ordered the PBB&J burger, many noted as being a favorite. It was pretty good. The burger was cooked nicely, but the PB and Jelly was pretty skimpy. My boyfriend ordered the 5 alarm burger which also noted had skimpy toppings. The food all tasted good and the service was good too.

When we got our bill though, we noticed I had been charged $1.75 for a sample of beer. I had just wanted to taste one to see if I liked it, but I didn't. The worst thing is the bartender didn't mention it at all, but when I asked if I could have a taste he just said yes. I feel like you should at least be told sure, but it'll be $1.75.

Overall, good place. Very crowded on a friday night so just prepare for a wait.

Tried this place for the first time during northside nights. We had 8pm reservations and when we got there asked if we wanted to sit in the main room or the lounge. We said we had never been there before so she took us to the lounge. Nice lounge, but had tvs and was distracting from trying to have a nice dinner. Should have sat in the main room. The service we great, but seems like we had 3 or 4 different people helping us out. 

B had an old fashioned that was nothing special and I had a cucumber type drink that was pretty good. Due to the set menu, we each tried the lobster bisque. Good taste, but not a lot of lobster. For the 2nd course, I had my heart set on the filet medallions - melted like butter! So delicious. B opted for the pork chop after the waiter recommended it. He said I had made the better decision though. Dessert came last then with the white chocolate creme brulee and flourless chocolate cake. Nothing to complain about there!

All in all, a great date night. Expensive even for northside nights though.

First visit here...great food, but interesting atmosphere. May have just been the night we chose, but ended up in the basement area where there were already a plethora of drunk college kids. It was super loud, crowded, and those awkward barrel table are hard to eat at! 

Good place to grab lunch or come if you're feeling rowdy! Service was great though and food was delicious.

This was my first visit here. Smelled great when walking in and the place seems nice inside too. I was here for a lunch meeting and the service started out pretty good. The biggest reason for the 2 stars was the meal. I ordered grilled chicken with bacon and avocado. The chicken was pretty charred (and I like a little char) but the bacon was completely inedible. It tasted like someone had dipped it in cough syrup. I hated not being able to eat my bacon. The avocado and fries were the only good thing about my lunch. The server never check to see how things were, but not sure if he was just being courteous since it was fairly obvious we were having a meeting too. Nonetheless, right before he was bringing our credit cards back to us, he placed them on an open table while he went and spoke to another table. Luckily that table was close to us and in my sight, but made me feel uneasy that our cards we just lying there.

Went to celebrate birthday dinner with B. I was so stoked to try a place brand new yet a bit nervous since it was brand new. They did not disappoint with their pre-view menu. I heard the full menu comes out next Monday :) 

Food was great. A bit expensive. Service could use a bit of work. It looked like all the other servers were great, we just had a new one I think.

Since I'm not much for beer, I can't write much to that side of things so I will focus on the other important things: food and service. I gave this a 3 star review to average out my 4 star rating of the food, but 2 star rating of the service.

It won't be any surprise if you've read some of the other reviews, but service could use some help. We went over lunch and waited about 10 minutes before I think anyone even looked at us. They weren't packed either. Maybe about 15 other people in there. I know they have this "shared tip" policy, but I really only saw one server and some help from the owners/beer makers. 

I'll agree service was friendly, but just took a while. It also took about 5 minutes to take the order down - but I'll blame that on still figuring out the tablet ordering system. 

We ended up with burgers and crab cakes at the table. The burgers were delicious. I was told so were the crab cakes, but we ordered the brussels sprouts with them for an extra $3. Maybe worth it, but would have been nice to know that it didn't come with anything. Makes sense though since it's no longer offered as a sandwich, just an app.

The prices are also a bit high - $17 for 2 mini crab cakes with side of brussels. ouch. That's rough for lunch. I believe the burgers were $13 though with a side of ribbon chips. They say ribbon fries, but they're definitely more of a "chip". I don't see them being successful for lunch with those prices. 

Overall, food was good, but expect to pay for it. Also not a good place if you're hoping to be in and out in an hour.

This place is my favorite sushi place south of 116th...I have a love affair with Wild Ginger too, but don't tell Sakura ;) 

We've tried a lot of rolls here and they're all pretty good, but by far my favorite is the soft shell crab roll. My boyfriend and I used to just get that with a couple other rolls we chose, but ended up always fight over the soft shell crab. We know get 2 of these so we can each have our own. 

We've only ever done take-out before, but they've always been friendly and accurate. I love that they have their own sort of "loyalty card" that you earn $$ on each visit!

We recently went back for a 2nd visit and still loving it. Customer service at this place is top notch. Tacos and margaritas were still amazing! We've also decided that they have the best queso, hands down. Ben, the GM, was great and wants to make sure everyone is having a great experience!

We went for drinks after work on a Friday so I can't say much about their food, but they have great drink specials...even for a Friday! The service was very friendly and good too.

I'm excited for warmer weather when it looks like their bar will open up to the outside :]

This place was a lot of fun to try. I'm always excited for new restaurants on Mass Ave. The place is fairly small so during peak times - be prepared for a wait. I think it was about 45 mins for us (table of 4). The bar is also very small, but they have partnered with a little bar/liquor place a few doors down. They then called that place to let us know our table was ready! 

When we were sat, the waitress was great about explaining everything from wine to the balls to the sauce! They have it set up so you can order sort of a la cart and get to try a little bit of everything. Surprisingly, the veggie one was the best (which is crazy for a meatball place) but that's probably because it's deep fried. My favorite part was the mac n cheese though! Definitely a keeper.

Alright, I'll admit it. I'm a sucker for breakfast foods. I could eat it twice a day it's that good. We got to this place around 9am and were seated right away, but it filled up quick. I don't drink coffee, but it's nice that they leave a whole carafe with you at the table! Great for those caffeine addicts :] I ordered a half order of french toast with the granola and apples - super good. I wasn't sure what to expect, but their granola was delish! I got the half order because I wanted to order some eggs too. The half seemed pretty big though. Definitely will be going back.

If I've said it once, I've said it a million times. Breakfast food is the best! We went on a Saturday morning and expected a wait, but were sat right away at the bar. The place is fairly big so that's nice. It's very bright in there too - with yellow and blue walls. They have a very big menu with all sorts of options from sweets to 5 egg omelettes! I tried a build your own skillet with avocado on the top! Very different, but very yummy. You can also opt for pancakes or toast - which I love so I can get my sweet with my savory. I would love to see them have outdoor seating since they have that big open area and are in a great downtown location! It's a bit expensive, but they do give you big portions - so it's like 2 meals in one :] Service could have been a little better, but nothing that turned me off from visiting again.

So I love Kolaches, but I've only ever been to the one on 116th. Found out today there's good reason for that. As soon as I walked in, I almost walked out. The place just isn't very clean, but I pressed on. I ordered an egg, sausage and cheese along with a fruit filled one. The guy at the desk, who had disgustingly long finger nails, asked me if I wanted them warmed up. Since I had planned on eating there I said yes please. He threw both of my kolaches in the bag and into the microwave they went. After the short time being in there, I decided that I couldn't really stand to eat inside so I left with my food. When I went to my car to eat them though, I realized he had thrown the strawberry one on it's side and in the heating process all the goodies had oozed out. Smooth move. 

Nonetheless, I give the kolaches themselves a B, but the place/experience a F.

We went here for my fiancé's 30th birthday with a group of 8 of us. I made reservations weeks in advance since it was a larger party. When we got there it was pretty empty so we were seated right away. We were greeted by our waitress once, then she disappeared for about 15 minutes. We finally ordered cocktails and apps. The cocktails came out a couple at a time, minutes apart. This would be a trend for the night. The drinks were mediocre and missing the fruit garnishes. The apps were also mediocre and missing their appropriate sauces. 

We had our fingers crossed that our dinners were going to make this all worth it. Dinner was delivered, yet again to be delivered plates at a time. I was halfway done with my meal before the last person got their food. Not great when you're trying to be polite and wait for everyone to get their food. The food was delicious though. We tried everything from the fried chicken, pork chops, to the shrimp and grits. Just when we thought all had gone wrong that could, we got our bills. They had charged us $75 for a bottle of wine that was on the menu for 50. There wasn't even a bottle for $75 on the menu, so be aware of what you're being charged.

The burger was decent, but for the price and amount of grease - I won't be back. I appreciate that they are grassfed burgers, but the grease was just too much for me. I ordered fries as well, but there was nothing exciting about those and my bill was almost $13 for everything.

Kwria-iqY2uZ9RmYM05SwA.review_text: The restaurant was clean.  The staff was friendly.  They even had plates and utensils for toddlers.   However, the ramen was over priced and only came with 2 thinly sliced pieces of pork.   I don't mind paying more for good food, but when they charge you almost $8 for a bowl with ramen with 2 slices of pork, it's a little ridiculous.   Next time, I will just make it at home.

I used to come here at least twice a month.  I love their food, especially their pho.  The owner is very friendly and always greets us.  However, the waitresses are lacking on customer service.  Some are quite rude and snotty.  Why, I don't know.  All I know is that I no longer go there and support the Vietnamese restaurant in sparks.

I love Port of Subs sandwiches.  I ordered a #1 at the Baring location.  When I got home , I could of sworn I ordered a sandwich with meat on it and not a  shredded lettuce sandwich.  There was barely any meat on the sandwich and it was sloppily made.  This is the second time this location has done this.  No more ordering from this location for me from now on.

I have been coming to this location for over 10 years. I love their food.  They have more authentic dishes than your average Mexican restaurant.   However, the last 2 times I have been there, there was hair on my food.  The first time I said something and told the waiter.  The second time I kept my mouth shut and lost my appetite.   Will not be coming back any time soon.

Took my family here this past weekend.  We ordered the tacos, nachos, and their rice.  The tacos were not as good as the other locations in Reno.  It was soggy and fell apart when eaten.  

The nachos were ok, but nothing to rave about because they barely put any ground beef in it.   

The rice was seemed like it was a day or two old because it was clumpy and not loose.  

The restaurant could use a good scrub down because my shoes stuck to the floor.  And decor and furnishings were probably the same furnishings back when I was in high school in the early 90s.  Please clean the chairs and tables because it was sticky when I touched it.

Stopped by this place after the Discovery Museum with my daughter.  

She ordered a Cap'n Crunch doughnut I believe. It was tasty.  

I ordered a jalapeño cream cheese croissant and it was delicious.  

Doughnuts were a good size. 

Would definitely recommend to any doughnut lover.
Great little place to take my kids to.  Store is clean and staff are friendly.  Also, love their ice cream and many flavors.

My daughter wanted corn dogs when we were at the mall.  I asked for the "box" (2 corn dogs and fries).  I felt like I was an inconvenience to him.  

No greetings what so ever. 

First thing he said was, beef or turkey.  He said it so fast I didn't get it the first time.  

Then he started throwing the utensils around as he was making our corn dogs. 

After he had our food ready, he didn't even look at me when he handed me our food or say thank you.  

Food was over priced and service was sh$tty.  Never 
again.

I was craving popusas but the place I went to was closed. I searched yelp and found this awesome place near the Shell station on Kietzke and Moana.  

Upon entering, my family and I were greeted by a very nice male host.

I ordered 6 popusas for dinner.  When it arrived, I noticed the popusas were huge.  Bigger than the place I normally eat at.  They were the most tastiest I have had.  

My wife enjoyed her fajitas and my son loved his quesadillas.   

And they even have horchata.  

Thus will now be my go to place for popusas from now on.

My family and I have a membership at their pool and fitness center.  So occasionally when the kids are hungry after playing at the pool we take them to David's Grill. 

We like to sit outside and enjoy the view of the greens.  The staff are attentive and the food is great.  

My kids love their mini corn dogs and my wife believes they make the best Cobb salad.  I personally love their burgers.

I took my 7 year old son here after I was tired of having to drive him across town to a place that cuts children's hair.  This place is an old fashioned barbershop located in the Greenbrae shopping center.  There are old memorabilias displayed throughout. 

The barber did an excellent job cutting my sons hair and made it fun for him.  

The price was very similar to what we paid at the other place.  

My son asked to come back for his next haircut.  We will definitely be back.

My wife and I stopped by this restaurant based on the positive reviews on Yelp.  

I had the country skillet and my wife had the shrimp omelette.   The portions huge and the service was quick.  

Even with COVID, there were a lot of patrons at every other table.  

I will definitely be back to this little hidden gem in Sparks.

I heard about this place through co-workers.  I decided to give it a try.  

I ordered the #1, which was 2 chicken tenders and fries. Since this place let's you choose the spiciness for the tenders, I had the HOT, even though it wasn't too hot for me. The food was great.  It was crispy on the outside and really juicy on the Inside. The tenders were huge.  

The reason why this place only received 4 stars is because I had to wait 35 minutes for my order.  This was at 1115, so It wasn't during the lunch rush. 

If Canes could make tenders and have the available in minutes after you order, I don't see why this place couldn't.  

I will definitely be back for more, but I will call in the order first for pick up.

It's not Starbucks and that's why I support this place.  While I don't drink coffee, my wife does.  So when she ask to stop for coffee, this is where I go.  She loves their coffee and great customer service.

I love eating at this place.  The location is on the way home and easy to get to.  

The service at this place is great.  They are quick to answer the phone and my food is always ready for pickup in 20 minutes or less.  

The prices are very good compared to other Asian restaurants in Sparks. 

Their beef chow fun noodles are the best.  My wife loves their Pho.

I went there for lunch with my wife for our "date day" on a Monday.  The restaurant had some nice authentic decor from India.   

We were greeted right away by a waitress and seated. 
Not too long after, the waitress returned with our water and took our order.  

My wife ordered the chicken biryani and I ordered the shrimp biryani.  

Our order came out relatively quick.  Both of the portions were huge. The shrimp biryani was delicious.  There were approximately 8-10 large shrimp in my dish.  

We also order the garlic naan and it did not disappoint. 

We will definitely be back.  

Thanks for a wonderful experience!

KyDNjtPbdRA-JEcxM1G--g.review_text:
I think the first time I came here was back in 2005 with some friends. We've come back countless times since then. 

Food is great and prices are reasonable. Lost one star because some special menu items are absent, such as taiyaki, kurokke, and sukiyaki. But I suppose I shouldn't expect to be able to buy these things outside of Japan. 

Overall, a very good experience.

I've been patronizing this place for many years after having been introduced to it by a friend. The first thing I noticed about the place was the warm atmosphere. The mismatched furniture, the art on the walls, and the music makes it feel like a home away from home. They seem to stick with an oldies playlist with lots of Beatles songs. 

The food is fairly priced, staff are friendly . I've overstayed my welcome many times due to papers being due for university and I didn't get any flack from the staff. They were really understanding :)

Can't go wrong with Block 1912!

This place is the best place to pick up Asian food. I don't even want to think about the amount of money I spent at this place over the last ten years or so. Their stock often varies, but they carry the major products such as Pocky or Pocari Sweat. 

I came down to T&T Supermarket today to pick up sushi for lunch. They were selling cone sushi, a first time in several years. After I paid for my food, I went to the dining area to eat my lunch. Despite the great selection and prices, I have to give T&T Supermarket 3 stars. The reason for this is because the dining area/food counter seems to be grossly understaffed. More often than not, the cash register here is closed. Today was no exception. Additionally, not a single table there was clean. I'm not really sure how such a high traffic area could be neglected like that.

Looks like businesses do pay attention to reviews on here!

Went to T&T Supermarket today and bought some sushi for supper. There was a lady on the floor cleaning the dining area of the store. The tables were actually clean! 

They lost a star for customer service here though. The cashier forgot to scan my drink and had to charge me separately. But in that separate transaction, she charged me for two bags (for the person next in line o_O) and didn't tell me until after I had paid with my credit card. She gave me the five cents in change to make up for the charge. It was only a minor inconvenience, but waaat :/

Stopped by here simply by accident on my travels. Great mom and pop type of shop. They were very surprised when I greeted them in Korean! 

They had lots of grocery product to choose from. They didn't have much as far as ready to eat lunches, just sushi and rice cake up at the cash. But I forgave them. 

I got the sushi to go and they even had my favorite Japanese milk tea product! 

Highly recommended.

I've only been to this location a handful of times, but it was a good experience every time. 

I came by today where I ate sushi for lunch and picked up some tea that was on sale. They even had a TV in the food court where they were showing a live fight on WWE. I thought that was cool. 

Another thing I immediately noticed is that they brought in bigger shopping carts. These new carts handled much better than the old ones. 

However, they need to do a better job with their cleaning because there were flies buzzing around the food court.

I've been to this Sushi place many times over the years. The prices they have on sushi are very reasonable compared to other places out there. Highly recommended if you're passing through City Centre!

I came here for lunch with my friend yesterday. We had orders of spicy shrimp and rice. Neither of us were too happy that the shrimp tails were still attached, and the meal was a bit too spicy for me. There wasn't a great selection of drinks and no dessert menu was offered. 

Customer service was good however, and I liked the atmosphere of the restaurant. 

I describe this as just "okay" and wouldn't be the first place that I would go to for lunch next time. Three stars.

I came back to T&T Supermarket this week. I came here for lunch and picked up a few snacks for a picnic that I went to the next day. 

The place was crowded as usual, but that aspect can't be avoided. I will return!

This is a lovely place!

I recently caught a cold, so I dropped by for a fill on tea while I was waiting for my bus. I usually go with green or black tea, but I wanted to try something different. The clerk recommended ginger tea, and it was nice chatting with Cally while she was working on that. I ended up leaving the shop with two maneki neko, one in pink and one in green. 

It's nice to see a tea shop with some fun Japanese imports. Highly recommended.

Great selection of European groceries and the staff are helpful. They even had a TV with CNN news turned out. That's how I found out about the damage of Hurricane Sandy. Great place to shop and stay informed!

I came here about two weeks ago to pick up some rice and natto. Since the Japanese winter festival was going on, the store had a bunch of stuff on sale. I ended up leaving with a lot more than I came for!

Just a shout out for putting up with my hours long study sessions. THANK YOU!

Also, I'd like to see crepes and macrons added to the menu since these are really hard to find in Edmonton. I was really excited to see Crepeworks open across the street from you guys, but they shut down literally just months after they opened because of a dispute.

I started coming here as a part of my recent efforts to have a healthier lifestyle. The prices for stuff here are steep, but your health is worth it. 

They have all sorts of beans and nuts that the main grocery stores don't carry. I recently picked up some fruit and vegetables here and I could taste the difference. The food here has more flavor and tastes fresher than anything you find at the national chains. They also have a deli where I discovered that vegetarian sandwiches can be really good. 

The staff here are super friendly and helpful. I like the super casual dress code at this store. It makes the staff a lot more down to earth and approachable.

Additionally, the store offers samples from time to time. Great opportunity to seek out good food.

This is the usual place my classmates and I will meet up to do projects. The seating upstairs is comfortable with several laptop plugins. Unfortunately, every time I've gone, part of the menu is unavailable. I think it's an awesome place to hang out, but ther menu needs a lot of work.

Much friendlier and welcoming than the Milwoods Town Centre location! I have never been harassed by security when I come to this location. The location is convenient when you need hygiene items in a pinch, but prices are a bit steep, depending on what you're buying.

My friend and I dropped in yesterday and the folks at Lindt had dropped in to hand out chocolate bunny samples. Lindt products are a bit pricy, but worth the extra money! 

After that, we dropped into the cosmetics department and goofed around. I found some Vanilla Coke and Cherry Coke flavored lip balm and I ran up to my friend and said, "Isn't it sad that this is the closest thing you'll get to buying Vanilla Coke and Cherry Coke in Canada?" So, we had a conversation about the lack of these soda flavors, and one of the clerks chime in, "I was gonna come to help you, but after hearing that conversation....!" 

That led into a friendly conversation about the US and stuff. The staff here are awesome. 

Even though I left the store empty handed, my friend did buy some nail polish. 

One thing worth mentioning is that this location does have a corporate Canada Post office. I mailed stuff through this location and the service here is touch and go. I was mailing some presents out at Christmas time and only needed a small box to send the items out, which the store was unwilling to give me one. The surrounding stores weren't willing to help out either. Other times, I came to ship stuff and forgot to bring packing tape and I was made to buy a whole roll of tape for $3. I understand this in a way because they are corporate and they have to make money, but shelling out $5+ for a box I can get for free elsewhere is a bit ridiculous.

Moral of the story here is that you have to make sure that you bring your own shipping supplies, otherwise you will end up spending a lot more money on your trip.

L5iTlyX6Me0r3MSKs-Mfdw.review_text: My first time at this restaurant, I ordered the curry with lamb and it was the best meal I have had in forever! Great service tops it all!

The service is slow and they don't really know what the meaning of hospitality is. The food took forever to show up and in my drunken noodles, the mushroom's were cold. Also, the chicken was bland and a bit cold. I asked for #4 spice level and everything was bland. Will not go back again.
Service staff is pretty bad. The food is not too shabby. But when I found a big cockroach in the bathroom, the manager didn't even care nor did he apologize. Not going back there.

Fast service, good wait staff and the best Thai food in Nashville. It doesn't have a great appeal to it. But all I need is good food and good service. I won't have Thai food any where else. I love how we can call ahead and order and they have our table ready for us in 10-15 minutes with our food. Now, that's what I call amazing service!
We were there on a Friday night at 7 and were seated right away. Good service and good food. Loved the ambiance and decor. Will definitely be back.
Been there twice and loved the food and service each time. The tacos are fantastic and the corn was awesome. The mango margarita really hit the spot. I will definitely go back.

Was in the area and thought of giving it a try. The server recommended fried rice and some sushi options. Two other guests showed after us, ate, paid and we still didn't get our food. Asked them twice and still nothing. We walked out.
I've never been there but have ordered delivery for the past two years. It's my favorite place in Nashville. Good portions and hot fresh food. Never disappointed.

Why didn't I come here sooner? I've been to every other Thai restaurant in Nashville before I made it here. This is by far the best Thai one in Nashville. Don't go there for a luxurious experience. Go there for the delicious fresh food. We ordered Pad Thai, Pad Ke Mao and my husband got Make Your Own Noodle Soup bowl. Everything was amazing! Even the lychee juice. Do yourself a favor and try it before you knock it.

Awesome Cuban food, great service and strong drinks. I'm extremely surprised and excited about a place like this in Nashville. I forgot I was in Nashville for a while. The plaza itself is an impressive building. Newly renovated and needs to be visited. I will definitely be going back here.

I wish this place was close to where I live. It really is not your run of the mill Chinese restaurant. They are different and offer unique twist. You won't regret giving this place a chance. We are definitely going back.

Wow!!! Everything we ate hit the spot! They made our sexy jalapenos vegetarian by adding avacado instead of spicy tuna. The vegetable roll, tofu lo mein and vegetable fried rice was the bomb!!! Our waitress was a sweet heart. She was very helpful and thorough. Will definitely be going back.

Delicious food! We had lebneh, tomato soup, bustan and mujadara and everything was delicious! The server, was awesome. Every one is really kind, clean environment and fun music. The food though. Damn! Hit the spot on a rainy day.

Leaving this review while I'm still at the restaurant. TJ, the waiter is funny and knowledgeable. We had their entire vegetarian menu and LOVED every single one. Cute decor inside and outside. Definitely will be coming back. New favorite spot!

I've ordered from them for the past year and would keep doing it. But as of today, I will be taking a break. I walked in at 2:15 to order take out as they close at 2:30. They turned us away as the other ladies didn't want to cook the food. If you don't take orders at 2:15, advertise your business as closing at 2:15.

The pulao is not supposed to be yellow rice with shitty flavor, the veg Manchurian has a weird red sauce, the hakka noodles are NOT as labeled. The biryani? Get out of here! If you are looking for good Indian food, keep looking.

Tried this place after a year. Had a plastic wrap in my spring role. Called to complaint and the lady who answered could give two shirts. She says it happens all the time... While they are prepping food, things can fall in it. She was extremely rude! Threw our entire food out and ruined my day. I'm pregnant and can't risk their careless attitude towards food safety hurt me and my unborn child. She didn't want to hear what I had to say! Extremely upset and will be calling the health department to complain. The spring roll wasn't even good. The rest of the food tasted old and fake.

Loved the vegan Bao's. But the veggie noodle soup is made of bone broth. This is my second time here and the check out lady tells me that this time. The guy who took my order the first time didn't mention it to me. Don't call it a veggie noodle bowl if it's truly not vegetarian. Very upset that I had a bone broth the last time!

This restaurant was worth the 40 minute drive from Mt Juliet. For picky eaters like myself, the chef definitely nailed it on every dish! I had the seafood platter and from a Rhode Islander, I APPROVE. And for a pizza lover like my husband, he was in heaven! As delicious as the food was, the service was even better. Josh, was the perfect server. He made our night by just being a wonderful human. The owner was sweet and celebrated our 5th anniversary with us. We are very grateful for a memorable evening and will be coming back. 

P.S the cocktail menu is phenomenal!

LBBDnlZzfaslPxlulJmjcw.review_text: They need to bring back the scale. The prices of the different size cups are not worth it.
Awesome flavors always a great variety even for the picky and conscious. The staff is very friendly and store is clean and uncluttered. Just wish they had more tables and chairs.

This is probably the best Mexican in this area compared to the other restaurants. The food is cooked just right never overcooked and their churros with the vanilla ice cream are to die for! If you want a good time and enjoy art this is the place to be. 9/10

This is probably the best place to go to if you like cats and good coffee. They get their coffee from a local place in the area and its amazing! The staff is very friendly and they make you feel right at home at Mauhaus. There are plenty of cats to play with. I recommend his place to anyone looking for a relaxing atmosphere.
They have the best selection of cakes for any occasion. I always make sure to order one for my birthday the chocolate covered strawberries are fresh and delicious.

Always friendly and fast! They have the best pita from the potato and cheese there are many varieties. My favorite has to be their dessert the puffy doughnut pastry (krofna) with the chocolate filling on the side. I stop by and pick up takeout quite often. Everything is fresh and delicious!
One of the best places for Middle Eastern food. The food is fresh and has such flavorful spices. Definitely worth trying even though its not as fancy as most places the food is superb!

The Chicken Kebab is absolutely delicious the meat is tender and full of flavor. When you first walk in there are many traditional cultural decorations throughout the restaurant it is a quiet and relaxing ambience. If you are a beginner of tasting various cuisines this is the place to visit. The layout of the restaurant is nice there are more tables for larger groups on the other side of the restaurant.

Great atmosphere and the Mississippi Mud House Cocktail is delicious. For my first time trying this drink it was amazingly delicious. The aroma of the Baileys cognac cream was sweet yet great pair with the Nitro Brew Coffee.

Hmmm so as i walk in this coffeehouse for the first time it looks neat and the interior is intriguing. I was surprised to be offended as i was taking my time to decide which coffee choice i want to order, the gentleman informed me if i knew what a specific coffee was. To my surprise i was taken back i may not be a coffee "expert" but my cappuccino was very bitter. My girlfriends coffee's were the same bland  tasted like watered down dirt. The picture speaks for itself. Thank you for making my experience not so lovely. Hopefully things change...

This place is very nice inside from the simple yet welcoming decor there is a nice patio outdoors and they also sell their wines for those who would like to enjoy at home instead of dine in. Food is great and filling would recommend their tuna sliders so delicious. Masks are required before being seated and try calling ahead to see if tables are available it does get busy quickly.

This is such a neat little Asian/Mexican Taco Joint, although you cannot go inside eat they offer curbside pickup and the burritos are so tasty and filling. Definitely better than any fast food tacos place and worth the price.
