The owners are really nice and they do a great job of giving you enough food for takeout. Definitely a must-visit place if you're looking for something new.

I'm very shocked at the low rating this restaurant has. this is a great establishment if you want to drift away from your typical "chain" steakhouse restaurants. they have great food selection. even their portions are amazing. the great part, in my opinion, is their sunday morning brunch buffet. you'll have a huge buffet table lined up, with omelet station and also a pancake/waffle station. so worth the $.
Awesome selection of hoagies and hot sandwiches. The inside is very clean and also pretty quiet to relax while you dig in.

Took my vegetarian gilrfriend out to dinner here last Saturday. She loves Mediterranean food so we ordered the sample platter for an appetizer and it was AWESOME. only downside to the experience was that our appetizer and meal all came at the same time so it was a little overwhelming. Bottom line, their menu is large and have plenty to choose from for meat eaters, like myself, and vegetarians. Food was very good and i would come here again in the future.

I come here often when they show UFC PPV events. It gets crowded on weekends as most popular bars do but to the point where seating takes about close to an hour long. The food is great. The menu is filled with a lot of items to choose from.
Went here with my girlfriend during cinco de mayo and another random weekend. we both loved it. food was great and filling. wouldn't hesitate to come here again. i recommend the 3 tacos dinner.

A friend from work referred me to this place and I couldn't be any happier. Their cheesesteak is amazing! I plan on trying out each kind. Rivals all steak places in the city. I'm coming here more often on my lunch break from work.

i work right next door @ visionworks and my associates and i walk to chipotle practically 3x/week during our lunch break. the place is very clean and food is well prepared even on busy lunch rush. My go-to meal is normally 3 soft tacos with barbacoa and carnitas w/ rice and beans, guac and cheese w/ a little bit of sour cream. NOM NOM NOM!

Dear lawd this is the BEST pizza that i have ever had in my LIFE! i'm from new jersey and my girlfriend who grew up in the area took me here because she's been coming here since she was a kid. she hyped it up so much that i finally had to visit and get a taste for myself. all the hype is true. their pies were amazing. the crust, the amount of cheese put on it was just enough to get me hooked. i ordered the hawaiian pizza for my first time but i'm itching to go back just to devour an entire pie of another flavor. i don't think i can enjoy another pie of pizza after having a pie from New Haven. simply amazing.
The pork belly tacos were amazing!! And I'm a guacamole fiend so I could have used some more in the bowl :)

Always knew about this place but never stopped in until a few weeks ago with my girlfriend. The price was amazing for each meal! Very reasonable and I didn't leave disappointed. Will definitely come back for their lunch buffet.

NI4bTaEEmVwsBbFYfX_WGQ.review_text: I like outback in general but this location is terrible when it comes to the quality delivered via curbside to go. Without fail, there is something critically wrong with my order every time! Things over cooked, items missing, general disaster... no apology given after 40 minutes of them waiting to fox the problem. Asked for a manager who never came...

The ice cream is good. It's a bit more expensive than some of their competitors. The service is decent but wouldn't say they go above and beyond. I wish they had more ice cream flavors to pick from which were more unique.

They have a great selection of food to pick from. The servers are knowledgeable of their menu and easily able to clarify any questions. I love that they added the drive up window for to go orders. It's a great place to go when you want quality food at a decent price.

Love love love this place! The pizza is so delicious. You get to build your own pizza so you get exactly what you want. It is a bit on the pricey side but so worth it. They don't have the quickest service ever.

Went to clinic and they were great. The doctor was very knowledgeable and listened to what I had to say. Quickly diagnosed me and sent over my medication. Was very informative as to what I could and couldn't do. So happy I went there so I can get back to feeling well again!

Great food with lots of options. I was surprised to find so many vegetarian options there! While I didn't try any, the desserts looked delightful! I will definitely go back many more times. Can't wait to try more things!

This place is phenomenal. All the food we had was absolutely delicious. The turtle soup is to die for. The server was amazing and knowledgeable. The drinks were a great variety and perfectly made. If you like creole, you must try this place! If I could, I would just move in there.

Great quality of products there. The variety in the market isn't that big, but what they have is great! It's one of the few places in Tampa that sells fresh crawfish when in season. Prices are pretty good too for what you get!

This place is a hidden gem. We found it randomly one day and tried it out. It has a great selection of beer and the food is actually very yummy. I prefer it to some similar bars since it's not as loud. Check it out for a great experience!

Terrible. Terrible. Terrible. Ordered takeout and was hung up on deliberately (lady said "OK bye") while I was talking. I ordered shrimp fried rice which seems like it should be reasonably priced ($8 based on an old menu). I get to the restaurant and am charged over $13 for this small order. I get the food in my car and realize it has an overwhelming raunchy smell. I opened the box to find that these " shrimp " look like they came out of a can - no larger than a nickel in size. If this is the quality I get for a $13 fried rice, I want no part of it. The quality of this place has just gone down drastically.

The To Go service is on time approximately never. That aside, the food is consistent and fairly decent for the price. I love their pretzel appetizer they introduced. If you plan to order To Go, just expect it to be at least 10 minutes late with no apology.

The food we had was great. I had a Thai shrimp salad which was perfectly balanced. The drinks were great as well -moscato mimosa? Yes please! The reason for only 3* is the very very poor service. We were the only table assigned to our waiter. He never told is his name.  When requesting our order he said "what do you want", took our order, then walked away. He had others being our food. Seemed like he absolutely hated his job. Quite disappointing for a pricey lunch.

You probably think barbeque restaurant and immediately think "no vegetarians allowed". While I'm not a full blown vegetarian, I'm definitely not a full on meat eater. Smokey Bones has so many options for meat free meals even including veggie burgers! The create your own burger gives you the opportunity to get your protein without eating meat. On top of that, so many of their appetizers are delish too! I personally love the potato and salad meal. I get the meat on the side for my carnivore husband. 

I've done both takeout and sit down here. I'm always pleased with the service I received. I will say that the to go is generally a few minutes behind their estimated time, but always fresh. Don't be afraid to ask for what you need either! Crazy about BBQ sauce? Ask them for extra and they'll happily grab you some!

I love the casual atmosphere that this place has. With all the TVs, it's a great place to sit down with a nice cold drink and catch up on all the sporting events!

After looking for a new restaurant to try out, we stumbled upon this gem. At first, looking at the menu, I was a bit afraid of what I had gotten myself into. After looking deeper into the menu, I determined that they had a wide variety to pick from! The waitress highly recommended the chicken plate, which most of my group ended up ordering. I personally ordered the cheese stick kids meal. I love that they actually allowed me to order off the kids meal despite no kids at the table. 

Everyone that ordered the chicken raved about how moist and delicious the whole thing was. They have their own, homemade hot sauce which has a great flavor and isn't too hot. As for my kids meal, though very basic, actually had a lot of flavor.

All around, I was very pleased with this experience and will definitely be returning!

I found the food here to be pretty decent. I had pretty low expectations based on the other reviews I found on here. I ordered the grilled cheese sandwich and was pleased with the taste. The beer selection on draft was pretty great too. The negative side of this, however, was the service. We weren't promptly attended to upon sitting down. Once we ordered, our food was brought out, but the waitress never checked in on us to see how our food was, nor did she ask if we wanted another round of drinks (though the beers were empty). Nearing the end of our meal, another waiter came over and cleared the table, despite the fact that I was still eating off my plate. I actually looked around to see if there were hidden cameras somewhere with someone about to jump out and tell me I'd been pranked. I would consider eating here again, but would do takeout and never actually go back for a sit-down meal.

We recently checked this market out and were pleasantly surprised with the wide variety of food offered. My family was thrilled to see the variations of high end meat which was available to pick from. We stocked up on some various hams as well as four different cheeses. Everything we had was incredibly fresh and sliced perfectly. What they offer is something that can't really be found anywhere else, that I've found, in Tampa. We'll be making this one of our regular stops going forward.

Meh. I went with a friend for Sunday brunch and was totally underwhelmed with the quality and selection for the price. The omelet again had very limited ingredients to pick from and there were more sugary pastries and desserts than normal breakfast food. I much prefer the brunch at grille 54 to this. I will go back at some point to give them a try for something other than brunch to give them a fair shot at wowing me.

I love the sushi from here! I typically get a warm bagel roll and it is absolutely to die for. The reason for only giving 4 stars is that the place is pretty pricey. I haven't found a way to get out of there spending less than $20/person which includes a cocktail. I also like to have the flexibilty to get takeout from places I love, however, for some reason, the sushi from here doesn't taste near as good when getting a to-go order. So when I'm looking for a good sushi meal, not caring about price, and I have time to get out for a sit down meal, Samurai Blue is my go to place.

We stopped by here wanting to try something different than the normal chain companies around us. We were not disappointed. The food was all very fresh and flavorful. Collectively, we had ribs, pulled pork sandwich, mac and cheese, and potato salad. The meats were cooked perfectly, and though the sandwich was a bit difficult to eat because the bun was moist from the pork juices and bbq sauce, it was still magic. I'm very picky about my potato salad and was blown away by how good this was! I will definitely be going back and trying some other things on their menu!

NKeKoFBQfYUA0zNSZCrIzA.review_text:
Fresh bread that's piping hot? Check.
Fabulous outdoor seating? Check.
Good food? Check.
Reasonable prices? Check.
BYOB? Check.

What's not to love?

-1 star b/c the staff isn't the friendliest.

Totally overrated.  This is the kind of place that exists solely to take advantage of unassuming tourists.  I can't believe I fell for it.  Or rather, let my friend fall for it, then let her drag me there.  

I've had much better food in New Orleans, at much better prices.  This place is all hype, no substance.

Totally overrated.  What's the hype about this place?  I just don't get it.

The steak they use is nothing but cheap, and you can tell.  The cheese doesn't properly melt.  And those are the worst sauteed onions I've had in a long time.

Sad to say it, I think Steak Escape at the mall is tastier than this place.  And cheaper, too. 

2 stars because at least the fries were tasty.

Definite pick-up spot.  Or rather, definitely a spot where men with mid-life crises come to hit on attractive 20-somethings. 

Nice decor (though surprisingly small dining room), and always a buzzing scene regardless of day of week.  Food is suprisingly decent given that this place is more see-and-be-scene than a foodie haven.
fabulous salads.  i particularly like the "control freak" design your own option.  because yes, i have been known to be a tad controlling when it comes to my food.

LOVE this place.  And not just because I live above it.  Sandwiches are to die for - try the Napoleon and thank me later.  Also love the Illy coffee.   

-1 b/c some of those prices are nothing but ridiculous ($6.99 for a quart of Ciao Bella ice cream?? ) NO THANK YOU.
Sub-par.  Service is horrible, chips are stale, food lacks spice.  The space is nice, if you're going for ambiance.  But don't expect much beyond.  FYI - drinks are weak...stick to sangria/wine/etc.
stiff drinks.  and cheap.  not my scene, but it'll do.  we're not in nyc anymore, kids.

looooove the cappucino here!!  granted, this is not a cappucino destination, but when you're feeling like saving yourself from the gelato calories, it will def not disappoint.  sandwiches also look yummy.  friendly service, too.  i'm a big fan.

Great onion soup.  And friendly service.  That's about all Parc has on the 'pro' list. 

Cons include a horrible beet salad, marginal escargot, and terrible tuna tartare.

I love the ambiance, but the food here is definitely lacking.  This is no Pastis. 

PS. Skip the rose here.  It's no Chateau de Marres.

anytime i can have cuban food for breakfast, i'm a happy girl.  

indeed, brunch here is fab.  friendly service, a huge selection of entrees, and an amazing crabcake omelette.  ordering it is a must, if only for the to-die-for potatoes on the side.  

-1 star b/c their iced tea is bottled, not fresh.

definitely check this place out.  morning or night, cuba libre never disappoints.
STIFF drinks.  Seriously.  These guys don't mess around.  Don't say I didn't warn you.

Shiroi Hana doesn't hold a candle to places like Tomoe or Kanoyama in NYC, but by Philly standards, I'm actually pretty pleased with this find (thanks yelp).  

First off, it's like the only decent sushi place in Rittenhouse that's actually open on Sunday.  

Second, the fish here is actually fresh.  Rolls (so far I've had the spicy tuna and an eel/avo) are good - nothing to write home about, but definitely standard (thereby not disappointing).  If anything, they throw in a tad too much rice, but I'll deal with that.  

Seaweed salad is also good if uninventive - it's literally straight from some Costco-size pre-packaged container, but again, that's Ok.  I've definitely lowered standards since moving to the hood.

I'm happy to have found a solid sushi joint in the area.  The restaurant itself has great atmosphere, but SH is also very accomodating to take-out orders (Sunday Sushi in the Park is my new tradition).  

For those complaining about the prices: don't ever go for sushi in New York.  As a recent transplant, I think the $6-7 rolls at SH are a DEAL.
AUGH.  Truly awful.  The bagels here have to be among the worst I've EVER had.  EVER.  I swear.  Not fresh, not tasty, just plain WRONG.  Avoid, avoid, avoid.  Their coffee sucks too.

Probably my favorite spot in the Rittenhouse area.  Great wines, love the sidewalk seating, and the food is de-lish.  Personal faves include any one of the bruschettas, beet salad, and my newest fave - the asparagus salad with grilled chicken.  Amazing.

I love being a lady who lunches here.

Total disaster.  The food here is completely sub-par.  I'm pretty sure I can make better pasta.  And that's saying a lot, seeing as how I can barely boil water.  And let's not start talking about the atrocious and utterly confused waitstaff.  Horrible service, horrible food.  All-around horrible!

Gardenia is amazing!  I love it so much, I want to have every meal here for the next 2 years.  Seriously.  

Fresh, delicious, well-prepared food?  Check.  Adorable outdoor garden?  Check.  Attentive, friendly service?  Check.  The perfect brunch spot?  Check.

 TDF.  Even by NYC standards.
Fabulous all-around!  Great rooftop bar, great food (order and share allll the apps, they're all amazing), great for groups, great service.  Go.

Decent food (the dessert was the best part), but HORRIBLE, TACKY service.  Absolutely classless.

Not only was my party of 5 forced to wait 30 minutes to be seated for our reservation, but the host/management wasn't the least bit apologetic.

Once finally seated, service at the table was unprofessional and practically nonexistant.  Our waiter looked about 19, his suit was clearly 3 sizes too big for him, and he described the monkfish as "poor man's lobster".  This kid should definitely never go into sales.  Other signs of terrible service: my iced tea was never refilled - not a single time!, we waited literally 30 minutes to place our order and another 30 minutes for our 1st course to arrive, the waiter forgot about our coffee order, the list goes on...

The kicker, though, was after all this horrible service, the waiter tries to claim that b/c our reservation was for 6 and we only had 5 people, they were going to charge us for the 6th person.  HONESTLY?!  And to bring it up while we're eating our appetizers?  Totally tacky.  

And if you think the waitstaff is terrible, wait until you see the managers.  The Park Hyatt should be embarrassed that a place like this occupies space in their hotel.

Great service, great food, great prices.  Totally unfussy, quick, and delish.  Love it!

PS. The waiter here is a hottie!!

You really can't beat 3 massive rolls for $10.95.  The only problem is it's such a deal, I never order anything else...and consequently end up gorging myself on sushi.  

Thankfully, the quality of fish here is consistently good.  Not great but good enough to be my go-to in Rittenhouse Square.  Until I'm back in NYC, Vic will be seeing lots of me. 

*Extra half-star for the amazing ginger dressing that comes with the "vegetable" salad.

Let me preface by saying I love a good tapas restaurant.  In fact, I think tapas should be the restaurant go-to for all women.  Let's face it ladies, you don't need the massive portions being served up at these BYO Italian joints.  Unless of course you like men who like their women thick. 

Anywho, on to the review...

Tinto is all-around fab.  Much needed in the Square, if you ask me.  I love the atmosphere/decor here, and they have some fantastic wines by the glass.  Oh, and service is impeccable.

As for tapas selections, coming here without ordering the bacon-wrapped figs, short-ribs, or the duck confit should be considered a cardinal sin.  De-lish.  

Perfect spot to catch up with old friends or flirt on a hot date.

I'm withholding the 5th star b/c I've been spoiled by too many visits to Cafe Iberico in Chicago and Alta in Manhattan.
5 stars only because it is the ONLY decent spot open past 10pm in this hood.  That, and who doesn't like a "control freak" salad?

I don't care if this coffee comes with a kick in the knee by these supposedly rude baristas (they're not rude, btw.  You people need to toughen up, lest never survive outside this city).  

The coffee at La Colombe is hands-down the BEST. IN. PHILLY.  PERIOD.  If you think otherwise, you don't know coffee.  If you let the baristas keep you from giving this place anything less than 5 stars, you don't know coffee.  Enough said.

If there were a Vino Volo in every airport, I might've considered prolonging my consulting career.  This place is fabulous!  Great wines, great prices, great snacks, and friendly service.  Next time I'm at PHL, I might actually hope for a flight delay, only to indulge in some Vino Volo goodness.

Some weeks, I am certifiably obsessed with this place.  As in, I might order Pita Pit every single day.  And considering that I only eat one meal on most days, that's a lot of Pita Pit dedication.  

I love the hummus pita.  And at only 240 calories, it's completely guilt-free.  I also love that I can pile on all the fresh veggies I want here.  And I do mean fresh - the produce quality here is far and above anything else I've had in Philly (sidenote - why is it SO hard to get fresh veggies in this city??).  

Pita Pit is fab.  Enough said.

Terrible.  This place gets one star because they're open til 10 most nights (apparently that's considered late in this city), and another star because they're located across the street from me.  Zero stars for food.  In fact, the food here is borderline inedible.  Not every wrap needs to be piping hot, people.  Especially when that means biting into microwaved wilting lettuce and about-to-spoil tomatoes.  Honestly, the ingredients here are horrible and you can taste it.  Avoid unless you're desperate.
Totally obsessed with the latte here.  I don't know what they put in it, but I suspect it's laced with crack cocaine.  I am completely addicted.
tzatiki = amazing.  the rest of it?  decent.  definitely not great.  but they're quick and semi-healthy, in an area where decent food options definitely do not abound.

Puh-Lease.  Don't waste your time.  The food here is nothing special.  Which is the only reason I didn't mind the impossibly small portions...maybe the owners should take the fact that we're not finishing our impossibly small portions as a hint that the food sucks.  Just saying...

Finally!  An Italian BYOB in this city that's actually worth writing home about.  Everything about the food at La Viola is a-maze-ing.  Probably some of the best Italian I've had in a looooong time.  Add great service and ambiance, and LV gets an easy 5 stars.

What would Penn students do without Distrito??  Always works in a pinch, especially with big groups.  Get the beef.  Anything beef.  It's top notch here.  Oh, and the guac.  

Only downside - margaritas are hit or miss here, and definitely weak on the tequila.  Or maybe my b-school drinking escapades have raised my tolerance and Steven Starr just can't keep up.

update - came here for dinner last Sunday...the restaurant was nearly empty (yeah, yeah, it's a sunday, but com'on philly) and the food was pretty disgusting.  i ordered the ropa vieja.  meh.  i barely put a dent in it.   I'm definitely no longer the fan I once was.

Possibly the best clam chowder I've ever had.  Period.  

I love the scene inside - homy and quaint meets preppy, Massachussetts cool.  I come here when I want to forget I'm in Philthadelphia.  

Can't give it 5 stars because the clam chowder is really the only thing I obsess over here.  The burger is good, not great, and other menu items including shrimp cocktail and salad are forgettable.

Go figure I discover this place exactly 1 month before my 2 year Philadelphia stint is up.  I cringe when I think about all the horrible meals I've put up with in this city (Porcini, Fontana della Citta, Continental, the list goes on)...and now to know I could've been at Meritage that whole time.  I can't decide if I'm angry or thrilled.

Everything about Meritage is fantastic.  Adorable and intimate, BYO on weekdays, reasonable prices, and some of the best food I've had in a long time.  Nearly everything was a hit: the mushroom risotto, the hangar steak, the chick pea fries, to chocolate espresso pot de creme, the list goes on.  Yes, I tried it all.  Even the foie gras dumplings, which I wasn't a huge fan of, were good compared to some of the meals I've had elsewhere in Philadelphia.

I will be back.  Maybe every night for the next month.  I suggest you pay Meritage a visit too.

Perfect place for practically any occasion: hot date, birthday party, girls night, you name it.  The decor here is beautiful and sexy, the vibe is intimate and fun at the same time.  

I love the unique small plates here.  Having been to one too many spanish tapas joints, I find it refreshing to sample Asia in tapas form.  Items I recommend: pork buns (duh), scallion pancakes (much better than I would've imagined), and the peruvian ceviche.  And what I didn't love: Chaufa (this is basically a boring fried rice).   And I do agree with Caroline C. - there's not a lot of true fusion going on here, but I'm actually OK with that. 

Overall, great spot. Garces does it again.

FAIL.  

Came here for a 3-course dinner, private party style.  What is with Philadelphians?  How can this place be 4 stars on Yelp?  Food is a total disaster.  

We started with a poor excuse/practically inedible round of apps - tomato bruschetta was the only passable part and come on...it's impossible to screw that up.  

Mussels were terrible.  

Chicken in balsamic vinegar was literally drowning in vinegar.  My broccoli was wilted and soggy.  

Best part of the meal was dessert.  Not the marscapone cheesecake I originally ordered, but the tiramisu I ordered as my second dessert.  

Actually, take that back...best part was the BYO wine we had. 

Never. Going. Back. Again.

I want to love this place.  Mostly because my fabulous boyfriend brought me here on our second date a long, long, long time ago.  Back then, I had a fabulous time.  Not just because of the 5 glasses of wine I had.  It was the company more than the alcohol, I swear.  I mention all the wine only to suggest that my first time here, I was apparently on a liquid diet.  

Last night, I returned.  This time, I was craving sushi and ready to overdose on it.  I'd been going to Zama recently, so I knew Raw was going to have to compare in order to leave me satisfied.  In fact, the only reason boyfriend and I decided to go back to Raw was because we wanted outdoor seating, and Zama doesn't have their license yet.  

Yes, Raw has a great outdoor patio.  But that's about the only thing that's great.  My pinot grigio was just meh, edamame needed to be steamed a few minutes longer, and I've had better seaweed salad from Whole Foods.  

Now for the fish - a solid 2 stars, nothing more.  We ordered the following rolls: spicy tuna, eel avocado, rainbow, capital, and salmon avocado.  None impressed.  Lovers of Raw may point to the crazy fancy rolls this place offers.  As a sushi purist, though, I firmly believe that 8 sauces on a roll shouldn't be a savior for less-than-fresh fish.  I'm also morally opposed to paying $20 for one roll, I don't care how crazy it is.  

I'm sad to say I'll never be back here, mostly because of my fabulous second date almost 2 years ago.  But I'd rather hold on to a great memory than force myself to eat bad sushi.

I love Gusto.  The pizza here tastes much healthier and much fresher than any other pizza I've had in Philly.  Pizza with less-than-typical guilt is something I always appreciate. 

Fast delivery, fresh ingredients, friendly service.  The only downside is it's cash only.

Sabrina's is amazing.  I wish I'd discovered this gem sooner.  

I've been here for dinner twice before.  Both times I was blown away.  I'll keep this short since my fellow yelpers have already established Sabrina's fabulousness.

My favorite dinner entrees in descending order:

1.  Meatloaf with sweet mashed potatoes- it's the best, hands down.  I never thought I'd order meatloaf at a restaurant, but I am soooo glad I did (or rather, boyfriend did and let me eat off his plate).

2.  Fish Tacos
3.  Short Ribs with sweet mashed potatoes
4.  Roasted Pork Chop

The mussels in red sauce are an excellent starter.

You will be ready to explode after a visit to Sabrina's but it's well worth it.  Add BYOB to the mix, and I can't find a single negative thing to say about these guys.
Bleh.  Do NOT order the appetizer sampler.  Utterly terrible.  Thank god I had good company, otherwise this experience would've been a total disaster.

NN343yGRDdFkMK90maNq3g.review_text: A perfect place to just relax.  If only the food quality was a bit better.  Sleepy environment...but is perfect if you want quiet time.
The meatloaf is amazing!  The quality here can not be beat.  My only complaint would be that it's a little bit of a lonely environment.

What can I say...I love it here!  

The food is amazing!  The service is amazing!  The salsa is amazing!  

The environment is comfortable a pleasantly relaxing.  We are treated like family every time we come in.  

Thank you!

Well, let's begin with the unappealing location in the casino lacking any sort of ambiance.  The staff is quite appropriate for a roadside truck stop if that's what your preference is.  

1.  Low grade service.
2.  Poor quality food.
3.  A sad environment.
4.  Simply not even impressed with the food.

We will not return!

With that being said if the staff, location, and if the food quality was upped several notches I believe this would be a nice addition to "diner" community in Reno.

I can not rave enough about Miguel's!  Another amazing meal this evening accompanied by a very pleasant conversation with the owners.  

Once again, I would like thank Miguel's for a fabulous dinner followed by a taste of why the service and food is top notch.

Samuel "David"

Well, I have to say the ambiance was better than I would expect for a "fast food" Reno restaurant.   Unfortunately, the ambiance did not out way the less than palatable food.  I do not frequent "fast food" and or "chain restaurants" as a norm, but I felt I needed to see what all the excitement was about.  

I think Chipotle will do just fine here in Reno as most residents do not experience or have normal recognition of quality and or well made food.  

We tried it....  We will not be back!

Well, I almost hate posting this review.  This was our second try at The Gas Lamp.  Needless to say it will be our last.

The only reason we tried this restaurant for a second time is due to the fact that we went to have their signature pork chop on our first venture...but they had sold out for the evening.  So we gave them a second chance.  

Ambiance:  
  1.  The exterior eludes to a trendy medium scale restaurant.  Very appealing.
  2.  The interior is a duplicated outdated Denny's.
  3.  Very sad and lonely environment.  
  4.  If you're looking for an old folks retirement setting.  You've found your place!

Staff:  
  1.  Not what one would expect for the image they are failing to portray.
  2.  Limited attention and simply a lack of concern.

Food:  
  1.  The "signature" pork chop sadly is far from good enough to warrant a return vist.
  2.  The Ribeye  steak or should I say a slab of soft mutilated meat over loaded with fat successfully reached my list of worst steaks I have ever had.  First of all, I ordered well done and received raw.  I tried to gut down half the steak but I threw in the towel and just went without.  Our waiter acknowledged that I ordered well done and said it sure wasn't so he took our coffees of the bill.  Nice gesture....but, if I wanted steak tar tar I would have ordered it.   

Save your $$$ and time and seek out one of the other new midtown restaurants.  Where quality, ambiance, and service is abundantly available.

What an amazing addition to Midtown.  The service was amazing as well as the food.  

The Grilled Chicken Burrito was well made and very flavorable.  Try it out! 

We will be back.....
I have not been disappointed, yet!  Nice outdoor seating over the Truckee River adds a wonderful touch to the dinning experience.
This is still our favorite pizza in Reno.   Friendly atmosphere, relaxed feel, and just a nice addition to the local area.

A little bit outdated and in ill repair but it's a comfortable place to work out. 

The staff is far from polite or even courteous for that matter.  If you can learn to ignore them you will be okay here.
I have to give it to Deli Towne they make one heck of a great sandwich.  Just be advised you will pay a pretty penny for it.

First and foremost I am a true bakery enthusiast.  Being from Boston I guess one may get spoiled with fine bakeries.  

Unfortunately, I would rate any grocery store bakery as I would here.  I will be very surprised if they stay in business.

This would be our second visit here.  I do have to give them credit for a good burger.  

If you're looking for a healthy option this would not be your venue.  Good old fashion burger and fries.

I would strongly recommend staying away from the food here.  Very...very poor unpalatable food.  The service coincided with the food quility. 

We without doubt will NEVER return!  

You are safe trying their desert selection in front of the coffee shop, though.

Another new addition to Midtown.  This was our first try at The Bridges.  Casual dining with a mid level flare.  

The menu was fairly difficult to navigate due to all the items being printed together with no separation.  I took a picture to display the confusion.

The service was quite pleasant.  Due to the fact that they just opened I wanted to go safe with my food choices.  I had the Reuben on Rye.  My wife had the Salmon.  We also tried the "signature bleu cheese chips" as a starter.  

The food quality seemed very good although my wife felt her salmon dish was a bit bland.  

I'm sure we will visit again as they become a little more established.

Since my last review it would be unfair not to do a quick update.  

First and foremost I have to give credit when credit is due; the staff has improved ten fold in the last several months.  Of course there will always be one or two knuckle heads that annoy you but the rest of the staff is amazing.  

I wouldn't opt for any other gym in town!

I reside in the Midtown area and try to make it a point to only frequent the restaurants that are within this couple mile radius.  

I was first introduced to SUP several years ago and was quite impressed at that time.  I continued to return quite often and then found myself losing interest and comfort.  

Well, I finally returned on Friday with a party of ten for a nice outside non formal dinner of sandwiches and soup. The good old comfort food mom would make when she wasn't in the mood to cook.   

Now, I have no idea when a walk to the counter and order sandwhich shop could have grown to be so pretentious. This is about as casual as it gets for dining aside from a food truck.  Each and every moment we were there the staff became more and more agitated with the fact that we were still there and it was approaching closing time.   

Let's just get to the point;  we spent more than $200 for sandwiches and were supplied with the same boring food that never has changed on the menu and were treated like  a recently acquired illness that they couldn't wait to get rid of.

For fact....  No one in our party will ever return and we will all be happy to spread the word.  

Customer service is the number one killer of small business.  You may want to take heed to your practices and rein in your young children employees and remind them that you are just another small sandwhich shop in a small town.  We have observed many just like yours disappear over the years.  Think about it or someday you'll be one of those "remember that sandwhich place on Virginia St. What was the name of it"!

Do not waste your money here.  As you enter this blue collar bar the aroma of old frying oil permeates.  Sadly, the wings and pizza tasted just like the horrifying spoiled oil.  

Sorry, we will never return.  Poor quality, shady environment, and the pungent smell of rotting cooking oil!

This is my "go to" for a quick heathy dinner.  With over a 100 visits to this location I can honestly say I am always pleased.

As I walk in the door I am always welcomed by Sage.  She was amazing...not only did she remember my name from the beginning but she could place my order for me.  It truly saddens me to see she is no longer with The Laughing Planet.  

Employees like this are hard to find!  Sage made my family and I feel like we were coming home for dinner.  

Of course, we will continue to frequent The Laughing Planet but I would be remised if I did not mention Sage's amazing customer service skills that are so rare in this day and age.

I am not going into full detail, but our experience was absolutely perfect!

The food and service was top notch for a brewery environment!  We we will be back many times to come!

I just simply love the relaxed environment. I must be honest I am not the coffee drinker but my wife is.  I'm just tagging along when we are picking up pizza next door at "Wild Garlic".  

While we are waiting for our pizza to be prepared we often fill her coffee need and relax at one of their tables. 

There is a great relaxing vibe here.

We finally made to Sparks to try, which some have labeled the best pizza in town, Grimaldi's!  

We arrived a bit late in the evening to place an order "to go".  As with many businesses in town you get a little cold shoulder if they are approaching closing time....not here!

We were greeted with a friendly demeanor in addition to a full overview of the menu.  What a pleasant surprise.  

Our order was placed and very quickly made.  

Great pizza and a salad that would be considered top notch in a 5 star restaurant.  

Will we return?  With out doubt we shall try to make this a regular addition to or pizza rotation.  

Thank you for an overall great experience!

This was our first dining experience at The Sterling.  

Ambiance:  Nice relaxed subdued environment.  Very comforting.

Staff:  Exceptionally nice without an overkill of  "stiffness" that a lot of nicer steakhouses present. 

Food:  I would label the food quality as good not exceptional.  One of our disappointments was my wife's Filet was ordered medium well and was served raw.  By the time she received her properly cooked steak back at the table I was done eating.  No concession was offered or discount provided.  

Pricing:  Fairly affordable for a steakhouse.

We have dined at the Atlantis Steakhouse many times over the last several years the service and food was exceptionally good for Reno.  Sadly, our visit last evening was a night not to remember.  A very expensive Birthday dinner that left a sad face on my wife.   

The service remained the same, quite satisfying, I wish I could say the same for the food.  

1.  The escargot wasn't quite the same.  Lacking the usual essence of butter and garlic.

2.  The Filet Mignon's where flavorless and cold.  

3.  The shrimp scampi was a little "fishy" and also served cold.  

The bread basket was the highlight of our meal.  Honestly, that's pretty much all we ate.  

It saddens me to say...we will not return.

Great pizza accompanied by great service.  A nice thin crust filled with flavor.  The sauce is perfect.

I highly recommend giving them a try if you haven't already.

Wow, this use to be one of our Midtown favorites.  Not after last nights experience.  

1.  20 minutes to be seated.  No problem!

2.  No wait staff for the evening.  We finally had to grab, who seemed to be the manager, and kindly asked if we could place our order.  He was only willing to accept our appetizers for some reason.  Although, we wanted to place our order.  

3.  The food came to us in random spurts...most of which were wrong.  He just kept telling us most of it would be free.   

4.  After an hour and a half of this disaster we went and asked for our check.  We skipped our dessert and left very unhappily.  

5.  I would give the food quality 2 stars.  

In summary we will not return in the near future and maybe never for that matter.

The new management staff needs a replacement, badly.  So sad that this establishment has gone this far down hill.

Very well done Bistro Napa!  The service was simply amazing accompanied by an exceptional dinning experience.  

Without hesitation the chef customer tailored my Prime Rib to my craving of grilled and blackened with a nice Cajun spice.  

Thank you and we will return soon.

Amazing food and exceptionally amazing service.  The entire staff greats me by my first name the moment I walk in the front door.  

Being that I frequent Sup, as norm, twice a week I miss all the smiling faces and the nice homemade comfort food.  

We look forward to your return!!!

Nf3lx-t7Bb2aer_JTx05Ng.review_text: 5 stars for the view, 3 stars for the food. Muscles were good, lobster was not. Would go again and just order something else.
Best donuts in town!! Fresh and delicious. Great coffee too! They're a little pricey- but worth it.
Great service during this pandemic! Outdoor seating is organized really well. Warm heaters by each table for the evening. Their bahn mi flatbread is outstanding! Great cocktails as well.
Very sub par. Maybe I went there on a bad night- but definitely would not go back or recommend. Seems like low quality food at high prices. Would expect more from a restaurant in that location.

Such a great place in SB! They're doing a decent job with organizing tables during the pandemic. The heaters really help when it gets windy at night too. They've got a decent cocktail list- although I'd like to see it change up a bit. Their mahi mahi tacos are delicious and their Bavarian pretzel is a must. My only negative experience so far was their ceviche appetizer. It was a little jar with mostly pico de gaillo and avocados. There were maybe two bites of shrimp. Not worth it! 
Otherwise, I enjoy the variety of food they have and can't wait to go back and try something new!

As a local, I have seen how restaurants are handling things during COVID and I think this place needs to take some notes. 
The line to eat here or order food to go is unbelievably long all weekend. Everyone says the line is worth it, but not in my case. We went for the lobster rolls, which everyone else in line wanted to order as well. By the time we made it to the window they had already sold out of the lobster rolls. The amount of people they had to tell they were out of lobster was shocking. Each person who went up the the window after us in line asked for the same thing and got the same answer. How frustrating it must be for that girl to have to repeat herself to every customer that the lobster is out! They should have a sign to put up which announces they're out of the lobster, so people waiting in the line for hours don't have to change their order last second under pressure when they find out at the window they can't order the lobster. 
The wharf was so crowded, we decided to order our crab to-go. That was the first thing we told the gal at the window because she kept having to pack up the food as people decided last minute to change their orders for to-go. We decided on the crab, since lobster was out. Not cheap, which was fine because we will pay up for something like that with high expectations. What a disappointment. After our number was finally called, the food was not packed up in to-go boxes. It was set on plates for us to take to the picnic tables, which were so overcrowded and not cleaned. We reminded her we ordered the food to-go (This happened to the couple right before us too). She reluctantly packed it up for us. When we got home we unpacked everything and there were no onion rings, which were supposed to come with the crab meals. We quickly got over that because we were excited to have crab. Well, the crab was undercooked, almost raw. 
All in all, waste of money and waste of time. Do not recommend and will never go there again. 
Also I want to make clear that I cannot imagine how stressful that job is for the woman at the window right now. They were extremely understaffed (obviously due to Covid) and she had a lot to keep track of. A sign to put up when lobster is out would make her job a lot easier so she wouldn't have to explain to every hopefully customer that they can't get lobster rolls. 
The wharf clearly has no restrictions put in place right now for Covid so I would stay away from that area if I were you.

Such a lovely spot, especially when they have a live acoustic guitarist! 
The spinach soup with goat cheese was spectacular. Cocktails way over priced, but that's the kind of place this is (fancy) 
Views amazing, will definitely return.
So good! Amazing appetizers, great atmosphere and service! Everything on this menu is delicious

One of (if not THE) best restaurants in Santa Barbara. We went here for a birthday celebration and they had a nice greeting card at the table when we arrived. 
The staff were clearly professionally trained. Every  server in SB should go to Loquita to be trained because this was the best staff I've ever been served by. 
Our waitress, Emily, was so kind and made the experience even better!
Everything smelled amazing and if I had gone with a big enough appetite (and paycheck), I would've had more tapas. The Pulpo was amazing.
We ordered the Mar y Tierra Short Rib Paella, which is newer to their menu, and I hope they never get rid of it! I can see myself ordering this paella for dinner once a week. 

The women's bathroom was nice and clean. The outdoor patio was kept very cozy and warm, when it was 50 degrees out. So nice! Definitely check out their wine list, lots of fun Spanish wines!

The only downside is the prices, but everything is worth it. Exceptional dishes. I cannot wait to go back!
Wonderful service, great atmosphere, fantastic food! The chips and salsa they give you are so good and the churros for dessert are delicious. Can't wait to go back!

Love the new location! The inside is decorated sooo nicely and gives the best brunch ambiance! 
We went right after they opened on Sunday and we barely got a table. We were able to bring our dog which was great! 
Our server, Vivian, was amazing! She was the nicest, most out going and funny waitress. 
She sold us on everything on the menu, and we can't wait to go back to try more. 

The only thing that would be nice is to have a bigger bathroom because the line was long the whole time we were there.

Love the new location!! We got lucky and sat outside which was lots of fun. The food was fantastic. The swordfish and the pork shoulder carnitas were both delicious. 
The cocktails were nice and the appetizer that they gave us when we sat down was interesting. It would be nice if they had a few more appetizer options but the rest of the menu was great

So disappointing. It's always very crowded and understaffed, so much so that the bussers don't get to cleaning the tables off in time for someone to sit down.  
We ordered the Bavarian pretzel and a brat. The brat took 30 min to come out and after over an hour of waiting for the pretzel, I had to waive down a waitress to let her know. Finally the pretzel came out and it was hard as rock. It was like eating those giant Snyder sourdough pretzels that break your jaw. 
For the cost of food there, it was totally not worth it.
Super expensive, but very cute and I'm glad to have a nice new spot on state street that is clean and good.
Sadly overrated. The impossible burger was so bland.

NhslY28yax0FFL04moJmXw.review_text:
A sophisticated treat! Delizioso!

This is as authentic an Italian Gelato Cafe as you can find on this side of the Atlantic. We met the owners who are from Italy and they have gone to great lengths to provide absolutely authentic Italian treats. Their gelato is made from fresh ingredients - daily! That means when they run out, they run out. No time to make more until tomorrow. If you're not familiar with real, fresh gelato, imagine a smoother, richer, yet somehow lighter version of your favorite ice cream. 

But you'll need to make more than one trip to savor all these fabulous flavors. I highly recommend trying a Gnutella crepe. It's big enough to share and unlike anything I've had before. They make their crepes fresh right before your eyes (crepes are like super thin and fluffy pancakes) then they spread a a rich chocolate over top. The chocolate has the consistency of peanut butter, but it's flavored with hazelnuts. Topped with whipped cream - why not just skip dinner!

Last but not least is their coffee bar - again completely authentic. I think I saw Illy's beans near the espresso machine. You must try a shot of espresso poured over top of your favorite gelato flavor. A coffee-lovers dream in a cup.

Our family favorite! 

We have to eat here at least once a month. It's the type of place where everyone has a favorite menu item - and they're all different. The owners are a lovely family from Sicily via New Jersey - totally authentic. 

The menu is extensive - salads, pasta with probably a dozen different sauces, fresh bread, and the best thin-crust pizza I can find in Tampa. One of our favorites is vodka sauce over penne. Trust me, just try it. It's one of their specialties for good reason.

The interior  is a typical New York-style pizzeria. Brightly lit, clean, metal tables and chairs, paper plates and napkins - you're there for the fabulous food, not ambiance. Again - very family friendly and affordable. Dine in or take out. No delivery.

Outstanding! Not your typical Chinese restaurant. 

Everything is fresh. Meats and vegetables are fresh and are high quality. Wait staff are polite and nicely attired. Not something typically found in a Chinese-Asian style restaurant.

The menu has many of your typical Americanized Chinese dishes. But more importantly are the fresh and unique flavors like their light and fresh lettuce chicken wraps as an appetizer or a light meal. Or try the black pepper or Thai basil leaves flavors over your preferred meat. Fresh, light, and original.

Uninspired.

After ready the other positive reviews I'm starting to think maybe we just had one bad experience. The food was, well, nothing special. The meats were overcooked, dry. I'd rather go to Bonefish one parking lot over - fresher foods, similar prices. And the desserts weren't worth the calories so we walked down the street to 365 Caffe Italiano (see my review).

The interior was nice though. If you're looking for a dark place for a cocktail, then you're probably safe.

We visited Wiregrass to eat at Pagelli's and realized it changed names. Apparently they changed everything except the Italian theme. The menu is much more limited and shockingly expensive for what you get. Nothing we ordered was particularly unique, inspired, or interesting. For a family of five and no alcohol I spent $150 with tip. I don't mind splurging for a great family meal, but there was nothing great about this. Oh yeah - and they took all the veal off the menu.

Wow! Just wow! This is the real deal folks. Delicious and creative dishes, excellent portions and reasonable prices. They even have easy-access free parking, which is rare for being so close to the hip downtown West Chester scene.

I had beef barbacoa which was generous and tasty. My buddy tried some soft tacos with cactus! That was new for both of us. Very tasty. They even had Pepsi and Coke in the long-neck bottles, which just taste better to me.

We've been here twice in the last three weeks and the food has been incredible both times! The Vaca Frita (shredded flank steak, onions, garlic) is AWESOME! My mouth is watering again just thinking about it. It's so beefy and flavorful. Highly recommended. Our family of five has enjoyed a little bit of everything - chicken and yellow rice, falling-off-the-bone tender and super flavorful. Roasted pork - juicy and savory. Shredded beef - a little sweeter than the Vaca Frita but fork-tender and juicy. And the sides are perfect compliments. Try the tostones - flattened fried green plantains, kind of like a fried potato pancake but crispier. And the fried sweet plantains are excellent - not like the frozen kind from the supermarket! 

The setting is very casual and family friendly. The sodas are self-serve and refills are free. The prices are also very reasonable for a sit-down dinner of this quality. I can't wait to try them for lunch. Highly recommended!

Excellent food. Excellent service. Hard to believe a restaurant of this high quality is a chain. Enjoyed the Kona-crusted sirloin. Perfectly cooked. Nice thick cut. Juicy and delicious. An excellent restaurant for special occasions. Pricey.

Best for the tradition, architecture, history, authentic Spanish decor, and a real "taste of Tampa." Ideal for special occasions. But if you are looking for fantastic food, I think there is better in Ybor. (The Bricks of Ybor and Tampa Bay Brewing)

Fish tacos! Fish tacos! FISH TACOS!  I honestly don't know about anything else on this menu. I order the same thing every time. I took my wife who can be a little fussy. She thought she only liked beef tacos. She was blown away. Super fresh flavors. Messy and delicious. Worth the stop.

Wow wow wow. We were NOT expecting this! My wife enjoyed dinner here on a Saturday evening. This is a three star environment with four star food. And the four star food is at three star prices. If you want super fancy views or stuffy ambiance, to go Armani's overlooking the bay or Berns. If you an amazing meal, try this place.

We both enjoyed a spectacular salad with fresh beats and goat cheese topped with the best toasted proscuitto I've ever had. Excellent salty-sweet-savory. She had an excellent piece of fish and I had a mouth-watering ribeye with a cognac-truffle sauce on the side that was absolutely fantastic. Maybe the most flavorful steak I've ever had. You can get bigger cuts of meat. You can get fancier environments. But seriously, this was an amazingly delicious meal!
We've been going here for years now and we are amazed that we've never had a bad dish or experience. Very impressive. Highly recommended!

Still my New Tampa favorite - even after all these years!

I grew up in the northeast. Pizza is EVERYWHERE. And it comes in all shapes, sizes, thicknesses, etc. Like so many foods, there is no "best pizza" for everyone. But there are *great* pizzas and pizza places. This is one of them. Pizza Mania serves traditional NY-style thin crust pizza. When I want a more traditional family-owned style of pizza instead of the big commercial stuff, this is where I go. You can dine in or take out. No delivery. And yes, it's worth the drive.

I could right a book about all the different things on the menu. Instead, I'll just say that I love their food. I appreciate the family-owned style. And after many years I'm still a very happy customer. I just got *several* whole pies for my birthday and my teenage boys have devoured ALL of it.

Enjoy!

Excellent Mexican food at reasonable prices. My table of four absolutely loved this place. The pork carnitas and shredded beef were flavorful and most. The pork tamales were filled with the carnitas meat and were generous in size. And the salsa was fresh - one hot, one sweet. On a Sunday evening at dinner time we had to wait about 20 minutes for a table but it was worth it. We'll definitely be back!

"Finally something I can't make at home!" That's what my wife said after our excellent chicken dinners at Yah Mon last Saturday. We visited rather early so our service from owner Andre and his wife was very personal and attentive. It's pretty obvious that the this is their own endeavor and they are passionate about giving their customers a great experience. Super friendly. 

I highly recommend the Caribbean chicken platter. It comes with three different BOLD flavors - curry, jerk, and a "stew" that I've never had before. The chicken stew was in a savory brown sauce that flavored the meat so deeply I first thought it was roast beef! Spectacular. It comes with a generous bowl of red beans and rice, salad, grilled plantains, and a nice little piece of fried cornbread. And all at a very reasonable price.

Can't wait to go back. Highly recommended.

Been here several times. Menu is always changing with the local ingredient options. Three of us had very different things - fish, chicken, beef. All excellent. My wife and I took her mother and she really enjoyed it. A great place for either a slightly upscale casual or even a more romantic event.

Eclectic - the menu, the art, the clientele - just very cool. We've been here many times but recently took a group of teenagers. Everyone loved it. The menu has everything from casual appetizers to delicious locally grown main courses. There's a bit of a hipster, trendy vibe to the place - super fun for groups and a casual outing. But a bit loud if you are looking for something romantic and cozy.

We sat upstairs next to a large group - probably at least 20. Parties would be fun here.

Just delicious! I've driven by this strip mall a hundred times and never knew this yummy little place was tucked in there. My wife and I enjoyed two flavorful meals at very reasonable prices. We particularly enjoyed talking to the wife-husband team who own and run the establishment. We swapped hummus-making tips. They were just lovely.

Oh wow! What a gem. Very small inside, maybe six or eight tables. I was actually a little surprised. But the gentleman and son who run the place were very nice. And the food? Spectacular! I always love a small menu with a handful of amazing things than pages and pages of meh. They made me the best Cuban I've ever had. The meat. Wow. The meat was the difference. Anyone can press sliced deli cuts into Cuban bread. But what they put inside was just heaven. My wife's chicken noodle soup was also made from scratch and would make any grandma proud. Can't wait to go back!
Yep. Still my go-to for fish tacos. Been enjoying them for years. No idea what else is on the menu because I always get the same delicious thing.

Still one of our favorites. We do our best to mix up our dining all over Tampa. This is the restaurant we have visited more than any other. In 13 years we have always had "wow" food here. This last time even the service blew us away. The wait staff and and manager were incredibly helpful, patient, and courteous. My grouper and my wife's salmon were absolutely amazing. My friend had the short ribs that I've tried before and he said they were melting in his mouth, just as a I said they would. We'll be returning very soon!

Just visited during the Gasparilla festival. The brisket was excellent - properly moist. Not wet. Not shoe leather dry. Just right. Nice sauce options on the tables. Tasty sides, particularly the baked beans. I think they mixed in a little pork to jack up the flavor. We'll definitely be back!

The reviews don't lie. This is a must-visit seafood restaurant if you are anywhere near the Tarpon Springs sponge docks. Listen to this - they have their own fishing boats! Who has their own boats? To get seafood any fresher you'll have to catch it yourself. We tried three of their many fresh specials - fried grouper sandwich, blackened grouper tacos, and peel and eat gulf shrimp. Everything was fabulous and we can't wait to go back.

NuEST2287F_qyCQMhVQDtg.review_text: My vegetarian pasta was very bland, but my boyfriend didn't complain about the steak. The service was not great as the waiters took a very long time to follow through with our requests. However, the venue is nice! It was a fine place for dinner that night in downtown Santa Barbara.

The decor is very nice and relaxing--reminiscent of Hawaii. And my portobello mushroom burger was so good! It's hard to find good vegetarian substitutes but I really liked this one. The restaurant itself is a good, casual place to grab a bite to eat, nothing fancy.

This is definitely my favorite place on state st (besides McConnell's ice cream--of course, this is an entirely different restaurant.) It's very nice and beautiful outdoors. The servers were so friendly and the food was delicious, though perhaps a little overpriced. Overall, it was a very nice restaurant for a night out and I would definitely recommend trying it out.
Pickles & Swiss is, by far, my favorite place to grab a sandwich in town! The staff is so friendly and accommodating. More importantly, the food is to die for. I completely recommend it!

I've been twice now and so very pleased both times! Good Indian food is hard to find around Santa Barbara (especially in Isla Vista), so for me, it is definitely worth the trip. The atmosphere is relaxing and authentic, too. It's a great experience!

Mexican food is my favorite type and I normally like everything and anything I get, so I suppose I had high expectations. Los Agaves was good, but not great; I was slightly disappointed by the bland, dry chicken in my meal. The salsas were delicious, though, and definitely improved the plate. 
The restaurant itself is very nice with pretty outdoor seating and decor!

I had high expectations since everyone I talk to loves this place, but I was disappointed. My tacos were kind of bland. Maybe I ordered wrong, but the menu doesn't have that many options so I think I was getting what everyone else gets. It was an okay meal to me, but I won't go again.

Amazing. I go here all the time. Let's just say I have dreams about their mouth-watering portobello mushroom sandwich. 
The place is healthy, affordable, and delicious! Enough said. Check it out.
I always go here with my Mom when she comes to town. We love it! The beignets are melt-in-your-mouth exquisite. We've been overjoyed with every other plate we've ordered, as well.
I absolutely love the massaman curry here so I've been back to get it twice. The staff is so friendly and the place is nice and clean. No complaints!
The hummus is to die for. Everyone in my party of four was super satisfied. It's got a nice location and atmosphere, as well.
The food is pretty overpriced and not very high quality, but what can you expect? The bowling and atmosphere is obviously super fun, though!

Great service, great food, great location. It's also the only reasonably priced place downtown Santa Barbara. It's not so much a nice sitdown place, though--just so you know. It's a fun, counter-service, relaxed, quick bite to eat sorta place.
Amazing food and very nice service. I'd recommend the grilled beef vermicelli, but I'm sure you can't go wrong with anything! My boyfriend really likes the pho tai.

I don't like giving bad reviews--especially when the restaurant has such nice service--but the food was subpar and overpriced. My blueberry pancakes were just regular pancakes with three blueberries placed on top; and they cost a dollar more. My egg order came wrong. Nobody in my party was satisfied. Overall, the food was probably below ihop standard--but actually more expensive. It is a cute little place, though. And to be fair, we only went for breakfast so I can't speak for the lunch or dinner menu.

The boba and milk tea are bomb. I found a lot of the things on the menu looked questionable, but when my boyfriend and I ventured out, we found that we really liked the interesting-looking meals! I'd say you have to give this place a try. It's fun and new. Oh, and the service is spectacular! They have a very fun and upbeat staff :)

Spudnuts is only okay; the donuts are acceptable but overpriced. ​I didn't find the selection to be very impressive. But hey, it's hard to go wrong with donuts.

The only other complaint I have is about the service. As a college student, I needed quarters for my building's laundry machine so I decided to buy like three dollars worth of donuts, give the worker a five dollar bill, and get my change back in quarters. The worker would only give me two quarters back, though (the rest in a bill and other change.) I don't know why--he couldn't be bothered to give me an explanation or heed my request even when I asked twice.

I LOVE MCCONNELL'S! And I've never met anyone who doesn't! I probably shouldn't post this review because I don't want it getting any more​ popular, haha--the line is already always out the door--but I have to give credit where it's due. 

The hot, made-to-order waffle cones are superb. Add two flavors of ice cream (which you get in just the "single" scoop) and you've got yourself a bit of heaven. My favorites are the double peanut butter chip and any of the sea salt/caramel flavors, but you really, REALLY can't go wrong. It's simply the creamiest ice cream I've ever had. Oh, and it's all natural ingredients that you won't feel bad about eating. You've got to get McConnell's when you visit downtown SB.

We loved the location right by the ocean, loved the outdoor seating, and loved the service! The only thing that was slightly less than ideal was the variety of menu options, but we still found something we absolutely loved! It's a very romantic and relaxing venue -- would definitely recommend for a date night!

My fajitas were amazing and my boyfriend's burrito was just as good! We loved the venue right on State Street. The outdoor decor was nice, relaxing, and pretty. The menu's options were quite varied and comprehensive. I'd be surprised if there weren't something for everyone here!

I love love love the choco peanutty milkshake with boba here--so much, in fact, that every time I go back to iv or drive through, I stop to get one! I think their food is great, too, and the staff is so personable and friendly!! It was definitely my favorite late-night snack spot in iv by far.

It's hard to find a good veggie sandwich as a vegetarian but, let me tell you, I found one at south coast deli! I love their south coast veggie. It's also super nice to see such a big selection of vegetarian and pescatarian choices! So I'm sure with meat all their other subs can't be anything but delicious as well. This was definitely a go-to in iv for me.

OGxTI5DMFWrPWp65_wHWGQ.review_text:
Attention Business Owner,
I first tried your restaurant, Cheba Hut in Tucson, about a month ago and thought it was fun, quirky, quick and tasty. I liked it enough to recommend it to others. Which is why it was stunning to have the complete opposite experience today. Bad customer service takes some of the good taste from food. The general manager, who says he is your brother provided by far the worst CS experience I have had in a while (talking over me, correcting me, etc). Even the employee we were calling about wasn't as bad as this guy. You are located adjacent to our university and as such should represent yourself and our city better. I don't plan to return to this location but hope you'll make the needed adjustments to improve the customer's experience.

Saturday afternoon lunch buffet was amazing! It was like eating a home cooked meal. Truly authentic Mexican food. The place was nearly deserted, which made it all the more relaxing. Well worth $8 a person. Planning to try the breakfast buffet next!

The pierogi, both the potato and cheese and the beef were very good though would have been better if they were a bit more hot. The sour cream was really nice and if it isn't homemade you would never be able to tell. The Reuben sandwich was terrific. The quality of the corned beef was better than most I have had in Tucson. Also tried the cheesecake. It wasn't very sweet but creamy and rich. Additionally, the service was impeccable and the decor delightful. Visited because I had a Livingsocial voucher, will return to try the cabbage rolls and Hunters stew.

Really, really yummy! First time having gelato and it was awesome. So rich and creamy! Their flavors are interesting, we had a cup of chocolate caramel sea salt and a cup with Mexican coffee and Stracciatella (a kind if sweet cream w/chocolate chunks) side by side. Delicious! The store was very clean and pleasant and the service was excellent too. Oh and they had butcher paper and crayons as a lovely distraction. Definitely returning to try another flavor!

So good I want to live here! Barbacoa is ridiculously tender and rich. Try it with a bit of pico or guacamole sauce. We had a pirata taco too, yum, with beef fajita meat, beans and cheese. The tacos may seem small, especially for a big guy like my hubby, but the flavor is completely worth the price. I'm so pleasantly surprised with El Taco Tote!

First-timers, we checked out this joint because we had a livingsocial voucher. Altogether we tried the from hell panini, the american psycho cold sub and slices of copycat and bone collector. The 'from hell' was perfectly grilled on the outside and flavorful, rich and creamy on the inside. The american was equally tasty. A really nice balance of meats and toppings. Both sandwiches had the perfect amount of heat. We all devoured these before I could think to snap a photo. 
The pizza slices were beautifully presented. Real attention to craft shown here. The copycat was surprising. Everything worked together to make each bite delicious. Definitely going to buy a whole pie of this one in the future. The bone collector was the one I tried last and I think I was getting, like really full because it seemed a tiny bit salty. Still terrific. The pizza is a little oily but not a turn off, just different and good. Facility was clean and staff friendly. Will return.

Great service! Our son couldn't sit in the bar(too young) so the manager moved chairs for us to have a nice spot by the games. The server, Tiffany was awesome. Never forgot about us and was very sweet and charming. The wings were just the right heat, so messy though. Black cherry mojito was yummy too!

Very nice! We shared the Mahi Mahi w cilantro jalapeño hummus and the Kafta burger. The fish was good not great, it is Tucson after all. The hummus was nice and fairly mild, reminiscent of guacamole. An abundance of paprika was attractive but just slightly overpowering. As for the burger, one word, yum! Definitely worth a try, or two! The hearty wheat bun is juxtaposed with a soft patty of beef mixed with lots of other flavorful stuff. 
The service was exemplary. Our server Ivy had perfect timing! Next will drop by and try out the happy hour specials w a glass of wine, or two ;)

Delicious! Authentic New Mexican fare with generous portions. The chips and salsa (seriously, could eat a bucket of this salsa) combined with the quirky and positively endearing waitstaff will hook you from the get go. These folks know how to feed you! Today we had green chili pork stew, preceded by a dish of red chili beef with cheese. The stew is very flavorful. The pork is moist and the potato perfectly cooked. This served with big flour tortillas! 
The red chili beef with cheese was our servers selection, and a good one. Rich and meaty. 
Fair warning it is a small place and very popular. Come prepared to wait. Then relax and get fed like you're at your mom's house.

We shared Mousaka with an Angus / Béchamel sauce and a flaming Saganaki burger. The subtle flavor of nutmeg in the Mousaka was quite nice. I feel the vegetarian might have been better as the meat sauce was kind of generic. It definitely could have been warmer. The burger had a good flavor but was a little overcooked and the fries were cold. The pita was very soft and nice.
Sadly, the service was incredibly bad. My fella says we won't return. I'm on the fence, I think they have potential. Just need to tighten things up.

Pulled pork with hot BBQ sauce was pretty darn good. A previous review had me worried but it was actually well seasoned and had a nice consistency, not too wet, not too dry. The sweetness of the sauce was satisfying. A side of potato salad with purple onion complimented the meat nicely. We also shared a sliced brisket sandwich,'Carolina style', topped with cole slaw. This was tasty too but my guy thought it a little dry and there definitely could have been more slaw. The only real problem with these dishes was the portion size. They weren't tiny by any means however the prices were a little bit high for the portions. Except the cheese fries! $5 buys a big old basket of salty ridiculousness. Very fine with a cold glass of beer. Good service too!

So tasty ate every bite! Had the curry beef and jerk chicken, both very delicious. The jerk had a nice spice, not too much or too little. Lots of small bones so be careful. The plantains were amazing! A lot like sweet potato. Wish there had been a bit more. Next time will order these as an app! Paid just a little too much though. Will go back during the lunch special.

Drove over from the Eastside, it was completely worth it! We decided to check it out because they generously give away a free bday sub, no coupon needed. We got the Kings Hawaiian pork and slaw. It was fantastic. A perfect ratio of meat to slaw on a super pillowy roll. We also bought the Brisket and Cheddar and the NY Steamer which is corned beef and pastrami. Both of these were amazing. All had an ample amount of meat, which made my hubby very happy.The facility was very clean and bright and the cashier sweet, competent and quick. I really hope someone opens a Firehouse subs on my side of town but in the meantime we will take the occasional 'road trip'. Yes, it is that good! Oh, and can't wait to try the under 500 cal menu, looks great! :)

I try not to leave a bad review. If I dont like it I just don't return. That being said, I laid out $11.50 for this plate and was really disappointed. Ordered the #3 combo cheese enchilada and relleno. The enchilada was okay. Not very thick so all the cheese dripped out when I cut it. The beans and rice were basic. Excellent quality and service. Tried the pastrami Rueben, so good! Clean and mellow eating in. Hope for an East Tucson location soon!
