 For starters, I ordered water no ice! And surely she bought me water with tones of ice! Ok no problem I will just let her know I wanted water no ice.. Ok moving.. on then I order a dinner ceasar salad with no chicken.. easy peazy right?? Wrong!! The waitress kept asking me if I wanted a small side salad... ok nooooo... I want the dinner salad. She then ask me again do you want the dinner salad.. okkkkk noooo.. I want THIS salad that I keep pointing toooo!! She then ask me do you want a side salad..OMG!! seriously??? Finally my says she wants the dinner salad..she then says ok.. moving on.. she bought us bread..wait.. she bought us a hard stone that was supposed to be bread. I asked for some warm fresh bread and she says ok.. cause this has been back there for a while.. OMG!!!! seriously?? Did she just say that?? Ok SEVERAL mins on top of SEVERAL mins went by and still no bread or food!! Now if they were  busy or slammed I would understand.. nope 8 ppl in the restaurant total.
 Ok now I talked with the manager and she says ok I will get you some bread.. nothing..nothing.. nothing..you got to be kidding me.. then she brings bread. Now we have been sitting here for mmmm.. about 55 mins.. NO JOKE!
 Now I may not have been as flabbergasted as I was had 2 tables that came wayyyy after us sat down and was served wayyyy before us..
 Finally, our food came! Yah!! Uhh hold it.. this is not what we ordered!!!!!!! It's was not our food!! Now I'm thinking we must be on the show "what would you do?" Hmmmm?? #$%^&&^%.. Ok im back..lol.. after this hour and 45 min fiasco we finally got OUR food. The manager gave us a new server, apologied, gave us a free desert and took everything off our bill.
 Shaking my head!

Pretty good! Met a freind here and it was a first for the both of us.
 I ordered the build your own pizza so I have the pesto tomatoe sauce with veggies.. black olives..red peppers and spinach..delicious!! again delicious! I also had the ceasar salad and it too was good. Fresh lettuce and croutons.
 My server was a young man who was very patient and tentative to our need and wants (biggie to me) a few minor mishaps but they were corrected immediately. For the most part the atmosphere was a little loud and that could be that's it's a kid and family friendly restaurant so there's bound to be some loud talking and laughing. 
 Ample parking and outdoor seating and there are other shops above the restaurant that you can visit. There's also a walking track near by, parks and other resturants so jacamos is in a great location and easy to find.
   Hope this helps..
Love love love me some TEAvana.. I live the oolong teas and the berry teas! Ben will educate you on all the teas and blends! I had a berry blend tea on ice with honey.. yum yum!

This was my first time having Koren food and it was my first time being at mama's. The food was very different for me yet it was very filling. I ordered a Bi Bim Bop salad and my guest  ordered  fried vegetables and rice. Our order came with a lot of other small beaker suze dishes of food which was very surprising to us because there was about eight dishes on top of the large portions we ordered. There was lots of food and we were very full before we even got halfway through all the food. The service was great our waiter couldn't speak a lot of English so he went and got the manager who spoke English and he took care of us.
 Price pretty well I think we spent about $40 that was including all the food we had and drinks not bad. The restaurant sits in a plaza. The signs are fairly big so you can see the restaurant and they have ample parking. 
 When our bill came I noticed there was an appetizer on our bill that we didn't order it was about $15 so I asked our waiter why was this on our bill we didn't order this. No problem he immediately took it off our bill without any fuss or questions which I thought was great. For the most part it's a pretty good restaurant to eat at the only drawback for me was it's  very smoky even though  they have the vents it's still very smoky for me when they bring out the sizzling Foods other than that it's a pretty good Korean restaurant and I think I will visit again and refer.

This is a pretty good place to go if you like Italian food the service is great the Ambiance is beautiful dim lights and not too loud.
 When I visit here I had the antipasto salad and warm cheesy bread my favorite I always seem to get this when I go to this restaurant this is why I like going with other so I can taste their food.. lol lol.. plus their portions are family style and other than everything else is ala carte so it pays to go with someone else..just saying..lol
 The the portions are huge you'll definitely get your money's worth here they have all things Italian Caprese salad or great also hope this helps enjoy!!

Looking for a really good buyer place with a variety of burgers? Red Robin is your go to place.
 Bacon burgers..cheese burgers..guacamole burgers..any burgeryou can think of Red Robin can make it. 
I have a regular double cheese burger and bottomless fries! Talk about delish and full! Lots of parking.

Met a client today at the cheesecake factory. We had a  really good experience and the food was beautifully prepared. The portions are huge and the cost is inexpensive.
 As many times as I've been here I always seem to get the same thing (the chicken little fingers with mashed potatoes) my favorite.. cheese... but today I decided to try the chicken quesadillias lunch portion.
 Fresh hot and huge. It came with guacamole and sour cream. I also had the mini crab cakes (4 tiny cake balls) which was pretty good as well and of course the warm bread and butter. Now don't eat too much before your meal comes because you may not have room left in your tummy.
 All in all this place is super cool the Ambiance is warm and cozy at the same time. The waitstaff are friendly and pleasant. Parking is ample and there are lots of stores to visit while your in the are connected to the Cheesecake factory. They also have the best cheese cake hands down to me. You just have to have some cheese cake when you visit and they have LOTS to choose from. From double chocolate to vanilla bean you are sure to be pleased. I most likely the strawberry cheese cake when in season. The turtle Cheesecake and the triple coco cake! With some milk!! Ooowha weee!!! Stop the madness!!
 One last thing.. the rest rooms are clean. This is another biggie for me because if the restrooms are clean it makes me believe the Kitchen is just as clean as well.. just saying..
 Hope this helps!

Quick healty bite to eat while your shopping or passing through the mall. Freshly made salads and wraps along with smoothies! I had the chicken wrap and it was pretty delish.. fresh crisp pickle for a added touch. Lots of parking space. I would suggest parking near Dick's that way your closer to the food court and Freshway... Enjoy!

Pretty cool place to visit!.. We had girls night out for a friend's b-day here. It was really nice! The attention and service we received was awesome! We had the opportunity to sample about 6 different flavors of wine. We also learned about how wines are made and where they come from. We were able to taste some peach sangria.. my favorite!! This was a very informative wine tasting experience for me because I don't know alot about wines so the time spent here was worth it! For more reasons than one.. wink wink!
Parking was kinda small. 
 They also have lots of wines and bottle openers for sale. All in all this was a pretty cool place to visit, purchase wine and sample some of the best wines offered.
 Hope this helps..Enjoy!

I just love the sign that says "Immediate  seating" this let's you know that there's no waiting  for a seat. Pretty good service along with the food!. I love the croissants that comes with the house salad. I always get 2 ;) I also like the baked chicken and mashed potatoes and for you steak lovers.. this is the place to have a gooood juicy steak!

You have to try this place for there biscuits and gravy! Oatmeal and pancakes. I'm talking mmmm mmm
Good.. this place can get crowded sometimes there can be a wait but it's worth it. They bring out a carafe of coffee and water. My friend had the egg skillet and it was delish also.. cheesy..eggs.. potatoes and veggies. How can a person go wrong!

Cheesy greasy deli.. who doesn't love a greasy breakfast every once in a while..lol.lol I sure do!  and this place has its fair share of greasy potatoes, huge pancakes and cheesey grits. Don't expect anything top of the line here. You get what you pay for and for a $7.00 quick greasy breakfast the service is just that. This diner has been open for some years now and people keep coming and it gets crowded early in the mornings and they run out of food at times which tells me. Im not the only one who likes a cheesey diner every now and then.

I know and love some soul food but this place just hasn't hit the mark.
 For starters we ordered fried chichen and baked chicken corn fried corn bread yams greens and sweet tea. Ummm.. ok so the fried chicken didn't taste fresh and for the 20 mins total wait time it should have been. The baked chicken tasted like it had been baked days ago and left on the counter for 2 more days.. the greens were over cooked and the yams tastes like they were poured from the can and boiled. The wait is long on Sundays so don't expect to get in quickly. The Locations pretty good close to other resturants and ample parking along with other resturants and stores close by. The staff.. well our waitress was your ordinary waitress (no extras on her end) until we asked for a to go box.. I though I had just been suckered punched!  Her whole personality  changed! She harshly and loudly said to us "U can't take no food out..huh? She said you gotta pay for it.. huh?? I'm paying for my meal this is just my leftovers.. nope! She said.. you got a pay to take out Leftovers! I was waiting on her to laugh and say.. "I'm just playin" NOPE! she didn't she just looked at me with her hands on her hips.. waiting on me to either pay or she takes the food. I told her nooooope! We don't want the food to go. I just shook my head I've never seen this before.

Panera bread  is a great place to have a small meeting with 2-4 people The food is delicious and they have catering, a variety of different juices (I always mix 3 different  juices together but that's just me) and free WiFi!  The food is delicious from sandwiches to Coffee to pastries. They also have a rewards card where you can get bonuses and birthday prizes. You can order online and  the restrooms are clean (yeah that's what biggie to me) and the pastries are delicious!! The staff is very attentive.  If you are a bike rider there is a place to park your bike and plenty of parking with restaurants and shopping with walking distance.

This is one of the coolest cozy spots in broadripple. It's a garage turned into a cool resturant. Here's a few reasons why I like this place. There's plenty of seating, you can bring your pouch with you and sit out side and have lunch, they raise the garage door open on really nice days, they grow alot of the veggies that they use and the decor is just darn relaxing! I love the chandeliers so classy! The employees make you feel like you've been friends for ever! You have to check this place out. The only small (and I do mean small) drawback is that it's a little hard to find but there's nothing wrong with hidden gems! It's kinda hidden behind other shops but it's worth looking for. And lastly  it's just a hair off the monon. So you can eat then take a walk.. or walk then have lunch. Hope you take time to check out this cool place. They also have Saturday and Sunday brunch. There a different menu on the weekends.

I spent a few hours at the Starbucks the other day doing some work on the computer (sometimes you just have a different scenery) I noticed that this Starbucks is a neighborhood Starbucks pretty much the people that came in  know the employees. Me personally I'm not a huge Starbucks fan I don't drink a lot of coffee but the atmosphere is so calming and soothing and the smell of the coffee in the teas and pastries are somewhat relaxing. So what The Fall season they have all these new and  different coffee mixes for The Fall season that customers  are flocking in to get. 
 I decided to try the iced caramel macchiato with pumpkin sauce instead of vanilla let me tell you it was an acquired taste very different yet delicious.
 You can earn Starbucks rewards and have a Starbucks account and you can purchase really cool glasses and cups. They have an online store where you can purchase items and coffees of all different flavors.
 The holidays are coming soon so there will be all kinds of  gifts to purchase friends and family.
Although I'm not a coffee drinker I do love the Starbucks atmosphere.

A friend of mine asked me to meet her at Bob Evans on Shadeland. As I was walking to my table a waitress jumped in front of me and said what do you want to drink. I looked around because I couldn't figure out if she was talking to me or someone else so I proceeded to pass her and she says again what do you want to drink. I turned around I turned around and said HELLO! how are you doing? She says I'm fine.. I'll have water.. Thank you. Now I've had messy service before but I have to say this one takes the cake. For starters we placed our order.  When our food came (20 minutes later and I do mean 20 minutes later). We hadn't  received bread, we didn't receive any water we just received our food 20 minutes later. Now, I get if it was busy and the cooks were overwhelmed. Nope!! there were only a  few people in the restaurant! (Like 3 tables)
 When our food came out it was not what we ordered wait maybe I should say when my friends food came out it was not what she ordered nor expected it to be. Now my food came out about 3 minutes after hers so now I'm at 23 minutes just for a salad (not a steak not fish not a special Grill item, not a roast just a simple salad!!).
 So we asked the waitress about the order that wasn't ours and when would mine come out and she said let me go check that was her famous line during the time she was serving us. I don't know "let me go check" let me see "I'll go check" you want more bread? "Let me go check".. but we never saw her until 10 mins later.

 Then my friend asked where's my honey where's my muffin where's my dressing and you know the saying "I don't know let me go check".
 I kid you not another 10 minutes went by. She finally came back with just the muffin I was every bit of finish with her service at this point!!

  I just think that nowadays some businesses don't take customer service seriously anymore!
 Customer service to me is huge..a biggie!! it does 3 things for me.
 #1 It makes me do better in my business.
 #2 it allows  me the opportunity to do a Yelp review hoping that the owners of the business would see/realize why their businesses go down the drain. 
#3 I can let others know the experience I had when I visited. The menu has "slim down" so much that my friend ordered three different meals because they didn't carry this or we are out of that. JEEPERS!!

 To top it off one of the employees started sweeping the floor right next to us which caused  dust to flare up while we were trying to eat the cold food that was brought out to us.
 Poor customer service leads to closed businesses. Consumers are not going to spend their hard-earned dollars on poor customer service! you can get that free you don't have to spend money and a tip for poor customer service!!

QM2u8M-hJi9-k-mOVKrEAw.review_text:
Rarely have I been treated with such a sour and unfriendly welcome. I went to Garces the other day to meet someone for a Happy Hour cocktail at 5:30. I walked several blocks to get there in the 90 degree heat and when I arrived, I was exhausted and thirsty. 

When I walked in, there were literally TWO other customers and about 20 staff on hand. I said, "Hi, I'm meeting someone here in a few minutes. Could I have a seat?" The hostess would barely make eye contact with me and said, "Do you have a reservation?" I was made to feel like since I didn't have a reservation, it was unlikely that I was deserving of a seat in this fine dining establishment. 
The drinks were okay. The wait staff was friendly. But I will never go back.

The hostesses have almost always been rude whenever I go to Good Dog. My friends and I ask for a table and the attitude is something along the lines of "Oh great. Now you want a table? Are you going to eat dinner here? Or are you going to waste my time?"

It's impossible to get a booth, even if you're just getting snacks. The beer is okay. Sadly, I think this may be one of the most over-rated beer joints in town.

Davio's has awesome Happy Hour specials and free fries and philly cheesesteak spring rolls from 5-7pm. The food is amazing but I don't reccomend coming to Davios for fries and cheesesteak as a meal, per say. 

Their warm spinach salad and scrimp scampi is awesome. A good place!

I've only been there once recently but the food was good-old-fashioned greasy-spoon stuff and it definitely met all of my expectations. The service was friendly and we got our food quickly. I was impressed.

I've been here before and have never been really impressed. The food is good but the service is still inconsistent. The woman who waited on us today was extremely rude to us more than once! I will not be going back.

I agree with with Steve S and Xiao Z here... It's a disaster at this ACME. The cashiers are all clearly miserable. I feel bad for them. It could have something to do with the fact that the other managers/supervisory staff are poorly trained and/or just inherently unprofessional people. I went there the other day to get a book of stamps. The customer service desk was FILTHY, covered in random crap; pretty much emblematic of this location's approach to serving customers. I waited at the desk patiently while staff members behind the desk loudly blamed one and other for losing an over-ride key, complaining amongst themselves as to why there was only one in the store; "Why can't we get another one?!"  "The answer to that is over my pay grade."... I stood there for several minutes but they continued to bicker and complain among themselves as if I wasn't even standing there. It was bazaar. Depressing stuff. I will do my best to go to a different location from now on...

Our party of seven had reservations in advance and still waited 15 minutes to be seated. The "hot" smoked salmon special was served ice cold to two of us at our dinner party. The lighting was terrible, completely dark for the entire table with a blinding spotlight one one person. Had a great time with our part but would not go back for the food or service. ..
This is might be the worst Rite Aid in the city. I live around The corner but I will drive five minutes to Cvs just to avoid this place.

The staff at this pharmacy are great. Jesse really went out of his way to be friendly and helpful. 

When people are going to the pharmacy, it's usually because something's already going wrong. It's bad enough that you have to deal with the pain or sickness. 

Dealing with pharmacists who are friendly makes a difference!
Great atmosphere and very friendly staff. Sweet potato fries were very good. Also some vegetarian- friendly options. Loved it!

Fancy restaurant? No. 
But Manayunk Brewery does a mighty fine job of serving a lot of healthy food in addition to a full sushi bar. Their pub food is also delicious. Plus free popcorn at the bar!

Couch Tomato Bistro is my favorite spot in all of Manayunk. Their food is awesome, fresh, healthy and affordable. There is usually enough space to get a table for a weekend bite anytime in the evening or afternoon. Very friendly staff. I love it!

Went to Yanako for dinner on a Friday night. We were seated promptly and the ambience was relaxed. Their sushi is amazing. Had the Yanako sampler, Yakitori, and a few rolls. We recommend the soft shell crab roll and the spicy salmon roll. Will be going back.
Awesome hummus plate. Plenty of vegetarian options. Very friendly staff. Will definitely be back.
We live the sushi pizza. This place has anything you could possibly want in terms of Japanese and Chinese cuisine. Very friendly staff and good drinks too.

Great service. Lots of really unique vegetarian and vegan options. We had vegan wings, a pineapple bowl and veggie burger. Awesome sweet potato fries too. Good draft selection and reasonably priced. Enjoyable and laid back atmosphere atmosphere. A big win for this part of Manayunk!

R086Vy0xE5_20lZjEH8Rsg.review_text: Love how quickly you can order and get your pizza. Maybe a total of 5 minutes max! You can build the pizza right in front of you and it fires in 3 minutes! Very good thin crust pizza and very cheap. Two pizzas, 4 drinks for $23. R u kidding me? IUPUI students must love this!!!!!

Usually get burgers which are fantastic, but tonight we tried the deep dish pizza. Salad and mozzarella sticks were amazing, pizza was a little dry for my liking. Ask for Angie Payne though when you go, she is awesome waitress

Love how quickly you can order and get your pizza. Maybe a total of 5 minutes max! You can build the pizza right in front of you and it fires in 3 minutes! Very good thin crust pizza and very cheap. Two pizzas, 4 drinks for $23. R u kidding me? IUPUI students must love this!!!!!
Fantastic Burgers of all variety! Huge list of Lagers and Ale and some really good dessert served in mason jars. Servers are very friendly and a very relaxed cool atmosphere.

Initial Impression.....

Very quick and polite hostess, quick seating. Took close to 10 minutes for the waiter to come to table.  Waiter was unaware of details for drinks and seemed a bit clueless about his job, however, he was very nice and polite. 

Pretzels were amazing! Garden Salad was an average salad. Really good root beer and the luxury margarita was really good! Burger was not very good at all and the chicken fingers were not very good according to my son. Very cool waiter though, so I am willing to try again.
This place rocks!!  I love this place and it is awesome every time we visit.  The salsa and chips are outstanding!  The fajitas are amazing and it is always busy!
Pizza is amazing!!! Atmosphere is awesome, especially if you like sports and most of all, RACING!

This BBQ is amazing in Indy.  The smoke rolling across 16th street from the smokers draws you in.  The service is good and the sauces are killer.  Pulled pork sandwich is my favorite with "mix" sauce on side.  Mac n cheese is really good too.  My favorite in indy
Awesome customer service, awesome food and this place is always packed!  Don't miss the berry sangria, it is delicious!

Service is usually pretty good, atmosphere is cool.  Bar sett me is really cool and almost like a sports bar feel.   High top tables and comfy booths.  

Chips and queso are really good on the appetizer menu, cheese fries are awesome and the salsa is really good too.  Sandwiches are all good and the portions are huge!  

I would steer clear of the sirloin steaks, I have never tried he ribeye but the sirloin is way below my expectations.  It was undercooked severely in one side and way over cooked on the other.  Quality of meat is not good.  They removed it from my bill so this is why I felt they deserve the rating.  Everything was truly really good.  Sorry for the gross picture of the steak but this is what I received.

Enjoyed lunch at cake bake shop. We had no reservation but ended up getting the large room to eat in. Was beautiful. 

We were seated within about 15 minutes and greeted with a very pleasant waiter whom filled our drink orders.  Once we got our water we were left alone for about 10 minutes before we ordered and it took us about that time to decide. 

We all ordered the 1/2 sandwich / 1/2 soup or pasta.  We got the ham sandwich and penne vodka which was really tasty. The penne was a bit spicy but good. The ham sandwich was delicious but very thin in the ham for the price of the combo.  My wife got the soup of the day, roasted potato with leeks and it was amazing!  My mother in law got salad and buttered noodles and they were awesome as well. 

We ordered the red velvet cake, raspberry cake and pumpkin pie. The cakes were amazing, but me as a pumpkin pie connoisseur have to say, THE PIE WAS A HUGE A+!!!  Are you kidding me?

We got to see Gwendolyn, the owner, and she was very nice and beautiful as well.
Amazing Pizza for the price!  One of our favorite pizza places. Their ovens cook the pizza amazingly fast and the service is awesome!
Love this place!  Our favorite Mexican Restaurant for miles.  The place is always very busy and the service is amazing! The carnitas are incredible as just about everything on the menu.

I must say I am very disappointed, as the same thing has happened to me now twice at the Barber Shop.  As any place you have a a favorite barber or stylist and you are willing to wait for them.  Twice now I have went in, signed in asking to see a certain barber only to watch that person finish up with not 1, but two customers THEN just leave.  While I have waited for 45mins today, a previous time was nearly 1.5 hrs.  The frustrating part is, no one says anything. Everyone watches them leave but no one offers any resolution they just keep taking other customers while I sat there. I left and say I won't go back. 

For what it's worth, the atmosphere is awesome and there are some good barbers there, but I am sick and tired of wasting my time waiting and obviously no one is managing this portion of the business or it wouldn't be happening. 

First time = shame on you! Second time = shame on me!  Not again!
One of the best in Indy!  I love the Pep, Ital sausage, bacon, mushroom well done!  OMG it is delish!

Visited Brew Link for the first time this weekend with my wife and son. Fortunately it was "Live Music Night" and the singer was really good!  

Very friendly staff with quick attention even during a very busy time of evening (530-600p) on Saturday night.  The wine was fantastic and we tried the pretzels sticks for an appetizer.  Pretzels were a little on the well done side and I would consider them a bit average.  

The Burger and Fries were good and my wife had a salad that she really liked.  

My 16 year old son thought the place was pretty cool so I am sure we will go back soon! Friends of mine say the beer is really good so if you enjoy a place to hang, hear some good music and have some good food then you should enjoy!

PF Chang's is one of my family's favorite Reataurants. The atmosphere and decor is awesome, service is always good and the food is killer good!  

You must try the chicken lettuce wraps at all cost, they are amazing!  My favorite meal is the Kung Pao chicken with white rice.  The sesame chicken, Mongolian beef and the orange chicken is quite tasty too.  They now offer the family size meals and it makes it much more affordable for families of four to enjoy for lower price.  

Downtown Indy and Keystone locations are really cool, but our favorite is downtown!

Love penn station!  Quick fresh hot, or cold, sandwich customized for exactly how you like it.  The bread is amazing!  I personally have a favorite of the chicken teriyaki replacing Swiss with provolone cheese, mushrooms and extra teriaki..!  Try the same ingredients with the cheese steak sandwich...the teriaki makes it so delicious!   

The fries are so good and the lemonade is crazy delicious!  I just don't like that the lemonade is held hostage behind the counter.  I guess people steal a lot of lemonade, I don't know. Lol

This place is a go to for me, love it!

I love HotBox Pizza' breadsticks!  They are quite delicious and the sauces are very good.  Pizza is a little above average for me, but willing to eat it when breadsticks are involved!  Lol. The Avon location customer service is really good! They have a drive up window, which is a little untraditional but makes it easy.
