Great place very fresh fish and delicious Sushi. For lunch I found it expensive for $24 Ala carte 2 long rolls of sushi ... no appetizers or ice cream
Great Indian food and home made ... the naan, chicken Marsala is yummy !!! The place is covid friendly, attentive server and delicious food!!!

RcZLSl1JYNHHkgp6CqsMMQ.review_text: Great lunch specials. We go often after church on Sundays when the special is $6.98 for fajitas and a drink.  The portion is large and the food is high quality.  Plus, the guacamole casero is excellent.  Even my husband loves it, and he doesn't normally like guacamole.

As with many other reviewers, my husband and I decided to try Cafe Rakka after seeing it on Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives.   Overall, our visits have been very positive.  The menu is small, but the food is unique and very flavorful.  I haven't seen many of the dishes anywhere else.   The dining room is very small, so I recommend going at non-peak times.  Service has been a little slow on our visits, but the staff has always been friendly.  I'm willing to wait for great food that I know is being prepared to order.  

I highly recommend the appetizer platter that comes with greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, and homemade farmer's cheese all drizzled with olive oil.  The farmer's cheese is delicious and not like anything else I've tasted.  

The filet mignon kebobs cooked on the salt block were quite good, but be aware if you go later in the day that they do seem to sometimes run out of the specials.  We had to wait and try this on our second visit, and even then we got the last portion available that day.  The chicken tikka masala is also superb and very unique.  

My last recommendation is the hummus bar.  The hummus itself is very good and you get to choose two toppings.  The roasted onions and roasted garlic cloves are my favorites.

With so many Mexican food restaurants around (and I wish I could try them all), I've found that there are certain ones I go to when I'm craving a particular dish.  Each one seems to have their specialties, and I have found that to be true with La Hacienda.   While there are many items on their menu that I have not tried yet, there are a couple that already stand out.    
Their tacos are some of the best I've had, especially the chicken tacos.  They are served on two small corn tortillas with just the meat, diced onions, and cilantro.  All you have to do is squeeze on some lime juice or their salsa verde to make them excellent.  Nothing elaborate, just basic and good.  
I would also highly recommend the breakfast dishes, which are served all day.  In particular, the Chorizo con Papas.  The chorizo is mixed in with diced potatoes, and they get the chorizo and potatoes nice and crispy.  The dish is served with the standard rice, beans, and tortillas.  Very filling and exactly like a dish made for me by a Mexican friend.   I haven't seen that exact dish on the menu anywhere else in Nashville so far.

I've been going to Rita's ever since they opened in Hermitage a few years ago.   Rita's is an excellent option when you want something to cool you down, or just to have a little treat, and are tired of the usual offerings.  The staff is always friendly and will let you sample as many flavors as you'd like.   Rita's has been a hit with anyone I've taken there, kids and adults alike.  
Personally, the ices are my favorite.  I have to say the mango and black cherry flavors are hands down the best offered.   The flavors are excellent and some of the fruit flavors contain actual pieces of the fruit (like the black cherry).   The sugar free flavors they have are a good and tasty option for those watching sugar intake, but (as in most cases) the ones with sugar definitely have more flavor.  
Definitely take advantage of a free sample before making your choice.  Keep in mind that the flavors do change daily and that they can run out of flavors late in the day.  I recommend becoming a fan on Facebook, as they post each day what the flavors are and have daily Facebook specials.   Try it before they close for the winter!

Alpha Bakery has some of the most unique breads and pastries in the Nashville area.  If you're in Bellevue, you really should give them a try.  The building is not fancy and this is a small business who doesn't spend a lot of money on marketing and advertising, but the food is great and made fresh every day.  Many people that I know who go there found out about it by word of mouth.  
Many of the offerings and pastries are Asian inspired.  They are delicious and really are like what I and other family members have had in Japan.  The curry pan is a great savory treat if you like curry.  As another reviewer mentioned, the sweet Asian pastries are not overly sweet.  A lot of people in the Asian community come here to get things they can't get anywhere else in Nashville.  
If you want something decadent, the snowballs (puff pastry stuffed with whipped cream and sliced bananas) can't be beat.  Both the almond and chocolate crossaints are flaky and fantastic.  
The breads are absolutely worth trying as well, from the Asian alpha fan to the dinner rolls to the best challah in town.  It absolutely melts in your mouth when it's fresh and beats Publix's challah bread hands down.  
They do serve brunch now, and those offerings are unique as well.  If you just want a sandwich, I highly recommend the chicken salad.  It's very peppery and isn't overwhelmed with mayonnaise.  
Last, but certainly not least, are the cakes.  The strawberry cake here is my absolute favorite cake that I ask for every year on my birthday.  The cake itself is super light and not overly sweet with a light creamy icing and a layer of fresh strawberries in the middle.  When I've served this at family gatherings or parties, it's gone in a flash.  They also have an amazing Asian inspired chocolate that is Japanese in style and not overly sweet.  They often have slices of the cakes available, but you do have to order whole cakes ahead of time.

Stoney River is my "go to" place when I want a great steak dinner.  In my opinion, they have the whole package:  phenomenal food, consistently great service, and a very comfortable atmosphere.  Yes, it can be pricey, but it's definitely worth it and I still end up with a lower tab than you'd have at some of the other higher end steakhouses.  (Money saving hints: Sign up for their e-mail club and they'll periodically e-mail you coupons like $20 off if you buy two entrees.  They also sometimes have a survey option on your receipt and you can do that survey to get a $20 off coupon mailed to you).  I also love that you don't have to overdress here.  I've seen plenty of people in what I would call business casual dress or nice jeans and a dress shirt.  
In my opinion, the ideal meal at Stoney River has to start with the Tomato and Mozzarella salad.  This is a great twist on the whole caprese salad idea with huge tomato slices, fresh mozzarella, crumbled bacon and onion straws.  It's all drizzled with the most delicious balsamic reduction I've ever had.  My husband and I often split this instead of ordering individual salads.  
For the main entree, my favorite is the 7 oz cabin filet.  They have a special seasoning blend that they use, and you can ask for your steak to be more heavily or more lightly seasoned.  The filet is so tender, and I've never even been tempted to ask for steak sauce.  Each steak comes with your choice of potato, and you can't go wrong with the garlic mashed or the carmelized onion mashed potatoes.  We typically each order one and then share.  They have lots of other great sides as well.  I highly recommend the sauteed mushrooms.  A bowl is definitely big enough to share, and they're a perfect fit with the steak.  
If you have room for dessert, there are some great options.  The chocolate cake is HUGE and is big enough for a whole table to share.  Plus, they serve it with ice cold milk shooters which is a great touch.  My favorite dessert now, though, is the blondie.  It's served warm and is filled with chocolate chips and nuts, topped with Haagen Dazs vanilla ice cream, and drizzled with chocolate sauce.  Absolutely sinful (and still big enough for two to share - though you won't want to).
Both the West End and Cool Springs locations are great, but parking is easier at Cool Springs with the private lot.

Yum, yum, yum.   That about says it all.   We tried NBC for the first time last weekend and I will definitely be returning.  For our first time, we decided to get a box of the 16 bundtinis (4 each of chocolate chocolate chip, white chocolate raspberry, red velvet, and pumpkin).   All were good but I have to say the chocolate chocolate chip with the cream cheese frosting was decadent.  The cake is super moist and the frosting is fantastic.  I'm the kind of person who usually scrapes most of the frosting off of cakes, but I ate every bit of this stuff.   The pumpkin is delicious as well and seasoned just right.  It also goes perfectly with the cream cheese frosting.   I can't wait to see what the seasonal flavor is for November, and we've already decided to place an order to go with our Thanksgiving dinner.  Now we just have to decide on flavors...

As others have mentioned, this restaurant is easily overlooked.  Many restaurants have come and gone in this location (a catering company, a barbecue joint, a mexican restaurant) and I had passed by Simply Thai many times before wising up and checking out the reviews here on Yelp.   
After two visits, I highly recommend giving this place a try.  The building is nothing fancy at all, but the inside is a clean and nicely decorated.  Our servers have been very friendly and service was quick both times.   
So far we've tried the Basil Stir Fry with beef, the Cashew Nut chicken, and the Musman (their spelling) curry with chicken.   All dishes were flavorful and I was happy to find that the chicken in the dishes was all white meat.   Portions are a good size as well and the dishes are served family style in a large plate or bowl so they are easy to share.  
The spring rolls are nice and crispy and served with a delicious sauce that has a nice tanginess to it.  This is different from what I've seen before at other Thai restaurants who all seem to serve their spring rolls with a sweet sauce.  
We definitely plan to return to try other dishes on the menu and the fried banana dessert which looked heavenly.   
Overall, this is definitely a place to try and it's nice to have more than one choice in Thai restaurants in the area.  The only other one is Dusit Thai on Old Hickory Blvd (previously Royal Thai), which is great as well.   We definitely got out of Simply Thai with a smaller check.  I'd say the entrees are about $2 to $3 cheaper than at Dusit Thai.

My husband and tried out P.S. Noodle Pot on Friday night. We were looking for a place for dinner before attending a graduation at nearby Lighthouse Christian, and came across them on Yelp (of course!). 
I'm not often in that area, but we immediately decided to find an excuse to go out that way again so that we can return to P.S. Noodle Pot.  
We arrived at about 6:00 PM and there was only one diner in the place when we arrived, though several others came in after and there were several to go orders picked up while we were there.  There aren't a whole lot of tables, but there is also the bar seating.  To me the only drawback was the dim lighting.     
I ordered the cashew chicken with rice, while my husband ordered the yellow curry with rice.  It did take awhile to get our food, but you could see and hear them preparing everything fresh to order, so it's worth the wait.  I ordered my entree slightly spicy, and it was perfect.  Portions on both were huge, so I think we could have easily split an entree with an appetizer.   Both dishes were very flavorful and contained a lot of meat and a variety of vegetables.   We also split an order of the pork spring rolls which were good, but I wish they had a fried vegetable spring roll option.   The only item that I wasn't delighted with was the hot and sour soup.  It didn't have as much of the tangy flavor I'm used to with hot and sour soup.  
I can't wait to go back and try other items (though it will be hard not to order the same dishes again).   Prices are moderate, but seem justified considering the portion size.  Next time, I'll make sure we're going right home afterward so I can take my leftovers with me!

We recently tried out Mt. Fuji on a weeknight for dinner.  My sister and two little nieces were with us, and both the adults and children thoroughly enjoyed the food.   The service was extremely friendly, and the hibachi chef interacted a lot with the kids.  The decor is very nice and upscale, and the place was very clean. 
The hibachi menu is extensive and prices are very reasonable compared to other hibachi style restaurants.  The portions were very generous.  My husband and I really liked their version of the "yum yum" sauce, which was a little spicy.  My nieces often don't eat well when they are at restaurants, but they ate very well at Mt. Fuji.  
I hope to return soon to try out the sushi menu, which appeared to be extensive and have great options as well.   I'm hoping a lot of people start to find out about this place as it was not crowded the night we went, and I'd hate to see it close.

Now that my summer favorite Rita's has closed in the Hermitage area, I was hoping to find a new summer spot.  Having tried Yogurt Mountain twice in the past week, I can definitely say I've found it!  None of the other yogurt shops in the area have impressed me like this one. 
The staff is super friendly, and the place has been immaculate on both visits.  The decor is wonderfully bright, cheerful, and welcoming.  
The flavor variety is impressive as well.  I highly recommend the salty caramel pretzel for a nice sweet and salty treat.  My nieces loved the cake batter yogurt.  For traditionalists, both the classic vanilla and vanilla bean can't be beat.  
They also have an impressive array of toppings that pleased both the adults and kids in our group.  For me, that means fresh fruit (raspberries, strawberries, bananas and more) and nuts. Not to mention the Ghirardelli chocolate and caramel sauces.  The kids loved the chocolate rocks topping and the little pieces of pastel colored mochi (Japanese rice cakes).   
The price is reasonable at .49 per ounce.  For me, a decent portion with all of the toppings I want has run about $3.50 (and usually my husband and I share).   They also have prepackaged quarts of some flavors at less than $7, which is a great deal when you look at how much that amount of yogurt would cost if you were paying by weight.  
Highly recommended!  And you can sign up with your cell phone number to receive text coupons.

We decided to stop in for some fro yo last Friday (before a shopping trip to Kroger right next door).   I made a second visit Saturday afternoon, so I guess that tells you how the first one went.  
They don't have as large of a variety of flavors as some others (like my other fav Yogurt Mountain in Hermitage), but what I have tried was excellent.  I loved how they have two flavors in each machine that you can then combine into even better swirled flavors.  I have to say the Creme Filled Cinnamon Donut flavor (which was a combination of Tahitian Vanilla and Ooey Gooey Cinnamon Bun I believe) was absolutely to die for.  Put that in a waffle bowl and top it with the maple walnuts, and you can't beat it.  
The place was nice and clean, and they have a good variety of toppings and sauces.  We'll definitely be going back.

I've been waiting a long time for a good sushi joint to come in to the Providence area, and now we finally have one!  Hana Sushi House did not disappoint on my first visit this past weekend.  
First and foremost, the food was delicious.  The quality of the sushi ingredients (the fish, rice, and nori) were all high quality.  The rolls were prepared beautifully.   So far we've ordered the sweet potato roll, asparagus roll, and chicken tempura roll.  I would recommend all three.  I also sampled the eel roll that my sister ordered, and it was delicious as well with an extremely tasty eel sauce.  They have a very large variety of sushi options on the menu, and I can't wait to try some others on my next visit.  
If you aren't in the mood for sushi, they have a great variety of non-sushi options as well.  Those include noodle dishes (udon and soba) and hibachi entrees.   My husband ordered the chicken hibachi lunch and was kind enough to let me sample.  The chicken, fried rice, and hibachi vegetables were all delicious.  They were cooked perfectly (not over-done), served at the right temperature, and portions were generous for a lunch order.   We also tried the Harumaki (Japanese spring rolls), which were fantastic.  They were nice and crispy, not greasy, and were served with a sweet sauce that was different from any spring roll sauce I've had before.  I'll have to try it again to try and figure out what was in it.  They do also offer children's hibachi lunches, and the portions there were huge as well.  Most of the entrees, and the maki lunch specials, come with soup or salad.  The miso soup was very flavorful, and served nice and hot.  The ginger dressing served on the house salad is excellent, and truly has an intense ginger flavor.  
They've created a nice atmosphere inside the restaurant.  It's not huge inside, but feels spacious.  I loved that they had traditional Japanese music playing, as it always throws me off to be in a sushi restaurant playing American radio or classic rock.  I also love that I can go here and get the sushi I crave while my husband can get the hibachi entrees or chicken katsu that he loves, and we can do that in a nice quiet atmosphere.  Here, the hibachi entrees are all cooked in the kitchen, so there are no large, noisy hibachi tables in the restaurant itself.  I love hibachi food as well, but sometimes you just aren't in the mood to sit at a big table with a bunch of strangers or deal with the noise.  
I encourage everyone to give Hana Sushi a try!

I've been dying to try this place since reading a magazine review, so my husband and I decided to try it out for dinner on Easter (hoping they'd be open, and they were!).  I can't wait to go back.
I was immediately struck by the friendliness of the staff.  Our server was very attentive and the manager checked on us multiple times.  As others have mentioned, the space isn't too large, but the interior is very upbeat, clean, and comfortable.  
We had a hard time choosing which appetizer to pick for our first visit.  We ended up with the basket of pretzel bites & beer cheese dip.  Both were great, and you could really taste the beer in the dip.  I also asked for a sample of the house made mustard to try with the pretzels, and my husband I both loved it.  It's creamy and a little sweet, but also with a little kick.  We ended up buying a bottle to take home.  
For entrees, I had the chicken wiener schnitzel with a burgundy mushroom sauce.  Makes me hungry again just thinking about it.  The schnitzel was cooked perfectly, and not greasy at all.  My sides of sauerkraut and german potato salad (served hot) were excellent.  The potato salad is made with vinegar so it's nice and tangy, not loaded with mayonnaise like american potato salad.  My husband ended up trying one of the sausages European style, and like it as well.  He was very impressed with his side of potato pancakes.  
The desserts sounded fantastic, and I can't wait to go back and hopefully save enough room to try one!  
If you like German/Austrian food, you have to give this place a try.  It's great to have an alternative to The Gerst Haus for great German food.  The menu is not as extensive, but to me that's not a drawback since the items on the menu are done well.  This would be a great place to stop in for lunch or dinner any time you're attending an event at Centennial Park, as it's within walking distance.

I've been looking forward to today's Grand Opening, as we really need a good place for Southern food here in Hermitage, so my husband and I decided to try it out at lunch.   
They've really created a great casual and comfortable atmosphere inside.  I love the walls covered with Southern sayings, and the way they've designed the space makes it feel really large and open.  You actually order at the counter, are given a number, and they bring your food out to your table.  They have a great little bar set up with all the extras you might want (hot sauces, jellies for the biscuits, pickles, etc).   
My husband and I both tried the dill chicken tenders today, and they were great (nice and crispy, and that dill in the breading is a great touch).  We both loved the sides we chose as well.  Everyone we interacted with today was very friendly, and the service was really fast and efficient.  
We were quite impressed and are already looking forward to a second visit to try out some of the other things on the menu, as they have a really large selection and we had a hard time deciding what to try first.  They have some excellent looking breakfast and dessert options as well as lighter options on the menu.  
Glad to have Hadley's in Hermitage!

RsQ9kJsX1K3wJX5YCSu8Pg.review_text: I love this place! They have the best, authentic Mexican food in Tucson and by far the best green corn tamales! They also bring your food out fast. Last but not least, cant forgot to mention how nice and welcoming the staff is at both locations.
My favorite is the Mexican chocolate cupcake followed by the pistachio, but everything is delicious!
Everyhing I've had here has been delicious! I would highly recommend the white bean purée( a little spicy) and also the spicy meatball pizza.

My burger was delicious! I thought it was odd all the burgers are served on english muffins, but it actually goes well together. The fries were ok, they could use some salt. The only other thing I didn't care for was the seating. It's a small place so more than likely you'll be sitting extra close to the stranger next to you, if not at the same table( long table w/ about 10 or so seats). Service was timely and the staff was welcoming, I will for sure be going back.

Food was good, service was good, drinks were really good! This place reminds me of a upgraded version of applebees. The drink prices were great! Usually your paying $9-10  a drink, there the avg price was $5!

I've been coming here for years and the quality of their food is becoming increasingly worse. But this review is talk about their customer service, or lack there of. You are guaranteed to get an attitude from at least 1 person every visit. You can most of the employees hate working there. Also I find it very inappropriate for the manager to reprimand  employees right in front of customers on many different occasions. This place needs a huge lesson on customer service.

Good quality, reasonably priced meat. Friendly and helpful staff. I'm not sure if its just on the weekends, but they marinate and grill your meat for free...tips are welcomed. For sure will be going back.

While they do offer gourmet flavors, they were all very bland(no seasoning/salt). The salsas were good and were a must for me to liven up the tamales. This would not be my first choice when in comes to tamales but on the other hand the pork quesadilla was very good!

Much better set up than the old one on craycroft. I sat at the bar and the bartenders were very attentive. Good place to go to relax and have a few drinks.
P.S. The jalapeño hummus is a must!

I definitely recommend the white out pizza. I've had it at least a million times and it is consistently good, you can tell they use quality ingredients. The only downside is how small the restaurant is, but totally worth it!

Came in to order to go on my lunch break. Debated on calling ahead but there was no need because I had my order in about 6 minutes. Staff was friendly, food is very good and fresh. I ordered the vegetable egg rolls(no tofu in them ) and bbq pork fried rice. I will definitely be back!

I was very pleasantly surprised by this place! At first I was a little apprehensive because of the location, but that was quickly put to rest once I tried the food. I ordered the chicken pita with dolmas....delicious. FYI if you've never had Mediterranean food before...you will leave smelling like garlic but it was well with it!

My family and I were really excited to try them for this first time. When we got to the counter to order, the guy told us they just ran out of pizza. How is that even possible, a pizza place runs out of pizza at 630 on a Saturday night!? Won't be back.

I am really shocked this place isn't that popular, the food and service is great! Everything tasted fresh and delicious. It is a little pricey, as most Italian food is, but it is worth it to me if you are getting quality food. I would recommend this place to anyone!
The owner was so nice and welcoming! Donuts are delicious! I will definitely be back! Highly recommend!
Food was good, decent prices. The waitress we had was not attentive at all. Poor service was to be expected after we overheard two tables complaining as soon as we sat down.

RscoPhnfz9HFXN7X8czFlg.review_text: Every time we go to Hellas we order a Greek Salad, Grilled Octopus, Saganaki, and Grilled Pita with different sauces! Food is always fresh and delicious :-) And, of course, we never leave the restaurant without a couple of deserts!!!
This particular location works like a well oiled machine! Super quick service and ALWAYS super fresh coffee! My kids and I go there at least 2 times a week!

THE BEST ORGANIC VARIETY IN THE AREA!!! I love purchasing organic produce as well as other consumer goods. This place is the only place in the area that offers a very fresh organic produce. There are few things in Publix and some in Target but nothing even close to what Nature's F Patch offers. I also love the seafood section which offers great items at regular prices. Also, their pre-made cold salads are awesome!!! Curry Turkey is our favorite :-)
My drink is always made exactly the way I want it! I also like their selection of desserts as some locations do not offer such variety :-)
Quick service, great margaritas, food is consistent as we go there once every couple of months for late lunch. Did I mention their salsa is great and you get hot and crispy chips :-)

What a GREAT place! We go there all the time for lunch and dinner! I also had my baby shower there and was very happy with the service and attention Greek Town employees provided to my family and all guests :-) 

Greek Town has beautiful decor and such a nice indoor/outdoor open bar - absolutely love it!

ONLY THE BEST MALL IN TAMPA BAY :-)

I love the variety of stores, special events, and kids playground is awesome! It is also nice that new cool stores opened up like H&M late last year and VS PINK just opened now. 

Number of restaurants is great so you always have a choice where to go for lunch or dinner!

Light and oh-so-perfect!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  There are so many flavors to try. I've been there with my parents who were visiting this area and my mom said this was the best gelato she ever had in her entire life :-) I stop by there with the kids to get couple of delicious scoops when we take a stroll along Clearwater Beach.

If you are looking for super fresh seafood, this is the place! They have the best variety of fish and other seafood products. My husband always gets a seaweed salad there which is delicious! They have a great selection of cold salads including baby octopus. So different and very tasty. This is OUR FAVORITE PLACE to go to before we are ready to cook seafood dinner :-)

Great selection of teas and accessories to make the tea with. I love to smell new flavors before buying them so the only complaint I have is that the location gets very busy and people working there are not always paying attention to the orders/customers..... At times when I go I just order my favorite Ribos and leave instead of getting a tea to go or find out about new products.

Do you love sweets? Well, sure you do if you are looking up reviews for bakery, lol. I'm being 100% when I say that desserts are awesome but Multi Whole Grain bread is the best thing. Ever since we tried that bread we go back over and over! It is a little chewy which is so great because most multigrain bread is not! Their take on chocolate macaroons is cool - they are flat with some dark chocolate in the middle of two layers. A little crunchy and chewy at the same time. Our little one was excited about the carrot cake and their delish cookies. Anyways, long story short, we love the place and will be back there as soon as the end of this week :-)
Pespashio and Double Chocolate muffins are AAAAAAAAAAAAAA-WESOME!!!!!!!!! They sure make great coffee too. I had a latte and have to say I do like it better than Starbucks.

Amazing champagne sangria and Columbia original salad which we always order with shrimp. Nice place right on the intercostal with beautiful outdoor seating. Portions are perfect, even on a larger side and every entry comes with a big piece of freshly baked Cuban bread. We love going there !

.................the service wag great but the food not so much... The grilled cheese sandwich was done is a way that the cheese was not melted (kids meal). The burger and the turkey burgers were ok but the fries served with them were soggy.. The only thing that was good is chicken strips served in a kids meal....

Exquisite!!! First off, restaurant offers a great selection of wine at very reasonable prices. You can choose from popular French wines or international including Malbec which we prefer very much. 

First and second dishes consist of cold and warm appetizers and enough to share. Oxtail was a pure perfection! I would also highly recommend ordering Foie Gras! 

Overall, it is a quite and romantic restaurant, perfect for a date night.

Exquisite!!!! Always a superb experience!

I love their surf & turf sushi roll! They have several delicious specialty rolls to choose from. 

From appetizers to desserts everything is unique and made using only top of the line ingredients. 

Full bar and pretty nice wine selection not to mention so many signature cocktails! You will be pleased!

European cappuccino and espresso are a must when you go there! Perfectly made every time!

Gelato is irresistible and plenty of flavors to choose from. They offer number of toppings and delectable desserts, crapes, and croissants!  

We are regulars as kids love their mango gelato topped with fresh berries and m&ms. 

Excellent service too!

What a great experience and place to watch sunset!!! Drinks are amazing and so is food! Donuts for sweet tooth will make you smile as you fill freshly backed donut holes with flavorful fillings yourself.

Such a beautiful and delicious dining experience! Table side salads and steak service is a must try. You will be pleased with selection of wines but dessert wines might hit the spot even more. Just look at the pics - so cute the way they serve the flights!
My fave is avocado toast, served with fruit and berries! They have delicious muffins, and bakery items too. Peach and berry mimosas are yummy. Added sitting outside as well

Thank you for making my birthday so special! From traditional dishes to caviar and variety of drinks and most of all service, absolutely everything was outstanding!  Table was beautifully decorated and plated before we arrived. I would like to note that we ordered for 5 people and every single dish came out perfectly. True home-made Russian food!

S0HVwmbJlPxpoPesa1Dqnw.review_text:
This place gets 5 stars! Visited on St. Patrick's Day 2021. They were so busy that we couldn't make a reservation so we ended up going in person. 

We waited less than 20 minutes at full capacity to be seated and were greeted instantly upon being seated. 
Our server was Sarah C. She is excellent! Very friendly and knowledgeable of the menu and specials for the for that evening.

The food and drinks were all excellent. 
I ordered a green tea shot and the pineapple paradise mixed drink. 

For dinner I ordered the coconut shrimp entree 
With the house salad and fries, all fresh and delicious.
Also at our table a house burger, Jameson and ginger
Chicken finger basket and Mac n cheese and for dessert, a fresh slice of peanut butter pie! Wow! 

ALL FRESH AND DELICIOUS!

The tab was all under $100!

They had a live band rocking the house the entire time.

The water views are absolutely beautiful during sunset hours with ample outdoor seating!

If you have not been here yet- SKIP THE FANCY PLACE ACROSS THE WATER and go to this place instead.

The staff are way nicer, more professional and you won't wait HOURS to eat or drink!

It's truly a great time! We will be back!!!!

REALLY GOOD BBQ! 

Although this place is also short staffed they provided the best to-go service they could.

The day I tried their BBQ one of their main meat freezers were out of order so they were only serving Pork and Beef brisket that day with choice of Potato Salad and Cole slaw only.

We purchased the Family Pack meal which comes with a  pound of meat, two sides, and bread. Also bought drinks from the cooler outside. 

They have many choices of BBQ sauce to choose from.
The Tennessee flavor was pretty good- sweet yet a pinch of bitter taste and zing of spice. Good! 

We will definitely be back- I want to try other items on the menu. They are decently priced for today's BBQ price point in the area. 

The parking area is interesting- cute decoratively set up with smokers and metal pig shaped static statue like art. Cute for the whole family. 

No indoor seating, picnic tables outside and porch area only.

Been here a few times in the past couple months.
Ordered take out in person and delivery twice over the phone. 

The in-person take out order went smoother than the delivery orders. My order only took 15 minutes and the order was 100% correct.

Typically this place stays pretty busy especially on weekends.

The last two phone calls for delivery were taken by a girl who never pays attention to your address or credit card number.

Their delivery takes an hour or more to get food.
The order was wrong and they put the wrong address on the order so the delivery driver had to call and use GPS to navigate the delivery after waiting already over an hour for food.

The food is VERY good but the customer service is two thumbs down. 

A couple of their delivery drivers told us they had people quit on the spot and they have 16 year old taking phone orders. 

As good as their food is it's not worth waiting hours for it. Especially with rude customer service. 

My reviews are always honest. I know times are tough. Hope they can do better in the future.

Great authentic Mexican cuisine.

I've been here a couple times in the past couple of months with family and friends and they are always kind and accommodating.

They practice social distancing when seating their customers and everyone including staff and guests are required to wear a mask unless seated to eat or drink.

Their place is very clean- including the restrooms.

The food is 100% authentic Mexican dishes.
Everything is fresh every-time.

They cater to large groups and is family friendly.

Their margaritas are delicious and the prices for lunch and dinner are in point.

Ok f you're looking for a good Mexican spot in the area this is the place. Most of their customers are return long time customers in the area and I see why.

This place is great! Everything from the atmosphere to the service.

We had a group of 8, including a mix of adults and children. We had plenty of availability for seating and immediate service.

We all ordered $5 margaritas, beers, juice, sodas, and water.

The margaritas are the bomb! The large margaritas are sooo good. The beers come in 32oz servings.

Around the table food orders were, an amazing Taco Salad, burgers, Philly cheese steaks, kids meals with chicken and a few orders of the Buffalo Cauliflower.

All the food and drinks were good. The service was great and everything is very affordably priced for the selection available at this restaurant.

All staff and customers are required to follow CDC COVID19 guidelines while visiting.

They have plenty of seating inside and outside.
They provide covered patios with elongated tables for outdoor service.

We had a great Sunday  afternoon here. 
Great for groups and kids!

We will be back!

Top Dog Grill in NPR is pretty good. The food is made fresh in front of you with a short wait. They weren't horribly busy for a weekday evening family order.

They had ALOT of take out orders to fulfill as we waited for our food to include, internet orders; Über eats and DoorDash Incase anyone wonders how all that works with this place. 

We ordered the American dog, a Chicago dog, and two kids skinless dogs. The kids meals comes with chocolate pudding or applesauce and French fries.

We also ordered two can sodas and one chocolate peanut butter mini cake that was absolutely amazing tasting. 

YOU GET 10% DISCOUNT which they gave us for checking in on Yelp! 

My bill was a little over $30.

The food was good. Better as a snack or lunch place.
Small meals served until 10pm.

See photos for menus.

Visited NPR WH on Thursday evening for their ALL DAY HAPPY HOUR- 

Have to say the only thing for happy hour are Domestic Beer and Margaritas THATS IT. 

We ordered a wing house side salad (was a very generous portion) with boneless garlic chicken wings

Kids Mac n Cheese and Kids Sliders with cheese

Order of loaded tots sauces in the side with side Original Buffalo chicken wings 

When we got there they weren't very busy at all and we were seated by their hostess right away however, no one came to our table to greet us or take our drink orders for about 15 minutes.

The same hostess realized we were still seated and came over with  menus and coloring activities for the kids.

Our server came quick over after that and took our drink and appetizers order. 

The food was excellent and the rest of the service was just as good.

Even though it seemed like they don't have much staff working at that location- or that day;
Our server did an excellent job to accommodate us.
All of their waitresses are very kind and professional.

This location has a limited menu due to COVID19 but the food is excellent.

Their food is GREAT!

The pizza is authentic! You can taste it in the dough.
You can order any custom pizza you like or want.

Their wings are soooo good. I would say they are competitive tasting to other near by Italian pizza places and even places known for their chicken wings!

I kid you not; their wings are that GOOD! 

We chose this pizza place because we wanted to try a new place out. What a great find! 

Food is delicious and fresh. Price point is good for quality of food.

We will be back for sure!

Great spot in downtown NPR! There's a rooftop bar. AND THEY SERVE BRUNCH HERE WITH A FULL BAR.
It's hard to find places out here that have a weekend Brunch special Especially one that serves alcohol.
The food is great. We had the asparagus fries, a blue burger, chicken tenders meal, and the pork sliders.
All delicious and fresh. They make all their own seasonings and sauces in house. Gives their food great flavor! The also have craft cocktails made to order and craft beers on tap. Great vibe and atmosphere. Very modern industrial with a rustic hint to the theme and decor of the place. It's a grand idea they had adding the rooftop bar to the restaurant. They have karaoke on Thursdays and something called dueling pianos which we have to go back for that sometime. 

All and all the social in npr gets 5 stars. Great experience. Excellent customer service and fresh food.
Great for all types of groups and kids!

This is a VERY unique experience HOWEVER, this location is run by a collection of very inexperienced young adults so it's operated late at night closer resemblance to a night club in YBOR City. Nothing like the Seminole Hard Rock class you'd expect.

Although the atmosphere and decor is amazing and unique as well as their very sweet menu everything else just didn't measure up.

What happened:
Waited in short line to be seated, looked like only manager available was acting as host at front of venue.
Finally got seated at bar. 
Was greeted by lead bartender Marisa and asked to move over three seats down on bar so her friends could be seated at the bar instead.

We obliged and gave Marisa our drink order.
The well window bar back came over and poured our drinks. They were both beautiful and delicious.
We then gave him our food order.

Over 30 minutes later our food order went to the lead bartenders friends and we were still waiting.
We told Marisa the bartender they got our food and reordered the same stuff again.

An HOUR PASSED BY STILL NO FOOD! ?! 
We told the other bartender to cancel our food order and give us our tab.

Marisa the bartender then gave my friend a cocktail on the house for the inconvenience.

What could've been an even better experience we will never know unless we visit again to actually get to try the food we order.

PROS:
Entertaining environment 
Amazing drink menu 
Delicious martinis 
Colorful food choices 

CONS: 
Unprofessionalism from staff
VERY slow kitchen
Not enough bar tenders 
Not the value you expect at the price point.

If staff at this business can learn a thing or two from it patrons overall, just because you're going to make a nice cash out at the end of the night because of a high priced menu doesn't mean your service should lack!

This is hands down the best lunchtime combo you can get at Panera. 

I ordered a You Pick Two Lunch Combo 

Half Green Goddess Salad with the best dressing ever
Half Smokehouse BBQ Chicken Sandwich with Regular Kettle Chips and a regular Prickly Pear Ice Tea.

Not only is the food delicious and fresh at this location in Port Richey FL off SR-19, it ROCKS!

Excellent customer service and attentive to your order details! Everything was correct and delicious. 
The food here is VERY FRESH!!! 

The wait was very minimal for lunch time. Even the drive through was expeditious. 

Great service and quality! I'll definitely be back!

They definitely live up to their 3 star reviews unfortunately.

Went in for late lunch early dinner (3-4pm).
Ordered the steak bowl, prime rib sandwich, wings, and drinks. 

The server brought out our food a bit later.
I let the server know she gave me the wrong food- I ordered a prime rib sandwich and she gave me a Philly cheese steak sandwich. 

She said she doesn't eat that type of meat and had no clue what prime rib is supposed to look like.
I told her no problem, but let the cook know my order is wrong please correct it.

The cook was rude to her and said 
I gave you a prime rib sandwich let them know.

He tried to pass off a Philly cheese steak sandwich with AuJus sauce as prime rib. 

Long story short the girl only made me pay for a Philly sandwich and not prime rib.

Although The servers are very kind and professional the kitchen staff are rude, inefficient, and unprofessional.

Probably reason why this location isn't so successful.

Hope they do better in the future.

Amazing NY Style Pizza! 

Popped in and out for a brief lunch!

The PIZZA IS GREAT! Very much like being in NY.
The pizza is fresh and made to order. Very affordable by the slice or pie!

They have short order kiosks for a touch free experience or order at the window in person.

Was quick and delicious!

Will definitely be back!

Stopped in on Sunday after 8pm. They were open with a few people sitting; eating and drinking. Stood at the front for about 5 minutes.

No one came over to host us into a table. The room off to the left of the restaurant entrance looked as if there was a bar fight that just finished up. Food and garbage all over the tables and floor.

The guests sitting closest to the door urged us that no one greeted them for over 10 mins when they got there until a manager noticed they sat down and came to take their order. 

We took their warning and started to head out the door.

Then a waitress came over and said Sorry, thanks for coming in and have a good night?!?! Huh???...

So... I gave them THREE stars. WHY? I would give them none on this visit HOWEVER I have had their wings twice before and I thought they were great!

They have the largest sauce menu available in the area as well.

Went to a Super Bowl Party last February and the host ordered Kickin Wings and they were delicious!

WHAT HAPPENED TO THIS PLACE???

Hope they get it together in there...

No stars on Yelp today at Brick House Tavern and Tap in Tampa Bay! Today is a big day for the Bucs and you are turning people away for service and dining at the door! Two thumbs down!! What Hospitality GM doesn't plan for patrons on game days with adequate amount of staff and availability? 10 people walked out the door the same time we did! I know times are tough but super disappointed today!

What a great venue for football Sundays! 

They get packed so be sure to get there early to find parking and a seat in the house!

The service is GREAT and the food is delicious!

The manager made it so fun every-time there was a touchdown!!! He made sure patrons had a great time and amazing service.

The drinks are great and the food is even better.

Their wings are the best!!!! You can't go wrong with their menu selection! What a great experience!

We will be back for sure!

HIDDEN GEM IN RIVERVIEW! The food here is both fresh and very delicious. The quality for the price point is spot on. This restaurant is very clean and follows strict COVID19 guidelines. 

The atmosphere here would be described as very quiet and quaint.

I highly recommend trying this place for amazing food if you haven't already.

I've ordered from this pizza place a couple times and they are amazing! Each time the pizzas are fresh and delicious.

The taste of their pizza  is very authentic. 
The workers are very kind and professional each time I've called or visited.

This is definitely the go-to pizza joint in the neighborhood!
I would definitely recommend them and order again in the future.

If you're ordering on the weekend it's best to call ahead or pick up. The delivery will take about two hours.

SNnzPR74qPZ6vXlm5Z5kMQ.review_text: The food is amazing. The cheesy potatoes (I'm not sure exactly what they are called) are to die for. Recommend this restaurant if you want to treat yourself.

Great customer service!!! I felt like I was being well taken care of by staff. The salad bar is small, but full of really eclectic and delicious picks. My steak was cooked to perfection. I recommend this restaurant if you want to be treated like you are part of the family.

The food and drinks were okay. The bartender seemed fairly indifferent and was on her phone texting when I had questions about the menu. I asked for recommendations considering that they ran out of several options I wanted and I felt that the server could care less about providing options. I was fairly disappointed by the service. The kale salad and fries were really good. My sandwich was okay (I had the Swiss and ham). I'm giving it three stars because the sides were delicious; sandwich could use a touch of more flavor; and service could use some improvement.

Excellent customer service!!! The truffle corn pudding is divine. Everything is so good. Highly recommend this restaurant. I felt like a queen being fully pampered. They even let us try some off the menu items. Amazing experience!!! I will be back!
Best wings and biscuits in town!!! Great desserts too. If you want some delicious, greasy food this is the spot to be.
The chicken wings and ribs literally melt off the bone. This place is one of the best BBQ places I've ever been too. Locally owned and a very special treat of Hermitage. Highly recommend it.

The atmosphere was really nice, but everything else was pretty mediocre for the price and wait. It took over thirty minutes to receive guacamole and chips and an additional hour to receive our food; which was disappointing considering they no longer had what either of us originally wanted to order. 

As a substitute, I ordered the brisket and my friend ordered the chicken. The brisket was dry and pretty bland. The chicken was also fairly bland. The sauces that went with the meat were pretty good. The tortillas and Texas toast were also disappointing.  I did enjoy my drinks. We did get a dessert, a key lime pie. It was very strange. It was like all the smokey taste that would have been good on the meat was in the pie. I think if I return it will be for drinks and not food.

Love the pancakes and hash browns. This is definitely one of my guilty pleasures. The pancakes are light, fluffy, and full of flavor. The syrup is perfectly sweet and the hash browns are cooked to perfection. The perfect spot to treat yourself for a carb overload. 
I usually come when there is no line and I can get pretty quick service (usually during the week).

The chicken is pretty commercialized for my taste. Not packed with the southern hotness and flavor as some of Nashville's more locally owned hot chicken places. The sides were mediocre. Overall, it was satisfactory, but does not meet up to the hype.

I had the bacon Apple crepe. It was very delicious and I don't really care for Crepes. The combination of the crepe, bacon, apples, syrup, and cheese were perfect. Service was good and food was amazing. I'll definitely be back.

Prince's chicken is a Nashville staple. The chicken is really spicy and packed with flavor. The chicken is never disappointing. The sides are okay, but nothing to go out of your way for. It's a must try if you are in the area.

I was a little skeptical at first. I'm not a really big snow cone person. I love Korean snow cones, so when I saw that they had ice cream in their snow cones I thought I'd give it a try. It was very much worth it. I had the tres leches and it was awesome!!  It had great rich flacked of Carmel and the ice cream was vanilla bean. A really nice blend. I can't wait to try other flavors. It is definitely worth a try if you want an experience full of flavor.
Gourmet ice cream and popsicles in Madison!!! Must try!!!! Amazing flavors, so hard to pick just one. I ended up buying 8 for my office. Major hit. Highly recommend!!!

I greatly enjoyed my time here. The portions were massive, hush puppies, onions, cornbread, and fish were delicious. Got a big pot of greens. I felt like I was in a hometown and rustic vibe. Might not be everyone's cup of tea, but I appreciated the down to earth at home atmosphere. The service was great. Had food coming as we sat down. Highly recommend if you are looking for a country style restaurant.

Service was amazing. The water service was on point. We had the chicken wings as an appetizer and they didn't really have a strong flavor; the fish lacked flavor also. The ribs were delicious. The presentation was beautiful. The atmosphere was great. They just need to work on the food.

The food here is absolutely amazing!!! The customer service is amazing!!! The best seafood in town (and maybe anywhere else) hands down. The chef definitely makes each bite with the best quality and love. I'm almost afraid to write this review out of pure selfishness to keep this diamond of a place hidden from the masses. The setup has an urban vibe, and can be easy to overlook as it is in a house, but don't let appearances fool you. The food here is some of the best in town.

Went to the new Party Fowl in Donelson. The food was subpar, and for some reason it seems to have less flavor than the original location. I also had the Bushwaker and it tasted like it was beginning to custard. I told the bartender that the machine might need to be cleaned, and no one even acknowledged my concern. I'm like can someone at least try it or look in the machine... I've worked in many restaurants and frequent many, and I can tell when things are off, and I felt like things maybe off with management. The service was also subpar. It took over fifteen minutes for someone to cash me out, and I had to have someone at the hostess stand take my check (which is not standard protocol). I didn't even see my waitress upon leaving. I am not giving one star because despite everything I don't feel like they were intentionally disrespectful, but I do feel like they can do better, and the food, drinks, and service are not at the standard of the location closer to downtown.

Love this place. Best Latin food in town. The rice and beans are amazing. The meat is cooked to perfection. The juices make you feel like you are on an island. You can tell the people who cook the food take pride in their flavors. Highly recommend.

Service was great and prompt. I ordered the snow crab legs with sausage in the medium Cajun. The seasoning they use is full of garlic and flavor. The sausage has a sweet side to it that really compliments the spice. Great food and service.

Might be the best beef stew I've ever had. I got the beef and carrot stew with rice noodles. It was the best food for a rainy day. Added the trimmings of cilantro, bean sprouts, crushed peanuts and basil to add more flavor. Left the jalapeños to the side already had tons of flavor. Very delicious. Will be returning.

I found this restaurant while visiting a few other restaurants in the area. This area is known for having really delicious restaurants, so I was excited to see this restaurant in the area. The restaurant is quaint and has a polished atmosphere. I will say that the art on the wall lacked diversity which was slightly disappointing. 

The food was okay, but not super exciting. We had the corn chowder and cheese fritters for an appetizer. They were okay, but I have had better. I did like the relish that came with the fritters. Very tasty. We also ordered the pork chop and duck. The meats have a nice wood smoked flavor. I think the pork chop was a little tough. The sauce and gnocchi that accompanied the duck lacked flavor. The macaroni and cheese that came with the pork chop was flavorful and had a nice jalapeño flavor. The cauliflower lacked flavor also. It wasn't the greatest compliment with the Mac and cheese and pork chop. I also had a Georgia mule with my meal, and it lacked flavor. Service was really nice. 

I would say it is a nice restaurant, good customer service, but nothing really special about the food.
Amazing food and prices. Some of the best soul food in town. I usually get the veggie plate. All of the veggies are delicious and comforting. The chicken and dressing is a favorite. Highly recommend.

SeicsNm0uFSAxQ95Ngwceg.review_text: We enjoy coming here regularly.  We love the smoked strip club, smoked tenderloin and warm cheddar crisps.  We've had many bottles of wine and tried their extensive draft beer selection.  Service and food is always great.
Love this place!  Try the flautas and margaritas.  Great happy hour specials.  We go here a couple times month.  Yummy!!!!

Ordered delivery-  delivery very fast.  Food not so good.  Ordered sweet and sour chicken for my daughter and the sauce was on the chicken and not on the side.  I was very disappointed.  My daughter is young and does not like the sauce.  I usually order it because it usually comes on the side.  Then we use the sauce for the crab ragoon and egg rolls.  I did not specify so that's my fault for assuming.  The crab ragoon and pork egg roll was very good.  The crispy chicken was also good and sauce was on the chicken so it wasn't very crispy.  It's kind of similar to sesame chicken.  Then I ordered my favorite Chinese food item beef  lomein.  The noodles were good but the beef was dry had no flavor.  There are many other places to try in U City so I won't be going back here anytime soon.  I'll keep you posted!
Great service and food.  Had the stuffed cheeseburger and fries.  Highly recommended for lunch.  Never tried the new dinner.  Would love to try the different meatballs soon.
Love this store.  It's a gem for families on a budget.  They have high end products for a small price.  We can go out and do things without having to worry about an outrageous grocery bill.

Great service and food.  Enjoyed the tacos and quesadilla.  We had the steak for both.  My in laws had the fajitas and enchiladas.  They really enjoyed both too.  The inside isn't fancy but the price is right.  They charge for more Togo food and won't tell you until you pay.

Always a hot spot in edwardsville.  Been going here for years.  The pizza and cinnamon bread is great.  Don't be fooled by the paneling the food is great.  Most people love the lunch special and salad bar.  I haven't had either in years.  Give it try!  Great for large families.

This is one of my favorite places to in St. Louis.  I love their sangria, Greek pizza, Pepperoni thin and deep dish.  The service is great and I love the atmosphere.  If you want great pizza, exceptional service and cool atmosphere then look no further to Pi.  If you are looking for a family place downtown try this one!  They are kid friendly with no kid menu.

The other night we picked up beef lomein and crab ragoon.  Can't go wrong with either!!  The crab ragoon is the best I've had in a long time.  I've always have trouble finding good Asian American food in St. Louis but this place has beat my expectations!  My daughter that's only 20 months loves the noodles.  I wish they delivered but are very close to our house.  I will be going back to try more!

I love Fortels!  I've had delivery at this one twice and they are pretty fast.  I didn't care for the buffalo chicken pizza.  I thought the chicken was dry.  Maybe they should use chicken from a rotisserie.  The pepperoni and green pepper is to die for.  Fresh ingredients for sure!!  I love their house salad and dressing.  I always add a salad onto my order.  The cheese garlic bread, jalapeños bites and onion strays are all great apps.

Today we ordered delivery and it was fast and good.  This is the best Chinese in St. Louis!!!  I can't believe how good it is.  My daughter (almost 2 years old) loves the lomein and General chicken.  This is the best fried rice I've ever had.  We'll be ordering from here more often.
Great little store.  This the only place that has Charlie Nobble custard.  The people in here are super friendly and always willing to help.  They know their regulars.

The pizza was good but they don't answer when they are busy and over cooked my mozzarella sticks.  I'm really disappointed with how they are running this joint.  Hope they find someone to help them over see business processes.

Went here for my birthday dinner with my mom and daughter and had wonderful time.  The staff and manager was accommodating and friendly.  The food was very good and fast.  Would like to try a date night with my hubby to enjoy more of the drinks and entertainment.  We hade the regular gyro and one with the andouille sausage.  Both were great!

Finally tried the original Pi on Delmar across from the Pageant for lunch today.  My daughter and I took her grandpa there for his birthday.  We had wonderful food, drinks and desserts.  Our server was attentive while also having a few other tables to manage.  We started off with meatballs as an appetizer and it also comes with two pieces of yummy garlic bread.  Grandpa had a glass of sangria and I had the Pi squared.  Both were also very good.  We had a thin crust pepperoni, sausage and green olive pizza.  I love the green olives.  They were fresh along with the rest of the pizza's crust, sauce, cheese and toppings.  We finished off with vanilla ice cream for my daughter and Grandpa had the S'more milk shake.  Phenomenal!  We left very full and happy.  Great place and service!!  Will be back for more.

Ordered their catering for a course at STLCC and was a success.  They made everything very easy from ordering to delivery.  Great catering menu online.  Everyone raved about the pizza and salad.  Would recommend the catering.  I'll have to try the dine in part soon.  Thank you from SLU PT Program!

I can say how much I LOVE their Meat Me in St. Louie!!!  It's the most amazing calzone I've ever ate.  I would recommend to try it with the spicy red sauce instead of the meat sauce.  I've never ate inside because we have a little one at home and she can't sit still so we order thru Postmates at least once or twice week.  If you loves calzones then you will love this place.  I've also tried the Duke and that is pretty good but it's hard to stray away from the STL.

I found that I love the chicken fettuccine.  It's very good and my husband loves the thin crust pizza.  The place looks like a hole in the wall.  I love the house salad but you have to add cheese.  They are wonderful cheese tubes with the garlic house dressing.  Love this place!!  So glad I gave it another chance.

Great food, place and people!!  I bought the beer and garlic brats.  Can't beat the taste.  Went to Grants Farm and had a brat there, found out they were from GW.  Won't buy them from anywhere else.  Had to wait a little but it was fine because it was hard to decide what to get.  Everything looks a amazing.  I'll be trying some deer sausage next time.  To be continued.....

I used the shake shack app and skipped the line.  The food was the bomb.com!!!  I had the shake shack cheese burger and my daughter had the hotdog.  Both great!!  The fries were crisp and good with their chili and cheese.  The chili is on the spicy side but good.  Worth the app and storage on your phone!!
Great little spot!  Cheesesteak and gyro were great.  Love the fries and mozzarella cheese sticks.  Great for on the go and if you're a good flat top cheesesteak!

We enjoyed carry out through door dash tonight.  Their platform doesn't have some of the older items we like but Tiara took care of us at Chang's.  We submitted our order through door dash and spoke with Tiara to make sure we could make those substitutions.  She was easy to work with and delightful.  We had the kung pao beef, garlic noodles, crab wontons and pork pot stickers.  We received our order in a timely manner and it was hot and delicious.

We enjoyed the hangover and hungry like a wolf.  They have an incredible deal on Tuesday and Wednesday.  You should look at their website.  The potato salad has too much mustard for me but my daughter loved her grilled cheese and applesauce.  We will be back as Arnold would say.

TXBlXlRepEljAkDpWjI8tg.review_text: I made reservations through the web site and had no problems. we spent five nights here. The king executive room is spacious and has a couch. There is a refrigerator but unfortunately no microwave. There is a restaurant and bar next door, you enter through the lobby. They have breakfast in the morning. We like this place and will return when we visit the area. Good location too. If you get a room in the back you can hear the train, and that's not a bad thing.
Great food and an extensive wine list.  The service was OK.
Great place!  You get soup and salad and garlic bread with your meal. The food was excellent and the service was good.

Best bakery ever. I grew up two blocks away and while I have been away many years I always remember the creme donuts. Now I am back for a visit and have to have some. They were like I remembered, but with  much more creme.  Actually it was too much creme. But they are still the best. I also got one of their pineapple cheese pies, which is like a cheese cake. Tomorrow, the day before Thanksgiving, my sister is going there at 7:30 AM to get the snowflake rolls before it gets too crazy. This place is the best.

Nice atmosphere, decent food and indifferent service. I ordered veal parmesan and wanted spaghetti instead of the "like mac and cheese" 
Astra that comes with it. They put the veal on one big plate and the spaghetti on another, very weird. Our server had a weird attitude, probably was just him. But everybody liked their dishes and we had a good time there.

Very slowwww getting a sandwich here. Good hoagies though, generous with the meat and light on the veggies. Good bread.  Nearly $20 for a small, a "primo" (medium) and two drinks, so not cheap. I would actually liked a little less meat and more veggies, and RIPE tomatoes.

Pretty good pizza but they won't give you any Parmesan!  What's up with that?  You can have oregano, garlic, red pepper but no cheese? That is so weird. In this family business the idiot generation must have taken over. The pizza did not seem as good as I remembered it.  I come back to visit about twice a year and always pay my respects to KOP.  our server was excellent and she did not give us any cheese. ;-).

Incredible shrinking crab cakes. They are incredibly good. I visit here once or twice a year and usually come to Bobby Chez' for crab cakes. I just remember them like almost softball size. Now they are hardly hardball size. Now that Bobby has found success is he following the lead of so many other companies that cut the portion and maintain the price?  It is great stuff though but not cheap to get those big lumps of crab meat.
I would not call this a "farmers market.". It's a store that has some produce and a few flowers. I was not impressed. The corn was shrink wrapped.
Love the historic atmosphere, the decor and location. Everybody was happy with their food and beers. The service was good too. This is a tourist restaurant worth visiting.
I have not tried the pizzas yet. I have gotten their cheesesteaks and hoagies a few times and I think they are very good. Nice people too.

This is not your father's diner.  It is a diner reinvented for foodies. It has the Art Deco diner atmosphere, but the old diner classics have some different and healthier options. If you want a regular diner, you might not like it. We have eaten here twice, and had very good experiences both times. Both food and service was very good.
Nice atmosphere, great service and good menu. One star off for price/value. We had the broccoli raab and a margherita pizza. Both were excellent. I would return.

Everything was excellent, except we did not like the beet salad too much. You should start with the salad selection and a hummus.  They have four types of hummus.  They serve a bread like a nan bread with that.  Then you order small plates.  There are lots of vegetarian options.  I could not adequately describe them, but every one was very good.  After the large salad selection, a hummus and four small plates, our party of four was too full for the big plates.  We just went straight to desert.  Our bill with beers was about $55 each with tip.  Definitely a great place, and something different.  I have eaten in Middle Eastern restaurants before, but this is a notch above.

This is Cuban food kicked up a notch.  We took advantage of the Restaurant Week $35 prix fixe four-course menu.  It was a lot of food, but a bargain.  We had scallop ceviche, rellenos, lechon and arroz con pollo.  Everything was excellent, including the flan for desert. Every dish had excellent presentation and great flavors. My regular Cuban places will never seem the same.
It is a joint. But the pizza is very good! I would certainly recommend it for a quick bite in the Olde City.
The service was excellent and the atmosphere is very nice. Excellent hot bread too. I can't complain about the food either. It was very good.

I can't believe I just paid $9.00 for such a small and mediocre cheese steak. It was skimpy, dry and tasteless. The atmosphere is cold and sterile. Service was good though. I will not return. Overpriced for sure.

Chubby's needs to step up its service if they expect to charge these prices; and buy a pepper grinder; and none of the staff should be wearing jeans. Service was inattentive and brusque when offered. The bread basket came with about a tablespoon of butter. I asked for more and got another tablespoon. Never had a refill on the water until asked. The wedge salad for was good but the waiter had to go to the bar to get even a pepper shaker. I think they only have one in the place because another server came to get it later. Food was generally good. My steak was overdone on half just because it was not cut evenly. It came with just an escarole salad and a dollop of mashed potatoes would have improved it immensely. I have written this whole review after the waiter cleared the plates and before he came back to check if we wanted anything else. Parking is on the street. 

This is nothing like the original that I remember. It's not bad but not quite worth the price. Dinner for three was $145, salads, entrees and the least expensive bottle of wine. The wine was quite nice for the price.
Too bad it is closing because PJ's bought the building or so I hear from other reviews. I saw her moving out today. So sad.
Great service and great food.  Stopped for brunch and had huevos rancheros. They were different but very good.  Portions were generous. Service was very good.

We have eaten here before and always had a good meal.  Last evening the veal Parmesan might have been cardboard with one slice of cheese on top, and everything was totally over-sauced.  The scampi was dry.  Service, as always, was excellent.  Maybe they had a problem in the kitchen last night.

Coming from California, I have been in very many Mexican restaurants.  This is the best one ever.  It is beautifully furnished, with great atmosphere, all first class.  They have a full bar and everything was very good.  Service was excellent too.  Highly recommended.

All the food was very good.  The lobster roll (special) was the best ever in California.  New York steak was perfectly done. The flan was wonderful and creamy. Rose sangria also was most excellent.  Service was good although the food took a while.

Everything was so good, especially the lamb shank.  We stopped here after visiting the Eastern State Penitentiary.  There is limited outdoor seating on the sidewalk.  Service was very good. Great for people watching too.

I ordered veal parmigiana for take out and it was one of the worst ever. It was dry and tough with maybe a trace of cheese and very little sauce.  The generous portion fed the garbage disposal.  Served on top of dry spaghetti with red sauce.  This is chain restaurant food at its worst.  I liked the bread and butter,  that was the best part of the meal.
Not much old time soda fountain vibe here. The food was just OK and it was a little pricey. Service was good.

This was takeout. We had to roll the windows down on the way back because it smelled bad. The fish was OK but the coating was more soggy and soft than crispy.  The fries were overdone.  Also had the roasted beet and goat cheese salad.  The beets were indistinguishable from canned and in big hunks. It was very light on the goat cheese and walnuts, barely detectable.  Is short, nothing was good. 

P.S. - The SCONE I saved for the morning was the worst ever tasted.  Bad texture too.  It is inedible.

I thought that this has to be good because who would come here to get pizza?  But I got a cold pie.  The Margarita Pizza was very pretty but won't be finished.  It was like a tomato pie with a dollop of burrata cheese and a single basil leaf on each slice.  And it cost a lot.  I thought the crust was pretty good and maybe I will give them another chance and get a cheese pie.  But I was disappointed. It should at least be hot.

Never been here before.  We ordered a couple of pasta dishes and both were quite good in spite of being over sauced. That is the one star deduction.  The meal came with generous bread (garlic toast and bread) and salad.  The house Pinot Noir was very good.  The service was friendly and attentive.  Prices are reasonable. We definitely would return,

This restaurant failed to deliver my delivery completely. Grubhub said they got it but never made it.  That made me call Grubhub three times. And that is not a pleasant experience. I wasted a lot of time and got no food.  Total failure by Seasons Pizza.  Never order from Seasons Pizza or Grubhub through Yelp again.

Had a good meal here on the patio.  The menu is not very big.  The gnocchi was good.  All were well pleased. Service was a little challenged. The servers had to bus and that's hard on good service. But good effort was made and all was fine.  Nothing too special here for me but I would return.  $3.00 scoops of ice cream for desert, not premium but just right.  (They had other deserts too.)

I have been very disappointed with the quality of the products purchased here, especially the produce. I have had to return decayed produce twice recently.  Last week I saw decayed berries being put right out on the shelf.  I even got a rotten watermelon, first time ever.  Produce generally is looking wilted and in poor condition. I just threw out their 365 mayonnaise because it tastes bad and looks like yellow matter custard.  The bread and bakery option are limited.  I do like the fresh meat and seafood counters better. And of course, we all now about the process.  My Amazon Prime saves next to nothing.

U8RoyRIRrmsxHz-A0IBz3A.review_text: The bartender with the short blonde hair (sorry don't know her name) was great. She was the host and bartender last night.... seemed very busy but served us right away, kitchen was super busy and she made sure she told us there would be a wait and kept asking us if we were ok. She really seemed attentive and unfortunately now in days thats not common. Anyway, great food and drinks were not watered down! I would definitely come here again.
Came here on Labor Day and the bartender Althea was great. I was surprise to see a nice chill crowd on a holiday. Food came out fast as well. Would def come here again.
Service was great. Second time coming here. It was packed but it was also restaurant week. Our server was Michael he was very nice. Like I said... Busy but the service was still great
Food was good but I'm not sure if they were short on staff or if it was just because it was extremely busy but the wait was LONG.

I have been coming here for 6 years. Brittiany is my hair dresser I love and followed her when she got transferred to haldeman hair Cuttery and didn't even care about the traffic!!! I was so excited when she came back to her original location (cottman). She's the best and the only one that can handle my super curly hair to get it straight.
Service was fast and good. Pulled pork sandwich was delicious. Mixed crowd, very chill atmosphere.
Came here for happy hour. Although extremely busy the waitress got to us very quickly and it was only a 15 minute wait to get a table.
Came here for a V day with the girls very busy obviously because of the holiday but it was still nice and quit and all the waiters were very attentive.
Super fast service and good food. Never get tired of this place. Staff is also very friendly.
Food came out quick and it was great. If your a spicy lover their potstickers are phenomenal.
This is one of my favorite places to eat at. The food and service is always great. Servers and chefs are polite. And they actually have a good wine.

It's been a couple of years since I've been here and all I have to say is that it has changed. I know Olive Garden is not a five-star restaurant but the quality of food has definitely taken a turn for the worse. Theee different servers dropped glasses and dishes. I guess you get what you pay for but this place was definitely not like this several years ago. I'm not saying I will never return but I probably will just come for a quick drink and that's it.

I absolutely love this place. I was introduced to this place by a good friend of mine we met Michelle the bartender and let me tell you I don't really come here for the food or the drinks I come here more for her! She's so super cool, she is the official super bartender! The food here is great the view is also wonderful I have never been here in the winter but it's a great summer place.

Live jazz can't be better. A bartender from Ireland and the best company ever.   I have never been here before, but the guy who introduced me to it was spot on. I can't decide what is better, the food, drinks or the guy who looks much better in person than his profile pictures
I stopped in here while home shopping. Very nice and quiet and the food was delicious
Come here all the time. I'm Puerto Rican and this is one of the places that you can come to still get authentic Spanish food.
