I can't speak of the atmosphere, but can vow to the flavor and comfort of this food. I had the braised short rib over grits with arugula and peanut. The satisfaction of a heavy  & generous southern meal with contemporary twist. Yum!

YASSSS!!!
I crawled out of bed New Years day with MAJOR HANGER, posing a considerable threat to society if unable to consume an omelet STAT. After walking to a closed restaurant without warning and exploring a few more with an earth shattering hour+ wait, I was slipping into desperation and mentally preparing to retreat my brunch fantasies when... RED DOG DINER.. 4.5 stars on yelp. 2017 has me charmed already.

Conclusion: 
*Drinks: Best bloodymary of my LIFE. I need one now (post workout at 7PM- that is how good). Also, this cocktail menu is incredibly incredible. I absolutely hate whiskey but I sure as hell am getting "The early bird gets the whiskey" next trip. 

*Food: Curry roasted cauliflower, Brisket hash, and Crabby shrimp omelets all ordered at our table. Brisket hash was deemed winner but all were incredibly satisfying. Obviously was creeping on other peoples plates and was salivating. That BACON y'all!

*Atmosphere: Just the best. Great design and flow. 

I can't wait to go for lunch, dinner and brunch again and again and again.

Went here a few friends from out-of-town for a Friday night dinner. I can't say the food was disappointing HOWEVER, I do regret having spent the $$ I did for this meal. I'm talkin $35 for a petite ribeye that was just soooo forgettable. My food opportunist is dying inside thinking about what that budget would have gotten me at another place. I'm sure it would have included goosebumps and a lot of closed-eyed while moaning chewing. And yea, let's talk about this menu.. ah very limited with general dishes (short rib, steak, burger, shrimp). I actually didn't really want any of the options but when I attempted to get whatever is cheapest and could satisfy my hanger, there's just no decent option. Cheapest plate is $25... so, VERDICT: not going back here and not recommending. So many amazing options in New Orleans and this place just doesn't cut it

I know it's not possible to get married in this venue but can I actually just marry this venue? My eyes are physically turning into hearts and my tongue is hanging out of my mouth thinking about this place. This cocktail menu is PHENOMENAL guys. I ordered the "Charleton" (I think that was the name) and woahhh I'm going to be bold and say it was the best cocktail.. I've ever had. Yep. Yep. Not to mention it's obviously a kick ass, interesting building. I just love it. Please go here. Thank you for existing, Vessel. I  U

Pho or ramen? We've all struggled with this choice. From all of us who have been forced to choose, Thaaaaank you MoPho for bringing the rich broth and various bowl choices of ramen to the delicious noodles and spice of pho. I love the CHOICES here. Ox tail, flank, hog cheese, mushroom... i could go on. You can honestly get everything you want here. Gourmet chicken wings? check. Fancy cocktail? check. Patio? check. I'm so happy that I finally went to this place and am sure you will be too.

STUDY FRIENDLY! 
If you're feeling studious but also would like to see the sunlight of the outside world, Rue de la Course is your place. 
The shop is very spacious so you can be to yourself for quiet time or far enough not to bother neighbors during group discussion. 
Thanks to the 2 story windows, it is filled with natural light--!!! This is definitely one of the most beautiful coffee shops in New Orleans. It's also a one stop shop if you want coffee andddd you're hungry. BAGEL SAMMICHES!! I say this place covers all the bases. Hoo-ra!

Great quick stop for lunch. One thing that makes this possible is the small menu size. While this is great for the indecisive, it poses a problem when a key ingredient is out of stock (ahmm hummus at a vegan based restaurant). Ultimately, I was let down that I couldn't get the wrap I was craving and was left with few options. However, my default choice was tasty (tofu wrap) and my body was satisfied. Nothing less, nothing more. Thus, 3 stars overall.

Quintessential "I want fairly greasy pizza but to hell if I'll get dominoes" place. I have to say... the Stromboli is the actual winner of the menu (sorry 'za). The cheese situation, guys.. at times, I thought I was eating a mozzarella stick. So, you CAN have it all (pizza, mozzarella stick, daily veggie intake (?)) 

Important to know: for TAKE OUT be prepared to wait. This is not the typical 15-20 minutes. This will take approx 40 mins so plan your appetite accordingly
This place remains my favorite vegetarian place. I'm still thinking about the potato skillet that I had 4 months ago with an drooling, open mouth posture. nomnomnom

There are no "hit or misses" with this place. It is ALWAYS a hit. You want a casual dinner? Hit. What about some dinner date ambiance? Hit. How about some tasty, fresh takeout where they DON'T cut your portions? Hit. Not to mention, the service is always attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly. 
As for the FOOD... falafel plate has it all, and it is all wonderful. That SLAW y'all!! I mean what?? How are they making something SO healthy SO good? It's honestly a miracle. You know about the Brussel sprouts (per every other yelper) they are incredible. Had the lamb hummus.. guess what? Amazing too. Once again, no misses here. Just close your eyes and point a finger on the menu....you'll be happy.

Y'all... best advice for tackling this place is to get 7-10 people together and split every single thing on the menu. EVERYTHING looks amazing and everything we had was amazing. Honestly, the sides were shockingly just as good as the entrees. It was difficult to pick a "winner" order. The service is 100% and the atmosphere is unintimidatingly chic. On top of a great atmosphere and food offerings, their cocktail list is unique with an exciting mix of ingredients and liquors. That being said, Saffron would make for a great place to grab a drink or 2 before or after dinner. All in all, this place doesn't miss a mark and should be one of your top dinner choices in the city.

You will never have to compromise at this bar. A creative cocktail menu and local beer offerings tucked into a warm, intimidating atmosphere. Everyone in this bar is friendly, creating a close-knit environment and the bartender, Keith is especially attentive and friendly to all. I especially love the setup that includes a nice comfy couch, loveseat, and coffee table.. honestly all it needs is a fireplace and I'd probably never leave (#COZY). We have been here a few Sundays to watch "The Walking Dead" and Keith makes tacos (!!!//free). He also has live music almost everyyyy night which is IMPRESSIVE. Go Sidebar!!

ALMOND MILK. Words fail to describe how fresh, natural, and flavorful Mammoth's homemade almond milk is. While I'm sure all of their drinks are great, considering the descriptive menu and knowledgeable staff, I have gotten an almond milk latte each time- it's that good!! I rank mammoth #2 in my top NOLA coffee shops because of this drink. I just torture myself writing this review at 10PM.. need it now.

There is a whole lotta good about this place. Great menu variety, fun, contemporary play on ingredients as well as an awesome cocktail menu. 

Food report: ok 1st, BRUSSEL SPROUTS. I am a little ashamed to admit this was rated best dish ordered (including appetizers and entrees) in 3/3 tasters. This is not to discredit the other items ordered, but wowza they good. I will say, I was fairly disappointed the pasta dish- Saffron pappardelle. Something about the pasta itself that I was really feeling. 

The restaurant itself is quite large and could accommodate larger groups while still allowing privacy for a date. The decor is very fresh, modern and warm. 

Overall, this is one of the most diverse and affordable menus without sacrificing quality. A top rec for the CBD/quarter area.

Ok finally, I have found my go-to, "I just kinda want something lighter. Like a sandwich or salad" locally based restaurant (sorry Zoe's). The menu is short, but comprehensive and enough to make you want multiple things. The sandwiches are "guilt-free HEFTY" as in, you're definitely full but aren't too hard on yourself after. I especially loved their bread and am looking forward to trying the sour dough next visit. Salads are also large and definitely filling.

This is a solid BBQ place. I love that the meat is cooked WELL and does not need to be smothered in sauce. While the meat is good, I have to say the brussel sprouts are my favorite thing here . They also have a great beer selection with lots of local brews. 
The outdoor area is great for a nice day and they often have a large screen TV outside for games. My only complaint is that the food often comes out before a table is available. This mostly happens on a busy weekend night... something to consider!

Eh... Ikura satisfies my sushi craving without putting my bank account into overdraft. And for that, I am thankful. The fish could be fresher and more flavorful but then... it wouldn't be as cheap. In sum: good place for a weeknight dinner and nothing beyond that.

My favorite breakfast place in Midcity. I have been to Toast at least 8 times and I get excited and "yummy dance" each time. So far, I've had every single crepe, the lox style Toast and ratatouille Toast. I mean honestly, none of those things are items you come by down here and it's affordable! Whaaaat. They also serve drinks/cocktails, so have no fear. My one caveat is that it's tiny and if going on a weekend, expect to wait. BUT there is a bar next door that opens early so.. have a drink while waiting. The BEST thing is that you're allowed to bring your drink in once you're table is ready

Wow you mean I can get some kind of poboy other than a fried something something smothered in some kinda somethin? 
I love that killer poboys offers new and creative combos on traditional po boy bread that we all know and love. 
We had the cauliflower and brisket debris poboy. Although the cauliflower was awesome, there was MUCH satisfaction from all that debris. So, I would recommend that one. As a side, those greens man.... get em'. So savory and best greens I've ever had.

EXCUSE ME BUT I AM OVERWHELMED AT HOW FREAKING GOOD THIS RAMEN IS. I feel very passionate about expressing how DELICIOUS this place is... but I don't think I can. Please go here and taste for yourself. The menu is small (this is a good thing) because all options look amazing. Ultimately, we went with the huxtabowl and crispy chicken ramen as well as the curried chicken dumplings. Everything was shockingly good. I'm very upset it took me 2 years to get here... lots of missed foodgasms

WHAT THE WHAT!! I'm not even... or previously WAS NOT a wing person.. I mean. I can't with this place. SO GOOD. After shoveling wings into my mouth, all I could say was #PraisedBe. I vow to never each a chicken wing anywhere else because honestly..why waste the money$$$$.

bnEioqv9m6p-pJGOG4_ujA.review_text: Delicious Chinese food. I have been eating here since this place opened in the 1990s and it has been my favorite Chinese place ever since. Clean food, excellent service, and lightning fast takeout.
Ordered delivery from Oscar's. Good pizza crispy crust and fast delivery. Will order from this place again.
Met some friends here for lunch and a little day drinking. Bartender was very attentive, and the food was good. I'd go here again.

I have been eating here since I was a child in 1988. I absolutely love this place, and my husband does too.  The pumpkin mushroom soup is delish, and I haven't had an entree I haven't loved!  Worth the money, great place to reconnect with your spouse.

My husband and I had breakfast and coffee here today.  Both of the owners were working, and were very helpful and friendly!  The local ingredients are a plus, and the food was prepared beautifully. I had the 2 eggs any style (I had over easy) with bacon added. It was a great deal of food for the money, and it wasn't greasy or heartburn inducing, as many breakfast places can be.  My husband had the kale and bacon hash, which he loved.  The lattes were yummy, with full bodied tasty espresso used.  We just loved this place.  We will be back as often as possible.  I love a locally owned, locally sourced business. Supporting this place is a great idea, come, eat, drink coffee and feel good about buying local and supporting passionate local business owners.

Good bacon burgers.   Sometimes staff can mess up a simple order, so be clear about what you want. I haven't had an issue with that lately though.  Juicy burgers, crisp salty thick fries - yum.  I don't recommend calling in an order, it seems they wait for you to show up before beginning your food, so you might as well go in and order.  Eat some free peanuts while you're there.

Had breakfast here again, delicious!  They now make their own mocha syrup for coffee drinks, which I love.  The food is amazing, I ordered the same as last time, my husband got the caramel apple pancakes. My meal was just as great as the first time, and the Carmel apple pancakes were like circles of heaven. I highly recommend coming for breakfast or lunch, you will not regret it.

Went here to order out a bakers dozen bagels.  They had a very large variety of flavors of bagels, at 10:30 am.  We got the blueberry, cherry vanilla, chocolate chip and two cinnamon crunch. The blueberry is always good,  cherry vanilla has a tart twist due to the type of cherries used.  Chocolate chip is self explanatory, but the cinnamon crunch was a treat!  More like dessert, but very good with cream cheese.  We were impressed with the quantity and variety of the breads available as well.  Maybe get a loaf here for Sunday night dinner?  We didn't have a meal here but I hear the food is good.

I had the wings here when a friend and I went to lunch yesterday. I ordered the wings medium, and they were prepared to order. The wings were tender yet well cooked. The dreamer fries were good too. Crispy with parm cheese all over them. My friend enjoyed her egg salad sandwich, that she gets there all the time.

Great locally roasted coffee.  I also enjoy the chocolate covered espresso beans. Located inside Zingos supermarket, it's a little stand that sells coffee beverages and whole bean as well as ground coffee. Try the blends, just fantastic!

We call this "the good wawa."  They always get orders placed correct, and they make their sandwiches very well.  The staff is nice and helpful.  They also make a very good pumpkin spice latte for $3.00, a great price for a specialty coffee drink.

We found this restaurant by searching on Yelp. We had just moved to the area and didn't know what pizza delivery to try. We read the reviews and boy they were right! The pizza was New York style, although it was a tad thicker than traditional New York style pizza. The toppings were fresh, and delicious! We ordered the cannoli Puffs, they were cinnamony and buttery goodness in a takeout container. We also got the sweet potato fries which my husband and I both enjoyed. This will be our new go to take out pizza place!

Had a delicious birthday dinner at back burner tonight.  I had the shrimp was on which was delicious the corn and crab chowder which was good and I also had the fillet en crute. That was delicious as usual. My husband had the veal porterhouse and it was delicious. Our server was courteous and attentive, we had a great time! We will be back. The signature drink, the border was  amazing!  Light and sweet. Perfect with antipasti cheeses and meats before appetizers. Bravo Back Burner. This life time customer will be back.

I came here with some co-workers for lunch. I was quite surprised how good this place was!  As I entered, the aroma I smelled was heavenly. Warm soups, and fresh bread. When in line, friendly staff offered small samplers of the soup, as many as you like!  I tried the lobster bisque, and cream of mushroom. They were simply delicious.  I had a turkey sandwich on French bread with cheddar cheese. It was perfection. Crusty bread, fresh spinach, moist turkey - yum. I bet take out from here would be great on a cold rainy day. Eat this in from of your fireplace or fire pit for extra coziness.

What a cool place that dates to American Colonial times!  The place feels like somewhere George Washington stopped to water his horse and have a meal and flagon of ale.  The food was also delicious. I had the pot roast, which was tender and moist. The gravy was perfect. My hubby had a burger, which he described as one of the best. We had sweet potato fries with the caramel sauce- woah!  These are fantastic. Salty and sweet, why has no one done this before. My husband had a true flagon of ale, and I had a root beer so I wouldn't feel left out. This is the place to go if you are into local Delaware history, or simple rustic food. Come here after visiting  ft. Delaware!

We went here for breakfast one busy Saturday morning, May 2016. The full dining room and the constant stream of patrons were good signs. I had the 3 eggs and scrapple, my hubs had the French toast. Both were delicious. Good old fashion breakfast comfort food.  We are going to come back for dinner. They don't take credit cards, but the do have an ATM in the back. We will be back!

Went here after work with some buddies for margaritas and food. The drinks were well made, and the food was amazing. I'm not normally a Mexican food fan, but the steak and chicken fajitas were delicious. The seasoning was yummy by itself but the toppings just made it more delicious. The marinade in which the chicken and beef sat was really good too, and added to the seasoning of the dish.  I would go back to this place.

Friendly service, good old fashion diner food; and wine and beer if you're so inclined. The chicken noodle soup is good, and the sandwiches and burgers are flavorful.  I also like the cherry pie a la mode. A good place for a family meal and super nice staff!

Friendly service, good old fashion diner food; and wine and beer if you're so inclined. The chicken noodle soup is good, and the sandwiches and burgers are flavorful.  I also like the cherry pie a la mode. A good place for a family meal and super nice staff!

Food was good, well cooked, crispy fries. The dinning room was dirty, there was a film of grease/dirt/grime on the non functioning juke boxes. I wish they still worked. The tv was on a terrible daytime talk show. The food though was tasty. Burger was juicy and perfectly cooked. Chicken sandwich was good as well. Our waiter was kind and attentive. It's a shame there was a layer of grime in the dining room. All cleaned up that place would be a Jem.  Nice view of the trees!

brwx3_ZbrER7fFHWWKutmQ.review_text: Overpriced for food quality, taco salad for example.  Everything from the fryer tastes the same and is often overcooked.  Chili requires lots of condiments. Light lunch is taken very literal, 3 bite sandwich. However, most of the sandwiches are pretty good. Great Service! Potential to be a Gem...

Gave this place two opportunities. Tried the Euro and the Greek salad. Pita bread is below par along with the food quality.
Fast service though...
did not have the experience most people had on here. Burger was ok, definitely does not deserve all the hype. You will definitely walk out this place smelling like one though.

Very disappointing. Went with the Mania Pizza(supreme) medium18$!!! Hot out the box the dough was soggy wet in the middle. Had to reheat in my oven to get the crispness back,  pieces of pep and sausage very sparring and and virtually no mushrooms to be found. Menu said double cheese, I would beg to differ. Just stick with a simple pizza with these guys 2 topping max. They cant handle much more
Food is getting better...Homefries are delish! Bacon is nice and thick. Great place for breakfast.
The Orange and the General TSo Chicken!Yummm. Explosion of real flavor! Nice and meaty unlike other Chinese food that's all breading.

Cupcakes, stale!!!! Icecream, frostbit!!! I don't know where these 5 stars are coming from but this place is nothing but a disappointment! And that's sad to say.


Girlfriends comment:  Freezerburnt icecream with stale sprinkles. Atmosphere is dim, needs lighting.  Wast even sure if it was open

Pizzas pretty good! The overpriced Greek salad however is disappointing! No quality! potato salad...ehhh

will try the pizza again....
Nice little place with decent food! Great salad
Hidden GEM! Atmosphere is very authentic and high quality. Very quiet and romantic setting. Food is delicious!

Nachos are like overwhelmingly delicious (: atmosphere is awesome so creative (: 
And the fact you can have a beer and chill in such a place with nachos without it being a sports bar kinda thing  Is cool 
Love Tijuana flats

I believe their menu is too large making the food just mediocre.
Hot dog was horrible. I took one bite and could not eat no more. I love hot dogs, I can even eat the cheap ones from the grocery store. breakfast is better
Best healthy burger around. Fresh unique toppings and as many as you want! Can't wait to go back. Little pricey, but you get what you pay for here!

Best Greek in the area !!!high quality low price

Good all around pizza.  Anymore than a thin crust,  it is just too doughy, like it didn't cook. And sadly, They go light on the toppings. Additional toppings rack up the price real quick. Still not a bad pizza.
Best pork chop in the world. Cornbread and asparagus point. Roomy atmosphere. Great for winter meal. Would make 200 mile trip just to come back here

cKWBI9GFrjHMJhcZ2ptb0g.review_text: Service was terrible, specifically the manager. Didn't get what we ordered and the food was at best average. Probably won't go again. If you want Italian, there are plenty other better places to eat.
The best Italian food in the city of Nashville...bar none. Bring your own wine if you want it with your dinner. I HIGHLY recommend the ziti or the caprese salad. The pizza is also out of this world.

Fantastic. I ordered the Winter Salmon roll and it was really really good. I have probably been to Minami 3 times. This is the first review I am writing but could have easily written 5 star reviews for the other 2 times I went. I have not had a bad meal there.
Ridiculously good burgers. I highly recomnend the Republic burger. Probably the best burger I have EVER had.
One of my favorite places to eat in Brentwood. I always get the small burrito. The fruit tea is really good.
The cubano is really good.  The toasted roll is awesome. Also try the sweet plantanes.

Really good. I highly recommend this place. They are new. I like new and clean restaurants.  The opposite of kitchen nightmares!  The rainbow roll had really fresh fish in it. The fried rice was very good. Friendly abd helpful service. Lunch specials are very affordable.  I plan on going back soon

Really good. The free breadsticks for being a Yelper is always nice but the star of the show was the panoony pile-up. My daughter and I got the medium and free breadsticks and it was way more than we could eat. The people were very nice to us.

This is probably the best deli i have ever been to. Ezra, who runs the place, gave us so much food i didnt know what to do with all of it. 
I got the hot pastrami sandwich and it was ridiculously good. Ezra is the man and Koch's deli is a must for anyone hungry in the city of Philadelphia. However long it takes...its worth it.

Sick! Everything is unreal good. I'm having an event in mid February 2016 and he's going to cater it. The shrimp and grits, skillet beans, smashed potatoes, fried catfish, hot chicken are all awesome. Must go place to eat lunch.
This place is so consistently good. I've been here 20 times. I usually get the Rainbow roll and fried rice. Both are excellent!!
Unreal service. Queso is really good. Sampler is really good. If you're in Nolensville, come here for a beer and/or appetizers. That's what we did.
One of our family's favorite restaurants. The grilled chicken basket is what I always get. The fried pickles are very good. The macaroni balls are really good too.
Best BBQ in Nashville. Everyone else is playing for second. Everything is fantastic. With BBQ sauce, everything is unbeatable.

This past Saturday at 11am, I experienced some of the famous customer service this location has a reputation for (see 2 star review). It was an awful experience. If you're in the mood for some of the worst customer service in middle TN (maybe you miss the Northeast and long for that kind of "customer service") then head on down to this location. Here's what you might be so lucky to experience: Employees who actually get angry with you, bad service, less than dunkin donut quality donuts and more! 

This location is a perfect example of a business that will likely survive in spite of itself and because it does, keep the current owners from making any changes or expecting better. Loyal fans of Dunkin coffee, donuts, and Baskin Robbins ice cream will come anyway right? 

I personally can't wait to go again to see if they can do any worse than the service I received on my last visit. 

Wait..McDonald's has good coffee and they just came out with Donuts! On second thought I'll take my business and interest in the Golden rule elsewhere.

I'm not sure how this place has a 4 star rating at the time I'm writing this review. At best, this is in the 3 star range. Have you had the Mac and cheese? It has not taste. What we had to eat for $49 was not consistent with 4 stars. I gave it a 2 because this rating needs some honesty.
I've been here one time. But, the one time I have been here was fantastic . The White Tuna sashimi was really good...so was everything else Looking forward to going again.

I've never been more shocked at a rating than this one. Over 2,000 reviews and a 4-star rating?!?! Are you serious. The fries (both sweet potato and regular) were soggy. The hamburger was below average.  I shared my experience with 2 other people who also said they didn't like to food either. Maybe it's fun. Maybe the atmosphere is cool. The food, however, is not good.

cMSZp7Go1bPKEQMYqStaXA.review_text: My boyfriend always make it a point to come here when he visits Santa Barbara. Good pad thai, good tom yum, good review from me. It's still hilarious every time my boyfriend tries to order "tom yum gai" and they think he wants "tom kha kai" which is the coconut soup.
Good chinese food for Santa Barbara. This one waitor always makes funny comments and was offended when my friend didn't drink the soup. This is where I usually go if I am craving Chinese.
Good smoothies. I love the Lise Fellini. I also love the sauteed tofu. Great alternative dining in SB.
The lady that works there is really nice and the broth is really good and served hot. And they upgraded from a small TV to a plasma.

How I miss OTT. I will be back though. Ever since I turned 21, we have been riding our bikes there almost every Wednesday night without fail. Cheap drinks, drunk people and karaoke. And now a free Bill's bus to get there. Does it get any better?

Okay so its not the most authentic sushi place I have ever been to...(I'm sure you can tell by the name) but I am a broke college student and this will suffice. My roommate and I enjoy coming here for half-price sushi during the week. I always get the fisherman's roll and salmon nigiri. 

Pros: miso soup comes with your meal, bennihana style, half-price sushi on weekdays

Cons: not good for groups (if you just order sushi, you have to sit at the sushi bar), sometimes it gets really crowded, not the best sushi in SB but decent (especially for the price)

After an exhausting two weeks of volunteering at the SBIFF, we got to closing night and a fellow volunteer suggested Spice Avenue after our shift. I had never been there before but I love Indian food so I was willing to give it a try. I ordered the tikka masala and naan. Both were delicious.

I find myself craving Woodstock's sometimes. It brings me back to my freshman year when we would order it at midnight and have it delivered to the furthest dorm on campus, FT. Great pizza. I usually get the veggie delight. Their crust is stuffed with marinara sauce and their toppings seem fresh. Now that I am 21, I can say they have good beer on tap. And what's better than beer and pizza? I cannot think of much else. Minus one point cause it always seems to take really long. But maybe thats cause I'm always starving when I get there.

I agree, FUCK FREEBIRDS. Its all about Super Cuca's. Great drunk food but also great sober food too. I cannot walk by it when I am heading back to my apartment because my fat ass will always want some. I like that they are open late, have a greater selection than Freebirds, is slightly cheaper and is delicious. I usually get the regular burrito with carne asada or the bean/rice/cheese burrito. I heard their breakfast burritos are good but I have yet to try one. Blasphemous, I know.

Okay I really love the Mercury Lounge and always go here when the line at OTT is too long. However, the last time I was there, my boyfriend and I both ordered two bottles of Franziskaner. It costs like 2 dollars at the store but cost us 8 dollars each. I cannot justify paying that much for beer in a bottle. Their beer on tap is only 5 dollars. But despite that, I like the laid back atmosphere. I usually like to go out back and enjoy the heater and free popcorn. I once got a massage from a massage therapist I met there. That was awesome. And I learned to play pool there.

Say no to Freebirds. Freebirds is acceptable if you are a freshman at UCSB but once you hit your 2nd year, you should have expanded to Super Cuca's or The Cantina. Freebirds is severely overpriced. I cannot justify paying 10 dollars for a burrito and waiting in a line that goes out the door to pay that much, even if I am drunk. The only good thing is that they have black beans. But really, try Super Cuca's or The Cantina. Bigger selection and value for your money. We're poor college kids, remember? Well maybe not in Santa Barbara.

Okay so my boyfriend and I came here after Rachel Ray's "$40 dollars a day" in Santa Barbara episode premiered on the Food Network. It's good but not really worth the hype or the drive. We went there for breakfast once and I didn't taste anything special. The place is nice though. It seems like it kept with the old tradition. But on that note, whats with all the biker guys outside? And how come it seems like they have never seen an Asian girl before?

My boyfriend and I rode our bike here from UCSB. It was worth it. Good portions, good taste but I think the greasiness of the tortilla chips give me a sort throat sometimes. I don't like the chicken burrito there but everything else I have tried is good including the torta, carne asada burrito, red/green enchiladas and tacos.

Mmmm so good. I have only been here once but I enjoyed it thoroughly. I think the portions are a bit small but so is the price. I guess it gives you room to try a bit of everything. Good selection, big menu. I will go back.

3.5 stars. I've had some good times here. It is a really nicely decorated, spacious place. However, they do not have a good beer selection. Also, I don't really like the music they play on college night but I think they play that everywhere. I still have fun and dance though. I would like to go to 80's night there and I will update this review when I do.

Minus two stars: one for the long lines to get in and two for it being too crowded. However, they do have dollar drinks on college night and my starving college ass can really appreciate that. It just gets too packed and lots of weird creepy guys hit on you. But maybe thats at all bars/clubs. I had fun there though.

I really liked Bangkok Palace. Its a hole in the wall, very family-oriented restaurants with nice servers. My boyfriend and I came here because we wanted to try something new. We usually go to Your Place on Milpas. So we got the tom yum soup, yellow curry to share and a mango with sweet rice dessert. 

One point for the tom yum actually being SPICY.
One point for the richness of the curry.
One point for the DELICIOUS mango with sweet rice dessert.
And one point for it being cheaper than Your Place.

I love I.V Drip. I use to love it more when this really hot guy use to work there but I still go all the time for their hot chocolate. It is smooth, creamy, delicious and not powdery. They are also the only place in I.V that has ice cream on a cone and donuts. I.V Drip helps me get through the day. I usually stop by before class, in between classes and when I need a latte for a late night study session. Wow, I just realize I am there a lot.
They have candy. I like candy. They also have coffee and I like that too. Therefore, deductive reasoning concludes that I like Java Jones.
Late night sushi. Hell yah. So good. And I met some awesome people here.

almost the only place i buy groceries in isla vista. they make wonderful veggie sandwiches, they have Ciao Bella shorbet (which is the most amazing thing that will ever touch your lips...and yes, waaaaaay better than that girl you met on DP last night), VEGAN COOKIES (i don't know how that is possible but it is delicious and huge) and a good selection of drinks. try the santa cruz brand lemonade. it will change your life.
yay for good beer, pool tables, good people. this is someplace you can  go to have after-work drinks, chill and be able to hear the person speaking to you. conveniently located near state st.

When I went, we had quite a long wait but it was worth it (just take a walk along the harbor). Good service, good clam chowder, good seafood. This captivates the essence of Santa Barbara. I wish I still went to UCSB so I could eat here more. Anyone feel like wining and dining me?

I think this is the official lunch spot for staff members of the SBIFF (although, I think they have converted to South Coast Deli.) *gasps*

-good sandwiches and breakfast
-walking distance

- I had a gross breakfast bagel here once though. Blueberry bagel with eggs is a no-no.

yeah this place sucks. the food is not good or very Thai at all. we only accidentally came here cause i mistaken your choice for your place. there is a huge difference. i'm just directionally challenged. go to your place on milpas.

Woodstock's is a throwback to my college days and how I miss it. Please tell me what is better than coupons in my email for discount pizza, delivering such pizza to my fat ass, and the option of wheat crust (which although I'm sure doesn't make that much of a difference, it disillusions me into believing that what I am eating is healthier...albeit it still being pizza at like midnight). Throw in a beer and you are set for life.

Lots of options to choose from and healthy! I had the red coconut curry tofu with rice noodles, pineapple, bean sprouts, sesame seeds and cilantro. Very customizable. Will try their different options. 

Good for a quick lunch!

Food was so flavorful and service was good and relatively quick. We started off with some olive oil and salt infused bread which was delicious. We also got the swordfish meatballs, regular meatballs, eggplant, baked cheese, salumi mixed plate, brussel sprouts and a couple of pasta dishes to share. 

All were delicious but I highly recommend the meatballs. Another favorite is the bucatini pasta with jalapeno and almond pesto. It has just the right amount of heat!

Would definitely come back if I'm in Philly again!

Oldest family-owned restaurant in the United States. This place really feels like a step back into the past.

The waitstaff showed so much Southern hospitality and the food I had was great. I had a pompano which is white, flaky fish that I have never tried or heard of before. It was indeed flaky, cooked to perfection and well-seasoned. I also had a glass of white Burgundy which while not the best I've had, was still pretty tasty.

Afterwards, we got a tour of the restaurant and its many exclusive rooms. There is so much history here and it would be a shame to miss this place.

cb5omh0nibWUYN2rws5rdg.review_text: I had lunch here today and could not be more disappointed in the food and service. One meal sat ready on the back counter for so long, my friend walked up and asked for her meal. My meal came ten minutes later and was lukewarm. Zero service from our server. I provided a photo of my plate when it arrived. It's less than appetizing. My plate was nearly empty and you can't even find the tiny patty under the oversized bun. The bacon was dripping grease onto the plate and the plate is smeared with greasy fingerprints from the kitchen staff. So, so gross...

Absolutely not! Walk away from this overpriced, disgusting place! The poor service set the tone for a lack luster lunch service. There are reasons this restaurant was nearly empty. Issues:

-Server brought three dinner rolls for all ten people to share, then dripped balsamic vinegar from the broken container all over the table and menus.
-Kitchen was extremely slow  with over a half hour wait
-Server informed me my meal was not available, just a minute or two before bring the remainder of the meals to the table. One person finished their meal before mine arrived.
-Others noticed their plates of pasta were not hot, just lukewarm
-Spaghetti noodles mixed into a plate of fettuccini
-One of the mussels in my meal was so undercooked the shell had not even opened - SERIOUS HEALTH HAZZARD
-The restroom had a dirty diaper and a religious brochure in the stall; from the horrid smell, it's clear the diaper had been in the bathroom many, many hours. Possibly overnight

There are far too many disappointing facets of this restaurant to consider returning.

This review is for the catering service - I do not recommend this restaurant for catering. The positive: the a$$ kissing assistant who orders your catering will show up at tbe restaurant often and get lots of free food and drinks. Quid pro quo.

The negative: your food will delivered in the back of a pickup truck, with only plastic wrap over the top of the serving containers. The food is NOT in a temperature controlled evironment and is not heated again before serving. You get room temperature, congealed, bacteria-filled  food every single time. After a two hour service, the leftover FOOD IS LOADED INTO THE BACK OF A PICKUP AND TAKEN BACK TO THE RESTAURANT to be used in their dining room. It is so gross, I won't even eat it for free.

Cesspool on a paper plate.

I've been here many times with varying results, but today was just terrible. With 3 customers in the entire place, i watched all four employees just sitting around BS'ing instead of making my food.  Over a half hour after I ordered, my soggy bottomed, top-burnt calzone was called. Since my lunchtime was long over, I couldn't ask for a non-burnt calzone to be remade. Hope your employees enjoyed the afternoon off today.

We arrived for a late lunch while the kitchen was experiencing a major malfunction.  Even with limited cooking abilities, they managed to pull together beatifully presented and delicious plates. The server was very helpful and friendly. No complaints, just kudos for working with half a kitchen.
Jose, please quit talking to your friend who has been standing in front of the pick up counter for ten minutes. Your multitasking skills are poor and my coffee is awful.

If I were rating the food, this would be five stars. Ive been here three times and loved every plate. Unfortunately, the service is stretched thin and very poor.

I highly recommend the bruschetta and soups of the day.

PARENTS: BEWARE OF THE TEMPERATURE of the children's meals. I tried my son's corn tonight before him and it was so hot it burnt my mouth. This would have been an ER visit for my son.

Why do people like this place? I have been several times and it is absolutely not worth it. Overpriced, poor cuts of steak with greasy sides. It's like going to Outback on Outback's worst night.

Lunch with a friend was awful! My sweet and sour was full of little greasy fryer leavings - bean sized bits of breading were as common as the dried out mystery meat pieces which were partially coated in breading. The rice was mush.

The other meal was also uneaten and left at the counter because no one was there...so gross and overpriced. A lunch "special" and drink was $13. NEVER GOING BACK!

Been waiting a half an hour- no food. Late returning to work. Watching wrong orders being returned. Just saw a refund because half an order was never delivered. Messy. Dirty. Out-of-control. Never again.

Zero stars! I phoned in at 3pm and went to pick up my pizza an hour later- well after the 40 minutes suggested. The line was ridiculously long because they were allowing people to sit in the store, waiting inside for their pizza to be made. With a limit of four persons in their lobby, you couldn't even get inside to pick up your pizzas because there was already four people waiting on the benches. Occasionally, an employee would come out and ask if there were online orders and he allowed them into the crowded lobby to pay, essentially cutting in line. I also just needed to pay for my pizza but was refused entry because i had a phone order. Rude, unorganized and its the sparsest toppings I've ever seen on a usually great pizza. I guess you will have more toppings to use in the future, as you definitely have one less customer after my 45 minute wait to pick up a pre-ordered pizza.
Selling bad product. Cork was disintegrated. Unable to find email to report this to the store. Clerks are not that friendly and dont care.
While the pizza is good, I have serious concerns about food safety and quality control. They literally baked a produce label into my pizza tonight. It makes you wonder what goes on in the kitchen.

Zero stars for the obviously microwaved food. I love the Sutro location but this reheat-by-microwave location is absolutely disgusting. $26 of inedible dried out poor quality ingredients. Very tiny portions of some kind of food. Definitely was not cheese inside what was supposed to be the enchilada combo.  meal. If your going to reheat previously frozen enchiladas, you should have more sauce on hand to rehydrate the tortilla. The nachos were worse - microwaved artificial cheese was hardened into a clear coat and the meat was great - but cold and had soaked the chips into rubber. So unbelievably gross - a total discredit to the Sutro location. Litterally, I threw the food away.

Worst service ever! Struggled to get there through fire related traffic, only to get home and find a meal was missing. AGAIN, FOR THE SECOND TIME, THEY FORGOT MY DINNER. Six out of seven items doesn't cut it - again, for the second time. Called to ask if my meal was there and was not offered delivery. They were willing to give me a small credit for ruining dinner with my family if I chose not to pick up my meal. Zero apology for forgetting my food, zero credit for picking up cold food. ZERO SERVICE!!! 

I do not recommend the super small 4 rib Peking pork ribs for $16. I do not recommend the paradise rice at $14 due to the random meat included in the only vegetarian meal we ordered. I do not recommend the Kung Pao Beef as it was 2/3 tasteless zucchini. The sesame chicken might have been good, but after sitting around waiting for me to return, it was cold and gross. The fried appetizers were cold and gross by the time I got home.

I AM UNABLE TO RECOMMEND ANYTHING DUE TO THE LOUSY SERVICE AND POOR QUALITY FOOD.

Not as described. I took the Chalamette Battlefield tour and was bitterly disappointed. The description read, "Ranger led one hour tour." Nope. The visitor center wasn't even open!!! The Creole Queen keeps taking your money even when the NPS site is closed. The sly boat narrator led us all to the back of a closed building to stand while he talked for an hour while he talked...this was to distract us from the fact there was no Ranger tour and the visitor center wasn't open. This was such a scam. Do not believe a word they say about this tour. Facts: you will have less than an hour at Chalamette Battlefield. Call the NPS at the site to see which days they are open so you don't get scammed into listening to a storyteller for the few minutes you have there. Historical fiction and storytelling is fun, but I really wanted to learn about the site significance from the visitor center and an NPS Ranger.
Adalaide was amazing! Very informative tour, with excellent storytelling! It is my favorite activity thus far and I highly recommend this tour company!

I strongly recommend the ala carte tacos - awesome! I do not recommend the meals. I paid $10.99 for dried out rice and beans which was supposed to have been the #16, two enchiladas with rice and beans. The plate contained two tiny tortillas with one spoonful of chicken. The entire enchilada filling consisted of one forkful of unseasoned checken. Nothing else. Greasy tortilla I wouldnt eat, even if I had a hangover, a single bite of tasteless chicken and dried out rice and beans. $10.99. 

I pointed out and commented about the extremely small meal to the waiter before I took a bite and he brushed it off. Fyi, the hamburger they use is gross - always go with chicken or shredded beef.

Again, the single tacos are great and highly recommended.

Zero stars. Waited a half hour for an on-the-menu bagel sandwich- nothing special, just a standard sandwich. They were really busy remaking two wrong orders during my half hour wait. I finally asked where my order was and it had been sitting behind the counter. It was in a weird place and no one had called it out. 

I should have known from the in-store experience, my order was wrong and slimy after sitting around. No bagel is worth a 45 minute wait. A $2.50 coupon for a free bagel isn't going to help. The hair in the fruit cup was just the end. Management is the only one to blame for the horrible lack of training and lousy service. Einstein will be happy to hear I am never going back, but I hope suckers walking into this mess learn to ask constantly if their order is ready and open/inspect their order right there at the counter.

NEVER PUT UP WITH HORRIBLE SERVICE.

SALAD EXPIRED FOUR DAYS AGO! They neatly wrapped it in a bag and hid the expired product
 When I called to let them know, they said I had to bring the salad back to get a refund. Uh, no. I'm not going to let the pizza and pasta go cold to return a salad you should never have served.

My three star rating is for the good pizza and meh pasta. It's tough to find employees that care. I feel bad for the franchise owner trying to find decent workers, but you can't serve salad four days past the expiration.

chq7UyerSDImd48KUj7j3A.review_text: I've been frequenting Cafe' Envie for many years and watched it change hands. I eventually got over the bright lights and touristy music. The ambiance and mystique left with the original barista, however the food and beverages and wi-fi still remain quite good. I still spend many Sunday mornings here for breakfast reading the Gambit and the employees are friendly and full of character. I laugh at the earlier review that complained about "gutter-punk baristas"....Let's get the terminology right ok! "Gutter Punks" are too lazy to even have jobs. They are the smelly, dirty runaway kids on the street bumming everything. Dreads, tattoos, piercings and gothy types are the awesome majority of the proud and hard working Lower-Decatur natives. Remember, hourly wages in LA are very low, so respect the circle of life and tip all your servers in NOLA, and they will take care of you from that moment on!

Seriously addicted to their "Thunder Chicken" pizza but have begun trying out the rest of the menu and so far always pleasantly surprised. When you fight over the last piece of pizza, you know it's good!
Great and imaginative drinks with fresh ingredients like sangria too. The restaurant is beautifully done in local charm with a charming and attentive staff to match. Very clean and enjoyed some fun events upstairs. When we're too tired to dine in, we appreciate the delivery!

This has been one of my local favorites for around 13 years. Away grom the more boisterous parts of the FQ, it has been consistently good food, fast service and friendly staff. Prices stay within reason compared to other Italian restaurants. I am glad they finally got their liquor license, but miss the days of bringing in your own bottle. Wine by the glass is nice and keeps your bill down. On weekends I'd advise getting there a little before dinner hour, as the line can get long and there's no waiting area. Low-lit and good for a romantic local night out. Delivery is nice too! Oh, couldn't forget the neato collection of paintings of Mona Lisa and your opportunity to draw your own, right on the table with crayons provided!

I'm not a restaurant critic and I don't pretend to be one (unlike a lot of people here on Yelp), but you should give credit where credit is due. If you know anything about the restaurant business, you would be amazed how quickly and proficiently this restaurant was put together in only a matter of a few months. I've been to many restaurant opening nights, and this one was the smoothest I've ever encountered, with a full menu to boot. We had dinner on opening night and received our appetizers and entrees in ample time and the server was very sharp, attentive and knew the menu items confidently. It's not meant to compete with your typical dark dingy smokey neighborhood bar with cheap beer; but it offers a unique niche that hasn't been filled in quite a long time here in New Orleans. The old adage goes, "you get what you pay for", and that certainly applies here. If you want a delicious unique Irish culinary delight with Guinness chilled and poured just right - this is what you're looking for. Pub menu for fish and chips, etc and another menu with finer dining items that include salmon, beef and lamb to satisfy those who are scared by the stereotypical Irish food reputation. We cant walt to come back for breakfast, and excited about live music starting next month. I'm betting, this will be "the place to be" on St. Patrick's Day! If opening day was this good, it's only sure to get better in time for March 17th!
I can't visit relatives in Mississippi without being asked to bring goodies from Maurice's bakery.  It's become quite a tasty tradition!

As a hotel employee, I often recommend cafe beignet because it offers a full menu and shorter walk than cafe du Monde. Of course by all means still visit cafe du Monde for what they are famous for, but if you're hungover or not up for a long morning walk, this is the place.
Loved the crepe de la crabe and cheese plate. The Kir Royal made my night! Get there early, this place fills up fast.

I love this place and after trying several
Other Thai restaurants it really is the best. I just hate that their opening for dinner is sometimes late and forces me to go somewhere else. I call them
and a lady in broken English says they are open, but when I get there it's dark and sign says closed. Frustrating.

I cant believe some of the ridiculous nit-picky reviews here. Please don't put down my favorite neighborhood burger and steak place, because they don't serve tofu; and I won't put down your favorite vegan or vegetarian place because they don't serve beef! There's a place for everything. The world doesn't revolve around picky eaters!
This little gem of a place is right up my alley...literally! Great tasting menu and nice view of Armstrong Park. Everything was fresh and good quality. Good tunes too!

I love Mary's Ace Hardware! It was worth the wait. They have hardwares, a/c filters in your size, and I cannot say enough good things about the upstairs!  It is a chefs, foodies and pet lover' one stop shop!

I can't believe I've been fighting the crowds at Port of Call all this time until a friend told me about this place. Even though it's just down the street, I gladly now drive to Lakeview Harbor. I love the big menu, lots of good choices and oh, so much parking.

Thank you for coming to our neighborhood! It was worth the wait. I had hoped it would have been bigger with the same selection and noodle bar as the Metairie location, but I understand they are just getting rolling. I hope they add to their pet food, coffee and soaps and oils, etc offerings.

This little gem of a place just upgraded to a beautiful new location on Tchoupitoulas street and definitely holding it's own amongst the who's-who of fine dining. As someone who came from a big family of steak connoisseurs, I've eaten steak at nearly every steakhouse in this city, and La Boca has me coming back for their fine flavorful selection of Argentinian beef. Sure, other places are known for their specialty items and typical sides, but if you're interested in a fresh take on the steak scene, I'd recommend La Boca for a really great meal that won't weigh you down and leaves you with plenty of energy for a night on the town afterwards! Management and staff are super friendly, attentive and anticipate your every need. Love the new valet service too.

Small, delicious slider burgers and donuts the size of a buicks! Sometimes backwards is better! The waffle fries are to die for. Good daily selection of delectable donuts. I'll have to wait until after the wedding to try them all!

This is my "go-to place" for good and fast Chinese takeout.  The staff are always nice, know me and the consistency is good. I can honestly say I eat here several times a month and never disappointed when trying a new dish on the menu.

Has Jäger Haus closed??? I have been trying to make reservations all week and their phone says it is out of service or some recorded message from the phone company. I even tried to email them as well and no response. Fingers crossed it is still open. ⁉⁉

This is me and my husband's favorite German restaurant. Being both of German families and traveling to Germany every couple of years, the food is pretty spot-on. Love that they carry Lavazza espresso too.

We love Lüke, but shocked they took the veal Jäger schnitzel, spaetzle and other items off their menu, so they are not really considered "German" anymore.  It's a real shame too, since Lüke was the last restaurant in New Orleans that served it now that "Jäger Haus" (only other German Restaurant in the city) has closed.
I cannot believe we are just finding out about this amazing neighborhood restaurant! So glad we did and looking forward to eating everything on their menu. Not all at once mind you, but tempted!

After living all over New Orleans, I cannot believe we are just now getting around to eating at this amazing neighborhood restaurant! So glad we did and looking forward to eating everything on their menu. Not all at once mind you, but VERY tempted to try!

Our favorite neighborhood burger place! Being across the street from both work and home, I would surely die if this place wasn't always there for me. Great "appies and sammies" too! Best liquor and beer selection this end of Canal. Bartenders and the chef rocks!

cio1G2jhQ2gwHBXsfSkYcg.review_text:
A friend and I ate here tonight. The atmosphere was great for a Tuesday night, nice and quiet just the way I like it!
Our waiter John ( if I remember correctly) was great, really nice.
I had Mozzarella Fritta which was ok and for an entree I had Involtini di Pollo which was very good. I cannot remember what my friend had but I know he enjoyed his meal and he's a foodie! After dinner we both ordered gelato (I had vanilla and I forget what he had) But we both enjoyed our dinner, this place is good and I'll definitely be retuning!

I went here last week. The restaurant is very pretty and it has a nice atmosphere. For an appetizer I had the Beef Carpaccio which I didn't like. The Seared Sea Scallops were delicious!! My entree was the Center Cut Filet Mignon (well done) which I also enjoyed. I will definitely be coming back here.

*This review is for the spa*

Working retail really sucks the life outta you! After holiday season and working 2! Not 1 BUT 2! 50 hr work weeks back to back, I told myself that I deserved a treat! And what better way to treat yourself than with a spa day!

Spa: 
Every inch of the spa was clean and very modern. Once you've checked in, The girl from the front desk gives you a tour of the whole spa, which is helpful! They have a relaxation room (tea and water is provided) Sauna, Steam room, Gym and a pool. They give you a locker ( more spacious than I expected) and you can make up your own 4 digit code which is nice! The robes are very warm and plush. They also give you slides which came in handy since I forgot to pack some for the pool.
The women locker room is very nice, they provide you with everything you need! Hairdryer, brush, comb, deodorant, razors, you literally just have to bring yourself and a bathing suit.

*Also, This is my first real spa experience. I usually go to Hand and Stone for a massage, which I never really enjoyed but w/e it did the job. Why pay $150 for H&S when you can pay the same price for a more relaxing and luxurious experience.*

General Service: All the staff members I encountered were very nice and accommodating.

Atmosphere: It felt very luxurious, staff and guests were all very quiet which I appreciated. The Relaxation room was my favorite part! The lighting was perfect and there was enough space for multiple people to really relax and stretch out.

Massage: I had the 60 min "The Rittenhouse" massage. Colleen was great! Ive had a massage by a women before and usually it makes me very tense, but I was so calmed and relaxed that I would definitely book with her again!

Pro Tip: They let you stay as long as you'd like. My massage was at 1:00, I arrived at 12 to check in, used the gym, I swam in the pool and relaxed before my appointment.  It wasn't busy the day I was there which was perfect! After my massage I spent almost another 2 hours taking my sweet ole time just relaxing. Sat in the steam room for a bit, showered, did my hair, makeup, etc!

I definitely recommend The Spa at The Rittenhouse!! I will be returning very soon!

You know your gonna get good Italian food when there's an old Italian man greeting you and walking around!
 I came here a few months ago for dinner with a friend and it was AMAZING!! I had the Ravioli and when I tell you it was FRESH! The Ravioli was FRESH! I forgot what my friend ordered but it was good lol. The table behind us ordered Linguine and Clams, I don't eat seafood but it looked delicious. The restaurant is pretty cozy but I liked that, the service was pretty good so no general complaints.

Am I there only person from Philly who just started coming here about 2 years ago?
Everything looks and smells amazing. The lines are very long around lunch time (which is to be expected).
I really want to give RTM a solid try! When I worked in the area I went to Kevin Parkers for lunch a few times and it was good. Ive had Bassetts Ice cream and that was YUM! I've yet to give the Amish Bakery donuts a try. I have to come back with plenty of time and a pair of Yoga pants.

I want to five Davio's 5 stars just for the Dimmer light in the dining room.. Like who doesn't love a dimmer light? but I can't.

I was watching GR Hells Kitchen and the contestants were making Halibut, so off to find a restaurant with Halibut on the Menu I went. 
Me and my friend came here a few months ago and there was a little bit of a wait so we had drinks a the bar. I am not a drinker but the cocktail I had was pretty good! He drinks beer so he's always satisfied lol
We had the cheesesteak egg rolls for appetizers..Delish! I ordered the Halibut and he ordered the Braised Beef Short Ribs.
His dish was really good, Ribs were nice and tender! My Halibut was disappointing as it was very dry. I was looking forward to a great meal considering the price were paying for dinner and that just didn't happen. I will be fair though, It was Saturday evening and they were busy!
The manager did stop by our table to ask if everything was ok and I should've told him about the dry halibut.... but I understand that they were very busy and I don't believe in sending things back to the kitchen. So, I ate the dry Halibut and drank the house white wine. Eventually I will give Davio's another chance as Im sure they could do better. Ill try something else off the the menu to see how they deliver!

Ive finally gotten a chance to try James after drooling over their Instagram for weeks!
Its a cute little restaurant and the atmosphere is nice. I ordered the Pot Pie which looked AMAZING on IG but it didn't taste as amazing as I expected. The Pot Pie overall was just okay, It wasn't seasoned enough for me. A little salt, pepper, basil, SOMETHING goes a long way.
I will give them a second chance closer to summer and see how other things on the menu pan out

Just order everything! Its all good, like seriously yummy! Don't count the calories! Forget about the carbs!! Just indulge yourself in the sweet yumminess of the sweet potato pie! We all deserve a treat and one night I came all the way from the depths of Packer Park to get a cheesesteak from Jims and on my way back to the Subway, I passed by this little bakery and decided to walk in. As soon as I seen the sweet potato pie I was sold! Anyone who knows me knows that I love sweet potato pie, I eat it all year 'round. The best part about the pie was that it wasn't light skin! If a pie looks to close to Beyonces skin complexion that means its not seasoned well! **Adds brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg** Sweet potato by should look like SZA lol Just the right amount of Brown! Anyways lol Stop by this gem of a bakery for all your Sweet potato pie needs!

Came here for a treat after class, Ive been following them for a while on IG.
Whats not to like? Its in the lobby on the new Comcast building, Very modern and clean, there's a great selection of deserts (block out any thoughts of carb/calorie counts) seating is kinda limited at peak times.
I ordered the sweet potato cake, which was really good!  Im an avid people watcher and its a great spot for that. Looking forward to trying more things!

I've had this place on my list since last year and I've finally gotten a chance to try it tonight! I was so excited when my bf made reservations (which I'm glad he did cause it was empty at first but halfway through dinner, traffic picked up quickly). Our waiter was Dan... let me tell you about Dan, he's my kind of waiter! He was easy going, accommodating and gave us plenty of space! We started off with scallops and a Caesar salad. The scallops were cooked perfectly! I ordered the salmon w/ a side of potatoes and he ordered a rack of lamb and the food was amazing! Cooked perfectly, plating was good! No complaints at all. 
The ambiance was nice, loved the ocean blue walls and the dimmer light! (I'm a sucker for a dinner light in any setting ) I cant wait for warmer weather as I will definitely be back.

Went to Del Friscos for the 1st time on a whim just to have drinks. I was dressed casually and was only sitting at the bar. Im not a drinker but the drink the bartender made was good. What I liked the most was the bread pudding! Ive never spent so much money on bread pudding in my life lol (yes I had multiple servings). The overall ambiance was nice, everyone seemed to be having a good time, the vaults are cool to look and Id love to come back for dinner.

The Cheesecake Factory isn't my go to restaurant simply because they severely lack in the breadbasket department *take a page out of Longhorns book* and the menu is a headache waiting to happen. But tonight was my kids birthday and he like TCF, so we went! 

1) My Caesar salad had a bite to it, kinda spicy (from what? I have no clue) and tasted like meat was previously in it.. disgusting
*the very nice waiter, Tyler? Took it back and the manager comped it! I appreciated that* I was trying to be "healthy" and my fat ass got a messed up salad  should've just ordered fries!

2) The sliders I ordered lacked flavor, so I wouldn't order them again

3) My mom and my kid had burgers which they liked. My moms order was wrong she received fries instead of the salad, but I happily ate those and all was well!

In the end the wait staff came and sang happy birthday to my kid which made him happy and he got a huge piece of Oreo cheesecake which he enjoyed! Thank you TCF staff for taking time to make an 8yr old smile  

I appreciated the service I received tonight, Tyler? (I hope that's his name) was very nice and attentive. Resolved my 1 issue quickly, He needs to be working in Fine Dining!! Will I be visiting TCF in the future for anything besides cheesecake and drinks? Probably not but as I stated before, I did like their service!!

I've had Savona on my radar for a while. I went last month and it was everything I expected.
Great Service, it felt like our waitress checked on us every 20 minutes, which personally I loved because it gave me and my man a chance to chat and have alone time. The food was delicious! Everything was cooked well and the plating was beautiful. All in all me and my man both enjoyed our dinner, we were happy with the service and we will be back!

Little Nonna's is such a cute place! 
The atmosphere is very cozy and I love string lights dangling from the beams.

I was here the other night and the food was so yummy! I ordered the grilled corn bruschetta to start with. It was a tad messy to eat but I enjoyed all of the different flavors and overall it was good! The chicken radiatore was perfection... just the right amount of creamy, chicken yummy goodness lol 

Seriously, if you have no self control and are a sucker for good pasta (or food in general) like I am, you will not be disappointed.

I'm willing to bet that there has been a change in management.
Long ago (2016-2017) this Starbucks (Near L&T) was ran really well! Long lines were handled quickly and smoothly, I saw the same baristas all the time and the baristas were creative(I can't get certain drinks I love because these new baristas couldn't imagine making a Caramel Brulée cold, think milkshake consistency )
Whomever working here now is very uninspired and the store looks like it lacks staff.

I visited this location 2 mornings ago, with a pretty empty store it took 8 minutes to get a Venti Passion iced tea lemonade! I opened my store almost 2 minutes late  
They were knocking out the mobile orders, but what about the customers in store?
Would you answer the phone and chat with a client for 8 minutes when there's one at the register with 50 things ready to purchase? No! Retail 101

I just left this location 30 minutes ago after waiting in line for 5 minutes with 1 water in my hand. The 2 guys working clearly can't multitask, there was a group of foreigners in front of me taking forever. 1 of them could've easily rang me up, sent me On my way!, made a drink, rang the other 2 customers behind me, made their drinks and MADE THE MOBILE ORDERS LAST cause the store wasn't busy AND the average mobile order in the mall sits for at least 3-5 minutes (huge mall, long walk)

I've had a long day... I'm done with SBUX for now

Walked in like wtf am I 
Walked down the steps and into a beautiful restaurant. I went in December and had a really nice meal. Our server was super knowledgeable about cocktails and wine, my bf said that Giuseppe's chicken Marsala was the best he'd ever had. Overall we had a perfect evening, delicious food and service was on point. 

I will definitely be back
