This is one of the first places we went in NOLA and it didn't disappoint. The staff is fun and friendly and the bar is great if you're looking for a good time! 
The vibe is a little college-bar (not super clean but open and inviting) and the drinks are fun! 
They have great food if you're looking for a quick bite, but I wouldn't say it's the best food in town.

This place is great and has a cool outdoor bar. 
Their happy hour is pretty great - lasts until 7 where most places are done at 6 or 630. Cheap IPAs and domestics and $3 wells. 
We only got an appetizer, but I would highly recommend the pickled paw prints! The tomato horseradish sauce is incredible. 
Above all the service was great! Our server, Michael gave us the best service we've had so far in Nashville.

Such a cute little coffee shop off the beaten path. 
This place is pretty standard, has delicious coffee, free WiFi, and a few breakfast pastries. 

The one thing that really sets them apart is their awesome staff. Everyone is so friendly and had great coffee recommendations. We got the iced americano and the cold brew and they really hit the spot!

One thing to note, this place gets busy as f. So arrive early if you want to get a spot to stay and work or study!

Yum yum yum to everything at this place.

The food is out of this world. It's so amazing to see a vegan/vegetarian restaurant do literally everything well. Everything we ordered was delicious. For our entrees we got the Patty melt and kimchi and holy shiite, I can't wait to eat it again.

They also have amazing seasonal kombucha! We got the passion fruit, safflower, and basil and it was awesome. The basil really cuts that apple cider vinegar taste most booch's have!

One thing that really stood out was how much they seem to value their employees, and you can tell people loved their job. I have never seen a restaurant, business, etc. put this type of respect on display (see the faces of graze photo).

We will definitely be back!

Fido is INSANELY busy on the weekends, so expect to wait in a looooong line or come very early. Even though the line to order is long, the food and coffee comes out quickly.

Other than that, I really cannot complain about this place.The coffee is decent, the food is good, the staff is great, and the atmosphere is awesome. 
You walk in to brick walls, vaulted ceilings, and a display of local artwork. The staff is friendly and greeted us right away. 

The menu is diverse with healthy and not so healthy options, as well as vegetarian, vegan, and gluten free choices.
I ordered the Huevos Rancheros, the flavor and portion size were great for the price. The food was lukewarm when it came out, but it was delicious so I didn't really care.

Definitely a must for brunch!

Awesome little pub tucked away in such a cute shopping area in Franklin! 

They have a huge, full service, bar with tons of TVs - perfect for football season. 

The service was great and the staff was sooo friendly. Southern hospitality at its finest.

The food is above average for what you would expect for a pub. The nachos could use some work, but the fried green tomatoes with the spicy ranch are some of the best I've ever had!

Officially one of my new favorite breweries in town!

The outdoor beer garden sets this place apart. It is so pretty and peaceful you would never know you are on a busy street. Bring bug spray though. They do their best with the citronella candles but I left with quite a few bites. 

I ordered a flight, and there wasn't a beer I didn't like. Everything from the IPAs, seasonals, and stouts were great! And if you drink a little too much like I did... their pizzas are great!

Officially one of my new favorite breweries in town!

The outdoor beer garden sets this place apart. It is so pretty and peaceful you would never know you are on a busy street. Bring bug spray though. They do their best with the citronella candles but I left with quite a few bites. 

I ordered a flight, and there wasn't a beer I didn't like. Everything from the IPAs, seasonals, and stouts were great! And if you drink a little too much like I did... their pizzas are great ;)

Overall, this place is great. The atmosphere is very cool and not too loud.
Definitely make a reservation because this place can get very busy on weekends.

The staff was lovely and accommodating. Our waitress, Anne Claire, knew her stuff. She was so friendly and had great recommendations. The entire staff was very attentive and made sure we were happy without interrupting our meal.

My food pros and cons:
- Pros: They start you off with a bread basket, that was delicious, a little salty and a little sweet. The beet and goat cheese salad was probably my favorite item of the night. Our waitress recommended the duck, and she made an excellent choice. The seafood is also delicious as an add on to your steaks! The brussel sprouts and mac n cheese are the best sides on the menu. so flavorful and a perfect add on. For dessert, we split the carrot cake and it was AMAZING.
- Cons: We ordered 2 different temperatures for the filets, and they were both a little overcooked, I would recommend getting a temperature below what you normally get, unless you're one of those people that get your steaks well done... The only side I was quite underwhelmed by were the mashed potatoes. They tasted like the Hungry Jack instant mashed potatoes you can make out of a box. 

This one is a given, but all of the wine was wonderful. The Avignonesi and the  Katherine Goldschmidt Cab paired well with everything!

If you're looking for LIFE ALTERING food, this is the place for you.

Tourists, this place is a little hard to find, but definitely worth it. 
It is tucked behind 700 Club, just walk through the bar and order the food at the kitchen door. Once you order, you can sit at the few tables in the back, or you can take it out to the bar and grab a drink.

I think this is what people would call a "hole in the wall", but every single thing we had was incredible. 

The mac n cheese, cauliflower sandwich, and loaded fries were so so so good. Lots and lots of cheese ;) We loved it so much, we ended up ordering take out for a drunken, late night snack.

I love the casual, open atmosphere of this place. The beer garden is pretty and DOG friendly, so it makes for a great place to hang out. This place is huge, so even when it is packed it doesn't make me feel claustrophobic.

We came looking for Cheese curds and we were not disappointed. The curds were very good, but the Panchos is my favorite thing on the menu. Potatoes + queso + jalapeños = YES PLEASE!
Avocado crunch salad was also very good, refreshing and so yummy.

We can't wait to go back and try the rest of the menu!

This was one of my favorite places in Indianapolis, and again is one of my favorite places in Nashville.

They have the best chips and guacamole you'll ever have, and the queso is amazing. I've never ordered anything here that I did not like. Everything  from the tacos, to the beans, to the many chips and dips is delicious.
The Bakersfield margaritas are dangerous. A pitcher of those and you'll be a little wobbly, but man they are goood.

Shout out to the entire staff. This place is always PACKED but they do a great job of greeting you, grabbing drinks and apps while you're waiting for your table, and the table service is quick, and everyone is always friendly.

Hattie throws down in the kitchen. We ordered takeout and YES MA'AM this place is delicious. If you're looking Southern Comfort Food, this is the place for you. 
We had the catfish and almost every side on the menu and everything was amazing. We ordered again 2 days later because the food is that good.
I highly recommend H & T's. Please support Black-owned and eat delicious food!

If you're in NOLA, stop by this place for lunch or a nice dinner. The restaurant is conveniently located close to Bourbon street. It's a beautiful restaurant that offers casual dining. The staff was friendly and sat our group right away.
We came for a late lunch and ordered Cauliflower with whipped feta (yum), Pizza, Squid Ink Pasta and some wine. The cauliflower and squid ink pasta were amazing, the wine was great, and the pizza was good (just about what you would expect for a pizza), but what really stole the show was THE BREAD. WHOAmygosh. It was served with a spicy olive oil that provided something a little different with a nice kick. Honestly, the best bread I've ever had.

Check them out!

This is the first restaurant/bar/pub I've been to in over a year. I was so so nervous about COVID precautions but those worries faded when we arrived. All the staff had masks on and signs were posted everywhere to enforce the mask mandates. The tables were still a bit close together, but since we went later in the evening, the bar area wasn't super packed. 

Robyn was our server and she was AWESOME. She was very personable and funny and made some amazing food and drink recommendations.

Everything we ordered was great, but the fried banana peppers stole the show. 

Definitely check this place out and request Robyn when you do!

Impeccable service. Sarah was awesome!
Mediocre French onion soup. I don't think it was cooked all the way.
2 for 1 beer?! Sign me up. 
Crispy Brussels. Fire  (as the kids say).

Y'all, these mozzarella sticks alone are worth a visit. Honestly, some of the best fried mozz I've ever had!

If you need other reasons to check them out: They have an awesome draft beer selection, ambiance is chill (a little loud at times), staff is friendly, and all of the food is delicious!

e_4sP0aqQPGGml8FFQAb2w.review_text:
Great food, great atmosphere, great service and entertainment 
My wife and I eat here at least once or twice a month
Oysters are awesome and shrimp tacos are wonderful
Yesterday the Wife had the tuna pokey which she loved
Let's just say the worst thing we've ever had here was Great!

No atmosphere but great fish tacos at extremely affordable prices!
Come for the food and you'll not be disappointed!

Been here maybe 5 times over the last year and a half always for breakfast.
Food is ok. It certainly meets standard diner style quality.
Service not so much! On our last visit we waited a l o n g time for our waitress to take our order and then l o n g e r to receive our food
Attention to our needs such as a simple request for more coffee and and water went unmet until we had almost finished our breakfast.
And NO they we're not that busy!
Ok food and lousy service just doesn't cut it. I'm local and there are too many other great places to eat breakfast on St Pete Beach.
Goodbye Skidders!
Long wait just ok food in a grimy over rated food network pumped restaurant! Never again Guy....sorry.
Love the food service and outdoor patio for dining. In my top five favorites in Saint Petersburg

Great brunch offerings at reasonable prices
Looking forward to lunch here one day soon

Love the location and vibe from the industrial decor.
Food is unique and for the most part very tasty and well presented. Service was somewhat sporadic on a recent Sunday brunch visit and pricey. That being said we'll make another visit there and place it our Sunday brunch rotation.

Great seafood and exceptional pricing
A go to at least twice a month.
Love the bar for dining and as always service is best at the bar!

If you love really good Italian food you must come an enjoy a wonderful meal at this well established haute in "downtown" Gulfport.
Fantastic dishes and attentive staff and service. Be sure to make a reservation on Friday and weekends or you'll end up on the wait list.

I'm from North Carolina and I know good que and this my fellow yelpers is the real thing. It's only walk up to counter order and take it with you but YouTube glad you did!
I'm working my way through all the meats but have had pulled pork, bbq chicken (sorry they only serve white meat breast), and brisket. The brisket was the juicy and very flavorful and the best I've had outside of Texas where my wife is from. Next visit we'll try the ribs. All the sides were well prepared and the bbq sauces offered are also excellent! If you like BBQ you must check this "spot"out.

The Wife and I recently had our first Saturday brunch here but certainly not our last.  I enjoyed the house made corn beef served as a benedict and The Wife enjoyed the portobello mushroom Benedict.  
The place is very small but does offer sidewalk seating as well as inside dining. Service was quick and friendly. How good was it..."We'll be back"

I from North Carolina and I've eaten bbq all my life. I'm here to tell  you this is by far the best bbq in St Pete and in my top ten of all the bbq places I've ever eaten at! The owner, Dan, knows what he's doing when it comes to smoking meat. The ribs and chicken are my favorites but the worst thing I've had here was great.
Don't be fooled when you first pull up to this joint, it's a dive but clean and purely counter  order and take out. No indoor or outdoor seating but absolutely great BBQ! Try it and you'll see why I'm so high on Casper's BBQ.

Just darn good food, excellent service and a great bar with a wonderful hometown atmosphere.
Sunday brunch is our favorite but we try to make an evening out here at least once a month.
In our top ten go to spots even if it's a haul for us from St Pete Beach. Well worth it!

The Wife and I eat brunch here on Sunday am (first visit ever) and it was a very pleasant and enjoyable meal.
I had the two hard tacos plated with a wonderful rice pilaf and flavorful refried beans sides. 
The Wife enjoyed her two chicken enchiladas with the same side servings.
The margarita she had was made with jalapeños and was fantastic.
The restaurant is large, clean and very inviting. The service was excellent.
This was a jewel and we are so glad to have found it. We'll certainly return very soon.

This was our first visit to Sea Worthy and we were very impressed with the quality of the dishes served. The Wife and I started with the Hog fish ceviche which was extremely flavorful and pleasantly presented. We followed that course with the Korean BBQ short ribs that were very tasty but a little to fatty and tough for the Wife but the flavor made them enjoyable to me. I even had them box the bones for me to take home in order to make a beef broth for a future soup dish. Finally we finished our evening with the best of the three, a fantastic serving of mussels and a side of bread to help us enjoy the broth to the ultimate degree.
We cared our own bottle of Belle Glos Clark and Telephone Pinot. They do charge a corking fee of $20 but that's par for most establishments. 
The atmosphere and service were certainly in line with the quality of the food and we look forward to returning soon and often.

We had been anticipating our first visit to this DTSP establishment for close to three years since we moved to Saint Pete Beach from Raleigh NC.
Sorry to say our first experience was disappointing. While the food was good the service was lacking. 
We got there about 2 pm yesterday (May 10, 2020) hoping to avoid the lunch time rush and we succeeded.
Our waitress was pleasant took our drink order and provide us with menus as we sat at the counter in the newly renovated indoor dining facility. About five minutes later we ordered. The Wife had a Cuban and I ordered the lechon  a Latin roasted pork and grilled onion sandwich. We were at the bar for about 15 to 20 minutes when we notice folks all around us were receiving their orders. This included people who had come in after us. The Wife even had time to finish her first beer before our waitress came to us and ask: Are you still waiting for your food? She went to the kitchen to check on our order and said that the order got cut from the system with an internet glitch and it would be "right out.....it was on the press right now. Well another ten to fifteen minutes went by. The Wife ordered a second beer and we waited. Finally The Wife said I think we need to just forget this and have her tap us out. The waitress came back in another five minutes or so with our sandwiches and apologized for the big delay. She also comped our three beers and in addition gave us 10% off our food order. Thus three stars instead of one star. The Wife's Cuban was good but she's had better and my roasted pork sandwich was yummy. We'll try it again in the near future but in no hurry. Ok food but horrible service and the kitchen's fault not the waitress.

Got take out sashimi and several hand rolls. All were very tasty and fresh but I live in St Pete Beach and we have several Thai restaurants that are equally as good. Just always looking to find "The Perfect One." 
Close but not quite worth the drive for me.
They are no longer at their original location at 16th Street and 30th Ave. I have no idea if they're still in business

Hole in the wall is correct. Not impressed with quality of food or cleanliness of the establishment. Waitress was the very best part of this breakfast experience, thus the second star. I look forward to not ever returning again!

el6g24jlP00Xp_dX6c7JGw.review_text: Was in town for a gig and had my family with me. Looking for breakfast and not wanting to stand in line for an hour at the big pancake joint, we found Fido. I have 2 say we were VERY impressed. Great food, kids were happy and good coffee drinks! Fido will def be a destination next time i am in town.

Went on a Sunday morning so all the "church folk" were out in full force. After waiting for 20 min (Bleh) it took about 15 min for food, which was not bad for the crowd. I gotta say the cinni stick pancakes rock! Well worth the wait and the $8 it cost me. My wife was less impressed with the cheese cake pancakes, but hey, its ihop, 40 dollars for 4 people isn't bad.

I have to say Jerrys cafeteria has to be one of the best authentic dive food places I have been... I can't figure out for the life of me why "Diners Drive-ins and Dives" has not been here.

It's an ever changing selection in the food line depending on the day of the week. It kind of takes me back to grade school and lunch lines.

If you are in the st. Louis area, I highly recommend leaving the beaten path and come try this place. Amazing fried chicken and twiced baked mashed potatoes.

just had our first experience at Yemanja. It was absolutely amazing. friendly staff and amazing drinks. I had the Feijoada. great tasting bean stew served with rice and collard. My wife had the special Risotto which was full of seafood.  My 11 and 6 year old kids were with the wife and I, they were quite happy with the empanada as well as other dishes

With a few drinks and dessert expect to spend $100 plus, but it was well worth it. We will be returning quite soon!!!! Obrigado!

Si señor is about a once a month stop for us as it is open until 10pm and has decent cheap drink nights. Food isn't bad, much better than the other Mexican place in the town. Go for the shrimp soup, it is always consistent. The spicy shrimp Diablo used to be a favorite, but lately is too hot to eat. Don't go in expecting too much and u won't be disappointed. But still not bad.

Enjoyed dinner at the Gast haus with my wife and kids. We found it interesting (and a little scary) that no one else was in the restaurant. We chocked it up to the time we decided to at which was around 7pm. We were pleasantly surprised to find the food was quite good. As this was our first time here we each decided on a different entree and shared a bit. By far the cabbage roll was a winner. We also had the pork strips in mushroom sauce, which wasnt bad, but nothing to write home about. The potato pancakes were very tasty, as was the kraut. All, in all this was a tasty outing into German food. You all should try it.
Holy Monkey thats some good ice cream! Salted Caramel was the personal favorite of everyone in our group.

Went back for dinner to experience their offerings. great burger combos that were both inventive and quite tasty. Some seemed a bit pretentious, but our choices were very flavorful. We ordered the PB&J 2.0 and a Goat cheese and bacon. both very tasty and cooked to our specs. The show stealer of the night is the Rum Chata milk Shake. absolutely amazing and highly recommended!

First time to Gelateria Del Leone. Very hipster type of place, but was still well taken care of by the staff. Coffee and gelato were both quite tasty. Pastries seemed a bit old, but we were late in the night so that could def be from sitting out. All in all a good gelato experience with some friendly hipsters

What an incredible value on really good sushi. For a dinner for 4 people including appetizer, dessert with a couple of drinks was under $80.00. This is almost unheard of for good sushi. 

This will be my new go-to sushi in St Louis!

Took the family out for Easter pizza. We are always looking for new places, so after finding a groupon for Bono's was our new place to try tonight. The service was excellent, the gentleman was very accommodating to us even though it was close to closing time. He was great to us. 

Food was awesome! We had the thick crust pizza, fettuccine, cheese garlic bread, and a cheese thin crust for my son. Everything was quite fresh and perfectly cooked. This pizza needs to be on your list!
Great food! Plain Jane decor and drinks in a can.
Always consistent no matter the barista. Let's face it, its Starbucks and corporate coffee but it always does the trick!

this is my single favorite sunday breakfast spot as well as my late night weekend craving place. Try the ultimate benedict, its better during the day, but it still works at night. I have been through about half the menu and its all tasty. Have a Benton Park Mocha as a great coffee beverage.

Since I just realized I'm the Duke of Tokyo, I thought maybe I should write a review and a reason! First and foremost, you can go to almost any Chinese buffet and find the standard "buffet" fare but at Tokyo you get choices that are generally not seen on most. The stuffed crab and mussels are quite tasty. The tofu and squid offerings are more than average. The decor is nothing to look at, but that's not why we go to buffets now is it....

This was our 4th time to Brazikat. It has been a very consistently good experience. I have had both the meat feast and the surf and feast options.  

I will tell you that each time the gauchos make the experience. Most are very friendly and knowledgable and completely service oriented. The owner was in house and made his way to every table to ensure customer happiness. Being a business owner, I found that to be a great touch. 

The food is very consistent, my family prefers beef cooked a certain way (rare) and they have never disappointed with a varied selection of choices each time we have been. 

The salad selection can be a little thin as my only downside, but the overall experience is well worth the trip.

First time to the Bevo Mill in several years. After reading all if the bad reviews I was a bit worried, but the wife bought a groupon so I figured why not?  As we walked in, we were a bit early for our reservation which was no problem. We were greeted and seated right away. The waitress explained the selections and took our drink orders (bottomless mimosa, heck yea) there was all a bottomless Bloody Mary bar, which appeared to have a lot of customization options. The buffet offered both breakfast and lunch items with some German type fare. The good was quite tasty and served quite hot as some have said selections were cold on their visits. The staff and chefs took great care to make sure all in our group were happy.  The gentleman who appeared to either be the house manager or head chef came by a couple of time to make sure we were happy and answer any questions. Overall this was a very nice experience. Only complaint that was heard from our group was the ladies room was as cold as a meat locker, but do to let that stop you from trying this historic landmark.

This was my first foray to Tucker's as the wife and I wanted a steak, our go to place was closed due to it being 10pm. First thing that we had issues with was that the weather was cold and snowy and there was ice all over the parking lot and walkways making it quite dangerous to walk in and slippery to park. We called ahead to see if we needed reservations, but we're told there was no waiting. We were seated immediately and served by a very nice waitress who took our drink orders. The cocktails were well made.  As we sat and placed our order, but noticed a VERY intoxicated table behind us were quite loud and obnoxious. We ordered the special boneless ribeye and loaded potato. These were well cooked and tasted great. As we had dinner we were basically forced to listen to the downstairs patrons have a conversation about their "dating" conquests. Due to my checkin on Yelp, we were offered a free dessert which we happily accepted. We had the turtle which was recommended by the waitress. Unfortunately, the turtle was basically a frozen purchased dessert that had a bit of a chemical taste. So all in all very tasty steaks, with some issues that may go along with later night dining.

Always love to try new business and this one is literally new at less than 2 days since opening. We found a case and pastry area full of tasty goodness we opted for the Brendan and a Nutty Columbian. Which were outstanding. Good taste and texture that you would expect in a $4.50 dessert. So we decided to try another which was called the Opera. It has the appearance of tiramisu but that was where the similarity stopped. It was an interesting light coffee flavor, and a denser body. Great start for the first week. It should definitely be a dessert stop. I could see an expanded selection of coffee drinks to accompany the dessert selection.

I just wanted to update my review as we have been here MANY more times since my last review. I wanted to update everyone. My only reason for the 4 stars was the sometimes slim. That has completely changed. The selections have been varied and delicious. My personal favorite was the tapenade and the soup. The owner Sam is a very gracious host and the staff is exceptionally helpful.

Decent food in a strip mall environment. We live within 45 minutes of the famous "Little Italy" St Louis known as "The Hill." This is where we frequent for great pasta and other delights. But tonight, we just didnt feel like driving that far for a quick dinner. A quick view of Yelp gave us Sugo's.  The place was quite empty, but that happens on Monday's. Servers were friendly and helpful. The food was no bad at all. I chose the cannelloni which was quite decent, my wife had the tutti mari, daughter the bolognese, and my 8 yr old son had a cheese pizza. THe food overall was tasty, maybe some work on the temperature of the dishes in the future, but over tasty dinner was had.

Some of the nicest staff in the Starwood family of hotels. I have stayed in this location on several trips to Nashville and they never fail. I wanted to stay an additional day this trip and use some of my SPG points. They had no more rooms on the club floor that I am used to, but they happily offered me a deluxe room on another floor and still gave me club access with me even asking along with comps for the bar and dinner. Overall great experience. Had some noisy neighbors on this floor, but that's what happens on a Saturday night in Nashville!

Saw some of the other reviews so I had to drop one of my own. Arrived at lunch and didn't have to wait long. The staff was fast and friendly. Food order was painless even though I customized my grinder a bit. The food came out quick and fresh. Everything was quite hot and very tasty. After talking with one of the staff members, it appears that this location is under new ownership, well it shows! Keep up the good work, this will be a once a week spot now.

Favazza's is one of those spots that we have made a New Year's tradition over the last couple of years. We also try to go at least once more during the year. For the life of me I can't figure out why we don't go more. 

The service is second to none. The food was absolutely delicious. They offer one of the largest selections of gluten free pasta in the area, which is much appreciated. 

Coffee and dessert rounded out the evening for us and another truly great dining experience at Favazza's. If you want a nice night out, grab a drink sit by the fireplace and enjoy this spot on the hill.
Still delicious and consistent. Been back 4 times since initial review and things are great!

Stumbled into Magpies literally by the luck of the draw. Looking for dinner in downtown St Charles. Magpies offered both indoor and outdoor seating. We opted for indoor due to the heat. Very friendly staff who offered recommendations. Decent wine was had along with the zesty feta appetizer. Dinner was seafood for both in my group I had the scallops, wife had the shrimp and andouille sausage kabobs. 

Very tasty and well prepared by someone who knew how to cook properly. Sides were tasty and different than average. Definitely a do again.
Continually one of my favorite go-to breakfast spots. They also have a great lunch menu. Coffee and mimosas happen quite often. Get a seat in their patio if it's available.

Thank goodness for Yelp! Family was wanting Pho, but not wanting to drive 45 min to Missouri to hit our normal place. Checked Yelp and found Saigon. I'm truly surprised something this good was in a strip mall in Belleville. 

First and foremost, the "chips and salsa" threw us for a loop. Crispy shrimp chips fried like cracklin and basically pico de gaio.  You will want a bag to go! 

Appetizer chosen was the "crepe" just try it. Fresh sprouts inside a thin pancake like deliciousness.

Dinner consisted of Each of us getting 3 different types of Pho and a lomein for the young one. This was some tastiness all around. All of the pho was as good as any I had at the big locations. 

Service was friendly and extremely helpful since none of us could figure out proper technique to eat the appetizer. No matter we were the last customers at closing, the staff was friendly and seemed genuinely happy to be there. If you need some really good Vietnamese food on the east side, make your way to Saigon!
Had an amazing time on Valentine's Day. Will definitely be back. Tasty house drinks and the show is enough to make it a regular spot.

We went to this Mendenhall Inn Restaurant about 6 months ago and were seated in the back of the bar.  Service was sparse at best.   I made them aware of the experience and they put us 'in the computer for the next time' and would make it up to us on a different occasion.  Well that occasion came to us this past weekend and I wanted to relate this story as it is quite entertaining.  
This place always seems to have a crowd and has a very nice atmosphere.  We went there for my wife's Birthday with a positive attitude.  After all, how could a place so nice be so bad?   Read on...
After 20 minutes, I decided to keep a time table, so here is a recap of the evening:

:00 - We were seated immediately in the dining room close to the piano.  How NICE!!! 

:01 - Greeted by the waiter and were told that he would be just a minute

:03 - Water given for table

:07 - Butter 'balls' delivered to the table (Great so far!!!)

:15 - Ordered app and wine (saw waiter running around, but our water glasses never got empty.  (Great job on the water!)

:25 - Wrong wine presented at the table prior to opening.  Not what I ordered.  Fortunately I had kept the wine men and 'proved' what I had ordered.  Apparently, I had the "wrong wine menu'.  

:27 - I was given a different wine menu and assured that this was the correct one. Okay, this ie becoming interesting at this point.

:37 - ordered new wine and the waiter gave me an excuse why service was going to be bad "crazy night, they have me all over the place tonight".  People in the service industry - Never tell this to your customers.  They do not want to hear it!!!  We also asked for some rolls.

:37.5 - Rolls given to the table.  WOW 30 seconds to get them!  
Note table beside us was empty when we sat down and they had the same waiter.  They already had rolls and wine.  Jealous urges set in.  

:43 - The table beside us got apps at the same time as us   Note that there were no app plates at the table.  Everyone was hungry so we all ate our one shrimp in the middle of the table off of the serving platter.  Are you picturing this????

:48 - Server seemed hesitant and came over holding a wine menu and said, "You are not going to believe this, but you were given the wrong wine menu again."  "This one is for sure the right one."  At this point, I asked for the manager and was going to call it a night.

:51 - Manager came over and I briefly recapped the prior event and evening.  I told him that he could just comp the app and we would all just walk away from the event.  He did not apologize, or explain, he just said okay and we called it a night.  A "rain out" I would say.  

Summary - This place has so much potential.  It really does.  The app that we had was quite tasty, but maybe we were just starving (g).  Many tables there had the same service, so I know we were not isolated.  Is this the status quo for a 'nice restaurant' in Southern PA and people just tolerate it???  Unfortunately, we will not be back. For anyone that goes there, we saw on the menu that you can bring your own wine with no cork fee.  Wish I would have known that!!!   We went to a nice tavern (Buckley's Tavern) about 3 miles South in Delaware and had a fantastic meal, which made the evening worth it.  

Hope you were entertained with this review.  I have never seen one with a time line associated with it, but had plenty of 'time' to do it.  

Cheers!

What a great little find this place is.  I have been passing by this place for years and never went in. Was I missing out. Do not let the outside fool you. Inside the market is a nice clean restaurant. The food is great, it is very clean, and the people that work there Are friendly. 

What a find in Antioch!

Been coming to Princes for years.  I get the extra hot.  Crazy I know, but it is so addictive.  I have a feeling of euphoria after I eat it.  I have been to EVERY hot chicken place in the Nashville area (up to 8 open currently with one more maybe on the way).  Princes is by far the best, but be patient.  They are in no hurry and you should not be either.  I try to go once a week, but sometimes do not make it.  This is a Nashville must and my ratings are always based on the type of place it is and not the Mobil 5 star system.  

This is my favorite hot chicken place in Nashville with a close follow up by 400 Degrees and then Scoreboards.  At 400 Degrees, you can call ahead and they will have it ready for you.  Nice people too.  

Well, enjoy!
Nice place for hot chicken.  I still like Princes, 400 degrees, scoreboards, then Hot Stuff.  It is in the neighborhood, so conveniently located.  Everything cooked to order, so be patient.

Oh my goodness! What have I been missing??? We went to a haunted house the other night and I used Yelp to find a restaurant nearby. Found Cafe Bosna!!! I knew where it was from living near there 10 years ago, so I was not expecting much. Used to be a place called KO's in that strip mall. 

The reviews were overwhelming so I could not resist going there. We had some small sausages for an app. They were served hot off the grill were good. Only so much you can do with just meat though. 

The Chicken Cordon Bleu was fantastic (we split it)! The best that I have ever had!!! And the mashed potatoes are to die for. 

We met the owner and she is very nice. It was just my wife and I in the restaurant and she turned down the lights, lit candles and put on some music. Wow. A tip to the owner, some indirect lighting, some nice curtains on the windows , and kill the lights on the fridge and you will have a very romantic place! 

We got so full that we could not possibly eat desert, but there it came. fresh Apple Strudel. Oh my... We got it to go and had one bite each before leaving. It did not disappoint! 

Noticed when paying that the cooking oven is just a regular oven like at your house. 

While we were there, several other people walked in and I talked to some of them. Apparently the goulash is VERY popular and a favorite amongst the regulars. 

Well today is Monday and I am sad, as they are closed and I cannot go for lunch to try some other delicacies. 

One more tip -  BYOB, so a nice bottle of wine puts this over the top!!!

Five stars plus!!!

The best super duper deluxe ultimate Cajun chicken sandwich EVER. That's all the review needed.  Try this place!!!  The only thing I am disappointed about it that he does not make his 'special' hot sauce anymore. 

Been coming here since he was in Madison. I wish he was closer. 

Enjoy!

Wow. All I can say is great food, friendly service, and free WiFi.  I do hate it for the staff, as behind the bar, they have to lean over a lot to serve the patron...  

Will be going back to try more.

I did not try the food.  I always thought that this was a quaint place.  My wife and I came here at 8:30 at night and were going to get a glass of wine and either an appetizer or split an entree.  The appetizer were all fried, so we were going to split an entree.   Wait....   $5 extra charge to split a plate.  And that on top of the high teens/low twenties price tag per entree.   Sorry, but we drank our wine and left. Nice place, wish I could have tried the food, but not at a premium. 

:-(

My wife and I ordered the same filet cut and noticeable difference in both size and quality of the steak.  Mine was about 3-4 oz smaller and had gristle.  I order mine rare + and was a perfect medium rare.  My wife ordered here medium rare and was more medium well.  The waiter was good and very attentive, but mentioned giving him a "good tip" four times throughout the experience.  This turned me off.  We sat upstairs in what used to be a porch and there is no music or any type of ambiance to make this a special place.

I really want this place to be better due to it's nostalgia, but other steakhouses in the area are sooo much better.  Kayne Prime for example.

This was the second time I have been to Pollo Tropical. The first time was awesome, with great service and fantastic food. This review is for the snotty manager and no chicken!  Went in and the three people in front of me left without placing an order. As I approached the cash register, the cashier stated it would be a thirty minute wait for chicken. Isn't that what they are known for???  As we were standing there, we got an update that it would be 15 minutes. I said okay and we placed our orders.  Thinking about it, I asked if they would discount our order for the inconvenience. The cashier said no and I asked if she would ask a manger. The female manager 5'6", shoulder length dark brown hair, mid 40's was snotty and stated that they just could not do that. I stated that seemed only fair and she was flippant and said no. 

I then told the cashier to cancel my order and went next door. 

Too bad Pollo Tropical. Your food was so good the first time, but this time you just lost a customer because of your manager!

Great food, still new and needs some work. We went to the Blue Cactus for the first time in the new location and overall, the food was great. Short falls were the service (our waitress was good, but others needed training), ambiance and and the details. 

The Cajun fondue was off the chain.  Never got the extra bread, as the server said I ordered it several times, "I do not know if you will get it. Do you want me to try one more time?  I'll go check on it".  The only check I got was the bill. Update - see below. 

The lighting was harsh and bright.  The ceiling was leaking water. The noise was loud with no baffles.  Now the food. The food is excellent.  With great service and atmosphere, this place could be 5 stars. Really has potential. 

Oh - there is one server (bar escalator?) that is cold and could use training. She did not crack a smile and looked annoyed or put out that she had to deliver our drinks. Be careful of her Yelpers. Not our server, but the one who apparently delivers drinks.  Brrrrr.,.  

Salmon tacos great, rattlesnake pasta, spicy ( I was told and very happy with the space level)

Keep trying guys. I'll be back. Please be successful, as the last 2 restaurants in this location have failed. 

Update - as we received our bill the manager came over and explained that the extra bread was a mix up in the kitchen and they compensated us for it.  Bonus! - extra tip for our server for recognizing the issue and bringing it to managements' attention.


Upping my raining one star from 3 to 4 based on follow up. 

Please do well Blue Cactus. I am a huge fan of local owned establishments!

Sorry bar Louie. I wanted this to be a good experience, but with lazy bartenders, dirty dishes, and cold food, it is hard to give a good review. We had to endure a empty Bloody Mary glass with a celery stick that looked like the blow up guy that his arms move for the 40 minutes we were here.  The flatbread that was brought out took over 20 minutes and was luke warm. No beer refills offered ( I had to ask each time). 

The dirty bar is appalling. 

$42 later, I walk out disappointed.  

I will come back for drinks not expecting much but expensive beer.

I really wanted to like this place. The first time I came here, Rock was the chef and he went on and on about how everything was fresh and it was all made to order. The Nashville Hot flavor was fantastic, but not as spicy as some of the other chicken places around Nashville. 

The second time I came was with a buddy and I tried the Jerk Chicken. It was so so, but my friend got the Nashville Hot. He let me try his, and the heat level was mild at best. He said something about it and they brought out two tenders that were hotter than what he got originally, but no where near the heat level of my first time. 

Time number three came around and I was very excited to get the XXX hot, only to be disappointed that my chicken was not fresh, luke warm, and the fries cold. So much for the fresh I was promised by Rock. Dave was the chef on time two and time three, so perhaps that is the issue???  

The waitress is Breanna and I mentioned to her after the meal and paying for my check, I mentioned to her, "I would like to give you some feedback from my experience today.  The food was not fresh". At that she gave me a look like I had snakes coming out of my head, said nothing, and walked away not following up at all.  I was not expecting anything from the comment, but based on this, I'm done with Hot Chicks. 

Sorry Rock, I love your attitude and you seem like a solid dude. I wish you the best.
Here at 8:15 on Saturday, supposedly opens at 7:30 per the sign. Dark inside, no one around.  Drove 10 miles to come here.  Sorry, do not think I will try again. So sad.

Went on the night of their grand opening to the public and was very impressed with the layout, the decor and the bar is awesome.  Looking for a seat at the bar, the only space was at the end, close to the POS, where the staff would congregate.  Sat down to a sticky bar and no paid any attention to us.  7 minutes later, a few seats became available and we moved and gained the attention of the bartender immediately.  Our cocktails were made artisan style and tasted as described.  When it came time to be seated, we were given a tour of the place, which is small, but very impressive overall with some surprises peppered throughout the establishment.  
To make a long story shorter, the brined chicken that I ordered was dry and unflavored.  I brought this to the attention of the waiter and they did get me another one which was 100% better, but lacked luster and flavor.  Very disappointing.   My wife's salmon was under cooked, too sweet and only warm to the touch.  We ordered the 2 premium sides at $13 each, the Brussels sprouts (sweet also), and the prosciutto wrapped asparagus (probably the best thing on the menu).  A manager did check on us, but did not seem to care, offer dessert (my reservation did state it was out anniversary), or other consolidation. Bottom line, the food was overpriced, with substandard quality, temperature, and amateur plating.   Glad I went, but after wine, cocktails, entrees and side, $400 for two people is a bit steep for the great atmosphere and airplane quality food.  I do hope they get better, as I love the place.  Please concentrate on the food quality!

This restaurant is permanently closed.  Poor management over the years and no customers. They had a very good happy hour and I used to like to go there, but they are done done.  

Too bad.  I liked it, just poor management over the years.  

Good bye WWC!

Highly suggest this place. Ingredients are fresh and unique. Seating can be tight, suggest reservations in evening or be ok w belling-ing up to bar. Had the chef special, shared several apps, all the crepes and super tasty German beer on tap. Everything was incredible. I'm legit going back in the morning for breakfast. 

This place is for locals and tourists. On the second story in the corner of plaza. Easy and free parking. Can see the water from the back tables.

This place has my heart. Ralf Beelers salted gruyeré cheese gravitationally pulls me into the store on the regular. 

Get an espresso when you're there w whip topping. 

Currently stalking out and waiting for the seasonal strawberry rhubarb pie.

Inside smells funny so walk thru and up to second story outside dinning patio/ totally on da gulf! 

Immediately write your name on the large chalk board on da wall w the number of peeps in your party. 

I love the crawfish basket. 

Enjoy
Good biscuits and gravy. Fast service. Refilled coffee fast enough for me (coffee addict). It's not fancy but it's a getter done breakfast place. Staff super nice.

Fried salmon skin is an "add-in" option for all the rolls. 

HIGHLY SUGGEST THIS! 

It taste like bacon and is loaded w omegas. So if you're feeling like giving your brain stomach and tongue a treat.. salmon skin - who knew!? Incredible. 

All food I've had here has been great. Eat here weekly.

The $6 tacos and shrimp quesadillas draw me in almost weekly. Give the "bloody beer" a try or their "top shelf margaritas" are great ie: dangerous too. 

Parking is tight. 

Think skinny thoughts if you wanna eat inside.

Super clean! Amazing fresh affordable produce. 

Try the gyro w the beer in the dark bottle. So good on a hot summer day. 

Love the strawberry chocolate bars too.

Been twice. 

First dinner dropped a cool $50-60 on entree w app and a beer or two and split dessert. 

(There are NO SPIRITS HERE) Just wine and beer.  

If available try their green goddess dressing on your salad. My guess is it's  avocado, cilantro or parsley, lime, garlic EVOO concoction. 

Worth every penny! Yum

Second dinner hit the "early bird" special 4-6.p It's limited menu, not the full dinner menu. Had the salmon. Excellent! They gave us a free "mini aka tiny" slice of key lime pie which was the perfect size.

Really good filet. Little over priced. The outside patio table lighting is dark to pitch black on the outer perimeter. So if you're a stickler about seeing what your eating. Sit inside or patio tables close to building.

BBQ pork buns, dumplings and bubble tea are my staples here. 

Tried the chicken feet for the first time. Recommend not waiting til they cool down. Eat while hot. 

Oh and try the salt egg bun as a desert item. Very yummy.

Went once. Food was nasty. Staff is rude. 

GO  to HONG KONG for Chinese. It's a mile away. 

Seriously the food here is gross.

This is my Chinese go to place. Super nice lady works the front. Super clean. 
Great food. 

They offer crab rangoon's even tho not on menu. 

It's a great take out and/or delivery place. 

Only two tables to dine in. No air conditioning.

There's something fucky about this taco bell. 

The peeps who work there - amazing! Always super nice.

But.. 

The food taste funky. Def not consistent w the brand. 

They run out of staples like tortilla shells. 

((Side eye)) there's just something off bout this location. Go to next location on 66

Great mex for casual dine in or even better delivery.

To the manager or people who make things happen at this place ----

PLEASE ADD SHRIMP AS A PROTEIN OPTION TO YOUR MENU!! 

*not having shrimp is reason me take star away

Legit dream about da OOEY burger  

The staff are always extremely tolerable of my drunk shenanigans which I soberly whole heartedly appreciate. For realz! 

Thank you cook for your delish 100% perfectly cooked every savory time patties. 

BEST BURGER EVER!

Fav watering hole. Casual, affordable. 

Cash only. Have ATM on premises 

Good solid pours. Great happy hour specials. 

Get the LOBSTER PIZZA YUM &

All about the large lobster pizza. The small pan size for some reason doesn't taste as good as large. 

Same owners as Willy's across the street. 

Great happy hour specials

Total of 4 visits.

Has beautiful outside patio on intercostal.

Martinis are great.

SEAFOOD PAELLA 
THE NUMBER SALAD 

Holy GREAT FOOD! For locals or tourist.

Can be romantic or super casual. 

Prefer this location over Tampa

Love the breakfast! Great biscuits and gravy. Great burgers and sandwiches. 

Hate the margarita mix. 

Love that i can booze it up w breakfast!!

THIS PLACE!? FUCK YAAA!!! 

Legit love this place. The air conditioner leaks on ur back, face & food sometimes so prissy whiney bitches please fuck off. 

Food amazing. 
Servers and service amazing. 

To da staff- THANK U for all ur patience, kindness & SOLID POURS to me and my fucktard friends. Like that one time you had to tell me that my friend couldn't sleep on the bar. You did it w eloquence and grace.

Lobster Tuesday ie: great day drinking spot on Boca Ciega Bay. 

Tried lobster pizza, lobster ceviche, quesadilla, bisque.. all amazing. 

The crowd gets a lil to sea urchiny in the evenings. Professional drinking sailors. 

Blimey pirates

Solid Cuban fo sho. 
Easy free parking. 
Air conditioning is always a plus. 
The pork dishes are all amazing. 
Lots of tables and booths. 
Excellent friendly service.

Love being able to get a whole pie or simply single slice w normal to funky delish toppings! 

Love the staff- owner-bartenders. 
Solid strong black out pours in the bar! 

Fav part was high jacking juke box from the privacy of my table all incognito like and over hearing the cooker bitching about my Michael Jackson take over. It cost me a solid $35 dollars to Alfa everybody else's play list and dominate w the king of pop for my entire pizza consuming experience. 
#worthEVERYpenny

Had an espresso and chocolate Croissant and went back in for second espresso. Super fast service and amazing croissant. 
Had some of my friends hazelnut pastry and was exploding w lil nuggets of chocolate and hazelnut. Not sure of the name but if u can get that one!!

Avoid this place! NOT SAFE

Friend and I were drugged at outside bar. Friend remembers bartender and some old creepy guy having a weird exchange before giving us our shots. Then lights out for the two of us for a day and half. Wake up super sick and confused.
Friend went back a few weeks later. His 6 foot friend had one drink then started falling out. The mf got dosed.  

SERIOUSLY AVOID! Bad-strange-up-to-no-good mf trolling this shit hole! There was a very good chance the bartender was in on it. Could be a full on racket.

All of it. Every part of it. Amazing.

Cute privately owned inter coastal cafe. 

Outside seating has view of blue water and sail boats. Inside nice bright w a variety of seating choices. No stairs. 

Had a banana w Nutella toasted croissant that looked pressed. Super flipping yum. Splurged on an iced mocha. Best iced Mocha I've ever had.. EVER..

So all u Starbucks snobs (recovering Starbucks junkie here- not judging). 
This is a safe and beautiful step outside that box. 

Easy front and side parking. Be careful backing out of side parking spots b/c it's not the usual distance. Almost hit a car so be super aware of that.. 

Extremely happy and helpful staff.  

Be careful! Went in to get an espresso and couldn't resist upgrading and lounging for a solid hour. Amy Winehouse was playing softly in the back ground. Then started trying to recruit friends to join. You might get trapped in the solei bubble

Misogynistic and belittling male employee experience here. Avoid this place!! 

Averaged breakfast here 1-3 times a week. Lunch 1-3 a month. Not super regular but not nothing either.

It was 730 in the morn and to early for some obnoxious male employee to throw any type of under the breathe snarky comments. 

Currently I work as a service provider at a high end resort. There are to many amazing restaurants on this magical beach to give to second to negative dining experiences!

Avoid this place. Go to Snappers for dinner or Ricks Reef for breakfast.

Loved my experience here. It's a simple menu using fresh local ingredients cooked in their home made fire oven. Completely rocked my taste buds! Save room for desert. Support local small biz like this place folks! It's a St Pete GEM!

Excellent scallops steak and sides. Can eat easily on Keto here. Wish I would have known about the dessert cheese platter prior to dinner order. Would have got that in beginning and/ or incorporated into meal. Highly rescind this place. Sexy chill interior. Huge parking lot so don't stress about downtown parking.

Excellent sushi experience. Small. Possibly only 10 chairs. On the weekends it's a chefs menu. $80-$150 per person. Obviously call ahead to reserve or check for availability. 
You may order extra off menu. 
It's a beautiful experience to let the experienced chef and staff prepare and serve special ingredients and freshly flown in ocean treats just for you right in front of you. 
HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE FOR SUSHI!!

Nice new place. Got 3 meals out of pork belly dinner. Chose red cabbage and blue cheese slaw as sides. Both yummy. Decent side lot parking that you have to pay for. Or just park on central. W friends that told me 1st ave S entrance was easier. 
It's a bright atmosphere w comfortable tables.

Have tried BIRTHDAY CAKE, white & reg cheddar,  caramel, Midwest & the green one which might be called key west or key lime. There product is % hands down best gourmet popcorn ever!  Birthday cake is my personal favorite - highly recommend! 

Bonus, the girls/family that own it are fantastic! So not only are you getting a great product! You're supporting small biz & local!! Highly suggest the large tins for gifts! 

I believe they offer free shipping. You won't regret this purchase! Give them your money!

Best pie on the beach! Hands down! Really friendly family run biz w fast and easy delivery! It's located close to beach access and has easy parking! Everything I've ever ordered from here has been the best tasting Italian on St Pete Beach!! It's not fancy so you can go in w your beach gear on! Kept very clean!

fRPHzqV585t-Q18Duklb9A.review_text: I tried Stone House from the billboard posting on Charlotte.  I had the pulled chicken with collard greens, cornbread and macaroni & cheese.  The food was divine.  I loved the barbeque sauce.  Being from the Carolinas I tend to find most of the sauces here are too sweet for my preference.  This was just right.  A little spice, thick in texture and not loaded with vinegar.  The collard greens were divine!  Nice little patio to enjoy a cold one!  Will certainly go back and would recommend adding to your rotation.

Truly disappointed! Ordered a captain and diet...it was flat.  When I told the waiter he said...yeah I know.  Nachos were not worthy!  Would not recommend as the next sports bar...does not compare with Sam's!

Decided to give this another try after a not so stellar first experience.  We decided to do a quick impromptu sushi night and enjoy some drinks on the patio.  The sushi was fabulous and the happy hour actually includes top shelf liquor.  

The patio was one of if not the best in Nashville; plenty of seating, an outdoor bar and according to the waiter they have live music in the summer. The wait staff was very prompt, funny and pleasant.

Not sure what they recently renovated; it still looks exactly the same.  Decent food and the service is okay.

If you want to go somewhere and actually have a conversation this isn't the place.  It is always full of screaming and crying kids, combined with the tightly packed tables....pass!

I tried this based on location and the great recommendations.  First impression is they lack good customer service.  I ordered the deli sandwich on the wheat bread.  The sandwich was a little bland.

Attitude of wait staff left a lot to be desired. Disorganized and totally seemed like you were interrupting them.

Great location! Great and friendly bartenders and waitstaff. Sunny the bartender is great.

Great selection of food, extends past the typical bar fare and they have weekly and daily specials.  

Only negative is parking.

So my first trip to to Edley's was the starting point for a Scavenger Hunt for Oyster Easter King and Queen.  I arrived a few minutes early to try and secure parking.  They do have a private lot around back and there is maybe 20 parking spots.  Pretty good for this part of town.

For a Saturday afternoon I have to say they had a pretty nice crowd and it was quite an eclectic mix of people.  I got a seat at the bar and ordered a Corona Light; no Corona here.  What?  Okay, let's try a Captain and Diet Coke; once again a no go.  So I figure third time is a charm right? Since I could see the bottle of Jack on the shelf I decided I would order a Diet Coke and Jack.  Score!  They did have it in stock. 

I decide to open a tab while I wait and perused the menu.  Not a big menu but the choices are very simple! So the bartender comes back after a few minutes and says,  "you were having a Jack and Coke, right?" Nope, diet and Jack.  Really, you already forgot.  Okay, so she is not off to a good start.  I decide to cool my jets and continue to peruse the menu. 

Drink finally arrives and to my dismay it is the size of a child's cup, seriously for $6.50.  Okay, clearly they are not interested in drawing a crowd based off the bar service here.  I decide it is time to place an order for some food; I start with an order of the fried pickles and well they were excellent.  Just enough salt and crispy!  Great job.  The BarBQue sandwich is divine; coleslaw piled on top.  I definitely give the food a great review.  

They definitely draw a crowd here.  A lot of families with kids and strollers come here.  Don't get me wrong I don't mind kids and think they are wonderful; but the parents I have to question.  Who lets there three year old run all over the restaurant and you just sit there!  You might think it's cute, but I sure don't!  If you can't control them; then don't bring them.  I paid just like you and I choose to enjoy my evening.  Sorry, where was I?

To wrap it all up; I will definitely give them another try.  The food was delicious and worth sampling a few more items.  I do think the next time I will wait until a little later in the evening and hopefully all the kiddies will be tucked in safe and tight for the night!

This was my second visit here; only this time I was here for an event and it was held upstairs.  It is definitely and older establishment; lots of dark wooded paneling but very spacious and they have several tables as well as pool tables and dart boards.  

The fried pickles here are really good but this time I was in the mood for a good cheeseburger.   Pleased with my choice; regular sized beef patty; not your usual flat frozen selection.  The fries were a little bland; some salt would have gone a long way.  

The bathroom was a one stall and left a little to be desired.  For a bar this size you need more than onsie for the ladies.  

A negative here is they allow smoking; and while I don't discriminate against the smokers; there was a lot of smoking going on here.  Opening a window or door would have helped.  

Overall experience; typical sports bar; nothing to write home about.

It's spring in Nashville and we need a patio.  So after several tossed out ideas we decide on Rumba.  I get there around 5:35 to try and get a table.  It is already pretty packed; but I get a table for 6 pretty quickly and enjoy the awesome weather.

I am waiting, I am waiting and watching everyone else get there tasty beverage and wondering were the...is my waitress?  Finally she arrives and apologizes for the delay and offers me a drink and let's me know that it is happy hour until 6 and top shelf liquor is included.  Very nice I might add.  So I decide on a captain and diet and off she goes.  And once again, I am waiting and waiting.  My friend arrives and it is 5:55, I suggest that he go inside and place his order if he wants to take advantage of the happy hour.  He goes inside gets his drink comes back out and yep, I am still waiting.  

To make a long story short; she finally comes over and asks did I not get my drink?  Well, no or I would be sipping it right now.  She apologizes and says she will be right back.  So at 6:15 I finally get my drink!  

There is a lot of action on this patio and the clientele is very unique.  Some great people watching going on here.  The patio has about 12 tables under the awning and there is maybe 10 that are not covered.  Nice size for Nashville!

Everyone arrives and we decide to place our orders.  A lot to choose from here.  From Hummus, egg rolls, flat bread to steak.  I decide to order the arugula salad and the St. Kitts Flat bread, another friend orders the vegetarian flat bread, chicken and some pork.  Food portions for the flat bread were very nice.  You could share with someone if you choose.  Reasonably priced and was delicious.

The inside is very cozy and serves as a great date spot!  Would recommend and will certainly be back.  My only tip, is get there early!

Decided to check it out as I have seen the sign and the construction over the past few months.  Their sign doesn't give you a lot to go on so I wasn't really sure what they offered.

It is super casual all American cuisine eat in or takeout restaurant.  You come in and place an order at the register; one for dining in and one for takeout.  They have Pizza, Sandwiches, Salads and Dessert.  

I ordered the Ultimate Salad and was very pleased.  The salad is huge; enough for dinner and lunch.  The ingredients were fresh, nice presentation and quickly prepared.

Will definitely be on my rotation for pickup on the way home!

What can I tell you that the name doesn't already say.

It is a local small joint located in the heart of Sylvan Park; it is small compact, filled with regulars and you can walk to it!

Food is good, drinks are right and the atmosphere is casual.

Okay who hasn't been to Jersey Mikes?  So this is a pretty simple review for some simple grub.

You order your sandwich, have it your way or Mike's and can make it a combo by adding chips and a drink.

The service is fast, the price is right and the sandwiches are way better than Subway....Who cares what Jarrod thinks!

First let me say I went here only because I was so sick and tired of hearing about cupcakes.  I wasn't a fan when I was six and I am not now. I do not like Icing.  There I said it, let the healing begin.

So the cakes come in a full size or they also have the mini Bundt cakes.  I decided to buy two, Cinnamon and chocolate.  I bite into it with a bit of trepidation expecting it to be extremely dry and to my surprise it was very moist and had a great flavor.

I don't know how long they will last; I mean how often is someone in the mood for a Bundt cake.  That is all they offer.  I think it is a bit of a limitation but then again who would have thought that grown adults would be so loopy for cupcakes. 

So stop in and have a bite!

Let's set the expectations up front.  This is an older pub that draws mostly an older regular Belle Meade crowd and some families.  It is a great location and one of the original restaurants in Sylvan Park; although there have been some recent additions over the past few years.  

The bar itself is old in decor; mostly paneling and the bar is the big feature.  They offer a "special" daily and the food is average.  They have a big outdoor dinning area that is fenced off and is an anomaly in this area.  Great to ride your bike down for dinner and a drink.  

I might add there is some good people watching here; however don't park in their lot and think you can run across to Local Taco, Cafe Nona, Park Cafe or any other establishment.  These guys are a bit touchy when it comes to parking!

I am torn on my rating as it varies based on the night and purpose for my visit; Christmas party, girls night out, impromptu happy hour to dinner with friends.  Overall this is a great local place, food is good and the drinks are good.

I personally don't think this is a great date spot if you intend to have a private conversation.  It is very small and the tables are very close; if your not careful you will be listening to their conversation and totally forget about the people you are with!  

The "Better than Sex Chocolate Cake" is the bomb!  Now I don't know if it would go down as better than sex with the right person but if they were just okay; I would choose the cake!  Just saying!

Crab cakes, Mac & Cheese, flatbreads, cheese plates, you name it and it has been great.  They have a wonderful selection of wines and good prices for Happy Hour.

A couple of tips; not a lot of seating at the bar so if you are coming for HH; get there early.  Parking is horrible but they offer valet - use them!

It's a chain and it's all the same!

I work in the not so hip trendy district so your lunch selections are limited to Ruby's, Applebee's and Hooters.  

Lunch service is fast and efficient; food is good.

If you like people watching, enjoy a great patio and enjoy half price bottles of wine on Sunday after 3; then this is your place.

The food is good, but I honestly can't say spectacular.  I am not a big fan of meatloaf but would recommend the barbecue meatloaf here.  I also love the Torrado's and for starters the sesame barbecue chicken is deli-sh.

Parking in Hillsboro village; well it is what it is.  Your options are street parking or in the evenings take advantage of the post office or church parking.  It is very noisy on the street with all the ambulances and fire trucks that usually go by.

The wait staff while a little peculiar on occasion do a great job keeping up with the flow of traffic; although there socialization skills could be refined!

I went in a little iffy with all the Vegan reviews; hey I like meat; what can I tell you.  However, I came out a huge fan!

From the moment we arrived on a Saturday evening with no reservation and were immediately seated on the patio at our request.  The waiter arrived very promptly to give us some water, share the specials and take our drink order.

We decided to do the 3 for $35 option; although we choose to order from the wine menu instead of taking advantage of the $5 house wine.  I selected the calamari as my started, claims for entree and cannolei for desert.  We also decided to split an order of the crab cakes.  Hands down they are the BEST crab cakes this side of Charleston!  The coleslaw that is served with them is absolutely to die for.  I could have eaten an entire plate!

You can also get some good people watching in here; they come in all shapes, forms and walks of life.  

I am a fan and will be back for the crab!

As much as we all like to say we are all the same and there are no differences on the other side of the river; we all know that just isn't true!

So being an adventurous sort, my girlfriend decide to give it a try based on a recommendation from a friend who I would have reasoned knew my tastes and preferences pretty well.  We arrive Saturday night around 10:30; there is a bouncer at the door and a few people loitering around.  From the outside I have to say it doesn't look like much and you will pass it if you are not careful.

So we go in and take a seat at the bar; we are given a menu to peruse.  The drinks are a little different than your typical bar variety although they have a fully stocked bar.  So the bar tender approaches to take our order; we give the spill we want to try something new and tell him our typical drink of choice.  Based on that preference he makes you a drink.  

I am reticent to say I can't recall the name of the drink..so needless to say they are pretty stout. I am a diet and jack or captain kind of girl but this was a clear/gin lemonade type drink.  Very tart and not what I was expecting.  Keeping the open mind I decide to drink on and find that it is refreshing and different in a pleasant way.  They add air/carbonation to all there drinks and do a little "cocktail" rendition by trying to through the drink in the air, etc.  No, they do not possess the same sex appeal as Tom Cruise, at least in my opinion.  

It appears to be a kind of local, retro and eclectic mix of people.  All in all it was not a bad experience but after two drinks we decided to head across the river and back to our vanilla world!

Yep, I would go back but don't count me being a local!

It's like any other dive/tourist bar on Broadway.  

The music is good, the drinks are strong and everyone thinks they look great.

For an afternoon of honky tonk give them a whirl!

If you have been to one Honky Tonk bar you have truly seen them all, but hey we all like to be adventurous and try something new.

The band was pretty good; of course you know they work for tips and the moment you walk in the door and haven't heard a full song; they will come up to you and want to know if you want to tip the band.  Here is my tip; wait till I have heard a full song before you ask!

Bartender was efficient and had a decent pour; drink prices are average.  It was a little smokey; they had the doors open so that helped.

Not a big dance floor but hey when it's closing time you can dance where you want!

Heard there was a new Pasta place in town and had to check it out.  I went on a Monday night and was able to get a nice patio seat.  

The waitress quickly greeted us and was very personable; she did share she was on the lemonade diet and how hard it was to serve this yummy food all day and not eat.  Yeah, good luck with that!

Monday nights are "Free Pasta" which means; you buy a drink and you can get a create your short or long pasta with your choice of sauce (no meat for all the carnivores out there)  for free!  Pretty good deal right!

The wine list could use a little upgrading but for the price of the food hell just buy another glass.  I could not believe how cheap the prices were and how good the food was.  

This place definitely has it going on and you won't need to sell your dog to afford it!

Okay I do have to clear my name here....being a regular at Hooters is not something I am proud of, however I work on the "wrong" side of town and my choices are limited.

What can I tell you....the girls are cheap....Hold your judgments; it doesn't have anything to do with their boobs.  I have a great set myself.  It is about class; get some please!

Service leaves a little to be desired, food is okay and prices are also.

Will I go back, yes because my only other option is some fast food joint or Apple-bee's.  Jealous aren't you.

So if you are in the neighborhood.....

Andre the waiter was awesome...food is as expected.

The store is very clean and draws quite a crow.  I was surprised to see they even had a small outdoor dining area.  Service time to be seated far exceeds the wait at Cracker Barrel and is a much better value in my opinion.

Cabana has done a good job of turning around it's failing reputation from a few years back.  My review is based solely on Ladies Night on Wednesday.  I have been twice now and find that they are working hard to change the atmosphere, service and the food.  You can't beat the $5 dollar drink and food specials.  If you are bringing a crowd I suggest you make a reservation.  

Drink specials run until 10pm!

Love this place!  The variety of yogurt varies and they constantly have something new to try.  Every topping imaginable is available; from broken up candy pieces, brownies, cheesecake, nuts (all varieties), fresh seasonal fruit, whipped toppings, fudge...the list keeps going.

If there would be a any complaint; is I never walk out of there for less than $10 due to the amount of fruit and the weight.

Love it!

I have heard so many rave reviews about Moe's so I decided to give it a try.  I am a HUGE fan of Chipotle and have heard the two compared.

As I enter the place I will give kudos for quickly yelling "Welcome to Moe's" although I don't know that I prefer someone yelling welcome when they don't even take the time to look up and see who I am.  Moving on....

So I place my order; I am looking for the burrito bowl.  So the closest option is the Chicken and Rice.  The cooked peppers and onions looked as if they mush the entire pepper and never bothered to slice it; the chicken had so much gristle, flavorless, the beans and rice left so much to be desired that I honestly threw the entire bowl away after two bites.

Lesson to me; don't get a to go order until you have at least tried the food otherwise you will be hungry!

I will not be back...

Okay so they have a patio and they are in a trendy district but I just can't give them a better review.  The food is okay, the drinks are well there drinks; you can get them at any bar.  My overall gripe with this place is there stuff, uptight and persona they are trying so hard to portray.

I have been three times now and every time I have been, there are open tables yet when you check in at the hostess stand they have never said less than an hour weight time.  Are you kidding me????  We had a group of six - big booth back in the corner was open when we arrived; we went to the bar and had a drink and one hour later they came back to seat is in the table that had been opened the entire time.

If your short staffed then fix the problem.  I waited tables in college so I understand not seating multiple people in one serves section at the same time, however this is unacceptable.

Get over yourself folks and people will either keep coming back or they won't making us wait doesn't earn you any special points.

Great location.  Very roomy and loved all the open outdoor dinning.  First week had some issues getting order correct but manager made it right by removing it from the bill.

I love the open feel of the restaurant and bar.  I look forward to coming back in the fall to experience the fire pits.  

I will be back to give it another go!

fog2DD4JiauuSeZpci0jAw.review_text:
The pizza was wonderful, plenty of sauce and lots of sausage. Service was great. Heather, the bartender, certainly knew how to handle a crowd, and did a great job. 
Highly recommend this little place, have a nice little bar and like I said = service was great.
WOW - this is a great little hidden place.  The food was excellent and the service was outstanding.  I would certainly visit this restaurant again.

This is one of the best Italian restaurants.  The pizza is wonderful.  The restaurant itself is a bit noisy - but the food makes up for it.  Service is always great.  If you are going for dinner = suggest you get there before 5:00 p.m. - cause it gets real busy.  The wait however is worth it.

When my husband and I pulled up in front of this restaurant we looked at each other and said "no way".  Well, we were glad our first impression was so wrong.  The restaurant is not fancy - in fact a bit unusual.  We ordered a large pizza (and it was very large) and it was a bit greasy, but the taste was excellent.  You fill your own soda from a dispenser inside the restaurant.  No signs saying no refills.  The chili peppers and cheese are in a holder on the wall of the restaurant.  The cooks were happy to help us find the condiments.  It was a little cool in the restaurant, but it didn't stop us from sitting there for a bit after we had our remaining pizza boxed up.  

The place is super clean - I went into the women's restroom and was pleasantly surprised how clean it was.  The restrooms speak well for an establishment.

I will go back to this restaurant.  I have told my neighbors/friends about the place too. Don't know how long they have been in business - but if you have an opportunity to visit - do so, you won't be disppointed.

This place is a real gem ...... The food is great.  The price is good, and sometimes when it is busy you might end up with lunch mates.  Which can be fun cause you meet all types of people here.  The service is good.  You walk in and there is a huge menu behind the counter - study it for a bit, then order and pay and take a seat and they will deliver it to your table.  I don't know if you have to but I always clean up after I'm thru eating, but like I said I don't know if it is required.  I don't think you'll be disappointed.  There isn't a great deal of parking, but there is street parking.  I'm always amazed at the number of people finding this place.  A real hidden gem here in Tucson.

I'm still laughing .....I never in my 75 years thought that I would be writing about a food truck.  Well let me tell you - this food truck sits near the Pecan Store in Sahuarite - and it is fantastic.  The food is fabulous and they make it fresh for you.  You can add something to the dish - or ask them to hold something - you get it just the way you want it.  They sell soda in the cans and they have a few tables where you can sit and savor your food.  Do stop by ....I know they are there Monday thru Friday but I'm not sure about Saturday/Sunday.  This is the place to go for lunch .......

My husband and I went to Macayo's for dinner.  We waited almost 10 minutes before anyone came to greet or seat us.  My husband told the hostess that we were just about ready to leave - she just smiled.   The food was fair.  The service was not good.  The waiter took our drink order and I tried to order a Happy Hour drink - those prices were only good in bar.  So I decided I'd drink water.  It took forever for the waiter to give us our bill - even close to "tip time" the service was very bad.  We'll never return to this restaurant again.  There are way too many good restaurants in Tucson, but this is not one of them.

We use to go to this restaurant, but the service was not the greatest so we stopped.  Just recently we decided to give it another try.  Much to our surprise the service was fantastic. Our waiter was right there when my drink needed to be refilled.  Asked how our meal was.  You can actually carry on a conversation in this restaurant which is always pleasant.  I would highly recommend this fine establishment.
Once again, I was disappointed.  The young man that came to bring the chips and salsa did not say anything at all.  This was our first impression - and it wasn't good.

The food was good, the server was excellent.  It was my husband's birthday and she did offer him a sundae, but he refused because he hadn't eaten all of his lunch.

I do think that their beverages are over priced.  I had a soda with lots of ice and it was $2.99 which is ridiculous.  Yes, I did have a refill (again lots and lots of ice).  I'll order water in the future.
