I'd go again in a heart beat.

it was so hard to rate Penzeys.  

First I have to say it's a class act store as far as spices go and they have almost everything you need.  i love the set up and feel and it's so easy to find what you want and need. 

Here's my issue.  I was there today, the cashier acted as if I was wasting her time.  She even ignored a question as she finished talking to the other casher.  At the end, i told her I forgot my coupon (for a free spice)  she said bring it with you next time, I told her I rarely get to the store, she said "bring it even if it is expired"  then I said by then, there will be  a new coupon.  

As she packed up my items, a friend walked in the back and she totally forgot I was there, I had to take my bag from her hand. as I said thank you and turned to leave she responds with.. " Oh yeah, here's your receipt"  

I really wish I did not waste her time!

I ended up here one night with a friend, we just had a drink and a couple appetizers but, I can tell you: I'm looking forward to going back.  

It was a bit chilly but we sat on the deck and it was so nice and very peaceful, they did not have the propane heaters or fires going yet, but when they do, it's going to be a really fun place to hang out.

So, we had FF and onion straws and WOW they were both very very good
I can't wait to get back there...

I have the best friend in the world!  When we are out and about he takes me to some of the coolest places and this is one of them!

Sure Einstein Bros. have been around a while, I've passed up a bunch of them in my travels and never went in.. yesterday I had the chance to go enjoy lunch at this particular store.

The cashier was a very nice person with a great personality, he seemed as if, anything thrown at him, he'd be able to handle.  Everyone was nice.  The store is big and very nice atmosphere.

I had the turkey cheddar melt and it was GOOD.  I had it on a thin bagel and I loved that choice... for me, who needs more bread?  

I had an iced tea and it was also very good, I've not had a good iced tea out like that in a long time, besides at Starbucks!

They had a sample basket by the front register so I sampled a pretzel bit with nacho cheese and just because of that sample we purchased a container of them.  The container looks small but there were plenty of pretzels and cheese to take care of that desire.  

It was a very pleasurable experience and I enjoyed the company as well as the food, it's a beautiful area and I can't wait to go back and walk around and find out what else is hiding in this area.

Just went here on a whim and a slight suggestion of a friend.  I was impressed.  The place is large with so many TV screen's  Very clean and the staff was great.  They hustled and did not stop.

The food was amazing.  I was interested in the matzah ball soup and corned beef and WOW it  both were huge, I had to take some home for leftovers and it was great.  

Our waiter Justin was very informative and even gave us menu suggestions, which were very helpful.

I can't wait to go back and take the rest of my family!  

Thank you Lesters!

I've been here twice now and each time I've loved the out door seating.  They have a beautiful waterfall and if it happens to rain there is a covered section to help.

The one thing I did not like is they do not have french fries.  I'm a big FF fan and even though they did have the home made potato chip version, I was really wanting some FF.

I had a hamburger that was really super good.  It was the perfect size and it was made perfectly.  Juicy and moist yet not so red it would make you sick!

Inside the bar they had live Irish music and from what I understand is they bring these bands over from Ireland and let them stay for a period of time while they perform.  How awesome is that. 

I could see having a fun party there with friends and family.  

Thanks McGurks for being original and fun!

I have heard about Jilly's since I moved to Missouri and finally the day came when my daughter and I headed out to enjoy our reserved brunch this past Sunday.  

First.. it's reserved.  So I was thinking WOW, this has to be good.  

It was.. at most OK.  The service was good at removing your plates and making sure you had drinks.   The food was...  hmm different.  

The eggs had cream cheese in it.  But here's the fun thing, I knew there was something different about the slimy eggs but when I asked.. This is the response I got.    Hmm, I don't know.  Imagine hands on hips and attitude.  Now had this been the first time I got this response I'd maybe be okay with it.. but..  

When it came to making the cupcakes there were three icings out.  All unlabeled.  We figured out the choc and van, but.. what was the other?  So, we asked another waitress... her response  "I don't know"   It's van and choc.  So my daughter said, but there are three..  Her response back was.. Well, then it's butter cream.  

Well, it was not buttercream it was peanut butter and what if someone had a peanut allergy?  

I don't know?

So the seating was okay.. it was uncomfortable but I like the trendy feel.  

I won't be back and I'll tell people it's overrated and don't waste the money.  

I'm not sure about the cupcakes but from what I sampled in the brunch they were something I could easily make and nothing spectacular.  

Jilly's you need to educate your staff on what you are serving.  Even the guy filling up the foods did not know what a particular item was when i asked.  

THAT was 3 for 3 all NOT in the favor of knowledgeable staffing.  

So that is my review.. most of the food was at most OK..  the cinnamon pita chips were good...  hmm that is about it.  

Sorry Jilly's I had to write the review and I hope you do read it and educate your staff.

I went to the Popcorn Co. last night, why?  because I was walking around downtown STL and saw the store, and i LOVE popcorn..  The woman their was the owner and she was soooo nice and very friendly, we ended up having great conversation.  Good peolple helps make the STL area amazing!

The best thing about the popcorn is that it's not full of the crap that other companies put in it.  Sure Garretts is good but it's full of crap.  Trust me on this.  I also do not believe she tries to hinge her company on a copy of Garretts, sure she mentions the mix but it's not what she is about it.  

There is a spicy popcorn and a chocolate that is amazing.  She said to mix the cheese and chocolate.. I thought ewww, but she planted that seed and when I left the store I did.  UMMmmm.. HELLO!!!  It was good.  

I think the city needs to do more to help these shop owners out.. it was an amazing night and I felt like I was on a deserted street.  If STL wants to bring people to STL then it better start marking what it's got.  

I loved the Popcorn company on more levels then just the popcorn, it's amazing as well, and I'll be back!!!

French Fries!!!!!  YES!  and they were amazing.  No chips.  I loved it.  

We sat out side and it was so pleasant, great atmosphere.  

I will say this, I had a burger and it was really good, made to perfection and tasted really good.  It was thick and juciy (medium)  

My friend ordered a veggie burger and she raved about it all night "The best she has ever had"  "that curry sauce is amazing"  She will be back for sure!

Service was good and we enjoyed a few drinks and had a wonderful time.  

Go, next time in the STL area, you won't regret it.

I just had my FIRST Hank's Cheesecake.  It was chocolate chip and it was amazing.  I did share it with my daughters but...  WOW. 

Light and airy with a perfect mix of chips with cheesecake.  Some/most melted in your mouth but there were a few that still gave a bit of chunky feel.

I've already decided, it's what I want for my birthday.  June 29th if anyone wants to get me one. 

Have you seen the flavors?  HOLY COW.. honestly more fun and better then Cheesecake Factory.  

ENJOY some and let me know what you think!

We were at the Ice Festival yesterday and wanted to eat, we have missed our lebanese foods, so we stopped in to visit Ranoush.   We were greeted by a very nice woman who seated us.  The menu is amazing but missing a mid price section of offering sandwiches instead of meals.   

We had a bunch of appetizers, arabic french fries cooked to perfection and some potatoes that were very spicy.  Za'atar bread YUM and of course Falafels.  The best was the grape leaves.  They were stuffed to perfection and had a great flavor and taste.   We were very happy with everything, including the service.  Everyone is friendly and nice.  

The one thing I think that may help them is to put up menus by the doors.  We were not sure about ordering and having to come in was something most people will just pass on.  

There is a hookah section but it's closed off and I really did not see any of it.  

The atmosphere is very nice.  The tables were cleaned off as soon as people left.  

OHHH and they did not have any dessert when we were there.  That was sad because were were going to order two, but what can you do.   Wish they had some while we were there.

It's like walking into A clip from A Bronx Tale.  look at the ceiling and walls and you know you are into a real place that's focused on it's food, not it's housing.  

I'm not trying to slam Pio's but I remember that tile in my grandmothers house.  I'm 52.  

But our waitress was so sweet and she was on the money as far as our order, timing and giving us space to enjoy.

I ordered the chicken Parm, my friend ordered the FettucinI Alfredo and WOW, both were amazing, big portions and absolutly the best we have tried.  

The bread could have been a step up better but honestly we did not care because the food was that good.  

Next time I go I'm getting the Prime Rib.  But I can tell you their sauce, and texture of the pasta is perfect.  The chicken was breaded but ever so lightly, 

Perfection in the food and an absolute to visit.  Pio, you done good!

You can expect when you order food to get a few things wrong, but honestly in all my orders and all the items inside that order I've not had bad food yet.  Pizza, appetizers, pasta YES!  All perfect and all very good.  

French Fries are amazing
Pretzel bites  YUMMY (maybe a bit too much butter oil)
Mozz. Sticks are incredible.

Now the pizza, the double decker is all I order and it's incredible, and you won't want anything else, it's thick, with cheese intertwined with the layers, it was amazing and sooo good.  

I love the Ofallon Store is the best, very kind staff and they are always so friendly.  

Oh, I'll be back and I hope to see you all there.

My daughter and myself were invited by a friend to visit this wine bar called "CORK"  I loved the name and have never been to a wine bar so I thought we would check it out.  First off the wine menu is double the size of the food menu (how fun) and it's made of...  that's right... cork!  

I was sad that my only choice of Moscato was a dessert wine and only 3 oz, so I moved on to a sweet Reisling which was not too bad.   

Service was good and the added bottle of water and cups was a nice touch.  

I did not eat, we had just left Ranoush and we were stuffed.   (see an earlier review)  

But the atmosphere of The Cork was fun, they had live music playing and the bar was very active.  Even as loud as it was at times you could still hold a decent conversation.  

I suggest you give it a try, it's really a very nice place and if you are with the right company, like I was you'll be very happy you shopped by!
Absolutely love this store, so many FUN things, great people and really,  you have to stop in and buy some fun stuff.   OKAY and it's deli is incredible and bakery as well.   LOVE LOVE LOVE IT

I went to an event here and the museum was open to the public.  I loved being able to walk around and enjoy the art  It's contemporary so beware!   I loved the upstairs gallery of adult only which gave a whole new perspective on things.  If you get a chance go check it out, it's so much fun!

I am pretty tough on my reviews and food in Saint Louis has been a trial for us as we travel to find great places to eat.  Sugarfire is one of them.   We ended up there after a day of checking out the city because of a friend directing to Sugarfire.  We had no idea what to expect.  First there was a long line and it moved swiftly.  You better know what you want because there is not a lot of time to decide once you face the cafeteria like window.  I choose the brisket sandwich and FF, friends I was with got the same and ribs.  We were in LOVE from first bite.  Great food, the meat melted off the bone.  The french fries were shoe string but honestly the best I've ever had.  There are over 10 different sauces and my favorite ended up being coffee.  Okay and you have to try the pie, I had Pecan  WOW!  

If you are used to fine dining and sitting at a table and being served... get over it.  Sugarfire is worth it all, even if you have to carry out!  

Oh and the price.. incredible.

Not the normal pub and grill, the setting is very nice and clean.  The food is incredible and must different then most pubs in the area.  The staff was friendly and even pulled down the big screen for us because we wanted to see a specific game playing on TV.  

You have to try the appetizer plate to start off, it's so good and gives enough of each appetizer for a couple people to try.

Don't forget the beer...

I LOVE THIS PLACE!!!  There I said it!  I've already been back since.  

They have an amazing line of beer on tap and my favorite by far is the Belgian Spicy Blonde.  The Park Avenue Pale Ale a close second.  You have to try several and if you are in the mood on Saturdays they have classes on brewing.  

The menu is diverse and my favorite (I had it twice now) is the Bavarian Weizen Chicken, we asked for a Chicken Breast instead of the whole chicken breast and they easily accommodated us.  It's served on a bead of mashed potatoes that are incredible and REAL!  The side of vegetables are seasonal and steamed to perfection.  

The atmosphere is fun and if you can sit outside it's really very roomy and open.  

For dessert, and YES you have to have this... it's a chocolate cake and ours was served with blackberries.  WOW, drizzling chocolate made this dish incredible.  When I went for my birthday they served me a surprise dish and I shared it with everyone.  

GO and let me know what you think.  Awesome place!

Sneak in the back of this store and you will find a surprise.   they have the best and biggest cheesecake and ice cream for you to enjoy!  It's really so nice and it's a surprise for those who have no idea.  

This does not take away from the incredible candies they have.  You have to try some or even order them online.  We went around fall and the fall chocolates were out.   Chocolate covered candy corn  YUM!!!   Caramel Corn!!!   

This is such a fun little area that you have to visit, right in the center or town.  Take a walk outside and enjoy the amazing fountain and park area as well!  

Enjoy and let me know what you got!

I am a fan.  This is not a family sit down and eat type place.  It actually is sitting right next to The Amsterdam Bar.  Inside are bar stools and counter space, and not a lot of it.  Everyone was very cheerful and happy.  My order was a bit strange and the chef even double checked so he'd get it right. 

I had a chill cheese dog.  OH MY GOSH it's HUGE!  Well worth the money and it was very tasty.  

I also had a plain hamburger with ketchup.  OH MY!  it was so good as well, grilled angus it's thin but very tasty.  Both buns were very fresh.  

French Fries.. very lightly seasoned and good.  They were fresh.   

I liked the food, the atmosphere.  They have outdoor seating or you can sit next door at the bar.  I believe it would best as a take home or a fun lunch if you are in the city.   

Trust me and ignore the naysayers.  Check it out. It's worth it!  

OHHH one more thing, they have different sauces for your fries.. Liquid gold was a honey curry WOW!  awesome and I'm not even a curry fan!

gzuemYEUAQ2xo_QR_2rzSw.review_text: Iron Hill is a great place!  The food is great, and the craft beer is good.  I would highly recommend calling ahead and making reservations.

This is my favorite Indian restaurant!  If you are not familiar with Indian food, I recommend one of the House Specialty Platters.  All of the appetizers are awesome.  It's a great BYO, and I highly recommend it.
The food here is good.  I think it is pricey, and that is the main reason for this rating.  The food and drinks are good, and the atmosphere is nice.
While the decor is a bit outdated, this is the best seafood restaurant in the area.  I have been there many times, and it is always good.  it is a great BYO, and the service is great.

LOVE their french onion soup, though it is filling.  If you can sit outside, the view is fantastic. Also, one of the best cosmos I have ever had, though it must be made by a specific female bartender.

The food is amazing and of great quality.  It is a great BYO, and the french onion soup is the best I have ever had.  The prefix menu is definitely worth it.  I have mostly had good service, with the exception of one occasion, however, the food is so good, I did not mind.  They are now offering wine as an option as well.  So, if you forget wine, you can grab a bottle while you're there.  My only critique would be that the menu does not ever change.  It gets no additions, and while I love the skate and filet, it stops me from going more often on the desire to try new things.

Healthy options at a faster pace!  There are many menu options that make it easy to want to go back on another occasion to try more.  My only complaint is that it's a little expensive, however, eating fresh/healthy out tends to be.
Great japanese restaurant!  While I am not a sushi eater myself, people close to me are, and always want to come here.  The other options are great too!  Great BYO.

Food is great!  This is coming from an Italian who can get picky with this type of food.  The gnocci and pizza are very good.  Their desserts are awesome, and their option for a half portion make it easy to have room for their desserts!  I am giving this four stars because it is a bit expensive.  There are other italian restaurants that have promise of good quality with lower prices. However, this place is always busy and the bar is usually full, if that is what you're looking for.  Definitely make reservations before going because it is very busy.

I absolutely love it here.  The service is always fantastic, and the food is always great.  I recommend getting one of the feasts if you are not familiar with Moroccan cuisine.  It is not only a great deal price-wise, but I would not have otherwise picked out most of the options on the feast on my own.  When I go back, I always end up getting the feast anyway because it is so good.  It is a BYO, and the hookah is always a great way to finish off the meal.  I recommend a mix of fruit with mint, or asking about the house blend.  If you are not a fan of hookah and do not want it around, they usually do not bring out hookah until after a certain time, or unless other guests are okay with it.
As a side note, one of my close friends is a 'more particular' type of eater, and they loved it!  Definitely go here!!

Love this place!

I ended up having an event here and hadn't been before. I worked with David on everything and he was great staying within my budget. We had great food, great drinks, great service, and great ambiance. He also went above and beyond and had a little drink menu especially for us upon arrival.

That being said, the inside is nice and they have a lot of great drink options, of course great beer, but also great wine and cocktails!

I will definitely be back in my own time, aside from having an event and would recommend!

We moved to the area during COVID and have only gotten to get takeout, which I am traditionally hesitant on in general. They have beyond exceeded our expectations and changed my mind on takeout being not as good as in restaurant.

They always have great service. The quality of food is great and the prices are amazing for the quality. It all feels fresh and we will continue to order from here.
I love this place. We have ordered from here several times since moving to the area and will continue to order from here. The food and service is great here! We definitely recommend.

There are different beers here every week and they are always so good. It's such a relaxing place to be and we love coming here. 

If you want food, you can have it delivered (some.places nearby will just walk over your delivery) or bring your own food!

This is one of my favorite restaurants. I think it's the best Italian in the area. All of the food is fresh, including the bread and pasta. Half servings of pasta allows for you to get multiple courses without getting full or to try multiple pastas if you can't decide.
The gnocchi is amazing, the baked chicken breast, and the short rib are all SO good. 
On top of all of that, it's a BYOB! 
I always recommend this place and am happy every time I go.

Stopped by for takeout this morning and got the Scrambler and the Maple. They were all prepped and ready, very friendly service. They were both AWESOME. We've ordered lunch and dinner from here before as well and definitely recommend it. They also have creative and new crepe specials.

hGd6g2nZVraL17H4DnY1Dw.review_text: I read the reviews which were mixed and thought we'd try it and see. The portions are HUGE!  Food was very good!  Staff was friendly and not at all rude or uninterested as some have stated. The dining area was clean. We enjoyed the food and went home full and happy. I had an amazing salad there and my family had pizza!!! I would go back for sure!!

I've lived in Oldsmar for 8 years. I've gone to this Starbucks many many times, it used to be a regular routine for me.  The last 4 times I've gone they have gotten the order wrong. One simple  grande mocha latte, no whip. I get cold ones not hot (latte) or hot ones when I wanted a Frappe. Two times the lemon loaf icing has been all melted and weird. 
Besides that however,  the staff is so nice and friendly. They are always so sweet to my pup and give him a dog biscuit. Who does that? So as far as service with a smile they get 5 stars. Fixing the mess ups they get 5 stars. Making it right the first time 3 stars. Being good to my pup 5 stars. Just make sure it's right before you drive off.

My fiancé and I went to Salt Rock on a recommendation by family. We had a long over due date night and we were not disappointed. The restaurant is very nicely done, cozy for a date night but still family or friends out night kinda place to, .the food was delicious. The service was great and the prices are reasonable. 
We will be going back again when we find the time.

My fiancé, 9 yr old and I want to Hot Tuna about a month ago. The restaurant is small and quaint. Nicely decorated, the staff is friendly and the food was very good. Sushi was so fresh!! It's a good place for a quick lunch too. We will be going back.

I have been to TJF many many times!!  My family and I love their food!!! The way they are decorated is awesome and the staff is always so friendly and ready to be of service. We have never had to wait once. The taco salads are just perfect!  The cheese and chicken quesadillas are my son's favorite!! The salsa is fresh and made daily. They have a hot sauce bar for any taste buds to delight in.
They are busy at lunch and dinner but there is never a very long wait and the staff will offer you a drink while you do wait. 
Try them out if you don't like Taco Bell but love Mexican food and want a restaurant style place.

I love Flamestone!!  This is a regular date night place for my fiancé and I. We love it! My kids went with us for Mothers Day and they have asked to go back a few times already. 
The staff is friendly and really know the menus and specials. The restaurant is clean and decorated very well. It's perfect for a cozy date night or a roaring part of friends and family. You can make a reservation (I recommend) or walk in. 
The food is delicious!!! I just can't say enough about how yummy every time we have gone has been.

We traveled 10 hours today!!  We are all tired and ready for bed. BUT first we wanted to have a little dinner. This was the closet place. 
We had a waitress who was unable to understand what we were saying. She kept saying, "huh" with a horrible look on her face. Seriously a pet peeve. After she FINALLY got the order......IT TOOK OVER AN HOUR to get our food. 
The food was okay. Nothing special!!!! It was fresh but not great. Won't be returning.....thank goodness!

This was only my second time ever going to a Dave&Busters!!  The place is awesome for kids and adults alike. The food was very good! The burger was a bit off in taste so my son didn't eat it but the chicken quesadilla was very good!! 
Our waitress was super friendly and talked to us as friends not customers. She made sure we were taken care of and never wanted for anything. 
The kids had a blast paying games and running around. The prices for everything there is very reasonable. I would defiantly go back with the family.

Dinner inside the Gaylord Opry Hotel. The service is awesome. There was no wait and our waitress so far has be wonderful. Drinks and appetizers were brought out shortly after ordering. 
The restaurant is well decorated, clean, and the food is amazing!!! It's fun, up beat vibe and relaxed for tired travelers. 
I ordered Maui Fish Tacos and they are so good. There were some pepper so it had a kick to them. The drinks are definitely worth the price. They have more alcohol than I've ever had in a restaurant.
The restaurant manager is quite a humorous guy!!! He walked around and greeted all his customers. He joked around with us, teasing my friend about her location in FL. Our nicknames are now WIFI!!  :). It was a pleasure to have dined here.

This place is breathtakingly beautiful!!  I am simply in awe of the size, beauty, friendly staff and amazing ambience. 
We were given our rooms as a complimentary gift. We thought we would get a regular room, which would have been 100% fine with us. However, we were given an Atrium view room with a King size bed. We were shocked and surprised at the hospitality at the front desk. 
Our rooms are bigger than average size and perfect. Perfect beds, firm and comfortable. Extremely clean rooms with modern decor. Bathrooms are small but really how big does it need to be?  
We have walked around most of the hotel. It's HUGE!  There is so much to offer. Arcade, dining, drinking, family fun, golf, river tours, shuttles, and so on. There is a "small" shopping Main Street area that is super cute. Live music all over the place!!! The hotel is so big you need a map to get around. It's like Disney for adults and kids too. 
If this isn't enough the Grande Ole Opry is 15 min by complimentary shuttle, the Opey Mills mall is close. Downtown music row and the museum is about 19 min away. 
Such an awesome experience all the way around...

The bar was kinda dirty even for an empty mid-day time frame. The girls were friendly enough to us but we honestly were not ready to be drinking, it's only 1:26. 

We looked around, looked at the clothes which was not a great selection and sizes were for tiny girls, not real ones. 

Would be a jumping place I'm sure at night, but nothing compares to the one in Austin.

I love this place!  It reminds me of an old vampire movie with all the velvet and wood carvings. But it also has the old charm of a train station from the 40s or 50s. There is an old rail car inside as well which you can dine in. 
There was light music playing in the background but not obtrusive at all. The lighting is soft and calming. It was cool and nice break from the heat outside. 

The food is very good, I've eaten at one before however this trip we only had salads. They were, however very fresh and hit the spot. 

Our waitress was very sweet and we didn't  have to wait for anything. I will defiantly take my family there when we go back to TN next summer.

We were given two nights at this Gaylord in TN. This was our last night and meal here so we decided to eat by the waterfall since we were tired from a long hit day in downtown Nashville. 

It was not quiet but then it was right in the middle of all the hub-bub and the waterfall. Our waiter was a bit over run with customers it still served us well. 

I ordered lobster bisque which was amazing. I then had sushi, a spicy tuna roll and one other one I don't recall, but both were so fresh and tasty. My friend said it was so fresh it was from the fish pond. :) Jokingly of course. 

Sadly. Her meal was not as good. Her burger was very over cooked even for well done standards. Her French fries were burnt and had no potato inside. It was all over fried batter in grease. It was a shame since my dinner was so very good. 

I gave 4 starts for my meal but would only give 2 for hers.

Located in the Boot Ranch Shoppimg Plaza, Palm Harbor this yummy treat is a great way too cool off on a hot summer day. 
They recently closed down and reopened as this location under new ownership. The staff is very friendly and helpful. 
The flavors are so good and fresh. They change every so often but I'm not sure when. The toppings available are fresh and kept clean in their own containers. The prices are comparable to other frozen treat places around this area. 
The decor is bright and cheerful! Oh and very clean!!!! That is a huge bonus! There are tables inside and outside to enjoy your special treat.

I LOVE MY PUBLIX STORE!  Yes I say "my" because I feel like they know me and when they smile or greet me it's as if they do. Maybe they really do since I kinda live there with two growing boys to feed! 
There isn't one thing about this store that I don't like. Let's start with the produce: It's always fresh, green, no rotten veggies or fruit, no out if dates produce or products. Fresh and clean! Fresh Bread: Oh my if you go early enough you can smell the delicious bread that was baked that morning. The bread is never stale, never left over and always very good. Deli: The actual deli staff has always been so friendly and eager to help. I've never had any issues and their sandwiches are incredible! Meat&Fish: FRESH FRESH FRESH!!! Honestly I've never seen out to date, brown or odorous meats or fish. The staff in the butcher area are nice and will cut anything you like or make things like meatballs for you. Just ask! The rest of the store is well organized and easy to shop in. Dairy: always well stocked! Never over due items and they are always restocking. They have some awesome BOGO deals!!! 
I love my PUBLIX!  Can you tell???

This location is close to our home. We don't go very often but have been there maybe a dozen times. 
The inside is clean, the tables are clean and the workers are always nice and respectful. 

The food is pretty good but their blizzards and moolatas are soooo very good!  Trey are always freshly made and always exactly what we order. 

It's a great stop on a hot day to cool down. The Orange Julius is so refreshing any time of the day.

This location is one of a few in the Tampa area. The wait is not too bad as long as you go before 5p on weekends.  The staff in the front are very nice and helpful. I witnessed one help an elderly women to her seat since she couldn't walk well and her husband was unable to help as he was on oxygen himself. 
We ordered calamari and breaded cheese sticks. They were both very good. The sauce was a bit spicier than expected but still good. The warm fresh bread with olive oil and seasoning dip is soooooo very delicious! 
For our main course we ordered Alfredo fettuccine with shrimp and mushrooms, Alfredo with chicken, chicken Marsala and Italian pizza. All were very good although my fiancée's chicken Marsala is much better. All the other dishes were very very good. There was ample supply of drinks and our waiter came back to check on us about 8 times even with a full section to wait on. 
This is a great restaurant for good Italian/American style food. 
We will go back again. Oh and it's wonderful for a date night, little pricey but the atmosphere is perfect.

We have been to Kobe a few times. The place is clean and decorated well. The fish are fun for the kids to watch in the tank and front water fall/pond area. We tell them that, is where the sushi comes from. :) 
They have a small sushi bar in the back of the restaurant that is almost always full. There is small seating area back there and a medium size bar area. There are benches in the bar area for customers to sit and wait to be seated. 
Our wait is usually 30min for the hibachi tables (and that was at 5:30p) but you can be seated right away for a regular table. We alway choose the hibachi tables as its so much fun to watch the food be prepared and cooked. 
Last night was not great. Usually the food is pretty good if not very good. The hibachi chef was funny and was enjoying entertaining us. However, the food was not great. The shrimp was chewy and tough and there was way too much soy sauce used as well as some of it was burned. The noodles were butter noodles not the usual soy seasoned with onion/mushrooms and chicken noodles. They are not my favorite but my family likes them. The steak was good and cooked to medium rare as I asked. My son had scallops, lobster and shrimp and he only liked the lobster. The scallops were under cooked so a bit slimy to eat. The veggies were under cooked for the broc., and over cooked for the carrots which had a lot of salt seasonings on them. (this is not usual for them) 
Overall it was still fun to watch and be there but the food was not great. Maybe he was a new chef. We will go back because we enjoy the hibachi side of it and we have had other great experiences.

We've been here a few times. The parking is pretty good but can be hard to find at dinner time. There is never a very long wait, if one at all. The place is clean and the weight staff is polite and attentive. 
The fresh sushi bar is wonderful! Great selection of fresh sushi, both cooked and raw for various tastes. There is low sodium soy sauce, fresh wasabi and ginger slices available. 
The buffet is fresh with a wide variety of food available. There is salad, fresh fruit, shell fish, pork, chicken, ribs sauces, rice, noodles, soups, crab Rangoon, pot stickers, egg rolls, and many other foods. There is a desert bar as well. 
Full range of drinks are also available. There are tables and booths and TVs on news channels all over. 

I've only given 3 stars because it seems the price has gone up quite a bit and for  people who don't eat a huge amount it's almost not worth it. However for a family who eats a lot it might be. It worked out at $15/person. 

Worth a try as the food is fresh and pretty good.

I've used this CVS since I moved to the area 9 years ago. It's central location makes it easy to access off of Tampa  Rd. 
They are very clean and well organized. Always well stocked shelves with an area for seasonal shopping too. 
The pharmacy is located in the back of the store beside the Minute Clinic. 
Prices for the store and the pharmacy are comparable to other ones, but the staff (up front) are very friendly and helpful here so it sets it apart for me.
The clinic is accessible and easy to make an appt. most insurances cover his as well. If you're not sure if yours does, just ask they will know. 
The only thing I would say that is not 100% great is the pharmacy staff. Although that seems to slowly be improving.

This Steak N Shake is right by our house so conscience is the main reason we go here. 
Reminds me of a 50's style diner. Clean, bright, friendly staff, and service is fast and good. 
The food is good, it's greasy; which is really my only complaint about it. 
All the food is made fresh to order so no heat lamp burgers. My favorite is the vanilla coke, extra vanilla!'n. YUM! They serve shoe-strong fries which are sooooo good. We always get cheese sauce on the side. Again YUM! The specialty shakes of the month are super good and the regular flavors of vanilla, strawberry and chocolate are good too. 
The breakfast they serve are surprisingly tasty. I alway question burger/lunch/dinner places who decide to add breakfast to their menus. However, they have done a good job, still too greasy but for a once in a while treat it's worth it. 
Give it a try if you want something a bit different with a fun atmosphere!

I know many hate Wal-Mart stating the prices, their discrimination or treatment of employees. I realize that some is fact, some fiction and all opinion. So here is mine.
I love Wal-Mart! It's a quick and easy one stop if I have 10 different things that would take five different stores. This Wal-Mart is by my house, literally walking distance. It's easy for quick runs or big shopping days. 
The store is clean. It's organized and well stocked (unless is a stocking day) then it may be hard to find what you need. However, the people are friendly and usually willing to help you. I've only had a handful of issues in the nine years I've been going to this location. 
I don't do produce here as I don't find it fresh enough but all other groceries are fine and well worth being able to find all things in one place. Meats are a hit or miss but usually they are very fresh and cut lean. Bonus! 
Friendly Neighborhood Wal-Mart

Pretty perfect, the Penguin Pretzel place is particularly pleasant to the palette. 

Our first time here! It's clean, adorable inside with an old 50's diner kinda charm to it. It is bright and inviting!! The menu is displayed on the wall in bright easy to read lettering. There are also smaller menus on the counter that have the full details of what is in each sandwich. 

Along with sandwiches they offer regular pretzels and desert ones too. They offer a good variety of pretzels in pretty much any combo you can think of. They are all freshly made while you wait, so if you're  in a rush I would suggest going when you can enjoy the ambiance and time it takes to make these delicious creations. While you wait look around there are cute sayings and penguin prints all over and enjoy a drink too (non alcoholic). They have side dipping sauces that are homemade in there. 

The aroma when you walk in is pure heavenly fresh baked pretzel/breads. Yummy! The food is DELICIOUS!!  Simply DELICIOUS!  There just are no other words to describe these pretzels!  

Enjoy!!!

This was the first time we had ever been to this location. We were invited for a birthday party. 

We arrived at about 3pm. It as busy but not too bad. Within an hour it was packed like sardines in there. Not a surprise on a weekend or with the amount of birthdays being celebrated. 

There are sections, one is netted of for little itty bitty kiddies. It was so cute to watch them jump and bounce. The middle section is for middle age kids and teens. They can bounce and jump around but no flipping. The last section is for playing dodge ball. The kids must have Airhead socks that are included in the price. TIP- keep them so you can use them again when you go. A waiver must be signed as well. It's not a huge deal just simple protection on their part. 

The kids were worn out!!!!  We were there for 2.5 hours and besides stopping for pizza and a couple games they played and jumped the entire time. Hot, sweaty happy kids!!!  

There is pizza, hot dogs, fries, and mostly fun park kinda food with a selection of candy. Drinks include sodas, energy drinks, cold coffees, and water too, 

It's a great place early in the day for the kids to get their energy out. It's not cheap but doable. Late on the weekend it fills up with rowdy older teens, not great for fun for the grade school aged kids. So go earlier!!

We have never been to Trinity, FL before. Our pediatrician just moved there from Palm Harbor and so this is where the new office is. 

The area is pretty new and very nice. The building is in a new strip mall. It's clean and smells delicious when you walk in. It's cold and a nice blast from the heat outside. 

The staff is friendly and services were wonderful. Prices were same as other but the quality was amazing!! I had the chocolate peanut butter specialty they have on their menu. To die for!  Better than 31 flavor's PBCHOC ice cream!  My son had sugar cookie which is a limited time flavor and loved it. 

They have just about every tipping you can think of. They blend it in the ice cream on a cold stone (hence the name) and its soooooooo good! 

We won't go often as its a drive from Oldsmar just for that but maybe Dr appts won't be so bad if they get this special treat afterwards.

There are two locations, the closest one to my location is in Oldsmar, however my son and I don't find it as good as this location. 

We always get the some thing BLT Club Quesada!!  You can have it with whatever you want. I don't have the beans but everything else,yes! It's so good. All the juices run together and mix. It's yummy and delicious and amazing. :) The white conqueso and chips are delicious as well. A nice add to any meal. The drinks are free refills and a very large selection from one of the new soda machines. 

The staff is friendly and make everything right there fresh to order for you. The place is clean, open and play some good old music. Bathrooms are always clean which is a good bonus. 

We go there a couple times a month if we get the chance. I highly recommend this one over the Oldsmar one. But then again that's just based on what we order. :). I'm sure the other location is just as good for the other menu items. It is as clean.

This location is in Tampa. Last time I went to a TJ's was in VA and years ago. 

With that said, this location is not impressive at all. The location is on a corner with a back parking lot. It's tiny and hard to navigate Ina bd out of small parking places. It's crowded and the flow is horrible. 

Inside was congested. A lot of stuff all over the place. The food was okay but nothing spectacular like I remembered from years ago. I remember finding rather unique things in there but not this time. 

I won't be making the trip again to go back. For some people I'm sure it's a great place and if you're all natural, organic and so on it would be a good place. However for just regular groceries I didn't find it to be. And as I mentioned the uniqueness wasn't there. Online has more to offer than this location. 

Sadly disappointed... :(

Whole foods has a special place in my heart. My MIL introduced me to my first one in VA. Every time we would visit her we would go shopping and it was our thing. I was always amazed at the quality and freshness of the store and wondered why all others couldn't do the same.....until I saw the prices and then I knew it was not for the ordinary salary challenged person. :)

I have not been to one in years!! Recently, a brand new one open in our local mall. I thought it was an odd place to open a high end grocery store but it's always full of shoppers. 

I've been a couple times for things that I won't buy in our local grocery store near my house. One main thing is seafood!! Whole foods' seafood is always so fresh. Yes, you pay more but to guarantee its fresh and won't harm my family is worth it. Second thigh is specialty cuts of meet. The butcher will have a cut for you if you call ahead or just go in, they will help you there too. The variety of both meats and seafood is excellent!! 

For the health conscious that are vegetarian is vegan this store is for you. Pricey? Yes but that tey prof food is anyway. The difference is its 100% what it says it is. The bonus is, the fresh foods area at the front of the store has regular, vegetarian and vegan foods available as well. There is fresh breads, soups, salads, sandwiches, and so much more!

The fresh coffee and juice bar is a nice touch. Allows that little extra something to help the him-drum of shopping. The bakery is fresh and smells delicious! 

Even if just for the smallest specialty go there and see for yourself.

5 STARS is for the workers!! They are always super sweet and do a great job. I've never had anything come to me done incorrectly.  They keep the store clean, donuts made freshly daily, coffees and mixed coffee/ice cream drinks are very good. The people who work there are well deserving of 5 STARS

HOWEVER...ONE STAR is for the owner who doesn't do anything special for his community who buys from him daily. Examples: the owner will not help support teacher appreciation for the school where my son attends. I've never had a business be so rude about it either. I've never seen other specials for say Veterans either. Maybe I just missed that one the last 10 years that I've lived here.  I'm sure the owner is a great person but business wise not the greatest and supporting his community. 

Back to the store and employees!  As I mentioned above they are courteous and very helpful. Clean store! Centrally located in Oldsmar. Near our house so convienent. We go there a few times a year now, we used to go a couple times a month. Everything is fresh! The ice cream is always so good too. 

Good place to stop quickly for ice cream, coffee, and other lighter quick bite kinda stuff.

3 stars, basically I was a little worried when we walked in and only one other person was in there at 12. No lunch rush?  Not complaining but seemed off.  Food wasn't great since I'm a Gyro fanatic and know what it's suppose to taste like. 

Met a friend for lunch and wanted a non chain usual kinda place. I'd been here once a long while ago. Since then there have been mixed reviews. I wanted to see if it was any better.   

I ordered a Gyro wrap. Not only did the lady at the register not know how to say it but she was not very friendly. A key to keeping customers coming back is customer service. The other lady working ass very friendly and informative. Besides the point.....however important to me. 

The food was okay. The meat which is lamb should be juicy not dry and crunchy like bacon. The traditional dressing/sauce is a cucumber base creamy dressing and this was not. I don't even know what it was, but it was not Greek!  Nothing else came with it. No Greek side salad no Greek potato salad just the Gyro and a pickle. Pickle? With Greek food?  Ha ha! 

I'm sure the regular sandwiches, salads and wraps are very good. I will however make sure to check the health Dept site but I've never seen them listed or at least not in the last year that I've been checking the list. 

I am curious about their coffee which I didn't have but have read on here is awesome! Next time!

For a chain restaurant 4 stars isn't bad. It's clean, staff is friendly and food is good. Nothing exceptional but again it's a chain restaurant. 

I've been here many times but two times in the last few months. I go because my friend loves it. I also go because they are a huge supporter of our local area schools and military, two things I'm passionate about. So I will support them even if they are not my favorite Mexican place. 

With that said, their food isn't bad. It's good. It's just exceptional.  It's the basic Tex-Mex. I've ordered chips and salsa, yum. I've ordered chicken southwest salad which is actually very tasty. The strawberry lemonade is soooooo good. Other dishes I've had have been good . 

If you love Tex-Mex then this is your place. Friendly, clean, good service.

My fiancé and I have made this our date night destination. 

The restaurant is casual, but can be more elegant if you're in the mood. It has soft relaxing lighting that is perfect to unwind and relax while having a drink. It's not too loud so you can hear the conversation but also enjoy the music. 

The food is also fantastic. They have specials each weekend which are nice for a change from the menu. The wine and drink selection is very good. They have specials and seasonal on these as well. 

My favorite is the scallops and mushroom risotto I believe it is. It's DELICIOUS! The portions are perfect if you also want desert but not too small that you're left needing more. 

I highly recommend this restaurant and will miss it when we move.

Took my fiancé here for his birthday for a fun hibachi dinner, but was nervous since since there were so many mixed reviews about the place. Overall, it was a good experience. 

Our hibachi chef was nice, but wasn't very engaging and didn't give us a show, but the food was good. It seemed like 1/3 of the chefs did the whole entertainment side of hibachi while the rest just cooked in front of you. That was the most disappointing. 

Good food, but have had better at other places. Nice chef and waitress, but missed out on the "show" part of hibachi. If you want to have a fun event dinner (bday, valentines, anniversary), I still recommend you go.

I've been coming to Kahuna Grill for years and will continue coming here in the future. Great food, atmosphere, and service. When the weather is good, I enjoy eating on their outdoor seating area and people watching. Sweet potato fries are a must! I also really enjoy their portobello mushroom burger.

Great cupcakes! Always full of flavor and very fresh. Every once in a while I'll get a flavor I don't like, but it it a rarity. I really enjoy that they serve vegan, gluten free, and mini cupcakes. I just wish they made mini vegan and gluten free ones.

Great food! I come here all the time for brunch and lunch. The tomato basil soup, tree hunger panini, and animal lover salad are a must. Always great and friendly service and a place to sit. Parking is difficult, so I suggest scoping out the parking situation there first, but you'll most likely end up parking in a nearby neighborhood and walking over. Definitely a gem in pricey and touristy downtown SB.

Note: they are super busy during the week at lunch time. Expect to wait in line about 10-15 minutes to order and 15+ minutes to get your food. If you call ahead, make sure to give them 15-20 minutes before you even head over there.

Cute tapas restuarant on the Mesa. The food and drink are really good, but not the best I've had. Happy hour is Monday through Wednesday until closing, so go then. Drinks and veggie tapas are a few dollars less. Good service, atmosphere (they play old cartoons), and fun place. I like that it is a nice hole-in-the-wall rather than the places downtown. Been here a few times, and it is reliably good.

Love TJ in general, and especially this one.. Every employee is really friendly and knowledgeable, there's parking, and the food is great. I always have to grab a free sample and a small coffee everytime. It can be crowded after work, especially on Mondays. 

This is the smallest store in SB (size but not product wise), but most convenient because of the large parking lot. I like the people who shop at this location the best because it is maily students, young professionals, and laid back Goleta families, versus the DLV and Milpas ones.

Great coffee and atmosphere. Service is always helpful and friendly. I enjoy coming here for every occasion, from reading a good book by myself to hanging out with a group of friends. Finding seating on the weekends can be difficult.

The hot drinks are known for being more luke-warm, so make sure to ask for it extra hot.

There are not enough good thinks to say about Backyard Bowls! Everything from their mission to the product is wonderful, and I'm officially addicted. The bowls are a little pricy, so I tried to make a replica at home, but nothing can compare. Each of the acai bowls are different, but I've never been disappointed. My favorites are the green bowl (only order if you like ginger) and island bowl. The hemp granola they use gives the bowl a great crunchy texture that is evenly distributed in your bowl, so it doesn't bunch up in one giant granola spoonful like others. Even though it is a bit pricy, they give you so much it can be two meals (or at least a meal and a snack).
The best restaurant in Santa Barbara. If you are looking for an amazing restaurant and don't mind spending the money, this place is the best.

My new favorite coffe place. I ordered a latte and it was one of the best I've ever had. The beans weren't burned and the shot was pulled to perfection. I really like how the owners care about their patrons, and remember your order when you come back. I enjoy that they offer some pasteries, especially vegan options. Just wished they served steel cut oatmeal too.

Read about this place in the Independent, so had to try it out with my family. Our waiter, Nick, gave excellent service and recommendations, and was super friendly. The food menu isn't extensive, but has a least something everyone will really enjoy. Make sure to ask for the bar menu also, there are more food options. They also have a great wine and beer list. 

I liked the atmosphere, with a built in fireplace and dark wood. The restaurant is intimate and on the smaller side. It is a great place to have a nice dinner but not have to get really dressed up (jeans, etc are acceptable). I want to go back and hang out at the bar next time.

You HAVE to get the macaroni, absolutely delicious!

One of my favorite sushi/Japanese restaurant in SB. I love trying their different specialty rolls, and recommend getting the Baked Lobster Roll (it is on the heavier side, so come hungry). I also really enjoy their flavorful tempura -- it isn't greasy like other places, and the dipping sauce is divine. They have a tv in the restaurant that plays Monsters, Inc on loop, which is entertaining for me. It can be crowded even on weeknights, so make sure to call ahead.

This is the place you go when you are by Stearns Wharf, there are no other coffee shops in sight, and you need something to drink. The staff is friendly enough, it is close to the wharf, there is a place to sit, but the products are not very good. This place is more for convenience than quality.

Love this place! Their salads at the counter and food you order are amazing and we have never been disappointed. They aslo have a lot of vegan, gluten-free, and sugar-free foods and desserts. I got a vegan, gluten-free chocolate chip cookie that I really enjoyed. Their coffee bar is great, and has a large selection of teas. They have almond and coconut milk options for coffee drinks, which I really appreciate. The only drawback is that their salad bar is kind of radom with its toppings. Also, the prices aren't the cheapest, but it is in the heart of downtown, so that's expected. Really cute atmosphere, great service, and an overall happy place. I come here too often, and love it!

Don't understand what all the hype is about. After moving from the Bay Area and eating great Thai food, a friend suggested Zen Yai. Very disappointed. Normally I finish my plate, but couldn't at this place. Everything was either way too salty or bland. Stick to Tap Thai or Your Place Thai instead.

iBQKwkuDvAdTM5gLWHgZwg.review_text: Very reasonably priced and good stuff.  Check their maiz appetizer - corn on the cob and a butter spice sauce.  Very good.  Last night we had their special tuna arepa.  Really excellent.  A couple decibels in volume more than I would like, but otherwise a very enjoyable experience.

OK - so I am not some terribly astute gourmand re croissants and such - I am happy with the ones I get at CCs and other coffee places - so perhaps I am a cretin in that regard.

I have had a couple of sandwiches from the new operation and today I just had a quiche for lunch.  Tasted fine to me.  Don't know what I would have done differently.  So . . . for my money (quiche 5.00, sandwhich 10.00), I am happy.

I really like this place a lot - very good breakfasts, nothing terribly extravagant, but damn filling and good.  A pleasant staff, good ambiance.  I would not travel great distances to get here, but it is a good local establishment.

Wonderful local place.  We go for the fried catfish occasionally - quite good.  This past visit we also ordered fried onion ring appetizer and it was a frigging mountain of food.  The fried catfish are not those slender little filets, but more thick chunks of fish.  The prices is very reasonable.  We both walked out with doggie bags.

This has become our "special occasion" go to place.  The fried green tomato with crab meat appetizer was delicious.  We generally opt for a fish of some sort.  Recently I had drum on a grain bed with beautiful string beans over the top.  We have eaten here a half dozen times and have never left disappointed in any way.

Eat here regularly and generally have a pho soup of some sort.  Crab rangoon appetizer is also very good as appetizer.  Never disappointment.  We walk there from our house, otherwise the parking would be a drag.

Interesting in looking at the review here.  The standards food is okay - nothing truly exceptional.  Soups are sometimes quite good.  When my wife orders a Bloody Mary's she likes it quite a bit.  However, we have stopped eating here because of the waiter Pierce.  To me he is just incredibly over the top to the point of being pretentious and over bearing.  Imagine my surprise that some folks enjoy that treatment!!!  But I imagine that is the type of service that one receives at Commanders Palace a place I have never been and likely will never go.  So it goes.

Man do I love this place.  Absolutely fabulous fried catfish, red beans and rice, fried onion rings, french fries, really thick and delicious blue cheese dressing for salads - and these are all things I need to avoid food-wise.  I wish I could eat here more often but this has become a true special event type of place, not for the price, but for the food I eat there.  I am looking forward to a visit on my birthday in a couple of weeks!

Stopped in for dinner tonight. Wife had Sparta bowl and I had la Bonita bowl. I also had carrot tumeric ginger soup. All were excellent. There is a strong health focus on the menu which is a bit over my head but it's all supposed to be good for you to hence the name of the place. Enjoyable low key atmosphere. Only down side is that right now they close at 6:00 pm which seems very odd. We happened in about five till and thought we were just the early dinner folks. Hope they revisit the hours. But will be back regardless.
Average seafood. We eat here when visiting the quarter with out of town guests. Got an oyster loaf last time that was really nothing special at all. But definitely not worth waiting in line for.
Without question the very best oyster loaf in town. Good raw and chargrilled too. Service can be hit or miss but generally very good.

Coffee is good, food selection is on the very light side, but what I really like about this place is the atmosphere.  Plenty of space to sit inside and is reasonably quiet.  No annoying Starbuckian music - actually, I don't think they play music at all.  Very much enjoy the outside courtyard in the back.  Comfortable seating, and only the occasional cigarette smoker.  My go to uptown location to sit and read or do light writing/work.
I don't think there is anything in this place that is particularly healthy, but I can't get enough of their pork belly slider - fantastic.  Donuts are really fine too.  A good lunch spot.

Okay, so this is the only place in town to get a really fine muffuletta - a quarter is usually filling for me.  Irritating at times that the bread seems a bit on the stale side, but other than that, can't be beat.

My wife had a small pizza and I had a calzone.  Her pizza was excellent and my calzone was very good.  The calzone seemed a bit too much dough on the edges, but otherwise no complaint.  I like that the menu seems pretty broad with sandwiches, salads, and appetizers as well for future visits.

What stood out to both my wife and I from other pizzerias is that this one was very clean, well lit, without that dingy feel that seems typical of the genre of restaurants.  As well, the very visible kitchen area was clean and organized and without the chaos and mess that seems to be characteristic of pizzerias.

Service was also excellent.  A very good experience and will now be our 'go to' place for pizza in New Orleans.

Gyro plate was excellent, wife had kebab plate, very good as well.  Food is well spiced  Portions are moderate and price is very reasonable.  Staff is very attentive.  Menu seems a bit limited which might ultimately prove a problem with the proliferation of Middle Eastern uptown choices in New Orleans.

Oyster soup with bacon and greens was very good.  Had a dinner salad with fried oysters - huge. Most importantly, the oysters were some of the better that I have had in terms of seasoning.  My wife had broiled catfish, corn bread and some stewed tomatoes and okra and enjoyed them all.  Always a good selection of nightly specials.  High Hat seems to be very consistent in terms of their food.

Service is very good.

Alright, so I am clearly in a minority, but I just don't get Trader Joes.  Their produce is no better or any cheaper than the local Rouse's.  The cheese selection is considerably less than Whole Foods.  There does appear to be a pretty extensive wine section, but then I don't drink.  And then, there are the crowds.  The place was just packed.  I made the mistake of getting a grocery cart which proved darn near impossible to maneuver in the store.  About 15 minutes into the experience, I turned the cart over to my wife and we agreed that I would wait for her in the car.  

I cannot think of why I would ever go back.  Clearly, others do not share that opinion.  Thank goodness for Rouses on Tchoupitoulas in New Orleans!

Both my wife and I had a burrito. Very average. I ate only half of mine. Had guacamole and chips as well, which was average at best. Place was pretty crowded particularly with families, so clearly there are folks that really like the place. Price is very reasonable. Just extremely average at best. Not many steps above fast food in my opinion.

We go here occasionally.  The thing that always stands out to me are the very friendly staff and how clean the place is.  They have a greater variety than normal for frozen yogurt stores, and a good variety of toppings and several syrups.  And the frozen yogurt is as good as any I have had.  Never been disappointed.

Food was very good, service good as well.  I realize there is only so much you can do with space, but the place has a rather cramped feel and was loud enough that I could not have a conversation.  Will go back, but probably for carry out.

My "go to" place for raw oysters.  Always excellent.  Had shrimp and grits last time as well - quite good.

Note that the place is most often quite crowded and loud in the main dining area and at the bar.  In the side rooms, quiet enough to have a conversation.

So I guess there are a couple hundred Po Boy shops in New Orleans.  I have been to maybe 10 of the highest ranked and by far Guy's is the best for a solid Roast Beef Po Boy (my personal favorite).  The bread is not overwhelming, the meat is thick, and the dressing is fabulous.  A full Po Boy is ample for two people.    

The place is small with limited seating and if you get there right at noon, you might wait a bit - can call in though for carryout.  They also have regular specials, salads, dirty rice and so forth.

Prices are very reasonable and we are fortunate to live within about 10 blocks.

I cannot imagine anything that they could do to improve the quality of their food.
