Nice selection of fruit & juices for the mimosas as well as all kinds of garnishes fir the bloodys.  Bar keeps are there to "suggest" but you literally make your own so YOU control the booze and everything else!  Food was good too.  I'm usually not a huge fan of buffets but this one was fresh with a wide variety of brunch items.  They kept it well replenished when needed.  I'd say the only down side is it gets very busy and the station where you make your drinks can get 6-7 people deep as you can imagine.  We got there before 11...(can't drink before 11 & they are very strict about that) not too bad ...but as we were leaving after 12 it was crazy busy.
Will is an amazing barkeep ...along with T and David kept it flowing well.  Food was very good...sat at bar and had red beans & rice and jambalaya both excellent.
Oysters were to die for!!  Best bartender, Rachel, was a sweetheart.  Everyone was friendly.  The crab cakes were delish but very rich.  Étouffée was the best I've every had.
Always a great time!  People watching is a job here!  Bands are always great and the more you drink the better they sound.

Great place for breakfast or brunch.  The bloody Mary's were outstanding!  They use their own bacon infused vodka and mix.  Very good.  The food was excellent we both had some kind of egg skillet and both were very good.
Try the Irish nachos ...a nice change from typical beef or chicken topped with corned beef.

I liked it!  Only had drinks but spoke to people at bar eating & they gave it two thumbs up.  So I came back for lunch today ...very good.  I had the toasted almond crab salad with a mimosa & the hubs had the steak salad.  Both were delish.  Our barkeep, David was great! Great convo, quick to please, informative.  Really cool decor in the place too.  They'll be packed during hockey season ...give them a try before the masses hit.
How did I not know about this sooner?  Great location for downtown fun and the food is oh course amazing.

Excellent!!  Same quality as the original.  Can't beat the salad ... got it with shrimp & it was perfect Sat at the bar both times and got outstanding service from Carolyn. She let us try several of their craft beers until we could figure out what we liked.  Even though it was hot out the fans made it better.  Saturday they had entertainment which was very good.  Nice location ...close to Amalie arena, convention center and aquarium.  Give it a try.

We really enjoy it here!  We make sure to go every visit to NOLA.  The music is always great...such talent.  The hurricanes there are better than most places, not sickeningly sweet.  Always had great service even if they're crowded and they usually are.  There is a speakeasy upstairs but I don't think they're associated with Fritzel's.  It is a great place to go to enjoy some of the best local music NOLA has to offer. Go there every time!
This is a fun spot if you want a little classier experience than the strip.  It gets really crowded but drinks are good.
How did I not know about this sooner?  Great location for downtown fun and the food is oh course amazing.

Travis rocks too!!! But that was in 2017. Today Victoria and Austin are rocking The Row. The cheese grits were soooo good. My hubby & nephew had the Nashville hot chicken served on a habanero corn cake, excellent! Cold beer friendly service, full bar, entertainment at night. Something for everyone .  Come to The Row. Music at 2:00 on Saturday.

Travis rocks too!!! But that was in 2017. Today Victoria and Austin are rocking The Row. The cheese grits were soooo good. My hubby & nephew had the Nashville hot chicken served on a habanero corn cake, excellent! Cold beer friendly service, full bar, entertainment at night. Something for everyone .  Come to The Row.

We really enjoyed this place.  A neighborhood bar type atmosphere, good food, cold drink.  Good wings says the hubs. We had 2 small kids and they were very accommodating. Also had nachos and tots ...both good.

We have tried to make it to this place several times on the weekend and it's just been too crowded. Stopped today for lunch and it was very good. We had the fried alligator, the ahi tuna wrap, the pepper jelly shrimp salad, a side of corn cheese grits,  on top of that the manager sent over an order of warm beignets. They were delish. I asked for the tails to be cut off of the shrimp on my salad and no problem. Our waitress, Caitlin, was spot on, and very sweet. We will definitely be back.

Very good! Special prices on mimosas and bloody Mary's. Alrick our server was point on. Weather was nice for patio seating. Six adults all drinking a cocktail or 2 and 2 children ate for $130 plus tip...plenty of food so that's a good deal I think. We'll be back.

Really Like this place. The food was excellent. Our server Syd was outstanding. We had shrimp & grits, lobster roll, shrimp tacos & grouper all great! The view is perfect ...true Florida. They had live music which was very good too. Drinks were great as well.

Cute little neighborhood bar! Just stopped in for a drink and had the Buffalo cauliflower it was yummy. People are nice, place is clean. Check out the Farve jersey hanging up on your way to bathroom...see a problem?

This was a pretty cool spot. Very large inside and outside dining areas. Food was good. We had the Buffalo cauliflower and 2 of the flatbreads. I had the tangerine something beer and liked it. The hubs had whatever is closest to Miller lite. I saw wine being served too. Place was clean and bathrooms were clean too. The brewery is cool looking. I'm thinking they have tours or will have after covid time passes...if that ever happens.
The grits were so good and of course the whiskey cake...I mean if the place is called whiskey cake there is no way I'm NOT having it! The great escape was excellent as well.

These people did a good job for St Paddy's day. We were able to get right in and sit at the bar at 1:00. Beer was cold and plentiful & the pretzel was very good & the corned beef sandwich was seriously one of the best I've had. The services was spot on too. Great Irish band. Not sure how it was outside but we had a great time.

What a gem! Great menu, lots of TVs, good variety of beers, clean bathrooms, good food, nice, friendly and prompt servers. We had one of the bowls and a wrap, both with chicken...very tasty. I saw signs fir Happy hour and game nights. We'll definitely come back. Brittany was our server, awesome!

This place is so good. The food is fresh and tasty. I had the lean and clean bowl with spaghetti squash it was so good and perfectly spiced with blackened chicken. The hubs & son had the pizza and they both loved it. Nice outside eating area with tropical feel with nice landscaping. We sat in the corner because we had small kids and that worked out great. We've never been disappointed...oh the cookies  too
Really good, authentic Mexican food. The people were really nice too. We will definitely be back.

Really really good !!! Chargrilled oysters are wonderful better than a lot of other places that I love too but these are with toasted crunchy bread points that really add to the flavor. Jambalaya & red beans & rice were outstanding too. Takia was friendly and prompt. No waiting for lunch on a Thursday so that's nice.

There is not a better place to start your pre flight festivities. Deb is pleasant and quick. Such a great sense of humor. A real asset to Rumfish. It doesn't take a lot to be nice ...yet not everyone is. Nice selection of food. We were there at breakfast time. Close to gates C 30-35 and to bathrooms. Big screen TV behind bar and 2 smaller tvs on each side. Best experience so far today . As we check out Deb wished us safe travels...what a gem.

jyMVH9PGkJibmhRHMaD1sw.review_text: This place was delicious!  The spring rolls were crispy and not greasy, the Pad Thai was amazing as well as the drunken noodles dish.  They even gave me just plain noodles and chicken for my toddler who was much appreciative.  Will definitely go back and be craving often!

It is Yats - If you've never been, you need to go.    I love everything I have tried from here.  Avon needed something like this on our side of town!  Don't be alarmed at the looks of the food.  The taste is amazing and even though all the dishes look similar the flavors are definitely not.  Ask for a sample, they are always more than happy and willing to help you decide which one is going to be your favorite!

Was pleasantly amazed at how well my whole family liked their meals.  My Pho was delicious and the variations I could add to it made it even better.  My mother was able to get one of their sweet dumplings filled with meat that is not on the regular menu, but they carry them when they have special catering orders.  My husband enjoyed his food and my 3 year old had his own "soup" that he loved.  Can't wait to go back.  The owner was extremely friendly and helpful to us as we know nothing about Vietnamese food!

This is a regular visit for my family.  We enjoy the corn dogs, the pretzel buns are amazing and the Italian beef is something to crave.  Get it served wet, just grab some extra napkins because it is messy but so worth it.  The staff is always friendly, remembers me and is very helpful considering it can take a 3 year old time to figure out exactly what he wants and how he wants it!

I really do not know how this place has so many stars.  I have tried it three times now.  The first time was when it first opened.  Had horrible service and horrible food.  Was willing to chalk it up to being a new place and needing to work out the kinks.  Two more visits and I can say I will never be returning.  Even my 70 year old mother who is willing to give everyone a shot after this last visit said it was not worth wasting her time to go back.

Great pizza.  The thin crust is amazing and love the bread sticks and cheese.  We always get the family meal which includes a fresh salad and great choices of dressings.  Even when they are extremely busy you get great friendly, fast service.

Frost Bite has been around for a long time.  I've been a fan for years.  The service is always friendly and pleasant.  Everything is always amazing.  Make sure you get a bag of Frosty bars to take home with you and keep in the freezer.  They will even double dip them for you if you ask!  The food is always cooked to order and fresh and the tenderloins are huge.  If you visit you will enjoy!

Great ice cream with many many unique choices.  If you have a kiddo who is lactose intolerant, they have choices for them.  This is what drew me to the Emporium, but the amazing ice cream choices is what will keep me coming back.  The place is small so if it is busy be ready to take your ice cream elsewhere to eat it because there is limited seating.

The food here is fantastic.  If you are craving something different, this is your place.  The choices are not your everyday steak house fare.  The fish and pub chips are amazing.  If you get pub chips make sure to ask for the seasoned cream to go with them.  Their Goat cheese salad is great.  The Monte Cristo sandwich is out of this world.  You can't go wrong with any of the choices.  Make sure to try the Scotch Eggs appetizer, it may sound crazy, but trust me it works!

I love McAlister's.  The choices here are endless.  Their baked potato offerings are huge, filling and very flavorful.  The soups are always great and I've never had a sandwich that disappointed.  The staff is always friendly and very helpful with giving options.  There are so many great choices I always like to ask what their favorite is.  When you want something that feels fresh and not fast food, this is your place!  I love that they have outside seating - makes a great option.

This is my new favorite Mexican restaurant.  I don't even want to go anywhere else.  The food is great and the portions are big.  They are very accommodating to children and even the fries for the kids are great, mom and dad always steal some.    I've had the stuffed Poblano peppers, nachos, Quesadilla's and the list goes on and on.  I've never had a bad experience.

I have put off going to this place because the reviews have never been great. Well yesterday we broke down and went. I was very impressed. The atmosphere was clean and nice. My three year old loved the train going around the ceiling. I am an avid coke fan so the homemade sodas were a concern, but they had several options and gave samples and I found one I loved. My turkey burger was amazing, my sons pizza was plenty and he ate it!  My husband ordered the train wreck burger and aside from it being messy he enjoyed it.  The server was friendly and attentive. I am sorry I put it off so long and will be going back.

First time in... Definitely not the last!!  LOVED this place. All you can eat sushi for 21.99 was a steal. Everything was amazingly fresh and delicious. I can't wait until I am not so full so I can come back and try even more!  Only down side is no fountain drinks. They do have canned coke products if you have to have a soda. We ended up eating a salad, soup, appetizer and four cooked rolls and 2 raw rolls all were 8 large pieces. Oh soo good!

Don't judge a book by its cover, GO IN and try it.
Breadsticks had no flavor and pizza was terrible. Chewy cheese and no toppings. Sorry pizza I'll I wanted to love you because you are so close.
Great tacos full of flavor- staff are super helpful in explaining the difference between the tacos and providing suggestions.  The rice and beans were amazing as well.
Amazing tamales.  I ordered the ones with the green sauce - they served three and I took one back to a co-worker who now craves the tamales from here.
Great food and fun atomosphere.  Staff were super friendly.  Had the alligator appitizer, was good.  We both enjoyed our meals and would go back.  Would be a fun place to go with a group of people!

k0PV5GT4lTx-kFdNx89qeQ.review_text: Love this place every time and we keep coming back. Roma are the nicest people in the business. Very happy we found this pizzeria when we moved to West Berlin. Keep up the great work Frank and Loretta !!!!

Terrible. First we order drinks absolutely watered down. Appetizers fried long hots burnt, mussels were dirty, entree pasta was undercooked sauce was burnt tasting. I think everything was burnt tasting to be honest. Live music was amateur hour but somewhat entertaining. Definitely not a place for live music. Waiter was very friendly and offers us free dessert coffee. Dessert was very good :)

Hands down the best BYOB around. Each time we visit we are always impressed. He's always adding new creative dishes. The seafood is always fresh you can tell. Very warm and friendly staff. We will keep coming back !! Great job Nunzios
Loved it ! Very authentic and fresh. Everything about the food was aces no complaints. We had the rancheros pollo Assada and burrito very good. Just losses a star in staff. Not very friendly
Loved the food here last week just getting around to leaving my review. Very authentic. Try the chimichanga s. Amazing !!! Jalapeño tequila drinks were great !!!

Ok so we been coming to adelphias for many years. It's always been our go to spot when staying local.  We decided to check out adelphia this weds fur the biggest party night of the year !!! Epic Fail !! Drinks were watered down! Live Music was terrible. Seems like Adelphia really has taken a step backwards !!
Great restaurant. The food is generous sized and each entree we tried this Saturday was perfect. Great flavor authentically prepared ! We would certainly recommend this restaurant if you like Thai!

Great restaurant and you will not leave hungry. Make sure you get there early as it does fill up and can get a little crazy to get seated. Once you are seated the will treat you very well and the food is cooked perfect. The steak is great and pork is mouth watering.

Overall a very good experience today. Well thought through menu. Carefully and meticulously prepared entrees. Filet and veal chops cooked to perfection. Specialty cocktails professionally mixed with precision. Organized and very friendly staff.

Pretty good I'll say. We were seated very fast and greeted upon arriving. Waitress told us about the specials and very pleasant. Food was very good cooked to order and authentic. I'm thinking we will try again soon!!

What a joke of a live music venue! Stopped in and left with brain damage from the loud craziness I saw. One beer was too long a stay. This place used to be a great place to see live music in South Jersey. I can't even review the food because there was no way I would have been able to eat through that spectacle.
Good steak and greens were on point. Compliments to the chef last night and thank you for a courteous staff for making our visit fun and delightful !!!

Terrible experience every time! Food was bland and service horrendous. We have tried it a couple times and every time it is disappointing. The love bands are fun but would be nice if they actually hired a good band. Advertise summer concert series but bands didn't feel like concert quality acts.
Love it love it love it. We ate here this past weekend. Service was on point ! Steaks were prepared perfect. Good entertainment as well !!!

Place is a joke! Staff is rude! Food is bland even for bar food. I would not consider it a restaurant more like a diner. The band was terrible, in fact every band I've been to see here has been pretty awful!
Good food for a bar! Fast service and food came out hot. Prompt staff, courteous, and friendly. Live music was pretty good. Solo guitarist was good! Will definitely be back!
Love it ! Great food friendly staff !! We will surely be back to experience it again thank you to Janet fir the great service :)

Sorry but this place just stinks. First Taylor's, then iguana, top dog and now Vera. Staff is extremely rude. Live music was a joke as are most places I've found in southern NJ. First rule in my opinion when your booking a band please make sure they can actually play. This place is like a karaoke bar for wannabes.
Pretty good pizza ! At least staff was very nice and order came right out. That's what you want in a pizza joint fast, tasty, crunch. Thank you

Terrible as they get. Another local eatery with horrible food and bad entertainment. Rude staff and just a really bad experience on Saturday night. You guys may need to revisit your strategy. Perhaps tell your staff to brighten up a bit and hire some babes that can actually play music.

Great time here every time ! Food is Cuban based but really done right. Perfect Saturday night spot for dinner and great entertainment. Lots of Tributes and Dance bands everyone we visit! Love it!!! Keep up the great work !

Place is a joke ... how could they still be in business as a live music venue. Seriously... every time the music is horrible... too loud, screaming, it's unbelievable. I've given it so many chances because a lot of our friends say "hey let's go to Otts" I cringe every time because every performance I've seen there is terrible. I Ben when I hear it's a good band at Otts it's always a huge let down.

Perfect dinner in Christmas Eve ! This place never lets us down! We always leave more than satisfied. All dinners prepared with perfect detail and all the best ingredients. Live music is always tasteful and entertaining!!

So we decided to give Fainting Goat another try tonight. Food was very good but we are only giving  it two stars because live music was horrendous which is why we left and my car was banged into in the parking lot. 

Suggestion better party bands and although the car being hit is really not the establishments fault better lighting out Back would be better.

Terrible!  Very rude people! stopped in to by a few bottles and also wanted some information on events.  Stacy is a rude, nasty, person.  Came home to try the wine and it was horrendous. so many better wineries in south jersey. this one gets a thumbs down.

I liked it very much. food was tasty and waitress was very nice. very warm ambience. great spot to grab dinner. only draw back is it's kind of a boring atmosphere. they do not host live music or even have a jukebox. in fact I don't believe they even had a sports game on. other than that I give it a B+
Ehhh it was ok. the menu is a little strange for my taste. cocktails were good but just needed a little more something lively especially during happy hour. C-

So we really were expecting so much more here. in fact we tried it a few times just to make sure it wasn't a fluke. to start this place has a pretty good grocery store. you can find some very good quality Italian imports. most of it is packaged type goods but if you look you'll find a few good cheeses ect. 
so grocery store is a B

Restaurant- well we went the first time and it was ok. do not get the sausage l!!! They claim its the best but it's terrible !!! My wife had chicken and was happy with it. So we went on a weeknight and it was pretty boring. The waiter which was kind of miserable said we should come on the weekend when they have bands. so a few weeks later we went back.  I wouldn't even call the two middle aged men trying to sing nirvana a band lol. It was a joke! they kept saying are you guys in the zone yet !! Lmao pretty embarrassing. we left after our drinks

Great spot! Friendly staff, and very good food. Seafood Pescatore was probably the best I've had in south Jersey. Perfect scallops, tender shrimp. Always packed the two times visited, the ambience is nice, and the food photographs well.  Yet it tastes okay.  The fig grilled cheese was very greasy and salty with barely any figs, and the hollandaise sauce on the Eggs Benedict was sort of sour, made for an off-putting flavor.  Food is affordable and average overall.  

Friend's french toast looked and tasted much better, would recommend that instead.

Don't judge it by its outside!  It looked grimy to me when I first passed it, but this year finally visited the inside, and surprisingly it's a nice, chill atmosphere where you can grab a bite and drink after a long day with friends.  Food has a wide range- def recommend the french fries which has a bite to it.  Tried one of their special seasonal drinks made with Angry Orchard and it was amazing.

The food here is always well portioned and fresh, as well as for a reasonable price more so than the other places I've been to in NJ.  Their original bubble tea is quite delicious, however a bit expensive at $5.  Service is always quite fast!  Would def recommend as it is one of the best Vietnamese places I've visited.

I was really hyped to try this restaurant, and while the stir fried beef noodles were good, they just tasted like good quality lo mein.  I wasn't sure it was special enough for the price - which is actually more like $9-10 now rather than the $5 that is posted on the menus uploaded from 2010.  It is cash only.  Their thinly sliced pig ear and beef tendon is quite spicy and delicious.

For the price, which is under $4 in general and quite reasonable, I would recommend!  The place is small but cute, and the original bubble tea I ordered had Wow milk, which definitely was addictive to drink and the bubbles were a good balance of soft and chewy.  I only took a star off because the cashier got my friend's order size wrong.

Really fun market with a variety of food! Range of seafood to Asian food and lots of baked goods as well... my friend and I ran out of time to try the Peking duck but we managed to take beilers donuts to go and they are some of the tastiest donuts I've had!

DELICIOUS.  Friendly, great, antique atmosphere, and most importantly, delicious, unique flavors of ice cream.  Got the mint choco chip, cherry butter almond, green tea, and teaberry, the latter of which is my new favorite flavor.  Happy ^_^

Came here twice- the first time, wasn't really feeling the hand drawn (slim) noodles - what I do recommend ordering for sure is the pig ears (again) and 100% the spicy braised beef noodle soup with SHAVED (thick) noodles. SO GOOD.  Def much tastier and more of a handmade taste than the slim noodles.

The positive reviews got me hyped up, but the cannoli I tried was too sweet and dense, and it wasn't especially crunchy either.  I also got overcharged for it.  They pipe it fresh in front of you though, so that's kinda cool.  I didn't particularly want to keep eating it though, unfortunately, and have had better :/

Friend recommended this place to me, and I was honestly doubtful of how tasty a grilled cheese sandwich could be.. Meltkraft proved me wrong!  Something about it makes you want to keep eating!!  We had the one with cornichon pickles, gruyere cheese, mustard and ham.   YUM. Good balance of flavors.

Everything in this shop seems pretty expensive, but it feels like stepping into a whole other time period and that's pretty cool.  I ordered a garden mint chocolate milkshake, which definitely tasted like a fresh herb-y mint; however, again was quite expensive which is why I give it 4 stars.

Their bubble tea is definitely the best I've ever had, at least in original and matcha - the bubbles are made perfectly, and the flavor is always very fresh and delicious, not overly sweet.  However, one star off because 1)  sometimes you end up waiting a long time, and 2)  the chocolate one I ordered once on a whim was frankly, disgusting.  Not mixed well, lumpy, and cheap quality.  Just avoid the chocolate.
I enjoyed the columbian coffee flavor we ordered, and it was apparent that many other customers enjoyed it as well around us.  Fun atmosphere and giant waffle cones!

Perhaps it was because we'd heard so much about this place and there was so much hype, but I didn't really enjoy either of the things we ordered- one roast pork and one cheesesteak.  Maybe it's just not my type of food, or that the sharp cheese we tried was too strong and not what I'm used to.  There is also no price menu available.  

It is a fun, unique, random spot to try out though.

Avoid this place.  The pineapple on the hawaiian pizza had obviously gone bad, and the people working here are not very bright.  Messed up order and tried to blame on the customer.  Also doesn't look like a very organized or clean kitchen.

Nice, clean and chill spot- ordered by phone and they were extremely fast and ready by the time I arrived in 2 minutes.  Pretty tasty, only second behind Gong cha so far of the bubble tea places I've tried.  Will be returning!
It's just ok- got the drunken noodles.  It was a bit oily and the chicken was dry.

At first, the lobster roll seemed a bit small for its price, but it was actually quite delicious and filling.  Their lobster bisque is the best soup I've ever had.  Unfortunately, I have to take a point off for the fact that I ordered one lobster bisque and their award-winning clam chowder, but they gave me 2 lobster bisques instead.  Also not a fan of their luke's blueberry lemonade at all.  My mom really enjoyed their blueberry root beer though.  Definitely worth checking out.

The cacio e pepe is packed with flavor - perhaps a bit too overwhelming and pricey for my personal taste, but I give it 4 stars because they're nice, extremely fast, and the establishment is clean.  The pasta is definitely very fresh.

Unfortunately, witnessed unsanitary practice by the waiter and will probably not be going back.  The waiter was slapping my bowl against his belly while bringing it over, and later was coughing into the fish paste he was making next to our booth... was a bit gross to see.  Please don't have your sick employees make the food served to your customers.

Deliciouss.  We ordered the salmon burger, the pulled chicken BBQ burger, and the Stock Burger, and all three were amazing and fresh flavors well paired together.  Service was a bit slow (20 min wait), but lunch time was nearing.  Love their menu as well, a few vegan options.

I ate at Jim's Steaks when i visited Philly a couple years ago.  The long line for this place, which wrapped around almost a block, was absolutely worth it.  It got very high recommendations from Philly locals and we decided to try it out.  Located on the historic South street, it's a great place to get an afternoon bite.

Remember to not ask for the philly cheesesteak. instead, just ask for the cheesesteak.  This is advice we got from locals.  I'd recommend getting the greasiest philly cheesesteak you can get when you're there, with cheese whiz and all.  When else are you going to be able to try as authentic a philly cheesesteak as that?  Since that experience, I usually just get provalone cheese with my cheesesteaks, since I like to eat a bit healthier, but the cheese whiz experience is a great one to try even just once, and what better place to do it than in the heart of Philadelphia itself? 

If you're ever in Philly and want good, authentic philly cheesesteaks, Jim's Steaks is your place.  it's absolutely worth the long wait in line.

On a recent trip to Santa Barbara, a city with no shortage of restaurants and tourist destinations, there was one restaurant in particular which stood out to me among the rest. Sandbar Cocina y Tequila is situated on the main street of downtown Santa Barbara. At first glance, the restaurant looks very inviting, with colorful lanterns strung about the establishment, emanating a warm, twinkling glow. The restaurant features both an indoor bar as well as a large outdoor patio and dining area. I was seated next to a cozy fire pit for drinks and appetizers. My server Ashley was very nice, and although the restaurant was very busy during this time, she constantly checked on me and apologized if there was ever any lag. I ordered a shrimp quesadilla off the happy hour appetizer menu (half price, great deal!) and I was not disappointed. I also ordered a margarita, followed by a delicious mojito. Since it was happy hour, I got both drinks for the price of one. Overall I would highly recommend Sandbar as a fun, lively restaurant to enjoy food, drinks and music!

On a recent trip to the Midwest, we stopped in Indianapolis, IN for a night.  After perusing Yelp for some good (and authentic Indiana) food options, we decided to get dinner at Fire By the Monon.  We were certainly not disappointed by our choice! 

Fire By the Monon is a bit of a drive from downtown Indianapolis, but is perfect for those looking for an authentic Indiana experience in Indianapolis.  The service is friendly and the restaurant looks both quaint and homey.  The service here was truly unparalleled - our waiter was extremely friendly and helpful with his suggestions for what to order on the menu. 

I ordered a burger with melted cheddar cheese, onions, tomatoes, lettuce, bacon, avocado, and an amazing horseradish-type sauce.  It came with really good crispy onion rings.  We also ordered the restaurant's famed fried green tomatoes.  We were quite impressed!  It was delicious!

It was my second burger that day (I had had a burger for lunch), but it was still perfect and I truly enjoyed it.

It's definitely worth the drive!  I'm so glad we stopped by Fire By the Monon.  What an excellent meal :)

Pretty decent liquor store with a large number of selections.  They have aisles upon aisles of alcohol. It was unlike anything I'd ever seen before.  It was even bigger than Bevmo.  Very decent prices too.

Wegmans is amazing!  There are a great selection of foods (both ready-made and packaged) and pastries here. We got 3 donuts and an apple streusel.  The pastries were fantastically fresh!  Probably the most fresh pastries I've gotten from a grocery store in at least a few years.  I'd definitely stop by again!

I love Peking Wok!  The food is delicious, the service is excellent, and the restaurant just feels really homey and peaceful.  It's on my list of top 5 favorite Chinese restaurants I've ever visited in the US.  

Peking Wok has a large menu with lots of delicious options to choose from. We ordered the hot and sour soup, salmon teriyaki, and sliced beef with mixed vegetables.  It was all quite delicious and filling between the two of us.  

I highly recommend this restaurant!

Very delicious food!  We visited on a Saturday night (we were a party of 6) and were seated quickly even without reservations.  The sushi was quite tasty - I recommend the Incredible roll, the Infiniti roll, and the Valentine roll.  Everything was fresh and tasty.

I'm hoping this is the WaWa we stopped at on our drive on I-95.  There seem to be so many WaWas in the area!  The WaWa store I'm meaning to review is store #8305.

I loved the customizable ordering machines - you essentially order your own food on a screen (which can be pretty efficient, or perhaps not, depending on the circumstances).  I also loved how clean and organized this store was.  Service was good too.  And for a little extra, you can even get your own WaWa coffee cup.

For just around $5, I got a delicious Philly cheesesteak sandwich!  It was both filling and delicious, especially considering it's pretty much gas station food.  I was pretty impressed!

We visited Jones recently for brunch while we were in Philadelphia and I really loved the experience.  The decor is modern and unique, the service is fairly quick and friendly, and the food is quite tasty.  As with most brunch places, this place can fill up quickly during Saturday or Sunday brunch, so there will likely be a long wait.  

I liked the variety of their menu - you could go with breakfast and order French toast, waffles, or pancakes.  Or you could go with lunch and order a sandwich, burger or their delicious ahi tuna tacos.  Or you could do something in between, which is what I did, and order the fried chicken and waffles, a quintessential brunch food.  I absolutely loved the gravy that came with my food.  It was a unique flavor that I hadn't quite experienced with chicken and waffles before.  My portion was pretty big, so I had plenty of food to eat later.

I definitely recommend Jones as a great brunch place in Philadelphia and I would love to visit again if I'm visiting the city in the future.

During a recent layover in Terminal C at Philadelphia's airport, I considered my lunch options and Au Bon Pain was the winner.  I was deciding between Chipotle (usually my first choice, but I'd had it so many times recently) and a cheesesteak place.  Au Bon Pain won out, though, since I estimated that that would be the food that would be least likely to give me food poisoning before my flight.  I ordered a chicken caesar salad and it came with the amazing Asiago breadstick that I love so much.  For about $7, the very filling salad and equally filling breadstick were truly worth it.  The ingredients were fresh and the meal was overall satisfying.  Another great thing is the food court located right outside this restaurant.  I'd definitely visit again during a future layover in Philadelphia.

My boyfriend and I visited this Bertucci's on our way back to DC from New Jersey.  It was a bit silly, since who visits a sit-down on a roadtrip? :D  But he had talked up Bertucci's for a while and I really wanted to visit with him and we saw this one on the way, so yeah.

The bread rolls they brought out at the beginning were delicious!  We decided to go for the full Bertucci experience and ordered the pizza and a pasta.  We ordered the shrimp scampi (Sautéed shrimp with fresh herbs, tomatoes, a hint of hot pepper and garlic tossed with spaghetti in a lemon wine sauce) and the Ultimate Bertucci pizza (each quarter was topped with a different topping - sweet Italian sausage,
meatballs, rosemary ham, chicken).  Both the pasta and the pizza were tasty.  I think I preferred the pasta to the pizza because it was filled with herbs.  Though I have to say that I loved the option of having all those types of meat on the pizza.

The restaurant itself was a bit dingy and service wasn't amazing, but the food (especially the pasta) was excellent.  I would certainly stop by again.

I truly enjoyed my experience at PF Chang's in Marlton, NJ.  Though it's not really authentic Chinese food, it's still delicious and I really enjoyed the caramelized dishes that were full of flavor.  I really liked the decor and the Terra cotta warrior statues were reminiscent of my trip to Xi'an a few years ago.  

I visited with a group of 5 people and they had an awesome holiday special dinner for 2 (for $65) that I split.  We got two appetizers, two entrees, and a dessert.  We really enjoyed the spicy tuna appetizer and Chang's lettuce wraps as appetizers, and they came in large portions that could be shared family - style around the table.  For the entree I ordered the Beef with Broccoli and it was great.  For dessert, we ordered the Great Wall of Chocolate and it was a monstrous portion!  Of course, I didn't partake in that course of the meal (hating chocolate as I do), but it was fine because I was super stuffed from all the other food.  

Service was a tad bit slow... maybe it was because it was super busy that night?  Not sure.  But overall, we had a great experience and I highly recommend it!

Solid food and experience!  I visited The Dandelion in downtown Philadelphia recently for a family graduation dinner.  We were a large party with several tables and the restaurant accommodated us well.  We had a pre-set menu with some great choices to choose from.

I absolutely loved the table bread they brought out at the beginning - very ambrosial.  

I ordered:

-Appetizer: House-made ricotta with extra virgin olive oil, dried herbs on toasted sourdough.  I thought this was delicious, but had I known that table bread would be served before the meal (it was not served until after we had ordered), I would probably have gone with the salad, as it was a bread overload for even me.

-Entree: Steak and Chips (with pan roasted beef tender, watercress salad, triple cooked chips, steak butter).  This was delicious, but I thought it was odd that they could only prepare the steak either medium rare or medium well.  I am accustomed to ordering my steak medium these days, so I was at a quandary.  I opted for medium rare, figuring the steak often cooks even more over the course of the meal when served on a hot plate.  And I think my fiance has ruined well-done steak for me - he has indeed shown me the light ;)  The steak was perfect (it did, indeed, cook further on my plate) and I loved the garnish on it.

-Dessert: They had a pre-set dessert with an assortment of mini-pastries.  I was very thankful that they were not all chocolate.  I truly enjoyed the mini-cheesecake pastry, but wasn't the biggest fan of the mini-lemon custard.  Strange flavor.  I gave my fiance my chocolate (as per usual) and he enjoyed having 2 mini-chocolate pastries :P  

I enjoyed the atmosphere - it has a gastropub feel to it, but the decor is also more elegant and sophisticated than the image that a "gastropub" generally evokes.  I really liked the fireplace in the comfortable waiting area and the myriad of paintings.

Service was quick and efficient throughout, though they were a bit slow with getting the bill out, despite the fact we had to leave by a certain hour because the event ended and they needed our tables vacant.  The end felt just a bit rushed.

While not one of my favorites, The Dandelion was certainly a wonderful experience and I would visit again in the future.

My fiancé and I were so excited to visit the Franklin Fountain, especially after we'd seen it featured on Man v. Food recently!  The rest of our group was equally as excited about it and we decided to stop by when we were in Philadelphia recently.  I think chocolate lovers fare better with their choices here, but there was a clear winner for me on the menu, since I detest chocolate - the Broken Hearts sundae (which is maybe aptly named for those who hate chocolate).  My dessert was served in a generously-portioned heart-shaped bowl and consisted of a slice of brick vanilla ice cream, covered with fresh, sweetened, and slightly mashed strawberries, and over these, they placed sweetened whipped cream, topped off with two whole strawberries and served with two nabisco wafers.  Wowzas!  I was impressed!  And finished almost everything that I could that hadn't already melted :D  

My fiancé and the rest of our party ordered chocolate options (he ordered something called the Mt. Vesuviu, I believe), because of course :P  I have to admit that the chocolate options are the things to order, if you actually like chocolate (I do not).

This place has all the trappings of an old timey ice cream parlor - from the old ice cream churning machine to the soda pop bottles and candied flavors of toppings and even the vintage uniforms the employees wore. 

There was plenty of seating for the 5 of us outside, but be wary on a hot day - the ice cream melts quickly!  I didn't follow through with my usual niceties of waiting for everyone else to begin before digging in.  There should be absolutely no expectation to wait for anyone, because your ice cream will likely transform into soup if you do!

Overall, I loved the Franklin Fountain!  I'm envious of Philly residents who get to visit this gem much more often than I would be able to!

I recently visited Fitler Dining Room for a family graduation brunch.  It's a very intimate restaurant (I counted only 6 tables in there), but the 7 of us were still able to comfortably fit at a reserved table.  The food is reasonably priced, the entrees are generously portioned, and the service was great.  Our waiter was very sarcastic and funny and efficient - if only all waiters were like that!  Keep in mind that they only do brunch (not lunch) during the day on weekends, so be prepared to order accordingly.  I ordered the fried chicken with a fried egg on top.  It was lathered with a delicious Russian dressing (think Thousand Island) and also contained some braised kale.   It was served on a biscuit.  Very delicious and filling!  Overall, I really enjoyed Fitler Dining Room and I would certainly visit again in the future.

Delicious, especially for take-out sushi!  We ordered a ton (and I mean a TON) of sushi from Akira II recently and I loved the food.  We initially ordered separate rolls, but ended up all sharing. 

The items of note that we ordered (as far as I remember) were:

-Sushi Pizza (Scallion pancake w. lobster salad, avocado top w. tuna & salmon w. spicy mayo).  This was my first time eating sushi pizza - it was an interesting flavor and overall I liked it, but I have to say that sushi is strange with bread!
-Rainbow Roll (Crab stick, cucumber inside topped w. tuna, salmon, yellowtail, fluke & avocado)
-Treasure Island Roll (California roll topped w. spicy lobster, mango & mango sauce)
-King Kong Roll (Spicy tuna, shrimp tempura, eel, cucumber, fresh avocado inside topped with whole soft shell crab)
-King of Roll (Lobster tail tempura, Chilean sea bass, fresh avocado, cucumber, tobiko, wrapped with soy paper, served with miso sauce and eel sauce)
-Rock Roll (Shrimp tempura, cucumber, inside topped with pepper tuna & spicy king crab)
-Super California Roll (Spicy lump crab with avocado and cucumber inside, topped with spicy crunchy salmon. Serve with yummy sauce)

So much sushi!  The platter was quite large.

My fiance and I ended up finishing the last little bit.  Whoo whee, I haven't felt so full off of sushi since my AYCE sushi days a few years ago!  

I would definitely recommend this place - delicious!

I recently visited Buddakan as part of a family graduation brunch (as a party of 6) and had a very nice experience.  I absolutely loved the decor.  Very lovely atmosphere.  Those chairs with the faces were a bit creepy, but I didn't even notice them until I looked at the pictures later on.

The food was good, but definitely overpriced and smaller portion sizes than you'd expect.  For $25 Pad Thai, I expect perfection.  We ordered a side of Pad Thai to share (as well as a side of lobster fried rice) and it was a bit dry, too small of a portion, with not enough meat or toppings.  Definitely not worth the price. The other dishes were better - I ordered the sea bass, which came with haricots verts, maitake mushrooms, butternut squash, and truffle jus.  It was tasty, but again not a generous portion for the price. Others ordered the duck and the chicken, as well as the Korean short ribs and Caesar salad (I thought it was funny that they offer a Caesar salad at an Asian restaurant, but it looked good!)  We also got several kinds of dumplings as appetizers.  The truffled edamame dumpling was a true winner!  Delicious!  

I didn't think the food was particularly authentic overall - seems more like a westernized Asian fusion place. But I don't fault them for that, as they don't really tout themselves as the paragon of authenticity.  

I left feeling satisfied, but not extremely full, despite all the food our table ordered.  

Service was decent - our waitress was very friendly and very efficient about getting our entrees out. She also gave good advice on things to order, though it did feel a little pushy when she recommended that we order a ton more food than I'd expected.  Granted, the portions are small so you should probably order a decent number of dishes.

Overall, a nice experience. Not my favorite restaurant, but I can see the appeal and would certainly visit again in the future.

Delicious!! The pizza is so fresh and tasty.  I love my pizza cheesy (think very melty) and Passariello's hit the spot perfectly.  I also had half a cheesesteak from there (with sauteed onions instead of mushrooms) and really enjoyed it. Very fresh and also very melty, which I much appreciated.  My fiancé has been eating here for years and I just tried it for the first time during my most recent visit to New Jersey.  I will definitely be eating more Passariello's - I love it! ;)

Nom nom nom!  My fiancé and I got a cheesesteak from Tony Luke's at the Lincoln Financial Field stadium during an Eagles game.  The cheesesteak is DELICIOUS!  I'm a huge fan of cheesesteaks and have visited Jim's on South Street in Philly previously.  Tony Luke's was definitely just as good, if not better, than the cheesesteak I'd gotten years ago at Jim's.  I would certainly love to visit again when I'm in Philly in the future!

I know I've already rated this Wegman's, but I just have to review it again for its excellent sushi selection!  The sushi is fresh, reasonably priced, and super delicious!  Nice variety of sushi too.  I visited recently with my fiancé again and we loved the sushi so much that we visited on two consecutive days to eat sushi for breakfast from Wegmans.  We will certainly be back for more of that nom-arrific sushi!!

I thought I'd already reviewed this Panera. I've visited on numerous occasions now and always enjoy it. The food is fresh, service is nice, and there are plenty of places to sit.  And it's consistently clean, which (surprisingly) I can't say about some other Panera locations I've been to.  I ordered a tomato soup during my most recent visit and loved it.  Super tasty!  I've also ordered the Caesar salad there on other occasions. We will certainly be back :)

Excellent!  My hubby (fiance at the time) and I visited New Jersey back in April and got food at Maurizio's. I ordered the chicken caesar salad and found it to be a large portion with excellent quality!  The salad was very fresh and they were generous with the chicken portion!  Wonderfully fresh dressing and cheese, as well.  My fiancé ordered something of the Pizza variety and enjoyed it as well.  The food was quick and we really appreciated that.  We are big fans and would certainly visit again!

Excellent!  My hubby (then fiance) and I visited Firebirds with his family back in April and we really enjoyed it. I ordered the Sesame Encrusted Salmon off the entree menu and it came with fried spinach and ginger mustard aioli. I ordered it with a side of rice pilaf and veggies and really enjoyed it. The salmon was perfectly prepared - crispy on the outside and tender/juicy on the inside!

We also ordered the Lobster Spinach Queso to share for the table and it was delicious and a decent portion!  Everyone else seemed to enjoy our appetizer, as well as their meals.

Service was excellent from start to finish!  I would certainly visit again.

Pie Lady Cafe is an adorable little pie shop in the quaint and adorable main street in downtown Moorestown, New Jersey.  My husband and I stopped in on a lovely Saturday last summer (August 2016) before we made our way down to the Jersey shore for the weekend.  We both ordered a slice of their apple pie and it was heavenly!  The pie was perfectly sweet, fresh, and melt-in-your mouth amazing!  We also ordered a whole blueberry pie (my favorite) to go to share with our family down at the shore.  The blueberry pie was also delicious and was a big hit with the family.  

Service at the Pie Lady Cafe is fantastic. The ladies working there were very friendly and sweet. They have some seating at the cafe, which was much appreciated, since we dined in to enjoy our apple pie while it was super fresh.  The decor is so quaint, old-timey, and cute!  I would LOVE to visit again in the future whenever I'm in Moorestown, NJ!

We visited Johnson's Corner Farm when we were in New Jersey for Christmas 2016.  It was super cute and festive during the holiday season and tons of cute little knick knacks like Christmas signs, pillows, and dolls.  We bought a blueberry pie to take for my in laws when we were there.  That pie was DELICIOUS!  I LOVE blueberry pies generally and really enjoyed how fresh and berry-licious that pie was.  I think this farm would be a fun place to go berry picking in the summer (I went berry picking in central Jersey with friends back during summer 2012).  I would definitely visit again if I happened to be in that area.  Their pies are delish, their service was very nice, and it's just very quintessentially Jersey.

We visited Prospector's Grille & Saloon during Dec 2016 when we visited New Jersey for Christmas.  My husband and his family used to frequent Prospector's Grille & Saloon during his childhood, since he grew up not too far from there.  The food is pretty awesome, decently priced, and service is excellent.  I also really liked the decor in there - it's old timey, and since we visited during the holiday season, there was adorable holiday decor everywhere.  The train track running along the ceiling is pretty iconic, as is the cowboy decor everywhere.  I ordered the salad and the steak with onion straws and onion rings.  Very delicious!  That steak was juicy and amazing.  My husband ordered a bacon cheeseburger with fries and was also happy with his choice.  I definitely recommend Prospector's Grille & Saloon and would definitely visit again in the future - great food, great prices, and a fun theme!

We dined at Angeline for dinner on New Year's Eve 2016 during our New Orleans trip.  The restaurant is pretty incredible!  Both the atmosphere and the food is perfect. It's nestled perfectly within the French Quarter in New Orleans and offers some amazing French food options.

We ordered the following:
-Oysters (raw, satsuma mignonette, roasted herbsaint butter, bottarga, herbs, cornbread crumbs fried, caviar, creme fraiche)
-Angeline Cioppino (mussels, oysters, shrimp, fin fish, tomatoes, heirloom beans, saffron, fennel, black olive toast)
-Tomato butternut squash soup
-Steak Special
-Fruity cocktail (for me)
-Chocolate cake dessert
-Beignets

They also brought out some amuse-bouche for us, which is always both amusing and delicious :) 

We visited New Orleans on an extremely rainy (and floody) night and it was so nice to get out of the rain into that welcoming, homey restaurant.  The French Quarter in New Orleans has many options to choose from, but Angeline undoubtedly ranks up there with the best of them!  I would definitely visit again.

We visited NOLA Restaurant, Emeril Lagassi's famous New Orleans restaurant, when we visited New Orleans in January 2017.  The restaurant is very nicely arranged and offers some spectacular, trendy food.  The food is a fun take on classic New Orleans food, but combines elements of other cultures.  The Vietnamese style po boy was a good example of the fusion of classic New Orleans dishes with the dishes of other cultures.  

We ordered the following:  
-Miss May's Vietnamese Po'Boy (fried oysters, sweet pickled carrots, fresh cilantro, cucumber, jalapenos, sriracha aioli, hoisin, kimchee salad) (this wasn't as good as I imagined, but it was still decent)
-Gumbo of the day (one of the best gumbo soups I've ever had!)
-Duck Confit and Fried Egg Pizza (parmesan cheese, truffle oil, baby arugula)
-Mint Julep (muddled mint, Kentucky bourbon, simple syrup and water"

The restaurant is conveniently located smack dab in the middle of the French Quarter.  I would definitely recommend it to friends visiting New Orleans and would visit again if I visit New Orleans in the future.

Great food and the service was nice, though a bit slow...we wished the service had been quicker. Other than that, great restaurant!

We visited Pat O'Briens in the afternoon of the second day of our New Orleans visit when we wanted to pass the time before our dinner reservation elsewhere. We had initially wanted to check out Preservation Hall, but it was way too crowded.  Pat O'Briens was also very crowded, but reasonable to get inside.  It has several different areas with bars and seating.  They have 2-3 inside halls, as well as an outdoor garden courtyard.  The courtyard still had throngs of people standing around, even though it was raining that afternoon.  We didn't stay for long, but enjoyed passing through and checking this bar out.  They also have a restaurant.

We visited Cafe Amelie for dinner when we were in New Orleans in Jan 2017.  The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a lovely courtyard.  We sat on the second floor of the restaurant, at the window, so we could glimpse the lovely courtyard down below.  Service was excellent throughout and the food was absolutely delicious.  Perfect New Orleans style fare.  

We ordered the following:
-Shrimp and Grits (with corn andouille and maque choux) (we both ordered this and loved it)
-Gumbo
-Mint Julep (very tasty and refreshing)
-Amelie Oysters (creamed spinach and artichokes made with housemade crostinis)

The food was amazing!  I'm so glad we got to have a nice, classy, sit-down dinner while in New Orleans.  I would love to return again.

We visited Magazine Street during our trip to New Orleans in Jan 2017.  Magazine Street is located in the Garden District in the uptown part of the city.  It's a lot cleaner and less crowded / noisy than the French Quarter part of the city.  It abuts the famous mansions of the Garden District and runs for quite a way through the uptown portion of New Orleans.  We visited briefly to get breakfast at The District, which I will review separately.  The street is full of cute shops and cafes.  It's definitely a must-do if you're visiting New Orleans and want to get a full picture of the city.

We visited District Donuts for breakfast when we visited New Orleans in Jan 2017.  Located in the uptown / Garden District part of the city, this restaurant sits right at the edge of Magazine Street and the famous Garden District mansions.  It was quite crowded when we visited and it took us about 20 minutes to get a table.  You order up front at the counter.  They have quite an array of donuts.  Each of them is AMAZING - fluffy, delicious, sugary, large, and perfect.  They have more than just donuts - their breakfast sandwiches are also excellent.  

We ordered the following:
-Powdered sugar donut 
-Glazed cinnamon donut 
-Ham, Egg and Cheese Sandwich
-Fried Chicken Biscuit sandwich 

Everything was absolutely delicious!  Service is really nice and though it gets crowded, it's not impossible to find a table.  I highly recommend it for breakfast if you are uptown on Magazine Street!

Commander's Palace is quintessential New Orleans, and it seems to be on every list of places you must visit while in New Orleans.  It's located in the uptown / Garden District of the city.  I had a good experience there, but the food wasn't as fantastic as I'd hoped and the service is SLOW and not very friendly.  We visited on our second fully day in New Orleans in January 2017 and had reservations (make sure to have reservations, as this place fills up quickly).  We were seated in one of the main dining rooms (this place is quite large and has several areas), which overlooked the outdoor courtyard behind the restaurant.  

We ordered the following:
-Commander's Turtle Soup (Rich veal stock simmered slowly for 2 hours with round snapping turtle, holy trinity, and pressed hen's eggs; finished tableside with aged sherry).  This was my first time trying turtle soup and it was definitely tasty, but the sherry made it a little too sweet / bitter for my taste.
-Commander's Crisp Romaine Salad (Hearts of romaine, grated Parmesan, pressed egg, housemade bacon, French bread croutons, shaved Gruyere, and creamy black pepper dressing)
-Cornbread Crusted Des Allemands Catfish (A saute of Cajun andouille, grilled Vidalia onions, Louisiana red beans, and roasted tomatoes with Creole tomato butter and smoked corn grits).  This was tasty, but not as delicious as I had hoped.  For some reason, the taste wasn't exactly what I was expecting.
-Chicken stew dish on their specials menu
-25 cent drinks - They have 25 cent martinis on their menu and I ordered one.  It was definitely delicious, and I've heard it's a highlight of this place It's certainly unique.

This place is good and it's worth a visit at least once, especially if you're visiting New Orleans for the first time, but I couldn't help but feel it was a bit of a tourist trap.  I doubt I'd visit again in the future when visiting New Orleans, since the city has so many other amazing restaurants.  But it's certainly worth a visit if you haven't visited before.

We visited Morning Call Coffee Stand for a snack while we were in City Park in New Orleans in Jan 2017.  Service wasn't the nicest and the chair / table areas were in a bit of a disarray and not the cleanest, but I did enjoy the food!  I tried Muffuletta, a New Orleans staple, for the first time at this cafe.  The dish is comprised of a large, round, and somewhat flattened loaf of bread with a sturdy texture, around 10 inches (25 cm) across.  I had a muffuletta sandwich, which was comprised of a muffuletta loaf split horizontally and covered with layers of marinated olive salad, salami, ham, Swiss cheese, provolone, and mortadella.  It was quite delicious - I loved the combination and being able to try this famous staple!  Not the best cafe I've been to, but I did enjoy the sandwich I ordered.

We visited Three Muses for an early dinner and to listen to some jazz when we visited New Orleans in Jan 2017.  The restaurant is located on Frenchmen Street, which is where the locals hang out when they want to get away from the hustle and bustle of Bourbon Street and other more crowded streets in the French Quarter.  

This restaurant has an eclectic menu, with several cultural fusion options, such as Falafel Crusted Fresh Mozzarella, Bulgogi Rice Bowl, and Italian Baked Mac n Cheese.  

I ended up ordering the "Ms. Moons Bulgogi Rice Bowl" (thinly sliced marinated ribeye steak, spinach, housemade kimchi, and fried yard egg), which was DELICIOUS!  I'd never expected to have one of my favorite Korean dishes while listening to some awesome jazz music simultaneously :)  You get that type of experience at Three Muses.  We also ordered the "Tempura Shrimp" with sweet Chinese mustard sauce.  Yum!  

I would definitely return again if I visit New Orleans in the future and absolutely recommend this restaurant!  Good jazz and good food.

3090 is a nice jazz club on Frenchmen Street, where the locals seem to go in New Orleans.  We visited 3090 to listen to some jazz when we visited New Orleans in Jan 2017.  The music was lovely and the atmosphere was lively and fun.  We didn't have any food there (we had eaten at Three Muses down the street), but their food and drink options seemed good and I would certainly like to go back for the food if I visit New Orleans and this restaurannt / jazz club in the future.

We dined at Merchants Restaurant when we visited Nashville, Tennessee while on our southern road trip in January 2017.  The restaurant is located smack dab in the middle of downtown Nashville, in the busy Music City part of the city.  There are tons of other restaurants and bars nearby, as well as the Country Music Hall of Fame, several museums, several live music halls, and the Bridgestone Arena.  

The food and service at this restaurant were excellent and I had some of the best brisket of my life while there. 

We had the following:
-Truffled Popcorn (they brough it out for the table, complimentary)
-Beef Brisket with BBQ sauce and cornbread, as well as coleslaw
-Fishes (mojo, pice de gallo, jalapeno aioli, guacamole, slaw)

The restaurant was really busy and we were visiting at an off hour (around 3/4pm in the afternoon).  I can't imagine how busy it must get t night!  I would definitely visit again and recommend it to friends!

We were looking for something to eat late at night when we were stopping in Moorestown, NJ for a night ahead of my in laws' wedding weekend and Yelped to find that Yard House, attached to the Moorestown Mall, was still open at that late hour (I believe they are open until midnight or even later).  We had driven about 4 hours, so the food was definitely very welcome.  They have great burgers and sandwiches, as well as amazing side dishes.  I had snacked on the road, so I only ended up ordering the fried brussels sprouts, but they were FANTASTIC!  I absolutely loved the lemony cream sauce it came with.  I'd been to other Yard House locations previously and this one measures up.  I'd definitely return again.  Parking is also great, as the Yard House is at the far end of the mall and has an entrance facing the mall parking lot.
