The last time I went to the Red Bicycle was a couple months ago so maybe things have gotten better.  But I will never return because of the customer service.  The crepe itself was solid but it took 45 minutes.  The shop was busy but not line out the door busy.  And let me emphasize that it was 45 minutes after I ordered, not from when I got in line.  

Sometimes things don't go well and I get it.  My issue is that when I said something about the wait the customer service response was snarky and unapologetic.  I wasn't asking for a free meal, just some acknowledgement.  Instead I had an argument about whether a crepe that is "made to order" (is there another way?) should take 45 minutes.  If they had just said "I hope you come back and give us another chance" then I would have done so.  Instead I will actively never return under any circumstances.

Hands down the best sandwiches I've had in Nashville.  I love sandwiches.  I can't get enough of the Turkey, Bacon, Avocado sandwich.  Although I've tried multiple types of sandwich and each were quite good.  Pretty cool ambience too and even when it is busy the wait isn't bad.

My only complaint is that it isn't in my neighborhood.

I've been driving past this place for a couple years and every time I thought I needed to try it out.  I love the building and the Preds support. Today I finally went.  Very good.  Not quite Mitchell's but it doesn't need to be.  Simple, straightforward sandwiches that are delicious.  I had a roast beef and smoked cheddar sandiwch. The wheat bread was great and they load up meat nicely. I was very hungry but I think I actually could've gotten by with a half sandwich.  Glad to find another non-chain sandwich shop.

Maybe the best pork chop I've had at a restaurant.  I was lucky enough to get the last one.  Solid service.  Really just what my party of 4 needed.  Pretty good menu that I'll be interested in exploring in the future.

Others have mentioned variable service and food but during my three times going have all been spectacular.  I've never personally ordered the chicken but someone in my part has each time and man is that delicious.  

Their pastas are tasty, lighter than what you get at most places, which suited just fine.  Most recently I had a pork belly dish and it was excellent.  Probably not something I could order over and over but one of the positives of Rolf and Daughters is you can bounce around the menu pretty easily.

It can be tough to get a table but the bar is a pretty good for hanging out while you wait.

What a great menu.  Unfortunately the menu is a lot better than the food.  My party of four ordered a variety of things, the best item being the szechuan green beans.  The others were largely forgettable including short ribs and ahi tuna.  

We also had a weird experience with one of our party repeatedly being brought the wrong drink.  Not the end of the world but added to the underwhelming nature of the meal.

Also a little too much effort to be trendy.  To be cool you can't try that hard.

Even though it is a little off of tradition I love going with the tenders at Hattie B's.  Being able to knife and fork it makes the experience more manageable.  At first I was skeptical that Hattie B's was as legit as the other mainstays but they do a great job.

In terms of the chicken, it was splendid and their range of hotness is great.  I generally have Hot as my base and then I might mix in a damn hot tender or a shut the gluck up tender.  Shut the gluck up is a struggle, one that I enjoy.  For the less spicily inclined Medium has a great balance between heat and flavor.  Southern style is just great fried chicken.

Sides are solid.  Black eyed pea salad is the best side I think.  Potato salad recommended as a good cooling agent.

Best BBQ in Nashville just like the original Edley's (although not quite on the level of Memphis).  But I actually like the east even better than the original because of its layout and location.  Easier access for me and a great outdoor seating arrangement, plus a lot of openness with the inside seating.  Definitely looks like a strong warm weather place to hang out.

I had the turkey sandwich with cornbread and mac and cheese.  Sides were good although the sandwich filled me up.  Great sandwich as always.

Gabby's is a true burger place.  No frills, no gourmet twists, just good burgers, good fries, good toppings and plenty of hot sauces.  I'm not anti the gourmet burger movement, I love burgers of all types, but sometimes all you really want is a reasonably priced, well executed masterpiece. 

I got the Gabby's Burger.  It is in the Five Guys family of really good burgers (I grew up on Five Guys in northern virginia before they expanded).  Enjoyed adding jalapenos and grilled onions.  Wasabi mayo was good for dipping the fries.

Ambiance also is perfect.

Gabby's is a place that is excellent at what it is.

I didn't come in with incredibly high expectations and ended up pleasantly surprised.  We had a nice waitress.  The beer list and whiskey lists are long for the connoisseurs.  

I ended up with a chili burger with jalapenos.  Quite delicious.  They served the chili on the side which was a nice touch so I could control how much I put on the burger, without causing too much mess.

It was a nice open space to eat and drink on a Saturday afternoon.   Probably not at the top of my list for a repeat but I could definitely see myself heading there with a group to hang out.

Went there for a happy hour and got to sit in one of the outdoor areas.  Pretty unimpressive but not a disaster.  

Weird, eclectic, over priced menu that seemed to say they weren't great at any particular thing.  Mussels were okay though.

Extensive wine and beer options were nice.

We got attacked by flies, which is not necessarily their fault.

The outdoor space was nice but seemed to say "we put a lot of effort into this space and building" rather than "I"m just enjoying a nice sit outside".

Most importantly every bit of food at Husk was delicious.  But the other parts were great too.  Cool building, accessible location, professional but casual waiters, cool but low key.

The crispy pig ear appetizer was the best thing we had.  But the pork was good, as were the johnny cakes.  

Really enjoyable experience.

I've been here a few times and every time has been excellent.  The menu is straightforward and classic.  This is the place for if you want a straightforward classy dinner.

The mac and cheese and vegetable sides were excellent.  I preferred the mac and cheese and though it might be better than Silo's (my other favorite mac and cheese in nashville).  My fiance preferred the vegetable side.

We both had steaks which were, as always, excellent.  

Service was good.  And it is always fun to go to the hermitage hotel with the fancy bathroom, the doormen, the whole thing.

I may be biased for this one because I proposed to my fiance immediately following dinner.  But it was a great dinner too.

The ambiance really sets things apart with the live jazz.  Our waiter was a great guy.  He brought my fiance out a couple different wines to try out, no fuss at all.

I got the lamb leg which was very strong.  

The salad we split was tasty.  And dessert, creme brulee, was excellent.

A dive so divey that it might be too divey for me.  The burgers are super legit.  Like really good, with texas toast.  The beer is cheap.

But...it is really smokey, the back hallyway/bathroom area is a little too dicey.  Pretty good location.  Wouldn't mind a spot in the area that is between this and Oak Bar.

Maybe I'm getting old because I thought this would be my type of hangout but it just doesn't keep me coming back except when I can't figure out an alternative.

A really enjoyable meal.  As good as the food was the true standout was the high quality of service.  We didn't have a reservation so we sat at the bar for a bit before getting seated.  The manager took good care of us even as she was completing a number of other tasks.  We got seated out on the upstairs balcony, a very cool little spot to sit.

Our waiter was excellent and friendly, just really high caliber and enjoyable.

I got the lamb chops special which was delicious.  Our waiter did a good job of steering me towards the dish I wanted.  His recommendation was perfect.

We went for happy hour.  It was a great happy hour menu, good prices and variety.  We got a few drinks and a couple appetizers.  The chips and guacamole and calamari were all solidly good but not spectacular.  Pretty good service.  Nice outdoor seating.  All in all a solid place and definitely a place to repeat during happy hour.

Lots of options but ultimately not superior to other doughnuts I've had.  The customer service wasn't great.  The line moved surprisingly slowly for a doughnut place and then it took us awhile to get our order rung up.

We tried a few different varieties of the doughnuts.  All fine, not spectacular or special.  Probably better than Dunkin Donuts but more inconvenient.  I don't think I could say definitively better than Krispy Kreme although I do prefer local places.

Mad Donna's is secretly my favorite restaurant in Nashville.  I say secret favorite restaurant because even though I didn't realize it this is the place I go the most often. I almost always go for brunch.  All their brunch options are very legit although I'm partial to the grilled turkey melt, the spinach artichoke adds something special to it.

If you are trying to spice it up go for a bloody mary with one of the many infused vodka options.  Along with the bloody mary bar are a lot of hot sauce options.  Read carefully before using because some of them will knock you out for the rest of the meal.

I've only done dinner once with my fiance and a friend.  Sweet potato enchiladas were enjoyable, the hot chicken sandwich was tasty and definitely hot even at medium and I'm a guy who loves hot chicken.  Crispy tofu was not good at all although to our server's ever lasting credit she said it wasn't that good and our friend blew through the stop sign. Just goes to show, listen to your server.

Our service has always been positive and enjoyable.

I'm a new addition to the neighborhood and just tried King Solomon's.  And then I tried them again...and again.  My favorite type of neighborhood quick service place.  The food is good, the location is walkable for me, it is a good price and the guys who work there are super nice.  Pretty much the opposite of the nearby Burger King.  Their spicy fries are good and the wings do well for themselves.  A couple different versions of their gyros are really good, especially the spicy chicken and the hummus chicken.

I eagerly anticipated my first visit to the Crying Wolf.  I was ready for a good bar, pretty different than other Nashville bars.  I just had that feeling that this was going to be an awesome spot.

I left...confused. Underwhelmed. Slightly frustrated.

Crying Wolf is a bar that has a lot of attributes of having a strong identity but without cohesiveness that delivers a clear identity.  

Some parts of it feel like a dive, some feel like a cocktail bar, some like a place that should have a great beer list, or top notch bar food.  It had a faux smokey quality.  The pool table is a nice touch.  It felt sort of empty even when there was a second wind of people who showed up.  

It has a full bar, including a nice variety of cheap beer, but a limited drink list and not much on tap. The burgers are decent but not in the my top 10 in Nashville.  Plus I'd really just prefer fries to chips.   The service was merely okay, pretty slow but not offensively so.  The ambience felt like some bars I've been to in other cities but felt overly manufactured.  

I guess overall I was put off by a middle of the road experience and what felt like a conscious effort to be something, I"m just not sure what that something is.

It could be that it is still a young bar and this will develop over time because I think there is a lot of potential.

Pretty cool space.  Seems like a place I wouldn't mind hanging out...

But really slow service coupled with coffee that tasted burnt doesn't do it for me.  

Also limited snack options.   Not quite an on-the-go coffee shop, not quite a hipster hangout paradise.

I'm a loyal King Solomon's customer but had not previously had their gyro fries.  Mindblowing.  That's all I can really say.  If they weren't already five stars, the gyro fries get them there.  Brilliant, filling, delicious.  Good with the spicy fries or the regular although I recommend the spicy fries.

The Ninja Bacon: Awesome.  If you're going to go to Virago that's what you need to get. Our server was cool.  She effectively steered us away from some items that she didn't think were great. 

But overall...pretty underwhelming.  It is overpriced for what you get.  Everything we ordered outside of the Ninja Bacon was pretty good but not amazing. I got a wagyu beef skewer. The meat was quite tasty but I was a little surprised that it was only meat on a stick, with no veggies or anything else. Seemed naked.

The brisket egg roll wasn't nearly as good as it sounded and generally less impressive than many brisket reimagined dishes I've had in Nashville. 

The sushi roll was big and pretty good but again not amazing.

And finally, our experience was marred when one of our party was asked to remove his stylish cap due to dress code.  It was clear that the manager doing the asking was uncomfortable asking someone to remove his hat and this aspect of the dress code seemed inconsistent with the rest of the trendy, upscale vibe. It was an unnecessary and uncomfortable moment and came midway through our meal.  Why wasn't something mentioned when we walked in the door?

Overall just not as enjoyable as anticipated and not sure why you would pay that price when similar price points will get you a much greater meal and experience at many other locales.

Took a few visits to realize it but Alegria has become one of my favorite restaurants in Nashville. The guacamole isn't the best I've ever had but the pomegranate adds a little flair, the portion is hearty and it is generally avocadoey which I dig. I always struggle with filling up too much on chips and guac.

The tacos are great. The brisket tacos especially are great.  The fajitas are delicious, especially the steak.  What else can I say it is just delicious and I always have an enjoyable experience.  The rice and beans that accompany pretty much everything are spot on.  Overall a pleasant mix of well-executed mexican and a touch gourmet innovation.

Who would've thought a strip mall in Green Hills would have the best Mexican food in town?  My wife is from Texas and she loves it, which is no small feat.  

Bonus points for being incredibly filling and also tasty for left overs so you when you're full you can just pack it up and take it home for more enjoyment later.

We got to sit outside and enjoy the patio, which I really like being able to do.  The food was solid but not spectacular.  

The hummus was the best part and I would recommend ordering it. 

We went with sandwiches and perhaps that's not the right approach here.  I went with  the ground sirloin sausage with pomegranate molasses.  It was tasty but not something I would go out of my way to get.  My wife got the chicken and while the flavor was solid, the chicken was a bit dry. 

Not bad and if we're in the mood for lebanese we might return but relative to other options in the area probably not our first choice.

Delicious.  I think they are safely taking over the best thai in Nashville.  A little bumpy on the service but that's okay.  I got the Panang Curry, esane hot.  Awesome.  And esane hot is no joke.  My wife got the drunken noodles, also quite good although not as awesome as the Panang.  The steamed dumplings may have been the best thing we had.  I'm getting hungry for thai just thinking about it. 

I'll be back and may be bumping this rating up to five stars soon enough.  They're close, I'm just not sure I'm ready to put Thai Esane in the absolute upper echelon of Nashville restaurants.

Thai Phooket has been my go-to Thai spot since I've arrived in Nashville and I think it will remain so but their food has been a little inconsistent lately.  I think we've learned to stick with the dishes we know are really solid, for me that's the Pad Thai. Very consistently excellent.  When you veer away into other dishes it is more difficult to get a guaranteed amazing dish.

The staff are incredibly friendly, the take-out is convenient and dining in is fun.  They've made the most of their venue and I enjoy Thai Phooket.

Ah Pharmacy...what to do about you.

Conveniently located for me, large beer garden that is great for hanging out, burgers burgers burgers.

But...consistently mediocre service, great burger toppings and buns but without the great burger patty.  I don't get why they aren't better at cooking their burgers.

The burgers knock your socks off when you're hungry from waiting 90 minutes and have been taking advantage of the beer list for awhile.  There's nothing wrong with that but it doesn't make a top burger place in a city full of great burgers.

Waiting in line isn't worth it.  Always better to put your name in and head to the back bar where you can lounge and drink beer while waiting.  I'm not sure why more don't take this approach rather than sitting outside.  It can be a good experience with properly calibrated expectations.  But if you're just looking for a great burger than go someplace that has great burgers like Gabby's, Oak Room or ML Rose.

n0f3ak2pHGAqmc7HWoMBsA.review_text: My boyfriend and I went to Iozzo's the day before Valentine's Day due to zero reservations due the day of, and it was the most exquisite italian meal I have ever had. The waitress we had was very nice, and attentive. I had the fetuccini alfredo with shrimp, mushrooms and broccoli, and let me just say. WOW. It was honestly the best thing I have ever tasted. My boyfriend got the lobster ravioli and we split both. We had lots of leftovers for the next day. For dessert we also got creme brulee and that was also amazing. I would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to go out and splurge on a nice dinner. This is the place to go.

Absolutely loved this place. My boyfriend both randomly noticed it as we were driving past and decided to give their dinner menu a try. Initially I was a bit skeptical because I thought it may be really pricey for how nice it was inside. Boy was I wrong!! The food was PHENOMENAL and so reasonable!! My boyfriend got this delicious crab curry dish. The crab was soooooo good, and cooked to perfection. I got the mango shrimp curry. It comes with giant pieces of shrimp and the curry base with chunks of mango in it was absolutely delicious. We also got a ginger beer with the meal, and when it was all said and done our total bill w/ the drinks and two entrees came out to be $40. For a really nice restaurant with a live saxophone player and wonderful ambiance, I'd say that's a deal. Highly, highly recommend!

This place is always busy, and I can understand why! It has a fun, lively atmosphere, and the burger selection is very tasty and unique. You can choose from your typical burger to some other non-standard burgers. Service is typically decently fast for how busy they are. They also have delicious salad options. My favorite is the gorgonberry pecan...so good! Overall, highly recommend!

I went here with my mom and dad for a dinner out, and was blown away. The servers are great at explaining the menu and are very attentive and friendly. I got a delicious drink, the chile mango margarita. The rim is coated in a sweet/spicy sugar..SO GOOD. The decor within is absolutely perfect, and the food was a 10/10. We tried the "Fantesia De Guacamole" Tasting Trio, which features 3 different types of guac. I am very picky about guacamole, but these were all amazing and so unique. The main course was great as well, I got the shrimp and street corn tamal, and I had leftovers for the next day. So happy this place came to Indy! Will most definitely be back next time with my boyfriend!
I love this place. Amazing food, great prices, excellent service, friendly staff and delicious margaritas. When it comes to Mexican cuisine, this is the place my boyfriend and I choose EVERY TIME!

So I spent way more money here than I would like to admit, but let me just say, it was worth it. I got the avocado toast with poached eggs and a side of the tomato bisque and it was so SO good. Our bartender, Raymond and the other bartender (I don't remember her name, but she had dope gauges and was super fun to talk to), were fantastic too. As far as drinks go, the bloody mary, the "Ladies Who Brunch" cocktail, and the "Sass-A-Melon" cocktail were all super great and refreshing as well. Moral of the story, 10/10 would recommend, loved it. Go there, you won't be disappointed.

The last time I was here I got the grilled cheese with apricot preserves, as well as the corn nuts and the kale salad. The kale salad is super good, and the grilled cheese was delicious as well. In the past I've also gotten the fried chicken with spicy honey and that was BOMB. If you come here, I would recommend splitting a few sides w/ a group so you can get a taste of everything, and of course, try the fried chicken at least once. Waiters were all really nice, and their drinks are decent too. Overall good experience.

Super relaxing, chill environment. Amazing cigar and cocktail selection. I went here with my friends on a Sunday afternoon, and was there for at least 3 and a half hours just hanging out talking. If you're wanting something fancy but quiet, this is the place to go.

Looking for deliciously unique Asian inspired tacos and an amazing bubble tea selection? Look no further!  When I'm in the mood for bubble tea and tacos, this is my go to. Also, I've heard their sweet potato fries covered in mole sauce and cheese are delish but I've never personally tried them..so looks like I have another reason to go back.

Came here for dinner and loved everything about it! Our waitress was really friendly and informative about everything on the menu. I got the Mediterranean chicken and it was flavorful and juicy! (you know how some chicken is bland and tough...blah). Anyway, drinks were also good, and they have outdoor seating which was fun since the weather was super pretty that evening. Will definitely be back!!

I love this place! Wandered upon this little gem the other day for the first time and got an in-depth tour and history lesson on the place from Russ. The drinks are good, and I hear the food is good too although I have yet to try it. It's cool because the back part of Alley Cat is a totally different vibe from the front so you can have the best of both worlds if you choose.

I'll def be returning!

UPDATE: went back here last night and had another phenomenal experience. we had originally ordered the cauliflower for an app and then changed our minds & asked for the shrimp and polenta (which by the way was ~*aMaZiNg*~) and our server let us still have the cauliflower for free!! might i add, the cauliflower was also very tasty but the polenta took the cake. all in all, amazing service once again, delicious food & fantastic ambiance. will definitely be back. 




Had been hearing rave reviews and decided to check it out. Everything we got from the yucca fries as an app to the red drum and skirt steak as the main entree was seriously delicious. The whole entire experience that the restaurant provides from the moment you walk in is spot on. It's decorated beautifully and has a really nice upstairs bar, eating area and outdoor patio, which is where we sat. They have cute lights strung across outside which makes it look fun and special. Out waiter Brandon was attentive and friendly and offered good advice on what to get since it was our first time there. All-in-all I don't have a single complaint and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for some delicious upper scale latin food!

Cool spot to chill w/ friends or do some work. The workers are always friendly & seem happy to serve. on top of that they have really good coffee and not super expensive for the quality! It's cool too because they offer a great beer & wine selection as well. so depending on what you're going for, there's something for everyone! 

I will say in the winter it gets a little drafty because the door opens straight into the coffee shop and can be windy, so be prepared and dress warm!!

yum...donuts!! but honestly, where can you go wrong? cheap prices. literally got a dozen and spent like 5 bucks. it's been around a long time so there's history and when you walk in it feels like you're in someone's kitchen. everything is hella fresh, you can tell. go here!

I love this place. The decor is alright, but delicious food completely makes up for the lack of ambiance. The chicken pho is always fresh and delicious & I know they have vegetarian/vegan options as well. I also always love getting the spring rolls. Service is on point. What's not to love?!?

came here for the first time today and had a great experience! their menu is extensive and full of unique options and the cafe itself has a cool rustic-"antiquey" vibe. i got the Vietnamese coffee for the first time and it was awesome, my friend got the chai tea latte w a cream cheese stuffed pumpkin muffin (wow, yum) & said he liked it. i will def be back!

this is a fun spot to come grab a beer and enjoy some delicious pulled pork nachos! i've never been a huge nacho person, but i love their nachos because each individual chip is topped with all the good stuff rather than a big sloppy mess on a plate that you have to somehow manage to eat. our waitress was so friendly and on it with the service, and the outdoor fire pit was fun to sit by once we were done eating. i will definitely be back again!

I came here for the second time a few weeks ago and really enjoyed the food. Their sides are sooo delish and I loved the fish I got for an entree. For an app we got the calamari but it was legit like eating little tiny raw octopuses because they didn't fry it so it was chewy and rubbery in my opinion. I wasn't such a fan. But I get the concept they're going for with the unique take on normal calamari & I can appreciate that. On the flip side the sauce it came in made up for it and was awesome. 

The service was pretty good and as usual I always love the ambiance that this place has to offer. Very cool new Mexican vibe within the decor selections. We came on a Saturday night (they were busy) and were pleased to be seated immediately! 

Price range is a little higher but with an upper scale mexican restaurant, I'd say that's to be expected. They do have some reasonably priced dishes though. I had the margarita and my date had the sangria both of which were very tasty in my opinion. I think I liked the marg a little better but then again I'm 100% a margarita girl. The cocktails range from around $8-$11ish they're good tho and i was pleasantly surprised with the size of my margarita. 

With that being said, All in all a very good experience!

Such a beautiful restaurant & such delicious food! The decor is simplistic and beautiful with (obviously) a nautical theme. I came here for the first time on NYE with my date and there was about a 20 minute wait so we sat at the bar. I didn't think 20 was bad at all considering it was New Years. The service was great and our server did a really nice job at explaining and walking us through the menu. I got a cocktail (I forget what it was called) and I have to say, for the $11 I spent, Ive had better. It was good but not great. The food was on point though. We got an app that we loved and they even surprised us with free dessert which was definitely a nice touch. If you're celebrating something or are wanting to splurge on a nice meal this is the place to be. Definitely pricey but you get what you pay for w the great service and delicious food.

Chances are you either have never been to this place or have never even heard of it. Well, that was me until Friday night. I came here on a Friday and was surprised to walk in and see how teeny tiny it was and, wow is it dark; BUT, these strange attributes are actually what make this place feel exclusive and unique. 

For starters, I'm pretty sure it only seats around 15 people, so you may want to make a reservation. We were lucky and got seated immediately, but the remainder of the night the place stayed full. Our waitress was 

The drinks are delicious. I got "A Proper Mai Tai" and the "Chomsky" both of which I really liked. I will say though, you have to try the mai tai. It was by far my favorite and comes in an awesome metal pineapple cup. so that was cool & special. 

Now, as far as food goes, I will have to say I was a tad underwhelmed. We split the pan roasted shiitake mushroom dish, and the fancy af burger. The mushrooms were pretty good, the sauce it comes in is flavorful, but the fancy af burger....um, probs not. It's really not that fancy, the only thing that makes it "fancy" is the fact that they put a couple truffle mushrooms on top, which I like, but other than the sparse amount of mushrooms on top, it was bland af not fancy af. No tomato, onion, lettuce, sauces, just meat, truffle and bread. Also it was pretty under cooked. 

Overall, I would give the drinks 4.5 stars and the food 3 stars. Come for the drinks and pass on the food!

Ya really can't go wrong with half price sushi every Sunday. Came here w some friends and got quite a bit of food for a super good price. Our waitress was attentive and informative also very friendly. I love the decor in this place. Feels fresh, simple and fun! Come here on a Sunday, but just know it will be busy. Won't wait more than 30 minutes for a table typically, altho bar is first come first serve and full service :D

As always mexican food is delish. This place is nothing out of the ordinary for Mexican but still pretty darn good. I got the jumbo house marg and the shrimp taco salad and loved it all. Our waiter was attentive and kept water glasses full. The decor is colorful and fun and they even have a little fountain thing inside which I thought was cute!! We ordered a large side of queso and that was PLENTY for 4 people. I had leftovers for dayzz, which I always love. Anyway, overall good experience. Good food. Good service. Will be back!

I love this place! I've never gotten food here but their drinks are always spot on. It's kind of a hidden gem, and I say that because from the outside you wouldn't really know how big it is inside. They have a nice outdoor dining part that overlooks a street so good people watching. sometimes they have live music inside. Our server was really nice and was helpful with describing the flavor profile of all the drinks. The interior is so pretty and I love the look/feel of the bar area. It's a little pricey but anywhere you go on mass ave for cocktails will be around $8-$12 so it's nothing out of the ordinary. Definitely check this place out and if you can, try to get a spot outside!

So good! I've gotten the tacos, salad and most importantly the margaritas here and they're alllllways spot on!! They have a back patio area as well as a downstairs bar area so there's usually something available which is nice on a busy Saturday night. Check it out fosho

I come here almost every Thursday and it's consistently been a really great experience each time! Food is delicious and the margs are good as well, all for a very reasonable price. Also the server that works there in the afternoons is so friendly and accommodating and always makes me feel welcome. I will definitely be back to try something other than my go-to, (shrimp tacos)!

My mom and I came here for lunch on my birthday and we enjoyed it. We split the salmon and got an appetizer. It's a tad pricey but I would say worth it since it is more of a fine dining kind of place. It's fun to sit outside on their patio area and people watch. Overall I would recommend, but just know it's not going to be cheap!

Came here last night on a whim. Come to find out, it happened to be their opening night! As we entered, friendly staff greeted us and told us about all the games & where to find them. Also. Ski ball. I haven't played ski ball since I was like 6 at Chuck E. Cheese's. But let me tell you, at 24 with a beer in hand, it is so much fun!!! 
They have two bars, one on the main floor and one on the second. Great open atmosphere where you can easily stroll from being indoors to outdoors on their giant wrap around patio area. The whole place is very spacious so you never feel like you're crammed in a packed bar. 
The beer menu is awesome, cocktails are delish and have funny clever names. Overall, I think it's an awesome addition to mass ave! Definitely check this place out!

No. No no no. I used to live right down the street from this place, and there were multiple times they just straight up wouldn't answer their drive thru speaker... ? I can't even count how many times I went there for a mcflurry and their "machine was down." As if that isn't enough, the lines here are always especially long. So, not only do you have to wait 30 minutes to place your order, you get then get the wonderful surprise of finding out that you waited 30 minutes to be told what you want to order isn't available! Awesome! :-)

Love this place!  Fun, lively, great food!  

Have been here 1/2 dozen times in last few months.  Each time memorable.

I highly recommend any of their pizzas.  novel and incredible.  They even offer pizza takeout.

Any of their cocktails are out of this world.  Take advantage of the HH prices.  Fresh ingredients and attention to detail are evident.

Do not miss the Brussel sprouts with guanciale-exquisite says it all.

The Staff is always professional, but not stuffy.

Wonderful! Simply exquisite! If you gave this place a try when it first opened - and were less than thrilled - I would encourage you to give it another attempt.  I was so impressed, and as well as my dining companions, by the food quality and uniqueness of the offerings.   The waitstaff is impeccable. A memorable evening - I recommend Tableau highly

Less than impressed. I understand the place is just starting up, but the delay of 20 minutes for a small bite plate and the overpriced concoction they call a cocktail that was swimming in vermouth, was too much to bear. I would like to give it another try once they get their act together.

Obtained reservations for lunch early the same day.  There was no wait upon arrival, even though they were quite busy.  The energy in the room was buzzing and positively charged. 

Chose the week day-offered three course calendar lunch ($20.15). It was excellent, as expected.  The oyster appetizer was succulent, tasty, and just as good as it has been in the past. The pork tenderloin, recommended by Eddie, our waiter, did not disappoint.   It was juicy, seasoned just right, and rested a bed of sweet potatoes.  OMG--perfect juxtaposition!!   The chocolate mousse was a simple yet perfect cap to a delightful lunch. 

Eddie's service by he and his team were prompt, engaging, and went the extra mile.  Very much appreciated.  

I recommend Antoine's to both tourists and local New Orleanians--without hesitation.  Besides the fact that it's chalk full of history, it's an epicurean legend--and so much fun!!

Loved it! Dropped in for a couple of tiki drinks - had a wonderful Mai Tai-just delightful, light and refreshing.  

Had the pork ribs appetizer suggested by Chef Chris--absolutely blown away--they were succulent, tender and sweet. The entire experience was memorable. I will definitely be recommending this to my friends.

Simply wonderful! The best darn martini ever, along with blue cheese stuffed olives. I go here for the martinis, even if I am not having dinner. The entrée was phenomenal, the daily special (recommended by my waiter-who was terrific), salmon, which was light, wonderful taste, mouth-watering.  The food is consistently great each visit.  No downside to this establishment.

A neighborhood haunt - love the chicken and waffles, the Sunday brunch with either bloody Mary's or mimosas are refreshing.  The service is expedient and friendly. Happy to recommend this establishment.

Always very nice and courteous.  Everyone at this store is extremely helpful and pleasant. I find it less harried than the other two stores in the New Orleans metro area.  This is my go to store for quality produce and prepared foods.
Excellent quality and superfast delivery. Always reliable.  Recommend all items on the menu.
Excellent food, phenomenal music, the acoustics and the Decour blend of very inviting ambience.
Consistently great. The eclectic vibe is one of the reasons that I keep coming back. Always entertaining and always Satisfied.

Attended yet another fabulous Little Gem saloon performance featuring the Ladies of Soul (Sharon Martin, Rechelle Cook and Naydja CoJoe).  Another sold out show and everyone on their feet dancing/clapping throughout their performance.  The food, as always, is delightful and on point.  The wait staff never disappoints. Nick and his team are extraordinary.
