The Baby Spinach Strawberry salad with raspberry vinaigrette was very good. The raspberry vinaigrette dressing was excellent. I usually don't stray from their house dressing, which is outstanding. 

I would recommend this salad and Ravanelli's.

Had steak and BBQ chicken combo. Chicken was very good, but the steak was a little over done for medium. The broccoli was a little dry. The restaurant is pretty loud and gets extremely load when the servers dance.  The waitress  was very good and friendly.
Great pizza!  The small salads are almost a meal in themselves. I would highly recommend Joe's Pizza.
Very good Mexican food. The staff is always friendly.  Everything is made fresh. The chicken and vegetables are outstanding.
Little Saigon is outstanding. The pineapple fried rice comes with chicken and shrimp and is excellent. The service is top notch and friendly. I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Very good casual Mexican dining. The staff is always friendly.  Everything is made fresh. The chicken and vegetables are outstanding.  

The Alambre dish is outstanding. The beef is sliced thin and cooked to perfection. The addition of fresh peppers and onions help to make it one of my favorites here. 

The homemade guacamole is very good.

The spinach strawberry salad with an added grilled chicken breast was very good. It comes with a raspberry vinaigrette dressing, sunflower seeds and dried raspberries in it. They have a homemade ranch dressing that is outstanding. The vegetable soup was good also. Sometimes the soup can be a little peppery, but tonight it was spot on.

Located in the downtown area and within walking distance of the movie theater, Aiello's Pizza is a hidden treasure in Granite City.  Their pizza is among the best I've eaten and the salads are very good.  

The owner is almost always there greeting the customers and if he's not his daughter Sam is. The service is always outstanding and the food has never disappointed. When the weather is nice you can sit out on the deck for some outside dinning. 

I would highly recommend this father & daughter pizza parlor. Good people and good pizza!

This is a very hard review to post. On one hand I thought the toasted ravioli was very good, possibly among the best I've had. For my entree I had the chicken marsala, which also was very good. 

The noise level in this restaurant might be the loudest I've ever experienced. I would say that my wife and I had to repeat what we said to each other about every other sentence. It was so loud that when we left we sat in silence in our car for approximately a full minute. 

The server was horrible. Our beverages spent more time empty than full and after asking us if we wished to see the dessert menu she disappeared. several minutes later she came back with our check instead of the dessert menu. 

Another disappointing thing was that the outside dining area wasn't being utilized for some reason. 

I would not recommend this restaurant.  I found it difficult to give them the second star.

The Granite City Applebee's is located on Nameoki Road just in front of the Shop N Save. As Applebee's go the Granite City location is your typical restaurant. 

Tonight I had the wood grilled chicken breast with garlic green beans and a house salad with ranch dressing. The chicken seemed to be a little bland. It tasted as though it could have used some type of seasoning. The green beans were good and the salad was also good. 

The server seemed to be trying, but wasn't very attentIve. I don't eat here often due to Applebee's not being one of my top restaurant choices, but the assistant manager is always moving around the dinning area checking on how everyone is doing.

Chava's restaurant is located in downtown Edwardsville near the library. It is a small restaurant with both inside and patio dining. 

I had the chicken fajitas which were outstanding. The meal comes with grilled chicken seasoned to perfection, grilled vegetables, re fried beans, and rice. The entire meal was outstanding.  

The service at Chava's is always spot on. The wait staff is very attentive and always great. 

I would highly recommend Chava's.

Pickles Deli is located in the Central West End on Euclid. It is a small sandwich shop that serves outstanding food.  They have inside and outside seating. 

The deli meat is high quality and always fresh. My favorite sandwich is the Club on a pretzel bun. Today I got the house salad with chicken added to it. I had the vinaigrette dressing.  The salad was very good. 

The staff at Pickles is always friendly and attentive. I would highly recommend Pickles Deli, especially for a light lunch.

Very good casual Mexican dining. The staff is always friendly.  Everything is made fresh. The chicken and vegetables are outstanding.  

The Alambre dish is outstanding. The beef is sliced thin and cooked to perfection. The addition of fresh peppers and onions help to make it one of my favorites here. 

The homemade guacamole is very good.  

8/19/206 visit

Tonight I had the Alambre again and it was delicious. It was cooked to perfection. The beef was sliced thin and the vegetables were once again very fresh. The food was very good.

The Alton Red Lobster is usually not too busy and you can get seated fairly quickly.   

Tonight I had the grilled salmon with broccoli and a side salad. The wood grilled salmon is very good.  The cheese rolls are always hot and delicious.  

The server was very friendly and probably the best server we have ever had at this restaurant. 

I would recommend this restaurant.
The chicken liver linguini is very good. The service it normally very good. Typically there is seating available when you arrive.  They could use a larger parking lot though.

Tonight (2/10/17) I had the stuffed chicken special and for starters I had the crab stew which was very good. The meal came with a chicken breast stuffed with cheese.  My sides were green beans and red potatoes. The chicken and potatoes were over cooked..  This might be the loudest restaurant I've eaten at. It was difficult to hear our conversation. The server was friendly and attentive.

The spinach strawberry salad with an added grilled chicken breast was very good. It comes with a raspberry vinaigrette dressing, sunflower seeds and dried raspberries in it. They have a homemade ranch dressing that is outstanding. The vegetable soup was good also. Sometimes the soup can be a little peppery, but tonight it was spot on. 

On 3/19/2017 I had the grilled chicken salad with the house dressing. The salad was very good.  Normally the service here is pretty good, but today it was just mediocre. The waitress forgot my cup of soup and failed to keep our drinks full.

We have eaten at Andria's three times now. Every time the food has been excellent.  I highly recommend any of the steaks or the salmon. The steaks are huge and always cooked to perfection. 

The service has been very good to outstanding on all three of our visits.

Located inside the airport it looked like a nice place to grab a quick breakfast. The server was not very personable. My wife and I both got got the classic breakfast. 

The food was okay, my wife found two hairs (possibly eye brow hairs) in her eggs.  The server never offered a refill on any of our drinks. 

I would not recommend this restaurant.

Locate on the outskirts of Edwardsville, Illinois. The sushi was very good and very reasonably priced. I got the shrimp and scallop lunch plate. It was very good. The server was also very good and continually stopped by the table to check on us and refill our drinks.  The penthouse sushi was outstanding. 

I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Located in Collinsville, Illinois Zapata's is a pretty good Mexican restaurant. It typically doesn't have a wait to be seated and you can choose inside or outside dinning.  

I recommend the California burrito.  It a huge burrito and comes with fries. I always substitute beans for the fries though. 

Another good option is the special fajitas.  I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

This Taco Bell is located near downtown Granite City. The food here is typically good, but over the last couple of months they have made mistakes while completing our drive through orders. 

I recommend double checking your order before pulling out of the parking lot.

Located on Hampton just about a mile or two from Forest Park this restaurant is pretty good choice for some casual dinning. 

Their salads are fairly big and I recommend the buffalo chicken salad. The service is typically pretty good and wait times aren't bad.

Located in Edwardsville near the Kohl's store. They have very good ice cream and the employees are very friendly. 

The ice cream cupcakes are very good and I recommend the pie who loved me specialty ice cream.

This small Chinese restaurant opened in the 1980's and is located in the Bellemore Village shopping center. The family who runs it are very nice and they make outstanding food. I highly recommend the cashew chicken, but everything on the menu is very good.

Pantera's Pizza is a nice restaurant located in Edwardsville. The restaurant is very spacious and can accommodate large groups. I have eaten here many times and normally the pizza is normally pretty good, but on my last visit the pizza and salad bar was very bland.

Located in O'Fallon, Illinois just about one minute from the movie theater, Chevys' has outstanding Mexican food. Their food is fresh and their home made chips and salsa is top notch. 

There servers are friendly and attentive and they are not typically super busy, so there is almost never a wait time for seating. They have some outside seating and they also have some dinning tables in the bar area too. 

Personally I like their fajitas, everything on these dishes is always fresh and plentiful. 

I highly recommend this restaurant.

This IHOP is located in Glen Carbon, Illinois. There usually isn't a wait time for seating, so it can be a nice option. 

The service here is usually good and the food matches the service. For some reason it can seem rather load in some areas of the restaurant, but overall it's a nice place to eat. 

The omelette dare very good and pretty big.  I would recommend this restaurant.

The Pizza Hut in Granite City is carry out and delivery only. The delivery times are usually pretty reasonable and I can only think of one time when it took them a long time to make the delivery.  On that particular occasion the driver explained why the pizza took so long and about an hour after the delivery, I received an e-mail coupon for a free large pizza. Nicely done Pizza Hut, great service recovery.  

The food items I have ordered from Pizza Hut have always been good and me my expectations. The drivers are typically very nice. 

I would recommend ordering from this Pizza Hut.

Located in an old farmhouse in Fairview Heights, Illinois this restaurant is a hidden gem. We have eaten at Andria's approximately seven or eight times now. Every time the food has been excellent.  I highly recommend any of the steaks or the salmon. The steaks are huge and always cooked to perfection. 

The fried ravioli are very good and I highly recommend them as an appetizer.

The service has been very good to outstanding for all of our visits.

Located in downtown Granite City, this cafe is located within walking distance of the cinema. Their lunch menu includes the typical sandwiches, salads, and soups. 

On this visit I ordered the combination lunch of a hot turkey club and the chicken teriyaki salad. I though both were very good. Jill was the server and  she did a very good job and was very friendly. 

They also offer a wide variety of coffee and lattes.  I have had their coffee and it is very good. 

Their dining area is very cozy and they will sometimes bring in local musicians to perform at the restaurant. They also allow local artist to sell their art in their restaurant. 

I would recommend this restaurant.

Located in Collinsville on the belt line, this Steak'n Shake is typically pretty busy. It had been a fairly long time since I had last eaten at this restaurant, this was due to the fact that my last few experiences were less that favorable. 

It appears that it is under a new manager and the server, Madison was outstanding. It was very busy and almost every table was full, that being said, she provided a great customer service and our food came out quickly and hot.  The server Madison was so good, that I actually ask to speak with the manager to let him know how great her service was. 

I had the double steak burger and a cup of chili. Both were very good.

Lascelles is another restaurant located within walking distance of the cinema in downtown Granite City.  The restaurant is inside an old bank building directly across from City Hall. 

The tomato bisque is outstanding. It comes with two small pieces of a grilled cheese sandwich. I order this ever time I go to this restaurant. 

Lascelles has a great special. It consists of a 16 oz steak, a 16 oz baked potato, and a 16 oz beer for $16. 

The dress code for this restaurant is casual and you can normally get a table without a wait.  I would recommend this restaurant.

The BBQ Saloon is located in the Central West End near Barnes-Jewish Hospital. The dress code for the restaurant is casual and there is not typically a wait to get a table. They serve lunch and dinner. 

The pulled pork nachos are very good and one of the less expensive options at the restaurant.  The nachos are huge and can easily be split between two people. 

Another special they have is a camel burger. The burger is good, but a little pricey.  

The restaurant has a great selection of whiskey and bourbon and the service is typically pretty good.

Located on The Hill in St. Louis Lorenzo's is a very good Italian restaurant. On weekends you will definitely encounter a wait for a table, but during the week you can often get seated almost immediately.  The prices here a very reasonable for the quality of food you receive. 

Everything I've ordered at this restaurant has always been very good. The service is always very good. 


While waiting for a table I ordered a Civil-life brown draft beer which was very good.

This IMO's restaurant is located on Fehling Road in Granite City near the high school baseball field. I believe it opened in the late 80's or early 90's. 

The restaurant is your typical IMO's Pizza location. The owner Ron Sack is a hands on owner an you can often find him manning the cutting table at least four days a week. 

The quality of the food is good and fresh. They offer a wide variety of lunch specials.

Located in Edwardsville near the Derberg's store. This Bread Co. can get fairly busy at times.  The restaurant is clean and kept neat. 

On my 2/10/18 visit I ordered the Brioche bacon and egg, with the egg over easy. The sandwich was one of the better breakfast sandwiches I've had in a while. I also ordered a small coffee. 

This particular Bread Co. seems to keep their coffee serving station well stocked.

Peel Wood Fired Pizza is located on South Arbor Vitae. The dress code is casual.  The restaurant has a small bar at the entrance, which helps to pass time when waiting for a table. The restaurant's dinning area is small, so there is usually a wait. When the weather is nice they have outside seating, which can help with the wait times to be seated. 

Their pizzas are good and baked in a wood fire oven. On my 1/28/18 visit my wife and I shared a small house salad and a build your own pizza (chicken and spinach). Both were good. The pizza could have had a little more sauce on it, but I thought it was good.

This restaurant has good salad and pizza. They also offer a pretty nice selection of beers to complement this items. I would recommend this restaurant.

Joe's Pizza is a hidden gem in Edwardsville, Illinois. Located in a strip mall about seven minutes out side the city, it is a small restaurant. 

I would say that Joe's is among my favorite pizza parlors. It seems like not too many people know about the place, so I have never encountered a wait to be seated. 

I would have to say that every thing I have ordered here has been very good to outstanding. I would highly recommend the the Joe's Special Pizza. 

The staff are all very good. 

I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Little Saigon is located in the Central West End near Barnes-Jewish Hospital. This restaurant serves outstanding Vietnamese food. The restaurant is fairly small, but normally doesn't have a wait to be seated. When the weather is nice they offer outside dinning and they allow pets in this area. 


I have eaten here many times and I highly recommend the steak cubes and the pineapple chicken. It is normally a difficult decision figuring it which one I will order.  The fried spring rolls appetizer is also very good.  

The owner is hands on and can often be found helping out among the staff. The wait staff are all very nice and do an exceptional job. This is one of my favorite restaurants in the Central West End.

Joey B's is like cared on Hampton Blvd. on the Hill. When you think of restaurants on The Hill, this one might not come to mind immediately, but it is a very good restaurant. Joey B's has a wide variety of menu items, ranging from itilian dishes to your not so traditional Italian cheeseburgers. 

The restaurant can get busy, but the wait is not typically too long and there is a bar area to help pass the time. 

On my 2/12/2018 visit I ordered the pollo Alfredo, which is by far my favorite dish on the menu. It has grilled chicken, peas, mushrooms and bow tie pasta, all covered in an outstanding white sauce. 

On previous visits I have had the nachos appetizer, the Joey B's Pizza and a Hawaiian grilled chicken sandwich. All of which were very good. 

Another item I must point out is the bread the serve. I would say it is definitely in the top five breads I hav been served. 

The staff is very good and always friendly. I highly recommend this restaurant. 

They also offer a nice deal around Christmas where they offer a free $20 gift card for every $100 you buy in gift certificates.

The Edwardsville Texas Roadhouse is located near the Best Buy. The restaurant is typically very busy and wait times can easily reach an hour on Fridays and Saturdays. 

When the weather is nice there is ample space to wait outside, but when it's cold outside it can get very crowded in the inside waiting area. 

The food here is normally pretty good and will often depend on how busy they are. On this visit I ordered the ribeye with a loaded baked potatoes. 

The food and service was as expected for how busy the restaurant was.

Traditionally this event takes place on Memorial Day weekend. The event allows you to try traditional Greek food, listen to music from Greece, and mingle with Hundreds of people. 

I would highly recommend the gyros and the pork kabobs. Both come with Greek rice.  They also offer several types of Greek deserts. 

You can also take a tour of the Greek Orthodox Church. During the tour you are introduced into the church and Christianity. The church is very beautiful and full or wonderful paintings and stain glass windows. 

The parking for the event is about a block away, which isn't too terrible of a walk. They do provide shuttles for those who would prefer not to walk or have difficulty walking.

Arrived at 11:10 AM. One of the two individuals at the front door advised that there would be a twenty minute wait due to only having one waiter working.  Seems like it would make more sense to have one hostess and two waiters working.

Best Mexican food in NOLA. Have to rate this place 3 stars because of what I'm used to eating in Houston. Otherwise, a definite 4 stars. Great service and food.
Checked in with Yelp and got a free appetizer which we ordered spinach seafood dip (yummy) and dinner was excellent! Service was very friendly!

Walking in, it took a bit to be greeted and seated....and the restaurant had only about 10 people sitting. 

However, once we sat down, and handed menu's, I knew this was gonna be good. 

Janie had the Lasagna, which had spinach inside.....very good!  I had ravioli with a mushroom sauce and ravioli with veal an maranaria sauce....really good!! Thought I was back in Italy!! Definitely an authentic experience.

My new favorite Mexican Restaurant. We have searches the city far and wide to find comparable to what we are used to in Houston. 

Definitely try the white cheese Queso. Very good! We then tried the chicken fajitas. very good and spices to perfection. Best of all....the salsa, magnificio!!

Great service and no wait when we checked in.
Not crazy about the "smoky bar room" environment, but you won't find a better tasting hot roast beef po boy!  Great sandwich and the wait staff was friendly.
Finally! Another one of my favorites from Houston we've been missing here in NOLA.

Who says you have to have a white table cloth and fancy speaking waiters to be 5 stars?? This place is fantastic!! I could've stopped at the French onion soup, but I had the Eggs Sardou (poached eggs laid in the middle of artichokes on top of a bed of Creme spinach), Janie had the eggs Benedict. BOTH dishes were prepared with exquisite decadence and the taste, well, not the right words to say how good it was. Definitely a favorite. Looking forward to come back and see what the dinner menu is all about. This place is worth eery penny. Service, atmosphere and food very much earned 5 stars!! Bon appetite!
Daily lunch plates are above average. Atmosphere and wait staff are why I keep coming back. They treat you like family and the food is always prepared fresh and to your specs.

This would be by far the BEST Ribeye I've ever tasted. Great wait staff, great classic steakhouse ambiance, overall great experience. I would expect though, if your going to charge $11 for the crab cake appetizer (off the chart good) they would actually have at least 3 to share, not 1.  Dinner portions of sides are family style, so spread the choices with dinner. Appetizers, not so much.

What a great local breakfast spot! The omelets are bar far the best choice when eating at this classic diner. Show up early, but if you have to wait, it's worth it. This local tradition comes with plenty of history and Nawlins flair. The wait staff are very engaged in the foodie experience. You won't be disappointed an you definitely won't walk away feeling you didn't get a hearty and fulfilling breakfast.

Great place for lunch or quick supper. Local cuisine at its best with the NOLA style added to it. Cochon de lait (BBQ pulled pork) was very good and the wait staff was prompt an attentive. If your a tourist in town, definitely a place to experience. ENJOY!!
One of my favorite places for lunch. Until today, it's been a no brainier to order the classic hot roast beef sandwich. But I got the BBQ version today fully dressed. Wow!! Still very good!! Enjoy!

I like this place. A new twist on Mexican cuisine. The fish tacos were pretty good but the beef enchilada was very tasty. Both dishes were "spiced" in a non-traditional way. Definitely sample the sauces. The challenge will be the parking if you arrive during prime time. Definitely a place to come back to.
Not a bad thing lace to have a sit down lunch. Especially since the lunch specials include Saturday's.

Make no mistake about this "chain". The Carabaas Family knows how to prepare traditional Italian dishes with a flair of excellence. You can always make this place a fantastic place for an after work event, as well a great family sit down meal or business entertainment meetings. The one thing you will notice when you walk in, there is plenty of friendly and welcoming wait staff, which is probably the reason there wasn't any parking for diners. It's the ONLY reason I gave this location 3 stars. If I were to rate this place strictly on food, it would and always has rated a 4.5 stars!!

One of my favorite lunch spots in NOLA. The wait staff is friendly and know the menu, so if you're not sure what to order, ask them to help you. My favorite is the fish tacos and spaghetti. I'm trying the cheeseburger for the first time today, because it just looks delicious!!

I don't like to be the barrier of bad news, but opening late fine. We all have bad moments, oversleep, etc.. Being rude when you open, not giving me what I asked for, it's just an inadequate way to run a business.

This is my go-to place weekend mornings!! I only wish it had more room for big parties, I've had to to take most friends to other locations because of the size. The staff is super nice and always welcoming. I met my town friends in the place and that's all because of our love for Honeys!!


My only suggestion is they had these corn tortillas about two months ago filled with egg, cheese and bacon. I absolutely loved!!! It was the best breakfast ever! I took a picture to keep the memory!! To the owners of Honeys, PLEASE BRING THEM BACK!!!

First time here but don't know why I would ever not comeback again and again. Great staff and food is super flavorful!! DELICIOUS! The ambiance is pretty sweet and it's just open enough to have a good group here.

I really loved this place. I found it from the original restaurant week list earlier in the year. I went with some friends and we really enjoyed the food and drinks that it provided. The atmosphere is more of a mature crowd but it was still very nice and clean. I'm excited to come back when it's warm out. 

Our server gave us a treat because the wait was so long for the entree.

Where to start with this particular lunch experience. I really don't enjoy calling anyone out, however, Isaiah our waiter was HORRIBLE. He wasn't attentive. He was very slow. We had assistance from every other waitperson around our area except for him. We waited 15 minutes after we sat down just to receive water from him. 

The food was fine. I'm not a huge fan of cooking my own food that I pay for... Not the best idea ever. I can't fault them for the route they chose to run their restaurant. The service however really just magnified the entire experience. Please retrain him or just cut your losses. The two other guests I was with also agreed with this review.

Front Street is a very clean cafe. I enjoy the vibe they've tried to create inside and out. You think that it's only one level but realize there is an upstairs to look over the street. The food was very good, I ordered something that would have been hard to screw up. However, kudos for not screwing it up!! They didn't serve us water so I had to get my own water out of the fridge upstairs and that's mostly why I put 4 out of 5 stars. Also, my gf didn't enjoy their coffee. She's sort of a coffee snob....so I can't fault them there. I would absolutely come back and look forward to see how they operate in the warmer months.

I was lucky enough to be in the neighborhood when I ran into Tony. He invited me and three of my friends inside for a soft opening. The food was delicious!! We all ordered one thing from the "Large plates" part of the menu and there wasn't anything that I wouldn't have ordered again. Tony is a very caring guy and really takes ownership of his restaurant named after his son. I can't wait for it to finally open on the 16th! I will sure to make weekly or bi-weekly visits to stop in for a healthy, tasty, perfectly portioned meal. The service was great too! Bring your best wine and closest friends and Jaxon won't disappoint!

I finally got a chance to try out Bud & Marilyn's and it was delicious. It was a brunch meal that we enjoyed with a some fun morning drinks. The service was very fast and polite - all the staff checked in and helped to make sure plates were cleared and food was available. I enjoyed the layout of the restaurant and it feels like you can really have a great time with a group for some late night fun! The throw back feel is a wonderful reminder of what it felt like to hang out at my Auntie's house or my granny's house - which I loved. We had the GRILLED SKIRT STEAK RANCHEROS and CHILAQUILES VERDES - the Chilaquiles has a little kick to it, so careful of that! The grilled skirt steak rancheros was very very good, you could tell the steak was actually marinated before hand. I can't wait to go back and I'm even more excited to learn that it is owned by a female.

I would like to start this review by stating that I am a HUGE BRENT CELEK FAN! 

Now that I have covered my basis on that - its time to give my honest thoughts on my experience at Prime Stache. I want to say that maybe people should think of this location as more of a bar that offers food than a restaurant that happens to have a bar. The first sign of my displeasure would be, when I went to order the "fish of the day" they didn't have any fish available. Immediately after finding that out, one of the cocktails weren't available. I would like to preface this with saying that it was only 9 pm on a Saturday.... and I've never experienced a bar/restaurant running out of a drink or at least having been prepared to make something similar. The drink was a tequila based drink that offered some heat with it! ( I could have told you what it was if our menus weren't pulled within the first 15 mins of being there.)

I would like to follow with - the restaurant began to pick up some speed with the patrons that began to come in. The staff immediately asked to take our menus before we ordered our main dish, which I found strange. Do they not make enough menus to adequately cover each table? The menus are paper based - I'm sure it wouldn't be too much of an effort to print more to allow each table enough time to review and pick their meal. 

The meals weren't anything I would say that wowed me. I ordered the Edamame Ravoli and since there was no fish of the day - the cedar plank salmon. They did offer a special that was a steak and cauliflower mashed with pesto. I'm not a big steak eater and prefer to have fish over steak when available. I checked the menu before we arrived and was hoping to have more options on seafood for an entree. 

Finally, when leaving the server who had been good all along - wasn't very polite on our way out. 

Overall, I would say that I was disappointed with my experience. The staff all helped to keep things moving which I enjoyed. I just felt that the food display was sloppy and the price for the value doesn't match. If this was a bar with some great munchies - I would say that you get what you order. However, I feel as though they have a lot of potential and could really fine tune things to elevate its food quality, experience, and display to the level that it should be.

I really enjoyed Kensington Quarters. We weren't originally going to go here but there was a wait at another restaurant so we kept walking. I heard from multiple people that this place has great meat options. They didn't disappoint in that department!

We ordered a charcuterie with corn and that was very good. It had salami and was a nice appetizer to share. My main dish was the steak, of course. My girlfriend got the bbq chicken. The chicken dish does have a spice to it that she wasn't expecting. Be careful of that. 

The vegetables with the chicken was delicious. I would definitely go back and bring more people. The service was good and the outside seating was very welcoming.

Love and honey is a great place for a quick pick me up! The staff and overall service is really fantastic. It pains me to give them 3 stars. I grew up eating fried chicken, I've also had fried chicken at some surrounding restaurants in the city and nearby. 

I think if you're into having more of a real honey taste in your chicken - this is perfect. I found the chicken to be too sweet and not crunchy enough for me. The Mac and cheese was good but it was hard not to think I could have made it on my own. 

Again, this is a great place for all the right reasons in regards to service and staff. They have great packaging and I even enjoy the great lengths they go to provide great cage free chicken. 


Good place. Just not the best I've taste in fried chicken.

I think if you're into having more of a real honey taste in your chicken - this is perfect. I found the chicken to be too sweet and not crunchy enough for me. The Mac and cheese was good but it was hard not to think I could have made it on my own. 

Again, this is a great place for all the right reasons in regards to service and staff. They have great packaging and I even enjoy the great lengths they go to provide great cage free chicken. 


Good place. Just not the best I've taste in fried chicken.

Amazing Cake!! Amazing Service! 

It was a very smooth transition with the inquiry for a cake, the design process, the payment process, and even the picking up of the cake. The cake was ready for pick up at the time we discussed. The amount of detail they showed for my unicorn cake was phenomenal! I had everyone for the party asking me where I got my cake from. 

I look forward to using them for other events! I'm very happy I decided to go with Whipped Bakeshop. They have a very nice staff and even better baked goods!!

pPvsrGX78-vP6IctzU1-oQ.review_text: Delicious pizza. Thinner crust and fresh ingredients
Very tasty deep dish pizza. Cold beer. The house salad was good with just a little bit of dressing. Good spot.
Very tasty. I had the brisket tacos and want more. I think I have dinner and lunch plans for the next week. Thank you Taceaux Loceaux for coming into my life.

Edit to review below:
I went back to Magazine St. Barber Shop to give them another shot and this time I requested Cesar, the owner. His cut was better than Gideon and he was way more friendly. It was easy to keep light conversation going with Cesar. Gideon was around, but not cutting hair this time. Gideon joined in on some of our conversation and was pleasant. I wonder if he was in a better mood because was not cutting hair.   

Now that I have found Cesar, I will keep Magazine St. Barber Shop in my standard rotation. Great haircut with fun atmosphere (gawking at women passing on Magazine St). Cesar makes all the difference.  

=================================

I want to like this place but it is hard for me. My barber was Gideon and he was pretty rude. He started by snapping at me when I stepped on the step on his barber chair. Instead of telling me calmly not to step there he yelled WOAH WOAH WOAH. Come on man. Not a good way to start my maiden voyage with you guys. He was also curt to 2 other people who came in. One guy didn't have an appointment and was rudely turned away. He also was a jerk to the person who was after me. When Gideon asked if the guy had an appointment the next patron got up to come to the counter and Gideon said "Hold up man. No need to step to me. Getting all aggressive and stuff." The next patron was a little taken aback, but I could now tell Gideon was just a jerk for fun and this was par for the course. 

My haircut was nothing special. When I came in he asked what I wanted. A haircut I replied and showed him a picture of my last cut and how I wanted it. He laughed at me when I pulled out a picture. I thought I was helping him. I had to keep coming up with things to talk about so it would feel less awkward. When I asked to go shorter he said it would not work with my hair even though I showed him a picture of my hair cut shorter than he did it. I know this was his first time cutting my hair and all, but it is not my first time getting a haircut. I know what my hair can do and what my last barber did with no complaints.

I think I am going to give them one more shot. They have a Hispanic barber that looked way nicer. He kept the light conversation going with his customer the whole time.

My favorite Mexican food in NOLA so far.
Mediocre cheap steaks in a sub-par environment.
Tasty burger with a great mayo bar. Roasted garlic, chipotle and basil mayos and homemade sweet pickled jalapeños available on the may bar.

I had the brisket, mac n cheese and cole slaw. The brisket and slaw were great, but mac was mealy and nothing special. Another patron raved about the mac, so I gave it a shot. I was disappointed. I did really like the Twelve Mile Limit cocktail. It was delicious and refreshing. Insider tip: get the 12 Mi Limit in a mason jar instead of the martini glass. It is way easier to drink and more fun. Everything tastes better out of a mason jar. They also have a High Life (draft in frozen goblet) and a shot of Jameson for $6. Hipster steal.

Small taco stand set up in front of Home Depot. They have great authentic taco options. Good street food for $5. Ask for one of the roasted jalapeños and some of their fresh salsa. You will not be disappointed. 

You can find them in front of the Home Depot at 500 N. Carrollton Ave. from 9:AM. to 3:PM. on most days before they redeploy about a mile away to the 100-block of S. Broad Street, where they stay until about 9:PM.
Amazing hamburger. This is probably the bast burger I have had in my life.
Okay hamburger. I went opening week. They might get better. I liked the cajun fries and the person I went with got a shake and she liked it.
I had the Polish Sampler and a cheap beer from the bar it was fantastic. I highly recommend this place
Delicious. You have to try the buffalo shrimp po boy with blue cheese. It is fantastic.
Solid Greek and Lebanese food. They also deliver which is a huge plus.

Great barber shop experience. I was greeted with a cold beer. Had a great cut from Sherie. The environment is relaxed and friendly. They have off-street parking which makes it easy to get in and out. The price was average for a good haircut in NOLA: $35. I will defiantly be back. Sorry "other guy".

LOTS of decent food. 

Huge serving size, but the food is nothing to write home about... except for the egg roll. It was super flaky and tasty. The wrapper was more like a spring roll.
Pretty good tacos. Not my fave in the city. Just a note - no free chips and salsa.
Great food and a clothing optional pool and hot tub. What more could you want?

My new favorite sushi spot in NOLA. Everything was fresh, staff was awesome and Steve Nguyen's passion for detail really shows when you taste the sushi. He made me a Funky Margarita with spicy tuna and it was stupendous. Fresh homemade guacamole and perfect fish set this roll above the rest

I went here for the Polish food from Kukhnya -- I got the Polish Sampler and it was delicious. I sat at the bar and had a great chat with a dude that ended up being the DJ that was performing that night. I didn't see the DJ Pasta show but am planning to head back tonight for some Pasta and cheap drinks.

Not good :/
Bad service. I had Thai (roast pork lunch) and the meat was bland but doused in a brown saccharin sauce. The best part was the white rice. My friend got a crawfish omelette - not good. The waffle was okay but that is hard to mess up
Good burrito make line. Get the quesadilla. It is basically a burrito with cheese on the inside of the tortilla. Not like a custimary quessadilla.
Delicious shrimp po' boys. Can't wait to try the bun and chicken. I am just a shrimp po' boy lover so it is hard for me to pull myself away.
Solid poboys +0. Free samples +1. Open 24/7 +2!
I am never impressed. I've tried the beef shawarma and the gyro. Both are so-so at best. The pita is frequently stale

I've been twice and tried 4 sandwiches. The sandwiches are pretty good but definitely overpriced. 

Plus, I can't believe the owner's responses to peoples' Yelp reviews. He needs to get a grip and work on his public persona. Horrible online responses will only help drive a restaurant into the ground.

Fan.Tas.Tic. 

Homemade chips. Great salsa. Delicious sauces on enchiladas. Tasty margaritas. 

I had the Cilantro Enchiladas. The sauce was mild and creamy. The chicken was moist and delicious. My lady had the Chicken Enchiladas and loved them. She is from Texas and has been looking for good Tex-Mex in New Orleans and we are super excited to find it. 

This is my new favorite Mexican in NOLA.
My favorite coffee shop Uptown New Orleans. The brews are great, wonderful vibe, and great staff.

Fantastic
Chris does an amazing haircut. I would put his cut up against some of the most expensive cuts in town yet he delivers at a fraction of the price. I now have a new favorite barbershop. I used his website to book my appointment.
The food is mediocre and they do not answer the phone for a call in order.

pcuCZ0RTYa4PUN0jrcHi8g.review_text: Some food are way too salty and spicy, it just numbs your tongue, and they could definitely do better on their services.
Such a cute Popsicle place! Lots of options including dairy and non-dairy, and so many different flavor. Nice desert spot after some tacos :)
Yummm tacos! The tacos are decent size, the fish taco and mango salsa are such a great combo, will definitely try the burrito next time!

The portion of the meal is great, I had the large dark chicken and I've got the 2 thighs and legs serving on top of the bread, mac n cheese and potato salad for the side, all of them are amazing. I order my chicken medium heat level and it wasn't spicy enough for me, I could have gone to hot or even damn hot if you want to sweat a bit.  The chicken skin is very crispy yet the meat is tender.  If you don't mind the wait, this is a great spot for some cheap and delicious eats!

What can I say, they have amazing food here! You get the experience of eating the whole fish and the flavor was very unique and tasty. Only downside it's that you'll have to be patient, they take their time in making the food.

This is the place to go if you're not in the mood for country music. They were playing indie music when I went here, the guys did a great job performing. I heard from the waitress that the first show is free, and second show charge a cover on weekdays, the cover is cheap anyways. The food is decent, it was a good experience overall.

Really awesome place to smoke some hookah, the service I received was immediate and excellent. I love being able to sit outside, so you can smoke hookah and people watching, how chill is that?! FYI there's a bottle opening fee for those that byob. Highly suggested if you want a hookah bar that's more relax for conversations.
Amazing singers, I actually prefer this place than the ones on Broadway. The songs they played have a wide variety. I love how everyone was sitting in circles, It really feels like one big family.

Make your way there if you want to taste a bit of every southern food! Everything is delicious and you will leave with a full belly of food! You will make tons of new friends on the dinning table too. Really awesome concept of combing groups so it really feels like eating at home during holidays.
Delicious and affordable! Services are prompted, the beef stew noodle soup was really good!

The best cheesesteak I've had in Philly! The portion is huge, so you can make two amazing meal out of it. I had to mention how wonderfully they wrap the cheesesteak that keeps it warm for a while for the to-go's. The staffs are also really friendly!

The best cheesesteak I've had in Philly! The portion is huge, so you can make two amazing meal out of it. I had to mention how wonderfully they wrap the cheesesteak that keeps it warm for a while for the to-go's. The staffs are also really friendly!

Very interesting place. This restaurant is tiny, only fits several tables but the atmosphere is cozy. I also like how they have toys all over the place, makes you feel like a big kid. I had the Portuguese black dawg and it was unique so if you like international and American food you'll love here. Had to wait in the cold for 40 min, so get here early to avoid the wait.

Surprisingly pleasant found! I love dim sum and had authentic dim sum before, so I'm usually pretty skeptical about the creative cuisine. This place definitely changed my mind, it's delicious! I had the turnip cake and pac man bao, the turnip cake was my favorite. The portion was just about right, but the prices compare to traditional dim sum is a bit higher.

Great lunch spot right next to Shoprite, feels like this place is a bit underrated. Very spacious and comfortable environment, lunch special is super affordable and delicious.  I had the Green Curry with Beef and the sauce was so good with rice! The lunch special also come with miso soup or salad, great deal for 7 dollars! Seems like they have a wider variety of Asian cuisine: Chinese, Japanese, Thai... Highly recommend it.

Gotta love to have bubble tea and Asian snacks in the west philly neighborhood! Service is excellent, food is fresh made and the milk tea is on point. They have lots of options on drinks, you should be able to find something you like. Not to mention the lulu icon on the cups are so cute.

The food is indeed on point here. We were able to be seated immediately since my 2 visits. They also take reservations if you have a larger group. BYOB option is a plus, they also offer orange juice and blood Mary pitcher for making your own mimosas and Bloody Mary. It is convenient just a few blocks off Washington ave, plenty of street parking option around the neighborhood if you're tired of paying meters in center city. The clucker of course is everyone's favorite, sweet and savory at the same time. I also had the Philly cheesesteak omelette, it is also amazing. Highly recommend On Point Bistro.

Very diverse type of hot dogs, ranging from the regular beef sausages to the more adventurous options like kangaroo and python sausages. It's one of the best happy hour place in philly, can't beat 3 dollar beer and wine.

Biang biang noodle with beef and lamb was so bland, definitely what we expected. Food was ordered via ubereats, the noodle arrived with a container of soup that barely had any flavors and it came with around 5 piece of meat. Do not ordered the biang biang noodle with beef and lamb, it's not worth it. Cumin beef hamburger was not too bad, a little on the dry side. Overall, it's a pretty disappointing compare to the authentic xi'an cuisine.

Amazing food and good value for what you pay for. Very decent amount of food, I have leftovers for both of my two visits here. The dolsot bibimbap is really good. Perfect ambience for conversations, it's not too loud and the music is on point. Definitely will come back to try more dishes!

Very mediocre coffee shop. I would take my money elsewhere if it wasn't because it's within 2 blocks away from me. My only good experience with the drinks are their smoothies, coffee and latte is very plain, nothing special. I felt that it's ridiculous that they charge me almost a dollar extra when I ordered a ice drink instead of the hot drink. Does ice cost that much extra? I could get tap water for free and ice is made from tap water so I don't understand the extra charge at all. From what I can tell, their menu seems to be higher than most places nearby. Sorry I'm afraid I won't return again. There are much better coffee shops out there that won't charge me with outrageous fees.

The mural arts on the wall made me really excited for trying the drinks here because I was expecting their tea is that good too. But I had the white peach oolong milk tea and it was disappointingly bland. I couldn't taste any tea flavor, seems to be water down. Also a bigger size straw is needed, it was really hard to drink the tea because the boba gets stuck in the middle of the straw so often.

This is my favorite restaurant restaurant in west philly. Get any sandwiches in maroosh way, you won't regret it. My new favorite is the lamb shawarma maroosh, the lamb is so flavorful and tender, the bread is perfectly toasted, and they stack so much ingredients in the sandwich. The pickles in the sandwich makes it so appetizing! The portion is huge, I usually could only eat half and save the other for the next day.

Service is quiet slow here, seems like they are understaffed/overwhelm. By the time our food arrived, it felt barely warm. Feels like it was sitting on the counter for a bit. However the portion is huge, I'm assuming if the food was served hot it'll taste a lot better. When we request to have some to go boxes they didn't gave us any bags despite we have 3 boxes to go. Didn't leave a pen for the check either.

Very authentic and delicious Szechuan food in the neighborhood. The portion is big and their menu has so much options. It's my favorite take out spot when we don't feel like cooking because I know that you can't go wrong with them.

New ownership, so I went back to give it a try. Best pho in west philly so far, it's comparable to our favorites on washington ave. Broth is so hot and flavorful, also comes with plenty of meat and noodles. A big bowl of yumminess that warms your heart while you're dining out on this cool days. 

Also try their vermicelli noodles, if you're a first timer try their deluxe because it comes with a variety of meat and spring roll. Spring roll is so crispy and fresh. 

Last but not least, they gives your that free coconut dessert at the end, it's so refreshing not filling at all after you had a bowl of pho. I just love this place, outdoor space is darn cute with plants. They also do a good job at social distancing while dining on site.  Give this place a try if you're in the neighborhood!

piIljcy0fhEW6IhB1eyrFA.review_text: So, I walked in and was greeted warmly. I asked for a recommendation and was told all of the empanadas were good. So, I ordered a dozen with various fillings. Lemme tell you, I was far from disappointed. The pastry was light and flaky. The fillings were rich and flavorful. There were several vegetarian options as well. I already can't wait to go baby!!

This restaurant has so much going for it. First of all, they have been serving St. Louis for a couple of generations now. They have preserved the old steakhouse feel. The service was top notch with food to match. It's unusual for me to visit a steakhouse and not eat steak but I enjoyed a beautiful white fish in a delicious white wine sauce. If it had been socially acceptable to lick my plate, I would have done so!!! My companion enjoyed the prime rib which was enough for two or at least a good amount of leftovers for the next day.

Just ok. There's so much competition in Clayton as far as steakhouses go. I've visited twice and feel the bar was missed both times. An over dressed salad and an over cooked steak left me underwhelmed. The staff was reasonably friendly but not overly attentive. Plenty of places to spend your money that are actually making the mark.

Let me just tell you, please come hungry!!! The food is hearty and filling. The seasonal cheese board for fall has just about everything you would need to make a well rounded board. As far as entree's go, I've had just about everything and have yet to be disappointed. And if you only have time to pop in for happy hour, the cocktail list is whoa!! Amazing!!!

When you need something different and familiar at the same time this is your spot! We ordered several things on the menu to share and the flavors were comforting and absolutely delicious. Several options for a vegetarian as well.

The Elmwood is totally unassuming from the outside. Inside the restaurant the staff is working hard for a first rate experience. We were a group of six and ordered just about everything. Flavors were given careful consideration and played well in the dishes. I'm looking forward to visiting again soon.

I have just a two words for this gem: tater tots!!!! These are hands down the best I've ever had in my life. I've visited for brunch and dinner and never leave disappointed or hungry. The team always has a solid recommendation on the off chance you can't decide. A full bar menu makes this a must dine for brunch.

The hospitality is what made this restaurant for me. We were a small group but ordered most of the appetizers and 4 entrees to share. The food was flavorful and comforting. I recommend the cookies for dessert. They are traditional and not your typical restaurant cookie.

OMG!!!! Flavor on flavor on flavor. We ordered three trays and I honestly can't decide which ones I loved more. What I can say is the attention to detail with the flavors has left no spice unturned. We were next door at Narwhals and you can order nachos to be delivered to your table. Definitely a must do!!

Delicious and quite possibly something for just about everyone. I appreciate seasonal flavors and usually try to order what's in season. I had an amazing apple pie ice cream with salted caramel. The pumpkin spice was not to be out done. Both were delicious and perfect representations of autumn.

I've never been here when there wasn't a line. That alone speaks volumes about the cookies at Grandma's. The aroma wafts out the door while waiting in line. I've had just about every cookie here, but honestly my favorite is the peanut butter. I'm not sure what they do but man...... definitely worth a visit. I'd also recommend buying more than you think you need. No point in waiting in line twice.

Quaint spot perfect for lunch. I appreciate a diverse yet well done lunch menu. Magpie's offers just enough to appeal to multiple tastes without losing quality and taste that comes when a place over extends themselves. The quiche was phenomenal, a definite recommend. Their patio is the perfect place to enjoy a cozy lunch.

This is my second favorite sushi spot in STL. Someone in charge knows exactly what they are doing. I spent several years living in Japan so I know how things are supposed to be. My go to is the guydon bento for lunch. They get the beef onions and sauce 100% right. A place that can do the lesser known dishes and do them well is a definite winner in my book.

I absolutely love this place. The staff is friendly and wonderfully helpful. I don't even know where to start with the sweets and treats. I'm told one of the proprietors is from Germany. My grandmother was German and one of her signature desserts was a cherry coffee cake. My grandmother has since passed on, but the coffee cake here is exactly like (if not just a smidge better) than hers. I've had so many things here it's hard to pick just one thing when I visit. I highly recommend the quiche. The pastry is rich and flaky and the egg filling is super light and just yum. I have the quiche there and get a to go box of treats to take home!

Comfort greasy spoon at its finest. A seat at the counter is definitely the best seat in the house. The servers were attentive and friendly (my coffee cup was never empty).  I had fried chicken and waffles. After a night on the town, this was the perfect breakfast to get me back out and into the action. A bit off the beaten path but well worth the trip.

Clementines is a perfect spot to visit if you're in need of some fantastic ice cream. The flavors are unique and flavorful as are the options for toppings (candied bacon anyone??!) Sometimes I'm looking for a little something extra and the naughty flavors completely hit the spot. The summer I enjoyed a champagne sorbet that I'm hoping will extend into the fall and winter. Clementines offers something for every taste.

Every visit to Russell's is always an experience. The hospitality of the staff is warm and welcoming. Followed second by their amazing dessert case. Truth be told, I pick out my dessert before I've decided what to have for dinner. The food is thoughtful and well executed. I've been visiting for several years now and every meal has been a hit. The cocktail list is just as amazing. Their patio is perfect for dining summer through fall.

Highly recommend!!! Thank you for your support of front line workers!!! As a critical care nurse I haven't missed a day of work since the pandemic began. The same cannot be said for our friends in the restaurant industry. I was offered dinner but instead chose to support the team at Tempus. The food was amazing and full of flavor. I had scallops with coconut and lemongrass which was light and delicious. I am looking forward to visiting them again soon.

I've visited Frothy Monkey on several occasions and have always enjoyed my experience. Their breakfast fare is traditional and well executed. I prefer lunch and dinner because my palate requires a little something extra. I always find something that fits the bill.

Our server was an absolute delight. Friendly but not hovering. She gave good recommendations and took excellent care of us. The food was so full of flavor. We went with the arepa, the flavor was perfect. We also tried the French toast with cranberry compote that was perfect flavor profile for fall. We are already looking to visit again.

Any time I venture south in places where sweet tea is the local drink of choice, I know I'm about to eat good!! The Loveless is homey and the team is so hospitable and friendly. We had a variety of different things to eat during our visit and enjoyed them all. My favorite was the hot chicken sandwich . Paired with a side of mac and cheese and collard greens made for one happy and satisfied girl. I'm looking forward to visiting again soon.

Absolutely delicious. I've spent time in Korea and Japan and really appreciate when a restaurant can do any Asian food justice. The food here was done right and it was done well. All of the elements were exactly where they were meant to be. Attention to detail is really what makes this place such a gem.

I spent several years living in Japan and have come to appreciate all of the time and effort it takes to make really good ramen. I've tried several places and they have all just kinda fallen flat and so I didn't have the highest of expectations for this one. Well, I was impressed and satisfied with my meal. The noodles were dense but tender and the bowls were brimming with traditional ingredients. This is probably one of the better ramens I've had without needing a plane ticket.

After living in Japan for over three years, I am incredibly particular about my ramen . The entire dish is considered an art form. The time and effort it takes to prepare the perfect broth. To making the perfect density and texture of noodles. Nudo House has it down almost perfect. My go-to is the curry ramen with tempura chicken. The broth is rich and creamy and garlicky. The noodles are chewy and filling. Makes you almost want to lick the bowl clean .

I love this spot. The Maryland Heights location is completely unassuming. We picked up takeout at a friends recommendation. We were not disappointed. We have a vegetarian in our house which can be challenging when dining out. There was something for all of us. I enjoyed a hearty bowl of noodles with flavorful beef. The only note I would like to add is to order extra spring rolls. You get one with your meal, but let's be completely honest here who ever only eats one?!?!

Twisted Tree steakhouse is definitely worth the visit. Completely unassuming from the outside, the restaurant is sizable and trendy. The food is exceptional and my favorite thing to order is anything with a side of onion rings. Truth be told, I've sometimes just stopped in for dessert. The wedding cake is the best dessert cake I've had anywhere. It is honestly reminiscent of wedding cake I've had in my life.

BBQ places can be tough to judge. Sometimes the meats are a standout and the sides fall completely flat. Well, at Salt + Smoke, be prepared to be wowed by both. I had a combo plate with chicken and ribs. The chicken was flavorful and juicy, the ribs were fall off the bone tender. For my sides, I went with the mac and cheese and cole slaw. We also tried the deviled eggs and hush puppies. Everything was delicious and very well executed. The cocktail menu was also versatile with plenty of options for everyone.

This was my first visit to Grbic and experience with food from the Balkan region. The most notable of the experience was the sincere and genuine hospitality. I felt like we'd gone to a friends house for dinner. We had a group of six people and we tried just about every dish on the menu. The flavors were exciting and comforting at the same time. If you're looking for authentic comfort food outside of the traditional American fare, definitely worth a trip.

Our server Jordan was just fantastic. She was knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. My favorite things at Napoli are the arancini which is rich and cheesy and crispy in a rich marinara sauce. My second favorite dish is the Stack Salad which is a delightful spin on a caprese salad. There is fried eggplant, local tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, basil, and balsamic drizzle. The salad is simple and incredibly well done. It wasn't on the lunch menu, but the kitchen was happy to make three of them for me and my friends.

We just love visiting The Barn. The staff is always warm and friendly. There are two draws for us: everything is homemade and the cocktail menu is incredible. I usually go with the quiche of the day and have yet to be disappointed. I also always take home a dessert or pastry for later.

OMG!!!! I planned a birthday trip to NOLA culminating with a visit to Commander's. First of all, the hospitality was five star. I was greeted warmly and ushered to the bar to grab a drink while I waited for my table. The food exceeded every expectation. The most memorable part of the experience was a table visit from Lally Brennan. I cannot wait to visit the city again, and when I do Commander's Palace will be at the top of the list!!

Willa Jean is a must visit for me every time I go to NOLA. It's a little off the beaten path being outside of the French Quarter but well worth venturing out. I ordered bbq shrimp for breakfast with a side of toast. The toast is required for sopping up every last bit of sauce in your bowl. Last time I tried licking the bowl and got a few strange looks from other patrons.

Please come hungry!!!! Every time I've been in I've never been disappointed. The mimosas are perfect and I can never seem to order just one. My go to are the eggs Benedict's served on soft fluffy biscuits. The portions are generous and filling.

This will be the most memorable meal during my last visit to NOLA. Every part of my meal was exceptional. The dish I still savor was called the chocolate bomb. I don't see it on the current dessert menu and hope it's just an oversight on my part. This was the most delightful dessert I've ever eaten. The whipped cream was salted caramel and it caught me totally by surprise. I scraped it off of my dessert and savored it all by itself it was that good.
All you need to answer is half or whole. I only got a half and devoured every single bite. Then I sat there wishing I'd ordered the whole!!!!
Bring cash!!! Yes, there as good as you've heard. Yes, you will get powdered sugar all over yourself. I visit at least twice every time I visit the city.

If there's a line, don't let that scare you off. These oysters are the real deal and definitely worth the wait. The staff was prompt and friendly. I did a dozen chargrilled oysters and enjoyed every bite. Definitely on my list for my next visit.

I came in for a cooking class to learn how to make a few traditional dishes. The chef teaching the class was knowledgeable and friendly. The best part was that I was able to replicate everything after I got home. Definitely worth the visit to be able to make some of my favorites at home.

I must preface this post by saying I've lived in Hawaii for five years and Japan for three and a half years. The flavors of these regions are synonymous with comfort and home for me. Yellowbelly hit every single note from my time in both places. The vibe is low key and fun. Our server Caroline was attentive and endorsed all of our decisions. We decided to try a bit of everything and were not disappointed in the least. My personal favorite were the Nashville hot oysters and the coconut shrimp. The shrimp were juicy and sweet. They are finished with a sprinkle of chili salt . The frozen cocktails were divine (the pina coloada packs a rum punch). I'm already looking for an excuse to go back!!

I came in for breakfast and enjoyed myself tremendously. The food was served buffet style and there was a perfect selection to choose from. I'm particular about eggs especially on a buffet but these scrambled eggs were fluffy and perfect. The rosemary potatoes are worth a spot on your plate. My favorite was the smoked salmon. I could have eaten just that and been completely happy! The best part of my visit was my server Aida! She was so friendly and welcoming. She attended to my every need and took excellent care of me. I'm looking forward to coming back for dinner very soon.

I am always looking for a little something different when I go out for breakfast. Egg St. Louis egg-ceeded (see what I did there?!?!) my expectations. The space is cozy and warm and if that isn't enough for you there's a full cocktail menu to warm you right up! We tried several offerings. I had a cornbread eggs Benedict with pork belly and fried potatoes. I have to say, the hollandaise sauce was the stand out for me. The food was delicious and the portions were filling, but I found myself scraping up every bit of that sauce!!!

Well, to be honest the food was just ok. And to be even more honest, we only ate dinner so we could get dessert. The staff was warm and friendly. Sam, our server was helpful and kind. We had hot chocolate, a chocolate covered cherry martini, and three ice cream  sundaes. The best part was the pretzel ice cream cone. Definitely recommend a visit for cocktails, the selection is fantastic. The ice cream is good quality and definitely worth the money and calories.

I remember going to The Parkmoor in Clayton with my mom as a kid. I'm a sucker for nostalgia and my visit here took me back. Katie is so friendly and took excellent care of us. We tried the buffalo chicken toasted ravioli. Red hot ripplet seasoning is my kryptonite! I enjoyed super grilled cheese sandwich with onion rings. The rings were crispy and the best beer batter. The grilled cheese was phenomenal. It comes with caramelized onions which elevated a grilled cheese sandwich to next level. Not to mention the pimento cheese!!! We enjoyed boozy sno cones  in a variety of flavors. Hands down definitely a must visit from the friendliness of the team to the delicious food and the dose of childhood nostalgia. 
p.s. try the cheese sauce with your fries!!

I'm always game for a good brunch place. This one is just across the River in Edwardsville. Our server Kelsey seemed to be the only one working the floor waiting tables and running food. She was friendly and took her time with us even though things were busy. Our first round of cocktails missed the mark. The coffee drinks could use another look. The mimosas were perfect. We tried a variety of things that were tasty but otherwise unremarkable. The home fries should have a crisp exterior and a creamy soft center. They weee kinda soft and soggy. The cinnamon bear biscuits were another story!! Light and flavorful reminiscent of a Hardee's cinnamon raisin biscuit sans the icing. This place was definitely something different to try at least once.

ppl2TnSwu7SIt2r94-LoDA.review_text: I used to live in Kirkwood and this was one of my favorite spots to squeeze- and I do mean squeeze- into. It doesn't have a lot of space, but it's worth elbowing other eaters out of the way. The fish sandwiches are crispy and the rootbeer in the chilled mugs is classic. Greasy spoon, here I come!

When I was in school in Chicago and would come back to St. Louis on my breaks, Helen's was one of the top spots I needed to go while I was home. I still love it there, and go back all the time for their awesome wings- they're hot but not in a wicked kind of way and they are nice and crispy even though they're doused in sauce. The bar is fun too although sometimes it can be tough to get decent service and it gets super smoky by the end of the night. Happy Hour specials aren't too shabby though, and they serve appetizers for free. Be prepared to show up early, because the appetizers are a free-for-all so you have to use some muscle to get them.

Growlers has an insane collection of beers (you can make a game out of trying them all) and their cocktails are good too. I love the atmosphere and the people. My friends and I have made Growlers our escape when Helen Fitzgerald's (right down the road) gets too crowded or loud on weeknights.

I live right by Fritz's which is incredibly dangerous. They have so many options on the menu it's intimidating and totally delicious. A little pricey but worth it. 
 It gets really busy after dinner, but you can walk up anytime during the day and not have a line to wait in. They also sometimes have cool events like a car hop and music.

I've only been here once, so I'm reviewing based on limited experience. I was told by friends that they had mixed reviews, so I was surprised by how much I liked the place. The food was tasty (the shrimp po' boy was the size of my head) and we were really happy with the wait staff. I'd be happy to go again, especially for drinks. For those of us who can never think of the cocktail name for what we want, they have a cocktail list on the table. Love that.

I'm a sucker for old-fashioned stuff, so a soda fountain appeals to my corny needs. The food is pretty good and I like that they serve breakfast all day. Sadly, service is pretty slow. I'd give it more stars if it weren't for that. But I've had consistently slow service all of the times I've been there since my first review. The soda-fountain stuff is pretty good and they have a nice turkey burger. Another perk- they offer tater tots as a side.

Someone at work recommended this restaurant to myself and two other coworkers, so we stopped in to grab lunch. First we asked if we could order something to takeout. They seemed confused, said "sure" but then didn't give us any menus. So we decided we might get better service if we sat down. Service was ultra slow, though we had mercy on our waitress since she claimed to be new. 
 Sadly, food was mediocre at best. I give credit for the homemade tortillas which were good. However, my empanada was the only decent thing on my plate and it wasn't fantastic- the enchiladas and everything else were pretty much tasteless.

I went here for an early lunch during the workday with a friend. A few great things happened...
1) No line whatsoever. No waiting, nothing. I love that.
2) The crepes were delicious- I got the bacon, carmelized onion one- and they were presented nicely. I'm a sucker for aesthetic value.
3) They had creme soda. Maybe no one else cares, but I do. Very much so.
4) I smelled like bacon for the rest of the day. Which probably isn't actually a good thing, but it drove my coworkers nuts so I give it a point for comic relief.

It's got a bit of a funky smell, but don't let that scare you. This place is a treasure trove of goodies. I spent a lot of time in the Netherlands as a kid, so I'm always looking for the treats I loved back then.. and VOILA! They have them at Global Foods. That's a beautiful thing.
Awesome atmosphere and great sandwiches. Plus, there's always a lot of men in uniform eating there, so the view is nice too ;)
The shots are awesome, just try to hit this bar before the others... you don't want to try and read all the shots when you're already feeling fuzzy.

I can't say much that people haven't already said. Great lunch special prices and the food is delicious. The chicken chimichanga is flavorful and has that great queso on it. When my coworkers and I go, no one orders it but me and then everyone stares at my plate when it arrives. I think they feel cheated. They should.
Crazy fresh ingredients and just plain delicious. The tempura shrimp tacos were so good I barely chewed. My date was horrified. But I was happy.
Great spiked cider! I could drink that stuff all day... ok maybe not all day, I'd be sleeping under the table in no time. But it's incredible stuff.

I've eaten there twice now and was even more happy with my food the second time. Delicious french toast with some kind of heavenly maple creamcheesiness thing on top that I could have eaten straight from the container. If it comes in a container. Or a vat.... ok, refocus. Delicious cheesy potatos and a great, super rich Benton Park Mocha. Yum and a half.

I've had great BBQ here and the most delicious, drool-worthy, now-I-can-die-happy Bacon Chocolate Bread Pudding. Yes sir. 
Only point taken away is because of limited seating. If there's even half a crowd, there's nowhere to sit which is a problem when you're trying to tackle some BBQ.
Fabulous sushi! And, if you get enough, it comes on a miniature boat. That's all there is to say about that.

I hate giving poor reviews, but the boyfriend and I had a terrible experience here, so it's due. 
Staff was not particularly friendly and appeared inconvenienced by our presence. Only a handful of people were in the restaurant and they "apologized" for slow service because of the number of customers... probably totaling less than a dozen. 
Next up, the waiter acted like we were stupid when we asked for some clarification about menu items. He literally pounded on our table at one point. Yikes!

And last, the food was awful. I ordered fried green tomatoes to share and they were mostly red and mushy of course, since the coating wouldn't stick to the soft tomato. 
I was really excited about the lobster corndogs and those were completely tasteless.
Only plus- the sauces were good.

Lovely place! And nothing but pie! The employees were incredibly nice & helpful. The pies are delicious. And sized for one... So no one needs to know that you bought two and ate one on the way home...
I love this place. Ultra cute and delicious savory muffins! Haven't met a treat I didn't like so far.

Stellar patio space. It looks like some kind of urban oasis, complete with fountain and everything. You can bring food in, which is extra convenient. Inside is laid back. I'd be more thrilled if it were non-smoking, but that's my problem more than it is theirs.

Definitely my favorite gooey butter cakes. I like that the consistency isn't the grainy, sugary kind that many places have. It is almost coffee cake/cheesecake-like instead and totally delicious. Yum!
Lovely coffee. Interesting space. Very modern and clean decor.
Incredibly friendly service and just plain old awesome bbq. So glad to welcome this to the neighborhood! A great addition!
I like a place with a ton of burger-meat options. And boozy shakes? Sold!

I enjoyed the atmosphere and the drinks but wasn't overly thrilled with service or my entree. Lots of shell pieces in my seafood linguine and over 30 minutes late to seat us for our reservation. Willing to try again, mostly because the appetizers we ordered were delicious.

So I realize that it sounds stupid to go to a burger place and order a veggie burger... But the Mean Green was probably one of the most unique and delicious veg burgers I've ever had! And we got to eat next door in the adjoining bar which is a cool little soccer-centric place. I dig it.

I love this place. The food is amazing, the decor is manly, and the drinks are great. I ordered the Cock-a-Leekie Supper (and wanted to giggle like a total child) and it was delicious. Burned the hell out of my mouth on that puff pastry top, which is a good sign; couldn't even resist waiting for it to cool off.

Love this new place in the neighborhood! Excellent gyros, and baklava worth fighting over. I say that because of the squabble that took place between the bf and I over the last few bites. Totally worth a minor fork stabbing. Service is always excellent, friendly, and fast. Winner!
This bar has great drinks & atmosphere. It's a really nice addition to Cherokee Street!

Such a great new pizza place! My friend and I sought refuge here during the Let Them Eat Art event and were so smitten! Staff was wonderful, helpful, and the pizza was brilliant. So tasty. The drinks were delicious too. Yay!

I've given this place a couple of tries and had mixed experiences and therefore a mixed review. The first time, the bartender was really nice and friendly. Kind of a weirdly wide-open space inside which I don't love. The second time, bartender was pretty unfriendly and the food mediocre. We were essentially ignored for quite some time despite there being almost no other customers around. Disappointing! We moved on down the road to a friendlier bar.

I really enjoyed both the atmosphere and the food. We ordered 1/2 a breadbasket (of which I would be happy eating just that bread array all day every day), chicken and waffles, smothered frog legs, and deviled eggs. We were completely happy with everything! Left feeling like I had exactly the quantity of food I needed, at excellent quality.

This was an incredibly awkward meal! Like at least one other reviewer experienced, when we ate here we were the only customers in the entire place. It was a weekend evening, prime dinner hours. This bizarre deserted restaurant beginning should have been fair warning. The bartender/server/host/jack of all trades was very nice. However, our drinks and food were miserable. The calamari was rubbery and inedible. My pasta was lackluster and the boyfriend's food, nearly inedible. We were terribly disappointed!

I really enjoyed almost everything about the dinner I had here. The atmosphere is super pleasant and interesting. We loved our chicken, greens, and banana pudding for dessert. My only reservation is that the sides were a teensy bit on the small side. I'm all about not wasting food with ridiculously enormous portions, so it really didn't bother me that much... except that I could have eaten more... so maybe they saved me from myself.

Perfectly sized (i.e. Not enormous) coffee and delicious baked goods. Being surrounded by the smell of baking bread sure doesn't hurt either. I really like the space, the outdoor seating, and the service as well. Hooray Companion!

My family and I started eating at Beyond Bread when I first attended UofA in '98. It has to say something that 14 years later (eek!), we hit up Beyond Bread every. single. time. we're in Tucson. It's understood amongst my parents and sister that if any one of us is in Tucson or will be passing by on the I-10, they must call to obtain our bread order. Since we always stop at Beyond Bread right before heading home, this newer location at Ina and Oracle is our default.

So I obviously I think the bread is amazing. I have at least a couple loaves in my freezer at all times. I buy it sliced, keep it in zip-loc freezer bags, and pop it in the toaster or microwave as needed. I love trying out the special flavors of the day, but my go-to loaf is the multigrain. My dad lives for their rustic loaf, and my husband must always have the garlic italian for his sandwiches. If it's available, get the ancho chile loaf. It's tastes like a spicy cheez-it and goes great with avocado.

Beyond Bread also has the best whole wheat pitas I've ever tasted. I'm so glad they finally started selling them direct. And unlike the pita bread at Trader Joe's, it can sit on the counter a few days without going moldy.

Finally, let's discuss their banana bread. No other banana bread even comes close to their heavenly loaf. It's loaded with chunks of cream cheese (I don't know how they manage to bake those in without the cream cheese melting) and chocolate chips, and it's topped with an awesome cinnamon streusel. Every cliche about amazing food fits the description of their banana bread. If you don't like it, you're either allergic to bananas or too joyless to live (I stole that from Frank Bruni).
