Overall this place is 4 1/2 stars. Our wait wasn't  bad at all since we beat the crowds. All this and a margarita for $34.

Decent spot for UA students and fam to grab a bite. It's slow service despite the number of helpers they have. So clearly the kitchen was or is short staffed. All we had was salad and an appetizer each. 

Overall this place is a solid 3 stars and the foodie matches to that rating... nothing mouthwatering "gotta have it" but still good good. Vibe is most enjoyable and I can see how the place is packed with students.

 Lots of TVs for game watching and good music so for that I def give them a thumbs up and  a 1/2 star extra.

My daughter and I came here to check out this spot and to shop. What one should be mindful of is that all stores are not outlet stores in these places. Usual retailer setup shop here too so look carefully. Said fifth off is a nice store but is a retailer not an outlet here. 

Nike is a retailer with good markdowns though. But the Makeup store is really a good find for Genifique and Urban decay sales and deep markdowns. That's worth it for sure. The NY and Co outlet was pretty good as well. 

Pleasantly we enjoyed the jazz that started at 5pm on a beautiful night. But the food court needs some help. Overall a cool spot but I would enjoy myself more at the Tucson mall which is a shorter drive and more stores to choose from that I prefer. Still it's a good visit if you like such. They do have MK, Coach and other big names.

This quaint spot with friendly hosts is a must try. Brandon and Ellie were great as they shared some history of Grassini and poured some of the best Reds we had all day. We had a hard time picking 1 as we loved 2 of the 5 we tasted. 

Additionally we were looking for a good dinner spot and they provided us with 4 places. It was so friendly that another wine taster suggested one more spot to consider. Needless to say it too was a tough choice. 

Grassini is a friendly spot and very laid back as you taste. Stroll in, pony up to the counter and get your pours started. You won't be disappointed.

This spot is quite the place. Clearly a popular spot off Anacapa and Ortega. Easy to get to from State street. It seems reservations are best but they accommodated us.. we told them we we're recommended by Grassini wines; which we were. And it didn't disappoint. 

Each dish is like a tasting which we shared. We had the bone marrow on crostini, salmon sous vide, and veggies en pappillot. The salmon melted in your mouth, the bone marrow was super flavorful and the veggies were equally tasty. 

The richness of the food was filling but not overwhelming. And what was nice is while we had 3 dishes all very delicious and buttery, our bill was $55. That sort of quality food doesn't come at that good a price usually. Now could you spend more... ? For sure. But we were more than satiated. 

The only down side is the amount of time to have a server follow up after you ate or to check on you. We might have ordered more but service delays sort of snagged that. Overall I would go again and you should give it a try too.

Another good wine spot just off state street. A hip contemporary vibe and welcoming crew. Pull up a chair at the bar and get ready to enjoy a real tasting journey. 

Unlike the other spots this one had and offered cheese and crackers or a chocolate pairing. $17. We tried the red wine flight of 5 for $18 and were not disappointed. We had 4-5 diff cheese. Olives. Fruit and chocolate pcs. We didn't have guidance on the pairing but that was okay. Having done a few of these I was good with that. We tasted our wines and got the cheese flavors to compliment. Fresh blueberries ended the tasting with the dessert wine which was delicious.  So much that I bought a bottle. 

This wine would be good with a lemon pie or cake topped with blueberries. It's not too sweet but just enough and will pull the flavor of blueberry from the wine which the vineyard grows. Enjoy... salud.

Laura was our host and this spot is very cozy. We shared the flight of red and white for $20. While enjoyable we didn't find a wine we fell in love with. Perhaps a different flight would have yielded a better outcome but what is a good sell for them is your $20 is applied to your wine purchase. All others might give you a small discount. 

Do yourself a favor and remember to check in on yelp. You will usually find a 10-15% discount on your wines at most of the cellars.

Service is good. Place is hopping. Everyone is friendly. A drive by and anyone can see this place has someThing special. There's an energy that you can sense even from the distance. Once inside it's a quaint but nicely setup spot. The salad bar is chicly done and the food is tasty. Servers roll around in usual Brazilian style for meat selections.  Tasty yes. Filling maybe. Just depends how you spend your appetite. For $100
Average for two people it's a bit in the expensive side for Arizona dining. Cheese bread popovers are addictive and their espresso is damn good too. But give a try of their Brazilian lemonade. It's a tasty beverage!

Overall, I enjoy Brazilian food but NEVER feel that  I get my Money's worth. So enjoy it, but have the meat first and then do the salad bar. Trust me, you'll feel better walking out if so. And your wallet will Still be lighter but you're nicely stuffed!

teE9htymK9q-dqA3upaOIA.review_text: This is place is cool. But the staff is kind of a mess. Maybe we caught them on an off night, but there were just mixed up orders and miscommunications all over the place, and the manager had the longest most awkward conversation ever with this couple next to us who were complaining about their food while we twiddled our thumbs hoping to order eventually. But it was kind of entertaining overall, so I would definitely go back.

This place is cool. But the staff is kind of a mess. Maybe we caught them on an off night, but there were just mixed up orders and miscommunications all over the place, and the manager had the longest most awkward conversation ever with this couple next to us who were complaining about their food while we twiddled our thumbs hoping to order eventually. But it was kind of entertaining overall, so I would definitely go back.

We had a great experience the first time in. Mostly we were really pleased with the value. The $4 guaca-hummus munchie was like a full appetizer. The half salad was large and delicious. Burger was good.
I would say the staff could probably up their game. All three people who served us were pretty disengaged, but still quick and helpful. 
Good atmosphere, too, not too loud.

I love this restaurant. It is not your typical Americanized Chinese take out restaurant, so people who want questionable meat drenched in sauce should go elsewhere. The food is fresh with lots of great veggies, so I feel good after I eat, not bloated and gross. The staff is friendly and proud of  the restaurant. Food comes out fast and hot!

GEM of a place. Crowded but it feels fun and intimate. It's incredible what the chef does with so small a kitchen. She is an amazing one-woman show. The short rib taco might be the best thing I've ever eaten. I only had two because I knew I had to try something else. I was not disappointed. The rabbit stew with white beans was comfort in a bowl. Had the fruit crisp with an incredible orange ginger ice cream. Would've just had the ice cream it was so fresh and flavorful. This will be a many repeated visit for me and my friends.

The Gallery Pastry Shop is everything I want brunch  to be. Cozy, fun, imaginative, bright, fresh, and delicious! I had so much fun designing my own sweet and savory crepes (one of each). You can't help but notice the skill and finesse with which everything is executed, too, so you just feel fancy :-D
YES! This is the kind of restaurant we want. Real food, fresh, and healthy. I had the greens and ancient grains bowl and felt amazing afterwards. The cranberry cayenne lemonade was seriously awesome.

I love a place where there's a clear love of food and all kinds of food. I've been a few times, and everything's always delicious. The burgers are incredible and indulgent but there are also awesome veggie options. I had the veggie buffalo wings, which were pretty dang good, and I love the roasted veggie salad.

WOW I am really excited about this place. First time in today, I had a butterscotch iced latte with oat milk. I could taste the sweet butterscotch syrup made in-house, the bitterness of the coffee, the rich spices, and the citrus of the orange all at once. It was like an upscale cocktail that I took in with my nose before tasting it on my lips. Quaint, comfy atmosphere with friendly, knowledgeable staff. Neil, who made our drinks, shared the ingredients used and how everything was made. Can't wait to go back and try everything!
Good place for families; however, the food is bland unless heavily breaded or sauced.

I want to like this place, but the food is not good. My husband and I have been twice. Everyone's been very nice, and the food's come out quickly. But everything we've ordered has lacked seasoning. My husband's pancake, which cost $3.39, was undercooked. The avocado in the avocado toast tasted old and did not look appetizing. Nice diner atmosphere, but we will not be back.

I love Pancho's! It is my husband and my favorite impromptu weeknight day. Simple, fresh, delicious. I love the tacos al pastor - really well marinaded. The fresh salsa bar is a highlight. 
On a weeknight, it is not very busy, but you'll want to have plenty of time at lunch because it can be packed. For good reason!

I've been to Woody's a couple of times, and I get the appeal. It's fun to feel like you're eating in a library. But that's about where the appeal ends. The food is perhaps diner quality but surprisingly pricey. On my most recent visit, everything was pretty underwhelming. We had the cheese fondu to start, and the bread was stale, the fruits and vegetables not in great shape. 
I would hope a local place like this would stay around, but I won't be returning any time soon.

This is my husband and my go-to date night. There is no place in Indy where you can get such good sushi. It is always busy when you go, and the staff, while really nice, are kept super busy, so it's good to go in with that expectation. But there's plenty of hot tea, soup, and salad to mingle over while you wait for the incredible taste journey to come :)

We visited Strange Bird for the first time last night and had such a great time. Being pregnant during the COVID winter can be hard, but Strange Bird has these awesome heated pods where 2-4 people can dine super safely. The staff were so friendly and accommodating, opening up another pod for us so we wouldn't have to wait too long to be seated. Our server, Ian, was so nice and helpful, standing out in the frigid air while we were warm inside our pod. They made me a yummy mocktail, and I felt so treated by the overall experience. We recommend the coconut crusted tenderloin and the falafel!

Major plus: delivery food is well packaged and arrives hot! I have eaten at Thai Cafe twice, once in person, once delivered. Noodle dishes are good but leave a little to be desired. I find the veggies and noodles just a bit overcooked. The meat tastes like the oil it was cooked in without much seasoning. But they do give you just the spice level you ask for. It may suit your tastes if you like a nice saucy dish, but I'm always looking for those crisp veggies and aromatic flavors.
We love La Piedad! The staff are fantastic, margaritas are awesome (not too sweet), food is great. My favorite is the taco fajitas salad with steak and chicken.

I've gotten takeout from Sahara a couple of times, and I still think of that gyro sandwich. It is seriously good. The falafel appetizer I had was a little on the dryer side for me. The salad was so fresh and herbaceous. Will be back soon!

Manee is definitely some of the top Thai you can get in North Indy. Worth a little extra drive for me and my husband. Crisp veggies, perfectly cooked meat, and explosive flavors. I love the drunken noodles!

We had high hopes for brunch at Northside Kitchenette as we loved our experience at Nook. However, for the price of the menu, we felt the food was good, but not excellent. The sausage gravy was yummy; however, I felt my eggs were very underseasoned, my husband's hollandaise sauce lacked seasoning as well, and the french toast was a little dry and not well seasoned either. The staff was great, and maybe it was just an off day in the kitchen, but, with so many excellent brunch places in Indy, we probably won't try it again.

I had such a lovely first experience at Bosphorus. The host made us feel so much at home, we had a great time. Everything was excellent, so full of flavor and homey at the same time. Even the side salad, which reminded me of my grandmother's, was perfectly dressed. So glad they've made it through the pandemic and can't wait to visit again.

tm8N1gZwjb9UOqqMYR-cog.review_text: I officially found my favorite spot of all time. Im from NJ but I live in Washington so finding a good barber out there was very challenging. I've lived in Virginia, Texas, and even North Carolina and I never found someone that I truly liked. Robert (the owner) was the one who worked on my hair and he did a fantastic job. He was patient and made sure I was getting the right cut. Everybody else in the shop were very friendly. I felt like I was going over a friend's house to hang out. Def going to be checking in here each time I visit.

I found this gem through yelp and I was highly impressed with the fast response I got from the owner about pricing and certain accommodations. I was able to get in and got sat down for a cut right away and the barber that took care of me (don't remember his name) really took the time to listen to my requests and gave me one of the best cuts I've ever had. I will definitely come back here. I'm extremely happy I found myself a reliable local barber!

Love this place! Such a good deal and environment is pretty chill. I've been to many hot pot places before but this is the only spot I've found so far that is the most reasonable priced. I definitely will recommend to come here to have your first experience if you've never had hot pot before.

I love this place so much because they have the best crawfish. I'm obsessed and have been taking my friends here. The staff is also super friendly and give you a warm welcoming feeling. I definitely recommend!

The idea of the process is cool but if I'm being honest, paying $18 for 3 powdered drinks wasn't worth it. I was very intrigued by the advertisement for this place but upon arrival, I wasn't that impressed. Thank you, next!

Honestly this place is trash. Service is trash and food isn't that great. We got sat down and the staff wouldn't even acknowledge us cause we weren't Chinese. I say this because anytime a Chinese person came in and spoke the language, the service was different. Never coming back.

SERVICE IS TRASH. Never in my life have I ever been disrespected anywhere I've ever been to to go eat. I'm the type to tip accordingly. That means if the service wasn't that great, I won't go out of my way. The last time I've been here, I tipped my guy $15 because he was great. The lady I dealt with this most recent visit talked to me once and it was on a slow day so it wasn't busy or anything. When I went to pay, I tipped her $5. I didn't feel like it was that bad of a tip for a lunch meal. I mean it could've been worse where I didn't tip at all. She made it very clear she was unhappy about it and started speaking in Chinese holding the $5 to her coworker being snarky. Rude. If you didn't want it you could give it back. It's free money on you and you guys charge a mandatory $39 to assist customers by cooking their food so what is the real problem here? The food isn't even all that great. For all this, I could've gone to Nine Ting in Philly which is another all you can eat hot pot and their service is way better and there's more variety so you can kiss my ass.

This place is super cute. The decor is beautiful and staff is super nice and helpful. The food was also delicious. Keep in mind that when you order, don't underestimate how much they give you. It was A LOT of food. And although it's all you can eat, there will be a $13 charge if you're wasting food. Well at least that's what the sign says. I ordered a lot but was able to finish it all and I ended up feeling like I was gonna throw up haha. The broth was decent, if I'm being honest. There wasn't much taste but I can't complain. So if you're looking for a hotpot experience for a good price, then this place is your best bet. Will def come back!
Love love love this place! The broth was amazing! Staff is helpful and friendly. Lunch prices are so cheap. Def the best hot pot place I've ever been to by far!

One word: WOW! I am so happy about this place, I can't even put it in the right words. The food is AMAZING, service is AMAZING. Right away, you get greeted with the friendliest and personable people. You get your own pot if you're going for hot pot which I think is a good idea cause you can pretty much regulate how much food you want and you can have your own flavor. I also ordered the sangria pitcher and it was so delicious as well. I've been on this hot pot adventure and so far I've been to about 16 places and I've come to the determination that this one is the best by far. Will def be back!!

Tip: If you wish to go here, you're better off either taking an Uber or Train unless you're okay with paying $10 for parking next to the fire station because street parking is almost impossible to find unless you're going at an early time. 

Review:
This place is super cute. Service was outstanding as well. When I was presented with my selection, i was so impressed. Whoever that's in that kitchen making these desserts puts in their effort and time into it. You can tell there's a lot of passion behind these dishes. I ordered the Matcha tiramisu with Caramel ice cream and it was so yummy. Def a good place to take someone on a date or if you're having a sweet tooth. Will be back!
We got the fresh watermelon and the You Cha Messy Milk Brown Sugar Boba and it was so yummy! The place has a really cute decor as well. Found my new fave boba place!! Will def be back!

My sushi looked like someone threw up and popped it on top of rice. They got my order wrong too. Gave me things I didn't even order. It wasn't appetizing at all. There's def a language barrier and my waitress didn't understand anything I said and on top of that, the rest of the staff was super rude. First and last time I'll be here.

Update: my 6th time here maybe. I ran into a small issue that was quickly fixed (won't go into detail) but the manager was incredible in understanding and was very welcoming when I decided to come back. I am not disappointed in continuing to recommend my friends and family to this place.

I was referred here by my coworker so I thought I'd give it a try. The food was good but was it authentic? Not quite. I may be spoiled because I've had authentic Sichuan food and the difference is very noticeable. I feel like if the food had a tad bit more salt, it would've been better. 

Service: Not really impressed. The atmosphere was a bit awkward if I'm being honest. Our waitress seemed like she was really over her job I almost felt bad for her lol. No one acknowledged our table in the beginning long enough that I decided to just reach out to ask if we can begin ordering. There's also a very young boy maybe 12 there that's an acting restaurant host. Everyone was very... meh. 

Overall, I'd rate a 3/5 due to the food wasn't terrible but it wasn't the best either. Will I be back again? Maybe if I'm looking for a quick bite, yes. So not so bad

Been my favorite local restaurant lately. I get the Bun Bo Hue Dac Biet a lot because it's so flavorful and it's just how I expect it to be especially growing up in a traditional Vietnamese home. I really love the fact that this place offers service through Door Dash too in case if I'm too busy or lazy to get out the house lol. The chicken is also so fresh. 3rd update: damn I go here a lot haha. But I just wanted to add this in here and I hope that either management or someone sees this to give this place a try. Our waitress, Mary was PHENOMENAL! Her customer service was outstanding. The level of proactiveness that she gave us made us feel valued. Even the hostesses upon arriving simply acknowledging me by my name gave me a comfort feeling. I honestly can't find anything bad to say and I don't think I can. Again, thank you for having me. Will def be a loyal customer!
Love this place! Been going for years. Cheap and delicious food. My favorite so far is Bun Bo Hue. The broth is amazing!!

I love their food but 4/5 cause their service is not that great. The lady that handed me my food slammed it down on the counter like she was over it. Yikes, I'm sorry you woke up on the wrong side of the bed but don't take it out on your customers. Really praying she has a better day

I love their dry pot so much that I eat it every month. Sometimes twice a month and it's such a guilty pleasure. If you like spicy, it's a nice feeling. Not too painful but just enough to make things a bit warm.

I am so in love with this place, it's insane. I've seen their Instagram a lot prior to coming here but haven't actually come to try until today and this was the best hands down. The flavors they used to make their dishes go extremely well together. The staff is so nice also. 10/10!!!

i love k pot and has been my favorite place for awhile now. i used to go to the franklin mills location religiously despite living 40 mins away so when they opened up a location in south philly, it was exciting because it's a lot closer BUT i had a problem the last few times i went and it left me feeling pretty disappointed. im a regular so the franklin mills location even knows me by name. and im a generous tipper so that's never been an issue. but mannnnnnn the last times i've been here i left a very minimum tip cause the service was terrible! i don't know his name but he's a shorter asian guy with curly hair. i've had him serve my table twice and each time he looks like he hates being there. i get it. sometimes we have bad days but he makes it fully known that he's in one by slamming our plates on the table, barely checking up on us and it felt like it was an inconvenience to even ask anything from him. i have the impression they have expanded from the franklin mills location because i see the same manager but man do you guys need to retrain because i've been going to this place for over a year and never had i EVER had this terrible service. i like the place only because it's closer but if i go back and i get terrible service again, im gonna suck it up and just go back to my franklin mills location. there should be no excuse why you have to be rude especially working with the public. maybe find a different job if you're that miserable because no one is forcing you to work there.

u0OTR_DAnqNfrc906_CJ1A.review_text: If you ask anyone in Nashville about brunch, you're sure to hear about Biscuit Love. Rain or shine, there's always a line out the door but it goes by pretty fast and the employees are really accommodating. Ok.. even though the name suggests that biscuits are supposed to be the main thing here, I like the dishes themselves more than the actual biscuits. The mushrooms a la carte are surprisingly really good! Got the bonuts (donuts made from biscuit dough) which are also good but only when they are made fresh/warm.  Overall, nice atmosphere, good food and feels like Nashville!

If you're looking for a nice place to eat in Germantown, I recommend R&D! In the middle is communal seating, seating at the bar, and reserved booths on the sides. You can call ahead to put your name down on busy nights. I highly recommend the beef tartare. Usually I'm hesitant to eat raw meat, but the tartare was flavored well. This place is also known for their handmade pasta. Overall, nice dining experience with a huge drink menu and good atmosphere.

There's not that many options for good Chinese food in Nashville so Corner Bistro is probably the best you can expect/get. My favorite dish here so far is the spicy beef tendon and shank. It's a cold dish but pretty good if you like Szechuan flavors and spice. I've had a couple fish dishes here and they aren't my favorite but not bad. Also highly recommend the string beans - can't go wrong with those! Overall, the food here is good and clean environment.

There's not many Asian options near Vandy so it's nice to finally have something! The place is cute, decorated with lots of Hello Kitty. I'm not sure if the noodles are made by hand, but I enjoyed my dish. I got the Shanxi Sliced Noodles. If you like flat and wide noodles more than thin ones, I highly recommend this. But if you want something with a spicy broth then get something else. I said I liked spicy but the broth was not spicy at all. The portions are big so I think it's worth the price. Overall, I recommend this place for your noodle fix and look forward to trying other dishes!

This is the location in the nations. If you're looking for a nice place to study, read a book, etc. I highly recommend! The upstairs space is a bit small and dark (doesn't get as much sunlight) but it has nice chairs and tables. The downstairs space is spacious, lots of natural light and pretty quiet. There seem to only be outlets on the smaller countertop tables but plenty of seats. I ordered a matcha latte with soy milk -- very good! Overall, a nice cafe to study or chill with good drinks.

If you're looking for something different in Nashville, check out Plaza Mariachi! I went on a rainy day so it's nice that everything is indoors especially with unpredictable Nashville weather. I went on a Friday so it was super lively. There was even an aerial dancer, someone who danced with fire, and loud live music. Like others have mentioned there's also a dance floor and things seemed kid friendly (around 7-8pm at least).

On to the food: Lots of food choices from Mexican to Argentinian to sandwiches. They also have a few places that sell desserts like churros, ice cream and boba. I got three tacos and all were awesome! Overall a fun experience and something pretty unique for Nashville.

Nice cafe located in the Gulch! The space is open (like a garage) so you get the fresh air from outside while enjoying a seat inside. There's also plenty of seating -- a long table to share and individual tables on the side. I had a lemongrass something tea. It was okay but could have had more flavor. Love the glasses though.

If you're looking for great quality drinks and very knowledgeable bartenders, go to Patterson house! I think I've been here on weekdays so it was never too crowded and didn't have to wait too long. The space is dark but cozy. The outside of the house is unassuming but the inside is so nice! The bar is in the middle with all their drinks on display and they even sell the alcohol on their walls. I sat at the booth once and the bar another time -- I like the bar because you can watch the bartenders making your drink. I always just tell him what flavors or alcohol I like and he always makes it so good!! (The one in the glasses). He will adjust the drink if it's too strong too. I haven't had the actual food here yet, but have had the donuts which are a perfect snack with drinks. Highly recommend!!!

If you look up foods to eat in SB, McConnell's always pops up. It's my first time in SB and I don't regret taking the time to come here! I recommend the flight for people who can't make up their minds and want to try multiple flavors. You can also try as many flavors as you want so no pressure to choose -- the pressure comes from wanting to eat them all.  The space is pretty big too with an upstairs. Came here at night so not sure if it gets crowded in the daytime. Highly recommend!!

My friend and I were looking for an Italian restaurant  in downtown SB and, honestly, there were a lot of choices but glad I came here! It was a bit busy on a Friday night but we got a seat right away. They give free bread with olive oil as a starter. We ordered the pappardelle and tagliatelle -- both super delicious. Asked the waitress for a wine recommendation and it was excellent (forgot the name but it was a cab). They have a big wine selection and full bar. I enjoyed the meal a lot and the atmosphere was lively but not overly loud. Highly recommend!

I drove by this place on the way back to my airbnb. I remembered it because the outdoor patio was so pretty with the lanterns. So glad I took the time to stop by here and actually try the food. I ordered the  Northern Thai curry noodles and it was so good! The curry is very flavorful. Portion is enough but not a lot. The inside is super cute and lots of photo ops lol. There's also a parking lot although not a lot of spaces. I had no problem on a Saturday afternoon. I would definitely come back again!

I honestly thought this place might be overrated but  I was pleasantly not disappointed! I came for lunch on Sunday so thought it would be super crowded. Parking was difficult but I luckily got a spot in the 90 minute lot (which is free). The wait was 30 minutes but we found a seat at the bar pretty quickly. If you can't get a seat outside then I actually recommend the bar because you still get a view (facing the water). My friend and I ordered the sea bass and seafood pasta. The portions are surprisingly big and all entrees come with sides like the clam chowder and salad. Both were flavorful and cooked well. Service was quick and servers were nice and efficient. Overall I would definitely check it out if you're in SB and want seafood at a casual place.

If you're in the Gulch, you should definitely check out Killebrew. Someone recommended it to me because of the pastries which have apparently won awards. It's right by the ritzy Thompson Hotel and you can walk directly into the lobby from the cafe. You can use the bathrooms in the hotel (which are very nice) and there's free wifi as well. The tables are on the smaller side with one wall that has a long booth seat. Not a lot of seating but I've never had trouble getting a table on a weekday afternoon. The only thing is they close pretty early (5pm) so this is more of a conversation or quick snack/coffee type of cafe rather than a study/work cafe. 

For food and drinks: I'm not a coffee drinker but my friend says the quality of coffee is good. I have had the matcha latte and green cloud and both had strong tea flavors. I also recommend trying a pastry! The farm quiche is very good but the biscuits are just okay. The chocolate croissant is crispy/flaky and not too sweet. 

Recommend this place for those in the area looking for a quick bite and some good coffee.

This is a review for the cafe portion of CB (haven't tried the food yet). When you walk in, you're greeted by high ceilings and a very spacious area with plenty of seating. Lots of natural lighting and big tables which are great for hanging out or studying. There's plenty of outdoor seating too (with umbrellas). The only downside is the lack of outlets, but there is free wifi and CB is open pretty late for a cafe so it's a good place to study. I'd choose CB over SB any day... 

I ordered an "Illuminated Mind," an organic green tea. The matcha flavors are strong, which I like. The drinks are fairly priced in my opinion. I paid $3 flat for the smaller size (silver) and it was pretty good quality tea. Next time I will definitely try one of the pastries or one of many assortment of snacks/chips.

Great little cafe near Vandy bookstore for doing work or grabbing drinks with friends. There's limited seating but large tables that can be shared. They have a sip to sit policy and wifi password comes with a drink order (on the receipt). You can also borrow a portable charger for your electronics (even laptop) so outlets aren't as big of an issue.

I ordered the House Tyrell in honor of GoT. It was actually really good! An iced tea with hints of orange and vanilla. I'm not sure if this is seasonal or not. 

I'd come here again :)

I was excited to try this place since I'd seen and heard about it online. The food didn't disappoint but the overall atmosphere could have been better.

The restaurant itself is nice, but pretty loud. There were lots of big groups and seemed like they added chairs to accommodate the bigger parties so it felt a bit crowded. The servers were attentive but also took away plates a bit too quickly. 

Ok onto the important part: the food. I love steak and really wanted to try the wagyu. The one on the menu is from Australia I think, but they have a separate special for an A5 wagyu straight from Japan too (think it was sold by the ounce). The wagyu strip was very good and tender. Also ordered the ribeye which came out more rare than I'm used to but the way they cook it takes out the bloodiness (sous vide). 

Sides: Highly highly recommend the black kale and shishito peppers from the "green" part of the menu. So good! The cream corn brulee was okay but too sweet for me. 

Dessert/drinks: if you like fruity drinks, I enjoyed the Peachy Keen. Also had a chocolate martini (la madame chocolat) which was decent too. 

Definitely recommend Kayne Prime if you want a well-cooked steak but the atmosphere is kinda loud and less intimate (than what I would expect of a restaurant at this price point).

Milk and honey is by far my favorite brunch spot in Nashville! Yes it's worth the wait (but try to avoid prime brunching hours if possible). At least you get a text message when it's your turn so you're not stuck waiting near the restaurant. I ordered the farmhouse biscuit and the burrata & fig. The burrata and fig is so good. I think it could be a meal on its own and definitely shareable. The slices of prosciutto are thick and there are plenty of cheese and figs. I just wish the sourdough toast was toasted so it would be crispy. Also enjoyed the farmhouse biscuit and think it was the best biscuit I had in Nashville. Service was great -- very quick and servers are attentive. Overall highly highly recommend! Go take pics at the murals and grab a coffee from Killebrew as you wait ;)

uL_O5y1kWF9fKfqm3WI1bg.review_text: Nice staff, good price, nice environment. Table was a little sticky. Had the Calexico (buffalo chicken jalapeño kind of pizza). 11" pizza was filling. Really good food. Can't wait to come back.

This place has great food. The price is reasonable. The restaurant has neat decorations. The best part about this restaurant, hands down, is the table-side salsa. Watching staff mix up some fresh salsa from fresh vegetables is really neat and very tasty. I definitely recommend this place.

Really good place. Cheap, nice staff, clean, and delicious food. Had the Macho Burrito, was not disappointed at all. Wife had mango chicken salad and liked it. Chips and salsa were really good. Highly recommend this place

Good food for the price. Had "The Carnivore" and was not disappointed. I liked the crust of the pizza best, it was crispy and chewy. The fried wings were also good. They were crispy on the outside, yet soft and moist on the inside. The wing sauce was good too. The staff were all nice. I like that there is a bar area in the next room. It makes it nice to enjoy a local beer while waiting for the food, which didn't take long. I recommend this place to anyone.
Wings were good, not great. Staff were nice. Price was reasonable. Felt more like a restaurant with a bar vibe.

The staff here are nice. The water tastes good. However, I don't know if I would recommend this place. The water is more expensive than water dispensaries throughout Tucson, but doesn't really taste any different. Also, this place lacks 24/7 convenience of other dispensaries. The shop at this location sells jugs and other dispensing equipment, but it seems over priced.

I liked this place. We got a meat lovers, some breadsticks, and some wings on a takeout order. I think there are cheaper options out there, but this place was really good. The pizza was good, but the wings and breadsticks were what sold me at this place. The breadsticks were heavy and thick. They were filling with a really good flavor blend of seasonings. The wings had good buffalo sauce, but the chicken quality itself is what set them apart from other places. The meat of the wings was fluffy and soft. The meat came right off the bones. The staff was nice and the food order was punctual. All in all, good experience. I will definitely order from here again when I see a good deal. I highly recommend giving this place a try.

Grabbed take out. Sushi was good, but more importantly in large portion size. Family member grabbed the seafood pho, and said it was good. Staff was nice. Little pricey, but again, fair considering the good quality and size of food. I will definitely be coming back, but will be calling in an order for pickup next time. I recommend this place to anyone who likes pho and/or sushi.

I like this location over any other location. The evening shift staff have been consistently great. I got quick, very friendly, and accurate service with each visit. Only been through the drive-thru during late evening hours, so I can't comment on the other hours, but late evening staff are fantastic.

This place was great. It was very Japanese in style. The restaurant felt as though it was relocated straight from Japan. The ramen was amazing. The gyoza was probably one of the best plates of gyoza I have ever had. The price was a bit steep, but very reasonable considering the exceptional service, food quality, portion size, and all around atmosphere. The food came out very quickly as well. If you would like to speak Japanese, the staff here are very friendly and all whom we interacted with were Japanese. The one and only complaint I have with this place is the parking is very tight and fills up very fast. I would suggest to customers to come early as well. We came shortly after it opened to a near empty restaurant. When we left, there was a wait line. All in all, I highly recommend this place and can't wait to go back!!

日本人がここすごいすきとも。食べ物がすごいうまい。たくさん日本人がここ仕事する。

Went through drive thru and ordered slushies in drink carrier. One of the slushies had beverage all over the side and dripping out the bottom of the drink carrier. This was unacceptable and showed a lack of quality control.

I liked this place. The price was a little steep, but the food was overall worth the cost. We had the chicken family meal and pork belly with Mac and cheese and coleslaw sides. The chicken was amazing. It fell off the bone, was real moist, and had a good flavor. The pork belly was flavorful as well and of good quality. I didn't really care much for the Mac and cheese, as I thought it was kind of bland. The coleslaw was crisp and had a great creamy texture, while balanced with a lot of flavor. The coleslaw was actually my favorite part of the meal. We got our food as an order pickup. When I called ahead, the employee was helpful in explaining menu items and providing options. The lady working the register when I arrived was very welcoming. I would have loved to stay and eat there. The restaurant interior had a lot of military/first responder and sports decorations. They gave a military discount which was thoughtful. Overall, I highly recommend this place, but only if your budget can support it.

Would not recommend. Our service started out great. Dominic took our order at the register. He was very polite and very helpful in ensuring we got our order correct. He even apologized for another server while we departed. The restaurant was clean, organized, and had a nice atmosphere. The food tasted great. However, a server completely ruined the experience. This server's mistake was repeated without regard to my polite request and continued without regard to my instructions to stop. The issue concerning personal space was addressed with a manager on duty, who said she would talk to the employee. That was the kind of response I hoped for as it was all that could really be done. Everything except one server was great. His actions have sworn me off this location.

Didn't really care for this place and not sure if I would recommend it. The parking was the first thing to annoy us. It is very tight. Upon arriving, we were greeted and seated at a table. The table was uneven on the floor and rocked from side to side. This was kind of fixed by the waiter placing something under a table leg. I had sushi rolls, but didn't like them much. The rice was hard and the fish didn't seem as fresh as other places. Family had udon, ramen, tempura, and teriyaki fried tofu rice bowl. Ramen was not good, udon was good, tempura was good, fried teriyaki tofu rice bowl was not brought out as ordered twice. First they brought out udon, then fried tofu and rice (without teriyaki sauce). The price was not horrible considering what we received, but the quality was not to par. The service was alright, as we didn't have to try hard to get a waiter for assistance. The interior of the restaurant was interesting. I really like the decor. The music was nice and the items on the wall were really fun to look at. The bad quality of the food was a huge turnoff from this place. Probably won't be back.

Absolutely loved this place. Hands down the most authentic and best tasting sushi I have had in Tucson. I was greeted and seated at the sushi bar. The complimentary miso soup was really good. I filled out the order card and handed it to the sushi chef, who got right to work. The sushi was fresh. The rice was sticky and held solid shapes. The plating by the chef was masterfully done on a wooden serving tray. The chef struck up a conversation that carried through the meal, granted it was at a slower time in the day so I can't guarantee the same luxury on a busier day. The chef was very kind and very interested in my satisfaction with the meal. The staff were professional and nice. The decor of the restaurant felt like Japan. The price was not too steep, but was relative to the outstanding service and food quality. I can't wait to come back.

日本人はここ仕事です。日本語しゃぶれるできる！ここはすごい日本みたい。ちょうおいしい！！

The lady working here was really nice. This store had a lot of Japanese and Korean groceries, dish ware, and kitchen items. The selection was really impressive. Some items seemed higher priced and some items seemed like a really good deal. One thing I liked about this place was the book library. I highly recommend this place.
Came back again. Great food, but glass had lipstick on it. Waitress didn't seem to care when issue was brought to her attention.

If you are coming to work on your computer, don't bother. There is very limited seating and it isn't very accommodating. Would only recommend this place for sipping on something while you shop at Safeway or to take back to your car.

I did not like this place. I ordered a California burrito and a medium horchata. The burrito size was good. However, the food was bland. The only way to tell the difference between the ingredients was the texture. The "California" burrito was not made like they do in California (no sour cream and steamed potatoes instead of French fries). The horchata wasn't that good compared to other places. There was ice inside the horchata, but it wasn't cold when served. The wait time was kinda lengthy at the drive thru considering it was just me and another car at first. I don't recommend this place.

We got a 1/2 dozen donuts. They were pretty good. The cost of the donuts was really good ($5). However, this place only takes cash. There was an ATM inside, but the $3.50 ATM fee was a bit ridiculous. I didn't like that the donuts were placed in a brown paper bag. The grease from the donuts began to soak through the bag, which meant holding the bag during the drive home to ensure my car didn't get dirty. I also didn't like the bag because the donuts were getting crushed together. The selection was pretty lacking as well. All things considered, I would recommend this place only if you are getting a donut to eat on sight, paying in cash that you brought, and are okay with choosing from a limited selection.

I have gone here on two occasions at the time of this posting. Each time, I had the SC-5 sushi combo. It includes pieces of Las Vegas roll, spicy tuna roll, and spicy crab roll. The sushi was really good. I particularly love the Las Vegas roll. The staff brought out edamame beans and miso soup as an appetizer. They also provided a small beverage at completion of my meal each time. While eating at the counter, the chef was fun to talk with. The chef can carry on a conversation in English or Korean. The facility was clean and the food was a good. I highly recommend giving this place a try.

Absolutely no complaints. Clean restaurant, friendly staff, great prices (especially with veteran discount), great for kids, and the food was fantastic. We had a large mega meat pizza, wings, bread sticks with cheese, and mozzarella sticks. Everything came out really good. I say great for kids because this place has tons of high chairs and a play area for kids. The play area has an arcade game (Terminator shooter game) small tables and chairs, a claw crane game, a candy dispenser, a small play kitchen, and a TV that had Disney Jr playing. I liked all the pictures on the walls and the TV's everywhere with sports on. Again, we had great food, great service, a great price, and can't wait to come back.

Great experience. Brit was the lady who took our order, prepared our food, and rang us up. She was polite, friendly, and did a great job at everything she did to complete our order. While at this location, I overheard Brit extend this same level of courtesy and great service to all other customers. Brit was the reason this location stood out over other Subway locations.

Came here with kids. Got buffets and some tokens for the arcade. Buffet was a great deal. The food wasn't anything to write home about and there were not a lot of options at the buffet. However, for the price paid, I still think it's a good deal. It did take some time walking around before I found a table that wasn't grotesque. Many unoccupied tables were left unattended with food, wrappers, napkins, and crumbs strewn about. The arcade did not have a large selection of games available to play and it did seem kind of crammed. However, the kids still had a blast at the arcade and won lots of tickets for prizes. We did have a little bit of a wait (about 10 minutes) before an employee was available to issue out prizes. I will most likely bring my family back again.

The service was good. The drinks were great. The price was fair. The staff were nice. However, the customer at the drive thru ahead of me had a dog that was hanging out the window onto the drive thru window ledge, drinking water from a cup. An employee was petting the dog at the window. Not sure if there is a health code violation here, but I'll enjoy Dutch Bros at a different location.

Not that great of an experience. The burgers were bland. The onion rings were good. The fries (both seasoned and unseasoned) were okay. The "Blake's Sauce" has little flavor. Portion sizes were good. Drive thru was very slow and they forgot bbq sauce. All things considered, I think I'll go elsewhere for burgers next time.

Nice customer service. Great prices. The food here has been in a decline in quality though. Seems like the food here used to be great. We used to look forward to coming here. However, as of recently, the food quality has been not as enjoyable. On a few recent visits the mac n cheese has been mushy, like a mashed texture. The chicken was kind of hard. Hoping the quality improves.

Absolutely no complaints. Clean restaurant, friendly staff, great prices (especially with veteran discount), great for kids, and the food was fantastic. We had a large mega meat pizza, wings, bread sticks with cheese, and mozzarella sticks. Everything came out really good. I say great for kids because this place has tons of high chairs and a play area for kids. The play area has an arcade game (Terminator shooter game) small tables and chairs, a claw crane game, a candy dispenser, a small play kitchen, and a TV that had Disney Jr playing. I liked all the pictures on the walls and the TV's everywhere with sports on. Again, we had great food, great service, a great price, and can't wait to com

Update: 10/24/2019 - From 5 stars to 1 star. Really dropped the ball tonight! The salad we ordered had big pieces of dirt in it! The staff apologized profusely and remade the salad. The new salad, though properly washed and missing dirt, was hardly even chopped! The wings were fried to perfection but were barely coated in sauce. There were several wings that didn't even look like they had sauce on them! The pizza was greasier and more bland than the several previous visits. The staff were nice, but the food quality took a huge dive. What happened!?!?!? All previous visits were amazing! This was terrible to such an extent that I don't know if I want to come back!

Been here on at least 2 occasions now. Both times I have had take out orders. I haven't had the pho here (not really a huge fan of pho), but other items from their menu are really good. Their steamed dumplings, egg rolls, and crab puffs are really good. My family really likes the pho. The prices are not bad at all. The staff are incredibly nice. What I also really like about this place is that they take exceptional care when bagging food items for take-out. The bag was neatly tied with the containers stacked inside so the bag could stand up on its own. It's nice to be able to focus on driving and not making sure my food doesn't topple over. The inside of the restaurant is clean and neatly organized. I highly recommend people come and give this place a try.

This place was great. I had the "Coyote Sandwich" which is basically a huge pork and brisket sandwich. I added a side of coleslaw. The price was cheap, the food was great, and the service was outstanding. The staff were nice. Our server was Amanda and she was great! The restaurant was clean, neatly decorated, and had a neat rustic charm. I highly recommend this place.

Nice customer service. Great prices. The food here has been in a decline in quality though. Seems like the food here used to be great. We used to look forward to coming here. However, as of recently, the food quality has been not as enjoyable. On a few recent visits the mac n cheese has been mushy, like a mashed texture. The chicken was kind of hard. Hoping the quality improves.

Update: Gave this place another try a couple days ago. Upon entering, restaurant was not very busy and a lot of people were waiting long times for their food. For the family meal, I had to wait about 30 minutes. One guy ordered the same and was complaining he waited 45 minutes. Though unacceptable for wait time, the food quality was spot on! That being said, there is always something wrong here. I don't know if it's time to give up on it yet though.

Placed an online order. Online order status said it was delivered to store for pickup. Called store on 2 separate occasions without luck. 1st call was useless. 2nd call offered no resolution and provided a 1-800 number for refund. Request to speak with manager was met with checking again but no manager, apologies, no manager and again suggesting I call 1-800 number. Called 1-800 number and got more help than store. I spoke with a customer service lady who verified UPS delivered the product to this location (confirming correct store). She was able to refund the amount to method of payment. 

The item ordered was X-Mas cards. We ordered so well in advance that they should have been received and sent out to our family and friends with time to spare before the holidays. Now, we get spun in circles with excuses, a sincere apology, a refund, and a search for a new store to handle our photo ordering in the future. Thanks, but no thanks. You lost our order and you did not make it right!!!!!

This place was pretty good. The wait was a little lengthy, but I chalk that up to us showing up at a busy time. There wasn't a lot of space for waiting without standing in front of the entrance. There were benches, but they were full. We waited outside, but one of the benches was damaged (splintered hole and rocking on base). We could have been seated immediately on the patio, but it was pretty chilly. When we did finally get seated, the service was great. We usually ask for an extra plate when we go out. The waitress recognized one might be useful for our family and, without being asked, brought one out for us. The restaurant was clean. The dishes were clean. The art on the walls was neat. The staff were very nice and very accommodating. The waitress topped off my coffee without needing to be asked. The food was amazing. I had the chicken fried steak, over easy eggs, biscuit, and hash browns. Family had pancakes, scrambled eggs, and bacon. There was not a single complaint to be had about food quality. The food didn't take long to come out despite the fact that this place was packed. The price was very tolerable as well. What I recommend is for people to go here with reservations ready. There is plenty of parking and seating, but it is evidently a favorite for many as it fills up quick. I think if this place had patio heaters and a fixed bench outside it would easily merit 5 stars. I will definitely give this place more business though.

More of an upscale place. Definitely cheaper options out there for sushi, but not with the quality of this place. Food was great, atmosphere was comfortable, staff were very accommodating, and the dishes/utensils were clean. The restaurant was very clean and had neat decorations. There were several options for drinks, entrees, appetizers, and desserts. I would highly recommend this place. Many of the staff are fluent Japanese speakers as well, if that is convenient for you. このレストランのスタッフが日本語わかります！

This was an overall good experience. We came in for lunch just before a crowd hit. We ordered some nan, curry, and ramen. The man was kind of flat and lacking somewhat in flavor. The chicken and cheese curry was good. The fried chicken was tender on the inside with a satisfying crunch on the outside. The rice and chicken were ample, but I think there should have been more curry sauce. I got a spice level 4 and was happy as it gave a kick but didn't burn my face off. The flavor was good as well. We also ordered shoyu and tonkutsu ramen, both of which were huge in size and delicious in flavor. The restaurant was immaculate, including the restrooms. The size was accommodating for not feeling cramped. The ordering process was easy with a menu being highly visible. The ordering here is done at the counter before you sit down. They give military discount. The staff were all social and friendly. The dish ware was clean. I also liked the hanging TV's and multiple windows. All in all I liked this place and will likely come back if in the area. They have dishes similar to what you would see at a "Coco Ichibanya" in Japan, so if you miss that place this might be a good one to try. 

これレストランが日本のCoco1番やのカレーちょとおなじみたい。ラメンがもうまい。

I was kind of disappointed. The garlic knots were lacking in flavor and were these bite size little chunks of heavy dough barely cooked to a bread. The wings were buffalo and garlic parmesan flavored. The wings were cooked to perfection but the flavor was way to subtle. The buffalo wings didn't really have enough sauce on them to make the flavor stand out. The garlic parmesan wings had a lot of parmesan flavor, but not much garlic flavor. The pizza was good. The toppings were piled on and the crust was perfect in every way. The salad was good. The customer service interactions were good. All employees were professional and really friendly. There was a bit of a delay in getting our order out but I think they were pretty busy. The price was, in my opinion, not that bad either. The most important thing they got right is that they got my order correct. I recommend people give this place a try. We will likely come back for another try. There were a lot of menu items we didn't try and getting a carry out isn't exactly the full experience.

No complaints. Everything was great. We grabbed food for take out. The chicken ceasar salad had a lot of toppings, all big in size. The two pizzas we ordered were perfect. We ordered a buffalo chicken pizza and a carnivore pizza. The crust was fluffy, but not soggy or warping in shape. The toppings were abundant. The cost was very doable. The staff were very friendly and had our order ready when they said it would be. The order was all correct as well. In summary, we regret not trying this place sooner and can't wait to go back. I highly recommend this place.

This place is great. The food quality is amazing, the selection is sufficient, and the prices are reasonable. What I think sets this place apart is the staff though. I was greeted, asked what I was looking for, suggestions were made, and I got what I came in for. The staff also made recommendations on things I should try next time I drop in. I'm looking forward to coming back. I strongly encourage people to give this place a try.

I have been here on at least four occasions now and have had consistently great experiences. I have not dined in, thanks to the covid-19 apocalypse. All of my experiences have been take out. The staff are very nice. The food is really good. The atmosphere in the restaurant is really pretty. The prices are a little pricier, but are fair considering the quality and size of the foods. My best advice for a large group is to get a family size pizza. Make sure you have room for it. The family size has trouble fitting in my sedan. I literally only get one with a cleared out trunk.

I honestly wouldn't even give this place a participation trophy. We came to the drive thru and ordered a $30 family fill up. The lady on the mic sounded annoyed while taking our order. We pulled up, paid, and were told to go park in front of the restaurant. Under 2 minutes had passed when an employee came out, confirmed our order, and had us on our way with our order in hand. When we returned home, we realized the gravy from the order was missing. However, my biggest problem I had with the order was one of the eight pieces of fried "chicken" was basically a breaded and fried bone. The chicken must have been on a hunger strike before the colonel sent him to the cage free chicken farm in the sky. I crushed the piece with my fingers and came to find there wasn't even any meat on the bone. See pictures. I firmly believe this wasn't a simple lack of attention to detail, as it was pretty obvious that this piece was made with no love......just remnants of the chicken's bitter hate and anguish. I don't know if the lady taking my order wanted to make sure my visit was terrible or a server shrugged and thought I wouldn't notice. They won't notice one less customer *shrug*.

I give it a 2/5. We have been giving this location a lot more tries since last review. We are constantly getting Mac n cheese where it seems like the noodles have been over cooked. We usually get family meals. Usually the chicken is perfect. The staff are consistently nice. Today we got home from the drive thru (family meal ordered through app) and found the Mac n cheese over cooked again. The chicken was also dry and over cooked. The salad was missing cheese, missing dressing, and missing avocado slices. The shrimp taco was supposed to have the tortilla removed (I know it sounds silly). We have given this place a lot of tries and will continue to do so because they get it right most of the time. The occasional mess ups are irritating though.

The place is greasy. The people who serve you are greasy. The pizza is greasy.  It would be average if they finished cooking their pizza but they don't. My brother says to try the roast beef.

2.2/5 stars. Overpriced for what it is.  Best pizza in carpinteria.

You know those people you keep giving second chances to that always end up disappointing you.  This is one of these people but it's a restraunt.  

Recently I went there as their burgers are okay.  It was right after the fires in southern California.  Clearly their food truck had not arrived and they went next door to smart and final to buy frozen burgers and buns.  Then they served that to me for $13.00.  I asked if they were being serious. 0.6/5 stars. My brother says try somewhere else.

Service is good and quick.  They have some great sandwiches and pastas.  Having this place in carpinteria is a godsend.  It would be a good touch if they actually rotated the "specials". 

4.0/5. My brother says try the turkey sandwich.

3/5 stars for poor service.  The food is relatively good especially the chicken.  Chicken sandwich and chicken salads are damn good. Unfortunately at night the place seems to be run by kids. 3.2/5 stars. My brother says try the chopped cobb salad.

0.6/5 stars. My brother says try buying a steak at the grocery store

3.0/5 stars. My brother says try the burger.

4.2/5 stars. My brother says try the fried chicken

Good authentic flavors. Friendly staff. Quick service.  Their curries and sauces are on point.  I typically do beef or vegetarian as I do not like their chicken too much.

4.3/5 stars.  My brother says try the vegetable tom yum soup.

Ah rusty you foul behemoth.  How did this place ever become successful.? Is it because californians know nothing of pizza? Perhaps.  This pizza hut ripoff will run you more than 2x the cost.
