wBvq-Nm5pKHzlbtn9fLk5A.review_text: Nothing all that special here, especially for the price.  Considering it's really nothing more than average breakfast fare and your really only paying for the kitschy atmosphere I would look elsewhere for breakfast.  The prices as well are totally absurd...over $3 for a glass of juice!!  Shame on the staff and owners for taking advantage of the public to such a degree, especially in this economy.  There are many other places in Reno that have better breakfast for a FAR better price.

Not bad, not great.  The outdoor seating is ample and not so bad other than the fact that you are right on top of the main drag (S. Virginia) which can be annoying at times.  Went with my wife and she got the "chopped salad" & I got the "steak baguette."
    The chopped salad was not chopped, it was some variation of a chef salad which was rather upsetting.  I (we) have ordered chopped salads in places from NY to San Fran. and never have I been served a chopped salad that was not chopped.  This is not to say it was bad, just not what is listed on the menu.  IMO her salad was better than my sandwhich.
    The Steak Baguette was mediocre, especially for $11.00.  It had plenty of steak & onions, just not much flavor.  It also comes with what I assume is supposed to be some sort of side salad.  (I'm looking at you pathetic pile of lettuce scraps on my plate.) The whole thing was rather underwhelming.  I've had steak sandwiches from Coney Island that I felt were better and far cheaper.
   Overall a little pricey for what you get but not terrible.  Kinda middle of the road.  A once is enough kind of place.

Not to be missed.  This is your basic mid level family Mexican place.    Nothing is very fancy except the food which IMO in this case is a good thing.  Everything I have had here is fantastic.
   The tacos are small but they are only a $1.00 each and for $6.00 you get three with rice & beans and man are they delicious!  I highly recommend the Pollo mole as it is fantastic as well.
   Between my wife and I we have tried a large portion of the menu here and everything is great.  Some of the soups are a bit on the salty side so beware of that.  I can't say enough about #10 the Bisteak Ranchero which is amazing!!
   Other than the great quality & quantity of the food, the prices are fantastic!  Full entrees with rice and beans for around $6- $8 are common on the menu.  A meal for two with 2 Jarritos sodas comes in at about $20 which is tough to beat given the quantity & quality of the food.
   I've tried quite a few Mexican places (Me Casa too, Los compadres, El Adobe cafe) here in Reno and this one is hands down the best I have come across yet.  Do not miss it!
Total Wine has existed back east for a long time now so I was happy when one came here to Reno.  Huge selection, best prices, n'uff said.

Been here a few times now and overall this place is just average.   They are a specialty Deli using some off brand inferior deli meat which is crazy if you ask me.  If your going to focus on sandwiches use some quality meats such as Boars Head or at the very least Thumann's.
    The prices here are also absurd, you can easily spend $11 for a single sandwich!  That much money for inferior cold cuts in my sandwich is unacceptable.
    I was also disappointed to find out they do not have a true "Italian combo" anywhere in their menu.  To me this is a staple of any true deli on the planet.
    A lot of what they do have is fairly decent overall but not the best, especially when you factor in the high price.  As for lunch, I would look someplace other than the Beach Hut Deli.

My first experience with Vietnamese food was upon arriving here in Reno.  I have tried a few of them around the city but Pho 21 is easily my favorite.  We have been back here many times now and it never disappoints.
   The food is always excellent and you get a good portion as well.  It is very casual and friendly.  On thing I like is that it's a great spot to pop in, have and bit and go if your  in a hurry.
    The prices are great as well.  Two people can have a good dinner with drinks for about $20 bucks! I recommend the Thai iced tea or the Jasmin tea as they are both delicious.  Once again price point and quality of food and portion combine for a well deserved 5 star rating.

My wife and I just came from lunch here and what a treat.  She had pork Pad Thai and I had the #27 Spicy Basil with beef.  We also got the chicken satay appetizer.
    Our appetizer was wonderful especially the peanut sauce and the cucumber salad.  Both were fantastic.  Our main courses did not disappoint either.  Very flavorful, fresh and filling.  The portions were just right, not too big, not too small.
    My only gripe is the fact that it was a bit on the pricey side.....a little over $40 for lunch for two.  I am willing to let it slide as the meals were so excellent but if you are looking for a cheap lunch special, this is not the place to go.  If you are looking for fresh flavorful Thai food this is a great choice.  Highly recommended.

Went here for breakfast the other morning and everything was okay  but nothing to get excited about at all.  The decor is kinda neat and the food was really average and priced about average as well.  My main problem was the street trash (bums) and hookers hanging out near the bathrooms and front entrance.  From the time we entered to the time we left there was some sort of human vermin hanging out in the entrance of this place.  Why this is tolerated is beyond me. Don't know about you but this is totally unacceptable in my book.   I will never go back, one visit was all it took to make that very clear for both of us.

Stopped in here as I have been on a quest for good pizza ever since I moved to Reno.  I got two pepperoni slices with my hopes high.  I had to wait about 15 minutes for my slices as they were out of pizza at the moment and had to make more.  Really?  Out of pizza at lunch time? My slices finally came & the minute I saw them I knew it was not going to be good.  Worst pizza I have ever had in my life anywhere!!  It made me think, "This must be what it's like to eat play-doh."   All I can say is when it comes to pizza, avoid pizza Reno at all costs.

Gotta say I love Popeye's chicken.  Glad there is actually one here in Sparks.  Back east Popeye's is everywhere and we used to get it quite a bit.  Happy to say everything is just as good with this chain here as it was there.  Sometimes chains can be radically different on different coasts....Pizza hut for example.  Almost everything on the menu is good except for the chicken po'boy, it's just weak sorry to say.  Also, it may be seasonal but if you have never had a Popeye's Cajun turkey for thanksgiving you really should give it a try.  We just ordered ours tonight for the 3rd year in a row.  You'll wonder how you ever ate a KFC after Popeye's granted that's not saying a whole lot but hey......it's fast food.

Coming from back east, especially the NY metro area, Mediterranean food is kind of a staple in every day life.  I was hopeful when we went to Naan & Kabab last night for my birthday and all I can say is, simply amazing!  The staff and decor are wonderful.  The food was fantastic, some of the best Mediterranean I have ever had in my life.  Easily the best dining experience and food I have had anywhere in Reno to date.  Hands down!  If you have not been here I highly recommend it!

Being from back east, living in Jersey and working in NY and the 5 boroughs for roughly 15 years I like to think I know something about a good pizza pie.  Unfortunately good pizza does not seem to exist anywhere out west, or so I thought.  I really did not want to believe what many of my friends who moved out this way and then moved back had always said to me about it being impossible to find good pizza on the west coast. Tried this place and although still not as good as pizza from back home, it's damn close.  Hands down far and away the best pizza I have had since moving to Reno a year ago.  I've tried quite a few other pizza places and have been completely let down by all of them out here.  My only grip is that their prices are absurd.  As of January 5, 2011 I could get a large pie with 1 topping in Jersey or the city for about $13 bucks.  The fact that they charge $20 dollars for a pie is obscene.....totally criminal.  Other than that, best pizza in the whole city of Reno, no contest.

Not so many Chinese places out here in Reno compared to back east so I was a little skeptical at first.  I must say I was pleasantly surprised.  The food was fantastic!  We wound up getting Generals chicken, sweet & sour pork, egg fried & pork fried rice as well as hot & sour soup.  Everything was wonderful and fresh.  Some slight differences out west which were actually rather nice.  I am used to getting a bowl of crunchy chow mein noodles and duck sauce to snack on before the meal arrives.  In it's place we got a chicken salad in a delicious peanut dressing that was excellent.  Some prices seemed a little high (especially on the soups) and some seemed very fair.  Overall a great experience and I surely will go back and recommend it to friends.

Went here last night for the first time and overall it was okay.  The decor leaves a lot to be desired.  Kinda has a Cajun warehouse feel to it, everything feels contrived and forced to me.  Plenty of space though and the upstairs balcony theme where the bands play seems very cool, note to self: come back when they have live music.

The bread appetizer was horrible, just avoid it.  We got the voodoo wings appetizer, crawfish etouffee and Cajun chicken and beef stir fry.  The wings were excellent.  They were crispy with a great sauce, some of my favorites anywhere in fact.  The crawfish was excellent as well and I'm not a big seafood guy but I did try it as the wife loved it so much she convinced me to give it a go.  My stir fry was mediocre.  Sure there was plenty of it, just not so much flavor.  They did not skimp on the chicken and beef which was nice but I had to throw on some salt and add some of the house "Voodoo sauce" to kick up the flavor a bit.  Overall not bad, but not great.

With an appetizer and two iced teas the meal came out to about $40 almost $50 with tip. This isn't too bad but not so great considering we really had no leftovers to speak of (I polished off the tiny bit of stir fry I had left for breakfast today.)  I will go back to try a few other things but I don't think I will put this place into my regular rotation of favorite establishments in the area.

First off I realize it's spelled "PHO" but it is pronounced "FU" as in without the "CK" ending.  This place was not so great overall.  It smelled a little off, especially in the back.  I got the curry chicken and the wife got Fried wonton & seafood soup.

The curry chicken was totally bland and also basically lacking one thing, chicken.  I was really let down by it overall.  The soup, which I did try, was okay but still not as good as our usual place, PHO 21.  We also got pork egg rolls for an appetizer which again, were okay but nothing great.

It was also about $6 bucks more for the same amount of food as compared to our usual spot as well.  They did have a wide variety of things to choose from on the menu but with what we had tonight being so poor I doubt we will be back to try much else.  The other thing I didn't really care for was our waitress.  She left me feeling like we were a nuisance to her overall because we had the audacity to come into the establishment and order food.

With so many Vietnamese places in Reno you can surely find one better than this place.  I highly recommend PHO 21 just off McCarran next to the Flowing Tide Pub, much better.

Update:  Went back the other night and I had the Mango curry beef with steamed brown rice and bean curd & spinach soup.  The wife got Singapore chow fun and hot & sour soup.  All I can say is everything was incredibly good.  How this place is not jam packed to the gills is beyond me to say the least.  I am updating my previous rating of 4 stars to a raging 5.  Do not miss this restaurant.

Went here for breakfast yesterday morning and what a treat!  The 50's throwback decor is great and I must say the place was immaculately clean.  I ordered the Kafta kabab and the wife got 3 eggs over easy with home fries, bacon and rye toast.

My kabab was great and very filling.  The french fries were fantastic as well, perfectly crisp yet not burnt.  Her eggs were done to perfection and the bacon was really something else, huge thick slices that were just right!  Even her toast was excellent.  The home fries were large chunks of potatoes with diced onion and green pepper.  Overall everything we got was excellent.

The only low spot for me was the price, our breakfast came out to $26 bucks which is a little on the pricey side when it comes to breakfast for two if you ask me, especially with all the super cheap breakfast deals at places throughout Reno and the surrounding areas.  They do have week day specials for only $5.99  that  appeal to the wallet as well as the palate, we will surely go back to try some of those items as well.  

Overall, after our first experience with Joe's I would recommend it to anyone looking for a good hearty meal in a great atmosphere.

The location in NW Reno continues to please time after time.  Fantastic value for the money.  Not to mention the quality and tasty factor!  At this point I have to try the Sparks location to see if it is as good.  You can't go wrong at the NW Reno location though, guaranteed.

Went here tonight with a big group from the wife's work.  Overall it left me feeling kinda "Meh."

Ordinarily I would not comment on the Sushi as I do not like it personally so I don't eat it, but I will make an exception in this case.  One of our party got a bad piece of tuna and looked as though he was going to get ill right at the table.  Maybe this can happen from time to time at any Sushi place, I have no idea, but it did not sit well with me and  a few others in our group.

I got the Schezuan lamb and a cup of hot & sour soup.  The soup was fairly good except for the fact that they used a bit too much white pepper so it was too spicy.  The lamb was just plain poor.  It was not spicy at all and very fatty as well.  It really tasted like nothing but soy sauce,  I was left very let down, especially after the good luck I had over at Dynasty on California.

As I mentioned I am not a fan of Sushi and my entree being so poor,  I doubt I will ever return here again, especially since Hiroba is close to the house, we head there when the wife gets a craving.  Overall I have to say I really can't recommend this place based on tonights experience, I'm gonna go with 3 stars for now in the off chance I do go back but I feel that is being too kind, tonight was honestly a two star experience in my opinion.

Stopped in here today for lunch while we were out running errands.  What a treat!  I got the healthy BBQ chicken and she got the BBQ beef Hawaiian plate.  Everything was tasty and fresh!!  My salad was especially good as was the dressing.  The chicken and beef were excellent as well.  The best part was it was plenty of food for the both of us and with a drink the whole thing was under $20 bucks!  Tough to beat for the amount & quality of the food!  Can't wait to go back and try some other stuff on their menu.
Gotta knock'em down a peg sine the arrival of Bronx Pizzeria.  Still think they are great but if I had to pick only one, I'd go with Bronx pizzeria all the way.

Went here for dinner the other night and again, everything was excellent.  I got the Moroccan steak and the wife got Diablo prawns.  We also got the wing kabob appetizer and each a Shirazi salad as well.  Everything was wonderful and chef Maurice was kind enough to share his recipe for the Shirazi salad going so far as to provide me with the label for the specific vinegar he uses, such a gracious host. We finished with an awesome dude, which was genuinely awesome.  Can't wait for our next trip back to try something else.
Knocked this place down to 2 stars as it is how I truly felt after my first experience....

Had a Groupon so we went here for lunch today to try it for the first time.  I must say I really liked the interior and the decor, very cool.  This place actually feels like a small pizzeria down in alphabet city, kinda reminds me of Two Boots actually.

Anyhow, we got a salad to share and the "Big Apple" style pie which came with roni, mushrooms, green pepper, black olives, sausage and onion.  It was actually quite good with a decent crisp crust.  My only complaint (and this really is a personal thing) was the size of the slices....they sliced the pizza to death creating a bunch of super small slices.  Being as that was my only real complaint I was very happy with our meal.  The salad was good with crisp fresh greens, red onion, tomatoes and sliced carrots.

The other thing that was cool is they had some very cool sounding varieties of pizza that I want to go back and try, mainly the "luna azul" which sounded really good.  I would like to try their wings as well.  The staff was friendly and efficient.

Not the best pizza place in Reno but certainly not the worst either, worth stopping in to give it a go.

Second time we have been to this place but my first review of it.  Overall I really like this place, very clean with great meal presentation.  Tonight I got the Beef Yakiniku and the wife got the Seafood Udon.

My meal came with miso soup, tempura shrimp & veggies, white rice and a green salad.  Everything was excellent.  The salad was fresh and crisp with a good variety of greens and a great dressing.  The tempura shrimp and veggies were pipping hot and just right crisp.  The beef was fantastic with just the right amount of their wonderful BBQ sauce.  Gotta say I love this place.

The wife loved her seafood udon which was rather huge.  I gave it a shot and enjoyed it myself.  That makes twice now that this place has made me full and happy, I highly recommend it.

After reading some of the other reviews for this place I am in shock.  I guess they had a bad waitress at one point but our service has been fantastic both times and again, the food is great.

I went in here rather unsure of what to expect and I was pleasantly surprised.  I got the grilled Italian for lunch the other day on my way to work.  I gotta say, it was delicious and filling, even if it was 10 bucks for the sandwich and a drink.

My biggest complaint is I waited nearly a full 15 minutes before I got my sandwich which is a little extreme in my opinion.  Other than that though, a great sandwich!

Just got back from the grand opening and man it was great.  They were PACKED and fully staffed.  The manager was having a great time rhyming everyone's order number and I will forever remain guest "264 that came back for more!"  I got the extra hot popcorn chicken with french fries and then went back for a 5 piece chicken strips.  Two new things I have never had at Popeye's previously presented themselves on this visit.  The first being french fries, which were excellent and the second being a sauce called "sweet heat" which was also excellent.  As far as fast food goes, Popeyes is tough to beat.  The service was great and everyone was in great spirits, a fantastic opening day, I wish them the best of luck.

I really wish they would implement the 1/2 star rating as this is officially a 3.5 for my first visit here.  The location is a bit odd but it is a charming in a minimalist sense  once inside.

The service was great but then again, we were the only people in the place which I hope is not the norm as I would like to see this establishment prosper.  I got the skirt steak with mushrooms, rice, salad and corn salad.  The wife got the skirt steak and pork chop plate with rice and lentils.

Overall everything was good, not amazing but good.  The meats appear to all be prepared roughly the same way which is grilled and seasoned with an authentic Chimichurri sauce, which is fairly typical for almost any portion of central or south America.

My salad was a bit of a disappointment as it was miniscule in size and consisted mostly of shredded iceberg.  The corn salad was simply mixed vegetables, nothing more. The only thing that really wasn't great at all was the appetizer of bread they brought out.  The bread was cheap and of poor quality and haphazardly smeared with what appeared to be more Chimichurri, I don't recommend it.  The portions were large and the prices were fair so we will be returning to further sample the menu in the future.

I left feeling a little underwhelmed though, I think mainly because the food was good, but not great. It was very much like a meal I would do on the grill at home only not as good, it also lacked a true ethnic feel overall.

Went to this FTF wth some friends for the first time tonight and it was very cool.  Live music, train rides and face painting for the kids, overall lots of fun.

I had a hot link sandwich from one truck that the name of escapes me at the moment, which is probably for the best as it wasn't very good.  I also tried a Bodog (not sure if that is how it is spelled) and it was great, very tasty especially with the neon pink onions and bodacious sauce!  There was a crepe truck as well that looked very good and some great dessert style trucks as well.  They served wine and beer until 8 as it is apparently a city ordinance that they have to stop then, overall this was a very fun time.

My only gripe is at the people that feel the need to bring their dogs to such an event...really?  The place is full of people eating out in the park with their kids and you need to bring along your dog?  Do everyone a favor and leave the dog at home for this outing, it's common courtesy.  I have never been to the FTF downtown but after talking with others in attendance apparently this one is much nicer and less crowded.

Went back here again this Friday and it was fantastic again.  They had two bands during the time I was there and a host of new trucks as well.  The Dish truck was there as well as Kenji's and a really good wood fired pizza truck as well.  Fat Burger even had a truck there and I loves me some fat burger but there are so many trucks with totally original menus that it's tough to settle for a burger at this event.

I got  3 Asian tacos from Kenji's, beef, chicken, and pork and they were fantastic.  The spicy cucumber on top was delicious!  I also tried a slice of the wood fired peperoni and I am happy to report that it too was excellent.

Again, my only complaint....dogs....everywhere dogs....please people, have some consideration for the type of event you are going to and the amount of small children present and leave the dog at home already!

Stopped in at the new location for the first time a few days back as we took grandma out for some pizza and overall, not an improvement.  It is extremely loud, like eating in a giant tin can and the sun can be blinding as it is like sitting in a giant glass box.

I can't imagine they changed the recipe after the move but somehow the pizza just wasn't as good as my previous experiences.  I probably won't be back I am sorry to say....not when I have better choices closer to home.

An old friend of the wives was in town and we took him here for dinner since the truck stop he was staying at was just around the way.  Also, we frequent the Mae Anne location so it was a great excuse to give this one a try!

Again, everything was fantastic, spot on delicious.  We got an assortment of tacos, guacamole and chips, bi steak ranchero and an enchilada.  Personally for myself this location surpased the location at Mae Ann.  Mind you, not by much as they are so similar but everything was just excellent.  I also noticed this location has a few items that do not appear on the menu up at the Mae Ann location which surprised me.

Also, just like the other location the prices are great.  Good portions, great prices and yummy food once again combine to make tacos El Rey our "go to" choice for authentic Mexican food.

I have eaten at this truck 3 or 4 times now and overall the food is good but the service can leave a LOT to be desired.

While attending this past weeks FTF over at Idlewild park I was on line for Kenji's.  I spent quite literally 20 minutes in line before getting to the window and placing my order.  Once my order was placed the gentleman looked at me and THEN decides to tell me "ohh BTW we have a lot of tickets in so it will be another 15-20 minutes until your food is ready,"  being hungry and not seeing much choice as most other lines were long as well we decided to wait.  One of our party decided to set a timer as he was already rather miffed to say the least over the wait.  Well folks, after   another 36 minutes pass, not 15-20 mind you, we had basically told them we want our money back and just to leave, we finally get our food.  Over an hours wait for 8 tacos and some mac salad.

My whole point is this, either invest in a ticker for the truck that announces the wait time from the window or call it out to the people on line so your customers can make a more informed decision as to whether or not they want to wait that long for the food or try their luck someplace else.

Like I said, I enjoy their food but this experience really pissed me off to say the least and although I am only one person, I am one person that Kenji's has lost as a customer due to this incident that I feel could have easily been prevented with a little common courtesy.

Awesome BBQ for sure!  We went here for lunch today and were greeted by the owner Michael (MJ) just as he was opening up for the afternoon.  Before we even made up our minds he brought us a sampler plate of Tilapia, ribs and pork.  All of which was wonderful, especially his BBQ sauce which was sweet without being overly so as well as tangy.  The wifey wound up getting a combo plate of ribs and fried catfish with greens and mac n' cheese.  I choose the hotlinks sandwich with greens and mac n' cheese as well.  Everything was fantastic, good portions and great flavor.  The hot link sandwich was actually spicy which was a refreshing change and the greens were flavorful with no hint of woody texture to them at all.  The mac n' cheese seemed to be done with a white cheddar and was excellent.  They smoke everything right outside in the parking lot on a big trailer with various smokers on it so you can't miss the place once you are in the lot!  Michael was a wonderful and gracious host and made us feel right at home immediately.  If your are into good BBQ go give this fledgling business some support and you will not be disappointed.

First time here the other day and boy were we impressed.  Great portions, great food!  I had an open faced steak sandwich with mushrooms and onions and a cranberry juice while my lady got a half order of biscuits and gravy with poached egg.  Everything was outrageous!  My steak sandwich was perfectly cooked with tasty mushrooms and onions galore.  The little woman's biscuits were of mammoth proportions and smothered in heaps of tasty gravy.  Her poached egg was absolutely perfect (her words).  It was a tad pricey, breakfast for 2 wound up costing just under $35 with no leftovers but the quality was there so I would absolutely go back for sure!

Went here for dinner the other night with my lady and we loved it.  I got some special burger that was a mix of ground beef & pancetta, with an extra sharp Vermont cheddar, red onion and arugula.  All I can say is this was one of the most mouthwatering outrageous burgers I have had in ages!!  Utterly delicious.  My lady got the duck salad which she absolutely loved.  It had a great mix of various greens and plenty of duck.

I sampled a chocolate cake cherry beer that was also delicious even if it was a bit heavy.  I highly recommend this place as everything on the menu sounded fantstic, we will surely be back soon to explore more of their food.

Went here tonight for dinner to see how it was compared to Green Papaya.  Things started out okay but took a turn for the worse fast.  We ordered herbed wings, crispy duck and the beef salad.  Twenty minutes goes by and no wings, at all.  The place was nearly empty so we asked if there was a problem with our order.  Apparently not the thing to do at all as some sort of fried wings were rushed out to us that did not appear to be "herbed" in any way shape or form.  The gracious attitude of our hostess disappeared as well and she was now rather callous and acted as if we were a nuisance suddenly.  My beef salad was good as was the duck but neither could save the abysmal service and poor attitude of our waitress.  I would only eat here again if I called something in for take-out, overall a very poor experience.  I will also mention that the removal of the partitioning makes the place feel cold and like you are sitting right on top of everyone else, there is no sense of privacy or intimacy at all.

First things first, THANK YOU for not even offering ranch dressing or pineapple as a topping.  Neither of which has any place on a good pizza pie.  Being from NJ and working in NYC for 15 years I search out good pizza anyplace I go.  For the most part out west here is a pretty big disappointment when it comes to pizza but Grimaldi's is outstanding!  Great toppings, wonderful sauce and a nice thin crispy crust.  The salads are also fantastic and are of a decent size.  They also have a great wine selection!  If you have been searching for a great pizzeria this is it!

wdhr6pmWJBTkHHn7EFGegA.review_text: First time at Brisbi's last night. We were a table of 8 which can be difficult to manage. It was a college graduation celebration and my future daughter in law was looking for a lake dining experience to cap off her years at UNO. She couldn't have found a better spot. The food was delicious! We sat outside on a breezy spring evening...fabulous! Would recommend to anyone who liked Bart's back in the day because when I walked in and saw the bar that was the first place I thought of!

Memorial Day craving barbecue, my husband and I went to Saucy's. The brisket was tender, as well as ribs, meat falling off the bone! The mini sweet potato muffins are a scrumptious sweet to complement their signature vinegar sauce. The only reason I gave them 4/5 stars is that it was really hot to eat in there.
Great sandwiches love the bread!!! Milk shakes are to die for!!! Only draw back is everything is served to go. Love me some Christmas in July

Delicious food and friendly service. Great place to go on a date night or early dinner. The desserts are wonderful!! We had a sample plate of them all. Outstanding creme brûlée! Need to bring my sons for $5 old fashion night!

As a rule I enjoy eating at Another Broken Egg franchises. This location was an enormous disappoint. I was waiting to have breakfast with my sons. I was seated immediately even though my sons had not yet arrived. I sat a table for 15 minutes. No one approached me. I even asked the host for a cup of coffee which never came. I finally walked out and went to Russell's Marina Grill instead, where I was immediately greeted at my table and asked if they could bring me some coffee while I waited. This location could learn a little something in customer relations from Russell's!

Great place for lunch with friends. Crab cakes and oyster artichoke soup delicious! Good cocktails. 
Friendly service....our waitress was so sweet especially since we asked her to take our picture 5 times
Great place to stop for lunch. Had the chicken salad sandwich with duck and mushroom gumbo. The chicken salad was a little dry, but the chicken was spiced perfectly. The gumbo was on point!
Best gelato, cannoli, and almond crescents anywhere!!! Service is awesome and friendly! Family owned for over 100 years! Definitely one of my favorite spots in NOLA!
Koz's Oyster's and Muffs are on point! Praline Cheesecake is like Cheesecake with a praline candy bar finisher! It's a beautiful day on the river!

Delicious! Our first time! The egg drop soup and crab Rangoon were great appetizers! Chicken and shrimp lettuce wrap were well seasoned. Had sweet and sour chicken, all white meat sauce comes on the side. Fresh tasting with friendly service!
Had dinner at the bar with Pete and Garrett!! Grilled artichokes, baked potato soup and grilled snapper with asparagus....key lime pie for desert...outstanding food and service!!!!
Gendusa French bread for my po-boy....yum!!! Pork Chops and baked mac on point...Sophie having her usual chicken tenders and fries....fast, friendly service

Cool vibe, great service and delicious fried oysters....we had Eggs Florentine which left us with the florentine sauce and hash browns (really more Brabant) to take home. Crabby eggs were good....need to clean the shells out of their claw meat before they make the crab cakes; I had two big pieces of shell in mine. All in all a good brunch in a hipster part of town.

Had my retirement luncheon there on Sunday afternoon! My team loved the endless champagne or mimosasI felt pampered by my team and the staff! Mallory was awesome..taking pictures and meeting all of our needs! Congratulations, Shawn!!! Written at the top of our personalized menus was an extra added bonus! Thank you Ralph's for a beautiful luncheon I will not forget!

My first DD experience and I must say I was duly impressed.  My husband and I went to the Elmwood store for lunch after a morning movie.  The atmosphere was fun and energetic. A young family was next to us.  The toddler was eying my waffle fries, which could have been hotter thus the 4-star rating. I love my hot fries! We had one of each of the sliders each one better than the other. My favorite was the debris roast beef with a fried onion ring on top! I had always heard about the cinnamon roll. It's def a must have, bruléed of course! Thanks, Derek Brennan and the rest of the friendly staff for a delightful luncheon experience.
Picked up Saturday date night dinner!! Delish! Easy order and curbside pick up! #shoplocal #eatlocal
Great place for brunch and breakfast! Lovely outdoor dining. Contactless ordering and payment.

I have wanted to come here since they opened. It did not disappoint! The entire service staff was friendly and accommodating. The short ribs and crawfish cracked potatoes were delicious. The hype for this restaurant is well deserved.

wgMd9fAF7qNu_QiZIg757Q.review_text: I was very disappointed with my experience here.  When I arrived I was told there was a 40 minute wait.  I asked the host if there was anything gluten free, such as gluten free bread or muffins. He went inside to ask and came back telling me there were indeed such items. After waiting the 40 minutes and being seated, I did not see anything gluten free on the menu. I asked the server and she said there was ONE gluten free item on the entire menu. It was some sort of egg dish. There was no gluten free bread to be found anywhere. I was not impressed with the quality of food. I will not be returning here.

Okay yes, this place has gluten free. And yes, the service was very friendly.  But I was not impressed with the place as a whole.  I ordered a sandwich on gf bread, and my boyfriend ordered tacos. Our order came out to almost $30 which I thought was ridiculous for the amount of food that we got. Also, this place is in the French Market, which means there is pretty much no where to sit. We also waited almost 45 minutes for our food that we ordered to go.  Don't think I will be returning here.

OH my goodness.  I was here for dinner on Saturday night, and it was incredible. Our server was incredible friendly and knew exactly which items on the menu were gluten free for me. I had the garlic sausage and it was delicious! When I asked which desserts were gluten free, he responded that all of them were! We had the chocolate mousse and it was to die for. I can't wait to go back.

After reading the reviews of this place I was pretty disappointed with my visit here.  I have celiac, so I was excited to actually get to eat a sandwich in New Orleans for once. We walked in and were seated right away. I asked our server which things on the menu were gluten free. She went to check and then came back and told me the macaroni and cheese was gluten free. I was super excited until another server came over and said that was not true. Then I ordered a sandwich on gluten free bread. When the food came, my sandwich was on raisin bread. I am not a fan. They should definitely specify on the menu that the gf bread is a sweet bread, and not a normal bread. Service was good, minus the false advertising of gf mac and cheese. Probably won't be returning.

I was really disppointed with this place. After reading the reviews I was really excited to try out a new restaurant, especially one with gluten free options. There are no other Italian places that offer gluten free in the New Orleans area. When I asked for the gluten free focaccia they told me it was only available during lunch. They said my only option would be the gluten free pasta. While the regular pasta is all handmade, the gluten free pasta was obviously from a box and the texture was really strange. The tomato sauce was watery and bland. The service was really good but unfortunately that was the only positive thing I can say.

This place is amazing. I've been here twice and the second time was even better than the first. They have fresh squeezed juices that they make cocktails with and the food is even better than the drinks. I had the arepa sampler and it was so beautifully presented. The pulled pork melted in my mouth. And everything is gluten free!! I will definitely recommend this place to everyone I know.

I usually love going to Sukho Thai, but this evening was the exception to that. First of all the restaurant was empty when we got there so service should have been really quick but it was not. We waited at least 10 minutes for the server to come take our drink order. It was also freezing in the restaurant and when we asked about it the server told us the manager hadn't bought the proper filter to run the heat yet... Our drinks took about 20 minutes to come out and then when the food arrived it was not what we ordered. I was very disappointed in this experience and hope this does not happen again.

I had a great experience at Swegs. As a person with celiac disease, I have a hard time eating in New Orleans and as soon as I walked in and spoke with the chef he assured me they take food allergies very seriously. They had gluten free pizza and several other options for me. They also had gluten free snacks and cookies that would be great for a meal to go. I will definitely be back.

This has quickly become my favorite coffee shop in New Orleans. I love the ambiance of this shop. They are family friendly but can also be a peaceful place to study or read. I usually get a mocha, but everything I have tried has been delicious. The food is also amazing and they have several gluten free options with is excellent for me. The staff is always extremely friendly and accommodating. I only wish I lived closer!

So excited to finally have a cider bar in town! They brew their own cider so you can try a local cider, or enjoy one of the guest ciders they have on tap. There are plenty of places to sit inside and a lovely patio out back to enjoy when the weather allows. Definitely going to be a regular here.

This was my first time dining here and it was such a great experience. I had a reservation and was seated right away at a nice table by the window. I had a beautiful champagne cocktail and my date had a glass of prosecco. I told the server I have celiac and she went through all of my options on the menu. They were about to make a caprese for me that was so incredibly delicious. For dinner I had the gluten free pasta which was some of the best I've ever had. Our server was so sweet and attentive and the dinner was super reasonable. We will definitely be back!

I am so excited to have a coffee shop in the neighborhood! I visited this gem for the first time a couple days after they opened. It is tucked away next to the community center. I met the owner, Courtney and she is incredibly sweet and friendly. They sell French Truck Coffee, which is delicious and they have a selection of pastries, including some vegan and gluten free goodies. There is plenty of space to sit and relax and I will definitely be back.

Hooray!! A place for gluten free breakfast tacos in New Orleans finally arrives. This new spot is entirely gluten free (unheard of in New Orleans). There are about 4 or 5 different tacos on the simple menu. We tried a couple of them and were impressed.  The queso was delicious as well. I am so happy to have a place to feed my breakfast taco craving.

I have nothing but good things to say about this place. I have been twice so far and both visits were excellent. The first time I went I spoke to the server about having celiac and he was very thorough in discussing my options. I had the broccoli cauliflower salad with chicken and it was delicious. The second time I went I had a burger wrapped in lettuce and it was perfectly done and exactly what I wanted. Everyone was so friendly and accommodating. They also have Scarpetta sparkling rose which is my favorite. I can't wait to go back!

I am so excited about this new spot! First off, they have great drinks. I had a chai latte with oat milk and it was so delicious and refreshing. They also have a TON of gluten free options which makes me so happy. I had the gf bagel with cream cheese and it was excellent. The owner chatted with me for quite awhile and told me about all the items she could make for me on the menu. I will definitely be back.

I had an excellent first experience here. When I first arrived the fellow working the register called over the chef and he told me nearly everything in the restaurant is gluten free. The only item that wasn't was the fish since it was beer battered. I ordered a quesadilla and a margarita. My wife had the pork tacos and the fried cheese. We sat at the bar and the bartender was super friendly and our drinks were delicious!  The food came out smelling great and tasting even better. The flavors were fantastic together and the tortilla was very pretty, it looked like a cactus tortilla. We will definitely be back!

Super excited about this new coffee shop in Metairie! The owner was there and served us. She was really friendly and enjoyable to talk to. The shop was spotless and well decorated. The coffee was tasty and they even had gluten free pastries from a bakery in Denver! We will definitely be back.

Wow! What a great experience. My wife heard about this spot through a coworker and I'm so glad we checked it out. When we arrived we spoke with one of the owners to order. He was extremely knowledgeable about celiac and ensured that everything I ordered would be gluten free and safe for me. I had the chickpeas, the elote and the beans and rice. My wife had the Manolito Swampwater and a Cuban sandwich. Everything was delicious. We will definitely be back. Thanks ya'll!

xI11p4t2Co7RwWuBc82lPg.review_text: Friendly staff. Great food. Good prices. Very clean bar open till 4am on the weekends. Check it out and enjoy your time.

A most excellent gem in Gloucester City. We are not fans of seafood but ordered the chicken parm and it was the best we have ever had. If you are in town we suggest you to check out this establishment. Yummy.
Some very good southwest bbq food. Our waiter was very entertained us. We took advantage of the all you can eat ribs and filled our stomachs to our hearts content. Looking forward to our return trip.
Food was very good along with the staff. The waitress was helpful and she had good timing with delievering the food and asking questions...def will be going back
Very good experience. Friendly staff. Food was fresh and appropriate temp. We will be coming back. Just the General Tso's Chicken was a little too sweet
Excellent amount of food with their early bird specials from 2-5pm. Food was average at best. People were friendly and everything was clean. Prices were pretty good
always like this venue ...1st time was to see Slayer. Awesome
aawesome prices. Great food and friendly staff. Looks like this will be our new haunt
The world famous pickle bar...good if you like pickles. Staff was nice...food was good ...and there was a ton of cheese on the pizza. The only neg was the small seats.

Was between jobs and needed to eat. Kind of on the expensive side. Git the bacon burgers and garlic knots....the burger meat was kinf if plain but the onions, hot sauce, and bacon made it good when you are hungry.

When we 1st walked in we were taken back...VERY crowded. We waited a few minutes to be seated. The service was slightly slow, but understandable on a busy Saturday night.....the food was some of the best that we ever had. Cant wait to try the Merryfield burger. Cant wait to go back and catch our new fave band, Sordid Past.
Ugh usually a good visit but the meat was pink and the customer service was horrible.
i never 5 stars, but this visit was perfect and here is my 5 star. The waitress was awesome, good prices, full portions and the beer was cold and non skunky. We will be back!
Freindly staff. Great food. Good prices. General Tsos done right! We will be back.
Usually this place is top notch...this time around the food was good but the customer service was sub par....

Great place. I only dined here three times but each time the food was great. The other night we did a pizza pick up and they messed up thr order so the manager gave us free beer for our wait. We will be back.
Great food, friendly staff with good prices and portions. Each time i was there the owners were also with a warm welcome. In a time when customer service is a dying art...they bring it back.

Great place. You just cannot beat the prices here, they are about 1/2 the price of a grocery store but much more fresh. Come here to stock up on fruits and vegetables.

If there was to be a downside it would just have to be the traffic/parking situation..right on the Brooklawn circle.

A great place, it has been 2 years since the last time we were there and I will not make that mistake again. The amount of food you get for the price is phenomenal. 

All the staff has been exceptional towards us and cannot wait to go back and try out other entries on their menu. 

Support your local businesses!

Food is good...but sadly the service is not. Had an issue with an order and was met with resistance. When my wife called to inform the shop he did apologize, then asked "What do you want me to do?" Then hung up on her.

xIgBho-drdd-sXcPebxtrg.review_text:
Bleu Sushi- I had to write a review of this place. First off, I made a reservation and showed up on time realizing that we forgot to BYOB! We asked if we could run out real quick and be back in ten minutes.. This was not an issue and they saved our table.

Ambience- Really nice, dark, candle lit, not overly romantic, more HIP then anything. it was warm with both the ambience and Ora.

Sushi- I typically do not eat a lot of rolls maybe 2. This particular night I must have ate 3-4 rolls. I would say this is due to how lite the sushi was. By the end I was filled but not "stuffed".. which is a great thing in my book.  So I have been to other places where the specialty rolls are OUTRAGEOUS--- deep fried so on and so forth. The specialty rolls at Bleu are simple. BUT HAVE AMAZING FLAVOR AND FRESHNESS. I believe that simplicity is the highest form of sophistication and Bleu is proof of just that. 

Service- The owner greets you and talks to you about himself and the restaurant. He inquires about your names and how you have enjoyed your meal. In all honesty, such interactions can lack genuinity. This interaction did not.. He was genuine, interested, engaging, and kind. He gave us a card and said "text me when you come in and ill make sure you have the best table available." I like stuff like this and the owner is privy to what brings a person back- Atmosphere, food, service, and feeling a connection. 

-Lastly, i got a groupon for this place. Typically (no offense) groupon restaurants are 3-4 stars and have their pitfalls. This place is exceptional and I was happy to see it on Groupon. 

Recommendations -Bleu roll- Great
Temple Roll- My favorite
Drexel- was also great

WE WILL BE BACK!!

-Greg Amatrudo

(3.5)- The atmosphere was over shadowed by the D.J booth and dance floor act. My Fada woulda scuffed if I brought him here. 

Whenever calamari is not served with marinara it's a problem.

Not a fan

A solid buffalo Chicken burrito (which you don't see everywhere).  I also enjoyed the avocado fries (4/5). Although, I think there should be more avocado fries!! I too went on the first day and they got slammed- it was apparent.They did not have a credit card machine set up but Joe, the owner, was nice enough to comp the meal ! I live in Pennsport and this is a friendly addition to the neighborhood with good food .

Recently tried the pulled pork burrito and the bugs bunny burrito . BOTH PRETTY PHENOMENAL!

As a transport to Pennsport I sought a legitimate "spot" for sandwiches. This place is the best ! The cheesesteaks, hoagies, Everything is Great. 

A quick recommendation that most people miss is that they offer sandwiches in 3 different sizes !!! The smallest is $3.95 and is ALMOST the size of a wawa classic!!  I tend to go small and buy a few!!

Felt compelled to leave a review for this place - we went here with a group of 10 for a birthday. We were looking for something classy, trendy, but not too stuffy .. It was the perfect spot and enough things hanging on the walls to keep your attention. I also have to say that the food was also excellent . Highly recommend Mac and cheese. Drinks were also great! Went upstairs after dinner to party and the scene was great (music was terrible though :/ indie night?) -overall great experience, we will be back !

Just moved to Pennsport and Moonshine is a great place - I wish there was more space so that it would get the recognition it deserves. Great food, great service, and 5$ bloodys for brunch ... I'm in .
Best buffalo chicken pizza in philly . I'm from NY and looked and tried everywhere .. This is the best you will get!

If I would give zero stars I could . The service is horrendous . I work next door in the wellness center and I am forced to stop here everyday for coffee . My average wait time is 15 minutes drive through . I have got the wrong meal SEVERAL times and unfortunately had a lot of trouble even understanding the person speaking at the drive through . They are well staffed but seem to have no direction . I watch as people honk and cringe every morning due to how terrible the service is . It's sickening how I still go to this place - if it was not in such a good spot and i didn't need a coffee I would not go . STAY AWAY and please hire employees that can do the job . A Dunkin by my home (south philly) has similar volume and half the staff - they kill it- I CANT SAY ENOUGH OF HOW TERRIBLE THE SERVICE IS!!!!!!

This is a real time review! I am sitting in Neon Lobster right now- they didn't have water and offered us free sodas :) I am eavesdropping on the staff who is super friendly to every customer that comes in or calls . As the smell grows stronger - my appetite grows bigger (I'm waiting on bacon wrapped Scallops and two warm lobster rolls).  (10 minutes in) I can smell the lobster and hear my bacon squealing!! My mouth is now watering and my girlfriend is growing more hangry! As I wrote this they came out and said sorry for the wait your scallops are cooking!  Hold on here comes the food- it is simply amazing !!! I can't say enough !!!now let finish eating damnit !!!

The Dutch is my new spot. I moved to Pennsport about 6 months about and I am very excited to see this place open up. It is clear that they know what they are doing - simplicity=sophistication and they have struck an excellent balance .

I think this place also goes by Millie's burgers steaks and shakes - nonetheless -I wouldn't feed it to my dogs. Shake was also terrible and chocolate -so my dogs wouldn't get it either way . Just don't

Sometimes it is busy but the STAFF does an amazing job and works very hard work . Specifically Ahmed, he was an exceptional host and gracious with myself and other patrons. This young man went out of his way to help older folks, accommodate my order, and he did it all with a smile .. I've worked extensively in the restaurant business and know that this guy can run a restaurant as a manager and owner .. Give this gentleman a raise or a promotion! The little things matter -

Greg

Woah- My taste buds are still buzzing. I really enjoyed eating at the South Helm. The food is exceptional and very unique. I like to eat A LOT and even though it was small plates, I got full! The service is great, ambience is perfect, and the food is just STUPID GOOD! Love this addition to the neighborhood! 


BYOB TOO! :)

To start- This place is on par with "The Dutch" but still offers it's own personality and style. A thoughtful menu, decadent desserts, and weekly specials keep me coming back. I've been to Creme Brulee for Breakfast, lunch, and dinner and each time was a 5 star experience.  The owner certainly takes pride in each dish that is served- whether it is a fruit platter or the entree at dinner, he makes sure that the quality and standard are consistent and delicious. 

Just go and try it for yourself!!!
BIG PRICE for small plates - we had to go out for dinner after our dinner here .. 350$ and still hungry YIKES!! Pass on this place - better places in old city !

xJaiCDF1x_lWgznw8iKfbw.review_text:
-Just phenomenal!!! The setting is super fun and brings you back to your childhood. Dum Dum lollipops are on all the tables along with fun little toys and knick knacks. 
-The food is excellent!! Countless appetizers to get things started ( I highly recommend the Poutine),and the entrees impress as well. 
-The drink menu is loaded with fun options, and you MUST try a pop rocket. It takes like the bomb pop from your childhood and HAS REAL POP ROCKS!!!
-Finally, if you're lucky enough to have Jenny as your waitress, then you've hit the JACKPOT. She is hands down one of the best I've ever had!!!

Talk about mastering BBQ!! This place is a must for anyone visiting St. Louis. The menu is superb and personal faves include the brisket platter with the fried corn on the cob. Staff also couldn't be friendlier:)
Up to 72 flavors of Gooey Butter Cake!!! Highly recommend going with one original and a red velvet. Embrace the OG classic, and wild out on the second piece. #TreatYoSelf

Super informative. It was fun learning about the history of one of the most storied beer companies as well as the brewing process! Also, you get to see the Clydesdales and enjoy free beer!!! #MajorWinning

Unbelievable! The first thing that stood out was the incredible '90's hip hop music. The setting is really cool and you can definitely tell you are in the French District. If you are a Biscuit and Gravy lover, you must pull the trigger on theirs! Finally, service was spectacular

Sandwiches were unreal! The Pig Mac is the best burger you've ever had, but it's made with pork patties. They took McDonalds' classic and made it gourmet. The Carolina BBQ and Muffaleto Sammies were dank as well. Finally....Get a bacon praline. Literally one of the best desserts I've ever had. Tastes homemade like out of your mom's kitchen. I ate my original one immediately, and got a 2nd roadie one bc they're that good.

Gotta start this review by raving about the service!! Josh was incredible. After baking in the NOLA heat, your boy was parched. I was pouring water down my throat like there was no tomorrow. In spite of this, my glass was never dry. #ThanksJosh. Eggs Atchafalaya were amazing. The crab and fried green tomatoes were a perfect pair. My boo got the chicken and biscuits. Obvi, I tried some and it to was fire

Just kind of meh. I feel bad because everyone raves about this spot. However, it was largely underwhelming. I don't know if that reflects on the establishment or my lack of appreciation for beignets. The price was fantastic though. For $4 you get 3 huge beignets which would easily be enough for 4 people.

We went here while in New Orleans because it was close to our hotel and our flight was leaving soon. From a convenience standpoint, it makes sense. That being said, I would never go here for any other reason. There are way too many great places to eat in NOLA. I got the crawfish egg benney and it was meh. There was too much hollandaise sauce and an unidentifiable taste. Service and coffee were great though.

Best place I ate at in NOLA. A baked apple got my fiancé and I real primed for our entrees. I got the Eggs Cardinal and my life has been changed. I can't exactly tell you what shrimp boudin or lobster cardinal are. But I know those when entered into a ménage a trois with truffle hollandaise sauce, it is INSANE. Also, you only need to order one biscuit for two people. They are huge in size and flavor. Final cool thing, I ordered coffee and they brought me my own French press of java .

This place has the best classic diner feel! The staff was awesome and they treat you as if your family. It felt like eating dinner and out of town family's house. Amazing omelettes, def a must. I also recommend the Doc Brinkers Special. This double cheeseburger with slaw and chili is to die for. It will satiate the biggest of appetites. Treat yourself to a shake as well.

This is a great, inexpensive activity to do in STL. We had a great time walking around the gardens and taking in all of the plant life. I would also really recommend a guided tour. I don't have any green thumbs and the tour guides give cool insight which helped me appreciate the experience.

This place was INCREDIBLE!!! I had time to get breakfast before a day work trip to philly. This spot had amazing reviews and I now see why. Easily one of the best bfast sandos of my life. And the customer service was stellar! The owner and founder, Nick, couldn't have been friendlier and provided great company while I enjoyed breakfast. I will 100% be coming back here in future work trips.

The donuts were spectacular here. We sampled the chocolate, cinnamon and brown sugar, and caramel macchiato. Of those, the cinnamon and brown sugar was the best. It was heavenly and reminded me of my mom's homemade donuts. The biggest downside here is price. For 2 coffees and 1/2 dozen donuts, we spent $25. That is an exorbitant price, and I wouldn't come back here.

This place was heaven! The pirogies were delicious and the prime rib, French onion soup was delightful. Big kudos also to the bartender. He made a perfect old fashion. The only downside was the fried mozzarella app. It was overly smoky and we didn't finish it. Finally, service was great.

xXoc8NO_MXq4zHX_N9a0KA.review_text: I used to be a big fan of this place. Their sushi was good at one point but it has let me down so much that I stopped going here. I love the sweet potato roll and the last 2-3 times the sweet potato was pretty much raw. The rolls seem to get smaller and the quality of the fish isn't is great either. I suspect they've changed management as well. The martini's, however,  are super tasty! I always get their "Watermelon Martini" but I've tried their cosmos and dirty martini and also very good.

Not the biggest fan of seafood but this place was really good and tasted really fresh. Went on Valentine's day with a few friends and wasn't very impressed by the menu. They told us that it was a special "valentine's day menu" so everything was pre-selected. I ended up getting the Blackened Big Eye Tuna Tacos, my friends got some Sashimi, and Ceviche.  I also had the clam chowder which was one of the best I've had. 

Pretty good. Would go back!

Definitely a fan of this place. Have been there twice but I already can't wait to go back. They have dancing on Friday/Saturday nights and amazing mojitos. The first time I went was for lunch during the week. I had the Cuban bento box which was 12 bucks I believe and had SO MUCH food ! It came with empandas, a reuben, guacamole with banana chips, rice, and a small desert (I believe it was a flan? don't quote me on that). Everything was really good and super flavorful. The second time I went was on a Saturday night and it was super packed! It has 2 levels and both had so many people. There was a DJ and live salsa dancers that night which got everyone super amped up to get dancing. They play all different types of latin music like bachata, reggaeton, salsa, merengue, etc. Lots of single people too if you're looking :P

Definitely the best Korean food in Delaware. I go around once a month, more if I have time. The staff is really nice and since they know me they talk to me a bit more. I love their spicy pork stone bowl and their , beef bone soup is great as well. I know this is considered "street food" in Korea but I wish they had ddeokbokki on the menu. I really like it! Anyway, goo experience overall, they're not expensive and the portions are super generous!

Best Korean grocery store in DE. They have everything! Meat, banchan, ice cream, cooking utensils, and even skincare! H-Mart is a hike since it's in Upper Darby, PA so this is the next best thing. The owners are so nice and so helpful. Also, I can't get enough of the snacks so whenever I come here I stock up.

I like this place a lot. Have gone a handful of times and I've always liked their food. The staff is so friendly and helpful. I had their udon, skewers, sushi, and a few cocktails and really enjoyed it. They have a karaoke on the second level, both private rooms and open mic at the bar. It's always packed when I go which is usually on weekends so that should say something about the place.

Can't wait to visit again!

Had to come back and change my review. I went a second time on Monday and had some amazing sushi here. I had the dragon roll and and another roll, forgot the name of it, that had crab and tuna with a spicy mayo sauce. I also had their raw tuna which was so fresh tasting. Loved it so much that I felt bad giving them a not-so-good review the first time. The staff was nicer this time around and very attentive. Had a pear martini that was quite tasty. Will definitely come back but just for the sushi! I still stand by my review on their poor excuse of a ramen. That was definitely bad.

--
Original review:

Went here to have some lunch with a friend and even though it was my first time, I will definitely not come back--at least not for Japanese ramen. I kid you not when I say that it tasted just like the packets of instant ramen. Disgusting! They skimped out on the pork and had none of the condiments that it usually comes with. Wow, horrible.

The complimentary sushi I got was decent but didn't care for it. The customer service was just ok. Had some green tea ice cream that was quite tasty. So 1 star for ice cream and another because I didn't try the sushi. Heard it was good but didn't want to get any.

This place is really good for mall food. I really dislike eating at the mall court with a passion but if I'm really hungry you can bet I'll be getting food from this place. I love their honey chicken, can't get enough of it. Their vegetable side is so tasty and not greasy at all. I'm a local and I've never met somebody that didn't like Suki Hana. The portions are generous for a cheap price. Haven't had their sushi but I'm not really tempted to since it's still mall food.

Definitely my favorite place to get pho in DE. The portions are generous and inexpensive as well. I've been coming here for 3 years and even though I've tried other places here in DE I still keep coming back to this place. 

Like one of the other people said, you come to this place for the food and not necessarily for the service. They hardly come over while you're eating but I can honestly say that I've never had bad service here. They're actually really nice but you do have to call them over if you want anything other than what you ordered.

I've had just about everything on the menu but their pizza is so legit. I absolutely can't get enough of the white pizza and the broccoli pizza as well. I've never had anything on the menu that I didn't like. I usually order my stuff for pickup but I've eaten there a handful of times. It's a small place but it fits maybe 30 people tops? Anywho, great place to eat and tastes authentic.

Would give it 5 stars but the customer service is sometimes lacking. I've had my order screwed up a few times or they've over charged me as well.

Yuck! Hate this place. Went like 3 times but disliked it. The cover is $20 but if you get on the guest list it's $10. I went twice when I was 17-18 because Friday's are the underaged nights where high school kids can get in (or under 21). Everybody that was there looked like there were from the Jersey shore. EVERYBODY. Went back again when I was 21 and figured it'd be better because I wouldn't have underaged guys hitting on me but it was just as bad. Creepers everywhere. Over priced drinks that were just ok. They have valet parking which is like an extra $20.

Wouldn't really recommend this place unless you're in the mood to be sleazy.

What a great hidden gem. Went on a "friend date" here the first time I went and was pleasantly surprised. Did the wine tasting for $20 and they paired it up with some great cheeses. I couldn't get enough of the goat cheese with honey. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. They had a live jazz band playing that day so we sat outside with our wine and enjoyed the music. They make some really good pizzas too.

The wine selection is great so I recommend going to this place.

Love this place! It opened up next to the office I used to work at and I was so happy that Trolley Sq. finally had somewhere that I could get froyo. At first I would just go for the froyo but eventually I tried out their breakfast sandwiches and omelets and ended up going there everyday on my lunch break. The owner is the nicest person ever and the rest of the staff is as well. If you're into indian food they have a few items on the menu that you could try out but I never got around to it.

This place is just OK. The coffee isn't bad but most of the menu is overpriced. I've had a few of their muffins and the first time I had the blueberry muffin I got sick. Decided to give the baked goods another try and I was fine so maybe I got a bad batch the first time. Service was average. Would consider going to other places in the area if I wanted a cup of Joe.

Definitely the best tacos in town. I've had just about every type of taco (even tongue!) and I've never been disappointed. My favorite has to be "al pastor" and "chorizo". It's super authentic. Everybody there is so nice! They make you feel so welcomed. I go as many times as my diet permits ^.^ Megan T gives a great review so if you don't believe me look at hers :)

All in all, you MUST try!

Went here for lunch today for the first time and was so very pleasantly surprised! It's a bit hidden (in Elsmere) and kind of small so most people would probably just drive by it and not notice it. It was kind of empty when I went because I had a late lunch like around 2pm. Everything looked delicious on the menu but since I wasn't feeling too adventurous I ended up getting the pork bulgogi bento box. The ban chan came out first and I was surprised that there were so many of them. Loved that they cut the cabbage and radish kimchi right in front of you. The pork was delicious, definitely had a different flavor than what I am accustomed to. Usually, every spicy pork that I've had is really red and tastes a lot like the red pepper paste but this one tasted like it was more of a tomato based spicy pork. If it would have had cilantro in it I would've guessed that it was Mexican style pork. I'm not saying it was great, but just that it tasted different than what I've had. It also came with rice, a small salad, mandu, broccoli and miso soup. After I asked for the check they brought out a banana drizzled with chocolate sauce ^.^

I will definitely come back to this place!

Great bar to go to after work. They have some really good mixed drinks and craft beers. Went here on St. Patty's day as well and it was super packed! Tons of fun but I would say that most of the people that come in to this establishment are like 26-27 and older. Had their shrimp tacos and they were delicious. Love their guacamole too!

I really like this place. I've been here a handful of times but the first time I went was on a date like 4 years ago and I quite liked it. To be honest I really only went back a few times but for lunch. They have an awesome bento box that I like to go devour when I have time :)

Also, it's so pretty in there! Aesthetically pleasing.

Went in here for the first time yesterday and I really liked it! Had the green boba tea and it was perfect. The boba was the right consistency and the tea was just right. Not too sweet but just the way I like it. I also had one of their strawberry cakes (which was $0.90!) and it was good but the sponge was a little dry. Their mango tart on the other hand was delicious! The customer service was great. They were super friendly and helpful.

Next time I'm on Race st. I'll definitely stop by again.

Got some late lunch here yesterday with a friend and we were pleasantly surprised. This is as close as I've gotten to having ramen that tasted like the one I get in NYC. I had their "terakawa" ramen which is just the classic pork broth with the slice of pork, egg, ginger, etc. It was delicious! I wish I would've ordered another boiled egg because it was really good but unfortunately I was too full to do that. The broth is so good! Not too salty and seasoned really well. My noodles were perfect. Our waiter was so nice and helpful and so was the rest of the staff.

The only thing that stopped me from giving them 5 stars was the fact that the pork slices were too thin and bit tough.

Came here a few weeks back with a friend and thought it was just ok. Since I'd already had a bite to eat I only had a drink and the egg roll appetizer. My friend ordered the Tom Kha which looked pretty good although he did mention it was thicker than he was used to. I actually forgot what kind of drink I got (was unmemorable I suppose) but I remember that it was super strong! I really liked that because most places skimp out. The egg roll was good, not too greasy or anything. As for the customer service, it was actually pretty good. I'd read that it was bad but I didn't experience anything bad here. We sat at the bar and the bartender was suer friendly and helpful. 

I had to knock a few stars because I recently went to Southeast Kitchen on Delaware Ave. and it was so delicious. It honestly made this place look kinda bad and unauthentic. I might come back if they have a happy hour but I'm not 100% sure I'd come back for the food.

Le Shio is one of those places that is a hit or miss for me but I'm somewhat torn about which one of those options is for me. I thought the service was great; from the host to the server, extremely friendly and helpful and not to mention patient since I didn't know what I wanted. I had the rainbow bridge roll which had crab meat, tuna, salmon, bass and avocado which was interesting. I'm not sure if it's because I was starving but I devoured it quickly and it was filling for being one roll. It had a strange texture which I only realized after I was almost done. It was kind of mushy, as if they mixed the different meats too much and it ended up being like baby food. It didn't taste horrible but I couldn't get over the texture afterwards. My friend said his sashimi was very fresh and delicious so he was definitely satisfied. For dessert we had a mixed berry creme brûlée that definitely wasn't a typical hard top creme brûlée; it tasted more like cheesecake with a bunch of sour berries on top. Usually creme brûlée has the hardened sugar on top that you crack with a spoon but this one didn't. It wasn't bad but I certainly would not categorize it as creme brûlée. 

I think I'd go back and try some other items on the menu. It wasn't horrible but I need to figure out if it's a definite hit or miss for me ^.^

What a nice wine bar! It was my first time there not long ago but I already want to go back. The wine is reasonably priced and their other drinks were amazing. I had the sangria and a strawberry mojito that were both tasty and strong! They don't skimp out on the vodka at all. They had Tito's vodka there so that was a plus. I went with a friend and we both had a blast. It has a great atmosphere, great place for a date since the lights are somewhat dim (not sure if that sounds weird or not). The bartender was great, I forgot his name but he was really attentive and helpful as well. I'll definitely come back next time I'm in the area. Really liked the atmosphere and the people!

This review is based on a first time visit to Presto. I felt compelled to write a review because I simply could not believe that such a bad cupcake could be made. I went in because of my sweet tooth after having lunch and since I never really notice the place I figured I'd give it a shot. There were a few different cupcakes to chose from but I wanted to try something different so I ended up getting the "Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough" kind. Don't judge me, please. Anyway, long story short, it was the absolute WORST cupcake I've had in my life. I consider myself somewhat of a cupcake connoisseur and I thought I had some bad ones in the past but this one definitely takes the cake (no pun intended). Lets start off with the sponge. The sponge was so very dry that instead of washing it down with milk I had to get water. Yes, water. It was flavorless, they definitely used little to no butter in the batter. The chocolate chips that were in it were super bitter and hard so that didn't really help. And the icing. Dear Lord was it bad. I'm not completely sure what it was made with but it was super greasy! Yes, I said greasy! My lips were so shiny from just the first bite. It was so incredibly heavy and tasted old. The whole thing tasted like it had been sitting for at least 3 days.

Yes, folks, this whole review on a cupcake. It's so simple, considering the right ingredients and proper technique, yet they got it so wrong. I will say that the customer service was great and would come back to try other things that aren't baked goods. I read the reviews on this place and everyone seems to think the food is good which is why I won't give them 2 stars because I still need to try other things on the menu. 

Can't recommend this place on baked goods alone but I will come back and update my review once I go back.

This place is a 3 at best. If you're looking for overpriced food, long waiting, and horrible customer service this is your spot! I came in once to pickup an order and when I got there I was never greeted. The person that was behind the counter saw me come in, stand there waiting for somebody, and took her sweet time before ever getting to me. She definitely looked like she didn't even want to work there so I didn't take it personally. The food itself was OK, but for being gourmet I was expecting a lot more. It's just overpriced because of the location but based on the food it really belongs somewhere outside of the city. 

I know people who have vowed to never go back because the customer service is so bad. This place really has to step it's game up because the employees and prices leave so, so much to be desired. Good thing it's nice to look otherwise there wouldn't be much to go in there for. I don't think I'll be going back despite working only a couple of blocks away.

I honestly can't fathom going to any other place except Jim's for a cheesesteak. Whether you're rolling out of a bar at 2 AM and need a bite or are completely sober wanting to get lunch with your family, Jim's is always good. I was born and raised 45 minutes from the city and it's the only cheesesteak I would sit on 95 for. 

The steak is consistently juicy and tender, the onions and whiz add great flavor, and I get to adjust the salt level as I please. I see some people saying it's not super seasoned and while I do understand this, this could be great for people that need to take care of their sodium intake. And no, the irony of having a cheesesteak isn't healthy is not lost on me but hey, gotta stay healthy where you can ;) While I would prefer more seasoning, I can adjust this with salt and pepper packets. Not that hard to do. 

Do yourself a favor and skip Geno's and Pats. Jim's is where it's at.

xuxDaz3ptwwAcV5nxnESqA.review_text: I just moved into the area and heard so much about Sidecar that I decided to give it a try. Why not, it's really close by! We had nachos, mussels and calamari. The calamari came with this sauce that tasted a little bit of bbq with tomato sauce, unusual but very good. The mussels were great and unique with tomatoes and salami. I thought the decor was quaint and welcoming and can definitely picture myself going back and bringing friends along. They had a great selection of beer, not just your typical miller lite/coors/bud. yuck. I think it would be great if they expanded.  Will need to go back for brunch!

This place is amazing. When you enter the restaurant has an open kitchen and very tall ceilings. From the minute you enter, the service it impeccable. The hostess dropped the napkin before she put it on my husband's lap and instead of using it again, she got a clean napkin instead. Our waiter was amazingly polite and had great recommendations.  He informed us that when we leave we can get the recipe for the Hawaiian martini on the way out. We had the pre fixe menu. The food was absolutely amazing. We had the shrimp and ahi tuna appetizers. The kobe beef meatloaf was SOOO lean and good. And of course to finish off this awesome meal we had the chocolate souffle, which also they provided a recipe card at the end. I can't wait to see what the next season's pre fixe menu is. I am going to bring my mom and my friends here whenever they visit. This is my new favorite!

Since this place is located down the block from me, it's convenient. I have to admit the lunch specials are mostly rice and little bit of meat which was disappointing. Their vietnamese pho noodles were actually quite good and their selection of sushi is very affordable if you get the 2 roll special. You can get 2 rolls for $7, good for the price.

I thought they offered quite a bit for Center City Sips. The first caipirinha didn't have much alcohol but the next few did. The appetizers they offered were great. The place was quite busy and the bartender didn't seem to be that accomodating or willing to serve the people standing beside the bar. Finally we got a place to sit on the couches and the waitress was then very attentive to us and got us what we ordered. We then had dinner since it was 15% after sips. The waiter we had completely ignored us and the dinner portion took almost 2 hours for the food to come out. I had the osteria which was a pretty good deal with salad and pasta for $21. The waiter failed to get us any bread so the other two guests just sat there with only water for like more than an hour. The waiter at the next table got his table bread immediately when they sat down. We told the busboy many times but never got any bread.
