Went by last night with three others.  We were seated in the bar area, even though the place wasn't crowded.  Nearly ten minutes before anyone came to take our drink order.  When they did show up we were ready to order entrees but the waitress wasn't, had to give drink order first.  Waitress was all blood-shot and glassy eyed.  When we finally were able to get the order in, we had to wait nearly 30 mins for the food.  My burger was over cooked, the potato was smaller than the bun, and black from sitting in the steamer all evening.  The person that ordered a steak had to sent it back, it was way over cooked also.    The quickest thing we received was the check.

BTW Logan's, you should tell your staff not to stand outside the door talking about going to smoke some dope and holding their crotch.  I hope they weren't the cooks.  My last time ever going to that location.

Love Cracker Barrel especially the breakfast and the chicken and dumplins.  The cornbread muffins are yummy treats.   Just one thing bugs me, stop putting my food in little bowls.  I"m a grown person and I like my food on the plate.

Wife and I when there last night.  After looking over the menu and figuring out the ordering setup we places out order.  I ordered the hummus appetizer, grilled chicken gyro, and grilled chicken salad with 2 ice teas.  Food came fast, there wasn't a lot of people eating because it was a rainy and messy night I figured.  

The hummus came with toasted pita chips, 2 olives and a half of a peppercini pepper.  Hummus was average, not the best I've had nor the worst, just plain.  The gyro was chicken strips, tomato, tabbouleh, all wrapped in a flat bread instead of a pita pocket as I'm used to..  I had to ask for some cucumber  sauce for the gyro, it was a bit dry.  The chicken was very tasty.  I also got a small bowl of rice and potato chips with the sandwich.  The wife's chicken salad was tasty, but a bit skimpy for a $10 salad.  We had to go back to the counter to get refills.  

All in all the food was good, but to me a bit overpriced for the amount. But was better than any fast food place.  The food did seem to be fresh and that's a plus.   I've had better gyro's in a lot of places for less money.  I thought $27 for what we got was too much and would have been better spent at other restaurants in the area.  Doubt we'll ever go back as it wasn't anything special.

For one thing the place was hard to find, I've passed by it several times looking for the place before I was able to actually find it.  

My son had recommend it to me several times, so five us decided to give it a go.  I got the gyro plate.  Excellent food, excellent price.  I wanted unsweet tea and they made me some just for me.  Of course, i didn't get a refill and had the sweet tea which I don't really care for.  

Give it a try for lunch, if you like gyros, then you'll like Cizars.

Love this place.  Love the soup, especially the Lentil soup.  I go there for lunch and I always get the Barry Special, well most of the time.  I'll get the hamburger on occasion.  The gyros are great!  Love the fries!  One of the best hamburgers anywhere.   Go by for lunch or dinner you won't be disappointed.

What I like about this place?  Fast service, value for the money and the HUGE tea.  Yeah it's fast food but the price/quality/quantity ratio are right on.  Get there early, the place is busy with working folk like myself getting a meal for their hard earned buck.

One of our favorites.  We've been going there since it opened for business.  Papusa's are excellent and I love the slaw they serve with it.  Just don't order the pork rind papusa, you'll never get it.   Best enchiladas I've had at any Mexican restaurant.  The tostadas are just like grandma's. The Shrimp Gazpacho  is delicious.  There's also daily specials on the board by the door, but you have to be able to read Spanish.  Forget about getting a translation, half the wait staff does not speak English.  The tacos are tasty.  For lunch you can't beat the price.

The only complaint I've ever had was sometime they serve tomato sauce with chips,  it's not salsa it's a very yucky tasting tomato sauce, the stuff is hideous.  And the TV's are too loud, really too loud, I mean WAY too loud.  I think it's so they can hear it in kitchen and up front of the store at the register.

You can eat like a king there for $5.
Love the lunch buffet, it's fresh and enough variety to satisfy.  The menu is great, lots of choices you won't find at the other 50 Mexican restaurants on Nolensville Rd.

My wife and I ate here when it first opened.  The service was ok, and the food was average.  Being as they had first opened we tried them again later.  I ordered the burger and was forced into get those hideous chips.  The ones that are over cooked in grease and taste like nothing but burnt potatoes.  If you order the fries you get charged extra and still get the chips.  The burger was good, very tasty.

I stopped by here to eat after being recommended by someone else.  Usual menu as at other resturants of this type.  All I can say is Number 1 tasted like Number 2.  Over cooked meat, rice was hard and cold.  Really bad food.

Hip and mediocre.  We had went there to eat and hear some live music.  The wife's sister had invited us out to see the band playing there.  The place is neat and hip.   The waiters that I saw were all young guys with beards or mustaches.  Not a large menu, but did cover a wide range of dishes.

I ordered the half chicken (local raised it said) and a side salad.  The wife and her sister order the steak, side salad and garlic potatoes.  Her brother-in -law ordered a salad.  Our waiter selected the dressing and how the ladies wanted their steaks cooked as he never gave us a chance to choose.  The side salad ($5.00) was served on a saucer, yep it was tiny.  A mix of lettuce, on slice of cucumber and one slice of tomato.  The house dressing, a cream herb dressing was bland. The half chicken ($24.00) was stuffed with a 'dirty rice'.  Tasted like it came out of  pack of Uncle Ben's Wild Rice, only it was so under cooked that it was crunchy and uneatable.  The mushroom gravy over the chicken was dominated by that popular spice, Salt.   The chicken was good, even the breast was moist, which was a surprise considering the rest of the meal.  The garlic potatoes were in name only, mashed potatoes with no taste of garlic at all.  The steak was served medium, which was ok, unless you wanted well done.  In that case you're out of luck, the server decided on the way it's cooked.

On the price to quality to quantity, price 8 out of 10, quality a 5, quantity a 4.  Service is a 5, I never got a refill and I was charged for a coke I never ordered.  Also if you have a party larger then 2, you'll get hit with a surcharge.  

I'd suggest you eat before you go there to eat. Or better yet, eat somewhere else then go hear the band.

We usually enjoy Olive Garden in MJ, but not tonight.  We were seated quickly, even on a Saturday night.  Our waitress informed us that she didn't know if she would stay our waitress or if we'd get someone else.  Don't think it would matter.  We ordered an appetizer which didn't arrive very quickly.  The salad came out before the appetizer, which we ate, but had a unusual taste as if the lettuce was old. We also never were offered the OG cheese on everything.  That was unusual, not that I really cared about that.  Then the waitress came by and said she'd get the appetizer, which she did.  Then the entree's came right out, the waiter said he'd take it back and remake them when we were ready.  After eating most of the appetizer,  the waitress brought out the food.  Unfortunately it was now cold, which means they didn't remake them.  At that point we were done.  Sent the food back and called it a night.

Went by on a Saturday night, easy parking and no waiting.  There was live music which added to the good feeling of the place.  Waitress was prompt and friendly.  Had Fish and Chips, very tasty, not greasy.  Order the sampler appetizer plate, the Hog Wings are the bomb!  So are the Bites.  Had a great time and will definitely go back with the rest of the clan!

Several of us went by there today after getting recommendations from two of the people in the party.  We went to the Donelson location.  The decor was what I expected to find in a meat and two.  We had a party of six and the seating wasn't the most comfortable.  The place was well worn, tables small and chairs hard.  The waitress was friendly and prompt with seating and taking the drink order.  

I ordered the Chicken and Dumplins, turnip greens, pinto beans and added fried okra.  The order came pretty quick.  The dumplins came in a bowl and looked good.  That's about the only positive thing I can say about them.  Plenty of gooey dough, no chicken, and a oil slick of chicken broth.  There wasn't any meat in the bowl, there was a very large, thick piece of dough in the bottom of the bowl that I first thought was a half of a biscuit. The turnip greens were cold, I mean COLD, like they had came straight out of a can.  The pinto beans were so salty, there wasn't any other flavor.  The waitress did bring another bowl of turnip greens that was warm.  The one little corn muffin I had tasted a lot like Jiffy cornmeal mix, with added sugar, pretty bad.  

Two of the other people in the party order the 'fried corn'.  Vittles should be more truthful and change the menu to read 'canned fried corn, with sugar added'.  One person ordered mac and cheese and couldn't eat more than one bite.  

This is not home cooking.  Don't go to Vittles expecting to have a meal like your grandmother used to fix, unless you're grandmother was a lousy cook.  Opening cans of vegetables and heating them up is not home cooking.

Hattie B's is the place for hot chicken.  We go to the Charlotte Ave location and is the main go to for hot chicken.  Get there at opening cause there's a line, but the service is tops.  I had the 'Shut the Cluck Up' and yeah I earned the bumper sticker.  Even if you don't like hot chicken the not hot chicken with worth going for.  You want fried chicken, you want Hattie B's.

We finally got to visit this new place in MJ.  It's in a location that previous restaurants have failed to stay open.  When you walk in you are right next to the stage, and in front of everyone sitting at the tables. The music is a bit loud, even with a single performer, it makes you want to head right for the back of the place.  The room is twice as long as it's wide, there's outdoor sitting in the front patio and in the back.  There's also a pool room off to the side down some steps.  

The seating is a bit awkward, there's long tables which puts you in a situation of sharing a table with people you don't know.  If you have several in your party, you may not all be able to sit together.  And if the folks your sharing with are there to drink and party more than you are, you may become annoyed.   The people we were near were really into the music, only they had no sense of rhythm and beat out of time on the table on several songs.

The beer selection was good, several draft choices as well as bottles and cans.  

They have food, they don't have a printed menu.  There are two chalkboards, one in the bar and one by the door, listing the food choices.  I expected bar food and that's what they have, appetizers, one burger, chicken tenders, sandwiches, salads, pizza, ect. We ordered a starter of stuffed mushrooms.  When they came out, they were black on top from the oven. I was hesitant to eat one.  But I was wrong, they were on point!  Really good. 

I settled on the burger, which goes for one penny less than $9.00.  Strangely it doesn't come with fries.  This is the second place in MJ that charges a $1.00 extra for fries, don't understand why that is.  Instead with sandwiches you get a choice of potato salad, pasta salad, potato chips.  I picked potato salad.  The person with me went with the ham and cheese sliders and potato salad. 

When the food came, the first thing that struck me was the size of the burger.  It's slightly larger than a slider. Close to the size of a Wendy's Junior burger, for $9.00.  There was two little scoops of white potato salad.  The burger smelled of charcoal grilling, which is a good thing.  I had noticed they had a grill on the back patio.  The meat was well done, looked hand pattied, and had no seasoning at all.  No salt, no pepper, no nothing.  

The ham and cheese sliders where just that ham and cheese.  Yellow cheese, not swiss which we thought was unusual.  

Then there's the potato salad.  The potato salad looked like lumpy mashed potatoes with a piece of sweet red pepper mixed in.  Not sure what was mixed in the potatoes, but the best description of the taste was rancid salad dressing. I've had bad tasting potato salad, usually it's the stuff sold in stores in the plastic tubs.  But this stuff is horrid, absolutely the worst potato salad ever made and fed to a human being.  Nothing short of throwing the it in the garbage and starting over could fix this stuff. Do not get the potato salad.  

They have TV screens on each of the  long walls and two behind the bar.  If you wanted to watch the pro game, you have to sit at the bar, which is limited seating.  Otherwise, you got to see college games from tiny schools play each other.  I didn't see any Chattanooga alumni there supporting their team.  Oh, and the channels get changed at random times.  The keeper of the remote comes by and changes the channel without warning.

They have a lot of different people playing there.  As a music venue, it's where the strength lies.  The night we were there the music was good, the singer had a good selection of songs.  Played well and sang really well.  The volume was a bit excessive for the size of the room and the number of people.  But as the night wore on and more people came in it got better.    

Go for the beer and music.  Eat before you get there or make plans on eating somewhere else later.  As for the food matrix of, value, quality, quantity, it fails short on all three. But the place shouldn't be faulted for the menu.  It's better suited for listening to live music.  Sitting on the patio and having a cold refreshing beverage with someone and relaxing.

Stopped by for lunch with co-workers.  We hadn't eaten there in 3 years or so.  The service was spot on, place was clean, staff friendly.  We were feeling good. The waitress was friendly and attentive, kudos to her and tips for her.  Got drinks, got plenty of rolls, placed order and waited.  Took too long for the food to come out, and the place was mostly empty.  Never did get busy the whole time we were there.  But the food did come out hot and that's what matter's most to me.  

So, why the 3 star rating?  Well I and a co-worker ordered the Nashville Hot Chicken under the Sandwich portion of the menu.  It's not a sandwich.  It's a frozen chicken patty, covered in hot sauce and I think brown sugar or something gritty on a piece of thick white bread.  The slaw they serve with it smelled like tainted mayo.  It was horrible.  

Now this is in Nashville, the home of Hot Chicken.  Maybe we were wrong ordering hot chicken at Logan's when Hattie B's is just down the block.  Logan's needs to take that off the menu, at least in Nashville.   The peanuts are still good though.

Wife and I went there after the daughter and son-in-law recommended.  Absolutely delicious.  Wife got a pizza, and I got a pizza to try.  Fresh ingredients, lovely sauce.  Best crust in town!  Spot on for NY style.  The crust is as good as Gondola's but in a different way.  We judge pizza by the crust.  Also, the salads were crisp and the balsamic dressing was very tasty.  Highly recommended!

We haven't been to Painturo's in Mt Juliet in over a year and a half.  The granddaughter was spending the night so we thought we'd go for pizza.  Picked a good night to go, $5 off large pizzas.  Wife and granddaughter ordered a large cheese and I order a Hawaiian.   

Pizza came out, both were brown on top from all the over cooked cheese.  I couldn't find much ham, there was some bacon, and a scattering of pineapple.  All you could taste was overcooked cheese.  The crust was gritty and not very good.  

The granddaughter didn't like the pizza at all.  I ate two slices and I was done.  It's terrible pizza.  Any of the other local carryouts have better pizza than either of those we were served.  

If you want great pizza, go to Gondola's or the stone fired pizza place on Mt Juliet Rd.  If you want pizza better than Painturo's go anywhere else like Pizza Hut, Domino's, or any of the other carry out places.
Went there Saturday and it was delicious.  Good beer, great service.  Had the BA burger, very tasty.  Fourth time I've been there and never been disappointed.  We'll be back, soon.

I've eaten here several times.  The food has been good every time, especially the fish tacos, even if they are over priced. The tacos are delicious, but the beans and rice are subpar.  The green salsa is delicious.  

My 2 star rating is about the guy working the cash register, which I assume is the owner/manager.  He is very unfriendly. I've never heard a 'welcome, thank you, or kiss my a... any time we've gone there. Every time we've gone in there we get the feeling that he doesn't really care for our business.  I've spoken with other patrons and they get the same feeling.  After the last visit I won't be back.  If a place gives the feeling that they don't really want your business I'm surely not going to give them mine.

Tried it twice.  The place is neat and cozy.  The wait staff is friendly and really work hard.  Where this place fails is in the kitchen.  We went twice and both times were left wanting.  We stopped in for a lunch, I ordered an italian hoagie with fries.  When the food finally came out the amount of meat was so thin that you could see a couple of slices, but you couldn't tell it when eating.  The hoagie was toasted but the bread was SO HARD, i had to keep taking a drink after taking a bite just to keep from cutting up my mouth on the shards of bread.  It was like eating broken glass.  

We went a second time, for supper because the place next door had a 40 min wait.  I decided to go for a pasta dish, baked zitti  with a  side salad.  It was supposed to come with garlic knots, that never happened.  When the dish came out it wasn't baked, it was noodles partly cooked with cheese and sauce poured over it.  There was no baking involved.  The noodle were cold, the sauce was the warmest thing on the plate.  I tried eating it, but had to send it back to the kitchen to have someone heat it up in the microwave.  One of the others with us ordered linguini with chicken, the chicken was horrible, he wasn't sure it was even chicken.  My grandson ordered a stromboli.  Stromboli doesn't have ricotta, this had ricotta, just like a calzone.

The kitchen needs real help, it was a horrible meal.

I waited two days before writing this review.  But my feelings haven't changed so here goes.  My co-workers and I stopped in at 11:00 on a Wednesday for some lunch.  This is the Cracker Barrel we always go to, but had stopped because the last two times it too WAY TOO LONG to get the food to the table.  We were seated and ordered within 5 mins.  The place was not busy at all.  45 minutes later we still didn't have any food.  I had to call one of the hostess over and ask her to check on our order.  The food immediately came out.  I had ordered a veggie plate, all in bowls of course.  I had about 8 pieces of Okra, half a bowl of turnip greens, pinto beans, and baked potato.  Everything but the potato was COLD. The potato wasn't warm enough to melt the butter.  One co-worker took a bite of mashed potatoes and he said they were awful.  The cornbread was good.  The waitress said they had a new cook, the last two times we were there the kitchen was SLOW to get the food out.  I don't think we'll be back for awhile.  Plus we're telling everyone about the experience we had there.  The cashier asked how it was and I said 'mediocre'. She asked if I wanted to speak to a manager, but what good would that do to fix this experience when it didn't do any good the last two times?  Besides, what incentive does the manager have? He doesn't want upper management to hear about things like this.  Not until they see sales dips, at least.

We haven't been to CB in 2 years.  So, we thought we'd stop and eat.  I ordered the meatloaf, pinto beans, turnip greens, okra.  The wife ordered chicken and dumplings, mac & cheese, apples.  I received 1/2 spoon of green beans, half a bowl of pintos, and 6 pieces of okra.  The wife's mac & cheese had something black in it.  The dumplings looked like they had been on the plate since noon.  The food wasn't even close to hot.  The server did bring the turnip greens, at least that was a full bowl.  We were really disappointed, we could have gone to a dozen other places and gotten better for the same price.  Looking at Yelp, CB has more 1 star ratings than any other.  I can see why.  We used to really like CB, COVID has kept us out of restaurants, when we do go out, we don't want experiences like this.  Really makes us reconsider where we're going to spend our money.

My go-to package store for all my high alcohol adult beverages. Best selection and prices in the area.  I can usually find old favorites and new soon to be favorites.  Always a friendly 'Hello' when I come in and more often than not someone will ask if I need assistance.  I appreciate the customer attentiveness.  I've found some beverages there that I haven't seen anywhere else.  The store is neat, clean, and well lighted for easy shopping.  Seems like I see something new on the shelf each time I go there, good selections within my price range too.

First time back there since before the pandemic.  We went because it was where the grandson wanted to go for his birthday dinner.  It wasn't good.  I ordered the salmon, and my son ordered mahi mahi.  The chef mashed and mashed both of the pieces of fish till they were half the thickness they started out.  Both were so over cooked they were crispy and dry.  The steak was ok, but not medium as requested.  The chef seemed to only know how to cook everything over done. Twenty dollars for over cooked, mediocre meat.  He wasn't the least bit entertaining.  Not worth the price, try somewhere else.

zJUdedHbPTtLff5ZoUCPxg.review_text: Was on my 4th trial run for my wedding....And Sarah was the first to impress me!

Visiting STL for the first time had a stressful day with all the sighting, getting lost, AND construction going on. Went to The Arch late so we were limited on places to eat plus we had two kids with us. So when I found this place on yelp I was super excited. EspecIally since I absolutely love Mexican food & they were open till 11pm. We got there & I fell in love with the decor! I had to go & approach the staff & ask if we seat ourselves. They told us the kitchen closed at 10, it was 10.

In a cute part of town. Service and staff were great and very friendly. I absolutely loved my food I had the shredded chicken and pork tacos. Guacamole as an appetizer. I would just pass on the rice and the street corn wasnt what i was expecting it was just ok. I'm from Cali and it taste a lil different out there. I would def. come back to thins place.
it was really really really bad....looks are very deceiving! Was so disappointed. The place is very cute and clean. Employees are very nice. But that was it.
the employees were super friendly and helpful. The place was clean and cute. The food was just ok . Best thing about my burger was the bacon. Probably wont go back.

Pricey but verrrrrrrrry yummy. LOVE LOVE LOVE the walnut shrimp. Love the hot and sour soup they serve a very large portion. The kids loved the kids meal and kids chopsticks! The fried rice could be better though. Great atmosphere too.
YUM food was delicious I had the house special pasta , service is quick and very friendly and the atmosphere is very relaxed plus I love the decor! Please have a location closer to Hendersonville!
Great food! Super friendly. Love the menu options! A little too many so it's hard to decide what to order! Will be going back

Tried the curbside service for the first time tonight food was fast, delicious, and the service was AWESOME. Robin K was the one to help us and really went above and beyond. Robin was super friendly and nice!
Never have been a fan of tex mex style Mexican food BUT I love this place! Chicken flautas, salads, jalapeno ranch, SALSA, chips, homemade tortillas...are all my fave!
this place is the best in Hendersonville, Gallatin, Goodlettsville area!!!! Im vey pick about Thai/Chinese food. Loved it

So for the last 5yrs I have been shopping here a minimum of once a week. I will even go out of my way sometimes to come here. Usually nice staff and lots of options. And everytime they are out of something in the produce section and when I ask about it they always go to the back to get it for me. But in the last year it has been very disappointing how few registers they have open and how long the lines are. I wish the would schedule more or hire if needed. The store is always busy so I'm sure they need the help.

Had the Bacado omelette (bacon & avacodo) yum!!!! Everything was great! Loved the restaurant decor and atmosphere. It's a lil pricey but worth it. My server was Oriana and she was super sweet and attentive. Will definitely be back!
Food and service was awesome, I have been twice so far. Both times I had the buffalo chicken tenders. Will return!

Never have had an issue with my order service and food has always been great!
Been eating here weekly for 2 years now.

Went there on a whim was going to go to Wendy's since I was running errands. So glad I did. Great atmosphere and staff and loved the food as well. Luckily i went on free cinnamon roll day! I ordered the turkey cranberry sandwich with mac and cheese as my side. A little pricey but I enjoyed my meal.
Can you ever have more than 2 lanes open??? It doesn't matter what time I go or day of the week. Its always like this now

AMAZING! It is by far my favorite! My 11 year old can be a picky eater and he had lettuce wraps for the first time here and killed it. I'm from California and this place reminded me of Chinese food from back home. Going forward any time we go out for Chinese food this will be our go-to spot! Should have taken pictures but I think we ate the food too fast  service was excellent too.
Love love love! I had the ceviche and bbq chicken lettuce wraps! I can't wait to try the other items on the menu! I have been waiting to try this place out forever!

Excellent service and EVERYTHING that we ordered was delicious!
Didn't get pic's of everything but ordered 
Chicken alfredo 
Linguine positano with chicken 
Scotty Thompson appetizer 
Mozzarella sticks
Side salad 
Sangrias
And dessert to go!

Why does it take soooooooooooooo long every time I come here????
I mean seriously! And then why do I keep coming back ‍
LOVE!!! Whipped feta dip, kabobs, and salad. Its sooooo good. Very happy that they cane to Hendersonville

Suuuuuuper friendly and helpful since it was my first time. Great price for everything that you get. And food was delicious! I will definitely come back again. I ordered the Cali fries, street tacos, fajitas quesadillas, and came with rice & beans, and chips & salsa.

Really great service our waitress was really nice and helpful. Cute atmosphere they did a great job at converting this building into a restaurant.
We both ordered the bissell breakfast one with pancakes the other with waffles. Portions are huge so you better be hungry! We had enough leftover for breakfast for the next day. We will definitely be back.

Always love coming here food is really good and service is excellent. Tried the shrimp tostadas camaron for the first time and its now my new fav. My only suggestion would be for the chips and salsa to be a little more authentic.
Really loved this restaurant! Food and service was excellent. Very cute restaurant. Food came out in a timely manner. I can't wait to go back and try other things on the menu.
It was great experience and really loved it. However parking was $25 and 2 milkshakes and 2 waters was $43. So probably won't be back. But I'm glad I'm able to check this place off my list.

Went here last night for the first time and I was very impressed. Was able to get a seat promptly. 
Atmosphere, vibe, decor, and lighting was very cool!
Ordered double cheeseburger, waffle fries, shrimp po boy, and peppers. It was soooooooo good! I wouldn't change a thing!
Definitely can't wait to go back!
Loved it!!!!! Planning on getting my sons Birthday cake here too! Great service as well.

Drove an hour to come here. Luckily we made reservations. My mom wanted Hibachi for her birthday. It was 9 of us AND everyone loved there food. The drive was well worth it!!!! I recommend doing a reservation so that you don't have to wait long. The cook was very entertaining, we loved him and our waitress. We all can't wait to go back!
Had brunch with the girls at EJ's. It a first time visit for all of us and we loved it. Already planning our next visit back!
Food was good. Cute lil restaurant. Has that country feel to it. Everyone was very nice.
First time visiting. Was very pleased. They have daily specials which was nice. We really enjoyed our food and will be back.

zaWLteQDRe-qAQJHwcpnuQ.review_text: I love this place. Food is good and not the norm. Great options for vegan/vegetarian!
Good down home food. Eggplant parm pasta and po boy are awesome options for vegetarians!
Great place for vegans and meat eaters alike. We went for breakfast and had a completely plant based meal. It was delicious and we'll definitely be back!

Great place for happy hour. Great drink and food specials. Checked in and tried to use the free drink provided through Yelp and was denied by management with no explanation. Just said we're not accepting Yelp coupons and manager didn't even bother to come and try to explain it to us ‍

So... I would have given 5 stars but customer service was lacking

******* we ended up asking for the manager to find out their policy and she was nice and explained that they don't honor the Yelp coupons because they have so many other promotions. Yelp needs to update this ********
Great soul food, plus it's vegan! I'll support this place every chance I get. Love it

We had such a great experience at Bravo! last night. The staff was friendly, the manager was welcoming and accommodating, and most importantly.... the vegetarian options were awesome! We tried the new veggie meatballs and the eggplant dishes. The veggie meatballs were EVERYTHING. I will be back just to get another order of these. Thanks for thinking of us non meat eaters Bravo!
Best seafood I've had in a long time... and they give you plenty of food! Will definitely be back!
Opened my sausage biscuit only to find that a bite had already been taken out of it. Who does that??

Always delicious! ...and this visit was no exception. I visited on my birthday and we started off with the signature chargrilled oysters. They were so good we ordered another dozen! Then I had the small crab Mediterranean salad... delish! The entrees were all great. Lastly, the staff came out and sung a nola version happy birthday song with a complimentary dessert. Idk what more I could have asked for
We had great time. Visited on Valentines night. We didn't play the simulator this time, but everyone looked to be having fun. The food was really good and the music was good too. We will be back

Many times the food at coffee places don't measure up, and the coffee at breakfast places don't quite measure up either. This place hits a sweet spot with gourmet coffee and an incredibly flavorful breakfast. To top it off it has a drive thru! If you haven't yet, this gem is a must try.
We literally just had the chicken and lamb wraps and they were GREAT! Like really Great. We also had meat pies and spinach pies they both were really good as well. We will be back
Ordered the spaghetti and it came with an Italian salad. Not sure if this meal is worth $17. Plus no bread. Salad was the best thing. Disappointing

Management contacted me and apologized for my experience. They encouraged me to give them another try and I am so glad I did... the fettuccine was great and so were the salads. Plus I received my bread. This is a meal I'll be back for!

Today I ordered the Stingray Trio and it was amazing!! I substituted the fish for redfish for an upcharge and it was worth every cent. It came with the grilled fish, grilled shrimp on a skewer, and 6 chargrilled oysters
Food was AMAZING! This may be our weekly spot. Our favorite was the lamb chop and the sweet chilli shrimp

Juliana's Kitchen

My wife and I were visiting in Wilmington and we're looking through Yelp for a nice place to eat. We'd been in Wilmington two weeks prior and had struck out on a Yelp recommended Hispanic food restaurant so we were hesitant to take a second chance with another, but we're now glad we did. 

It's secondary street location is indicative of its quality as you have to know its there to find it and even when looking for it, it's very easy to drive right past it and miss., yet it now nearing its fourth year in business. 

Simply put, it's quant and very clean. The service and food are great. It's traditional Peruvian fare done very well. We started a fish ceviche which was excellent.  The fish was fresh and firm and the flavors well balanced. My wife's main course came with a bowl of chicken-vegetable soup. Wow! This has to be the best chicken-vegetable soup I've ever had. (I had half her soup.) It was so good that we recommended it to the two couples ordering at the table next to us. They loved it too. 

Our main courses were very good too. She had a fish course and I a meat course. But although we were both very full, we shared a 'Tres Leches' desert. It was fantastic. The cake had great texture and the flavors were spot on. We were stuffed yet finished it. 

Treat yourself to something different, eat here.

They have been open for only 7 weeks as of end of August 2014, so I can understand how the first review might have been right, but my experience on week six was on the money.
 
On our arrival at the location, we were impressed with the nice clean exterior of the building and colorful outdoor umbrellas in the rear outdoor seating area. There is parking right behind the restaurant.
 
We were greeted and seated right away. The interior has been cleanly decorated with a few authentic touches that let you know this is a Puerto Rican restaurant. If you miss the few family photos, the background music is another clue this Puerto Rican food you are about to eat. The family photos also make you feel right at home.
 
Our server was very pleasant, telling us that she was new to her role and enthusiastically said "we'll work through this together" which we did. It was not any work at all and she did a great job. At one point after we ordered our appetizer, two gentlemen walked out of the kitchen and immediately greeted us. They were the owners. We spent a few minutes chatting it up and they showed us around the place and the seating on the second floor, a good place for a party.
 
We ordered the tasting appetizer which is really big enough for 3-4. It had multiple portions of several things which, unless you're familiar with the food, you're not going to recognize by name, so I won't name them. Let me just say that there wasn't a thing on the plate that we didn't like. The kitchen sent out a coupe other tasters that were not on the standard platter and they were great too. Nothing that was fried was greasy. Our lunches were authentic and tasty, with all authentic flavors done in balance.
 
This is high praise for this cuisine as my wife is a fantastic cook and in the many Puerto Rican restaurants we've visited, she's has never come close to having praise for any of them. Yet this time, she could not stop talking about this place. Her exact words were "they nailed it!"
 
It's a BYO-Wine which is another one of my favorite traits of a restaurant. Don't let the bar fool you, it is just a place to pull up and eat. Good if you're eating alone.
 
Come explore this cuisine done well. We are going back this week with a couple of chef friends.

I was hoping for better quality BBQ based on the rating. I had chicken, sausage, brisket and ribs. None were outstanding, just good. 

It's tight quarters and self serve so don't show up with a large party.

We keep coming back to Burn Provecho even though it's a 45 minute ride from our home., it's worth the the time. The food is just that good and  authentic. 

We noticed that the seasoning was kicked up a notch during our last two visits and this is much more to our liking. Let those PR flavors show through. 

All their dishes are great and the portions are  generous. If you're real hungry and like plantains, try the mofongo. Also, the rice with chick peas is perfectly seasoned. 

The appetizers are wonderful too. Try alcapurias and empanadas. 

We're headed back there now. I can't wait!

My wife and I had dinner at Zahav a few months ago. I had become aware of the restaurant through Anthony Bourdain's TV show. With this much hype, I was moderating my expectations, and counting on the fact that Bourdain, who is not generous with his praise, had said all the right things about it.

We went with another couple but arrived early, so we sat at the bar for a drink. My wife ordered a lemon based drink that was out of this world and I had a drink that hand the smokiness and layers of a fine cigar. Someone put a lot of effort into the creation of those drinks and the bar execution was spot on!

Once the other couple arrived, we were seated. As the different dishes arrived the focus of our conversation became the food. It was; "Oh my God, did you try this?" or Who the heck though such and such could taste like that?" and so on. The layering of flavor and texture has been perfected by these folks. 

Because this was our annual "thank you" dinner for our generous neighbors who plow our driveway and won't take a dime in pay, it was even more satisfying to hear them say; "I don't know how you're going to top that one!" I don't know how I'm going to do it either as I have been to less than a hand full of establishments that do food this well.

I'm headed back in July with another couple and can't wait to do it again.

I would have given D'Floret five stars as the food is exceptional and the service was great...up until the last five minutes. At approximate 7:45 we were presented the dessert menu and by 7:50 our desserts and coffee were served. At 7:55 we were informed that we needed to hurry because the 8:00 seating had arrived and were waiting for their table. We managed to get out between 8:05 and 8:10. This ended what was a great evening until then, on a very sour note.

I can bore you with multiple other ways this could've ended much better but I won't. I'll just mention that you should get a clear understanding of the time constraints when booking your reservation to avoid our experience. I would have gladly made my reservation for an earlier time.

Stopped in here for lunch on a Saturday based on the Yelp reviews. We were in the area shopping and wanted to try something new. 

We were their only guests for lunch this holiday Saturday. Not sure if this is usual but lucky for us, our waiter was a foodie and very exited to spend his extra time talking us through their menu and events. Their Saturday lunch menu is very limited but the food was fantastic! We ordered two personal pizzas and a burger. 

It stopped short of rating them four stars because their wine choices are just ok. We're definitely headed back to try them for dinner and to experience choices from their full menu because their chef has peeked our interest in his attention to flavors and preparation. And if all the wait staff is a excited about their food as our waiter was with us, it's bound to be a five-star night.

This was our first time here. We came to have breakfast and were pleasantly surprised, as we didn't really know what to expect by way of food quality. 

My wife have vegetarian frittata which came with a side of house-made hollandaise sauce and breakfast potatoes. She loved her dish. I had a sampler platter that included two eggs, bacon, sausage link, pork roll, breakfast potatoes and two generous sized pancakes another plate. You better be hungry! My over here say eggs were fine right, the meats were tasty as were the potatoes and the pancakes were great. 

The Delaware river view is and added bonus to the food. It's a 45 minute ride but we'll be back over the river from NJ.

We were a party of eight that included two under 10YO children. Our waitress was great! She was attentive and patient. The multiple small dishes were all excellent. We probably had at least 15 different dishes so I won't attempt to list them. The pace of dishes arriving at our table was on target as we never felt rushed or as we were waiting.

We just moved to Nevada and we were fortunate to select Arario for lunch. My beef Bibinbop was delicious. The only improve that I could suggest is the the pot is hotter so that the rice continues to crisp at the table. The pork Bulgogi was also very tasty. 

The service was excellent. We look forward to returning soon.

We went as a party of four. The place is somewhat impersonal. The staff if efficient, mechanical, but not friendly. 

We went with the all-you-can-eat choice. I was disappointed in that the appetizers could me in tiny portions. For example, if it's all you can eat, why bring three pot-stickers for a table of four? 

It was also obvious that our waiter was regulating the volume if food we would eat by regulating the temperature of our grill. We eventually ate enough but if was frustrating to "managed" this way. The meats were good and had the service been different I would've given this establishment 4 Stars.

We've been looking for authentic Taiwanese food. Based on the Yelp recommendations we made the 40 mile trek to try it out. We noticed that the menu includes many small plates, therefore to sample a broad range of flavors, we ordered a range of appetizers that included, braised pork belly, pigs feet, wontons, fried rice (super delicious) and a couple other dishes. I'm happy to report that all our dishes did not disappoint. My wife proclaimed this her new favorite casual place to eat. It's not for everybody but if you enjoy this style of food, do t miss it.

I just completed my third visit to the establishment. Their food is good but the service is completely off. The wait staff friendly but unattentive. This trip, our table was missing a water glass. Our waitress didn't bring one until we called her back. She was graceful taking our order and in making recommendations but failed to tell us that one of our dishes would take a while. The time gap between presenting the first dish and the second was long enough for one of us to be 90% done with our dish while the other waited. The folks seated behind us got their food but had to get their own flatware from another table. 

This is our last visit here as service is a large part of the dining experience.

Stopped here for lunch while in Reno. In brief, the food was good but the service was horrifically slow. 

My wife had a ceviche that she enjoyed. Nothing fancy but very fresh. I had steak with sweet plantains, rice and beans. My dish was also very good except that my steak was salty. 

We'll give it another try because everyone has a bad day.

Visited M&Ms for a second time. We got in this time, meaning that the last time we got there, we discovered that they were closed. Today, they opened one-hour late. Suggestion to owners: It would only take you two minutes to record a voice message indicating your status for the day. We drive an hour to reach you and would like to visit again. 

All that said, I'm happy to report that the food was great. We had fried asparagus, ox tail, mac&cheese, hush puppies and the gumbo. The asparagus was crisp and not greasy, the ox tail comes with rice, in a stew. They were soft, well trimmed and tasty. The mack&cheese and hush puppies are great and the gumbo was flavorful and protein generous. 

Why not a higher rating? Customer experience. Driving from several towns away to arrive at a closed restaurant, advertising it's open, is easily avoidable via my suggestion. I'd like to return and not find it closed again.
